name: EPA-SL GRS Portal
description: Public GRS portal of the Environment Protection Agency Sierra Leone OneEPA Database System. Lists environmental applications, licensed companies, concession maps, and documents (CEDAS).

name: WebGIS Michalovce
description: Public municipal WebGIS map client for the City of Michalovce.

name: Katalóg otvorených dát Mesta Žiliny
description: Dedicated Invipo open data catalog of the City of Žilina, harvested by the national open data portal, publishing machine-readable municipal datasets such as parking occupancy separately from the POMOSAM eGOV site.

name: Otvorené dáta Trenčianskeho samosprávneho kraja
description: Open data download page of Trenčiansky samosprávny kraj, publishing regional datasets from the publication minimum as structured files.

name: Geografický informačný systém TSK
description: Regional GIS map viewer of Trenčiansky samosprávny kraj for the spatial plan (komplexný urbanistický návrh), with related WMS map services.

name: STATdata public database
description: Catalog of indicators maintained by the Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic

name: Open data of the Statistical office of SK
description: Slovak Statistical Office open data portal

name: EnviDat – databáza environmentálnych indikátorov
description: EnviDat environmental indicators database of the Slovak Environment Agency. Time series of about 280 indicators in 14 themes, with tables, charts, and XLS/PNG/SVG export on Enviroportál.

name: NCZI – tematické štatistické výstupy
description: National Health Information Centre thematic statistical outputs. Health indicator tables, datasets (XLSX/ODS), and Power BI infographics covering population health, registries, and health-system statistics.

name: DATAcube Slovakia
description: Statistical Office of Slovakia data catalog

name: SODB 2021 – Sčítanie obyvateľov, domov a bytov
description: Official 2021 Population and Housing Census (SODB 2021) dissemination portal of the Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic. Dashboards, multidimensional tables, municipal profiles, and geospatial census results.

name: Open Data portal of the Ministry of Finance of the Slovak Republic
description: Open data portal of the Ministry of Finance of the Slovak Republic. Publishes financial datasets from the ministry and its budget organisations under an open licence, including budget execution, invoices, orders, public debt, and financial statements.

name: Slovak National Open Data Catalogue
description: Official Slovak Open Data Portal. open data portal. managed by Ministry of Investments, Regional Development and Informatization of the Slovak Republic. powered by Custom software. accessible at data.slovensko.sk.

name: Slov-Lex
description: Official legal and gazette catalog of Slovakia, including the Collection of Laws (Zbierka zákonov).

name: SHMÚ Open Data Server
description: Slovak Hydrometeorological Institute bulk open-data server for weather radar volumes and composites, ALADIN NWP GRIB, station observations, air quality, and alerts.

name: Open Data portal of the Financial Administration of the Slovak Republic
description: Public open-data portal of the Slovak Financial Administration (Finančná správa) publishing tax, customs, debt, eKasa, and related datasets with a public catalog UI.

name: Solargis Maps and GIS Data Download
description: Website providing access to solar, meteorological, and environmental GIS data, map layers, and time series for solar energy site assessment and project development.

name: Národný geoportál
description: National Geoportal of Slovakia (Národný geoportál). Central web access point to spatial data and services of the National Infrastructure for Spatial Information (NIPI) under Act No. 3/2010. Provides search, viewing, and download of public-administration geodata through thematic maps, a metadata-backed dataset catalogue from the Register of Spatial Information (RPI), and a directory of data providers.

name: Register of Spatial Information (RPI)
description: National register of spatial information metadata for Slovakia (INSPIRE discovery service). Provides unified access to metadata about spatial datasets, services, and applications under the National Spatial Information Infrastructure (NIPI).

name: Knowledge Graph of Public Administration Data
description: Central knowledge-graph portal for Slovak public administration data interoperability. Publishes the Central Data Model as linked data, including ontologies describing core registers, semantic taxonomies and code lists, plus example instance data, with SPARQL and REST APIs. Developed since 2021 by the Data Office of MIRRI.

name: mzCloud
description: mzCloud is a web-based mass spectral database designed to support the identification of small molecules using tandem mass spectrometry. It contains an extensively curated collection of high-quality MSⁿ spectra organized into searchable spectral trees, along with compound structures, fragments, and related metadata. Researchers can search the database to match experimental spectra and aid in compound identification, and registered users can build custom spectral libraries.

name: Slovak National Corpus
description: Portal and catalog of the Slovak National Corpus (SNK) at the Ľ. Štúr Institute of Linguistics, listing written, spoken, historical, dialect, and learner corpora of Slovak with public search and registration-based full access.

name: Slovak Archive of Social Data
description: The Slovak Archive of Social Data (SASD), established in 2004, is a national repository dedicated to preserving and providing access to documentation and datasets from sociological and social science research in Slovakia. It archives data from major international programs such as ISSP, ESS, and EVS, as well as Slovak research projects funded by public, private, or commercial sources, provided they meet professional standards.

name: Open data UNSK
description: Open data download page of Nitriansky samosprávny kraj, publishing CSV lists of health, pharmacy, social-service, and subsidy datasets.

name: Karta Örebro kommun
description: Public web map of Orebro Municipality showing local planning, streets, and municipal geographic layers.

name: The V-Dem Dataset
description: Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) dataset portal from the V-Dem Institute at the University of Gothenburg, publishing country-year and coder-level democracy indicators.

name: Organic Materials Database
description: Open electronic-structure database of three-dimensional organic crystals, with search and data-mining tools hosted at Nordita.

name: Kommunatlas
description: Independent comparison service presenting 81 key indicators across eight themes (population, economy and tax, school, care, safety, work, environment, housing) for all 290 Swedish municipalities and 21 regions, with rankings and national comparisons. All statistics are sourced from Kolada (RKA).

name: Försäkringskassans statistikdatabas
description: Queryable database of official social-insurance statistics on sickness benefits, disability, family support, and related Försäkringskassan products.

name: Tillväxtverkets statistikportal om turism
description: Tourism statistics portal with custom table extracts for accommodation, travel and visits, and tourism satellite accounts.

name: Svenska kraftnät Kontrollrummet
description: Live Swedish power-system generation, consumption, and exchange view published by Svenska kraftnät.

name: Nationella emissionsdatabasen
description: Maps, charts, and tables of Swedish territorial greenhouse-gas and air-pollutant emissions allocated to county and municipality level.

name: Kolada
description: Open database of about 6,000 key performance indicators for Swedish municipalities and regions, with comparison tools and a public REST API.

name: SIPRI Arms Transfers Database
description: Queryable database of international transfers of major conventional arms since 1950.

name: Arbetsmiljöverket arbetsskadestatistik
description: Searchable official database of occupational accidents and work-related diseases, with maps, tables, and Excel export by industry, region, cause, age, and sex.

name: Trafikanalys Statistikportalen
description: Interactive portal and open API for official Swedish transport statistics covering road, rail, aviation, maritime, public transport, and communications.

name: Biblioteksstatistik
description: Official Swedish library statistics for public, higher-education, hospital, and special libraries, with organisation-level reports and open linked data.

name: Högskolan i siffror
description: UKÄ interactive statistics on Swedish higher education: students, doctoral education, staff, finance, and key performance indicators, with CSV and Excel export.

name: Vården i siffror
description: National indicator portal for Swedish health and care quality and efficiency, with comparisons across regions, hospitals, municipalities, and quality registers.

name: Brå statistikdatabas över anmälda brott
description: Public query tool for official Swedish statistics on reported offences, with tables and charts by crime type, region, municipality, and time period.

name: Konsumentverket statistik
description: Public consumer complaint and market statistics of the Swedish Consumer Agency.

name: Sveriges miljömål
description: National environmental quality objectives portal with indicators and follow-up for Sweden's 16 environmental goals and generational goal.

name: Utsläpp i siffror
description: Swedish pollutant release and transfer register. Public search of facility emissions and waste transfers.

name: Skolkoll öppna data
description: Independent open data portal for Swedish school statistics, offering 16 downloadable CSV and JSON datasets under CC BY 4.0 with a machine-readable DCAT-AP SE JSON-LD catalog; municipal school economy files are derived from Kolada.

name: National Library of Sweden Open Data Portal
description: Information from the Royal Library's data sources is published on data.kb.se. The material is primarily for those who want to do larger analyses, processing or develop their own services. Most of the material can be downloaded as raw data in open standards.

name: Regeringskansliets rättsdatabaser
description: Legal database of the Government Offices of Sweden, including Svensk författningssamling, the Swedish code of statutes.

name: Öppna data från Arbetsförmedlingen
description: Open data catalog from Arbetsförmedlingen (JobTech Development) with APIs and files for job ads, occupations, skills and labour-market statistics.

name: Gymnasio öppna data
description: Open data catalog of Swedish upper-secondary schools, admission scores, and programme offerings derived from Skolverket and Kolada, with CSV downloads and a DCAT-AP JSON-LD feed harvested by dataportal.se.

name: Riksdagens öppna data
description: Offentliga data från Sveriges riksdag, innehåller bland annat protokoll, anföranden och förslag i Sveriges parlament.

name: PRV Katalog över öppna och delade data
description: Här sammanställer vi öppna och delade data från våra datakällor. Vi strävar efter att följa de principer och riktlinjer som DIGG tagit fram, och att följa öppna standarder så långt det är möjligt. Materialet som är tillgängligt på denna sida är i första hand ämnat för intressenter som vill göra egna bearbetningar och tjänster med hjälp av data som hämtas från PRV. Besök även Sveriges dataportal, där DIGG samlar data från alla svenska myndigheter, samt den officiella portalen för europeiska data.

name: SMHI Open Data Portal
description: Data catalog for Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute, aimed at developers building applications consuming open APIs for meteorological, hydrological, and related climate data.

name: Skogsstyrelsen Kartor
description: Public OpenLayers map catalog of the Swedish Forest Agency.

name: SMHI radar data (Open Data API)
description: SMHI open data API for Swedish weather radar composites and per-site volume scans.

name: Swedish National Research Data Portal
description: Sweden's national portal for finding, sharing, and reusing research data across disciplines, with guidance on research data management and links to leading national research-data infrastructures. Contact via SND at researchdata@snd.se.

name: Riksbank API Portal
description: Sveriges Riksbank developer portal for public REST APIs covering interest rates and exchange rates, turnover statistics, and macroeconomic forecasts. Unregistered use is rate-limited; higher quotas require a free portal account.

name: Trafiklab
description: National developer portal for Swedish public-transport APIs, including static and real-time data from regional transport authorities.

name: Kringla
description: National cultural-heritage search service aggregating museum, archive and library records through the K-samsök (SOCH) API.

name: QoG Data Finder
description: Data catalog of open-source datasets, variables, and visualization tools related to Quality of Government (QoG), including compilations and original datasets.

name: KinMutBase
description: KinMutBase is a database of disease-causing mutations in human protein kinase domains, with mutation statistics, sequence displays, and restriction-site changes. Originally developed at the University of Tampere and now hosted by the Protein Bioinformatics group at Lund University.

name: The Symmetric Functions Catalog
description: The Symmetric Functions Catalog (SymCat) is an online mathematical reference of symmetric functions and related combinatorial objects, maintained at Stockholm University.

name: SWE-CLARIN Knowledge Centre for the Languages of Sweden
description: SWE-CLARIN Knowledge Centre for the Languages of Sweden provides language resources, tools and expert support for Swedish and other languages of Sweden, hosted at Uppsala University.

name: Human Protein Atlas
description: Open map of the human proteome in cells, tissues, and organs using antibody imaging, proteomics, and transcriptomics.

name: Online Database of Quasi-Twisted Codes
description: Searchable database of binary quasi-cyclic and related coding-theory constructions maintained at Kristianstad University.

name: Uppsala Conflict Data Program
description: Public catalog of Uppsala Conflict Data Program datasets on organized violence, georeferenced events, and peace agreements.

name: Antibodypedia
description: Antibodypedia is an open antibody database organised by human gene target, with experimental validation, publications and an evidence-based ranking of reagents.

name: SciLifeLab Data Platform
description: SciLifeLab Data Platform lists tools, databases and other resources for data-driven life science in Sweden, including services, guidance and community material for research data.

name: Substances in Preparations in Nordic Countries (SPIN)
description: SPIN (Substances in Preparations in Nordic Countries) publishes data from the Nordic product registers on chemical substances in preparations, operated with the Swedish Chemicals Agency.

name: Vienna Atomic Line Database
description: VALD (Vienna Atomic Line Database) is a collection of atomic and molecular transition parameters for spectroscopy. The public query service is operated by the Department of Physics and Astronomy at Uppsala University.

name: Plant Genome Integrative Explorer
description: PlantGenIE is a collection of plant genome integrative explorer portals for searching, visualising and analysing genomics and transcriptomics data for species such as poplar, spruce, eucalyptus and Arabidopsis.

name: LTU Magnetotelluric / EPOS-MT
description: Luleå University of Technology magnetotelluric data portal publishing MT site coordinates and electrical conductivity models for the EPOS multi-scale laboratories / geomagnetic community.

name: Bolin Centre Database
description: Open Access to data from the Bolin Centre for Climate Research

name: Metabolic Atlas
description: Metabolic Atlas is a web platform for browsing and comparing curated genome-scale metabolic models, with visualisations and links to related metabolic resources.

name: Coherent X-ray Imaging Data Bank
description: The Coherent X-ray Imaging Data Bank (CXIDB) publishes experimental CXI datasets from X-ray free-electron lasers and other light sources, so that large imaging experiments can be reused and reproduced.

name: FEGA Sweden
description: Swedish node of the Federated European Genome-phenome Archive (FEGA), operated by NBIS. Public catalogue of controlled-access human genetic and phenotypic datasets stored in Sweden; data-access requests are handled through EGA.

name: InParanoidDB
description: InParanoiDB is a database of ortholog and inparalog groups inferred with the InParanoid algorithm across hundreds of eukaryotic proteomes.

name: Mitelman Database of Chromosome Aberrations and Gene Fusions in Cancer
description: Mitelman Database of Chromosome Aberrations and Gene Fusions in Cancer compiles published cytogenetic and gene-fusion cases in human cancers, hosted at ISB-CGC and originating from research at Lund University.

name: SITES data portal
description: Open data portal providing quality-controlled, long-term ecosystem data from research stations in Sweden, covering atmospheric, aquatic, and terrestrial themes. Data are freely available under Creative Commons Attribution license (CCBY) and must be properly cited.

name: FunCoup
description: FunCoup infers genome-wide functional coupling networks for model organisms, covering physical, regulatory and pathway associations between proteins.

name: NOVAC Database
description: Network for Observation of Volcanic and Atmospheric Change (NOVAC) database of volcanic SO2 gas-flux time series. Per-volcano DOI landing pages resolve to this Chalmers-hosted catalog.

name: Swedish National Data Service
description: Realtidsdatakatalog för forskningsdata, etablerad 1980.

name: AIDA Data Hub
description: Data and services for AI innovation in data driven precision health. We are a national e-infrastructure for research and clinical innovation in medical imaging diagnostics AI. The purpose is to gather, annotate, and share large volumes of data necessary in order to enable research, innovation and clinical adoption of world-class AI technology. Also operates a GPU compute system for AI training on sensitive personal data for Swedish researchers.

name: Sundsvalls kommuns datakatalog
description: DCAT-AP catalog API published by Sundsvall Municipality.

name: DataGURU
description: Lund University service for discovering, regridding and downloading environmental and climate datasets, with DOI assignment in collaboration with SND.

name: Zambia 360 Data Access & Sharing Portal
description: Official Ministry of Health Zambia platform (Z360DASP) for discovering and requesting controlled access to curated national health datasets drawn from SmartCare Pro (the national EHR) and the national health data warehouse. Users can browse dataset metadata and request time-bound access to full datasets or selected variables, subject to MoH, IRB, and NHRA approval. Published collections include de-identified client-level records for HIV ART cohorts, COVID-19, immunization, and non-communicable diseases.

name: Bank of Zambia Statistics
description: Bank of Zambia statistics catalog of monetary, financial, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: Zambia EITI Data Portal
description: Zambia EITI Fusion / mainstreaming portal. Interactive public disclosures of extractive-sector revenue, production, and G-Factor for Natural Resources data.

name: ZamData - National Data Portal
description: Zambia's national catalog of government data registers (ZamData) on the Government Service Bus. It publishes National Data Registers (NDRs), semantic entities, classifiers, and operations across identity, business, land, agriculture, health, and other domains so agencies can discover and reuse government data.

name: Information and Communication University Research Repository
description: Information and Communication University research repository of departmental collections and scholarly publications.

name: Zambia National ETD Portal
description: Zambia National Electronic Theses and Dissertations (ZANETD) portal. Aggregates ETD metadata harvested via OAI-PMH from higher-education institutional repositories across Zambia.

name: Zambian Open University Repository
description: Zambian Open University institutional repository of academic research output, theses, and dissertations.

name: Syria Education Indicators Portal (EduCators)
description: EduCators (EDUcation indiCATORS) is a civil-society portal of education performance indicators for Syria across elementary, preparatory, secondary, and university levels, compiled from educational institutes and government establishments.

name: Syrian Planning and Statistics Commission
description: Official statistics website of the Syrian Planning and Statistics Commission (هيئة التخطيط والإحصاء), the national statistical office formed in 2025 from the former Central Bureau of Statistics. Publishes economic, social, and demographic indicators, time series, and the statistical yearbook.

name: OpenSyria
description: Public data commons for source-cited Syrian reference datasets covering administrative geography, universities, transport locations, and telecom numbering. Offers downloads and a documented read-only REST API with no registration or API key required.

name: UBOS Dissemination Portal
description: Official UBOS dissemination portal for census, survey, and national indicator products, including the interactive National Population and Housing Census 2024 explorer.

name: Bank of Uganda Statistics
description: Bank of Uganda statistics catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic tables.

name: Uganda Budget Information
description: Ministry of Finance budget portal with a dashboard and an Excel download catalog of approved budgets and outturns for the national government, local governments and facilities.

name: Freshwater Biodiversity Portal for Uganda
description: National freshwater biodiversity data portal for Uganda, publishing fish occurrence, composition, and habitat datasets from lakes, rivers, and wetlands.

name: Sudan Soil Information System (SUSIS)
description: Sudan Soil Information System (SUSIS), created in 2016, is the national repository for collecting, storing, and sharing soil and land-resource information that previously existed only as scattered hard-copy maps, reports, and databases. Publishes regional soil datasets (East, Kordofan, North, North Darfur, South, and South Darfur) at 0–30, 30–60, and 60–100 cm depths. Some products are downloadable; others are available on request. No public machine-readable catalog API was found.

name: Balochistan Geo Land Information System
description: Interactive land parcel map for Balochistan digital land settlement (Quetta, Sibi, and Loralai divisions), hosted as LandInfo.

name: Gilgit-Baltistan Mines and Minerals Map
description: Public Leaflet mining-cadastre map of Gilgit-Baltistan mineral titles, including study, applied, exploration, mining, and reserved areas by mineral type and scale.

name: NIPS Public Microdata
description: National Institute of Population Studies public microdata catalog, including Pakistan DHS and maternal-mortality survey files.

name: Pakistan Agricultural Input-Output Tables
description: Public statistical tables from the PBS agricultural input-output study, including farm size, crop costs, livestock, and prices.

name: Karandaaz Data Portal
description: Financial inclusion and macroeconomic indicators portal operated by Karandaaz Pakistan. Publishes time series on demographics, national accounts, commodities, telecommunications, banking, microfinance, SME and housing finance, mobile money, capital markets, and energy, plus Karandaaz survey dashboards.

name: National Open Data Portal (NODP)
description: Education statistics portal of the Pakistan Institute of Education under the Ministry of Federal Education and Professional Training. Despite the National Open Data Portal title, it disseminates education indicators and is intended to integrate provincial EMIS databases for researchers, policymakers, and the public.

name: Pakistan Diaspora Database Dashboard
description: PBS diaspora database with migration, remittance, and overseas Pakistani statistics, reports, and downloads.

name: Pakistan Migration Trends
description: Interactive census explorer of internal and international migration flows by district, sex, reason, and duration of stay.

name: Pakistan HIES and PSLM Dashboard
description: PBS household survey dashboard for HIES and PSLM indicators on education, health, housing, and sanitation, with provincial and district views and downloads.

name: Pakistan Crime Statistics
description: PBS crime statistics dashboard with provincial time series of reported crime.

name: Data for Development
description: Sustainable Development Policy Institute Data for Development catalog of Pakistani survey and development datasets.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Bureau of Statistics Data Portal
description: Official Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Bureau of Statistics data portal of sector indicators, publications, and MICS microdata.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Forest Monitoring System
description: Public Leaflet GIS of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Forest Monitoring System with KP boundary, multi-year forest masks and LULC, NFI sample plots, and deforestation hotspots.

name: Koh-e-Atlas Karachi
description: Open shapefile atlas of Karachi socio-economic, urban, climate, and transport layers from Habib University DAR Lab, with downloadable town, population, waterway, and bus-route datasets.

name: Sindh Irrigation GIS Web Application
description: Public GIS web application of the Sindh Irrigation Department Hydro Informatics Centre, with canal, flood, crop, and river layers.

name: Punjab Planning Support System
description: Provincial land-use and zoning geoportal for notified district plans covering 159 cities, 150 towns, and 37 districts in Punjab.

name: PULSE Punjab Land Information System
description: Public GIS parcel map of Punjab covering divisions, districts, tehsils, and development-authority housing societies (LDA, MDA, FDA, RDA, GDA).

name: SIAT Statistics Portal of Uzbekistan
description: SIAT (Statistika axborot-tahlil tizimi) is the integrated statistics portal of Uzbekistan. It publishes official indicators with SDMX metadata and machine-readable downloads (Excel, CSV, JSON, XML, PDF). The REST API lists statistical themes and more than 3,000 indicator series.

name: Central Bank of Uzbekistan Statistics
description: Central Bank of Uzbekistan statistics catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: Open Data Portal of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: National Open Data Portal of the Republic of Uzbekistan. Publishes machine-readable government datasets from ministries and agencies in CSV, Excel, XML, JSON, and RDF. Operated under Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 232 of 7 August 2015, with technical support from the Ministry of Digital Technologies.

name: GIS Geoportal of the State Urban Cadastre of Uzbekistan
description: Geographic information system geoportal of the State Urban Cadastre (Davlat shaharsozlik kadastri / ГГК) of Uzbekistan. Publishes urban-planning layers, cadastral maps, and related spatial data. Public map layers are available without login; full use requires administrator-issued accounts. The site returned HTTP 403 to automated clients on 24 August 2026.

name: Public Geoportal of the Cadastre Agency of Uzbekistan
description: Public national geoinformation portal of the Cadastre Agency of Uzbekistan. Provides access to open information from the state register of rights to real estate (cadastral numbers, addresses, and land use) through the National Geographic Information System. Some services require identification via id.egov.uz and may be charged for non-government users. The REST map services themselves are recorded separately as db.ngis.uz.

name: SFA Fisheries Information Management System
description: Public Fisheries Information Management System of the Seychelles Fisheries Authority. Dashboards publish licensing, catch, trade, and revenue statistics with downloadable tables. A separate login is used for the staff/secure view.

name: BitMEX Public Data
description: Public file catalog of BitMEX historical market data.

name: OKX historical market data
description: Download catalog of OKX historical trades, candlesticks, funding rates, order books, and borrowing rates.

name: MEXC market data download
description: Download catalog of free historical MEXC spot chart data for all trading pairs, at daily and monthly intervals.

name: KuCoin Data Collection
description: Public file catalog of KuCoin market data, published as daily and monthly archives.

name: Bitget history data download
description: Download catalog of Bitget spot and futures candlesticks, transaction history, and order-book depth.

name: UMBRELLA Seychelles LDN Platform
description: Land Degradation Neutrality monitoring platform for Seychelles, developed under the GEF/UNEP Umbrella project with the Sahara and Sahel Observatory. Public geoportal, dashboard, and open-data sections integrate environmental and geospatial layers used for UNCCD and SDG 15.3.1 reporting.

name: Ecosystemology
description: Public Shiny catalog of ecosystem types derived from the Seychelles BIO database. Ecosystemology lists eco-species names, stand occurrences, maps, IUCN and BIO typologies, and potential KBA triggers.

name: Seychelles Plant Gallery
description: Seychelles Plant Gallery of the National Herbarium. Public species and image catalog linked to the BIO/herbarium database, with thematic galleries (native, endemic, threatened, lost) and a species list. Image search also runs at shiny.bio.gov.sc/biogallery/.

name: University of Seychelles ResearchConnect
description: Custom Next.js institutional repository of the University of Seychelles. Public catalog of research outputs, faculty profiles, research units, and student theses (148 records listed). No DSpace, EPrints, or OAI-PMH interface.

name: Flora of Seychelles
description: Public Shiny catalog of the Seychelles National Herbarium BIO database. Flora of Seychelles lists species occurrences, area-of-interest maps, species statistics, and the national Red List (app version bioflora 1.3, seychecklist v1.9). Companion occurrence maps are at /biodistrib/.

name: Szczecin Spatial Information System
description: Szczecin Spatial Information System. Provides access to spatial data, maps, and geographic information for the City of Szczecin.

name: Wrocław Spatial Information System
description: Wrocław Spatial Information System. Allows searching, browsing, and downloading spatial datasets and plan metadata, including land use, local plans, public amenities, transportation, and more.

name: System Informacji Przestrzennej Wałbrzych
description: Municipal spatial information system of Wałbrzych providing an interactive city geoportal.

name: WebEWID Wałbrzych
description: WebEWID cadastral and surveying portal of the City of Wałbrzych, publishing land registry and related spatial data.

name: Otwarte Dane Miasta Rzeszów
description: Portal otwartych danych miasta Rzeszów, zawierający zbiory danych publikowane przez Urząd Miasta Rzeszowa.

name: Portal Otwartych Danych Miejskich w Przemyślu
description: Portal otwartych danych miasta Przemyśl, zawierający zbiory danych publikowane przez Urząd Miejski w Przemyślu oraz inne instytucje miejskie.

name: GIS Białystok
description: Municipal Spatial Information System of Białystok. Provides interactive map services and WMS layers covering addresses, buildings, spatial plans, cadastre, transport, environment, and orthophotos.

name: Geoportal Województwa Opolskiego
description: Official geoportal of the Opole Voivodeship (Urząd Marszałkowski Województwa Opolskiego), providing regional maps and spatial datasets. Harvested by data.europa.eu as catalogue opole.

name: Otwarte dane - Urząd Miasta Łodzi
description: Catalog of open data managed by the City of Łódź Office (Urząd Miasta Łodzi)

name: Otwarte Dane Olsztyn
description: Independent catalog of City of Olsztyn open data published by the Olsztyn.com.pl news portal. It presents municipal organizational units, alcohol licenses, nurseries, hotels, vehicle plates, presidential ordinances, and public WiFi hotspots, sourced from the official city open data portal.

name: Geoportal Miasta Elbląg
description: Official interactive geoportal of the City of Elbląg, publishing municipal spatial data and map layers.

name: Platforma Danych Miasta Kielce
description: Official open data portal of the City of Kielce, providing access to open datasets published by Kielce City Hall on environment, mobility, health, economy, finance, safety, and housing.

name: Zielonogórski System Informacji Przestrzennej
description: Municipal spatial information system of Zielona Góra with an interactive geoportal and planning modules.

name: Geoportal Województwa Lubuskiego
description: GIS geoportal of the Lubusz Voivodeship providing public access to regional spatial data and map services.

name: Otwarte Dane Poznań
description: Public open data platform of the City of Poznań (Otwarte Dane), publishing municipal datasets and APIs on environment, mobility, society, quality of life, digital city services, economy, and 3D spatial data.

name: RZIIP AKO data registers (GeoARA)
description: Data registers of the Regional Integrated Spatial Information Infrastructure of the Kalisz-Ostrów Agglomeration (RZIIP AKO). The GeoARA application publishes spatial and tabular registers for the agglomeration's 23 local governments.

name: Lublin Spatial Information System
description: Lublin Spatial Information System. Provides access to spatial data, maps, and geographic information for the City of Lublin.

name: Statistics Poland research microdata
description: Statistics Poland service for unidentifiable microdata used in scientific research. Social-statistics and census files are provided to universities and research institutes on application, for a fee, through TransGUS or the on-site research workstation.

name: Statystyczne Vademecum Samorządowca (SVS)
description: Statistical Vademecum of Local Government (Statystyczne Vademecum Samorządowca, SVS) is Statistics Poland's interactive indicator browser for municipalities, cities with county rights, counties, voivodships, and functional areas. The knotting complexity of proteins is presented in the form of a matrix diagram that shows users the knot type of the entire polypeptide chain and of each of its subchains. The database presents extensive information about the biological function of proteins with non-trivial knotting and enables users to analyze new structures.

name: Base of Scientific Achievements University of Agriculture in Krakow
description:
Scientific Output Database of the University of Agriculture in Krakow (URK)

The Scientific Output Database of the University of Agriculture in Krakow is an institutional repository that collects, manages, and disseminates information about the research achievements of the university's academic staff and PhD students.

The database includes:

scientific publications (articles, books, book chapters, monographs),

patents and patent applications,

research projects,

conference papers and presentations,

other scientific and scholarly outputs.

Its main objectives are to:

document and promote the research activity at URK,

support internal and national research assessment processes,

enhance the visibility and accessibility of research results through integration with national and international systems (e.g., ORCID, POL-on, OpenAIRE).

The repository contributes to the open science movement by enabling open access to scientific knowledge and fostering transparency in research.

name: Repository of University of Life Sciences in Lublin

name: LinkProt: A database of proteins with topological links
description: LinkProt collects information about protein chains and complexes that form links. LinkProt detects deterministic links (with loops closed by cysteine), and determines likelihood of formation of links in networks of protein chains called MacroLinks. Links are presented graphically in an intuitive way, using tools that involves surfaces of minimal area spanned on closed loops. The database presents extensive information about biological functions of proteins with links and enables users to analyze new structures.

name: Atlas of Open Science Resources

It provides open access to a broad range of scientific resources, including publications, research datasets, databases, multimedia, software-related files, and educational materials across fields such as engineering, medicine, life sciences, computer science, and the humanities.

name: miRNEST

The data comes from our computational predictions (new miRNAs, targets, mirtrons, miRNA gene structures) as well as from other databases and publications.

name: Proteome-pI 2.0 -  Proteome Isoelectric Point Database
description: Proteome-pI 2.0 is an updated version of an online database (Proteome-pI [http://isoelectricpointdb.org/]) containing the information about predicted isoelectric points. The isoelectric point, the pH at which a particular molecule carries no net electrical charge, is an important parameter for many analytical biochemistry and proteomics techniques, especially for 2D gel electrophoresis (2D-PAGE), capillary isoelectric focusing, liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry, and X-ray protein crystallography. The database allows the retrieval of virtual 2D-PAGE plots and the development of customized fractions of proteome based on isoelectric point and molecular weight. Moreover, Proteome-pI 2.0 facilitates statistical comparisons of the various prediction methods as well as biological investigation of protein isoelectric point space in all kingdoms of life. The database includes various statistics and tools for interactive browsing, searching, and sorting. It can be searched and browsed by organism name, average isoelectric point, molecular weight, or amino acid frequencies. Proteins with extreme pI values are also available. For individual proteomes, users can retrieve proteins of interest given the method, isoelectric point, and molecular weight ranges (this particular feature can be highly useful to limit potential targets in the analysis of 2DPAGE gels or before conducting mass spectrometry). Finally, some general statistics (total number of proteins, amino acids, average sequence length, amino acid, and di-amino acid frequencies) and datasets corresponding to major protein databases such as UniProtKB/TrEMBL and the NCBI non-redundant (nr) database have also been precalculated.

name: eCUDO Polish Open Research Data Repository
description:
The eCUDO.pl project is created by a consortium of Project partners. These are research units, scientific institutes and universities whose scientific activity focuses on the area of knowledge related to the seas and oceans. The genesis of the project was the desire to make these resources available to a wide range of interested parties, not only those from the scientific and industrial sectors, but also ordinary citizens interested in oceanographic issues.
Partner institutions have collected a huge amount of data as part of their research activities. The result of this idea is a database prepared by us and a dedicated application. The data covers the broadest possible spectrum of information on the environment of the Baltic Sea and other maritime areas. The application allows you to search for information about data based on many criteria. The retrieved data can be easily downloaded or used directly via web services in other map portals or projects.The eCUDO.pl portal is practically the only place on the web where information from the Baltic area and beyond has been collected from various scientific disciplines, such as: physics, chemistry, biology, meteorology, climatology, geology. The huge amount of data already collected will be updated and successively supplemented with the acquired new data sets.

name: North American Breeding Bird Survey

name: Integrated Resource for Reproducibility in Macromolecular Crystallography

The IRRMC identifies, catalogs and provides metadata related to datasets that could be used to reprocess the original diffraction data. The intent of this project is to make the resulting three-dimensional structures more reproducible and easier to modify and improve as processing methods advance.

In most cases, the images found in this system were taken by and loaned to us by photographers other than ourselves. Most are in the realm of public sector images.

name: Center for Engineering Strong Motion Data
description: Archive of processed strong-motion records for structural and earthquake engineering, operated jointly with the California Geological Survey.

name: National Park Service Geographic Information Systems
description: The I&M GIS group of NPS manages the collection, analysis, and distribution of I&M, NPS, and related geospatial data to I&M networks, the NPS, and the public. Develops, collects, and shares helpful GIS tools, extensions, and applications with I&M networks, the NPS, and the public.

name: The Arabidopsis Gene Regulatory Information Server
description: The Arabidopsis Gene Regulatory Information Server (AGRIS) is a information resource of Arabidopsis promoter sequences, transcription factors and their target genes. AGRIS currently contains two databases, AtcisDB (Arabidopsis thaliana cis-regulatory database) and AtTFDB (Arabidopsis thaliana transcription factor database). The two databases, used in tandem, provide a powerful tool for use in continuous research.

name: VertNet
description: VertNet is a NSF-funded collaborative project that makes biodiversity data free and available on the web. VertNet is a tool designed to help people discover, capture, and publish biodiversity data. It is also the core of a collaboration between hundreds of biocollections that contribute biodiversity data and work together to improve it. VertNet is an engine for training current and future professionals to use and build upon best practices in data quality, curation, research, and data publishing.

name: JGI Secondary Metabolism Collaboratory
description: The Secondary Metabolism Collaboratory (SMC) is a public, searchable repository of biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) sequence data across bacteria, archaea, and other organisms. It catalogs millions of predicted BGCs from publicly available genomes and allows users to explore gene and domain annotations, search by taxonomy or compound type, and programmatically access the data via APIs.

name: RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Database
description: Compiled stock assessment results for commercially exploited marine populations worldwide.

name: Cacao Genome Database
description: The Cacao Genome Database (CGD) is a database storing information on the genome of Theobroma cacao. The sequenced genotype, Matina 1-6, is representative of the genetic background most commonly found in the cacao producing countries, enabling results to be applied to current commercial cultivars. Before viewing the data, users have to agree that they will not seek any intellectual property protection over the data, including gene sequences contained in the database. The Information Access Agreement allows any cacao breeders and other researchers to freely use the genome information to develop new cacao varieties. This allows for a level playing field and a healthy competitive environment that will ultimately benefit the sustainability of cacao production in the long term.

name: World Religion Database
description: The World Religion Database (WRD) contains detailed statistics on religious affiliation for every country of the world. It provides information from country censuses as well as best estimates for every religion to offer a definitive picture of religion and non-religion in the past, present, and future.

name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information - formerly: National Oceanographic Data Center
description: The National Oceanographic Data Center includes the National Coastal Data Development Center (NCDDC) and the NOAA Central Library, which are integrated to provide access to the world's most comprehensive sources of marine environmental data and information.

name: NASA Ames PAH IR Spectroscopic Database
description: Collaboration between the astronomers, laboratory chemists and theoretical chemists at the facilities of NASA's Ames Research Center resulted in the collection of PAH spectra known as The NASA Ames PAH IR Spectroscopic Database. Collaboration with different institutes, across several countries, helped mature the database and allowed for the construction of the web-portal with its data and tools. Initially intended for astronomers to explain the astronomical unidentified infrared bands and to investigate the "PAH hypothesis", now the spectral data and developed paradigms prove also valuable to, e.g., chemists, environmentalists, pharmacologists and nano-technologists.

name: NIAID-DOE LANL HIV Database and Analysis Unit
description: The objective of this repository is to (a) provide a centralized resource of comprehensive data on HIV genetic sequences and immunological epitopes by compiling, annotating, and maintaining a relational database, and (b) develop HIV sequence and molecular immunology analysis methods and tools with searchable web interfaces to assist with design and development of vaccine and therapies.

name: Oak Ridge National Laboratory (managed by NASA) Scientific Data Repository
description: Assembles, distributes, and provides data services for a comprehensive archive of terrestrial biogeochemistry and ecological dynamics observations and models to facilitate research, education, and decision-making in support of NASA’s Earth science.

name: Ontobee
description: A linked data server designed for ontologies. Ontobee is aimed to facilitate ontology data sharing, visualization, query, integration, and analysis. Ontobee dynamically dereferences and presents individual ontology term URIs to (i) HTML web pages for user-friendly web browsing and navigation, and to (ii) RDF source code for Semantic Web applications. Ontobee is the default linked data server for most OBO Foundry library ontologies. Ontobee has also been used for many non-OBO ontologies.

name: FaceBase
description: FaceBase is a collaborative NIDCR-funded consortium to generate data in support of advancing research into craniofacial development and malformation. It serves as a community resource by generating large datasets of a variety of types and making them available to the wider research community via this website. Practices emphasize a comprehensive and multidisciplinary approach to understanding the developmental processes that create the face. The data offered spotlights high-throughput genetic, molecular, biological, imaging and computational techniques. One of the missions of this consortium is to facilitate cooperation and collaboration between projects.

name: Neuroscience Information Framework
description: NIF maintains the largest searchable collection of neuroscience data, the largest catalog of biomedical resources, and the largest ontology for neuroscience on the web.

name: Addgene
description: Addgene is a non-profit plasmid repository dedicated to helping scientists around the world share high-quality plasmids. Addgene are working with thousands of laboratories to assemble a high-quality library of published plasmids for use in research and discovery. By linking plasmids with articles, scientists can always find data related to the materials they request.

name: ModBase database of comparative protein structure models
description: ModBase (https://salilab.org/modbase) is a database of annotated comparative protein structure models. The models are calculated by ModPipe, an automated modeling pipeline that relies primarily on Modeller for fold assignment, sequence-structure alignment, model building, and model assessment (https://salilab.org/modeller/). ModBase currently contains almost 30 million reliable models for domains in 4.7 million unique protein sequences. ModBase allows users to compute or update comparative models on demand, through an interface to the ModWeb modeling server (https://salilab.org/modweb).

name: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions
description: The Digital Library of Mathematical Functions (DLMF) Project was initiated to perform a complete revision of Abramowitz and Stegun’s Handbook of Mathematical Functions with Formulas, Graphs, and Mathematical Tables, published in 1964 by the National Bureau of Standards. The DLMF Project has updated and expanded the coverage for current needs.

name: Berkeley Drosophila Genome Project insitu
description: In early 2010 we updated the site to facilitate more rapid transfer of our data to the public database and focus our efforts on the core mission of providing expression pattern images to the research community. The original database https://www.fruitfly.org/index.html reproduced functions available on FlyBase, complicating our updates by the requirement to re-synchronize with FlyBase updates.

name: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Scientific and Technical Information Scientific Data Repository
description: OSTI.GOV is the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Scientific and Technical Information search platform for DOE-funded scientific and technical research outputs, including data, software, reports, and publications.

name: Drosophila Synthetic Population Resource
description: The Drosophila Synthetic Population Resource (DSPR) is a research resource and database of over 1,700 recombinant inbred lines of Drosophila melanogaster, derived from multiple sequenced founder lines to capture extensive genetic variation. It provides high‑resolution genotype and genetic map data to help researchers dissect the genetic basis of complex traits and perform quantitative trait loci (QTL) mapping. The resource also includes analytical tools and documentation to support genetic and genomic studies in the Drosophila research community.

name: National Center for Earth-Surface Dynamics Data Repository
description: In its 10-year tenure, NCED has made major contributions to the growth of Earth-Surface Dynamics (ESD) through direct research in three Integrated Programs (IP) of Streams, Watersheds and Deltas.

name: Polar Geospatial Center Data Archives
description: The Polar Geospatial Center (PGC) Data Archive makes research data regarding both poles available by working with researchers on mapping and remote sensing projects in the most remote locations on Earth. The archive of many open data products such as digital elevation models, historic and contemporary polar maps, and historic aerial photography. Open data is available at no cost. Licensed data, namely commercial satellite imagery, is available to PGC core users only.

name: English Lexicon Project
description: English Lexicon Project (Washington University): behavioral megastudy database with downloadable lexical decision and naming datasets for 40k+ words.

name: Complete Genomics
description: Complete Genomics provides free public access to a variety of whole human genome data sets generated from Complete Genomics’ sequencing service. The research community can explore and familiarize themselves with the quality of these data sets, review the data formats provided from our sequencing service, and augment their own research with additional summaries of genomic variation across a panel of diverse individuals.

name: IMPACT Cyber Trust
description: DHS-coordinated catalog of cybersecurity datasets and tools for cyber-risk research, with mediated access for approved researchers.

name: Database of small human non-coding RNAs
description: Integrated annotation and sequencing-based expression data for all major classes of human small non-coding RNAs (sncRNAs) for both full sncRNA transcripts and mature sncRNA products derived from these larger RNAs.

name: OpenEI
description: The Open Energy Information (OpenEI.org) initiative is a free, open source knowledge-sharing platform created to facilitate access to data, models, tools, and information that accelerate the transition to clean energy systems through informed decisions.

name: CiteSeerX
description: CiteSeerX, operated by Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence, provides research data on engineering sciences, computer science, and computer science, electrical and system engineering.

name: Childhood Cancer Data Initiative Hub
description: The Childhood Cancer Data Initiative (CCDI) Hub serves as an entry point for researchers, data scientists, and citizen scientists seeking to utilize and connect with CCDI-related data. It offers information about available tools and applications that align with the CCDI vision, as well as descriptions of resources, each focusing on specific aspects of childhood cancer research.

name: ACE Science Center
description: The ACE Science Center (ASC) is a data archive and processing center for measurements collected by the Advanced Composition Explorer (ACE) spacecraft. It provides access to space science data related to the solar wind, energetic particles, and cosmic rays. The center processes, documents, and distributes calibrated datasets to support research in heliophysics and space physics. It ensures long-term preservation and public availability of ACE mission data for the scientific community.

name: Project Achilles
description: Project Achilles is a systematic effort aimed at identifying and cataloging genetic vulnerabilities across hundreds of genomically characterized cancer cell lines. The project uses genome-wide genetic perturbation reagents (shRNAs or Cas9/sgRNAs) to silence or knock-out individual genes and identify those genes that affect cell survival.

name: National Trauma Data Bank
description: The NTDB, run by the American College of Surgeons, is the largest collection of trauma-registry data in the U.S., aggregating millions of anonymized patient records from hundreds of trauma centers. It includes data for both pediatric and adult patients from all levels of trauma centers, capturing demographics, injury details, treatments, outcomes (including mortality), and hospital events.

name: LacCore
description: LacCore curates cores and samples from continental coring and drilling expeditions around the world, and also archives metadata and contact information for cores stored at other institutions.LacCore curates cores and samples from continental coring and drilling expeditions around the world, and also archives metadata and contact information for cores stored at other institutions.

name: Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO)
description: GEO is a public functional genomics data repository supporting MIAME-compliant data submissions. Array- and sequence-based data are accepted. Tools are provided to help users query and download experiments and curated gene expression profiles.

name: Mozilla Data Collective
description: Community-governed catalog of multilingual and cultural datasets, harvested into CLARIN VLO.

name: Protocols.io Research Protocol Repository
description: A secure platform for developing and sharing reproducible methods. A research protocol is a document that describes the background, rationale, objectives, design, methodology, statistical considerations, and organization of a clinical research project.

name: Greenland Climate Network
description: The Greenland Climate Network provides year-round data on the climate of Greenland's ice sheet. These data are available to researchers by request through the Greenland Climate Network Data Request Web page. GC-Net data, previously hosted by CIRES, have now been moved to WSL’s Envidat data repository.

name: SuiteSparse Matrix Collection
description: The SuiteSparse Matrix Collection (formerly known as the University of Florida Sparse Matrix Collection), is a large and actively growing set of sparse matrices that arise in real applications. The Collection is widely used by the numerical linear algebra community for the development and performance evaluation of sparse matrix algorithms. It allows for robust and repeatable experiments: robust because performance results with artificially-generated matrices can be misleading, and repeatable because matrices are curated and made publicly available in many formats.

name: NIST JARVIS
description: Joint Automated Repository for Various Integrated Simulations, a NIST catalog of materials datasets, tools, and workflows.

name: Primate Aging Database
description: The Primate Aging Database (PAD) is a web-based searchable database that contains body composition, blood chemistry, and other biological data collected across the lifespans of healthy non-human primates (NHPs) in captivity and in wild populations. The PAD was developed to study aging in NHPs and can be used for analyses of species and sex differences in normal aging processes, the examination of the impact of diet and environment on aging, studies on biomarkers of aging, and the establishment of a normal range for comparison to values obtained from experimental or diseased groups.

name: NIST Atomic Spectra Database
description: NIST Physical Measurement Laboratory database of critically evaluated atomic energy levels, wavelengths, and transition probabilities.

name: Polar Rock Repository Database
description: The Polar Rock Repository (PRR) is a research collection hosted by the Byrd Polar and Climate Research Center at Ohio State University, funded by the National Science Foundation’s Office of Polar Programs. It offers access to over 60,000 rock, core and dredge samples collected from Antarctica and the Southern Ocean, along with associated field notes, maps, thin sections and media. The online database enables researchers and educators to discover and request these materials for study or teaching.

name: Atmosphere to Electrons Data Archive and Portal
description: Atmosphere to Electrons (A2e) Data Archive and Portal for U.S. Department of Energy wind-energy experimental, observational, and modeling datasets.

name: Database of Interacting Proteins
description: The database of interacting protein (DIP) database stores experimentally determined interactions between proteins. It combines information from a variety of sources to create a single, consistent set of protein-protein interactions. The data stored within the DIP database were curated, both manually by expert curators and automatically using computational approaches that utilize the the knowledge about the protein-protein interaction networks extracted from the core DIP data.

name: Solar Dynamics Observatory
description: The Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) is a NASA mission launched in 2010 to study the Sun and its influence on Earth and the solar system. It continuously observes the Sun in high resolution, capturing detailed images and measurements of the solar atmosphere, magnetic fields, and energy output. SDO data helps scientists understand solar activity such as sunspots, flares, and coronal mass ejections. The mission provides open, real-time data that supports both scientific research and space-weather forecasting.

name: DatabasE of StruCtuRe and functIon residue-Based prEdictions of PROTeins
description: The DescribePROT database provides access to amino acid-level annotations of protein structure and function, which include 3 experimentally validated and 19 putative characteristics. It covers hundreds of complete proteomes of popular and model organisms. Users can search it in multiple ways, interact with the data using an interactive graphical interface, and download data at various scales including individual proteins, entire proteomes, and whole database. The annotations in DescribePROT are useful for a broad spectrum of studies that include investigations of protein structure and function, development and validation of predictive tools, and supporting efforts in understanding molecular underpinnings of diseases and development of therapeutics.

name: OpenAQ
description: OpenAQ is a global open-access air quality database that aggregates and harmonizes real-time and historical ground-level air pollution measurements from thousands of sources around the world. It provides this data in a standardized, machine-readable format that anyone can access via an interactive map tool (OpenAQ Explorer) or the OpenAQ API. They also provide an R client and a Python SDK to access the API.

name: CoMSES Computational Model Library
description: Our mission is to help computational modelers at all levels engage in the establishment and adoption of community standards and good practices for developing and sharing computational models. Model authors can freely publish their model source code in the Computational Model Library alongside narrative documentation, open science metadata, and other emerging open science norms that facilitate software citation, reproducibility, interoperability, and reuse.

name: Integrated Microbial Genomes / Viral Resources
description: Since 2016, the IMG/VR database has provided access to the largest collection of viral sequences obtained from (meta)genomes. The 3rd version of IMG/VR (Sept 2020) is composed of 18,373 cultivated and 2,314,329 uncultivated viral genomes (UViGs), nearly tripling the total number of sequences compared to the previous version. UViGs in IMG/VR are reported as single viral contigs, integrated proviruses, or genome bins, and are annotated with a new standardized pipeline including genome quality estimation using CheckV, taxonomic classification reflecting the latest ICTV update, and expanded host taxonomy prediction. The new IMG/VR interface enables users to efficiently browse, search, and select UViGs based on genome features and/or sequence similarity.

name: MPContribs
description: Community contribution platform for publishing and browsing materials datasets associated with the Materials Project.

name: Structural Biology Data Grid
description: The Structural Biology Data Grid (SBGrid-DG) community-driven repository to preserve primary experimental datasets that support scientific publications. The SBGrid Data Bank is an open source research data management system enabling Structural Biologists to preserve x-ray diffraction data and to make it accessible to the broad research community.

name: Surveillance Epidemiology of Coronavirus (COVID-19) Under Research Exclusion - IBD
description: Surveillance Epidemiology of Coronavirus Under Research Exclusion (SECURE-IBD) is an international, pediatric and adult database to monitor and report on outcomes of COVID-19 occurring in IBD patients. The goals of the registry is to rapidly define the impact of COVID-19 on patients with IBD and how factors such as age, comorbidities, and IBD treatments impact COVID outcomes.

name: Human Salivary Proteome Wiki
description: The Human Salivary Proteome Wiki is a a NIDCR-funded collaborative, community-based Web portal to more than 1,000 unique human saliva proteins identified by high-throughput proteomic technologies. The wiki is available for the research community and the public to harness the knowledge in the data and to further enhance the value of the proteome through addition of their own data. You are very welcome to share your thoughts in the forums; add your own data to the growing database; annotate the proteins; or just explore the site.

name: EcoliWiki
description: Community wiki database of E. coli K-12 gene and protein information, gene lists and strain data (Colipedia).

name: Materials Project
description: Computed materials properties database of known and predicted inorganic crystals, with interactive search and API access.

name: Standard Application Process (SAP) Data Catalog
description: The SAP Data Catalog provides a searchable inventory of confidential datasets held by the 16 U.S. federal statistical agencies, describing each dataset's content, methodology, access conditions, and availability. Rather than storing the data itself, the catalog helps researchers discover relevant data assets and submit standardized applications for access to restricted-use datasets. It is designed to streamline and harmonize access to confidential federal statistical data for approved research projects.

name: MiST 4.0: Microbial Signal Transduction database
description:
Signal transduction systems in bacteria and archaea link environmental stimuli to specific adaptive cellular responses. They control gene expression, motility, biofilm formation, development and other processes that are vital to survival. The microbial signal transduction (MiST) database is an online resource that stores tens of thousands of genomes and allows users to explore their signal transduction profiles, analyze genomes in bulk using the database application programming interface (API) and make testable hypotheses about the functions of newly identified signaling systems. However, signal transduction in metagenomes remained completely unexplored. To lay the foundation for research in metagenomic signal transduction, we have prepared a new release of the MiST database, MiST 4.0, which features over 10 000 metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs), a scaled representation of proteins and detailed BioSample information. In addition, several thousand new genomes have been processed and added to the database, bringing the total to over 202,000 genomes now available in MiST. A new interface has been developed that allows users to seamlessly switch between genomes and MAGs. Starting from MiST 4.0, the database incorporates updates to the NCBI taxonomy reflecting the inclusion of the rank "phylum" in the International Code of Nomenclature for Prokaryotes, which involved changes to 42 taxa.

MiST 4.0 is freely accessible at https://mistdb.com; genomes and MAGs can also be explored using the API available on the same page.

name: TreeSnap
description: Invasive diseases and pests threaten the health of America’s forests. Scientists are working to understand what allows some individual trees to survive, but they need to find healthy, resilient trees in the forest to study. That’s where concerned foresters, landowners, and citizens (you!) can help. Tag trees you find in your community, on your property, or out in the wild using TreeSnap! Scientists will use the data you collect to locate trees for research projects like studying the genetic diversity of tree species and building better tree breeding programs.

name: Tropical Cyclone Information System
description: The JPL Tropical Cyclone Information System is being actively developed to help scientists improve their understanding and forecasting of hurricanes. It has two components: a set of near real-time portals that integrate model forecast with multi-parameter satellite and airborne observations from a variety of instruments and platforms, providing interactive visualization and some on-line analysis tools that work with both observations and models, and a 12-year global archive of multi-satellite hurricane observations.

name: Human Mortality Database
description: The Human Mortality Database (HMD) is the data resource on mortality in developed countries. The HMD provides detailed high-quality harmonized mortality and population estimates to researchers, students, journalists, policy analysts, and others interested in human longevity. The HMD follows open data principles.

name: Time-sharing Experiments for the Social Sciences
description: Time-sharing Experiments for the Social Sciences (TESS) offers researchers the opportunity to capture the internal validity of experiments while also realizing the benefits of working with a large, diverse population of research participants.

name: NIST Interatomic Potentials Repository
description: Curated catalog of interatomic potentials and force fields for atomistic simulation, with evaluation data and downloadable implementations.

name: Legacy Archive for Microwave Background Data Analysis
description: LAMBDA is a part of NASA's High Energy Astrophysics Science Archive Research Center (HEASARC). LAMBDA is a multi-mission NASA center of expertise for cosmic microwave background radiation research. LAMBDA exists to serve the CMB research community, and the greater cosmological research community.

name: Protein Sequence Culling Server
description:
The Protein Sequence Culling Server (PISCES) is a database with a simple filter-and-download interface created to produce lists of sequences from the Protein Data Bank (PDB) using a number of entry- and chain-specific criteria and mutual sequence identity. The purpose of the database is to provide the longest list possible of the highest resolution structures that fulfil certain sequence identity and structural quality cut-offs. It uses a combination of PSI-BLAST and structure-based alignments to determine sequence identities. PISCES has two ways of producing subsets of sequences from larger sets: 
1. Subsets of protein chains and sequences culled from the entire PDB according to structure quality and maximum mutual sequence identity, and 
2. Subsets of protein chains and sequences culled from a list of PDB chains or PDB entries input by the user, according to structure quality and maximum mutual sequence identity

name: UNAVCO
description: The NSF GAGE Facility promotes research by providing access to data that our community of geodetic scientists uses for quantifying the motions of rock, ice and water that are monitored by a variety of sensor types at or near the Earth's surface. After processing, these data enable millimeter-scale surface motion detection and monitoring at discrete points, and high-resolution strain imagery over areas of tens of square meters to hundreds of square kilometers.

name: Spitzer Heritage Archive
description: Spitzer is the final mission in NASA's Great Observatories Program - a family of four orbiting observatories, each observing the Universe in a different kind of light (visible, gamma rays, X-rays, and infrared). Spitzer is also a part of NASA's Astronomical Search for Origins Program, designed to provide information which will help us understand our cosmic roots, and how galaxies, stars and planets develop and form.

name: Space Physics Data Facility
description: The Space Physics Data Facility (SPDF) leads in the design and implementation of unique multi-mission and multi-disciplinary data services and software to strategically advance NASA's solar-terrestrial program, to extend our science understanding of the structure, physics and dynamics of the Heliosphere of our Sun and to support the science missions of NASA's Heliophysics Great Observatory.

name: Invasive.org Invasive Species Image Database
description: invasive.org is a project of the University of Georgia’s Center for Invasive Species and Ecosystem Health and one of the four major parts of BugwoodImages. The Focus is on invasive and exotic species of North America. This can be animals, plants, insects, and pathogens. It provides an easily accessible archive of high quality images for use in educational applications.

name: Dietary Supplement Label Database
description: The Dietary Supplement Label Database was developed by the American Office of Dietary Supplements at the National Institutes of Health. This database includes printed on more than 200 thousand labels of dietary supplement products sold in the United States.

name: Loeb Music Library
description: The Loeb Music Library digitizes scores and libretti selected for their rare or unique natures and their popularity as objects of research and teaching.

name: Docker Hub
description: Docker Hub is a library and community for sharing container images. It currently contains over 100,000 container images from software vendors, open-source projects, and the community. It has become a common way of sharing bioinformatics tools and resources in a way that reduces the difficulty of running these tools in a compute environment with the correct software dependencies.

name: Repository of AUC Digital Collections, Archives and Research
description: Repository of AUC Digital Collections, Archives and Research is a scientific data repository, operated by Atlanta University Center, publishing datasets and related research documentation.

name: Geochemical Earth Reference Model
description: Geochemical Earth Reference Model contains summary data on the geochemistry of all reservoirs in the Earth. All search results are customizable, allowing the user to sort and convert units and to download the data in a format of your choice with one click. This relational database only includes peer-reviewed data.

name: Planetary Data System
description: The Planetary Data System (PDS) is a long-term archive of digital data products returned from NASA's planetary missions, and from other kinds of flight and ground-based data acquisitions, including laboratory experiments. But it is more than just a facility - the archive is actively managed by planetary scientists to help ensure its usefulness and usability by the world wide planetary science community.

name: SOFIA
description: SOFIA, operated by United States Department of the Interior, provides research data on microbiology, virology and immunology, microbial ecology and applied microbiology, and biology.

name: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Image and Video Gallery
description: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) Image and Video Gallery is a catalog of the images, video and audio available from NASA. It provides a simple search interface as well as web services for accessing the resources.

name: Databrary
description: Databrary is a restricted access data library that is specialized for storing, streaming, and sharing video and audio recordings collected as research data or documentation. Databrary supports sharing of many types of research data and documentation beyond video and audio. Based at New York University, Databrary's mission is to support data sharing among researchers in the behavioral, social, educational, developmental, neural, and computer sciences.

name: Toxicology Excellence for Risk Assessment
description: ITER is an Internet database of human health risk values and cancer classifications for over 680 chemicals of environmental concern from multiple organizations wordwide. ITER is the only database that presents risk data in a tabular format for easy comparison, along with a synopsis explaining differences in data and a link to each organization for more information.

name: Gene Expression Nervous System Atlas
description: The GENSAT project aims to map the expression of genes in the central nervous system of the mouse, using both in situ hybridization and transgenic mouse techniques. It is a collection of pictorial gene expression maps of the brain and spinal cord of the mouse. Using EGFP BAC-transgenics, this project provides the scientific community with tools to catalog, map, and electrophysiologically record from individual cells.

name: Pennsieve
description: Cloud-based platform for scientific data management, analysis, and publication with publicly discoverable datasets.

name: The PrimePages: prime number research & records
description: The site maintains a list of the 5000 largest known prime numbers which is updated hourly, and provides a collection of research, records and results all about prime numbers.

name: Signaling Pathways Project
description: The Signaling Pathways Project is an integrated 'omics knowledgebase based upon public, manually curated transcriptomic and cistromic (ChIP-Seq) datasets involving genetic and small molecule manipulations of cellular receptors, enzymes and transcription factors. Our goal is to create a resource where scientists can routinely generate research hypotheses or validate bench data relevant to cellular signaling pathways.

name: BioSimulations
description: BioSimulations is a web application for sharing and re-using biomodels, simulations, and visualizations of simulations results. BioSimulations supports a wide range of modeling frameworks (e.g., kinetic, constraint-based, and logical modeling), model formats (e.g., BNGL, CellML, SBML), and simulation tools (e.g., COPASI, libRoadRunner/tellurium, NFSim, VCell). BioSimulations aims to help researchers discover published models that might be useful for their research and quickly try them via a simple web-based interface.

name: Surveillance Epidemiology and End Results
description: A premier source for United States cancer statistics, SEER gathers information related to incidence, prevalence, and survival from specific geographic areas that represent 28 percent of the population, as well as compiles related reports and reports on the national cancer mortality rates. Their aim is to provide information related to cancer statistics and decrease the burden of cancer in the national population. SEER has been collecting data from cancer cases since 1973.

name: Knockout Mouse Project
description: Knockout mutant mice strains. The KOMP repository is a resource of mouse embryonic stem (ES) cells containing a null mutation in every gene in the mouse genome. The KOMP collection of mice, ES Cells, and vectors are now distributed through the Mutant Mouse Resource and Research Center at UC Davis.

name: Shared Platform for Antibiotic Research and Knowledge
description: SPARK is a free, openly accessible resource for scientists studying antibiotics for Gram-negative bacteria.

name: Geoscience Data Exchange at NSF NCAR
description: The Geoscience Data Exchange at NSF NCAR contains a large and diverse collection of meteorological and oceanographic observations, operational and reanalysis model outputs, and remote sensing datasets to support atmospheric and geosciences research.

name: Pallter Marine Data Catalog
description: Catalog index page of the Pallter Marine Data Catalog

name: NCBI Sequence Read Archive
description: Largest public repository of high-throughput sequencing reads, including raw data and alignments across organisms.

name: Comprehensive Large Array-data Stewardship System
description: The Comprehensive Large Array-data Stewardship System (CLASS) is designed to support long-term, secure preservation and standards-based access to environmental data collections and information. Developed by NOAA, CLASS distributes NOAA and US Department of Defense (DoD) Polar-orbiting Operational Environmental Satellite (POES) data, NOAA's Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite (GOES) data, and derived data.

name: NCBI BioProject
description: Catalog of biological research projects at NCBI, grouping related data across archives such as SRA, Assembly, and GEO.

name: Predictive Networks
description: Integration, navigation, visualization, and analysis of gene interaction networks. This record has been marked as "Uncertain" because its homepage no longer exists. If you have any information on the current status of this resource, please contact us via the "Ask Question" button at the top of this page, or contact us through any of the methods described in the footer.

name: iGEM Registry of Standard Biological Parts
description: The iGEM Parts Registry is a growing collection of genetic parts that can be mixed and matched to build synthetic biology devices and systems.
