BALSA houses curated, user-created Study datasets, extensively analyzed neuroimaging data associated with published figures and Reference datasets mapped to brain atlas surfaces and volumes in human and nonhuman primates as a general resource (e.g., published cortical parcellations). ConnectomeDB powered by BALSA is designed for distributing HCP-Young Adult and related HCP-style processed imaging and phenotypic datasets. Datasets in BALSA may include PMID and/or DOI that links them directly to relevant publications.

name: Restriction enzymes and methylases database
description: A collection of information about restriction enzymes and related proteins. It contains published and unpublished references, recognition and cleavage sites, isoschizomers, commercial availability, methylation sensitivity, crystal, genome, and sequence data.

name: Bioregistry
description: The Bioregistry is an open source, community curated registry, meta-registry, and compact identifier resolver.

name: COVID-19 Registry
description: The COVID-19 Registry is a research project that aims to provide real-time information on the spread of COVID-19, who is being affected, and how.

name: Federal Land Manager Environmental database
description: The Federal Land Manager Environmental Database (FED) is an environmental data platform developed by the Cooperative Institute for Research in the Atmosphere at Colorado State University. It provides access to air quality, atmospheric, and emissions-related data to support federal land managers in assessing environmental impacts, particularly visibility and air pollution effects on protected areas. The database integrates monitoring data, modeling outputs, and analytical tools to assist in regulatory and environmental decision-making.

name: Madrigal Database
description: The OpenMadrigal project seeks to develop and support an on-line database for geospace data. The project has been led by MIT Haystack Observatory since 1980, but now has active support from Jicamarca Observatory and other community members. Madrigal is a robust, World Wide Web based system capable of managing and serving archival and real-time data, in a variety of formats, from a wide range of ground-based instruments.

name: SkinRegeneration
description: Collection of gene expression datasets for normal and regenerating murine skin

name: National Center for Science and Engineering Statistics Data Explorer
description: Public database providing detailed information about the employment, education, and demographic characteristics of the nation's highly educated personnel.

name: NOAA's Atlantic Oceanographic and Meterological  Laboratory Data
description: AOML data on the climate, environment and meteorological patterns and changes.

name: Integrated Ocean Observing System National Data Portal
description: The Integrated Ocean Observing System National Data Portal (IOOS.us) contains data from a variety of technologies and data collection systems. The national IOOS data products accessible from IOOS.us include data collected from buoys, high frequency radar systems and gliders. Modeling teams across regional associations also create data products including physical and environmental models of coastal systems. The IOOS.us portal includes the IOOS Catalog, the IOOS Model Viewer, the Environmental Sensor Map, and a number of additional data products.

name: ChemIDplus
description: ChemIDplus is a web-based search system that provides access to structure and nomenclature authority files used for the identification of chemical substances cited in National Library of Medicine (NLM) databases. It also provides structure searching and direct links to many biomedical resources at NLM and on the Internet for chemicals of interest.

name: MolSSI QCArchive
description: MolSSI quantum chemistry results archive for computed molecular properties and datasets.

name: Jason Virtual Van
description: Jason is a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) deep-diving vessel that gives shipboard scientists immediate, real-time access to the sea floor. Jason is connected by a long fiberoptic tether to its research ship. The 10-km (6 mile) tether delivers power and instructions to Jason and fetches data from it. As part of the Jason ROV project, the Virtual Van data acquisition system was developed to automatically captures the information in the control-van during ROV operations including up to four simultaneous video sources, vehicle data, scientific instrument data, and event data. All this information is accessible via a web-browser in real-time and is also available to the scientists after the cruise for post-cruise data access and analysis.

name: NARSTO
description: NARSTO is dedicated to improving management of air quality in North America. NARSTO is working to improve collaboration between the air-quality and health-sciences research communities, to advance understanding of the scientific issues involved in effecting a multi-pollutant/multi-media approach to air quality management, and to increase understanding of the linkages between air quality and climate change. NARSTO is represented by private and public organizations in Canada, Mexico, and the United States. NARSTO was terminated as of December 31, 2010. While data remain available via the original NARSTO Data Archive, the permanent data archive is maintained by the NASA Langley Research Center Atmospheric Science Data Center at https://eosweb.larc.nasa.gov/project/narsto/narsto_table

name: U.S. GLOBal Ocean ECosystems Dynamics
description: Global Ocean Ecosystem Dynamics (GLOBEC) is the International Geosphere-Biosphere Programme (IGBP) core project responsible for understanding how global change will affect the abundance, diversity and productivity of marine populations. The programme was initiated by SCOR and the IOC of UNESCO in 1991, to understand how global change will affect the abundance, diversity and productivity of marine populations comprising a major component of oceanic ecosystems.

name: Exome Aggregation Consortium Browser
description: The Exome Aggregation Consortium (ExAC) is a coalition of investigators seeking to aggregate and harmonize exome sequencing data from a variety of large-scale sequencing projects, and to make summary data available for the wider scientific community. The ExAC Browser spans 60,706 unrelated individuals sequenced as part of various disease-specific and population genetic studies. All of the raw data from these projects have been reprocessed through the same pipeline, and jointly variant-called to increase consistency across projects.

name: U.S. Energy Information Administration
description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) collects, analyzes, and disseminates independent and impartial energy information to promote sound policymaking, efficient markets, and public understanding of energy and its interaction with the economy and the environment.

name: IPM Images
description: IPM Images is a project of the University of Georgia’s Center for Invasive Species and Ecosystem Health and one of the four major parts of BugwoodImages. The Focus is on Integrated Pest Management. It provides an easily accessible archive of high quality images for use in educational applications. In most cases, the images found in this system were taken by and loaned to us by photographers other than ourselves. Most are in the realm of public sector images.

name: Funder Registry
description: The Funder Registry is an open registry of persistent identifiers for grant-giving organizations around the world. FundRef is the result of collaboration between funding agencies and publishers that correlates grants and other funding with the scholarly output of that support. Publishers participating in FundRef add funding data to the bibliographic metadata they already provide to Crossref for reference linking. FundRef data includes the name of the funder and a grant or award number. Metadata includes funder names, alternate names, and abbreviations.

name: caArray
description: The National Cancer Institute (NCI) Center for Biomedical Informatics and Information Technology (CBIIT) instance of the caArray database was retired on March 31st, 2015. All publicly-accessible caArray data and annotations will be archived and will remain available via FTP download https://wiki.nci.nih.gov/x/UYHeDQ and is also available at GEO http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/ .

name: Forest Ecosystem Monitoring Cooperative (FEMC) Data Archive
description: The FEMC Data Archive houses hundreds of research and monitoring projects and datasets related to forest ecosystems in the northeastern US. Built using EML, OGC standards, and DataONE practices; supports Creative Commons licensing and long-term archiving.

name: Atlas of Life (Vermont Atlas of Life)
description: Vermont Atlas of Life (VAL) - biodiversity portal for occurrences, datasets, species, citations, contributors, and images; part of the Vermont Center for Ecostudies (VCE). Data are published via the companion IPT at ipt.vtatlasoflife.org.

name: English Corpora Collection
description: Catalog and query interface for large English corpora including COCA, COHA, NOW, GloWbE, and related collections.

name: Massachusetts Data Hub
description: The Data Hub connects users to data and reports published by Massachusetts state agencies. Search for data of interest, check out our featured content, or browse by topic.

name: GIS Data - City of Cambridge, Massachusetts
description: City of Cambridge GIS data portal with over two hundred different data layers integrated across nearly every department. Provides GIS Data Dictionary with detailed descriptions, download links in various GIS file formats (ESRI Shapefile, File Geodatabase, GeoJSON, etc.), and access through ArcGIS Online and Open Data portal. Includes interactive maps and 3D data.

name: The Boston Region MPO data catalog
description: Data catalog provided by Central Transportation Planning Staff (CTPS)

name: Global China Databases
description: Directory of Boston University databases on China's overseas development finance and other global China economic activity.

name: MIT GeoData Repository
description: Online interface to search for and download GIS data held by MIT GIS Services, including data from MIT and partner institutions. Some data may be restricted to the MIT community. Formerly at geodata.mit.edu.

name: MBTA Developers
description: MBTA developer catalog of the V3 JSON API, GTFS, GTFS-Realtime, and historical performance datasets for Greater Boston transit.

name: Rapid7 Open Data
description: Project Sonar internet-wide scan datasets covering DNS, TLS, HTTP, and related internet measurements.

name: Reality Commons
description: MIT Media Lab repository of reality-mining and social-physics datasets from mobile phones, bluetooth encounters, and related traces.

name: MOPHIMS / MICA
description: Missouri Public Health Information Management System (MOPHIMS) and Missouri Information for Community Assessment (MICA) for community health profiles, vital statistics, and environmental health tracking.

name: Missouri Education Data Explorer
description: Missouri Education Data Explorer with school, district, and statewide enrollment, assessment, attendance, and outcome data from the Department of Elementary and Secondary Education.

name: City of St. Louis Open Data
description: A collection of City datasets by topic, department, and format

name: Open Independence
description: Open Independence publishes City of Independence, Missouri datasets including permits, licenses, inspections, and property data with API access.

name: Missouri Accountability Portal
description: Missouri Accountability Portal for tracking state expenditures, contracts, and tax-dollar spending.

name: MSTAHRS (Mississippi Statistically Automated Health Resource System)
description: Web-based query system from the Mississippi State Department of Health for vital statistics. Users can produce tables, graphs, and maps for births, pregnancies, deaths, infant deaths, early elective deliveries, population, marriages, and divorces by year, demographics, and place of residence. Cells with fewer than five events are suppressed.

name: Mississippi Succeeds Report Card
description: Statewide school and district accountability catalog from the Mississippi Department of Education. Includes A-F grades, student achievement, growth, and spreadsheet downloads for school years 2017-18 through 2024-25.

name: MDPS Public Release Data
description: Public release datasets from the Mississippi Department of Public Safety, published as Excel and CSV extracts used to respond to public records requests. Includes crash, arrest, and citation data without personally identifiable information.

name: Transparency Mississippi
description: Statewide financial transparency portal with expenditures, contracts, and grants search under the Mississippi Accountability and Transparency Act.

name: MARIS Data Download
description: Statewide GIS download catalog of the Mississippi Automated Resource Information System. Free shapefiles covering boundaries, parcels, elevation, imagery, transportation, hydrology, and other Mississippi layers. Operated by the MARIS Technical Center at the Mississippi Institutions of Higher Learning.

name: OASIS
description: Online Analytical Statistical Information System with Georgia public health indicators, vital statistics, maps, and query tools from the Department of Public Health.

name: Georgia Insights
description: Georgia Department of Education dashboards, data files, and reports for school and district performance.

name: GOSA Downloadable Data Repository
description: Downloadable school and district report card files and dashboard source data from the Governor's Office of Student Achievement.

name: Georgia Open Government Data Portal
description: Georgia spending transparency portal for salaries, travel reimbursements, payments, obligations, and key budget reports from state agencies.

name: Georgia GIS Data Clearinghouse
description: Statewide geospatial data clearinghouse for downloading Georgia aerial imagery, roads, utilities, geology, and other GIS layers.

name: MARTA App Developer Resources
description: MARTA developer catalog of GTFS schedules, bus GTFS-Realtime, and the rail realtime arrivals REST API (API key required for rail).

name: Comparative RNA Web
description: Comparative RNA Web (CRW) Site is a scientific RNA structure and sequence resource hosted by Georgia Institute of Technology, providing comparative sequence analysis data for ribosomal and other RNAs.

name: Khazana
description: Computational materials knowledgebase of atomistic structure and property datasets, including polymer datasets for machine-learning research.

name: Montana Census and Economic Information Center
description: Census and Economic Information Center (CEIC) at the Montana Department of Commerce. State Data Center for demographic, housing, business, and economic statistics, analysis, and maps for Montana.

name: GEMS — Growth and Enhancement of Montana Students
description: Growth and Enhancement of Montana Students (GEMS) provides access to data collected from Montana's educational community, including school and district statistics used by the Office of Public Instruction, educators, and the public.

name: Montana DPHHS Interactive Dashboards
description: Montana Department of Public Health and Human Services interactive dashboards covering Medicaid, public assistance (SNAP/TANF), child welfare, vital statistics, communicable disease, and Community Health Insights county indicators.

name: MSU CHSD Data Hub
description: Montana Community Health Services Development (CHSD) Data Hub at Montana State University. Community Health Needs Assessment reports, implementation plans, and related health indicator maps for Montana critical access hospitals.

name: Montana State Library Data Catalog
description: Discover and access digital spatial data for Montana, including GIS datasets, aerial photos, lidar, soil data, and more. Organizations can also publish data by registering as a Data List Publisher.

name: Ravalli County GIS Data Downloads
description: Ravalli County GIS public download catalog (Data For Nothing) providing shapefile and geodatabase zips for addresses, cadastral parcels, transportation, and related county GIS layers at no charge.

name: Montana Natural Heritage Program Map Viewer
description: Montana Natural Heritage Program Map Viewer for species observations, habitats, wetlands, land cover, and environmental summary reports. A program of the Montana State Library Natural Resource Information System.

name: Montana State Library GIS Data List
description: Montana State Library GIS Data List. Searchable metadata catalog for Montana Spatial Data Infrastructure (MSDI) datasets including boundaries, cadastral, imagery, elevation, hydrography, and other statewide GIS layers.

name: Montana Ground Water Information Center
description: Montana Ground Water Information Center (GWIC) at the Montana Bureau of Mines and Geology. Statewide repository of well-completion reports, water-level measurements, well-performance data, and water-quality samples for Montana groundwater resources.

name: Montana Climate Office
description: Montana Climate Office provides climate, drought, and water resources information, including the Montana Mesonet network of weather and soil-moisture stations and an OGC API Features endpoint for latest station observations.

name: Minnesota SLEDS
description: Statewide Longitudinal Education Data System matching pre-kindergarten through postsecondary and workforce records to report education and employment outcomes.

name: Minnesota Public Health Data Access
description: Minnesota Environmental Public Health Tracking portal with interactive charts, maps, and queries for environmental hazards, exposures, and health outcomes.

name: Minnesota LCC-GIS
description: Legislative Coordinating Commission GIS office providing Minnesota legislative, congressional, and election district maps and downloads.

name: PGC FRIDGE
description: Polar Geospatial Center FRIDGE portal for searching and downloading ArcticDEM and REMA elevation products. Licensed commercial satellite imagery requires NSF Office of Polar Programs access.

name: Minnesota Natural Resource Atlas
description: Interactive map and data catalog of Minnesota natural resource layers from the University of Minnesota Natural Resources Research Institute.

name: Duluth Transit Authority Developer Resources
description: DTA developer catalog of GTFS Static and GTFS-Realtime (alerts, trip updates, vehicle positions). Distinct from the DTA ArcGIS Hub.

name: Candidate Cancer Gene Database
description: The Candidate Cancer Gene Database (CCGD) disseminates results of transposon-based forward genetic screens in mice that identify candidate cancer genes, so researchers can check whether a gene has been flagged as a potential cancer driver.

name: MiTracking
description: Michigan Environmental Public Health Tracking query portal with downloadable tables, charts, and maps for environmental hazards, exposures, and health outcomes.

name: MI School Data
description: Official State of Michigan public portal for pre-K, K-12, postsecondary, and workforce education data with statewide, ISD, district, school, and college reports.

name: Michigan Vital Statistics
description: Official Michigan vital statistics and community health tables covering births, deaths, cancer, hospitalization, and county health profiles.

name: ICPSR (Inter-university Consortium for Political and Social Research)
description: Multi-disciplinary social sciences data repository hosted at the University of Michigan. The ICPSR data catalogue contains over 16,000 studies associated with approximately 85,000 datasets, covering topics like social media, politics, economics, social sciences, government, GIS, and more.

name: Materials Commons
description: Collaborative platform for sharing and publishing materials science datasets from the PRISMS center and partner groups.

name: openICPSR
description: A research data-sharing service for social and behavioral sciences allowing public access to research data at no charge.

name: KYSTATS
description: Kentucky Center for Statistics public reports, labor market information, and downloadable education and workforce data files from the statewide longitudinal data system.

name: Kentucky Cancer Registry
description: Official SEER and NPCR population-based cancer registry for Kentucky, with public county incidence and mortality rates.

name: KDE Open House
description: Kentucky Department of Education downloadable School Report Card and supplemental K-12 datasets from school year 2011-2012 onward.

name: KYTC TRAK Data Hub
description: Kentucky Transportation Cabinet TRAK data hub with downloadable transportation datasets including bridges, construction contracts, and highway plan authorizations.

name: COVDATA
description: City of Covington's open data hub providing facts, figures, and maps related to life within the city, including public safety, revenues & expenses, economic development, and more.

name: Kentucky CPE Data Portal
description: Open data portal for Kentucky public postsecondary education, including enrollment, completions, and related higher-education datasets from the Council on Postsecondary Education.

name: OpenDoor
description: Statewide transparency portal for Kentucky executive-branch expenditures, contracts, and employee salaries.

name: WRIS Portal
description: Kentucky Infrastructure Authority Water Resource Information System portal for drinking water, wastewater, and infrastructure project data.

name: Kentucky Mine Mapping Information System
description: Public catalog of Kentucky coal mine maps, mined-out areas, mine portals, and oil and gas well GIS downloads.

name: Alaska Satellite Facility Search Portal
description: The Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF) operates the NASA archive of SAR data and provides services to researchers supporting NASA's ESDIS project. The Search Portal allows access, discovery, and download of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data products.

name: GINA Alaska Direct Broadcast Satellite Data Portal
description: GINA Alaska Direct Broadcast Satellite Data Portal for near-real-time satellite imagery products covering Alaska and adjacent oceans.

name: Alaska Mapped
description: Alaska Mapped imagery and elevation portal from the Statewide Digital Mapping Initiative and UAF Geographic Information Network of Alaska (GINA).

name: Alaska DGGS Geologic Publications and Data Catalog
description: Public search catalog for Alaska Division of Geological and Geophysical Surveys publications, maps, and geospatial datasets, backed by the GERILA enterprise database.

name: Alaska Native Language Archive
description: Catalog of documentation on Alaska Native languages, including manuscripts, publications, and audio recordings.

name: Digital Atlas of Southern Guam
description: Digital atlas of southern Guam (land south of the Pago-Adelup fault) with themed maps and downloadable GIS, GeoTIFF, and Google Earth files for watersheds, streams, geology, vegetation, and related environmental layers. Built by WERI and Island Research and Education Initiative (iREi).

name: Digital Atlas of Northern Guam
description: Digital atlas of northern Guam (land north of the Pago-Adelup fault) with themed maps and downloadable GIS, GeoTIFF, and Google Earth files for topography, geology, hydrology, karst, land cover, and the Northern Guam Lens Aquifer. Built by WERI and Island Research and Education Initiative (iREi). hydroguam.net is only a splash page that links here and to the southern atlas.

name: GraniteStats
description: New Hampshire Employment Security labor market information system with unemployment, labor force, employment and wages, projections, population, income, commuting, occupational profiles, and related statewide statistics by state, county, town, labor market area, and planning region.

name: NH Health and Human Services Data Portal
description: Interactive New Hampshire DHHS portal (formerly NH Health WISDOM) with health and social services indicators, dashboards, maps, and time-trend analysis at town, county, and state levels.

name: UNH Data Discovery Center
description: Digital library providing access to atmospheric, aquatic, and terrestrial sensor data, imagery, model results, and survey data generated by the New Hampshire EPSCoR program and the New England Sustainability Consortium (NEST) collaboration with Maine and Rhode Island EPSCoR.

name: San Marino National Office of Statistics
description: Official statistics portal of San Marino's National Office of Statistics (Ufficio Nazionale di Statistica), established in 2025 from the former Ufficio Informatica, Tecnologia, Dati e Statistica. Publishes population, labour, economic, price, tourism, education, health, and transport indicators, statistical publications, and the IMF e-GDDS National Summary Data Page with SDMX downloads.

name: Nghe An province open data portal
description: Official open data portal of Nghệ An Province (data.nghean.gov.vn), the designated point for publishing open data from provincial state agencies. Not a CKAN API.

name: Vinh Phuc urban planning and development GIS
description: Public Vinh Phuc construction-planning GIS covering the cities of Vĩnh Yên and Phúc Yên and the province's rural districts, with parcel lookup and planning layers.

name: Ha Tinh Map Database GIS
description: Public GIS application for Ha Tinh's map database.

name: Hanoi planning information system
description: Official Hanoi city planning information system (trial operation), publishing urban and land-use planning maps and dossiers for public lookup.

name: Dong Nai Provincial Atlas
description: Public provincial atlas of Dong Nai with a map catalog covering administration, natural resources, population, and economy.

name: Ho Chi Minh City construction GIS planning lookup
description: Public ArcGIS JavaScript planning-lookup map (DPA) of Ho Chi Minh City construction GIS, used to query urban planning information.

name: HCMGIS Maps
description: Public map search application of HCMGIS. Guest users can search map layers. Search is served by search.hcmgis.vn.

name: Binh Dinh Province open data portal
description: Official open data catalog of Bình Định Province, publishing provincial government datasets for public use.

name: Lang Son Provincial Atlas
description: Public provincial atlas of Lang Son (AtlasLangSon).

name: Bac Giang Province Open Data Portal
description: Official open data portal of Bắc Giang Province, publishing provincial government datasets.

name: Thanh Hoa CSDL TNMT geoportal
description: Provincial natural resources and environment spatial database (CSDL TNMT) of Thanh Hóa, with a public WebGIS application alongside an admin console.

name: Ba Ria - Vung Tau Provincial Atlas
description: Public provincial atlas of Ba Ria - Vung Tau with a browsable map catalog on ArcGIS.

name: Viet Nam Sustainable Development Goals
description: Public Sustainable Development Goals indicator explorer covering 17 composite goals and 95 sub-indicators for Vietnam's 63 provinces, with charts, metadata, and data download. Operated by the independent Institute for Social Economic and Sustainable Research (ISESR), not the official GSO SDG database.

name: 2021 Economic Census Data Warehouse
description: Public data warehouse of Vietnam's 2021 Economic Census. Users browse multidimensional tables of enterprises, non-farm household businesses, and related units and export results to Excel.

name: 2019 Population and Housing Census Dashboard
description: Interactive dashboard of Vietnam's 2019 Population and Housing Census, with charts of population, marriage, fertility, mortality, migration, education, labour, and housing indicators by administrative level. Built by the National Statistics Office with UNFPA support. Also served at dashboard.nso.gov.vn.

name: Ministry of Justice Open Data Portal
description: Open data catalog of Vietnam's Ministry of Justice, publishing legal and civil-status data categories.

name: National Administration of Science and Technology Information open data portal
description: Shared data infrastructure of the Digital Vietnamese Knowledge System (Tri thức Việt số), publishing open datasets on tourism, health, land, education, science, and public administration.

name: Mekong Delta Regional Data Portal
description: Tecotec portal of thematic datasets for the Mekong Delta, including observation, remote sensing, hydrometeorology, land use, and disaster damage.

name: Kịch bản biến đổi khí hậu Việt Nam (Vietnam Climate Change Scenarios)
description: Official WebGIS of Vietnam climate change and sea level rise scenarios based on IPCC AR6. Maps and data cover temperature, precipitation, climate extremes, sea level rise, and flood risk to 2100 under SSP scenarios, with a documented data API.

name: SMAP GIS Cloud (GeoAI land valuation)
description: Web GIS application operated by Smap Group (SMAP) for GeoAI-assisted land valuation and planning lookup in Vietnam. The former GeoNode / GeoServer stack on www.giscloud.vn is no longer exposed; the public site is a custom mapping application.

name: Vietnam administrative boundary spatial database
description: National administrative-boundary spatial database of Vietnam, with a public OpenLayers map lookup and a documented client API for integrating boundary maps and related services.

name: APIX Vietnam API hub
description: Commercial API marketplace operated by Kalapa Joint Stock Company, listing identity, KYC, and other business APIs for Vietnam.

name: Openscience.vn research data platform
description: National platform for sharing scientific and technological research datasets (VinIF / VAST / NASATI).

name: Da Nang City open data portal
description: Official open data portal of Da Nang City, publishing municipal datasets for public reuse.

name: Tra Vinh province open data portal
description: Official open data portal of Trà Vinh Province, publishing datasets from the provincial shared data warehouse.

name: Lao Cai Province Open Data Portal
description: Provincial open data portal of Lao Cai, with public dataset search by sector.

name: Son La Province Open Data Portal
description: Provincial open data portal of Son La, listing datasets by department and theme.

name: Phu Tho Sectoral Database GIS
description: Public Mapbox application for Phu Tho's sectoral spatial database.

name: CRRF Marine Collections Database
description: Public marine invertebrate and marine plant specimen database of the Coral Reef Research Foundation in Palau. The collection contains more than 10,000 lots from NCI Natural Products Branch collections and other CRRF projects, with museum depositions at CAS, USNM, NIWA, NTM, and MNHN. Search by taxonomy, depth, locality, and collector.

name: CRRF Water Temperature Catalogue
description: Public catalogue of coral-reef water temperature time series from thermograph arrays at sites around Palau, operated by the Coral Reef Research Foundation. Users can filter by site, year, and depth and view average daily temperature graphs; raw files are available on request.

name: Геопортал містобудівного кадастру Луганської області
description: Geoportal. managed by Луганська обласна державна адміністрація. powered by Custom software. accessible at mkadastr.loga.gov.ua.

name: Управлінська геоінформаційна система міста Кременчука
description: Managerial geoinformation system of Kremenchuk with municipal spatial registers and related map services.

name: Київ Цифровий
description: Geoportal. managed by Київська міська державна адміністрація. powered by Custom software. accessible at gis.kyivcity.gov.ua.

name: Геопортал земельних ресурсів Києва
description: Kyiv land-resources geoportal covering land-use, cadastre, and related municipal spatial data.

name: WDC-Ukraine
description: World Data Center for Geoinformatics and Sustainable Development at Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute, member of the ISC World Data System.

name: Єдиний адресний реєстр міста Харкова
description: Kharkiv City Council public address register with map search. The broader municipal geoportal is not currently public.

name: Геопортал Харкова «Відкрита мапа»
description: Geoportal. managed by Харківська міська рада. powered by Custom software. accessible at smart.khmr.gov.ua.

name: Геопортал відкритих даних Львівської міської ради
description: Lviv City Council open-data geoportal with thematic municipal map layers. Separate from the city's CKAN portal.

name: Відкрита мапа Дніпра
description: Public city map of Dnipro City Council with thematic municipal service and infrastructure layers.

name: Геопортал міста Запоріжжя
description: Zaporizhzhia City Council geoportal of urban-planning documentation, zoning, and thematic maps. Map apps are published from the municipal ArcGIS portal.

name: Геопортал містобудівного кадастру Тернопільської міської територіальної громади
description: Geoportal. managed by Тернопільська міська рада. powered by Custom software. accessible at gis.tmrada.gov.ua.

name: Геопортал міста Переяслав
description: Municipal geoportal of Pereiaslav (formerly Pereiaslav-Khmelnytskyi) with an interactive city map, master plan, and cadastral layers.

name: Геопортал містобудівного кадастру міста Кропивницький
description: Geoportal. managed by Кропивницька міська рада. powered by Custom software. accessible at map.kr-rada.gov.ua.

name: Геопортал відкритих даних Рівненської області
description: Geoportal. managed by Рівненська обласна державна адміністрація. powered by Custom software. accessible at geo.rv.gov.ua.

name: Геопортал Вінниці
description: Geoportal. managed by Вінницька міська рада. powered by Custom software. accessible at map.vmr.gov.ua.

name: National Bank of Sociological Data (Kyiv Archive)
description: Catalog of Ukrainian sociological survey microdata operated by the Kyiv International Institute of Sociology. It lists 244 survey datasets from KIIS, SOCIS, TNS, the Institute of Sociology of the National Academy of Sciences, the Razumkov Centre, and other producers from 1991 onward. Open studies can be downloaded as SPSS or OCA files; other studies are released on request to the data owner.

name: Ukrstat microdata files
description: Public-use anonymized microdata from the State Statistics Service of Ukraine. The catalogue lists labour-force survey and household living-conditions survey files for 2018-2021 as SPSS and Excel zip archives under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

name: NBU Open Data
description: Statistics and Open Data REST directory of the National Bank of Ukraine.

name: STS RRO/PRRO Analytics
description: State Tax Service dashboard of cash-register (RRO/PRRO) registration and payment-activity indicators.

name: Customs BI
description: Interactive customs trade-statistics explorer for Ukraine import, export, and related fiscal indicators.

name: National Portal of Strategic Public Health Information
description: Public Health Center hub of national health-indicator explorers (atlas, HIV, TB, mental health, hepatitis, and mortality).

name: Аналітичний портал ДП ЛІАЦ
description: Indicators catalog. managed by Державне агентство лісових ресурсів України. powered by Custom software. accessible at stat.ukrforest.com.

name: Education Indicators Dashboard
description: Ministry of Education dashboard of general secondary-education indicators at national, regional, and community levels.

name: NEURC Electricity Market Indicators
description: NEURC public dashboards of electricity-market monitoring indicators disclosed during martial law.

name: NHSU Analytical Dashboards
description: Public catalog of NHSU analytical dashboards on Medical Guarantees Program, eHealth, and health-facility indicators.

name: IDP Dashboard
description: Public dashboard of internally displaced persons statistics operated by the state information and computing centre.

name: OpenBudget
description: State web portal of the budget for citizens, part of Ukraine's E-data public-finance suite.

name: ProIFIs
description: Register of investment projects financed with government loans, part of the E-data suite.

name: Єдиний державний реєстр декларацій
description: Public register of asset declarations of public officials, with a documented REST API.

name: Prozorro
description: Ukraine public procurement system with a public Open Contracting Data Standard API.

name: Портал відкритих даних Верховної Ради України
description: Open data portal of the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine with laws, bills, agenda, and MP datasets.

name: Ukraine Public Spending Portal
description: Unified web portal of public-fund transactions (E-data Spending) published by the Ministry of Finance of Ukraine.

name: Відкритий реєстр дозвільних документів на заготівлю деревини
description: Open data portal. managed by Державне агентство лісових ресурсів України. powered by Custom software. accessible at lk.ukrforest.com.

name: Реєстр суб'єктів освітньої діяльності (відкриті дані)
description: Open data dumps from the Unified State Electronic Database on Education (EDBO).

name: Єдиний реєстр оцінки впливу на довкілля
description: Open data portal. managed by Міністерство захисту довкілля та природних ресурсів України. powered by Custom software. accessible at eia.menr.gov.ua.

name: Energy Map
description: Open catalog of official Ukrainian energy-sector datasets maintained by DiXi Group. The former map.ua-energy.org hostname redirects here.

name: Портал Єдиної державної електронної системи у сфері будівництва
description: Open data portal. managed by Міністерство розвитку громад та територій України. powered by Custom software. accessible at e-construction.gov.ua.

name: Національний геопортал НІГД
description: National geoportal of Ukraine's National Spatial Data Infrastructure. Public API documentation is available; the map and catalog UI currently require authentication.

name: Геопортал: Ліси України
description: Geoportal. managed by Державне агентство лісових ресурсів України. powered by Custom software. accessible at forestry.org.ua.

name: Єдина геоінформаційна система моніторингу та оцінювання розвитку регіонів і територіальних громад
description: Geoportal. managed by Міністерство розвитку громад, територій та інфраструктури України. powered by Custom software. accessible at gisrr.gov.ua.

name: Публічна кадастрова карта України
description: Public cadastral map of Ukraine published by StateGeoCadastre.

name: Геопортал містобудівного кадастру на державному рівні
description: State-level urban-planning cadastre geoportal of Ukraine with a public map and registers of planning documentation. Distinct from the NSDI node at nsdi.gov.ua.

name: Ukrainian Biodiversity Information Network (UkrBIN)
description: Ukrainian Biodiversity Information Network (UkrBIN), a citizen-science and research catalog of species occurrences. The former IPT instance on port 8888 was unreachable in August 2026; the public database remains at ukrbin.com.

name: Ukrainian Antarctic Data Platform
description: Ukrainian Antarctic Data Platform holding observations from Akademik Vernadsky station and expedition research, coordinated by the National Antarctic Scientific Center.

name: National Repository of Academic Texts
Ukrainian Geospatial Data Center
description: The department specializes on developing complex distributed systems for satellite data processing. The main task given to the department is development, validation and implementation of different satellite data processing methods in the form of information services and certain systems.

name: Геопортал містобудівного кадастру Житомирської області
description: Urban-planning cadastre geoportal of Zhytomyr Regional State Administration with community documentation and thematic spatial datasets.

name: Observatorio Metropolitano OPAMSS
description: Metropolitan Observatory of COAMSS/OPAMSS. Public catalog of City Prosperity Index and Sustainable Development Goal indicators for the San Salvador metropolitan area; some downloads require registration.

name: BCR Base de Datos de Comercio Exterior
description: Detailed merchandise trade statistics database of the Central Reserve Bank of El Salvador, with queryable import and export series by tariff heading and downloadable tables.

name: Portal de Transparencia Fiscal — Datos Abiertos
description: Open data section of El Salvador's Portal de Transparencia Fiscal, with downloadable budget execution, municipal finance, tax, public investment, debt, and customs import/export spreadsheets plus classification catalogs from the Ministry of Finance.

name: SIMACC — Sistema de Información y Monitoreo Ambiental y Cambio Climático
description: SIMACC (Sistema de Información, Monitoreo Ambiental y Cambio Climático) public geoportal of El Salvador's Ministry of Environment. Catalog of environmental layers, ecosystem maps, and climate and environmental indicators.

name: Sistema de Información del Agua (SIA Paraguay)
description: Water information system of Paraguay (SIA), coordinated by INE with sector institutions to publish water-related statistics and quality indicators.

name: BOOST Data - Paraguay
description: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas BOOST open-budget database. Interactive pivot tables of central-government and municipal expenditure from SIAF and municipal finance reports, with CSV download. Alias host boost.vep.gov.py.

name: Portal de Datos Abiertos de Abogacía del Tesoro
description: Open data portal on beneficial owners, partners, and directors of companies registered in Paraguay.

name: Datos Abiertos Legislativos
description: Legislative open data portal of Paraguay's National Congress, with bills, parliamentarians, committees, plenary sessions, and downloadable datasets.

name: Datos Abiertos DNIT / Aduanas
description: Open data section of Paraguay's National Directorate of Tax Revenue, focused on customs (Gerencia General de Aduanas) datasets.

name: Datos Abiertos DIGIES / MSPBS
description: Open data of Paraguay's Ministry of Public Health and Social Welfare (DIGIES), including vital statistics from live-birth and death certificates.

name: Portal de Datos Abiertos - Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
description: Portal de datos abiertos del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF, ex Ministerio de Hacienda), con conjuntos como nómina de funcionarios, presupuesto y otros datos fiscales.

name: Datos Abiertos DNCP
description: Open data portal of Paraguay's national public procurement authority (DNCP), with bulk CSV downloads and an Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) REST API documented with Swagger.

name: Datos Abiertos MEC
description: Open data portal of Paraguay's Ministry of Education and Sciences (MEC), providing public datasets related to education.

name: Portal de Datos Abiertos de la Sociedad Civil de Paraguay
description: Civil-society, academia, and private-sector open data portal for Paraguay, complementary to the government catalog datos.gov.py.

name: Datos Abiertos MIC / Ventanilla Única de Exportación
description: Open data portal of Paraguay's Ministry of Industry and Commerce, including Ventanilla Única de Exportación (VUE) business registry datasets.

name: Datos Abiertos del Viceministerio de Capital Humano
description: Open data portal of Paraguay's Vice Ministry of Human Capital (former SFP) with public-employee payroll and competitive-exam datasets.

name: Datos Abiertos del Poder Judicial
description: Open data portal of Paraguay's Supreme Court of Justice, covering courts, lawyers, prosecutors, localities, and the corruption-case observatory.

name: CONACYT Datos Abiertos
description: Open data portal of Paraguay's national science and technology council, covering research projects, scholarships, PRONII, and related STI datasets.

name: Visor del Servicio Nacional de Catastro
description: Public cadastral map viewer of Paraguay's National Cadastre Service, with layers for departments, districts, registered parcels, urban ejido, and the border security zone.

name: Comptabilité nationale du Gabon
description: INSTAT Gabon national accounts portal with SNA 2008 production, expenditure and income tables for GDP 2022 (current PIB 13,103,182 million FCFA; primary sector 5,234,740 million FCFA, 39.95 percent). Includes Excel/PDF downloads. Distinct from the IHPC CPI dashboard and Open Data for Africa.

name: INSTAT Gabon tableau de bord IHPC
description: INSTAT Gabon IHPC dashboard with monthly CPI tables, COICOP functions, regional indices, average prices, and REST JSON from the IHPC MySQL server. July 2026 national index 115.4 (base 100 = 2018), monthly variation -0.26 percent, annual 0.17 percent. Distinct from Open Data for Africa and the old stat-gabon.org CMS.

name: Portail des Permis Miniers du Gabon
description: Public mining-title portal of Gabon's Ministry of Mines and Geological Resources. Lists permit applications and titles (operator, substance, province, status) with a harvestable JSON API.

name: BoreHive
description: BoreHive is the Botswana Geoscience Institute borehole portal. It publishes searchable water and exploration borehole records, logs, and related reports collected from government, mining, and private sources.

name: Botswana Geoscience Portal
description: Interactive GIS platform of the Botswana Geoscience Institute for multidisciplinary geoscience data search and access, including geology, geophysics, geochemistry, drill holes, seismic data, and publications.

name: Midocean University Digital Library
description: Public digital library of Midocean University with searchable articles, books, conference papers, lectures, and graduation projects. Listing at /en/search does not require login.

name: Central Bank of Malta Statistics
description: Central Bank of Malta statistics catalog of monetary, financial, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: Malta Open Data Portal
description: National open data portal of the Government of Malta, publishing government datasets for public reuse.

name: Legislation Malta
description: Official catalog of Maltese legislation, including acts published through the government gazette.

name: MEPS Geoportal
description: Malta Environment Platform & Services (MEPS) map viewer from the Environment and Resources Authority, providing public access to environmental spatial data including air, permitting, noise, protected areas, waste, water, and marine layers. Harvestable ArcGIS REST services are recorded separately on eraportal.org.mt.

name: Malta Blue Pages
description: Directory of Maltese ocean and marine data sources maintained by the Physical Oceanography Unit at the University of Malta, including a national metadata inventory of marine datasets.

name: National SDG Indicator Reporting Platform of Belarus
description: National SDG reporting platform of Belarus, consolidating official indicators for monitoring the 2030 Agenda. Built by Belstat with UNICEF, UNDP, and UNFPA support as a custom reporting system rather than Open SDG.

name: Gender statistics portal of Belarus
description: Official gender statistics portal of the National Statistical Committee of Belarus, publishing sex-disaggregated indicators on population, labour, education, health, and related topics.

name: Regional SDG indicators of Belarus
description: Regional Sustainable Development Goals dashboard of the National Statistical Committee of Belarus, comparing official SDG indicators across oblasts and Minsk.

name: Belarus Census Portal
description: Official Belarus census portal of the National Statistical Committee, publishing population and housing census results, demographic tables, and interactive tools for exploring census indicators.

name: National Bank of Belarus Statistics
description: National Bank of the Republic of Belarus statistics catalog of monetary, financial, and external-sector indicators, including balance of payments and related tables. Distinct from the IMF NSDP page hosted by Belstat.

name: Interactive information-analytical system for official statistics
description: Interactive information-analytical system of the National Statistical Committee of Belarus for disseminating official statistical indicators as tables, charts, and downloadable extracts.

name: Open Data Belarus
description: Community catalog of Belarusian open datasets maintained by the Open Data Belarus civic initiative. The current site is a custom catalog (not DKAN or CKAN); former CKAN/DKAN API paths return 404 and data.json is HTML.

name: State Urban Planning Cadastre of Belarus
description: Official web portal of the State Urban Planning Cadastre of Belarus, with a public register of urban planning projects (general plans, detailed plans, and territorial organization schemes) for oblasts, cities of oblast and raion subordination, and other administrative-territorial units. Operated by UE BelNIIP of Urban Planning.

name: Orsha environmental monitoring geoportal
description: Public online monitoring geoportal for environmental components in Orsha and Orsha raion, with Leaflet maps and local observation data for atmospheric air, surface and wastewater, groundwater, soils, and radiation. Operated by the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environmental Protection with the Sakharov International State Ecological Institute of BSU.

name: MeteoEye meteorological satellite data service
description: Public MeteoEye service of UE Geoinformation Systems of NAS Belarus, providing near-real-time meteorological satellite imagery (AQUA, NOAA, Metop, Fengyun, SUOMI NPP, Terra) with search by satellite, sensor, and date, plus a thermal-anomaly hotspots map.

name: Map of protected natural areas of Belarus
description: Interactive map and directory of specially protected natural areas of Belarus (nature reserves, national parks, zakazniks, and natural monuments), with oblast views for Brest, Vitebsk, Gomel, Grodno, Minsk, Mogilev, and Minsk city. Published by the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environmental Protection.

name: Cadastre of renewable energy sources of Belarus
description: Public map of the State Cadastre of Renewable Energy Sources of Belarus, showing operating and planned installations for wind, solar, hydropower, biogas, biomass, and other sources.

name: RISAMOS environmental monitoring system
description: Public Republican Information System of Automated Environmental Monitoring (RISAMOS), publishing a map and observation data for atmospheric air, precipitation, snow cover, and related parameters from monitoring stations in Belarusian cities and at the Berezinsky Biosphere Reserve.

name: Geostatistics information-analytical system
description: Geostatistics information-analytical system of the National Statistical Committee of Belarus, linking official statistics to geographic objects for maps, diagrams, and tables.

name: Public Cadastral Map of Belarus
description: Public Cadastral Map of the Republic of Belarus (PKK), a geoinformation system for viewing spatial and other data from the state land cadastre, including administrative-territorial units, addresses, streets and roads, real estate rights, and land valuation. Operated by the National Cadastral Agency.

name: Interactive map of the mineral-resource base of Belarus
description: Public interactive map of the mineral-resource base of Belarus, publishing deposits and subsurface sites from the state cadastre of mineral resources with filters by oblast, raion, deposit status, and commodity, plus tabulated records and regional summaries.

name: Repository of Belarusian State Academy of Arts
description: Public institutional repository of BSAA (library.bdam.by). Custom catalog UI of academy publications and conference materials.

name: Repository of Yanka Kupala State University of Grodno
description: Public institutional publications catalog of YKSUG (elib.grsu.by/catalog). Custom electronic-library UI, not DSpace.

name: FUSE Lab Open Data Portal
description: Open data portal providing datasets from the FUSE Lab (Future Urban Science and Engineering Lab) at The University of Hong Kong. The portal hosts research datasets related to urban science, engineering, and data-driven urban planning.

name: 2021 Population Census Interactive Data Dissemination Service
description: Interactive Data Dissemination Service for the 2021 Population Census, with custom tables and charts from the 2021 Census, 2016 By-census, and earlier census rounds.

name: Common Interactive Data Dissemination Service
description: Common Interactive Data Dissemination Service (Common-IDDS) lets users build custom statistical tables and charts of Hong Kong social and economic statistics, with downloadable outputs.

name: HKMA Data and Statistics
description: Hong Kong Monetary Authority data and statistics hub for monetary, banking, and financial indicators. Distinct from the IMF NSDP page hosted on the same site.

name: Interactive Data Dissemination Service for Trade Statistics
description: Interactive Data Dissemination Service for Hong Kong merchandise trade statistics, with custom tables and a documented HTTP GET API.

name: HKEX Data Marketplace
description: HKEX Data Marketplace public catalog of historical securities, derivatives, Stock Connect, and index datasets. Sign-in is required to purchase.

name: Hong Kong ENC Coverage Catalogue
description: Public catalogue of Hong Kong Electronic Navigational Chart cells (15 cells covering Hong Kong waters) with coverage, usage band and edition metadata, maintained by the Hydrographic Office of the Marine Department.

name: Geological Map of Hong Kong - Geotechnical Engineering Office (GEO) Data
description: Online geospatial data catalog for geological and related datasets provided by the Geotechnical Engineering Office (GEO) of Civil Engineering and Development Department (CEDD).

name: Hong Kong Marine Spatial Data Infrastructure Portal
description: Public Marine Spatial Data Infrastructure map of the Hong Kong Hydrographic Office showing marine services and facilities, restricted areas and related hydrographic layers in Hong Kong waters.

name: Hong Kong Biodiversity Information Hub
description: One-stop Hong Kong biodiversity platform with a species database, multimedia, education resources, and the Biodiversity Geographic Information System (BGIS).

name: Hong Kong Herbarium Plant Database
description: Searchable plant database of more than 3,300 native and exotic species recorded in Hong Kong, with photographs, conservation status, and herbarium specimen information.

name: GigaDB
description: GigaDB primarily serves as a repository to host data and tools associated with articles published by GigaScience Press; however, it also includes a subset of datasets that are not associated with GigaScience articles. GigaDB defines a dataset as a group of files (e.g., sequencing data, analyses, imaging files, software programs) that are related to and support an article or study. Each dataset in GigaDB is assigned a DOI for citation, and all datasets require a title, author list, and abstract. Datasets are encouraged to include detailed information in ISA-Tab format, and all data is under a CC0 waiver.

name: Banco de Moçambique Domínios e Indicadores Estatísticos
description: Banco de Moçambique public catalog of monetary, foreign-exchange, external-sector, and financial-inclusion statistical indicators, including long series downloads.

name: Portal de Divulgação de Dados de Infra-estruturas Públicas
description: Public infrastructure project catalog operated by Fundo de Estradas, publishing road, bridge, and other public-works records aligned with the Open Contracting for Infrastructure Data Standard (OC4IDS).

name: Flora of Mozambique
description: E-flora of flowering plants and ferns of Mozambique, part of the Flora Zambesiaca family of regional flora websites.

name: Mozambique Data Hub
description: Curated collection of policy-relevant Mozambique datasets from the Inclusive Growth in Mozambique programme, covering macroeconomic indicators, agricultural surveys, manufacturing firms, and school-to-work transitions.

name: BioNoMo - Biodiversity Network of Mozambique
description: Biodiversity Network of Mozambique (BioNoMo) portal for primary occurrence records and related digital collections from national universities, research centres, and conservation areas.

name: Ghana Fiscal Data
description: Yearly central-government fiscal data workbooks published by Ghana's Ministry of Finance, with a downloadable spreadsheet for each year from 2018 through 2026.

name: Ghana Energy Database
description: National energy statistics and district mapping platform of the Energy Commission of Ghana (GhED). Dataset pages cover energy supply, consumption, prices, SDG 7, oil, gas, and administrative boundaries.

name: Plants and Environments of the Marshall Islands
description: Public flora catalog of plants and vegetation zones of the Marshall Islands, with 81 species sheets indexed by Marshallese and scientific names plus traditional uses. Produced by Mark Merlin with the UH Mānoa Center for Pacific Islands Studies from the book Plants and Environments of the Marshall Islands.

name: Marshall Islands Nuclear Document Database
description: Restored public catalog of 13,748 declassified U.S. Department of Energy documents on nuclear testing and its consequences in the Marshall Islands. Search and browse by title, author, date, and accession number; rebuilt after the original DOE site was taken down in 2013.

name: Kogi State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
description: Kogi State e-procurement portal of the Bureau of Public Procurement, with public tender and award listings.

name: Bauchi State E-Procurement Open Contracting
description: Bauchi State e-procurement OCDS page publishing open contracting releases for state procurement.

name: Anambra State e-GP OCDS Portal
description: Anambra State Public Procurement portal publishing tenders, awards, and OCDS-style contracting records.

name: Lagos State PPA Registered Awards
description: Lagos State Public Procurement Agency public register of awarded contracts.

name: Lagos Bureau of Statistics Open Data Portal
description: Official open data portal of the Lagos Bureau of Statistics, publishing health, education, economic, and public-order statistics for Lagos State.

name: Ogun State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
description: Ogun State e-procurement portal presenting public procurement and open contracting records.

name: Osun State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
description: Osun State Public Procurement Agency e-procurement portal publishing tenders, awards, and related contracting records.

name: Abia State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
description: Abia State e-procurement portal publishing public contracting records, including OCDS-oriented award and tender listings.

name: Kaduna State Open Contracting Portal
description: Kaduna State open contracting portal publishing procurement records as OCDS packages, with project search and documented HTTP APIs at /api and /ocds-api.

name: KADPPA Infrastructure Portal
description: Kaduna State infrastructure project map and list published to the Open Contracting for Infrastructure Data Standard (OC4IDS).

name: Adamawa State OCDS Portal
description: Adamawa State Bureau of Public Procurement OCDS portal of projects, tenders, and awards.

name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria
description: Official statistics website and data portal of Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics. Publishes indicator tables, statistical reports, and an eLibrary of national accounts, CPI, GDP, labour, and social statistics.

name: CBN Statistics Database
description: Central Bank of Nigeria statistics database (LiveShop) of monetary, external, fiscal, and real-sector time series, with chart and table views at /shop and /data-browser.

name: Open Nigerian States
description: BudgIT civic portal of Nigerian state fiscal and administrative data, with per-state profiles and downloadable figures.

name: GovSpend
description: BudgIT GovSpend tracker of Nigerian federal treasury payments, with searchable daily spending reports.

name: Edo State OCDS Releases
description: Edo State Public Procurement Agency OCDS releases catalog of public contracting records.

name: Jigawa Due Process Awarded Contracts
description: Jigawa Due Process and Project Monitoring Bureau listing of awarded public contracts.

name: Ekiti State BPP Open Contracting Portal
description: Ekiti State Bureau of Public Procurement open contracting catalog of procurement records.

name: Ekiti State Open Contracting Dashboard
description: Ekiti State Bureau of Public Procurement OCDS records portal (BigFUT), listing open contracting releases for state procurement.

name: Ebonyi State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
description: Ebonyi State e-procurement portal with public tender, award, and open contracting pages.

name: DSEC Population Statistics Database
description: Population Statistics Database of the Statistics and Census Service (DSEC), providing interactive census and demographic tables for Macao.

name: DSEC Time Series Database
description: Official time-series warehouse of the Statistics and Census Service (DSEC), covering demographic, social, economic, and tourism indicators for Macao with a public SOAP web service.

name: DSEC External Merchandise Trade Statistics Database
description: Interactive External Merchandise Trade Statistics Database of the Statistics and Census Service (DSEC), for querying Macao import and export figures by commodity code, country or territory, and period.

name: DSEC Visitor Statistics Database
description: Visitor Statistics Database of the Statistics and Census Service (DSEC), with interactive tables on visitor arrivals and related tourism indicators for Macao.

name: Macao Tourism Data plus
description: Macao Tourism Data plus, the Macao Government Tourism Office platform for interactive visitor-arrival, hotel, and market-performance statistics, charts, and downloadable tables.

name: University of Macau Data and Open Data API Platform
description: University of Macau Data and Open Data API Platform, listing campus operational datasets such as facilities, parking, power consumption, and Wi-Fi logs, with APIs for staff and students via UMPASS.

name: Macao SAR Government Open Data Platform
description: Official open data portal of the Macao Special Administrative Region, operated by the Public Administration and Civil Service Bureau (SAFP). It publishes government datasets for download and provides a custom REST API at api.data.gov.mo, with Traditional Chinese, Portuguese, and English interfaces.

name: Applications Programming Interface for Geographic Information
description: Applications Programming Interface for Geographic Information, the Macao government map-service gateway operated by the Land and Urban Construction Bureau (DSSCU). Developers register for tokens to consume official map and geodata APIs.

name: University of Macau Scholars Page
description: University of Macau Scholars Page, the institutional repository (CSpace) that collects research outputs of the University of Macau, including journal articles, theses, and datasets.

name: Aquila
description: Aquila is a spatial-omics database and analysis platform that provides visualization and analysis on both spatial transcriptome and proteome data.

name: Andorra Department of Statistics (SIGDDE)
description: Official statistics dissemination platform (SIGDDE) of Andorra's Department of Statistics. Provides publications and per-indicator time series on population, economy, labour, prices, and public sector statistics. The department website at estadistica.ad is an ArcGIS Hub/Sites front end that links here; it is not a separate dataset catalog.

name: IDE Andorra Geoportal
description: Official public geoportal of Andorra's spatial data infrastructure (IDE Andorra i Cartografia). Provides the national map viewer, metadata catalogue entry point, OGC service directory, and geographic data downloads operated by the Govern d'Andorra. www.ideandorra.ad redirects here.

name: INIDE Nicaragua databases
description: Official statistics website of Nicaragua's National Institute of Development Information (INIDE). Publishes statistical databases and indicator tables covering census, demography, poverty, and economic statistics.

name: Banco Central de Nicaragua — Base de datos estadísticos
description: Official statistical database of the Central Bank of Nicaragua (BCN), providing macroeconomic, monetary, and financial indicators. The public site is a Drupal 10 page; bot-protection (Radware) sometimes intercepts automated requests.

name: Mapa Interactivo Energía y Minas
description: Interactive national map of Nicaragua's energy and mining sector, covering electricity generation, transmission, distribution, hydrocarbons, and mining sites.

name: Armhydromet - Hydrometeorology and Monitoring Center
description: Data portal of the Hydrometeorology and Monitoring Center (Armhydromet) SNCO under the Ministry of Environment. Publishes meteorological, hydrological and ambient air-quality monitoring observations from the national station network as web charts, monthly data and annual summary reports.

name: Interactive Budget of Armenia
description: Ministry of Finance interactive budget on the Armenian e-government site, with a yearly viewer of the state budget from 2016 onward.

name: Central Bank of Armenia Statistics
description: Central Bank of Armenia statistics catalog of monetary, financial-market, and macroeconomic time series. Distinct from the IMF NSDP page hosted by Armstat.

name: AirQuality.am - Open Air Quality Data Armenia
description: Civic air-quality data portal for Armenia. Publishes hourly sensor measurements (PM1, PM2.5, PM10, temperature, humidity) from Yerevan Municipality and independent networks as open data: bulk file exports (DbCL 1.0) and a documented public JSON API with station, current-readings and history endpoints.

name: ARMEPS - Armenian Electronic Procurement System
description: National electronic procurement system of Armenia. Public reports module provides downloadable Excel datasets of procurement procedures, bids and contracts alongside the tender notices database.

name: National Geoportal of Armenia
description: National geoportal of the Republic of Armenia, operated by the Cadastre Committee. Provides a metadata catalogue and map access to base and thematic spatial data, including cadastral maps, addresses, orthophotos, administrative boundaries, relief, hydrography, and transport networks.

name: Republican Geological Fund of Armenia
description: Republican Geological Fund public catalog of mineral deposits, ore occurrences, mine passports, and subsoil-use permits. The homepage interactive map (map/table views with search and filters) locates mines and related reports across Armenia. Digitized geological reports and maps are linked from the same site.

name: Interactive Forest Atlas of Armenia
description: Interactive Forest Atlas of Armenia, a Global Forest Watch MapBuilder application published by the Ministry of Environment with REC Caucasus and WRI. Provides forest, land-use, and biodiversity layers for planning, monitoring, and restoration. The public atlas UI is at forestatlas.am; the map app is hosted on GFW MapBuilder. Default data license is CC BY 4.0.

name: ArVO Byurakan data center
description: Armenian Virtual Observatory (ArVO) data center at Byurakan Astrophysical Observatory. Publishes Digitized First Byurakan Survey plate scans and extracted spectra through an IVOA TAP/VOSI service (schemas dfbsplates, dfbsspec, ivoa.obscore).

name: Guatemala Food Price Monitoring and Analysis (FPMA) Tool
description: National Food Price Monitoring and Analysis (FPMA) Tool hosted by the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food (MAGA). Public dashboard of domestic agricultural prices. The site title is Herramienta para el Análisis y Monitoreo de Precios.

name: INE Guatemala estadísticas por tema
description: Official statistics website of Guatemala's National Institute of Statistics (INE). Publishes statistics by theme and indicator tables covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics. Distinct from the INE CKAN open-data portal.

name: Geoportal IGN Guatemala
description: National Geographic Institute (IGN) geoportal (SNIG) with metadata and cartographic layers for administrative boundaries, roads, and altimetry of Guatemala. The site is served over HTTP only.

name: Central Bank of Barbados Statistics
description: Macroeconomic and financial statistics of the Central Bank of Barbados, including GDP, inflation, labour, depository corporations, and historical financial data. Tables are disseminated as Excel downloads via CBBWEBSTATS.

name: CZMU Oceanographic Monitoring Stations
description: Public listings of Coastal Zone Management Unit oceanographic monitoring stations around Barbados, with historical time series from CREWS, wave buoys and acoustic current profilers.

name: Bienvenue sur le portail open data de ARES
description: Open data catalog published by the IwEPS (Walloon Institute for Evaluation, Prediction, and Statistics), providing datasets for Wallonia, Belgium.

name: Géoportail de la Wallonie
description: Official Wallonia geoportal with a public geographic data catalogue, interactive map, and download/web services. Distinct from the Metawal GeoNetwork producer catalogue.

name: Brussels open datastore
description: Regional platform for opening and sharing data and services in the Brussels-Capital Region

name: Bruxelles Environnement Geodata
description: Brussels Environment public geodata atlas and metadata API (maps, layers, metadatas). Distinct from the QGIS Server OWS at ows.environnement.brussels.

name: Gemeente- en Stadsmonitor
description: Flemish Gemeente- en Stadsmonitor of municipal and city indicators published by Statistiek Vlaanderen.

name: The Flemish Open Data Portal
description: Catalogus van datasets en services van overheidsinstanties in Vlaanderen.

name: EODaS Open LiDAR portaal
description: Flemish government portal for viewing and downloading raw LiDAR point clouds from the Digital Elevation Model Flanders (DHMV I and DHMV II) campaigns. Provides LAZ tiles and map sheets together with elevation derivatives such as DSM, DTM, hillshade, and orthoimagery.

name: Geopunt
description: Central access portal to geographic government information of Flanders. Combines Flemish public geospatial data on a single map, including parcels, buildings, roads, rivers, aerial imagery, environmental data, and flood maps, as the public face of GDI-Vlaanderen.

name: Research Portal Flanders/Belgium Scientific data repository
description: Portal providing access to research datasets and information in Flanders and Belgium.

name: Belgium PensionStat Indicators
description: Official Belgian information platform for pension statistics, providing key figures on statutory, supplementary, and total pensions. An initiative of Sigedis, the Federal Pensions Service, and NISSE (RSVZ).

name: Sustainable development indicators
description: Official Belgian sustainable development indicators portal of the Federal Planning Bureau. Presents 84 indicators selected by the Interfederal Statistical Institute to measure Belgium's progress towards the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals, with time series, methodology, and trend assessments.

name: Barometer for Social Integration
description: Official Belgian statistics barometer of PPS Social Integration, with municipal to national figures on social integration income, social assistance, and related measures. Data can be visualized on maps and charts and downloaded for reuse.

name: Statistics Belgium Indicators catalog
description: Official Statbel web data catalog, providing access to over 100 datasets including population, census, labor market, living conditions, environment, and more. Data provided in multiple formats and regularly updated.

name: Belgian Mobility Open Data Portal
description: Joint open-data catalog of Belgian public-transport operators with GTFS, NeTEx, and APIs. Reached via opendata.stib-mivb.be. Distinct from the STIB OpenDataSoft tenant and transportdata.be NAP ITS.

name: FPS Finance Open Data Portal
description: Open data portal of FPS Finance with operational and statistical time series on Belgian federal tax receipts, budget, income tax returns, tax audits, compliance, collection, and tax disputes.

name: BIPT Data Portal
description: Official data portal of the Belgian Institute for Postal Services and Telecommunications (BIPT). Publishes broadband and mobile coverage maps, FTTH roll-out status, railway signal measurements, user-experience indicators, and downloadable open datasets on Belgian telecommunications.

name: FPS BOSA Open Data
description: Open data catalog of FPS BOSA for BeST (Belgian Streets and Addresses), consolidating official address registers from Flanders, Wallonia, and the Brussels-Capital Region. Provides weekly XML and CSV downloads and a REST API under CC BY 4.0.

name: Belgisch Staatsblad
description: Belgian official gazette (Moniteur belge / Belgisch Staatsblad). Searchable catalog of laws, royal decrees, and other acts published in the official journal.

name: Mobito Data Marketplace
description: Belgian mobility data marketplace listing third-party data products (vehicle, POI, footfall, EV charging, weather). Catalog is browsable without login; purchasing requires an account.

name: Geoportal of the Belgian federal institutions
description: geo.be is the official Belgian geodata portal, providing spatial data and services related to Belgium.

name: Botanical Collections
description:
Botanical Collections is a data portal developed and hosted by Meise Botanic Garden, where the digitized herbarium specimens and the living collection accessions of the Garden can be consulted. As evidenced by its generic name, the portal's scope is wider than just the Garden's collections and includes other botanical collections in Belgium or any other interested institutions abroad. As of 2022, a few other Belgian collections can already be found on the platform and more are expected to be added in the context of the DiSSCo Flanders project (https://dissco-flanders.be).

The portal allows users to search for specimens by various data elements such as kind of specimen, taxonomy, collector and location. Users can also view high resolution images and see the location of origin of specimens or the current location of accessions through a Google Maps plugin. Web API access is  possible, but not yet documented.

name: LNCipedia
description: LNCipedia is a database for human long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) transcripts and genes. In addition to basic transcript information and gene structure, several statistics are determined for each entry in the database, such as secondary structure information, protein coding potential and microRNA binding sites. Available literature on specific lncRNAs is linked, and users or authors can submit articles through a web interface. LNCipedia is publicly available and allows users to query and download lncRNA sequences and structures based on different search criteria. Please note that, while searching and download of this repository is available, the last release was in 2018.

name: PHOEG Helps to Obtain Extremal Graphs
description: PHOEG is an acronym for "PHOEG Helps to Obtain Extremal Graphs". It is a discovery system developed in the Algorithms Lab at Université de Mons and is effectively the sequel of the former system GraPHedron. It uses a geometric approach to study graph invariants and has led to numerous conjectures in extremal graph theory.

name: The Open Membrane Database
description: The Open Membrane Database (OMD) is an open-access, crowd-sourced resource with the performance and properties of reverse osmosis (RO) and solvent resistant nanofiltration (SRNF) membranes. The interactive charts and search functions allow easy data exploration and comparison of membrane performance, physicochemical properties and synthesis conditions.

name: short Open Reading Frame database
description: sORFs.org is a database for sORFs identified using ribosome profiling. Starting from ribosome profiling, sORFs.org identifies sORFs, incorporates state-of-the-art tools and metrics and stores results in a public database. Two query interfaces are provided, a default one enabling quick lookup of sORFs and a BioMart interface providing advanced query and export possibilities. At present, sORFs.org harbors 263 354 sORFs that demonstrate ribosome occupancy, originating from three different cell lines: HCT116 (human), E14_mESC (mouse) and S2 (fruit fly).

name: PIPPA
description: The public PIPPA interface provides access to the raw phenotypic data and linked metadata, making the data FAIR based on the MIAPPE standard. API calls are available for expert users to perform customized data requests. Through implementation of the Breeding API (BrAPI), PIPPA serves as a data provider for FAIDARE, an international portal to facilitate the discoverability of public data on plant biology. Bioschemas markup has been added to PIPPA to improve the findability of the data via public search engines.

name: House of Graphs
description: Most graph theorists will agree that among the vast number of graphs that exist there are only a few thousand that can be considered really interesting. It is the aim of this House of Graphs project to find a workable definition of 'interesting' and provide a searchable database of graphs that conform to this definition.

name: Microbial Growth Database
description: μGrowthDB is a relational database that provides a structure to store microbial growth data. It supports uploading, querying, visualising, and sharing microbial growth curves and accompanying metabolite measurements for a range of experimental designs.

name: An atlas of subgroup lattices of finite almost simple groups
description: This atlas contains all subgroup lattices of almost simple groups G such that S ≤ G ≤ Aut ( S ) and S is a simple group of order less than 1 million appearing in the Atlas of Finite Groups by Conway et al. Some simple groups and almost simple groups or order larger than 1 million have also been included, but not in a systematic way.

name: PLAZA
description: PLAZA is a platform for comparative, evolutionary, and functional genomics. It makes a broad set of genomes, data types and analysis tools available to researchers through a user-friendly website, an API, and bulk downloads. The platform consists of multiple instances, where each instance contains additional genomes, improved genome annotations, new software tools, and similar.

name: MariClus
description: MariClus is a website that helps scientists discover and study natural products from marine microbes. It allows users to search and visualize gene clusters that are responsible for producing these molecules in over 500 marine-related prokaryotes. It also provides information on the predicted molecules and their sources. MariClus combines data from different databases and tools, such as GenBank, MIBiG, PubChem, and antiSMASH, to offer a comprehensive and user-friendly platform for marine natural product research.

name: WALTZ-DB 2.0
description: WALTZ-DB 2.0 is a database for characterizing short peptides for their amyloid fiber-forming capacities. The majority of the data comes from electron microscopy, FTIR and Thioflavin-T experiments done by the Switch lab.
