Apart from that class of data we also provide the amyloid annotation for several other short peptides found in current scientific research papers. Structural models of the potential amyloid cores are provided for every peptide entry.

name: Alzheimer Disease & Frontotemporal Dementia Mutation Database
description: Alzheimer Disease & Frontotemporal Dementia Mutation Database, operated by University of Antwerp, VIB-Center for Molecular Neurology, Department of Molecular Genetics, provides research data on basic biological and medical research, biochemistry, and medicine.

name: EBRAINS Data Catalog
description: EBRAINS is on a mission to revolutionise how neuroscience is conducted. The digital ecosystem that we provide enables advances in brain research that translate to innovations in neuroscience, healthcare and technology.

name: Marine Data Archive
description: Scientific data are unique and need to be prevented from being lost. For this reason VLIZ developed the Marine Data Archive: a secure, online system where researchers can archive their data files in a well-documented manner. The MDA holds data from a wide range of international, European, and Flemish projects. It is free for anyone to use: to archive and manage their data, as a personal, project, or institutional archive, and as an open repository for data publication. Data of any type -- raw, processed, structured, data products, documents, images, etc -- can be archived in the MDA. Data in the MDA are made public by linking them to the Integrated Marine Information System, or to any other catalogue.

name: Disbiome
description: Disbiome is a database covering microbial composition changes in different kinds of diseases. Disease names, detection methods or organism names can be used as search queries giving that return information related to the experiment (related disease/bacteria, abundancy subject/control, control type, detection method and related literature).

name: Institutional Repository Universiteit Antwerpen (IRUA)
description: IRUA is the Institutional Repository of the University of Antwerp, the public search platform for the academic bibliography. It includes dataset records (publication type Dataset) with metadata and links to deposited files in external repositories.

name: corpor@uclouvain
description: UCLouvain catalog of written, oral, video, and learner corpora, including the CLARIN Knowledge Centre for Learner Corpora (CKL2CORPORA).

name: IDEM Interdisciplinary Database of European Melodies
description: IDEM is an interdisciplinary and multifaceted database of manuscripts and printed books that are relevant to the Alamire Foundation's research and activities. It therefore especially focuses on the musical heritage of the Low Countries from the early Middle Ages until 1800. IDEM is designed to be an online, freely accessible platform and tool for the preservation, study, and valorisation of the music heritage of the Low Countries.

name: EUREF Permanent GNSS Network
description: The EPN (or EUREF Permanent Network) is a voluntary organization of several European agencies and universities that pool resources and permanent GNSS station data to generate precise GNSS products. The EPN has been created under the umbrella of the International Association Geodesy and more precisely by its sub-commission EUREF. The European Terrestrial Reference System 89 (ETRS89) is used as the standard precise GPS coordinate system throughout Europe.

name: Radiocarbon Palaeolithic Europe Database
description: The Radiocarbon Palaeolithic Europe Database stores available radiometric data taken from literature and from other more restricted databases. Data is collected by continuous checking of newly published articles in hundreds of international and regional scientific journals and in collections or books dealing with a particular period or a specific Paleolithic site. User submissions are also accepted. Please note that this database is only available for download and local use via Microsoft Access or, in a more limited way, via Excel. As such, its accessibility is limited.

name: EV-TRACK
description: EV-TRACK centralizes extracellular vesicle (EV) biology and methodology to encourage authors, reviewers, editors and funders to put experimental guidelines into practice. It implements a bottom-up community consensus approach and encourages researchers to upload published and unpublished experiments and provide feedback. It is a unique resource that was developed to (i) create an informed dialogue among researchers about relevant experimental parameters, (ii) improve the rigour and interpretation of experiments studying EVs, and (iii) record the evolution of EV research.

name: Oligogenic diseases database
description: OLIDA is a curated database of oligogenic diseases and the variants in genes that have been published as causing these diseases. The combinations of variants that are contained in this database have been identified by researchers as being the cause of certain genetic diseases.

name: Emergency Events Database
description: EM-DAT (Emergency Events Database) is an international disaster database that documents occurrences and impacts of natural and technological hazards across the globe. It provides structured data about disaster types, affected regions, human impacts (deaths, injuries, affected populations), and economic damage.

name: European Ocean Biodiversity Information System
description: The European Ocean Biodiversity Information System – EurOBIS – is an online marine biogeographic database compiling data on all living marine creatures. The principle aims are to centralize the largely scattered biogeographic data on marine species collected by European institutions and to make these data freely available and easily accessible. The data are either collected within European marine waters or by European researchers and institutes outside Europe. The database focuses on taxonomy and occurrence records in space and time; all data can be searched and visualised through a set of online mapping tools.

name: Autidacts
description:
The "Autidact" website is dedicated to monitoring and disseminating information about autism. It aims to make a multitude of resources—articles, testimonies, books, podcasts, and more—more visible, whether published by people on the autism spectrum or by non-autistic individuals in response to the needs expressed by autistic people. Idealistic yet determined, we are convinced that autistic people can help non-autistic people better understand autism, thereby promoting the inclusion... of non-autistic people into their worlds, fostering greater mutual acceptance.

In line with the recent neurodiversity paradigm, we believe that to better understand autistic individuals, it is crucial to listen to and value the voices of those with direct experience. Our site aims to be an inclusive and respectful platform, where the diversity of perspectives on the autism spectrum is highlighted.

Making more visible those voices that have been overlooked in the flood of external productions (disconnected from autistic individuals) might lead some to think they are more valuable than the voices of non-autistic people. Of course, this is not the case. To counter this, it is essential to incorporate a diversity of opinions within the site's operations and to foster debates. Therefore, this is not a "promotional" site (in the sense that people on the spectrum would be put on a pedestal solely because of their autism, without the need to debate the relevance of their viewpoints and cultural/scientific/ethical contributions/testimonies).

The more autistic individuals participate, the richer this project will be, making visible the complexity of perspectives on autism from the inside, in order to create echoes at the political, cultural, and scientific levels within the frenchspeaking landscape.

name: BCCM/GeneCorner Plasmid Collection
description: The BCCM/GeneCorner Plasmid Collection warrants the long-term storage and distribution of plasmids, microbial host strains and DNA libraries of fundamental, biotechnological, educational or general scientific importance. The focus is on the collection of recombinant plasmids that can replicate in a microbial host strain. BCCM/GeneCorner also accepts natural and genetically modified animal or human cell lines, including hybridomas, as well as other genetic material, in the safe deposit and patent deposit collections.

name: Institut d'Astronomie et d'Astrophysique Databases
description: The following databases are maintained at IAA-ULB: Nuclear Database (BRUSLIB - A collection of nuclear data (masses, fission barriers, E1 strength functions, nuclear level densities, partition functions, reaction rates) of interest for nuclear astrophysics, stellar evolution and nucleosynthesis), Nuclear Network Generator NetGen (A tool for generating nuclear-reaction rates on user-defined networks), NACRE II (An update of the Nuclear Astrophysics Compilation of Reaction Rates (NACRE) including the evaluation of 34 reactions on stable targets with mass numbers A<16), The Ninth Catalogue of Orbits of Spectroscopic Binaries (SB9), The Henize sample of S stars, The radial-velocity monitoring of barium and S stars, Molecular linelist (Molecular linelists for stellar spectra), and Stellar models (Pre-main-sequence and super-AGB phases).
tags: catalogue of orbits of spectroscopic bin

name: BCCM/IHEM Fungi Collection: Human & Animal Health
description: BCCM/IHEM is a fungal culture collection specialized in medical and veterinary isolates. About 15.000 strains are available from all over the world: yeasts and filamentous fungi, pathogens, allergenic species, strains producing mycotoxins, reference strains, teaching material, etc. It also comprises the Raymond Vanbreuseghem collection. The BCCM/IHEM collection makes strains publicly available for medical, pharmaceutical and biological research, as well as for method validation, testing or educational purposes. Deposits of strains for public access are without costs for the depositor. The collection also offers a range of services including trainings in mycology and identifications of strains.

name: RETOPEA
description: RETOPEA investigates the different ways in which religious coexistence is thought of in different environments and how religious peace treaties have been established in the past. The idea is to use the insights gained to inform thinking about present-day peaceful religious co-existence The dataset contains the contents and the metadata of the resources (i.e., clippings) published on the RETOPEA website (retopea.eu).

name: BRCA Share
description: BRCA Share is a novel gene datashare initiative that provides scientists and commercial laboratory organizations around the world with open access to BRCA Share (formerly UMD-BRCA1) contains BRCA1 and BRCA2 genetic data. The program’s goal is to accelerate research on BRCA gene mutations, particularly variants of uncertain significance, to improve the ability of clinical laboratory diagnostics to predict which individuals are at risk of developing these cancers.

name: Base de Données Statistiques - HCP Maroc
description: Statistical database (BDS) of Morocco's Haut Commissariat au Plan, with indicators from the population census, household surveys, and economic and social statistics.

name: Bank Al-Maghrib Statistics
description: Bank Al-Maghrib (Central Bank of Morocco) statistics catalog of monetary, financial, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: Plateforme ODD - Indicateurs de Développement Durable du Maroc
description: Interactive HCP platform of Sustainable Development Goal (SDG / ODD) indicators and metadata, covering the UN official list and complementary national indicators for Morocco.

name: ANDA Marine Aquaculture Geoportal
description: Public marine aquaculture geoportal of Morocco's National Aquaculture Development Agency (ANDA). Lists allocated aquaculture zones, active farms, licensed projects, free parcels, and landing infrastructure along the Atlantic coast, including Dakhla and Boujdour.

name: Mediterranean Founder Mutation Database
description: Web database of founder mutations in Mediterranean populations, maintained by Institut Pasteur du Maroc, to support diagnostic test design and research on population history and migration.

name: Moroccan Genetic Disease Database
description: The Moroccan Genetic Disease Database (MGDD) documents mutations and polymorphism frequencies reported in the Moroccan population, for research and clinical lookup by disease or gene.

name: KNBS Census DataBrowser
description: KNBS JSON-stat DataBrowser (Istat Cooperation) for the 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census. Interactive table explorer listed on the KNBS portals page as the Census 2019 Data Browser. Distinct from KeNADA microdata and Open Data for Africa.

name: KNBS CPI Explorer
description: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics Consumer Price Index explorer with COICOP breakdowns, regional series, an inflation calculator, and a public JSON API of published CPI observations. Distinct from the KNBS data listing page and KeNADA.

name: KSA Datahub
description: KSA Datahub is the Kenya Space Agency GIS and Remote Sensing Data Hub, providing access to geospatial data, satellite imagery, story maps and tools for mapping and analysis in support of Kenya's space research and Earth observation initiatives. Custom React application with a REST API and GeoServer backend.

name: Indicateurs du RGPH 2014
description: INS query database of indicators from Guinea's 2014 General Population and Housing Census (RGPH). Users select theme, indicator, and disaggregation for fertility, mortality, education, households, and economic characteristics.

name: INS Guinée Indicateurs clés
description: Key indicators database of Guinea's National Institute of Statistics. Users select years, regions, and themes to query official statistics on demography, economy, education, health, agriculture, and other topics.

name: Infrastructures socio-économiques de base de la Guinée
description: INS query catalog of Guinea's 2017 inventory of basic socio-economic infrastructure (schools, health facilities, markets, transport, and other amenities) by region, prefecture, and sub-prefecture.

name: Centrale Bank van Aruba Monthly Tables
description: Centrale Bank van Aruba monthly statistical tables covering monetary, banking, fiscal, and external-sector indicators.

name: Auckland Transport developer portal
description: Auckland Transport developer portal for GTFS schedule data, realtime public transport APIs, and related transport datasets used to build applications on Auckland's bus, train, and ferry network.

name: Pacific Islands Families Study
description: Pacific Islands Families Study data resource at Auckland University of Technology. It documents a longitudinal cohort study of Pacific children and families in Auckland. Dataset access is arranged through the study team rather than a public API.

name: Physiome Model Repository
description: The Physiome Model Repository (PMR) is the main online repository for the IUPS Physiome Project, providing version and access controlled repositories, called workspaces, for users to store their data. PMR also provides a mechanism to create persistent access to specific revisions of a workspace, termed exposures. Exposure plugins are available for specific types of data (e.g., CellML or FieldML documents) which enable customizable views of the data when browsing the repository via a web browser, or an application accessing the repository’s content via web services.

name: Open IFC Model Repository
description: Repository of Industry Foundation Classes building models for BIM and construction-informatics research.

name: An Atlas of Polytopes for Small Almost Simple Groups
description: This Atlas contains all regular polytopes whose automorphism group is an almost simple group G such that S <= G <= Aut(S) and S is a simple group of order less than 1 million appearing in the Atlas of Finite Groups by Conway et al.

name: University of Waikato Datasets
description: Public machine-learning dataset collections hosted by the University of Waikato, including User-friendly Deep Learning (UFDL) and TAIAO environmental time-series datasets.

name: Metlink Open Data Developer Portal
description: Greater Wellington Metlink open data developer portal documenting public transport APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger) for the regional bus, train, and ferry network.

name: Environment Canterbury's Open Data Portal
description: Environment Canterbury open data portal for regional environmental and geospatial datasets. The site title identifies it as the ECan Open Data Portal.

name: Metro Christchurch Developer Portal
description: Canterbury Metro public-transport developer catalog listing GTFS Static, GTFS-Realtime, and SIRI APIs for Christchurch-area bus services. Public overview at metroinfo.co.nz/about/developer-resources; API keys via this portal.

name: RBNZ Statistics
description: Reserve Bank of New Zealand statistical series catalog. Numbered tables cover economic indicators, exchange and interest rates, monetary and lending statistics, banks, and the Bank's own accounts, published as Excel files.

name: Electricity Market Information
description: Wholesale and retail electricity market statistics and datasets published by New Zealand's Electricity Authority.

name: Figure.NZ civic statistics
description: Civic statistics catalog of free figures, charts, and community data hubs about Aotearoa New Zealand.

name: Stats Infoshare New Zealand
description: Self-service open online data tool on Stats NZ's website, containing over 30 million aggregated, confidentialised, time-series data across topics including businesses, economic indicators, population, health, tourism, and more.

name: NIWA DataHub
description: NIWA DataHub catalog of climate, freshwater, and marine datasets including CLIDB climate observations for New Zealand.

name: Stats NZ API Portal
description: Stats NZ developer portal listing data APIs for machine-readable access to official statistics datasets.

name: Ariā SNZ
description: Stats NZ Ariā classification management system for official statistical classifications and related metadata.

name: GeoNet Data
description: GeoNet scientific data portal for New Zealand earthquake, volcano, tsunami, landslide, geodetic, geomagnetic, and strong-motion observations, with data discovery and web feature services.

name: enviPath
description: enviPath is both a database and a prediction system, for the microbial biotransformation of organic environmental contaminants. The database provides the possibility to store and view experimentally observed biotransformation pathways, and supports the annotation of pathways with experimental and environmental conditions. The pathway prediction system provides different relative reasoning models to predict likely biotransformation pathways and products.

name: New Zealand Hazardous Substances and New Organisms Chemical Classification and Information Database
description: The CCID is a database of chemicals classified by the New Zealand Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) in accordance with the EPA Hazardous Substances (Classification) Notice 2020. This Notice, issued under the New Zealand Hazardous Substances and New Organisms Act (HSNO), incorporates the UN Globally Harmonised System for Classification and Labelling of Chemicals (GHS) revised edition 7 by reference, with the addition of classifications for terrestrial ecotoxicity (applied only to agrichemicals).

name: National Vegetation Survey (NVS) databank
description: National Vegetation Survey databank managed by Manaaki Whenua – Landcare Research NZ, providing access to environmental research data related to New Zealand vegetation surveys.

name: Biota of New Zealand
description: Biota of New Zealand portal for taxonomic names, descriptions, occurrence, and related data on fungi, land invertebrates, plants, and some viruses and bacteria relevant to Aotearoa New Zealand.

name: Napier City Open Data Portal
description: Data catalog providing up-to-date demographic, economic, social, and geographic data for Napier City, New Zealand.

name: APMIS Mauritius
description: Agricultural Production and Market Information System of FAREI. National catalog of crop production, area harvested, retail and wholesale market prices, and related agricultural statistics for Mauritius.

name: Data ODE
description: Open data portal of the Observatoire de l'Environnement. Searchable environmental datasets and indicators for Mauritius, covering themes such as biodiversity, climate, waste, water, and energy.

name: Maustats Platform
description: Statistics Mauritius official Maustats data hub with a data bank, dashboards, regional and sector views, SDMX exchange, and an API gateway. Distinct from the IMF NSDP page, the NADA microdata archive, and Open Data for Africa.

name: Database of Marine Organisms of Mauritius
description: Database of Marine Organisms of Mauritius. Taxonomic checklist of marine species reported from the maritime territory of the Republic of Mauritius, compiled by the Mauritius Oceanography Institute from literature and existing databases.

name: Marine Diversity and Genetic Data Bank
description: Marine Diversity and Genetic Data Bank of the Mauritius Oceanography Institute. Searchable morphometric and DNA-barcode records of commercial and other marine organisms from Mauritian waters, with nomenclature and BLAST search.

name: Mauritius Research Repository
description: National open-access research repository of the Mauritius Research and Innovation Council. Collects reports, publications, and other research outputs related to Mauritius or produced by Mauritian authors. Public browsing is available; REST and OAI-PMH paths redirect to login.

name: BOOST Mauritania
description: Ministry of Finance BOOST open-budget pivot of central-government expenditure and revenue. Users filter by year, administrative title, chapter and economic article and read inscribed, initial, revised and payment amounts.

name: Base nationale d'indicateurs SCAPP-ODD
description: National database of SCAPP (Stratégie de Croissance Accélérée et de Prospérité Partagée) and Sustainable Development Goal (ODD) indicators used to monitor Mauritania's 2016-2030 development strategy and related sectoral plans.

name: DataMR - Catalogue de Données de la Mauritanie
description: DataMR is a public catalogue of Mauritania-related datasets operated by the RIM-AI community. It lists about 100 downloadable datasets (CSV, GeoJSON, XLSX) compiled from official and international sources such as UNHCR, IATI, the World Bank, WFP HungerMap, ACLED, and UN SDG indicators.

name: Transparence MTNIMA - Suivi des marchés publics
description: Public portal of the Ministry of Digital Transformation for tracking ministry procurement and spending since August 2024. Provides searchable contract and below-threshold expenditure records, with filters and summary statistics, in Arabic and French. No registration is required.

name: ONE República Dominicana
description: Official statistics website of the Dominican Republic's National Statistics Office (ONE). Publishes indicator tables and statistical publications covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics.

name: Sistema de Información de Contrataciones Públicas - DGCP
description: Sistema de Información de Contrataciones Públicas. Portal de datos abiertos de la Dirección General de Contrataciones Públicas (DGCP) de la República Dominicana.

name: ANAMAR Plataforma de Datos Oceanográficos
description: Public oceanographic data platform of the Dominican National Maritime Affairs Authority, providing real-time and historical observations from coastal buoys and tide gauges around the Dominican Republic.

name: Portal de APIs dominicano
description: Official developer portal of the Dominican Republic digital government programme. Lists public APIs and related resources for agencies and integrators.

name: Trondheim kommune kartportal
description: Municipal map portal listing Trondheim's published map applications, including Trondheimskartet, cultural heritage map, planning dialogue and ISY Map status maps.

name: Simula Datasets
description: A collection of datasets gathered and published by Simula Research Laboratory and SimulaMet. Includes datasets on subjects such as health (e.g., depression, schizophrenia, gastrointestinal), sports (e.g., soccer video and player position), and various scientific domains.

name: Bergen kommune åpne data
description: Open data portal of Bergen kommune for municipal datasets.

name: Surveybanken
description: Sikt's research data catalogue of thousands of Norwegian surveys since 1957, with search across about 750,000 questions and variables. Data come from recurring surveys, Statistics Norway, research institutes, and individual researchers. Some datasets are openly downloadable; others require login and an access agreement. The archive is CoreTrustSeal-certified and is Norway's CESSDA service provider.

name: Statnett Power System Data
description: Public data from the Norwegian transmission system published by Statnett.

name: Helseatlas
description: National health atlas comparing use of specialist health services across geographic areas. Interactive analyses and reports by specialty, produced by SKDE (Helse Nord) and Helse Førde for the Ministry of Health and Care Services.

name: FHI Statistikk
description: Public health statistics portal of the Norwegian Institute of Public Health. Presents aggregated registry statistics as tables, charts, and CSV/Excel downloads, filterable by geography, age, sex, and time. Covers vaccination, causes of death, births, infectious diseases, medicines, cardiovascular disease, abortions, and municipal health and care services.

name: Trafikkdata
description: Norwegian Public Roads Administration traffic-data explorer and API for traffic counting stations and time series (www.trafikkdata.no).

name: Miljøstatus - Norges klima- og miljømål
description: Miljøstatus catalog of Norway's climate and environmental goals and associated indicators, covering nature, cultural heritage, outdoor life, pollution, climate, and polar areas. Distinct from the Environment Agency geoportal.

name: Statsregnskapet
description: Norwegian central-government accounts download catalog. Annual, year-to-date and full-history zip datasets of statsregnskapet from 2014 onward, with a CSV column guide.

name: Udir Statistikkbank
description: Utdanningsdirektoratet statistical bank of kindergarten, primary, lower and upper secondary, and vocational education tables. Public reports are filterable by geography and unit. An open REST API currently covers Elevundersøkelsen exports. School-level unredacted cells require login.

name: Nasjonale kvalitetsindikatorer
description: National quality indicators (NKI) for municipal health and care, dental care, pre-hospital services, somatic specialist care, and mental health. Public search, indicator articles, dashboards, and CSV/Excel export. Distinct from FHI Statistikk.

name: Kreftregisteret Statistikkbank
description: Cancer Registry of Norway statistical bank with public incidence, prevalence, and survival tables, figures, and maps. Norwegian and English UI. Organizational pages now sit on fhi.no; this table catalog remains on sb.kreftregisteret.no.

name: Norges Bank SDMX API
description: Norges Bank SDMX API providing access to official central bank statistics and time series.

name: Dune Analytics data catalog
description: Queryable catalog of raw, decoded, and curated blockchain datasets across 100+ chains. Most tables are public; some collections are paid.

name: DFO Datakatalog
description: Data catalog of the Norwegian Directorate of Fisheries

name: BarentsWatch Data
description: BarentsWatch data service for downloading open datasets on fisheries, fish health, vessel activity, sea ice, and related Barents Sea information.

name: Lovdata
description: Official legal database of Norway, including Norsk Lovtidend and consolidated statutes.

name: Nord Pool Data Portal
description: Public day-ahead, intraday, and system price data for the Nordic and Baltic electricity markets.

name: Norske utslipp
description: Norwegian pollutant release inventory. Public search of facility releases to air and water and waste generated, reported alongside E-PRTR.

name: Norwegian Offshore Directorate FactPages
description: Public database of wells, licences, fields, discoveries, facilities, and petroleum production on the Norwegian continental shelf.

name: Bufdir Datakatalog
description: Open data catalog for the Norwegian Directorate for Children, Youth and Family Affairs (Bufdir), providing datasets related to children, youth and families in Norway.

name: Vann-Nett
description: Norwegian water-environment catalog. Public factsheets and maps of water-body status, pressures and measures under the Water Framework Directive.

name: NADAG National Database for Ground Investigations
description: NADAG (Nasjonal database for grunnundersøkelser) mobile map of the Geological Survey of Norway, publishing national ground-investigation data.

name: Vegkart
description: Public map client for Nasjonal vegdatabank (NVDB), the Norwegian National Road Data Bank, for browsing the road network and associated object data.

name: NINA Map Viewer
description: Public map gallery of the Norwegian Institute for Nature Research (NINA), with thematic maps on land-use change, planned development, ecological networks and nature mapping. Distinct from geodata.nina.no GeoNode.

name: Kartkatalogen - Geonorge
description: Search, view or download official Norwegian geospatial data.

name: Kilden
description: NIBIO's main map portal gathering the institute's geospatial datasets with other key national layers. Subject areas include land information, landscape, soil, reindeer husbandry, forestry, wildlife, and regional agricultural grant zones.

name: Entur for Developers
description: Norwegian national public-transport developer portal. Documents and exposes SIRI 2.0 (ET, VM, SX), SIRI Lite, GTFS-RT, NeTEx, and journey-planner APIs. Distinct from transportportal.no.

name: Brønnøysund Register Centre Datasets and API
description: Datasets and APIs from the Brønnøysund Register Centre, including the Central Coordinating Register for Legal Entities. REST APIs and bulk downloads cover Norwegian organisations, roles, beneficial owners, municipal reporting, and related business registers. Most datasets are available under NLOD without registration.

name: NMRlipids
description: The NMRlipids Project is an open collaboration focused on understanding lipid systems at an atomistic level. This collaborative effort occurs through a blog (nmrlipids.blogspot.fi) and github (github.com/NMRlipids); it involves detailed exploration of lipid structures and interactions through all-atom Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, using Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) and other high-fidelity experimental data as a benchmark. The project aims to enhance the understanding of lipid behavior in biological systems, contributing significantly to the fields of biochemistry and molecular biology.

name: Luftkvalitet i Norge
description: Norwegian air-quality measurements. Public station data hosted by NILU for the national monitoring network.

name: PRIO Data Catalog
description: The following list provides access to the datasets used by authors of articles appearing in Journal of Peace Research since 1998.

name: MirGeneDB MicroRNA Gene Database
description: MirGeneDB is a database of microRNA genes that have been validated and annotated as described in "A Uniform System for the Annotation of Vertebrate microRNA Genes and the Evolution of the Human microRNAome".* The initial version contained 1,434 microRNA genes for human, mouse, chicken and zebrafish. Version 2.0 contains more than 10,000 genes from 45 organisms representing nearly every major metazoan group, and these microRNAs can be browsed, searched and downloaded.

name: SalmoBase
description: SalmoBase is an integrated molecular resource for Salmonid species which includes visualizations and analytic tools. The genome of the Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) has undergone extensive restructuring since a whole genome duplication event ~80 million years ago, which creates opportunities to explore the evolutionary process of rediploidization. A public genome assembly is available and ordered into 29 chromosome files. SalmoBase includes a GBrowse interface for exploring the chromosome sequence as well as BLAST functionality and links to expression levels, gene and SNP information. Using public RNAseq data 37,000 high confidence protein coding genes have been identified, wherein almost half show splice variants.

name: CESSDA Vocabulary Service
description: CESSDA Vocabulary Service enables users to discover, browse, and download controlled vocabularies in a variety of languages. The service is provided by the Consortium of European Social Science Data Archives (CESSDA). The majority of the source (English) vocabularies included in the service have been created by the DDI Alliance. The Data Documentation Initiative (DDI) is an international standard for describing data produced by surveys and other observational methods in the social, behavioural, economic, and health sciences.

name: Norwegian Marine Data Centre
description: Norwegian Marine Data Centre metadata catalogue of marine and polar oceanographic datasets contributed by Norwegian research institutes, harvested by SAON and SIOS.

name: Norwegian Research Information Repository (NVA)
description: National Research Information Repository (Nasjonalt vitenarkiv, NVA) operated by Sikt. Launched in 2025, it replaced Cristin and 67+ institutional Brage/DSpace repositories as the shared CRIS and open-access archive for Norwegian universities, university colleges, and research institutes. The public catalog covers publications, projects, researchers, and dataset metadata; research data files are archived in DataverseNO, Sikt Research Data Archive, or other certified repositories.

name: Text Laboratory, University of Oslo
description: The Text Laboratory at the University of Oslo develops language corpora, speech databases, and corpus tools for Norwegian and other languages.

name: CLARINO Humit Text Laboratory Centre
description: CLARIN C-centre catalog of speech and text corpora from the University of Oslo Text Laboratory, with Glossa search and OAI-PMH metadata.

name: Norwegian Meteorological Institute, Free Meteorological Data
description: The Norwegian Meteorological Institute supplies climate observations and weather data and forecasts for the country and surrounding waters (including the Arctic). In addition commercial services are provided to fit customers requirements.

name: Eukaryotic Linear Motifs
description: This computational biology resource mainly focuses on annotation and detection of eukaryotic linear motifs (ELMs) by providing both a repository of annotated motif data and an exploratory tool for motif prediction. ELMs, or short linear motifs (SLiMs), are compact protein interaction sites composed of short stretches of adjacent amino acids.

name: EBAS Atmospheric Database
description: Database hosting observation data of atmospheric chemical composition and physical properties. Hosts data submitted by data originators in international and national frameworks like long-term monitoring programmes and research projects.

name: HUNT Databank
description: HUNT Databank is a research database hosted by the Department of Public Health and Nursing at NTNU (Norwegian University of Science and Technology). It provides access to data from the HUNT (Health Study of Nord-Trøndelag) studies, covering health, genetics, lifestyle, and epidemiological variables.

name: GBIF Norway
description: GBIF Norway is the Norwegian participant node in the Global Biodiversity Information Facility, GBIF. They make primary data on biological diversity from the Norwegian collections and observation databases freely available and coordinate and support GBIF-related activities and data use in Norway.

name: ACTRIS Data Portal
description: Portal providing free and open access to atmospheric measurement data and data products from ACTRIS infrastructure network's activities. Allows searching a metadata catalogue of datasets archived in external archives, covering approximately 150 atmospheric variables from around 600 facilities worldwide, with some records dating back decades.

name: JASPAR
description: Open-access catalog of curated, non-redundant transcription factor binding profiles across taxonomic groups.

name: Sikt Research Data Archive
description:
Sikt Research Data Archive is a national research data infrastructure dedicated to the digital curation of high-quality research data, focusing on social science, humanities, and select areas of medical, health, and environmental research.  The Archive's mission is to archive, facilitate, and disseminate rich data resources and support services to students, researchers, and organisations in higher education and research. The Archive offers data curation services that include carefully reviewing incoming data and documentation, enhancing documentation, adding detailed metadata, creating new sustainable formats, and reviewing deposited data for accuracy and legitimacy. The Archive is the Norwegian Service Provider for the Consortium of European Social Science Data Archives (CESSDA). 

The Archive has a long history of promoting and supporting open access to research data and data sharing within the social sciences, both as a national infrastructure and as part of the European and worldwide network of social science data archives. Before its merger into Sikt in 2022, the Archive was part of NSD – Norwegian Centre for Research Data. NSD was established in 1971 as part of the Research Council of Norway and became an independent limited company fully owned by the Ministry of Education and Research in 2003. The Archive is now a service under Sikt – Norwegian Agency for Shared Services in Education and Research, a public administrative body under the Ministry of Education and Research.

name: NIVA Public Data Portal
description: Public environmental data portal of the Norwegian Institute for Water Research (NIVA). It publishes monitoring and research datasets from expeditions, river, lake and coastal stations, and ship-based instruments, including CTD profiles, Ferrybox streams, microplastics, and Oslofjord monitoring. Distinct from NIVA's GeoNetwork catalog at sjoa.niva.no.

name: Norwegian Marine Data Centre
description: Norwegian Marine Data Centre (NMDC) at the Institute of Marine Research, providing access to Norwegian marine research datasets.

name: Helsedata
description: National portal for discovering Norwegian health data sources and applying for access. Covers health registries, medical quality registries, health studies, biobanks, open data, and statistics, with a variable catalogue and application process for personally identifiable and aggregated data.

name: Norwegian Polar Data Centre
description: Maintains Arctic and Antarctic research datasets from the Norwegian Polar Institute and partners.

name: Attica OpenData Portal
description: Regional open data catalog for Attica, Greece, providing datasets spanning various societal and administrative topics as per regional government initiatives.

name: EYDAP Open Data Hub
description: Open data hub of the Athens Water Supply and Sewerage Company with downloadable water consumption, wastewater, and reservoir datasets.

name: Athens Maps
description: Public Athens Maps geoportal of the Municipality of Athens, distinct from the GeoNode GIS.

name: Larissa Urban Planning Geoportal
description: Municipal urban-planning GIS of Larissa for city-plan layers, city blocks, land parcels, and EGSA coordinate search.

name: Bank of Greece Open Data
description: Open data portal by the Bank of Greece, containing datasets on monetary economics, real estate, public finance, balance of payments, exchange rates, and financial accounts.

name: LIFE-IP AdaptInGR Indicators
description: LIFE-IP AdaptInGR monitoring and evaluation catalog of climate-change adaptation indicators for Greece, with public indicator identity cards and reports.

name: Greece in Numbers
description: Public hub of Greek economic and social indicators compiled by IOBE with the LSE Hellenic Observatory and Yale Hellenic Studies. Charts and downloadable series drawn from ELSTAT, the Bank of Greece, and other official sources.

name: Rural Development Programme 2014-2022 Statistics
description: Statistical dashboards for Greece's Rural Development Programme (PAA) 2014-2022 public expenditure and EU co-financing.

name: ELSTAT Census 2021 Results
description: Interactive 2021 Population-Housing Census results explorer with national and regional indicator tables.

name: Diavgeia (Διαύγεια)
description: Greek government's official platform for publishing and searching administrative decisions and acts online.

name: data.gov.gr (previous version)
description: Previous version of the Greek national open data portal, kept online at old.data.gov.gr after the current data.gov.gr relaunch. It publishes datasets from public-sector bodies, exposes a REST query API, and provides a DCAT-AP catalog export.

name: Greece Traffic Accidents Map
description: Public map of road traffic collisions on maps.gov.gr.

name: Hellenic Military Geographical Service Geoeuretirio
description: Public Geoeuretirio geospatial search geoportal of the Hellenic Military Geographical Service, distinct from the ArcGIS Online Web AppBuilder.

name: HNHS nautical chart map catalogue
description: Interactive catalogue of Hellenic Navy Hydrographic Service nautical chart books, with map coverage of official paper charts and related hydrographic products.

name: AUTH Open Data API
description: Public API catalog of Aristotle University of Thessaloniki with 25+ methods and Swagger documentation for university open datasets.

name: Pyxida
description: Pyxida is the institutional repository and digital library of the Athens University of Economics and Business. It collects postgraduate dissertations, doctoral theses, research papers, and digitized historical collections of the AUEB Library.

name: HNODC EDMED Database
description: Hellenic National Oceanographic Data Centre (HNODC) EDMED search for Greek marine environmental datasets.

name: Academy of Athens Digital Repository
description: Digital repository of the Academy of Athens. It provides unified access to collections of the Academy’s research centres and library, including manuscripts, photographs, maps, archival material, and scientific publications.

name: Social Data Network
description: SoDaNet is Greece’s national research infrastructure for the social sciences, established in 2010 by EKKE and several universities. It serves as a digital portal that collects, documents, and shares social science data and metadata for researchers, academics, policy makers, journalists, and the wider public.

name: Codex Sinaiticus
description: Digital edition of Codex Sinaiticus, a 4th-century Greek Bible manuscript, with transcribed text, images, and related scholarly apparatus.

name: CLARIN:EL Inventory
description: National inventory of language resources and language-processing services for Greek and other languages in the CLARIN:EL infrastructure.

name: TarBase
description: DIANA-TarBase is a reference database that indexes experimentally-supported microRNA (miRNA) targets. It integrates information on cell-type specific miRNA–gene regulation and includes miRNA-binding locations. The target data provided by DIANA-TarBase is supported by information on methodologies, cell types/tissues and experimental conditions.

name: Genome Variation Allele Frequencies Worldwide
description: FINDbase worldwide is an online resource documenting frequencies of clinically relevant genomic variants, namely pathogenic variants leading to inherited disorders and pharmacogenomic biomarkers, in various populations worldwide. The initial data came from previously published reports as well as from unpublished information contributed from individual researchers prior of publication.

name: gpDB G-protein Coupled Receptor Database
description: GpDB is a publicly accessible, relational database of G-proteins and their interactions with GPCRs and effector molecules. The sequences are classified according to a hierarchy of different classes, families and sub-families, based on extensive literature search.

name: Pergamos
description: Pergamos is the unified Institutional Repository / Digital Library of the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens (NKUA). It holds a number of diverse digital collections coming from museums and libraries of the University of Athens. The interface is available in Greek and English.

name: Cayman Islands National Weather Service
description: Cayman Islands National Weather Service climate and observation products. Publishes yearly weather statistics for Grand Cayman and Cayman Brac and a climatology extract service for temperature, rainfall, wind, and humidity. Downloads of up to three years are free; longer or specialised requests may incur a fee.

name: Cayman Islands Economics and Statistics Office
description: Official statistics website of the Economics and Statistics Office of the Cayman Islands. Publishes interactive indicator tables covering GDP, balance of payments, merchandise trade, CPI, population, employment, and related economic and social statistics, plus census and compendium publications.

name: Cayman Islands Monetary Authority Statistics
description: Statistical publications of the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority. Public tables and interactive digests cover investment funds, insurance licensing, and the banking sector, with Excel time series for locational and domestic banking assets and liabilities.

name: Gate.io public market data
description: Public file catalog of Gate.io historical market data, including spot and futures order books, trades, and related archives.

name: Binance Data Collection
description: Public file catalog of Binance spot and derivatives market data, including klines and trades, published as daily and monthly archives.

name: Pirojpur 3 Upazilas Mouza Map Search (P3UDP)
description: Public mouza-map search of the Urban Development Directorate's Pirojpur 3 Upazilas Development Plan (P3UDP). Users select upazila, union, mouza, and dag to view land-use maps for Pirojpur Sadar, Nazirpur, and Nesarabad.

name: Chattogram Development Authority GIS
description: Public GIS land-record application of the Chattogram Development Authority. Visitors can search plots and open the map viewer. Linked from the official CDA website as the online GIS land record management system.

name: RAJUK Web Enabled Plot based Land Record System
description: Web Enabled Plot based Land Record System (WPLRS) of RAJUK. Public GIS maps and plot records for RAJUK housing estates including Gulshan, Banani, Baridhara, Uttara, and Purbachal New Town.

name: Khulna Development Authority Mouza Map
description: Public web GIS of the Khulna Development Authority for mouza maps, existing and proposed roads, planned services, and land-use zoning in the KDA planning area.

name: Chittagong Stock Exchange
description: Chittagong Stock Exchange market data portal with market statistics, quotes, indices, and listed company information.

name: Bangladesh Bank Economic Data
description: Official economic data portal of Bangladesh Bank, the central bank of Bangladesh. Publishes macroeconomic and financial time series including exchange rates, inflation, monetary survey, money supply, foreign exchange reserves, interest rates, remittances, balance of payments, and national accounts. Monthly Economic Trends tables are available as downloadable Excel files.

name: INSTANT - Integrated Forecast Dissemination Portal
description: Integrated Forecast Dissemination Portal (INSTANT) of the Bangladesh Meteorological Department for dissemination of weather and climate forecast products.

name: Dhaka Stock Exchange
description: Dhaka Stock Exchange market data portal with market statistics, daily quotes, company data, and a historical data archive.

name: National Water Resources Database (NWRD) Online Data Dissemination Tool
description: Online data dissemination tool of the National Water Resources Database (NWRD), maintained by the Water Resources Planning Organization (WARPO) with CEGIS, providing NWRD/ICRD and project data subsets to registered users.

name: SDG Tracker | Bangladesh Development Mirror
description: SDG Tracker (Bangladesh Development Mirror) for monitoring and reporting prioritized Sustainable Development Goal targets for Bangladesh, including poverty, hunger, health, education, and gender equality indicators.

name: FFWC API Service - Flood Forecasting and Warning Centre
description: API service of the Flood Forecasting and Warning Centre (Bangladesh Water Development Board) providing real-time and historical river water levels, flood warnings, 24-48h forecasts, and station geospatial data.

name: Flood Forecasting and Warning Centre
description: Flood Forecasting and Warning Centre portal (Bangladesh Water Development Board) publishing rainfall and observed/forecast water-level tables, hydrographs, flood bulletins, and inundation forecast maps.

name: BMD Real-time Rainfall Network
description: Real-time rainfall observation network of the Bangladesh Meteorological Department with live station readings, 24-hour data tables, and downloads.

name: Bangladesh Open Government Data Portal
description: Official Bangladesh Open Government Data (OGD) portal providing one-stop access to publicly available datasets from ministries and agencies. The portal supports Sustainable Development Goal 16 and publishes data across agriculture, health, education, economy, environment, transport, and other topics. Launched as the successor to data.gov.bd with technical support from the a2i programme.

name: OpenDataBD
description: Civic open data portal that curates, verifies, and publishes Bangladesh public datasets under open licenses for researchers, journalists, and citizens.

name: BMD Climate Data Portal
description: Climate Data Portal of the Bangladesh Meteorological Department for ordering historical climate and weather data by station, variable, and time period at government-approved rates.

name: DLRS Integrated Online Map Purchase System
description: Integrated Online Map Purchase System of the Department of Land Records and Surveys. Public catalog of digitized mouza maps (CS, SA, RS, BRS, BDS surveys) searchable by division, district, upazila, and mouza.

name: BDGIS Environmental and Census Data Sharing
description: BDGIS / Environmental and Census Data Sharing (ECDS) layer catalog of the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics. Lists recently added nationwide GIS layers for land cover, soil and agriculture, rivers, and related themes.

name: Hydroinformatics and Flood Forecasting Circle
description: Hydrology data portal of the Bangladesh Water Development Board's Hydroinformatics and Flood Forecasting Circle. Provides station maps and observations for surface water, groundwater, rainfall, discharge, sediment, salinity, water quality, and climatology, plus hydrographs, sample datasets, and hydrological reports. Full historical data is available through online request.

name: Bangladesh Geospatial Information Sharing Platform (BGISP)
description: National GIS metadata and data-sharing platform that coordinates geospatial activities among government agencies in Bangladesh. Hosts GIS metadata and datasets from member organizations, including administrative boundaries, cadastral maps, transport networks, and survey products, under Section 6 of the Statistical Act, 2013.

name: LGED GIS Portal
description: Nationwide custom web GIS portal (SurfGIS) of Bangladesh's Local Government Engineering Department. The public map publishes layers for administrative boundaries, LGED and national road networks, railways, water bodies, rural markets, health facilities, cyclone shelters, forests, and settlements.

name: Crop Zoning Information System
description: Crop Zoning Information System of the Bangladesh Agricultural Research Council. OpenLayers GIS for upazila land suitability, cropping patterns, and fertilizer recommendation maps based on SRDI soil and land-resource data.

name: Bangladesh Delta Plan 2100 Atlas
description: Bangladesh Delta Plan 2100 Knowledge Portal atlas. The Data Layers viewer publishes national GIS layers for boundaries, water resources, flood and cyclone risk, land use, forests, and related planning themes.

name: Bangladesh Digital Land Zoning Map
description: National digital land zoning map of the Ministry of Land. The OpenLayers viewer publishes mouza- and plot-based land-use zoning (agriculture, settlement, forest, water, industry, and related classes) for Bangladesh.

name: BIDS Data Bank
description: Research data bank of the Bangladesh Institute of Development Studies (BIDS). Publishes downloadable datasets from BIDS studies on health, labour, energy, SMEs, and related development topics, along with hosted copies of Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics household and labour force surveys.

name: Bank of Albania Time Series
description: Public time-series warehouse of the Bank of Albania covering monetary, financial soundness, balance of payments, and external-sector indicators.

name: Research census portal
description: National research census portal with public statistics on research staff, scientific libraries, and research infrastructure.

name: Open Procurement Albania
description: Public procurement database with tender passports and red-flag risk indicators, operated by the Albanian Institute of Science.

name: Open Spending Albania
description: Treasury transaction database of public spending operated by the Albanian Institute of Science.

name: Open Corporates Albania
description: Searchable company database built from official National Business Center filings, operated by the Albanian Institute of Science.

name: Open Data Albania
description: National government open data portal of Albania, a custom DCAT-AP platform with a REST catalog API and SPARQL endpoint, harvested into data.europa.eu.

name: Qendra e Botimeve Zyrtare
description: Official Publishing Centre of Albania. Catalog of the official gazette and official publications.

name: IKTK Monuments WebGIS
description: Public OpenLayers/GeoExt WebGIS of the National Institute of Cultural Heritage (IKTK) cataloguing cultural monuments in Albania.

name: Albania Irrigation and Drainage MIS (IDMIS)
description: Public Irrigation and Drainage Management Information System geoportal for Albania, with an open OpenLayers map of municipal boundaries, irrigation canals, drainage canals and reservoirs. Operator WebGIS requires login.

name: IKTK Archaeology WebGIS
description: Public OpenLayers/GeoExt WebGIS of the National Institute of Cultural Heritage (IKTK) cataloguing archaeological sites in Albania.

name: ONS Algérie
description: Official statistics website of Algeria's National Statistics Office (ONS). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics.

name: Bank of Algeria Statistics
description: Bank of Algeria public statistics catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic tables.

name: Open Data UpGrowth
description: Public catalog of Algerian reference datasets published by UpGrowth under CC BY 4.0, including CNRC activity codes, ANAE auto-entrepreneur activities, wilaya reference data, a Journal officiel index, and customs tariff nomenclature.

name: GeoAlgeria
description: Community atlas of Algeria with an interactive trilingual map of 69 wilayas and 1,541 communes, plus MIT-licensed open geographic datasets (boundaries, post offices, banks, health, transit, and related points of interest) published as JSON, CSV, GeoJSON, and SQL.

name: Aquamap Algérie
description: Public marine aquaculture geoportal for Algerian coastal waters, mapping aquaculture sites and related marine spatial layers. Developed by CDTA for the National Centre for Fisheries and Aquaculture Research and Development (CNRDPA).

name: OpenStat Madagascar
description: Civil society open data portal operated by Madagascar Initiatives for Digital Innovation (MAIDI). Publishes datasets on public finance, health, economy, education, energy, and society to promote open data and open government in Madagascar.

name: INStaD Benin
description: Official statistics website of Benin's National Institute of Statistics and Demography (INStaD). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics.

name: SIDoFFE-NG – statistiques sociales publiques
description: Public module of SIDoFFE-NG (Système Intégré des Données relatives à la Famille, la Femme et l'Enfant, Nouvelle Génération). Disseminates official social statistics on family, women, children, disability, and social protection in Benin. The public site is an Angular application; no harvestable catalog API was found.

name: Base de données financière de la Direction Générale du Budget
description: Public financial database of Benin's Direction Générale du Budget (DGB), linked from budgetbenin.bj. Angular application for budget and public-finance datasets. No harvestable catalog API was found at /api (the path serves the SPA).

name: Ulaanbaatar Statistics Department
description: Statistical table catalog of the Ulaanbaatar Statistics Department. Publishes queryable socio-economic indicators for the capital, including population, employment, health, environment, livestock, industry, and khoroo-level counts, plus weekly consumer-price monitoring.

name: Ulaanbaatar Mapping
description: Interactive mapping portal of Ulaanbaatar (Улаанбаатарын газрын зураглал) covering khoroo-level public services, infrastructure, demographics, and socio-economic indicators. Layers include public transport, water access, waste sites, education, health, roads, and green space.

name: Mongolian Statistical Information Service
description: National statistical information service of the National Statistics Office of Mongolia. Provides queryable socio-economic indicators and dashboards covering population, labour, economy, education, and health. Machine-readable tables are published separately on the NSO PxWeb database.

name: Mongolian SDG Dashboard
description: National Sustainable Development Goals dashboard of the National Statistics Office of Mongolia. Tracks SDG indicators with charts and Excel, PDF, and CSV downloads, plus Vision 2050 and green-development indicator sets.

name: Mongolia National Data Indicators
description: Independent open data platform created at the American University of Mongolia that collects, cleans, and republishes official Mongolian government statistics with interactive visualizations and downloadable CSV/Excel datasets. Sources include the National Statistics Office and the Bank of Mongolia.

name: Mongolia Government Integrated Database
description: Government Integrated Database (Data Nation) of the National Statistics Office of Mongolia. Joins administrative registers from government agencies and publishes queryable statistical indicators and visualizations covering population, households, herders, livestock, agriculture, and the business register, including aimag-level views.

name: Billion Tree Forest Fund Dashboard
description: Public dashboard and map of Mongolia's Billion Tree national movement and forest fund. Shows planting statistics by aimag, year, program, and species, with a Leaflet map.

name: Bank of Mongolia Statistics
description: Official statistics portal of the Bank of Mongolia (Монголбанк), Mongolia's central bank. Publishes monetary and financial indicators including money supply, monetary survey, consolidated bank reports, outstanding loans, deposits, interest rates, and foreign-exchange market rates, along with downloadable monthly statistical bulletins.

name: Mongolia Integrated Health Statistics Database
description: Integrated health statistics database of Mongolia, with topic pages for maternal and child health, facility surveys, and health-sector human resources.

name: Judicial General Council Open Data
description: Open statistical reports of the Judicial General Council of Mongolia. Publishes pivot tables for monthly case movement, summary-procedure courts, and judicial proceedings.

name: Mongolia Public Investment Management System
description: Public Investment Management Information System (PIMIS) of the Ministry of Finance, listing state budget investment projects with contracts, tenders, financing progress, and breakdowns by budget governor and aimag.

name: Mongolia Procurement Open Data
description: Open data and API access to Mongolia's national e-procurement portal (tender.gov.mn), publishing tender invitations, bidders, and awarded contracts for reuse and public monitoring.

name: State Registration Open Data

Metalloenzyme-specific analysis servers are also provided, including 3D visualization of metalloenzyme structures, structure/metal active site comparison, substructure search for ligands and MBPs, and metalloenzyme profiling.

name: DrugMAP: molecular atlas and pharma-information of all drugs
description: The efficacy and safety of drugs are widely known to be determined by their interactions with multiple molecules of pharmacological importance, and it is therefore essential to systematically depict the molecular atlas and pharma-information of studied drugs. However, our understanding of such information is neither comprehensive nor precise, which necessitates the construction of a new database providing a network containing a large number of drugs and their interacting molecules. Here, a new database describing the molecular atlas and pharma-information of drugs (DrugMAP) was therefore constructed. It provides a comprehensive list of interacting molecules for >30 000 drugs/drug candidates, gives the differential expression patterns for >5000 interacting molecules among different disease sites, ADME (absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion)-relevant organs and physiological tissues, and weaves a comprehensive and precise network containing >200 000 interactions among drugs and molecules. With the great efforts made to clarify the complex mechanism underlying drug pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics and rapidly emerging interests in artificial intelligence (AI)-based network analyses, DrugMAP is expected to become an indispensable supplement to existing databases to facilitate drug discovery. It is now fully and freely accessible at: https://idrblab.org/drugmap/.

name: National Earthquake Science Data Center
description: National science data center for earthquake monitoring and seismological research data, hosted by the China Earthquake Networks Center.

name: Genome Sequence Archive
description: NGDC repository for collecting, archiving, and sharing raw genome sequence data.

name: Molecular Glue and Ternary binding database
description: MGTbind database contains 3,093 manually curated MGs with their chemical structures and physicochemical properties, along with 3,924 ternary interactions with bioactivity measurements (e.g. degradation capacities for MG degraders, in vitro biochemical activities and cellular activities). Hierarchical binding affinity is also collected to enable exploring of cooperative binding mechanisms. Ternary complex structural data are systematically integrated, either from the Protein Data Bank or generated by AlphaFold 3. All of them can be intuitively analyzed and visualized along with various predicted metrics. A fully functional and user-friendly web interface that allows global search and smooth browsing is provided and is freely accessible at https://mgtbind.pkumdl.cn.

name: National Microbial Data Center
description: The National Microbial Data Center (NMDC) is jointly constructed by the Institute of Microbiology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (IMS), the Institute of Oceanography of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the Institute of Infectious Diseases of the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention, the Institute of Plant Physiology and Ecology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and the Computer Network Information Centre of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. The General Office of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is the parent department. The data resources covering the whole life cycle of microbiological research, including microbiological resources, microbiological and cross-technological methods, research processes and engineering, microbiomics, microbiological technologies, as well as microbiological literature, patents, experts and results.

name: Beijing Genomics Institute Rice Information System
description: In BGI-RIS, sequence contigs of Beijing indica and Syngenta japonica have been further assembled and anchored onto the rice chromosomes. The database has annotated the rice genomes for gene content, repetitive elements, and SNPs. Sequence polymorphisms between different rice subspecies have also been identified.

name: MethMarkerDB: a comprehensive cancer DNA methylation biomarker database
description: MethMarkerDB is a comprehensive cancer DNA methylation biomarker database based on WGBS data, providing precise genomic location information for biomarkers, including genes and DMRs. It offers various functions such as literature-based marker gene search, pan-cancer biomarker search, and diagnostic/prognostic tools, supporting the discovery and clinical application of novel DNA methylation biomarkers in cancer.

name: Gansu Provincial Science Data Center
description: Gansu Provincial Science Data Center is a scientific data repository operated by Northwest Institute of Eco-Environment and Resources, CAS.

name: Resource and Environment Science Data Platform
description: CAS resource and environment science data cloud (RESDC) providing national geographic, climate and land-use datasets.

name: EVLncRNAs
description: Long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) have emerged as crucial regulators across diverse biological processes and diseases. While high-throughput sequencing has enabled lncRNA discovery, functional characterization remains limited. The EVLncRNAs database is the first and exclusive repository for all experimentally validated functional lncRNAs from various species. After previous releases in 2018 and 2021, this update marks a major expansion through exhaustive manual curation of nearly 25,000 publications from May 15, 2020, to May 15, 2023. It incorporates substantial growth across all categories: a 154% increase in functional lncRNAs, 160% in associated diseases, 186% in lncRNA-disease associations, 235% in interactions, 138% in structures, 234% in circular RNAs, 235% in resistant lncRNAs, and 4724% in exosomal lncRNAs. More importantly, it incorporated additional information include functional classifications, detailed interaction pathways, homologous lncRNAs, lncRNA locations, COVID-19, and phase-separation and organoid-related lncRNAs. The web interface was substantially improved for browsing, visualization, and searching. ChatGPT was tested for information extraction and functional overview with its limitation noted. EVLncRNAs 3.0 represents the most extensive curated resource of experimentally validated functional lncRNAs and will serve as an indispensable platform for unravelling emerging lncRNA functions. The updated database is freely available at https://www.sdklab-biophysics-dzu.net/EVLncRNAs3/.

name: National Polar Science Data Center
description: National science data center for Arctic and Antarctic research data, hosted by the Polar Research Institute of China.

name: World Data Center for Renewable Resources and Environment
description: World Data Center archive of renewable-resource and environmental datasets, distinct from the CAS Resource Discipline Innovation Platform.

name: Global Change Research Data Publishing and Repository
description: The Global Change Research Data Publishing and Repository (GCdataPR) is an open-science platform by the Chinese Academy of Sciences that publishes data papers (journal entries accompanied by datasets), each with a DOI to ensure persistent citation, accessibility, and long-term preservation. Launched in March 2017, it supports sharing, discovery, and reuse of global change research data through formal peer-reviewed documentation.

name: National Space Science Data Center
description: National science data center for space science mission and satellite data, hosted by the National Space Science Center, CAS.

name: National Infrastructure of Mineral Rock and Fossil Resources for Science and Technology
description: NIMRF offers state-owned specimens with scientific values, including minerals, rocks and fossils. As a data provider, it is our mission to advance the understanding of geo-resources and to provide services for academia, education and scientific popularization in the field of geoscience through collecting, organizing, and sharing specimen resources as well as attaching links to rock-mineral-fossil websites worldwide.

name: National Stem Cell Translational Resource Center
description: The National Stem Cell Translational Resource Bank (NSCTRB) contains various stem cell resources of both clinical and research grade, especially a sub-bank composed with HLA high-frequency iPSC lines in which the HLA types could match more than 60% of the Chinese population.

name: Fudan University Social Science Data Repository
description: Open for Fudan University affiliated researchers to deposit data.

name: Type IV Secretion system Resource
description: SecReT4 (Type IV Secretion system Resource) is a comprehensive collection of information of type IV secretion systems (T4SSs) in bacteria. T4SSs are versatile assemblages that promote genetic exchange and/or effector translocation with consequent impacts on pathogenesis and genome plasticity in turn.

name: DNA Methylation Interactive Visualization Database
description: DNMIVD is a comprehensive annotation and interactive visualization database for DNA methylation profile of diverse human cancer constructed with high throughput microarray data from TCGA and GEO databases, and it also integrates some data from Pancan-meQTL and HACER databases.

name: Chinese Virtual Herbarium
description: Chinese Virtual Herbarium is online access to herbarium specimens and botanical information in China.

name: GeoCloud Geological Cloud
description: China Geological Survey geological information cloud with shared geological maps, boreholes, and mineral datasets.

name: Compendium of Protein Lysine Modifications
description: CPLM (Compendium of Protein Lysine Modifications) is a database for various post-translational modifications (PTMs) specifically occurred at the side-chain amino group of lysine residues in proteins.

name: CAS Nanjing Institute of Soil Science Data Center
description: Institute-level scientific data catalog of the CAS Nanjing Institute of Soil Science.

name: ETS-Data
description: ETS-Data journal data catalog on SciOpen, harvested by Findata.

name: iProX
description: iProX is a public platform for collecting and sharing raw data, analysis results and metadata obtained from proteomics experiments. The iProX repository employs a web-based proteome data submission process and open sharing of mass spectrometry-based proteomics datasets. iProX is a member of the ProteomeXchange (PX) consortium.

name: RNA Atlas of Structure Probing
description: RASP (RNA Atlas of Structure Probing) is build from 161 deduplicated transcriptome-wide RNA secondary structures from datasets culled from 38 papers. RASP covers 18 species across animals, plants, bacteria, fungi, and also viruses, and categorizes 18 experimental methods including DMS-seq, SHAPE-Seq, SHAPE-MaP, and icSHAPE, etc. Specially, RASP curates the up-to-date datasets of several RNA secondary structure probing studies for the RNA genome of SARS-CoV-2. RASP also provides a user-friendly interface to query, browse, and visualize RNA structure profiles, offering a shortcut to accessing RNA secondary structures grounded in experimental data.

name: ncRNADrug
description:
ncRNADrug is an integrated and comprehensive resource that records manually curated and computationally predicted ncRNAs associated with drug resistance, ncRNAs targeted by drugs, as well as potential drug combinations for the treatment of resistant cancer.
https://academic.oup.com/nar/advance-article/doi/10.1093/nar/gkad1042/7416364

name: NONCODE
description: NONCODE is a database of noncoding RNAs (except tRNAs and rRNAs), including long noncoding (lnc) RNAs. Information contained within the database includes human lncRNA–disease relationships and single nucleotide polymorphism-lncRNA–disease relationships; human exosome lncRNA expression profiles; and predicted RNA secondary structures of human transcripts. This resource has not been updated since 2017, and therefore its status has been marked as Uncertain. Please get in touch if you have any information about the current status of this resource.

name: YanHuang - YH1 Genome Database
description: The YH database presents the entire DNA sequence of a Han Chinese individual, as a representative of Asian population. This genome, named as YH, is the start of YanHuang Project, which aims to sequence 100 Chinese individuals in 3 years.assembled based on 3.3 billion reads (117.7Gbp raw data) generated by Illumina Genome Analyzer. In total of 102.9Gbp nucleotides were mapped onto the NCBI human reference genome (Build 36) by self-developed software SOAP (Short Oligonucleotide Alignment Program), and 3.07 million SNPs were identified.

name: National Tibetan Plateau Data Center
description: The only data center in China with the most complete scientific data for the Tibetan Plateau and surrounding regions, hosting thousands of datasets across diverse disciplines.

name: Cotton Functional Genomics Database
description: Cotton Functional Genomics Database (CottonFGD) integrates with modern genomic/transcriptomic data and earch/analysis/visualization modules. It aims at providing an easy, quick and visualized data analysis platform for cotton (Gossypium spp) researchers and other functional genomic researches.

name: Public Health Science Data Center
description: China CDC catalog of infectious-disease, chronic-disease, vital-registration, and health risk-factor datasets.

name: National Canine Laboratory Animal Resource Center
description: The center's main task is to introduce, collect and preserve dog laboratory animal varieties, strains, develop and maintain new technologies, cultivate new varieties and strains, and provide standard experimental seeds.

name: National Rodent Laboratory Animal Resource Bank
description: Based on the needs of national scientific and technological innovation for laboratory animal resources, we use various methods such as foreign introduction, domestic collection, independent research and development, and protocol conservation to collect, integrate, and optimize laboratory animal resources.

name: CMA NSMC Satellite Data Service

name: Silkworm Pathogen Database

SilkPathDB provides access to not only genomic data including functional annotation of genes and gene products, but also extensive biological information for gene expression data and corresponding researches. SilkPathDB will be help with researches on pathogens of silkworm as well as other Lepidoptera insects.

name: Protein Lysine Modifications Database
description: The Protein Lysine Modifications Database (PLMD) is an online data resource specifically designed for protein lysine modifications (PLMs).

name: National Metrology Science Data Center

name: The database of eukaryotic RNA binding proteins
description: EuRBPDB is a comprehensive and user-friendly database for classifying and annotating eukaryotic RNA binding proteins (RBPs) drawn from various public databases. Over 100 eukaryotic species such as human, mouse, fly, worm and yeast are included. EuRBPDB also provides information on known and potential cancer-associated RBPs.

name: National Human Brain Bank for Development and Function
description: National Human Brain Bank for Development and Function was originally established in 2012 by the Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences as a public interest institution dedicated to the preservation and research of human brain tissues based on the volunteer donor station of Peking Union Medical College.

name: piRBase
description: piRBase stores information on piRNAs and piRNA-associated data to support piRNA functional analysis.

name: NADC (National Astronomical Data Center of China)
