name: Database of Somatic Mutations in Normal Cells
description: The Database of Somatic Mutations in Normal Cells (DSMNC) provides a catalogue of somatic single nucleotide variations (SNVs) occurring in single cells from various human and mouse normal tissues.

name: National Marine Data and Information Service
description: As the third center for oceanography of the World Data Center following WDC-A of the United States and WDC-B of Russia, WDC-D for oceanography boasts long-term and stable sources of domestic marine basic data. The State Oceanic Administration now has long-term observations obtained from the fixed coastal ocean stations, offshore and oceanic research vessels, moored and drifting buoys.

name: CAS Kunming Institute of Zoology Science Data Center
description: Science data center of the CAS Kunming Institute of Zoology.

name: Global Communications Repository
description:
The Global Communication Repository (GCR) aims to collect, store, cumulate and circulate academic case study research and industry practice cases and welcomes submissions from scholars, students, practitioners and media organizations and other institutions from across the world, especially from the Global South countries. GCR is to be launched in cooperation with the Ubiquity platform owned by De Gruyter Grille and hopes to generate more research opportunities by leveraging on case study as a new form of academic and professional format for knowledge building between an academic paper and a professional report. A case study is expected to address a specific issue of concern or question that should be solved but still remain unsolved in most societies, especially Global South countries.

By so doing, GCR encourages comparative approaches for case studies submitted around the world, in an effort to better enhance its goal to serve as an academic bridge between the Global North and the Global South countries. Note that only some records have DOIs minted by GCR.

name: miRSponge
description: miRSponge is a comprehensive miRNA Sponges / ceRNAs functional annotations server.

name: Chinese Crop Germplasm Resources Information System
description: Chinese Crop Germplasm Resources Information System provides germplasm resources and genetic information for crops including grains, fruits, vegetables, oilseeds, and fibers. The data includes crop fingerprint and DNA sequence data.

name: IMP: bridging the gap for medicinal plant genomics
description: Medicinal plants have garnered significant attention in ethnomedicine and traditional medicine due to their potential antitumor, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Recent advancements in genome sequencing and synthetic biology have revitalized interest in natural products. Despite the availability of sequenced genomes and transcriptomes of these plants, the absence of publicly accessible gene annotations and tabular formatted gene expression data has hindered their effective utilization. IMP (Integrated Medicinal Plantomics) is a freely accessible platform storing genetic, genome assembly, and transcriptome sequencing data encompassing various organs, tissues, developmental stages and stimulations.

name: National Geological Archives of China

It spans prokaryotes, archaea, and eukaryotes, and includes not only protein-coding essential genes but also non-coding RNAs, promoters, replication origins and other regulatory sequences.

description: China Meteorological Data Service Centre, an upgraded system of the meteorological data sharing network, is an important component of the National Science and Technology Infrastructures Platform and a main portal application system of meteorological cloud. It is an authoritative and unified shared service platform for China.

name: eccDNAdb
description: eccDNAdb currently includes 1270 eccDNAs, which were identified in 480 samples (of 42 cancers) after analyzing a total number of 3395 tumor samples (of 57 cancers) including patient tissues, patient-derived xenografts, and cancer cell lines. A total number of 54,901 eccDNA genes were annotated and included in the database as well. With the integration of gene expression, clinical information and chromatin accessibility data, eccDNAdb enables users to easily determine the biological function and clinical relevance of eccDNAs in human cancers.

name: National Earth Observation Science Data Center

It stores information on the genomic diversity of each population, including their genetic affinity, population structure, genetic admixture, ancestral architecture, and evidence of natural selection in their genomes.

Variables include mean, maximum, and minimum temperature and precipitation. Map browsing is public; file download requires a free account. Operated by the Institute for Energy, Environment and Sustainable Communities at the University of Regina.

description: National Aquatic Biological Resource Center (NABRC), established in June 2019, is a member of National Science and Technology Resource Platform supported by the Ministry of Science and Technology and the Ministry of Finance. The NABRC consists of 6 sub-platforms. In summary, these six sub-platforms have reached leading levels at home and abroad in terms of the resource richness, the resource digitization, as well as the amount and quality of resource services.

name: Deep-time Digital Earth repository
description: Population health data archive of the National population health data center Chinese Academy of Sciences

name: scMOVIR
description: scMOVIR is a multi-omics database for human viral infections and immune responses, which integrates transcriptomic, proteomic, and immune receptor repertoire data at single-cell resolution. scMOVIR incorporates 8,532 samples covering 114 viral species, subtypes, and strains, 59 disease states, and over 30 tissue types, spanning acute and chronic infection contexts, virus-associated cancers, vaccination cohorts, and therapeutic intervention studies. All datasets are subjected to standardized processing, quality control, and unified annotation to ensure consistency and interoperability. We performed multi-layered analyses, including differential gene and protein expression profiling, functional enrichment, cell–cell communication inference, and clonality characterization.

name: Pig Genomic Informatics System
description: The Pig Genomic Informatics System (PigGIS) presents accurate pig gene annotations in all sequenced genomic regions. It integrates various available pig sequence data, including 3.84 million whole-genome-shortgun (WGS) reads and 0.7 million Expressed Sequence Tags (ESTs) generated by Sino-Danish Pig Genome Project, and 1 million miscellaneous GenBank records.

name: ScRAPdb: an integrated pan-omics database for the Saccharomyces cerevisiae reference assembly panel
description: As a unicellular eukaryote, the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae strikes a unique balance between biological complexity and experimental tractability, serving as a long-standing classic model for both basic and applied studies. Recently, S. cerevisiae further emerged as a leading system for studying natural diversity of genome evolution and its associated functional implication at population scales. Having high-quality comparative and functional genomics data is critical for such efforts. Here we exhaustively expanded the Telomere-to-Telomere (T2T) S. cerevisiae reference assembly panel (ScRAP) that we previously constructed for 142 strains to cover high-quality genome assemblies and annotations for 264 S. cerevisiae strains from diverse geographical and ecological niches and also 33 outgroup strains from the other Saccharomyces species described in the genus. We created a dedicated online database, ScRAPdb (https://www.evomicslab.org/db/ScRAPdb/), to host this expanded pangenome collection. On top of the pangenome, ScRAPdb also integrates a population-scale pan-omics atlas (pantranscriptome, panproteome, and panphenome) and rich data exploration toolkits for intuitive genomics analyses. All curated data and downstream analysis results could be easily downloaded from the database. We expect ScRAPdb to become a highly valuable platform for the yeast community and beyond, leading to a pan-omics understanding of the global genetic and phenotypic diversity.

name: National Ecological Science Data Center
description: National science data center for ecology and ecosystem research data, hosted by IGSNRR, CAS.

name: Database of Arabidopsis Transcription Factors
description: The Database of Arabidopsis Transcription Factors (DATF) collects all Arabidopsis transcription factors (totally 1922 Loci; 2290 Gene Models) and classifies them into 64 families.The Version 2 of DATF was updated at July 2006. It is based on the Arabidopsis Sequence of TAIR, predicted Nuclear Location Signals, UniGene information, as well as links to literature reference.

name: IAnimal: A cross-species omics knowledgebase for animals
description: IAnimal is a cross-species, multi-omics knowledgebase. It provides comprehensive structured multi-omics data for a wide range of animal species, abundant omics data mining and visualization tools, and intelligent integration analysis algorithms for multi-omics data. In the present version, IAnimal provides 61,191 WGS, RNA-Seq, ChIP-Seq, and ATAC-Seq individual information and genome annotation information for 21 species, such as mouse, pig, cow, chicken, and which the scale of clean data reaches about 846.46 TB. In order to better understand the biological significance of omics information, IAnimal built a deep learning model based on BioBERT and AutoNER to mine 'gene' and 'trait entity from the abstracts of 2,794,237 research papers, and this is helpful for users to understand how each different omics layer regulates genes to affect the traits.

name: National Sharing Platform for Reference Materials
description: Standard, reference material is used for measurement process control and reliability evaluation of measurement results, and plays a key role in important fields such as food safety, international and domestic trade, medicine and health, and environmental monitoring.

name: National Wild Seed Resource Center
description: The National Important Wild Plant Germplasm Repository has ten types of resources and data such as seeds, DNA, isolated materials, dried leaves, etc. totaling about 180,000 copies.

name: National Collection of Authenticated Cell Cultures
description: Cell Bank/Stem Cell Bank is a nonprofit biological resource center, which includes two divisions named as cell bank and stem cell bank. It is affiliated to Shanghai Institute of Biochemistry and Cell Biology (SIBCB), a nation-renowned biomedical research institution with worldwide reputation. Our mission focuses on collection, authentication, production, preservation, development and distribution of standard reference cell lines in the life sciences.

name: National Forestry and Grassland Science Data Center
description: National science data center for forestry and grassland research data, hosted by the Chinese Academy of Forestry.

name: Animal Transcription Factor Database
description: AnimalTFDB is a comprehensive animal transcription factor database. The resource is classification of transcription factors from 50 genomes from species including Homo sapiens and Caenorhabditis elegans. The database also has information on co-transcription factors and chromatin remodelling factors.

name: World Data Center of Microorganisms
description: WFCC-MIRCEN World Data Centre for Microorganisms (WDCM) provides a comprehensive directory of culture collections, databases on microbes and cell lines, and the gateway to biodiversity, molecular biology and genome projects.The WFCC is a Multidisciplinary Commission of the International Union of Biological Sciences (IUBS) and a Federation within the International Union of Microbiological Societies (IUMS).

name: Chinese Atomic & Molecular Database
description: The Chinese Atomic & Molecular Database (CAMDB) provides a large collection of evaluated data on atomic and molecular processes mainly for plasma physics and spectroscopy. It stores information such as atomic energy levels, spectral lines and transitions, radiative rates, and collision cross sections.

name: FerrDb V2
description: FerrDb V2 contains 1001 ferroptosis regulators and 143 ferroptosis-disease associations manually curated from 3288 articles. Specifically, there are 621 gene regulators, of which 264 are drivers, 238 are suppressors, 9 are markers, and 110 are unclassified genes; and there are 380 substance regulators, with 201 inducers and 179 inhibitors. Compared to FerrDb V1, curated articles increase by > 300%, ferroptosis regulators increase by 175%, and ferroptosis-disease associations increase by 50.5%. Circular RNA and pseudogene are novel regulators in FerrDb V2, and the percentage of non-coding RNA increases from 7.3% to 13.6%. External gene-related data were integrated, enabling thought-provoking and gene-oriented analysis in FerrDb V2.

name: GHDDI Info Sharing Portal
description: GHDDI Info Sharing Portal is the public information sharing portal and data repository for the drug discovery community, initiated by GHDDI. We are making our drug discovery capabilities and resources available at no cost to all researchers who are developing new treatments for COVID-19.

name: National High Energy Physics Science Data Center
description: The National High Energy Physics Science Data Center (NHEPSDC) is a repository for high-energy physics. In 2019, it was designated as a scientific data center at the national level by the Ministry of Science and Technology of China (MOST). NHEPSDC is constructed and operated by the Institute of High Energy Physics (IHEP) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). NHEPSDC consists of a main data center in Beijing, a branch center in Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and a branch center in Huairou District of Beijing. The mission of NHEPSDC is to provide the services of data collection, archiving, long-term preservation, access and sharing, software tools, and data analysis. The services of NHEPSDC are mainly for high-energy physics and related scientific research activities. The data collected can be roughly divided into the following two categories: one is the raw data from large scientific facilities, and the other is data generated from general scientific and technological projects (usually supported by government funding), hereafter referred to as generic data.  In the past three years, the average data increment is about 10 PB per year. By integrating data resources with the IT environment, a state-of-art data process platform is provided to users for scientific research, the volume of data accessed every year is more than 400 PB with more than 10 million visits.

name: Iridovirus Comprehensive Database
description: Iridovirus Comprehensive Database (IVCDB) is a comprehensive database of Iridoviridae, including geographical location and genome of known virus isolates, non-redundant protein database of Iridoviridae, core genes of different viral taxonomic levels, evolutionary relationships between virus isolates, host range, vaccines, and visual detection methods.

name: CAS Northeast Institute of Geography and Agroecology Science Data Center
description: Public science data center UI of CAS Northeast Institute of Geography and Agroecology.

name: Chicken Variation Database
description: The chicken Variation Database (ChickVD) is an integrated information system for storage, retrieval, visualization and analysis of chicken variation data.

name: WDC for Geophysics, Beijing
description: Among the basic tasks of WDC for Geophysics, Beijing there is collection, handling and storage of science data and giving access to it for usage both in science research and study process. That includes remote access to own information resources for the scientists from the universities and institutions.

name: CryoSeek
description: CryoSeek represents a structure first paradigm for the discovery of biological entities. The CryoSeek strategy employs cryo electron microscopy (cryo EM) as a discovery tool to identify previously unknown biological entities directly isolated from natural environments or native resources. This approach is further integrated with AI facilitated computational tools and bioinformatic analyses to assess their potential origins and biological functions.

name: CASEarth Data Sharing and Service Portal
description: The portal is built for the release and sharing of data resources of "Big Earth Data Science Engineering Project (CASEarth)" launched by the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). The portal provides a variety of data mining models, such as item classification, keyword search, tag cloud filtering, and association rules. It also provides multiple data acquisition patterns including online downloading and API access. It provides online services for customized multiple data formats such as view, preview, and query. Additionally, the portal supports advanced functions such as data evaluation, validation, download, and cloud analysis for customized needs.

name: CAS Marine Science Data Center
description: Marine science big data center of the CAS Institute of Oceanology.

name: SilkDB 3.0
description: SilkDB is a database of the integrated genome resource for the silkworm, Bombyx mori. This database provides access to not only genomic data including functional annotation of genes, gene products and chromosomal mapping, but also extensive biological information such as microarray expression data, ESTs and corresponding references. SilkDB will be useful for the silkworm research community as well as comparative genomics.

name: PGG.Han Genomic Database
description: The Han Chinese Genomes Database (PGG.Han 2.0) serves as the central repository of the genomic data of the Han Chinese Genomes Project (Phase II). As is its current version, PGG.Han 2.0 archives genomic data of 137,012 Han Chinese individuals (a.k.a. Han100K). Some computational tools are available, as is an interface for data analysis and results visualization.

name: gutMDisorder
description: gutMDisorder is a comprehensive and user-friendly database for gut microbial dysbiosis under various phenotypes and therapeutic interventions from literature and raw data in human and mouse.

name: Gene Therapy Omnibus
description:
The Gene Therapy Omnibus (GTO) is a free, specialized resource in the field of gene therapy. It compiles data from global clinical trial registration platforms and the literature, along with pre- and post-therapy transcriptomic data from the GEO and ArrayExpress. This information is meticulously organized, stored, and analyzed to provide valuable insights into gene therapy research.

The database contains a total of 6,333 clinical trial records and 3,466 transcriptome profiles. These include 614 altered genes (e.g., p53, VEGFA, NY-ESO-1) and 22 types of gene therapy (e.g. CAR-T, TCR-T, gene transfer, ASO, mRNA vaccine). For each gene therapy product, detailed information is provided, including the altered gene name, structural components, indication, vector, clinical trial phase, and, where available, clinical outcomes and adverse effects.

name: National Materials Corrosion and Protection Data Center
description: National science data center for materials corrosion and protection data, hosted by the University of Science and Technology Beijing.

name: Resource Discipline Innovation Platform
description: This database is supported by the "Science and Technology Data Resource Integration and Sharing Project" project of the 12th Five-Year Plan for Informatization Construction of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the "Scientific Big Data Project" project of the 13th Five-Year Plan for Information Construction of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

name: East China Normal University Social Data Sharing Platform
description: This platform aims to realize data storage, data management, data analysis, data sharing and data citation traceability of various data sets in the field of Humanities and Social Sciences of East China Normal University.

name: Therapeutic Target Database
description: Therapeutic Target Database (TTD) catalogues therapeutic protein and nucleic acid targets, target-disease associations, perturbation profiles, and corresponding drugs. Maintained by the College of Pharmaceutical Sciences at Zhejiang University in collaboration with the National University of Singapore. Freely accessible at https://idrblab.org/ttd/ (also served at https://ttd.idrblab.cn/).

name: SpatialDB
description: Public database curating spatially resolved transcriptomic data from published papers, providing spatial gene expression profiles in tissues.

name: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry
description: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry provides the services include register for trials, consultation for trial design, central randomization for an allocation sequence, peer review for draft articles and training for peer reviewers.

name: Multi-scale Clustering of Buildings Based on Gestalt
description: This dataset is the validation process of the method mentioned in the paper "Multi-scale Clustering of Buildings Based on Gestalt". Contains shp data and related codes of two study areas

name: Plant Transcription Factor Database
description: Plant Transcription Factor Database (PlantTFDB) provides a resource of plant transcription factors (TFs), regulatory elements and interactions between them. In the latest version, It contains 320 370 TFs, classified into 58 families, from 165 species. Abundant functional and evolutionary annotations (e.g., GO, functional description, binding motifs, cis-element, regulation, references, orthologous groups and phylogenetic tree, etc.) are provided for identified TFs. In addition, multiple online tools are set up for TF identification, regulation prediction and functional enrichment analyses.

name: real-time quantitative PCR Primer Database
description: The qPrimerDB database stores information on qPCR primers and is accessible through a web front-end providing gene-specific and pre-computed primer pairs across 147 different organisms, including human, mouse, zebrafish, yeast, thale cress, rice, and maize. The qPrimerDB provides an interactive and information-rich web graphical interface to display search and BLAST results as table-based descriptions and associated links. The database provides 3,331,426 of the best primer pairs for each gene based on primer pair coverage (PPC), as well as 47,726,569 alternative gene-specific primer pairs, which can be conveniently batch downloaded.

name: MatCloud
description: High-throughput materials computing platform and database integrating simulation workflows, machine learning, and materials-genome datasets.

name: National High Energy Physics Science Data Center

name: Multi-tool DPO by MARLA Supplementary
description: Supplementary file for  Multi-tool Drilling Path Optimization by Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach, IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics.

name: National Infrastructure of Cell line Resources BMCR
description: The center is a national-level cell bank that is in line with international standards, has complete collections, and is rich in data. The center mainly collects and preserves various types of cells related to medical and biological research and provides technical services. In addition, it also conducts collaborative research and technical training of personnel.

name: SIGSEF Côte d'Ivoire
description: Integrated system for economic and financial statistics of Côte d'Ivoire, operated by the Direction Générale de l'Économie. Public multicriteria and predefined table consultation across five sectors (real, monetary, public finance, external, social), with about 84 tables and 1,990 indicators and Excel export. Distinct from the ANSTAT indicator explorer.

name: SIE Cote d Ivoire
description: Système d'Information Environnementale (SIE) of the Ministry of Environment, with thematic environmental indicators and a SIG-SIE GIS module (https://sie.environnement.gouv.ci/sieapp2/sig_index.php). No public catalog API is advertised.

description: Indicators catalog. managed by Pacific Islands Forum Secretariat. powered by Custom software. accessible at blue-pacific-2050.pacificdata.org.

name: Pacific Regional Data Repository for Sustainable Energy for All
description: Pacific Regional Data Repository for Sustainable Energy for All (PRDR SE4ALL) is the Pacific Community (SPC) catalog of energy statistics, policies, and project data for Pacific Island countries and territories, supporting the Sustainable Energy for All initiative.

description: Digital Atlas of Micronesia, a public geospatial data repository and interactive map atlas for the Federated States of Micronesia. Publishes themed map layers and related datasets for Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei, and Kosrae, covering land, reefs, water, vegetation, population, infrastructure, conservation, and culture. Created and maintained by Island Research and Education Initiative (iREi) with support from DECEM. The former islandatlas.org hostname no longer serves this atlas.

description: An extensive catalogue of interactive open datasets made available by the department of economics & statistics, Government of Kerala.

description: Public geospatial portal of the Kerala Water Authority. Hosts Jal Jeevan Mission asset maps, Geo-O&M leak and work maps, and related water-infrastructure web maps.

description: Public municipal GIS dashboard for Solapur, with OpenLayers maps and MIS views for administrative boundaries, roads, water, and ward layers.

description: K-GIS public download catalogue of Karnataka administrative and thematic spatial datasets from KSRSAC.

name: Rajkot City GIS
description: Public Smart City GIS citizen portal for Rajkot, with searchable property, ward, and public-utility layers.

description: Public Leaflet urban GIS of Haryana's Directorate of Urban Local Bodies, covering municipal boundaries, wards, colonies, and property features statewide.

description: IIPS public data catalog of NFHS, DLHS, LASI, SAGE, GATS, Youth Study and related household surveys, listing 7 catalogs and 800-plus datasets.

name: Unified-District Information System for Education Plus
description: UDISE+ (Unified District Information System for Education Plus) is the Ministry of Education's school statistics system, publishing enrolment, infrastructure, and teacher indicators for schools across India.

name: NDAP - NITI Aayog
description: The National Data and Analytics Platform (NDAP) is NITI Aayog’s flagship initiative to improve access to, and use of, government data.

name: SDG India Index and Dashboard
description: NITI Aayog dashboard ranking Indian states and union territories on the Sustainable Development Goals, with goal-level scores, metadata, and the North Eastern Region district index on the same host.

name: National Power Portal
description: National Power Portal disseminating Indian power-sector statistics on generation, capacity, demand, supply, and transmission at national, regional, and state level.

name: India KLEMS
description: Industry-level productivity accounts for India, with capital, labour, energy, materials, and services inputs.

name: IN-GRES
description: IN-GRES is a indicators catalog operated by Central Ground Water Board.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission Dashboard
description: Public Jal Jeevan Mission dashboard reporting household tap-water coverage and related rural water-supply indicators for states, districts, and blocks.

name: India Climate and Energy Dashboard
description: India Climate and Energy Dashboard is a indicators catalog operated by NITI Aayog.

name: eSankhyiki (MoSPI)
description: A data platform developed by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, Government of India, providing a single point of access to all publicly available datasets of the ministry, designed to make the datasets easy to find, download and share. It features a Data Catalogue and Macro Indicators module, with tools for filtering, visualization, and data download.

name: Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell
description: Official Indian petroleum and natural-gas statistics, including indigenous crude production, imports, and product sales.

name: Database on Indian Economy
description: One of the main purposes of DBIE is to provide time series data on aggregates in a flexible and reusable format for analytical inputs on policy matters and for research and analysis purpose.

name: Unified Portal for Agricultural Statistics
description: Unified Portal for Agricultural Statistics (UPAg) of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, publishing crop area, production, and yield tables and related agricultural indicators.

name: Corporate Data Management
description: Corporate Data Management portal of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, providing access to company registry statistics and related corporate filings data.

name: India Data Portal
description: India Data Portal at the Indian School of Business publishes geo-coded, LGD-mapped time-series datasets drawn from government sources for research and public use.

name: National Geoscience Data Repository (NGDR)
description: National Geoscience Data Repository (NGDR) is a Ministry of Mines initiative under the National Mineral Exploration Policy (NMEP) 2016, implemented by the Geological Survey of India. It hosts baseline and exploration-related geological, geochemical, geophysical, and mineral data in GIS-compatible formats for visualization, analysis, and download.

name: Survey of India Online Maps
description: Survey of India Online Maps is a geoportal operated by Survey of India.

name: Survey of India
description: Survey of India is the national mapping agency, publishing topographic maps, geodetic products, and related geospatial datasets for the country.

name: National Hydrographic Office online chart catalogue
description: Online catalogue of Indian Naval Hydrographic Department paper charts and Electronic Navigational Charts, searchable by chart name, number, area, folio and scale, with links to Indian Notices to Mariners.

name: VEDAS Earth Observation Data Archival System
description: ISRO Space Applications Centre portal for visualisation and archival of earth observation data and geospatial energy maps.

name: National Spatial Data Infrastructure
description: National Spatial Data Infrastructure is a geoportal operated by NSDI, Department of Science and Technology.

name: GSI Bhukosh
description: Geological Survey of India gateway for geoscientific map services including geology, geophysics, mineral and landslide layers.

name: Bhoomi Geoportal
description: Soil and land-use geoportal of ICAR-NBSSLUP providing access to national soil resource maps and related geospatial products.

name: Bhoonidhi
description: NRSC Bhoonidhi archive of Indian and foreign remote-sensing satellite data from 1986 onwards, including regional distribution of Sentinel and Landsat 8/9 products for India.

name: India Water Resources Information System
description: Single-window national geoportal for water resources data in a standardized GIS framework.

name: AIKosh
description: IndiaAI Mission repository of public datasets, models, and use cases for AI development, with 12,000-plus listed artefacts.

name: GTS AI Data Collection
description: Commercial catalogue of machine-learning training datasets and data-collection services from Global Technology Solutions, covering image, text, audio, and related AI data.

name: API Setu API Directory
description: API Setu API Directory is a api catalog operated by National Informatics Centre, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

name: IndiaVotes
description: IndiaVotes compiles Indian general and state assembly election results, candidate information, and constituency-level statistics from official returns.

name: KRISHI ICAR Research Data Repository
description: ICAR centralized research data repository for experimental, survey, observational, geospatial and technology datasets.

name: Prokaryotic Glycoproteins Database
description: ProGlycProt is a manually curated, comprehensive web repository of experimentally characterized glycoproteins and glycosyltransferases that are involved in protein glycosylation, in prokaryotes, exclusively. The website is a focused effort to provide concise and relevant information derived from rapidly expanding literature on prokaryotic glycoproteins, attached glycans, their glycosylating enzyme(s), their specificities, mutants, glycosylation linked genes, and genomic content thereof, in a cross-referenced, interactive manner.

name: Linguistic Data Consortium for Indian Languages
description: Catalog of text, speech, and lexical resources for Indian languages developed and distributed by LDC-IL.

name: India Environment Portal
description: The India Environment Portal makes environment and development documents from within India publicly available. It contains information from newspapers, journals, magazines, books and other documents.

name: Collection of Anti-Microbial Peptides R3
description: CAMPR3 (Collection of Anti-Microbial Peptides) has been generated to enhance research into AMP families. The collection is compatible with well-known databases such as PubMed and Uniprot with information like sequence, protein definition, accession numbers, structures as well as relevant organisms. Making this database a useful tool in AMP studies.

name: E. coli K antigen 3-dimensional structure database
description: EK3D - an E. coli K antigen 3-dimensional structure database is a repository of 72 E. coli K antigens that provides information about the sugar composition, epimeric & enantiomeric forms and linkages between the sugar monomers .

name: Kodaikanal Solar Observatory Digitized Data Archive
description: Public digitized solar observation archive of the Kodaikanal Solar Observatory, one of the longest continuous solar data series.

name: World Data Centre for Geomagnetism, Mumbai
description: World Data Centre for Geomagnetism in Mumbai with observatory holdings and long-term analog and digital geomagnetic records.

name: FlavorDB
description: FlavorDB is a repository of flavour molecules, their natural sources, physicochemical properties, and sensory responses, covering tens of thousands of molecules linked to ingredients, tastes, and odours for food and fragrance research.

name: India Water Portal
description: India Water Portal is a public knowledge platform on water and related resources, publishing articles, data, and documents on water supply, sanitation, and hydrology in India.

name: NCMRWF Reanalyses Datasets
description: NCMRWF portal for IMDAA regional and NGFS global atmospheric reanalysis datasets.

name: NICES Earth and Climate Data Portal
description: National Information System for Climate and Environment Studies portal for satellite-derived climate and earth observation data products.

name: SigMol
description: SigMol is a specialized repository of quorom sensing signaling molecules (QSSMs) in prokaryotes. SigMol harbors information on QSSMs pertaining to different quorum sensing signaling systems namely acylated homoserine lactones (AHLs), diketopiperazines (DKPs), 4- hydroxy-2-alkylquinolines (HAQs), diffusible signal factors (DSFs), autoinducer-2 (AI-2) and others. The database includes biological as well as chemical aspects of signaling molecules. Biological information includes genes, preliminary bioassays, identification assays and applications, while chemical detail comprises of IUPAC name, SMILES and structure.

name: NBPGR Plant Genetic Resources Portal
description: Searchable catalogue of plant genetic resources conserved in the Indian National Genebank at NBPGR.

name: Oral Cancer Gene Database
description: OrCGDB is a user-friendly database containing information on 374 genes related to oral cancer including gene function mutations expression pathways and clinical relevance with search options and an interaction network linking gene relationships through PubMed references.

name: ICAR-NBPGR Genebank Database
description: Dashboard and holdings catalogue for the Indian National Genebank, including seed, cryo, in vitro, and field collections.

name: Fish Barcode Information System
description: Public DNA barcode archive for fishes of the Indian subcontinent with taxonomy, morphology, and conservation status.

name: NCS Earthquake Catalogue
description: Public earthquake catalogue of the National Center for Seismology with origin time, location, depth, and magnitude.

name: National Genomic Resource Repository Database
description: Public accession catalogue of genomic resources conserved in the National Genomic Resource Repository at NBPGR.

name: Compilation and Creation of datasets from PDB
description: ccPDB (Compilation and Creation of datasets from PDB) is a collection of commonly used data sets for structural or functional annotation of proteins. Datasets from literature and the Protein Data Bank (PDB) were incorporated into ccPDB to facilitate the analysis and organisation of additional dataset collections by the researcher.

name: ISRO Science Data Archive
description: The ISRO Science Data Archive (ISDA) is India’s main repository for science data from national space missions, beginning with Chandrayaan-1. It stores a wide range of mission data, including raw and processed observations, calibration files, auxiliary datasets, and higher-level derived products such as images, spectra, and geophysical parameters.

name: Clinical Trials Registry - India
description: The Clinical Trials Registry- India (CTRI), hosted at the ICMR's National Institute for Research in Digital Health and Data Science (https://nims.icmr.org.in), is a free and online public record system for registration of clinical trials being conducted in India.

name: Indian National Polar Data Center
description: India's National Polar Data Center (NPDC) at NCPOR manages datasets collected by Indian scientists in the Antarctic, Arctic, Southern Ocean, and Himalaya. It is India's SCAR National Antarctic Data Centre.

name: IMD Data Service Portal
description: IMD National Data Centre portal for historical meteorological observations, station inventories, and gridded climatological products.

name: MoES Earth System Science Data Portal
description: Ministry of Earth Sciences metadata and data discovery portal covering atmosphere, ocean, polar, and geoscience datasets.

name: PASS2 Protein Alignment Database
description: PASS2 is an automatic version of the original superfamily alignment database, CAMPASS (CAMbridge database of Protein Alignments organised as Structural Superfamilies, Sowdhamini et al., 1998). It contains alignments of protein structures at the superfamily level and is in direct correspondence with SCOPe 2.08 release.

name: Database of Bacterial Exotoxins for Human
description: DBETH is the Database of Bacterial Exotoxins for Human. The aim of this database is to assemble information on the toxins responsible for causing bacterial pathogenesis in humans.

name: National Health Research Data Repository
description: ICMR national health research data repository listing named clinical and epidemiological datasets for registered researchers.

name: CHAVI - Comprehensive Archive of Imaging in Oncology
description: CHAVI - The Comprehensive Archive of Imaging is the first imaging biobank from India with an exclusive focus on Oncological Imaging. CHAVI was designed as a research collaboration between Tata Medical Center, Kolkata and Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur. Researchers, academicians and industry are welcome to collaborate and use the wealth of imaging data available in CHAVI subject to our terms and conditions of use. Please note that all users who would like to download the imaging data available in CHAVI will need to complete a user profile, user agreement form as well as provide us with a brief statement of the purpose for which they would like to use these images. All images have been de-identified but certain sets of images may require additional licensing prior to use. Collaborators who would like to contribute imaging data to CHAVI would be provided with a free copy of the CHAVI de-identification system on premises.

name: Bharat Genome Database
description: Bharat Genome Database is a community genomics resource compiling genomic variation and related annotations with a focus on Indian populations.

name: Resource of Asian Primary Immunodeficiency Diseases
description: The Resource of Asian Primary Immunodeficiency Diseases (RAPID) is a repository of molecular alterations in primary immunodeficiency diseases (PID). It hosts information on sequence variations and expression at the mRNA and protein levels of all genes reported to be involved in PID patients. This database aims to to provide detailed information pertaining to genes and proteins involved in primary immunodeficiency diseases along with other relevant information about protein–protein interactions, mouse studies and microarray gene-expression profiles in various organs and cells of the immune system. Please note that, while available, the RAPID database is no longer being updated.

name: Lok Dhaba
description: LokDhaba is a structured repository of Indian election results, covering both national (Lok Sabha) and state assembly elections from 1962 onwards. It provides cleaned and organized datasets, including candidate and constituency-level information, for researchers, journalists, and students. The data are assembled from official sources and enhanced with contextual variables, and users can explore and download them for analysis.

name: PROtein-protein compleX MutAtion ThErmodynamics Database
description: PROXiMATE is a database of thermodynamic data for more than 6000 missense mutations in 174 heterodimeric protein-protein complexes, supplemented with interaction network data from STRING database, solvent accessibility, sequence, structural and functional information, experimental conditions and literature information. Additional features include complex structure visualization, search and display options, download options and a provision for users to upload their data.

name: NCPOR Polar Observation Data Catalog
description: NCPOR observation data catalog with public listings of AWS, glacier, ice-core, radiometer, and surface-ozone datasets from Maitri, Bharati, Arctic, and Himalayan stations.

name: Tallinn Open Data API
description: Universal API for Tallinn city open data. SQL-style query interface with OpenAPI documentation. Dataset metadata is also published on the national data portal.

name: Estonian Climate Data Explorer
description: University of Tartu Centre for Climate Research explorer of public Estonian weather datasets: historical station series, live observations, radar precipitation, lightning, and drought indices.

name: Estonian Biocentre Public Data
description: Public genotype and population-genetics dataset dump of the former Estonian Biocentre (now University of Tartu Institute of Genomics). Listed in re3data as Estonian Biocentre Free Data.

name: Haridussilm
description: National education indicators portal (Education Eye). School- and institution-level statistics on basic, secondary, vocational, and higher education, hobby education, lifelong learning, and labour-market outcomes from the Estonian Education Information System (EHIS).

name: Elering Live
description: Public live dashboard of the Estonian electricity and gas transmission system operator. Real-time series for production, consumption, cross-border flows, prices, and system plan data, with a JSON API.

name: Estonian Unemployment Insurance Fund statistics
description: Public labour-market dashboards for registered unemployed, vacancies, services, benefits, and work-ability assessment.

name: Tree of Truth (Tõetamm)
description: Statistics Estonia and Government Office public indicator tree for Estonia 2035, sustainable development, and the government action programme.

name: Päästeamet fire statistics
description: Rescue Board interactive map and tables of fires with fatalities, filterable by county, building type, and cause, with CSV download.

name: Finantsinspektsioon statistics module
description: Supervisory statistics tables for Estonian banking, credit, investment, payment services, and insurance-broker markets, with Excel, CSV, and XML downloads.

name: Statistics Estonia dashboards
description: Public Statistics Estonia dashboards for business sectors, local government, SDG, youth, and other cross-cutting themes. Login is optional for personal boards.

name: Eesti Pank statistics module
description: Official statistics module of Eesti Pank, publishing Estonia's external-sector, financial-sector, and financial-accounts statistics, with table downloads and SDMX files for SDDS Plus.

name: Valimiste avaandmed
description: Public election open-data catalog of the Estonian State Electoral Office. Lists XML files for candidates, turnout, and results by election event (RK, KOV, EP), with a documented machine interface at /api/{event}/{filename}.

name: Keskkonnaportaal open data catalogue
description: Estonian Environment Agency open data catalogue on the Environmental Portal. DCAT 3.0 / DCAT-AP descriptions of environment and weather datasets, data dictionaries, downloads, and API/OGC distributions.

name: Andmete teabevärav
description: National data portal (Andmete teabevärav, ATV), launched in 2025 as the successor to avaandmed.eesti.ee. Catalogues open data and metadata for restricted public-sector datasets.

name: KAIA environmental open-data file store
description: KAIA environmental open-data file store. Searchable repository and API for Estonian Environment Agency meteorological monitoring, radar, model forecasts, hydrological forecasts, and fire-danger (FWI) files.

name: TEHIK open data
description: TEHIK open-data portal for Estonian health datasets, including COVID-19, vaccination, and influenza tables, with REST (PostgREST/OpenAPI) and OData APIs. Successor of opendata.digilugu.ee.

name: Riigi Teataja
description: Official gazette and consolidated legislation catalog of Estonia.

name: Tark Tee
description: Tark Tee (Smart Road) traffic-information application of the Estonian Transport Administration, publishing live road, weather, and traffic conditions.

name: Estonian Hydrographic Information System (public HIS)
description: Public hydrographic survey database (AHIS) of the Estonian Transport Administration covering survey areas, depths, underwater objects and contours. Distinct from the Nutimeri nautical chart viewer on the same organisation.

name: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board Geoportal
description: National geoportal of the Land and Spatial Development Board (Maa- ja Ruumiamet, formerly Maa-amet / Estonian Land Board). Hosts web maps, spatial datasets, download services, and open data. Also reachable at geoportaal.maaruum.ee and geoportaal.ee.

name: METOC portal (Estonian coastal ocean measurements)
description: Real-time hydrometeorological portal for Estonian coastal and marine stations. Parameters include wind, waves, sea level and temperature from TalTech Marine Systems, the Environment Agency and navigation buoys.

name: JCDecaux Estonia Geo Portal
description: JCDecaux Estonia map of outdoor-advertising inventory and related geospatial layers.

name: RIHA — Riigi infosüsteemi haldussüsteem
description: State information system management catalog (RIHA). Public register of more than 1,300 Estonian government information systems and datasets, with a REST API and OpenAPI documentation.

name: X-tee iseteenindus
description: X-tee (X-Road) self-service portal. Catalog of SOAP and REST data-exchange services between Estonian public- and private-sector information systems, with WSDL and OpenAPI descriptions.

name: Eesti õhukvaliteedi juhtimissüsteem
description: Estonian air-quality management system. Public monitoring data for the national network.

name: UNITE
description: UNITE is a database and sequence management environment centered on the eukaryotic nuclear ribosomal ITS region. All eukaryotic ITS sequences from the International Nucleotide Sequence Database Collaboration are clustered to approximately the species level (distance between species in steps of 0.5%), and all such species hypotheses are given a DOI to facilitate unambiguous scientific communication and data assembly. The user can interact with these species hypotheses (e.g., SH1566366.08FU) in various ways, and third-party sequence and metadata annotation are supported. Registration is needed to access the more powerful features of the accompanying PlutoF workbench. A range of search and query options are available, and precompiled reference datasets for local sequence similarity searches and HTS pipelines are available for download. Owing to the mycological roots of UNITE, two versions of the release files are available: all eukaryotes (including fungi), and fungi only. UNITE is a community effort that relies on the scientific expertise of its users – please consider contributing by, e.g., annotating sequences of your taxa of expertise.

name: ONEI Cuba indicadores
description: Official statistics website of Cuba's National Office of Statistics and Information (ONEI). Publishes national indicators, yearbooks, and statistical tables covering population, economy, and social statistics.

name: Jordan Economic and Social Indicators System
description: Department of Statistics economic and social indicators database with 284 time series across 13 sectors, including monetary, real economy, public finance, labour, education, health, tourism, and Amman Stock Exchange, with chart and table views.

name: Jordanian Labor Market Information System
description: Public Labour Market Information System of the Ministry of Labour, with bilingual indicator matrices on labour supply and demand, employment, and related decent-work statistics compiled with the Department of Statistics and other agencies.

name: Jordan Data Portal
description: National SDG and development indicators portal of the Department of Statistics, with bilingual dashboards, an SDG tracking tool, a report builder, and topic pages covering education, environment, gender, health, labour, the macroeconomy, and the statistical yearbook.

name: Central Bank of Jordan Statistical Database
description: Central Bank of Jordan statistical database of monetary, banking, public finance, balance of payments, external trade, GDP, prices, production, and Amman Stock Exchange time series, with charts and downloadable tables.

name: Jordan e-Government Open Data (SANAD)
description: Dataset listing on the Jordan e-government portal (SANAD), separate from the national CKAN Open Government Data Portal at opendata.gov.jo.

name: Mutah University E-Print
description: Mutah University faculty publication repository (MU E-Print), listing article metadata and abstracts by college and department. Public browse does not require login; deposit is limited to university staff.

name: Royal Botanic Garden Jordan Garden Explorer
description: Living-collections catalog of the Royal Botanic Garden of Jordan, with a searchable genus list of native and garden plants and a map of individual plant and area locations at Tell Ar-Rumman.

name: Philadelphia University Scientific Research Portal
description: Philadelphia University (Amman) public catalog of faculty research papers and master theses, with faculty and year filters and downloadable full text for many records.

name: Jelgavas ģeodatu portāls
description: Jelgava municipal geodata portal. Public map of city infrastructure, flood maps, spatial planning, protected nature areas, adjoining land, and street red lines.

name: Riga Open Data OData service
description: Riga City Council machine-readable OData v3 catalog. Municipal datasets on population, education, social statistics, and local government activity. The former portal homepage now redirects to the Riga organisation on data.gov.lv.

name: GEO RĪGA
description: GEO RĪGA is the Riga municipal geospatial data portal. It publishes city maps, open geodata, and GIS applications for urban planning, infrastructure, and public information.

name: CSB Research data catalogue
description: Central Statistical Bureau catalogue of anonymized survey microdata for off-site use under a data-use agreement and for on-site remote access. Includes EU-SILC, the labour force survey, the household budget survey, the European Health Interview Survey, graduate tracking, and the city quality-of-life survey.

name: RAIM — Regional Development Indicator Module
description: National Regional Development Indicator Module (RAIM). Public profiles of socio-economic indicators for Latvian municipalities and planning regions, used to monitor regional development and support evidence-based policy.

name: Internet statistical database (INTS) Latvijas Banka
description: With its internet statistical database (INTS) Latvijas Banka aims to provide users with modern, user friendly and adaptable means for data access and analysis of data using graphic tools.

name: VSAA social insurance statistics
description: State Social Insurance Agency (VSAA) public indicator summaries built in eazyBI from the Welfare Information System. Monthly pensions, benefits, and compensation series, plus annual counts of socially insured persons.

name: Latvijas Vēstnesis
description: Official gazette of Latvia. Catalog of laws and official notices published in Latvijas Vēstnesis.

name: CVK vēlēšanu dati
description: Public election-data catalog of the Central Election Commission. Lists candidate lists, results, and elected deputies for recent Latvian elections (including PV2025 municipal elections and SV2026 Saeima elections).

name: Transports. Mobilitāte
description: Latvian National Access Point for transport and mobility data (Transports. Mobilitāte).

name: Uzņēmumu reģistra atvērtie dati
description: Origin open-data dump of the Latvian Register of Enterprises. Public CSV/XLSX tables for the company register, beneficial owners, officers, insolvency, and related legal-entity datasets, documented in ur_opendata.pdf.

name: CSP geospatial statistics portal
description: Geospatial statistics portal of the Central Statistical Bureau (CSP). Maps and spatial views of official statistics for Latvia, separate from the national GEO Latvija geoportal.

name: Lauku bloku karte
description: Rural Support Service (LAD) public field-blocks map. Interactive viewer of declared agricultural parcels with a harvestable WFS at /arcgis/services/lauki/MapServer/WFSServer.

name: GEO Latvija
description: GEO Latvija is the national unified geospatial information portal. It publishes maps and geospatial datasets from Latvian public-sector organisations for government, public, and research use.

name: Teritorijas attīstības plānošanas informācijas sistēma (TAPIS)
description: TAPIS (Teritorijas attīstības plānošanas informācijas sistēma) is the national territorial-development planning system. It publishes planning documents and related geospatial data for municipalities and the public, operated by the State Digital Development Agency.

name: VDAA API Pārvaldnieks
description: National API Manager developer portal. Catalog of REST and SOAP services from Latvian state and municipal information systems, operated by the State Digital Development Agency on WSO2 API Manager.

name: Riga Technical University research outputs and resources
description: Riga Technical University institutional catalog of research outputs and research datasets, published through the ORTUS science portal.

name: Baltic 100 Data Catalog
description: Quantitative historical data catalog of the BALTIC 100 project on societal and economic transformations in the regions of Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania over the last hundred years.

name: LATMARE marine environmental database
description: Public marine monitoring database of the Latvian Institute of Aquatic Ecology for hydrological, hydrochemical and hydrobiological observations in the Baltic Sea and Gulf of Riga. Open datasets are also published to the Latvian Open Data Portal via API.

name: Korpuss.lv — Latvian National Corpora Collection
description: Latvian National Corpora Collection. Catalog of written and spoken Latvian language corpora from multiple institutions, with federated search and corpus metadata for linguistics, digital humanities, and language technology.

name: Dabasdati.lv — nature observations
description: National citizen-science portal for wildlife observations in Latvia. Volunteers report plants, animals, and other organisms mapped to Latvian territory; validated records support research and nature conservation, including data shared with the national Ozols nature-data system.

name: GEO SIGULDA
description: Sigulda Municipality public map-publishing portal. Thematic maps of roads, shelters, school-bus routes, municipal property, and related local-government layers, distinct from the municipality terGIS planning map.

name: Mapa Zona Catastrada Municipalidad de Santa Bárbara
description: Municipal cadastral map of Municipalidad de Santa Bárbara, Costa Rica.

name: SIG público Municipalidad de Orotina
description: Municipal geoportal of Municipalidad de Orotina, Costa Rica.

name: Visor Cartográfico Municipalidad de Santa Cruz
description: Municipal geoportal of Municipalidad de Santa Cruz, Costa Rica.

name: Visor Cartográfico Municipalidad de Cañas
description: Municipal cadastral viewer of Municipalidad de Cañas, Costa Rica.

name: INEC Costa Rica
description: Official statistics website of Costa Rica's National Institute of Statistics and Censuses (INEC). Publishes indicator tables and statistical products covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics. Distinct from the INEC DKAN open-data portal.

name: Portal Estadístico de Comercio Exterior (PROCOMER)
description: Official interactive statistical portal of Costa Rica's Foreign Trade Promoter (PROCOMER). It provides export and import statistics by destination or origin market, product, sector, customs regime, transport mode, and customs office, with open data access via OData.

name: Indicadores Económicos de Costa Rica | Banco Central (BCCR)
description: Official economic indicators catalog of the Banco Central de Costa Rica (BCCR). Provides exchange rates, inflation, interest rates, national accounts, and other macroeconomic time series through the Sistema de Divulgación de Datos Económicos (SDDE), with a documented REST API.

name: Sistema Nacional de Información Ambiental (SINIA)
description: Official environmental information platform of Costa Rica, operated by the Centro Nacional de Información Geoambiental (CENIGA) under the Ministry of Environment and Energy (MINAE). Provides national environmental indicators, statistics, maps, and reports.

name: MapaInversiones Costa Rica
description: Costa Rica's public investment transparency platform (MapaInversiones / Rendir Cuentas), operated by MIDEPLAN. It publishes geolocated public investment projects from the Banco de Proyectos de Inversión Pública (BPIP) and the Plan Nacional de Desarrollo y de Inversión Pública (PNDIP), plus open data on COVID-19 emergency spending, subsidies, donations, public procurement, and budgets.

name: Geoportal Estadístico del INEC
description: Statistical geoportal of the National Institute of Statistics and Censuses (INEC) of Costa Rica. Integrates statistical indicators with geospatial data at region, province, canton, and district levels.

name: MIO-CIMAR marine information module
description: Public marine observing and forecast products of the University of Costa Rica CIMAR oceanographic information module, including tides, metocean forecasts and coastal bulletins for Costa Rican waters.

name: SIMOCUTE - Sistema Nacional de Monitoreo de Cobertura y Uso de la Tierra y Ecosistemas
description: Official Costa Rican platform for monitoring land cover, land use, and ecosystems (SIMOCUTE). Led by CENIGA under the Ministry of Environment and Energy (MINAE), it publishes standardized maps, statistics, and reports, including WMS/WFS layers on forest cover, land use, protected areas, and related environmental themes.

name: SNIT - Sistema Nacional de Información Territorial
description: Official geoportal of Costa Rica's National Territorial Information System (SNIT), the spatial data infrastructure of Costa Rica (IDECORI). Administered by the Instituto Geográfico Nacional of the Registro Nacional. Provides map viewers, official institutional layers, and OGC services (WMS, WMTS, WFS).

name: BERNHIST Historisch-Statistische Datenbank Kanton Bern
description: Historical-statistical database of the Canton of Bern (BERNHIST). Query population, economy, environment and political series from 1700 to the present by municipality, parish, district and canton, with Excel and PDF export and a public API.

name: Statistik Baselland
description: Official table catalog of the Amt für Daten und Statistik Basel-Landschaft. Twenty-one statistical themes with communal, district and cantonal tables and charts. Distinct from the OpenDataSoft portal at data.bl.ch.

name: Geodaten Kanton Basel-Landschaft
description: Official geodata catalog of the Canton of Basel-Landschaft (Amt für Geoinformation). Geodata products are available free of charge via GeoShop BL in INTERLIS, ESRI Shapefile and DXF formats, covering cadastral survey, land-use plans, environment, waters, agriculture, forest, transport, energy, natural hazards, 3D building models, LiDAR, administrative boundaries, archaeology and orthophotos.

name: Geoportal da l'administraziun chantunala (Geoportal der kantonalen Verwaltung Graubünden)
description: Auflistung der in der kantonalen Verwaltung Graubünden vorhandenen Geodatenbestände. Geodaten, Interaktive Karte, WebMapService, WebFeatureService, Geofunktion.

name: Crans-Montana OpenData
description: Public download catalog of Crans-Montana points of interest and municipal datasets in XML and JSON. Distinct from the VSGIS geoportal for the commune.

name: Statistiques cantonales Genève (OCSTAT)
description: Official statistical portal of the Canton of Geneva (OCSTAT). Publishes tables, charts, maps and analyses across 21 statistical domains covering population, labour, economy, health, education, construction, environment and public finance.

name: Open Government Data-Portal Kanton Aargau
description: Open Government Data Portal des Kantons Aargau mit maschinenlesbaren Verwaltungsdaten und REST-APIs zu Politik, Bevölkerung, Wirtschaft, Verkehr, Energie, öffentlicher Sicherheit und Geographie.

name: Geodaten Kanton Solothurn
description: Geodata catalogue of the Canton of Solothurn, listing cantonal spatial datasets and download services.

name: Open Government Data Schaffhausen
description: Open Government Data portal of Schaffhausen, publishing freely reusable cantonal and municipal datasets.

name: Geoportal Schaffhausen
description: Official geoportal of the Canton of Schaffhausen (Amt für Geoinformation), providing browser-based access to cantonal geodata, map viewing, and applications such as building-land search and ÖREB.

name: Gemeindeporträts Kanton Zug
description: Interactive municipality and canton portraits of the Fachstelle für Statistik Zug. Public dc.js map and indicator table comparing communal kennzahlen. Distinct from the data.zg.ch open-data portal.

name: STADA2 Statistikdatenbank St. Gallen
description: STADA2 indicator database of the Canton of St. Gallen with more than 1,000 pre-calculated statistical indicators, maps and time series for municipalities, regions and neighbouring cantons. CSV and XLS exports can be generated from the Export tab, including parameterized export URLs.

name: Datenaustauschplattform GDI des Kanton St. Gallen
description: Öffentliche Datenaustauschplattform der Geodateninfrastruktur (GDI) des Kantons St.Gallen. Nextcloud-basierte Plattform zum Bezug von kantonalen Geodaten.

name: Geometadaten Kanton St. Gallen
description: Cantonal geographic metadata catalog for St. Gallen, with public geo_records and product documentation distinct from the geoportal.ch/ktsg viewer.

name: Viageo
description: Geodata catalog for French-speaking Switzerland (Suisse romande), operated by ASIT. Lists maps and geospatial datasets from cantonal, municipal and other providers. Open-data slices for Lausanne and Morges are harvested by opendata.swiss via DCAT-AP CH.

name: AIcrowd
description: Challenge platform cataloging machine-learning competition datasets, tasks, and leaderboards.

name: Statistik Stadt Zürich Linked Data Cubes
description: Linked statistical cubes of Statistik Stadt Zürich. RDF Data Cube catalogue with a SPARQL browser and machine-readable cube listings, distinct from the city CKAN open-data portal.

name: Gemeindefinanzporträt HRM2 Zürich
description: Public HRM2 municipal finance portrait of the Canton of Zurich. Query accounts, functions and ratios for political municipalities, school communes, associations and institutions, with tables, maps, comparisons and export. Distinct from Zürcher Gemeinden in Zahlen.

name: Zürcher Gemeinden in Zahlen
description: Cantonal statistics portal “Zürcher Gemeinden in Zahlen” of the Amt für Statistik und Daten. Publishes about 80 comparable indicators for municipalities, districts and regions of the Canton of Zurich as interactive charts, maps and tables.

name: Datenkatalog Kanton Zürich
description: Datenkatalog des Kantons Zürich mit offenen Behördendaten aus der Kantonsverwaltung, statistischen Analysen des Amts für Statistik und Daten, Indikatoren aus dem Gemeindeporträt und Publikationen. Geodaten sind ausgenommen.

name: Stadtplan Winterthur
description: Official 2D city map of Winterthur, providing public access to municipal geospatial layers and points of interest.

name: GeoLION Zurich Geoportal
description: GeoLION is the geodata catalogue of the Canton of Zürich, documenting cantonal spatial datasets, geoservices, and metadata.

name: Food Systems Dashboard
description: Global and country dashboards bringing together more than 300 indicators on food production, availability, affordability, diets, nutrition, livelihoods, climate, environment, resilience and governance, with metadata and bulk downloads.

name: CHstat
description: CHstat comparative database of Swiss cantons, cities over 10,000 inhabitants and communes. Theme tables, regional portraits, maps and dashboards on public administration, finances, population and justice. Successor of BADAC; not the FSO StatBank.

name: Historische Statistik der Schweiz
description: Historical Statistics of Switzerland (HSSO) table catalogue of long-run economic, social, political and environmental series compiled from official statistics and research. Browseable by theme with downloadable tables.

name: Infectious Diseases Dashboard (IDD)
description: Infectious Diseases Dashboard of the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health. Publishes surveillance indicators (influenza, wastewater monitoring and related infectious-disease series) with a DCAT-AP CH catalog harvested by opendata.swiss.

name: Identitas Animal Statistics
description: Public livestock statistics portal operated by Identitas AG. Publishes tables and charts on cattle, pigs, sheep, goats and other livestock in Switzerland, with a DCAT-AP CH catalog harvested by opendata.swiss.

name: BAG Health Insurance Costs Dashboard
description: Health insurance costs dashboard of the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health (BAG KUV). Publishes cost-monitoring tables for compulsory health insurance with a DCAT-AP CH catalog harvested by opendata.swiss.

name: BAFU Umweltindikatoren
description: Environmental indicator catalogue of the Swiss Federal Office for the Environment (FOEN/BAFU). Searchable list of monitoring indicators on the state and development of the environment, typically updated once a year.

name: Global Trade Alert
description: Database of government trade-policy interventions worldwide, with a public data center of measures affecting cross-border commerce.

name: SNB Data Portal
description: On the data portal, the SNB publishes data which is of importance for monitoring the economy as well as for monetary policy; to this end, the SNB draws on external sources, such as the Swiss Federal Statistical Office. The selection contains tables and charts which can be configured by the user, as well as predefined charts. Topics include Swiss National Bank, Banks, Interest rates, yields and foreign exchange market, Capital market and payment transactions, Swiss economic affairs, International economic affairs, and Cross-thematic publications.

name: Energie-Dashboard Bundesamt für Energie
description: Energy Dashboard of the Swiss Federal Office of Energy. Interactive indicators on electricity, gas, energy prices, weather and annual energy balances for monitoring Switzerland’s energy supply.

name: Swissgrid Production and Consumption
description: Swiss electricity production, consumption, and cross-border exchange data published by Swissgrid.

name: Swiss Tourism Data
description: Tourism metadata catalogue for Switzerland providing access to tourism datasets, including points of interest, web traffic data, transaction data, mobility data, and user-generated content. Part of the Resilient Tourism Project supported by Innosuisse.

name: Dodis Open Data
description: Public dump catalog of Diplomatic Documents of Switzerland open data, including yearly LOD exports (Turtle, N-Triples, SQL).

name: Swiss Federal Statistical Office Open Data
description: Overview of datasets currently published by the Swiss Federal Statistical Office (FSO/BFS), grouped by the 21 official statistical themes. Includes tables (XLSX), machine-readable files (CSV, JSON), statistical cubes, and open government data also available on opendata.swiss, with access via the FSO DAM API.

name: ACAPS datasets
description: Public humanitarian datasets from ACAPS, including severity, protection risks, and crisis-specific core datasets.

name: SNSF Data Portal
description: The Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) Data Portal publishes data on evaluated projects and the people involved, to provide transparency and support analysis of funding activities. Downloadable tables cover grants, persons, and research outputs since 1975, alongside key figures, data stories, and grant search.

name: Fedlex
description: Official compilation of Swiss federal law, including the Official Compilation and the Classified Compilation.

name: Official Gazettes Portal
description: Swiss official gazettes portal, including the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SHAB) and cantonal official gazettes, with a public REST API.

name: Kiwix Library
description: Catalog of offline content in ZIM file format, filterable by language and topic (e.g., Wikipedia, MOOCs, TED talks), offering online preview and various download options.

name: InfoFlora Atlas
description: Public Swiss flora occurrence atlas with distribution maps and symbology for observation counts, indigeneity and validation status.

name: Swiss Basic Geodata Catalog
description: Geo data portal provided by the 'Konferenz der kantonalen Geoinformations- und Katasterstellen'. In Switzerland, the basic geodata catalog is a catalog-like listing of all geodata that have been collected by a legal authority by linking them to underlying legal enactments. In addition to a visualization of the geo data recorded by geo information law, its function is the database-specific assignment of responsible bodies and other legally relevant attributes.

name: OpenStreetMap Switzerland tile server
description: OpenStreetMap Switzerland tile service providing raster and vector tiles of OSM data for Switzerland.

name: info fauna carto
description: Public species-distribution cartography of InfoFauna, the Swiss Biological Records Centre.

name: Swiss Geodienste Spatial Data Services
description: Intercantonal portal for accessing official geodata and geoservices. Cantonal and municipal geobasis data are aggregated in a structurally harmonized form for Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Offers WMS, WFS, OGC API Features, Atom, STAC, and a REST API. Access conditions are defined by the cantons.

name: Eawag Data Lakes Portal
description: Search, visualise and download data on Swiss lakes.

name: I14Y Interoperability Platform
description: Switzerland's national metadata catalogue of public administration data collections, electronic interfaces and government services. Operated by the Federal Statistical Office, it publishes metadata from the Confederation, cantons and communes so data can be found and reused; the actual data remain with the responsible agencies.

name: MycoBrowser
description: Mycobrowser is a resource that provides both in silico generated and manually reviewed information within databases dedicated to the complete genomes of Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Mycobacterium leprae, Mycobacterium marinum and Mycobacterium smegmatis. This collection references Mycobacteria tuberculosis information.

name: BeeBiome Data Portal
description: BeeBiome Data Portal is a resource for scientists and the general public on bee-associated microbes/viruses and their impact on bee health.

name: Eawag Biocatalysis/Biodegradation Database
description: Eawag-BBD (formerly the University of Minnesota Biocatalysis/Biodegradation Database) catalogs microbial biocatalytic reactions and biodegradation pathways. Hosted by Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology.

name: Integrierter Katalog (InK) der Mediathek HGK Basel FHNW
description: The Integrated Catalogue (InK) of Mediathek of the Basel Academy of Art and Design (Hochschule für Gestaltung und Kunst Basel, HGK) hosts, collects, archives and makes available digital resources of HGK and its digital, special collections. It is available both to members of the Academy of Applied Sciences of Northwestern Switzerland (Fachhochschule Nordwestschweiz, FHNW) to which the HGK belongs and to the general public.

name: MetaNetX
description: MetaNetX/MNXref is a database for reconciliation of metabolites and biochemical reactions to bring together genome-scale metabolic networks. The tools developed at MetaNetX are useful for accessing, analysing and manipulating metabolic networks. MetaNetX goal is to automate model construction and genome annotation for large-scale metabolic networks.

name: SwissRegulon
description: The Swissregulon Database contains genome-wide annotations of regulatory sites. The predictions are based on Bayesian probabilistic analysis of a combination of input information including i) Experimentally determined binding sites reported in the literature, ii) Known sequence-specificities of transcription factors, iii) ChIP-chip and ChIP-seq data, iiii) Alignments of orthologous non-coding regions.

name: Eukaryotic Promoter Database
description: The Eukaryotic Promoter Database (EPD) provides accurate transcription start site (TSS) information for promoters of 15 model organisms, from human to yeast to the malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum. While the original database was a manually curated database based on published experiments, new promoter collections are now produced entirely automatically (under the name “EPDnew”) based on high-throughput transcript mapping data and high-quality gene annotation resources. Corresponding functional genomics data can be viewed in a genome browser, queried or analyzed via web interfaces, or exported in standard formats like FASTA or BED for subsequent analysis with other tools; of note, EPD is tightly integrated with two tool suites developed by our group: ChIP-Seq and Signal Search Analysis, for analysis of chromatin context and sequence motif respectively. EPD provides promoter viewers, designed with the aim of integrating and displaying information from different sources about, for instance, histone marks, transcription factor-binding sites or SNPs with known phenotypes. These viewers rely upon the UCSC genome browser as a visualization platform, which enables users to view data tracks from EPD jointly with tracks from UCSC or public track hubs.

name: PolyASite
description: Alternative cleavage and polyadenylation (APA) of RNAs gives rise to isoforms with different terminal exons, which in turn determine the fate of the RNA and the encoded protein. APA has thus been implicated in the regulation of cell proliferation, differentiation and disease development. PolyASite is a portal to the curated set of poly(A) sites inferred from publicly available 3’ end sequencing datasets. It allows efficient finding, exploration and export of poly(A) sites in several organisms. In constructing our poly(A) site atlas, we applied uniform quality measures, including the flagging of putative internal priming sites, to input datasets originating from different 3’ end sequencing techniques, cell types or tissues. Through integrated processing of all data, we identified and clustered sites that are closely spaced and share polyadenylation signals, as these are likely the result of stochastic variations in processing. For each cluster, we identified the representative - most frequently processed - site and estimated the relative use in the transcriptome across all samples. While other existing alternative polyadenylation databases rely on a single experimental method, or on poly(A) site estimation from RNA-seq data, PolyASite is built on data from several 3’ end sequencing techniques. This allows a broader coverage of cell types and poly(A) sites to support further genomics studies.

name: OrthoDB
description: Catalog of orthologous genes mapped across a broad range of species for comparative genomics.

name: Global Atmosphere Watch Station Information System
description: The Global Atmosphere Watch (GAW) is a worldwide system established by the World Meteorological Organization, a United Nations agency, to monitor trends in the Earth's atmosphere.  GAWSIS is the official catalogue of GAW stations and Contributing networks. It provides the GAW community and other interested people with an up-to-date, searchable data base of : station characteristics, measurements programs and data available, instrument, contact people, bibliographic references. GAWSIS also serves as a repository for supporting documents.

name: OLOS Swiss Research Data Repository
description: OLOS is the consultation and archive portal of Switzerland. OLOS supports Open Data and offers ways to explore data and associated metadata from archives.

name: Organic Synthesis Search
description: The Organic Chemistry Portal offers an overview of recent topics, interesting reactions, and information on important chemicals for organic chemists. Searchable index of citations, chemical synthesis and chemical products. We publish 1000 additional citations per year. German version see https://www.organische-chemie.ch/.

name: Cellosaurus
description: Knowledge resource describing cell lines used in biomedical research across vertebrates and invertebrates.

name: The mOTUs online database
description: The mOTUs database is a comprehensive microbial reference constructed by clustering universal single-copy phylogenetic marker genes from reference genomes, single-cell assemblies, and metagenome-assembled genomes. It currently includes over 124,000 species-level taxonomic units, many of which are represented only by metagenomic data. This database supports taxonomic profiling of microbial communities.
