name: ABCD database
description: The ABCD (AntiBodies Chemically Defined) database is a manually curated depository of sequenced antibodies.

name: Selectome
description: Selectome is a database of positive selection, based on a branch-site likelihood test. Release 6 of Selectome includes all gene trees from Ensembl for Primates and Glires, as well as a large set of vertebrate gene trees.

name: e-codices
description: The e-codices Virtual Manuscript Library of Switzerland is a digital repository of Swiss medieval and early modern manuscripts, offering high-quality scans paired with scholarly metadata and descriptions. It makes handwritten manuscripts from numerous Swiss collections freely accessible for research and study.

name: GlyConnect
description: GlyConnect is a knowledgebase of glycoproteins spanning protein, glycosite and glycan information. It is a platform designed to investigate the relationships between glycans, the proteins that carry them and the proteins that bind them via the UniLectin sister project. The underlying database stores curated data on glycosylation extracted from literature and preserving the contextual information relative to species, original cell line, tissue and disease. GlyConnect is the central resource of the Glyco@Expasy collection hosted at SIB - Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics.

name: ATLAS Open Data
description: Educational open-data portal with ATLAS detector datasets, software, and analysis examples for teaching and outreach.

name: SSRQ online
description: Digital scholarly edition of the Collection of Swiss Law Sources (Sammlung Schweizerischer Rechtsquellen). The public catalog lists edited historical legal documents by canton and indexes of persons, places, organizations, and lemmata.

name: FORSbase
description: FORSbase was the former social-science data repository of FORS. Deposit and discovery now take place on SWISSUbase; this host remains as a legacy entry point.

name: ETH Data Archive
description: ETH Data Archive is ETH Zurich's long-term preservation solution for digital information such as research data, digitised content, archival records, or images. It serves as the backbone of data curation and for most of its content, it is a “dark archive” without public access.

name: Enzyme nomenclature database
description: ENZYME is a repository of information relative to the nomenclature of enzymes. It is primarily based on the recommendations of the Nomenclature Committee of the International Union of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology (IUBMB) and it describes each type of characterized enzyme for which an EC (Enzyme Commission) number has been provided. The database is complete and up to date. It is regularly updated to reflect updates and additions to the nomenclature.

name: MHC Motif Atlas
description: The MHC Motif Atlas allows you to visualise and compare binding motifs (as well as other properties) for thousands of MHC-I and MHC-II alleles.

name: Orthologous Matrix Browser
description: Orthologous Matrix resource for comparative genomics, providing orthology predictions across species.

name: PROSITE
description: PROSITE is a database of protein families and domains. PROSITE consists of documentation entries describing protein domains, families and functional sites as well as associated patterns and profiles to identify them.

name: STRING
description: Database of known and predicted protein-protein interactions, including physical and functional associations.

name: SwissLipids
description: Expert-curated knowledgebase of lipid structures and metabolism from the SIB Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics.

name: Long-Acting Therapeutics Patents and Licences Database
description:
LAPaL is a repository for information on long-acting (LA) technologies patents and licences. As of Sep 2025, it comprises 37 long-acting platform technologies and 50 LA formulations with many potential applications in the fields of HIV prevention and treatment, hepatitis B treatment, malaria treatment, type 2 diabetes and metabolic disorders management, pain management and contraception, among other applications.
In 2023, and through a collaboration with the Center of Excellence of Long Acting Therapeutics and the Long-Acting/Extended Release Antiretroviral Research Resource Program, a new section was added to LAPaL, with 10 compounds with long half-life or that could be formulated in a manner that enables extended release. We are also collaborating with major initiatives and groups, such as AVAC, to synergise efforts and support the global community to deliver effectively in the HIV prevention space.
Additionally, a visualisation tool (Landscape) is available for the selection of investigated and approved long-acting compounds in the HIV and TB fields and the related clinical trials. It provides information on the clinical trials pipeline of a set of compounds and filing data for the most advances products.

name: Chlamydiae Database
description: ChlamDB is a comparative genomics database covering the entire Chlamydiae phylum as well as their closest relatives belonging to the Planctomycetes-Verrucomicrobiae-Chlamydiae (PVC) superphylum. Genomes can be compared, analyzed and retrieved using accessions numbers of the most widely used databases including COG, KEGG ortholog, KEGG pathway, KEGG module, Pfam and InterPro. Candidate effectors of the Type III secretion system (T3SS) were identified using four in silico methods. The identification of orthologs among all PVC genomes allows users to perform large-scale comparative analyses and to identify orthologs of any protein in all genomes integrated in the database. Phylogenetic relationships of PVC proteins and their closest homologs in RefSeq, comparison of transmembrane domains and Pfam domains, conservation of gene neighborhood and taxonomic profiles can be visualized using dynamically generated graphs, available for download. As a central resource for researchers working on chlamydia, chlamydia-related bacteria, verrucomicrobia and planctomyces, ChlamDB facilitates the access to comprehensive annotations and integrates multiple tools for comparative genomic analyses.

name: TreatmentBank
description: TreatmentBank (TB) is a service provided by the Swiss Plazi GmbH to liberate data from scholarly publications, and convert, enhance, link, store, and disseminate it as Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable (FAIR) data. These data include taxonomic treatments, treatment citations, figures, tables, material citations and bibliographic reference. The data extraction processes can be highly automated to process entire journal back-issues as well as current publications. A quality control (QC) process as well as manual checks produce data fit to become reference deposits of treatments in Biodiversity Literature Repository (BLR), as well as daily uploads of treatment articles data sets to the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF), with persistent identifiers minted in BLR. Input formats can be printed to born-digital publications. All data are openly accessible in various formats and are searchable. Currently, BLR contains more than 650,000 treatments extracted from 66,000 articles, 400,000 figures and 1,040,000 material citations.

name: ViralZone
description: ViralZone is a web resource for viral genes and families, providing detailed molecular and epidemiological information, along with virion and genome figures. Each virus or family page gives easy access to UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot viral protein entries.

name: SWISSUbase
description: SWISSUbase is a unique research data repository in Switzerland. It supports multidisciplinary data archiving with rich discipline-specific and multilingual metadata. The platform offers several discipline-specific metadata schemas, currently available for linguistics and social sciences, with humanities to be added in 2025. Data on SWISSUbase is curated by professional data curators at partner institutions, ensuring high-quality, well-documented datasets that can be easily shared, reused, and preserved long-term.

name: ETH Travel Data Archive
description: ETH Travel Data Archive, operated by ETH Zurich, provides research data on geography, geosciences, and engineering sciences.

name: Medienarchiv der Zürcher Hochschule der Künste
description: The Media Archive of the Zurich University of the Arts is the platform for collaborative work, sharing and archiving of media at the ZHdK. It is available to students, lecturers, reserarchers and staff. The areas of application of the media archive are mainly focused on teaching and research, but the ZHdK departments archive and university communication also benefit.

name: SWISS-MODEL
description: Repository and workspace for homology-modelled protein structures accessible via the ExPASy server.

name: Bgee Gene Expression Database
description: Gene expression knowledgebase for retrieving and comparing expression patterns across animal species.

name: ModelArchive
description: ModelArchive is the archive for structural models which are not based on experimental data and complements the PDB archive for experimental structures and PDB-Dev for integrative structures. The ModelArchive is being developed following the "Workshop on Applications of Protein Models in Biomedical Research" held at the University of California, San Francisco in July 2008 for applications of protein models in biomedical research. ModelArchive is a repository for depositions of computed models of macromolecular structures which are not based on experimental data. The models can consist of any combination of proteins, RNA, DNA, or carbohydrates and include small molecules bound to them. Deposited models are findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable. Depositions are assigned a DOI to be included in manuscripts for which the model was generated.

name: Glittr Bioinformatics Training Registry
description:
Glittr.org is a curated database of educational material for the computational life sciences.

All material is:
- In a GitHub or GitLab repository
- Free to use
- Written in markdown or similar

name: Idiap Scientific Datasets
description: Idiap Research Institute public catalog of scientific datasets, including biometric, speech, vision, and machine-learning corpora available for download.

name: SugarBind
description: The SugarBind Database (SugarBindDB) was created in 2002 as part of an effort by the MITRE Corporation (http://www.mitre.org) to develop a pathogen-capture technology based on the binding of viral, bacterial and biotoxin lectins to specific glycans (aka, sugars, carbohydrates) displayed on glycoprotein films. The database content results from compiling publicly available information. In 2010, the 2008 version of the database was migrated from MITRE Corporation to the SIB Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics in Geneva, Switzerland. From then, substantial changes in the database design and usage were undertaken and previous content was significantly extended.

name: Novartis Clinical Trial Results Database
description: Novartis launched the results website in 2005 becoming one of the first companies to publically post results from Phase 2b-4 interventional trials. The Novartis position evolved over time to include public disclosure of results from Phase 1- 2a interventional trials in patients.

name: SwissBioPics
description: SwissBioPics is a freely available library of interactive biological images for visualizing subcellular location data. It includes cell types from all kingdoms of life - from muscle, neuronal and epithelial cells of animals to rods, cocci, clubs, spirals and other more exotic forms of bacteria and archaea.

name: Automated Single-cell Analysis Portal
description: A collaborative portal to visualize and analyze single-cell transcriptomics data.

name: SICAS Medical Image Repository
description: The Sicas Medical Image Repository is a medical database for academic, scientific, technical and clinical biomedical research and collaboration. Registration is required for data download and usage, although browsing and searching is available without registration.

name: IAP Microwave Dataportal
description: Public scientific file portal of the University of Bern Institute of Applied Physics microwave group, with a public storage browse and internal VPN area.

name: LOTUS
description: Natural products occurrence database linking structures to organisms, built as a Wikidata-backed resource.

name: DEWA/GRID-Geneva
description: GRID-Geneva is a unique platform providing analyses and solutions for a wide range of environmental issues. GRID-Geneva serves primarily the needs of its three institutional partners - UNEP, the Swiss Federal Office for the Environment (FOEN) and the University of Geneva (UniGe) - which are linked by an ongoing, multi-year “Partnership Agreement”, along with other local-to-global stakeholders.

name: Materials Platform for Data Science (MPDS)
description: Materials Platform for Data Science (MPDS) provides access to curated materials science data, including crystalline structures, phase diagrams, and physical properties derived from peer-reviewed literature and exposed via web interface and API.

name: HAMAP database of microbial protein families
description: HAMAP is a system, based on manual protein annotation, that identifies and semi-automatically annotates proteins that are part of well-conserved families or subfamilies: the HAMAP families. HAMAP is based on manually created family rules and is applied to bacterial, archaeal and plastid-encoded proteins.

name: FORS - Swiss Centre of Expertise in the Social Sciences
description: FORS – Swiss Centre of Expertise in the Social Sciences is a national research data infrastructure that supports the accessibility, preservation, and reuse of research data in the social sciences. As a CoreTrustSeal-certified repository, FORS adheres to internationally recognised standards of responsible data stewardship, ensuring that research data are managed, stored, and made accessible in a secure and sustainable manner, both now and in the future. FORS supports Swiss social science researchers and institutions by offering expert guidance on data management, documentation, and sharing. It fosters a culture of secondary data use and transparency by acquiring, curating, and disseminating high-quality quantitative and qualitative datasets. In addition to its repository services, FORS conducts large-scale surveys and methodological research, and collaborates with international partners to promote global access to trustworthy and reusable research data. FORS shares data with SWISSUbase, but is a distinct entity.

name: MoultDB
description:
MoultDB is an integrated resource that merges data from paleontology to genomics to explore moulting in arthropods.
The database aims to consolidate dispersed knowledge, offering insights into the vast diversity and evolutionary trends of arthropod moulting.
This comprehensive approach facilitates a deeper understanding of arthropod biology and success

name: Continuously Automated Model Evaluation
description: Continuous automated benchmarking of computational protein structure prediction methods (and model quality estimation techniques). CAMEO assessment is based on blind predictions for weekly pre-released targets from PDB. Benchmarking results are made available as reference data for methods development.

name: Rhea Biochemical Reaction Database
description: Expert-curated biochemical reaction database using ChEBI for reaction participants.

name: Expasy
description: Expasy is the bioinformatics resource portal of the SIB Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics. It is an extensible and integrative portal which provides access to over 160 databases and software tools, developed by SIB Groups and supporting a range of life science and clinical research domains, from genomics, proteomics and structural biology, to evolution and phylogeny, systems biology and medical chemistry.

name: Research Catalogue -  Society for Artistic Research
description: RC content presented through one of our portals is peer reviewed, while the remaining expositions and other information are quality controlled by the individual author(s) themselves. As a result, the RC is highly inclusive. The open source status of the RC is essential to its nature and serves its function as a connective and transitional layer between academic discourse and artistic practice, thereby constituting a discursive field for artistic research.

name: Integrated proteogenomics databases
description: Accurate annotation of all protein-coding sequences (CDSs) is an essential prerequisite to fully exploit the rapidly growing repertoire of completely sequenced prokaryotic genomes. However, large discrepancies among the number of annotated CDSs, missed functional short ORFs, and overprediction of spurious ORFs represent serious limitations.

name: Homepage of Oriented Matroids
description: This site is dedicated to objects in discrete geometry and their abstraction in terms of oriented matroids.

name: MoniThur Nachhaltigkeitsindikatoren Thurgau
description: MoniThur sustainability indicator system of the Canton of Thurgau. Publishes 62 indicators for society, economy and environment, including an SDG grouping of the same series.

name: USTAT Ticino tabelle interattive
description: Interactive statistical cubes of the Ufficio di statistica del Cantone Ticino (USTAT). Catalogue of multidimensional tables (Excel, PC-Axis .px and CSV) covering population, labour, enterprises, buildings, education, elections and related topics.

name: Il Geoportale Ticino data portal
description: Geodata catalogue of the Canton of Ticino, listing cantonal spatial datasets and download services.

name: Geoportal Kanton Luzern
description: Official Lucerne cantonal geoportal with interactive maps, 3D landscape, and access to open geodata products. Distinct from the geoportal.ch/ktlu tenant and the daten.geo.lu.ch STAC API.

name: North Western Province GIS Public Portal
description: Public GIS portal of the North Western Province GIS Unit. Publishes road, street-light, culvert, developed-area, and water-resource maps and data sheets for local authorities in Kurunegala and Puttalam districts.

name: SDG Data Portal Sri Lanka
description: National Sustainable Development Goals data portal of Sri Lanka, operated by the Sustainable Development Council. Dashboards, indicator tables, and a documented REST API cover progress toward the 17 SDGs. Some API access requires registration.

name: Sri Lanka at a Glance
description: Official key-indicators dashboard of Sri Lanka's Department of Census and Statistics. Browse All Data covers more than 300 datapoints on population, labour, income, agriculture, prices, national accounts, trade, tourism, and education.

name: DCS Economic Indicator Portal
description: Department of Census and Statistics Economic Indicator Portal. Interactive charts and tables cover GDP, the Index of Industrial Production, Producer Price Index, National and Colombo Consumer Price Indices, and inflation.

name: Census Data Portal Sri Lanka
description: Census of Population and Housing table and map portal of Sri Lanka's Department of Census and Statistics. Users select 2012 or 2024 census variables, browse administrative layers, and download CSV tables.

name: Data Library - Central Bank of Sri Lanka
description: Official time-series data library of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Interactive tables cover real, monetary, fiscal, external, and financial-sector statistics used in monetary policy and macroeconomic analysis.

name: DCS Sustainable Development Goals Sri Lanka
description: Department of Census and Statistics SDG indicator site. Lists DCS-compiled baseline tables for 46 global SDG indicators (poverty, health, education, labour, and related goals). Distinct from the Sustainable Development Council data.sdg.lk portal.

name: Department of Census and Statistics Sri Lanka
description: Official statistics website of Sri Lanka's Department of Census and Statistics. Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, prices, labour, and economic statistics.

name: Lanka Data Foundation Datasets
description: Open, structured datasets from Sri Lanka curated by the Lanka Data Foundation. Collects, cleans, and organizes government statistics on tourism, foreign employment, immigration, foreign affairs, and official gazettes in machine-readable JSON.

name: Geographical Names Information System
description: Survey Department gazetteer map of official geographical names for Sri Lanka, searchable by district and DS division with transport and hydro layers.

name: Sri Lanka NSDI Geoportal
description: National map viewer of Sri Lanka's National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI). Configurable Map Viewer (CMV) application on the ArcGIS JS API for discovering and viewing spatial data layers shared by government agencies, with search, measurement, print, and use-case tools.

name: Geo Sri Lanka Land Information System
description: Survey Department Geo Sri Lanka portal and Land Information System. Public cadastral parcel viewer searchable by district, DS division, and Grama Niladhari division, including Bim Saviya title references. Distinct from the Survey Department ArcGIS REST directory.

name: Sri Lanka Marine Spatial Data Infrastructure
description: Public Marine Spatial Data Infrastructure of the Sri Lanka Navy Hydrographic Service, with map layers, ENC and paper-chart product lists, coastal areas of interest and supporting hydrographic documents. Distinct from NARA MEBIN.

name: API Gateway - Department of Agriculture Sri Lanka
description: CROPIX API Gateway of the Department of Agriculture, Sri Lanka. Catalogue of agriculture APIs for crop details, geographical layers, cultivation and season data, seed certification, and related datasets. Public APIs need no credentials; registered APIs require an API key.

name: Geovisor Catastro Multipropósito Fusagasugá
description: Municipal cadastral geovisor of Fusagasugá with public layers for comunas, constructions, parcels, and veredas.

name: Geoportal Agencia Catastral de Cundinamarca
description: Public cadastral geoportal of the Agencia Catastral de Cundinamarca with parcel search, map layers, and shapefile download for 76 municipalities in its jurisdiction.

name: Datos Abiertos Jamundí
description: Municipal open data catalog of Jamundí, Valle del Cauca, with a public dataset listing and API.

name: IDESC Santiago de Cali
description: Public geoportal of Cali's municipal spatial data infrastructure (IDESC), including the IDESC geovisor over municipal geospatial layers.

name: Tángara geovisores Cauca
description: Public geovisors of Tángara, the socioeconomic information system of the Government of Cauca, covering political maps, ecological structure, and infrastructure.

name: Observatorio Inmobiliario Catastral de Santa Marta
description: Public cadastral and real-estate viewer of Santa Marta, with filters for parcel number, land treatment, and property type.

name: Geovisor CORPAMAG
description: Public environmental geovisor of CORPAMAG with map layers for the Magdalena jurisdiction, embedded from the corporation's official geovisor page.

name: Observatorio Municipal de Sabaneta
description: Municipal statistics observatory of Sabaneta, Antioquia, with public indicator sections on living conditions, territory, security, economy, and education.

name: Universidad de Antioquia Datos
description: Open data portal of Universidad de Antioquia, publishing institutional datasets from teaching, research, and university administration. The site currently returns HTTP 403 to unauthenticated harvest clients.

name: Geovisor CORPOURABA
description: Public OpenLayers geovisor of CORPOURABA with environmental determinants, POT, and ethnic-community map layers for the Urabá jurisdiction, linked from the corporation's official site.

name: SIATA - Sistema de Alerta Temprana del Valle de Aburrá
description: Interactive geoportal of the Early Warning System of Medellín and the Aburrá Valley (SIATA). Provides real-time hydrometeorological, radar, air quality, and risk-monitoring maps and station data for the metropolitan region.

name: Geovisor CORPOCHIVOR
description: Public environmental geovisor of CORPOCHIVOR with OpenLayers map layers for the corporation's jurisdiction in southern Boyacá.

name: Catastro Tunja a un clic
description: Municipal cadastral geoportal of Tunja with a citizen geovisor, interactive maps, open geospatial downloads, and planning certificates.

name: Observatorio Inmobiliario de Cartagena
description: Public real-estate observatory for Cartagena, operated by AMB Catastro, with maps of sale offers, transactions, rentals, and buildability.

name: IDEEP Soledad
description: Municipal spatial data infrastructure (IDEEP) of Soledad, Atlántico, with interactive maps, a citizen geovisor, open geospatial downloads, and a metadata catalog.

name: SNIES indicadores de educación superior
description: National Information System of Higher Education (SNIES). Publishes official higher-education statistics and indicators on enrolment, coverage, quality, graduates, and public university performance, with public queries and consolidated bases.

name: Datos Abiertos Fundación Luker
description: Public indicator catalog of Fundación Luker (Mi Junta), with strategic and city indicators.

name: Portal de Datos Abiertos de la Contraloría General de la República
description: Official open data portal of the Contraloría General de la República, Colombia.

name: Geovisores SIMEC - UPME
description: Catalog of interactive geovisors (map viewers) of Colombia's Mining and Energy Planning Unit (UPME) within the Colombian Mining-Energy Information System (SIMEC). Covers electricity generation and transmission, hydrocarbons, mining districts, territorial energy information, infrastructure, and renewable energy potential.

name: Geoportal de la Contraloría General de la República
description: Public geoportal of the Contraloría General de la República (DIARI) that integrates SECOP and related public datasets in interactive views.

name: ICDE Colombia
description: National spatial data infrastructure portal of ICDE (Infraestructura Colombiana de Datos Espaciales), documenting fundamental geospatial data types and related geoservices.

name: Colombia en Mapas
description: National geospatial platform of the Instituto Geográfico Agustín Codazzi (IGAC). Integrates official maps, satellite and aerial imagery, cadastre, geodesy, land use, and historical cartography from national, regional, and local producers for visualization, query, analysis, and download.

name: SNIGRD - Sistema Nacional de Información para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres
description: Official national information system of Colombia's Unidad Nacional para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres (UNGRD). Provides public access to disaster risk maps, geoviewers, emergency histories, investment data, and related geospatial layers for decision-making by authorities and citizens.

name: Geoportal Alcaldía de Pasto
description: Municipal geoportal of Pasto for urban planning information, built over an ArcGIS Enterprise portal and map services.

name: Geoportal CAM Huila
description: CAM Huila geoportal hub listing thematic geovisors for protected areas, wetlands, land-use planning, mining titles, and watershed management plans.

name: Geoportal UFPSO
description: Public geoportal of Universidad Francisco de Paula Santander, Ocaña, with map layers served as KML over a web map.

name: Hazmieh Municipality GIS
description: Public municipal GIS viewer of the Municipality of Hazmieh (qgis2web / Leaflet). Linked from the official municipal GIS page for geographic information and cadastral lookup.

name: Banque du Liban Economic and Financial Data
description: Economic and financial statistics portal of Banque du Liban, Lebanon's central bank. Publishes time series for monetary aggregates, banking-sector balance sheets, interest rates, exchange rates, public finance, and the balance of payments.

name: Arab Development Portal
description: Arab Development Portal of the UN Regional Collaboration Platform for Arab States. AI-powered data and knowledge hub with country indicators, an open data catalog, official statistics, geospatial insights, and SDG tracking for Arab countries. Hosted with ESCWA in Beirut.

name: IMPACT Open Data
description: IMPACT (Inter-Ministerial and Municipal Platform for Assessment, Coordination and Tracking) Open Data site of Lebanon's Central Inspection. Publishes free datasets collected with ministries and municipalities for transparency, audit, and access to information.

name: IMPACT Open Data (CIB)
description: IMPACT Open Data portal on the Central Inspection Bureau hostname. Same Inter-Ministerial and Municipal Platform for Assessment, Coordination and Tracking as impact.gov.lb, publishing public-sector datasets for transparency and access to information.

name: Open Data Lebanon
description: Citizen-run catalog of data resources, reports, and knowledge about Lebanon. Open Data Lebanon (ODL) publishes searchable datasets and sources to support public awareness and data-driven reuse.

name: Arab Regional Geospatial Portal (ARGP)
description: Arab Regional Geospatial Portal (ARGP). This geoportal. managed by UN Regional Collaboration Platform (RCP) for Arab States.

name: Lebanese Petroleum Administration Web Map
description: Official interactive web map of the Lebanese Petroleum Administration. Public layers include offshore block boundaries, awarded blocks, drilled wells, onshore 2D seismic lines, and PGS, Spectrum, Geco Prakla, and NEOS geophysical surveys. Embedded ArcGIS Online web map ed0806dabecc47d2867d1f3558f71b7b.

name: ICASEES Centrafrique
description: Official statistics website of the Central African Institute of Statistics, Economic and Social Studies (ICASEES). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, and economic statistics. Distinct from the ICASEES NADA microdata catalog.

name: Regione Autonoma Valle d'Aosta open data
description: The provided URL (https://www.regione.vda.it/statistica/Opendata/Opendataregione/opend_categoria_i.asp) does not contain structured data catalog entries in the response. Only descriptive or category pages are found. No explicit dataset rows or metadata are available for extraction based on the open URL content. If you provide an actual dataset page (e.g., with records, metadata, or download links), extraction can be performed.

name: Regione Autonoma Valle d'Aosta geoportal
description: Catalog of datasets and data services provided by the Valle d'Aosta regional government

name: Portale Open Data - Comune di Palermo
description: Progetto del Comune di Palermo per la pubblicazione e condivisione degli Open Data in possesso dell'Amministrazione comunale

name: Open Data Università degli Studi di Palermo
description: Open data portal of the University of Palermo, publishing reusable public datasets on study programmes, teaching staff, departments, and course offerings.

name: Geoportale SITR Regione Siciliana
description: Official SITR geoportal of Regione Siciliana, with an INSPIRE CSW discovery catalog, metadata search, and map viewer. Distinct from the ArcGIS REST endpoint at map.sitr.regione.sicilia.it.

name: Osservatorio Istruzione Calabria Esplora i dati
description: Osservatorio Istruzione Calabria Esplora i dati, a public explorer of regional education indicators for schools, pupils, teachers, outcomes, inclusion, and early-childhood services by province and municipality.

name: Geoportale Regione Calabria
description: Official geoportal of Regione Calabria, a catalog of geographic data with a multidimensional map viewer and open cartographic resources.

name: OpenData Politecnico di Milano
description: Institutional open data portal of Politecnico di Milano, publishing datasets on degree programmes, students, PhD courses, research outputs, and graduate employment.

name: UniData - Bicocca Data Archive
description: UniData is an interdepartmental center of the University of Milan-Bicocca, serving as the Italian point of reference for research data archiving and dissemination, following the model of major European national archives. It manages scientific and statistical data, particularly survey datasets such as Eurostat, ISSP, Istat, WVS, and Eurobarometer, and ensures open access according to data producer agreements.

name: Portale di cartografia della Provincia di Varese
description: Online cartography and SIT portal of the Province of Varese, including PTCP map services.

name: Geoportale Provincia di Sondrio
description: Public provincial geoportal of Provincia di Sondrio for cadastral, technical, and planning cartography of the province.

name: Geoportale Provincia di Bergamo
description: Provincial geoportal of the Provincia di Bergamo.

name: OpenQuake Platform
description: Global Earthquake Model platform for seismic hazard, risk, and building-exposure datasets used in earthquake engineering.

name: Open Data Comune di Trieste
description: Open data portal of the Comune di Trieste, publishing municipal datasets on demography, prices, and electoral statistics.

name: OpenData Udine
description: Open Data catalog of the Udine municipality

name: Open Salute Lazio
description: Open Salute Lazio, DEP SSR public portal of population-health indicators by region, ASL, district, and municipality (demography, maternal-infant health, chronic disease, cancer, hospitalisation, mortality).

name: ARS Toscana Indicatori socio-sanitari
description: ARS Toscana Indicatori socio-sanitari, a public explorer of health and socio-sanitary indicators for AUSL, municipalities, and care pathways. Distinct from Regione Toscana statistical banche dati.

name: Comune di Livorno Open Data Catalog
description: Repertorio Nazionale dei Dati Territoriali (RNDT) è il catalogo nazionale dei metadati, riguardanti i dati territoriali (e i servizi ad essi relativi)... Il portale italiano degli open data raccoglie i dati aperti del Ministero per la PA e l'Innovazione e di numerose Amministrazioni centrali e territoriali, per mettere a disposizione dei cittadini e del mercato dati in formato aperto e per stimolare l'utilizzo di questi dati in applicazioni che rendano più facile la vita di cittadini ed imprese.

name: Opendata Prevenzione Collettiva Toscana
description: Opendata Prevenzione Collettiva Toscana. This open data portal.

name: Open Data Comune di Lucca
description: Open data portal of the Municipality of Lucca.

name: WebGIS PTC Provincia di Arezzo
description: WebGIS of Provincia di Arezzo for public consultation of the Piano Territoriale di Coordinamento and municipal planning overlays.

name: Arpa Umbria - Regional Agency for Environmental Protection open data
description: Public geospatial datasets and map layers from the Regional Agency for Environmental Protection of Umbria

name: TerniGEO
description: Municipal geoportal of Comune di Terni for urban-planning maps, toponymy, building titles, public green, and related territorial layers.

name: Geoportale Regione Liguria
description: Official geoportal of Regione Liguria, providing access to the regional catalog of georeferenced cartographic data. Distinct from the regional CKAN open data portal.

name: Emilia-Romagna Statistica self-service
description: Regione Emilia-Romagna Statistica self-service, a public table builder for official regional statistics with customizable territory, year, charts, maps, and CSV export.

name: Forlivese Open data portal
description: Open data portal for the Unione di Comuni della Romagna Forlivese, providing public data produced or acquired within the activities of the Union of Municipalities in the Romagna Forlivese area.

name: Open Data Università di Ferrara
description: Open data catalog of the University of Ferrara, publishing institutional datasets. Not CKAN; the public catalog UI is custom software.

name: Open Data Città metropolitana di Bologna
description: Open data catalog of the Metropolitan City of Bologna.

name: Cartografia Lepida
description: Lepida cartographic portal for Emilia-Romagna public-sector geographic data.

name: WebGIS Città metropolitana di Bologna
description: Public WebGIS hub of Città metropolitana di Bologna, listing interactive cartography applications for metropolitan planning, environment, and forestry layers.

name: Geoportale Regione Emilia-Romagna
description: Official geoportal of Regione Emilia-Romagna, with public catalogs of cartographic data, metadata, and published maps. Distinct from the GeoNetwork node at geo.regione.emilia-romagna.it.

name: SIT Comune di Ravenna
description: Public interactive cartography of Comune di Ravenna for municipal SIT maps used by citizens and professionals.

name: Piemonte Dati
description: Data catalogs and portals registry for the Piemonte region

name: Geoportale Arpa Piemonte
description: Public geoportal of Arpa Piemonte for environmental and territorial map layers.

name: Open Data Comune di Sassari
description: Open data catalog of the Municipality of Sassari, with reusable CSV datasets on population, elections, waste charges, and administrative records.

name: CREA Banca Dati RICA
description: Italian FADN/RICA farm accountancy microdata bank operated by CREA-PB. Anonymized holding-level files for authorised researchers; aggregated AREA tables are separate.

name: Istat Elenco rilevazioni
description: Istat inventory of survey microdata files available to SISTAN and ADELE laboratory users, with record layouts and SIQual metadata.

name: Banca d'Italia Research Data Center
description: Central access point to Banca d'Italia survey and granular microdata, including public-use files, remote execution (REX), and the labBI safe room.

name: ASTer Atlante statistico del territorio
description: Istat Atlante statistico del territorio (ASTer), the territorial statistics atlas that replaced the Atlante statistico dei comuni and the infrastructure atlas. Public SPA titled Data Browser; hub JSON did not respond at last check.

name: Istat Stat Portal Data Catalog (statportal.it)
description: Official web interface for browsing and downloading statistical data produced by Istat, covering environmental, social and economic changes in Italy.

name: Istat Historical Timeseries
description: Historical series is an archive of approximately 1,500 downloadable and re-elaborable series, divided into 22 themes and 6 macro areas, each of which is enriched by interactive visualizations regarding the main phenomena explored.

name: SIAPE
description: National information system for Italian energy performance certificates, with public aggregate statistics.

name: Disabilità in cifre
description: Istat Sistema informativo Disabilità in cifre (SID), a thematic warehouse of official disability and inclusion indicators from Istat and other Sistan bodies.

name: Banca d'Italia Statistical Database (BDS)
description: Public Base Dati Statistica (BDS) of Banca d'Italia. Interactive inquiry of macroeconomic, monetary, banking, balance-of-payments, and financial time series, with CSV export via the A2A data service.

name: Portale Dati Terna
description: Terna data portal publishing Italian electricity transmission operational, market and statistical data.

name: DgStat Ministero della Giustizia
description: Judicial statistics catalog of the Italian Ministry of Justice (DgStat), publishing indicators on civil and criminal proceedings, duration, enforcement, and related court activity. Distinct from the administrative-justice open data portal.

name: Demo demografia in cifre
description: Istat Demo (demografia in cifre) table builder for resident population and demographic phenomena in Italian municipalities. Distinct from IstatData, which also carries some population series.

name: Dati aperti del Senato della Repubblica
description: Open data portal of the Italian Senate, including SPARQL access to parliamentary datasets.

name: OpenCoesione
description: National open government portal on EU and national cohesion policy in Italy. Publishes bimonthly open data on programmed and spent resources, project locations, thematic areas, implementing bodies, and payments, with bulk CSV/Parquet downloads and a REST API.

name: Open data portal - Agenzia del Demanio
description: Open data catalog for public real estate and related administrative information managed by Agenzia del Demanio, the Italian government agency responsible for State-owned property assets.

name: Gazzetta Ufficiale della Repubblica Italiana
description: Official gazette of Italy. Catalog of laws, decrees, and other acts published in the Gazzetta Ufficiale.

name: MeteoHub
description: National meteorological data platform of Agenzia ItaliaMeteo providing interactive maps and open datasets of weather and marine forecasts, station observations, and radar products for Italy.

name: CNR Open Data Portal
description: Institutional Linked Open Data portal of the Italian National Research Council (CNR). Distinct from individual CNR GeoNetwork, ERDDAP, and CKAN nodes.

name: OpenData UPO
description: Open data catalog of the University of Eastern Piedmont (teaching, research, staff and campus datasets).

name: ISPRA Linked Open Data
description: ISPRA linked open data catalog of environmental datasets.

name: BDAP open data
description: I dati aperti sono dati che possono essere liberamente utilizzati, riutilizzati e ridistribuiti da chiunque, soggetti eventualmente alla necessità di citarne la fonte e di condividerli con lo stesso tipo di licenza con cui sono stati originariamente rilasciati. Informazioni su enti della Pubblica Amministrazione, aspetti finanziari e procedurali, pagamenti, conti economici e patrimoniali, risorse, personale, ecc.

name: Open Data INAIL
description: Official open data portal of INAIL, the Italian National Institute for Insurance against Accidents at Work. Publishes workplace accident and occupational disease datasets as CSV, XML, and RDF, with REST APIs and a SPARQL query interface.

name: Italian National Access Point MMTIS
description: Italian multimodal NAP. Lists regional RAP and national operator datasets in the Italian NeTEx profile (levels 1-4) and SIRI.

name: CulturaItalia Linked Open Data
description: Linked open data platform of CulturaItalia, with SPARQL and OAI-PMH access to Italian cultural heritage resources.

name: UNIME Opendata
description: Open data portal of the University of Messina (Università degli Studi di Messina), publishing institutional datasets such as departments, degree courses, regulations, real estate, and service charter data under CC BY 4.0.

name: OpenPNRR
description: Public catalog of datasets on Italy's National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR), published by the OpenPNRR civic monitoring project.

name: Italian Ministry of Culture Open Data
description: Linked Open Data catalog of the Italian Ministry of Culture (MiC), publishing cultural-heritage datasets as RDF/DCAT-AP_IT. Successor hostname of dati.beniculturali.it. Distinct from the Archivio Centrale dello Stato CKAN at ckan.acs.beniculturali.it.

name: Open Data per la Salute Pubblica
description: Italian Ministry of Health open data portal. Publishes public-interest health datasets such as NHS personnel, hospital beds and admissions, medical devices, veterinary medicines, and plant protection products, mainly as CSV with selected JSON and XML files under the Italian Open Data License v2.0.

name: Open Data Corte costituzionale
description: Open data portal of the Italian Constitutional Court, with SPARQL access to court data.

name: Open Data INPS
description: Open data catalog of INPS, the Italian National Social Security Institute, publishing pensions, contributions, CIG, and labour-market datasets. The dedicated opendata.inps.it host was unavailable at last check; this record uses the working public listing page.

name: Banca Dati Trasporti ART
description: Open data catalog of the Italian Transport Regulation Authority (ART), publishing railway, motorway, and maritime transport datasets.

name: Portale Unico dei Dati della Scuola
description: Official open data portal of the Italian Ministry of Education covering schools, students, school staff, school buildings, the national evaluation system, textbooks, PON projects and school budgets. Datasets are published as CSV, JSON, XML and RDF, with a SPARQL interface and a DCAT-AP IT catalog dump.

name: Open Data CREA
description: Open data catalog of CREA, the Council for Agricultural Research and Economics, exposing agricultural research datasets through an RDF/SPARQL interface harvested by dati.gov.it.

name: opendata.gse.it data catalog extraction
description: Extraction of metadata from the opendata.gse.it data catalog using specified vocabularies.

name: AGEA Geoportale
description: Geoportal of AGEA, the Italian paying agency for agriculture, providing access to agricultural geospatial services and related territorial data.

name: AIPO WebGIS
description: Public WebGIS of the Interregional Agency for the Po River, including waterway concession maps.

name: Terradue GEP-EPOS OpenSearch
description: Terradue Geohazard Exploitation Platform OpenSearch catalogue of EPOS InSAR products, including interferograms, displacement time series, atmospheric screens, and inverse-modeling source maps.

name: GeoWeb ENEA SSPT-CLIMAR
description: ENEA SSPT-CLIMAR geoportal presenting climate, air-quality and marine model results as geographic data.

name: AI-on-Demand Platform AI Catalog
description: Browse, search and download AI assets including libraries, datasets, containers and more, indexed in the AI-on-Demand platform.

name: Catalogo delle API della Pubblica Amministrazione
description: Catalogo delle API della Pubblica Amministrazione italiana. Raccoglie e cataloga le API pubblicate dalle amministrazioni pubbliche italiane per facilitare la condivisione e la circolazione dei dati amministrativi.

name: Elettra Open Access Data Portal
description: Open-access catalogue of experimental datasets from Elettra Sincrotrone Trieste beamlines.

name: European Database of Seismogenic Faults
description: The European Database of Seismogenic Faults (EDSF) is a repository of faults that are deemed to be capable of generating earthquakes of magnitude equal to or larger than 5.5, and aims to ensure homogeneous input for use in ground-shaking hazard assessment in the Euro-Mediterranean area.

name: 4DMED-Sea
description: The Mediterranean Sea ecosystem provides fundamental resources and services that support large and complex human socio-economic activities, that can be severely impacted by both natural and anthropogenic stressors.

name: Mediterranean Germplasm Database
description: The Mediterranean Germplasm Database (MGD) is the reference database for the agro-food plant germplasm collection stored at the Institute of Biosciences and Bioresources (IBBR) of the Italian National Research Council (CNR) in Bari, Italy.

name: ITINERIS HUB
description:
ITINERIS is dedicated to building the Italian Hub of Research Infrastructures in the environmental scientific domain.
The ITINERIS HUB provides access to the comprehensive collection of knowledge, data, analytics tool and services provided by the Italian Research Infrastructures (RIs) in the environmental scientific domain for the observation and study of processes in the atmosphere, marine domain, terrestrial biosphere, and geosphere.

name: Bologna Annotation Resource
description: BAR 3.0 is a server for the annotation of protein sequences relying on a comparative large-scale analysis on the entire UniProt. With BAR 3.0 and a sequence you can annotate when possible: function (Gene Ontology), structure (Protein Data Bank), protein domains (Pfam). Also if your sequence falls into a cluster with a structural/some structural template/s we provide an alignment towards the template/templates based on the Cluster-HMM (HMM profile) that allows you to directly compute your 3D model. Cluster HMMs are available for downloading.

name: Biofilm-active AMPs database
description: BaAMPs is the first database dedicated to antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) specifically tested against microbial biofilms. The aim of this project is to provide useful resources for the study of AMPs against biofilms to microbiologist, bioinformatics researcher and medical scientist working in this field in an open-access framework.

name: The Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT Data Repository
description: The Alliance Bioversity-CIAT Data Repository is a database where the Alliance shares research datasets, documentation and data files.

name: RepeatsDB
description: RepeatsDB (https://repeatsdb.org/) is a database of annotated tandem repeat protein structures. Tandem repeats pose a difficult problem for the analysis of protein structures, as the underlying sequence can be highly degenerate. Several repeat types haven been studied over the years, but their annotation was done in a case-by-case basis, thus making large-scale analysis difficult. We developed RepeatsDB to fill this gap. Using state-of-the-art repeat detection methods and manual curation, we systematically annotated the Protein Data Bank, predicting 10 745 repeat structures. In all, 2797 structures were classified according to a recently proposed classification schema, which was expanded to accommodate new findings. In addition, detailed annotations were performed in a subset of 321 proteins. These annotations feature information on start and end positions for the repeat regions and units. RepeatsDB is an ongoing effort to systematically classify and annotate structural protein repeats in a consistent way. It provides users with the possibility to access and download high-quality datasets either interactively or programmatically through web services.

name: ODIN Ocean Data Interoperability Network
description: ODIN (Ocean Data Interoperability Network) catalogue at JRC Ispra for ocean and marine research data objects.

name: Allergome
description: Allergome aims to supply information on Allergenic Molecules (Allergens) causing an IgE-mediated (allergic, atopic) disease (anaphylaxis, asthma, atopic dermatitis, conjunctivitis, rhinitis, urticaria). The resource is funded through the Allergen Data Laboratories via unrestricted grants from companies and institutions.

name: Preclinical Image Dataset Repository
description: The Preclinical Image DAtaset Repository (PIDAR) is a public repository of metadata information of preclinical image datasets from any imaging modality associated to peer-review publications. It provides a new metadata model to describe preclinical image datasets. This model has been developed from the Working group of Data Management of Euro-BioImaging Med-Hub

name: Cell Line Integrated Molecular Authentication Database
description: CLIMA 2 is the result of an integration effort aimed at including all certified STR profiles of human cell lines in a unique database. The contents of the database are dynamically summarized (i.e., they are always up-to-date) in a table in the home page. CLIMA can be used to identify researcher's cell lines. Moreover, it can be searched either by name or by locus. The identification of a cell line is performed according to the standard ANSI/ATCC ASN-0002-2011 on "Authentication of Human Cell Lines: Standardization of STR Profiling".

name: Catalog of Agrogeophysical Studies
description: A platform putting together a database/catalog of agrogeophysical surveys in order to promote FAIR practicies and boost future research

name: PhenPath
description: PhenPath includes a database and a tool: PhenPathDB collects all the functional annotations associated with a specific phenotype or to a cluster of phenotypes and PhenPathTOOL retrieves the functional annotations for two or more phenotypes.

name: Open & Sustainable AI Ecosytem
description:
Based on the 2025 paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.16619), the OSAI AI Ecosystem is a simple interactive, community-maintained digital resource. Its primary function is to serve as a practical registry that supports the implementation of Open and Sustainable AI (OSAI) principles in the life sciences.

The core of the resource is a direct mapping of the paper's OSAI recommendations (for reusability, reproducibility, and environmental sustainability) to a living collection of over 300 real-world components.

These components include a wide array of tools, platforms, standards, and resources that researchers can use to build more sustainable, reusable, and transparent AI. The registry is designed to help researchers "stop searching and start implementing" by allowing them to filter for resources based on their specific goals, such as finding reproducibility tools or sustainability supports.

The resource is supported by an open community-maintained GitHub repository: https://github.com/BioComputingUP/OSAI_ecosystem.

name: Work Histories Italian Panel
description: WHIP is a database of individual work histories, based on Inps administrative archives. The reference population is made up by all the people – Italian and foreign – who have worked in Italy even only for only a part of their working career. A large representative sample has been extracted from this population: in the standard file the sampling coefficient is about 1: 180, for a dynamic population of about 370,000 people (figures will be doubled in the full edition).

name: OGS OpenData
description: Open data landing catalog of OGS research datasets with DOIs.

name: ASI Space Science Data Center
description: ASI Space Science Data Center archives for high-energy astrophysics, cosmology, and planetary missions.

name: Italian National Biodiversity Network
description: The Ministry for the Environment, Land and Sea has promoted the project "Environment 2010" which plays a strong team move to support the National Strategy for Biodiversity . The crux of the system is the National Biodiversity Network (NNB), a network of Centers of Excellence (CoE) and National Focal Point (FP), accredited to international and national level for the management, sharing and information about data on biodiversity.

name: it-ioos
description: The Italian Integrated Ocean Observing System (IT-IOOS), initiated by the PNRR project ITINERIS, is a national initiative aiming to coordinate and harmonize national marine observations and provide a single access point to all Italian marine data. IT-IOOS integrates and harmonize data collected by various Research Infrastructures (RIs) with the aim of guaranteeing access to Italian facilities, services, and marine data and ensuring long-term monitoring of Essential Ocean Variables (EOVs), Essential Biodiversity Variables (EBVs), and Essential Climate Variables (ECVs). Data collected from a wide range of platforms and technologies, including moorings, floats, drifters, gliders, and research vessels, models, are harmonized and made accessible from the IT-IOOS portal. IT-IOOS adopted the FAIR principles—Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable. All data are structured in a way that promotes seamless integration with other datasets. This accessibility empowers marine stakeholders to leverage the data effectively, fostering collaboration across different disciplines and enhancing the potential for innovative solutions to emerge. IT-IOOS builds upon Italy’s active involvement in Research Infrastructures (RIs), which have been established to share facilities, resources, and services to monitor the environment and ensure their long-term sustainability. RIs contributing to IT-IOOS includes the Italy's nodes and facilities of EMSO ERIC, EURO-ARGO ERIC, DANUBIUS, ICOS, JERICO, eLTER, EUROFLEETS and SIOS as well as three significant Italian infrastructures: Laboratori Nazionali del Sud, N/R Laura Bassi, and GeoSciences-MER The IT-IOOS has been designed as a distributed system to enhance the collection and sharing of oceanographic data. This design adheres to the guidelines established by the Italian Oceanographic Commission (COI), a national body of the UNESCO Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission, which has emphasized the necessity of a unique portal where all Italian marine monitoring systems, modeling results, and marine data are displayed and easily accessible. By aligning with these national and international standards, IT-IOOS strengthens Italy's capacity to contribute to global ocean observation efforts, fostering innovation and sustainability in marine science.

name: Eukaryotic Ribosomal Internal Transcribed Spacer 1 Database
description: The Eukaryotic Ribosomal Internal Transcribed Spacer 1 Database (ITSoneDB) is a collection of eukaryotic ribosomal RNA Internal Transcribed Spacer 1 (ITS1) sequences. It is intended to provide a curated reference database aimed at ITS1-based metagenomic surveys. Each ITS1 is mapped on the NCBI reference taxonomy with its start and end positions precisely annotated. ITSoneDB has been developed in agreement to the FAIR guidelines by enabling the users to query and download its content through a simple web-interface and access relevant metadata by cross-linking to European Nucleotide Archive.

name: BioMemory
description: BioMemory is a digital repository developed by the National Research Council of Italy to catalogue and connect biological collections and biobanks. It provides structured access to specimens, genetic resources, and associated metadata (such as taxonomic, ecological, and molecular information).

name: SIGnaling Network Open Resource
description: SIGNOR, the SIGnaling Network Open Resource, organizes and stores in a structured format signaling information published in the scientific literature. The captured information is stored as binary causative relationships between biological entities and can be represented graphically as activity flow. The entire network can be freely downloaded and used to support logic modeling or to interpret high content datasets. Each relationship is linked to the literature reporting the experimental evidence. In addition each node is annotated with the chemical inhibitors that modulate its activity. The signaling information is mapped to the human proteome even if the experimental evidence is based on experiments on mammalian model organisms.

name: Human Multifaceted Protein DataBase
description: MultifacetedProtDB is an integrated and manually curated database providing a comprehensive collection of multifunctional UniProt/SwissProt human proteins.

name: Environmental Data Platform
description: The Environmental Data Platform collects and hosts datasets from different repositories managed by Eurac Research. For creators it allows to provide documentation, metadata and centralized access to their repositories and datasets. Users can query metadata catalogues to find data and use integrated web tools to download, process and visualize it.

name: Engineering Strong-Motion Database (ESM)
description: ORFEUS Engineering Strong-Motion Database distributing European and Mediterranean strong-motion waveforms, peak-motion parameters, ShakeMap products, and the ESM 2018 flatfile.

name: International Service for the Geoid
description: ISG' activities are on educational, research, and data distribution sides: principal purposes of ISG are the collection and distribution of geoid models, the collection and distribution of software for geoid computation, and the organization of technical schools on geoid determinations. ISG collects and disseminates worldwide local and regional geoid models estimated by geodetic Institutions and researchers of many countries.

name: ISTI Open Portal
description: A gateway to the scientific production of the Institute of Information Science and Technologies (ISTI), an institute of the Italian National Research Council (CNR)

name: Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research
description: The Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research (EDGAR) is a global, independent inventory of human-caused greenhouse gas and air pollutant emissions compiled by the European Commission’s Joint Research Centre. It provides consistent, long-term estimates of emissions by country, sector, and grid cell, based on international statistics and standard methodologies. EDGAR’s data help scientists, policymakers, and modelers analyze historical trends and support climate change research and policy assessments.

name: FuzDB Database of fuzzy protein complexes
description: FuzDB compiles experimentally observed fuzzy protein complexes, where intrinsic disorder (ID) is maintained upon interacting with a partner (protein, nucleic acid or small molecule) and directly impacts biological function. Entries in the database have both (i) structural evidence demonstrating the structural multiplicity or dynamic disorder of the ID region(s) in the partner bound form of the protein and (ii) in vitro or in vivo biological evidence that indicates the significance of the fuzzy region(s) in the formation, function or regulation of the assembly. Unlike the other intrinsically disordered or unfolded protein databases, FuzDB focuses on ID regions within a biological context, including higher-order assemblies and presents a detailed analysis of the structural and functional data.

name: DisProt - Database of Intrinsically Disordered Proteins
description: DisProt is the major manually curated repository of Intrinsically Disordered Proteins (IDPs). Part of ELIXIR infrastructure; maintained by University of Padua and the IDP Community. CC BY 4.0.

name: INGV VOLC-TCS Gateway
description: INGV Catania Volcano Observations thematic core service gateway distributing Italian volcano monitoring data including seismic catalogues, strainmeter and tiltmeter series, magnetic data, geochemistry, VONA notices, and volcanic reports.

name: ORCHESTRA Data Portal
description: ORCHESTRA research data portal (CINECA) with data explorer, data dictionary and public-use files.

name: Visual Media Service
description: The aim of the Visual Media Service is to provide CH researchers with an automatic system to publish on the web, search, visualize and analyze images and 3D models in a common workspace, enabling sharing, interoperability and reuse of visual data. Visual Media Service enables the easy publication and visualization on the web of high-resolution 2D images, RTI (Reflection Transformation Images) and 3D models.

name: MobiDB
description: MobiDB is a database of intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) and related features from various sources and prediction tools. Different levels of reliability and different features are reported as different and independent annotations. The database features three levels of annotation: manually curated, indirect and predicted. MobiDB annotates the binding modes of disordered proteins, whether they undergo disorder-to-order transitions or remain disordered in the bound state. In addition, disordered regions undergoing liquid-liquid phase separation or post-translational modifications are defined.

name: MOIST - Multidisciplinary Oceanic Information SysTem (EMSO  - European Multidisciplinary Seafloor and water column Observatory)
description: MOIST - Multidisciplinary Oceanic Information SysTem (EMSO  - European Multidisciplinary Seafloor and water column Observatory) provides 90 datasets ([100%] open access) according to the BASE search index as of 2015-02-17.

name: FRIDGE Near-Fault Observatories gateway
description: INGV FRIDGE gateway for EPOS Near-Fault Observatories, providing access to multiparametric NFO datasets (seismic events, CO2, radon, meteorological, and Vp/Vs products) via FDSN and REST services.

name: Protein Ensemble Database
description: The Protein Ensemble Database (PED) is an open access database for the deposition of structural ensembles, including intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). Manually curated data of structural ensembles measured with nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, small-angle X-ray scattering, fluorescence resonance energy transfer are annotated in PED.

name: ENES Thematic Data Catalogue
description: The ENES Pilot Node integrates ENES services with the next generation of EOSC Core capabilities to deliver an interoperable and scalable environment that enables AI-driven analysis, big data processing, and provenance tracking, fostering seamless access, innovation, and federation across scientific research domains.

name: MetalPDB
description: MetalPDB is a resource aimed at conveying the information available on the three-dimensional structures of metal-binding biological macromolecules in a consistent and effective manner. This is achieved through the systematic and automated representation of metal-binding sites in proteins and nucleic acids by way of Minimal Functional Sites (MFSs). MFSs are three-dimensional templates that describe the local environment around the metal(s) independently of the larger context of the macromolecular structure embedding the site(s), and are the central objects of MetalPDB design. MFSs are grouped into equistructural (broadly defined as sites found in corresponding positions in similar structures) and equivalent sites (equistructural sites that contain the same metals), allowing users to easily analyze similarities and variations in metal-macromolecule interactions, and to link them to functional information.

name: ViDEPI
description: Public catalog of historical Italian petroleum well logs, final profiles, and documents from expired exploration titles.

name: APICURON
description: APICURON is a database to credit and acknowledge the work of biocurators, it collects and aggregates biocuration events from third party resources and generates achievements and leaderboards.

name: DISNOR
description: DISNOR is a resource that uses a comprehensive collection of disease associated genes, as annotated in DisGeNET, to interrogate SIGNOR (https://signor.uniroma2.it) in order to assemble disease-specific logic networks linking disease associated genes by causal relationships. DISNOR is an open resource where more than 4000 disease-networks, linking ~ 2800 disease genes, can be explored. For each disease curated in DisGeNET, DISNOR links disease genes through manually annotated causal relationships and the inferred 'patho-pathways' can be visualised at different level of complexity.

name: Disease And Reactome database
description: DAR is a database mapping disease-associated enzyme into Reactome pathways.

name: neuGRID
description: NeuGRID is a secure data archiving and HPC processing system. The neuGRID platform uses a robust infrastructure to provide researchers with a simple interface for analysing, searching, retrieving and disseminating their biomedical data. With hundreds of investigators across the globe and more than 10 million of downloadable attributes, neuGRID aims to become a widespread resource for brain analyses.

name: miRandola: extracellular circulating RNAs database
description: The miRandola database is the first resource for extracellular circulating RNAs. The first version of the database has been published on Plos One in 2012. It mainly contains information on circulating microRNAs and other non-coding RNAs. It is manually curated and constantly updated by the authors (usually once a year). We have extracted data from PubMed papers and Exocarta (a database that collects data regarding exosomes). We report information on methods of RNA extraction and qualification, diseases, experimental description, expression data and the potential biomarker role. We are updating the database with other RNAs and the future direction is to have a portal for all the non invasive biomarkers such as cell free DNA and circulating tumor cells.

name: Musa Germplasm Information System
description: The Musa Germplasm Information System (MGIS) contains key information on Musa germplasm diversity, including passport data, botanical classification, morpho-taxonomic descriptors, molecular studies, plant photographs and GIS information on 4771 accessions managed in 24 collections around the world, making it the most extensive source of information on banana genetic resources.

name: QUADRatlas
description: QUADRatlas is a database of experimentally-derived and computationally predicted RNA G-quadruplex (RG4s) in the human transcriptome, enriched with biological function and disease associations. QUADRatlas includes known interactions of RG4s with RNA-binding proteins (RBPs), complemented with an extensive RBP binding sites dataset. Users can thus intersect RG4s with their potential regulators and effectors, enabling the formulation of novel hypotheses on RG4 regulation, function and pathogenicity. To support this capability, we provide analysis tools for predicting whether an RBP can bind RG4s, RG4 enrichment in a gene set, and de novo RG4 prediction. Genome-browser and table views allow exploring, filtering, and downloading the data quickly for individual genes and in batch.

name: Jacob Burckhardt Digital Source Archive
description: Burckhardtsource.org is a digital humanities database that hosts a critical online edition of letters sent to the Swiss cultural historian Jacob Burckhardt. It contains around a thousand documents from more than 300 correspondents, offering insights into 19th-century European cultural and intellectual life. The platform provides scans, transcriptions, metadata, and semantic annotations, allowing users to search, link, and visualize the correspondence.

name: ViruSurf
description: ViruSurf is a large public database of viral sequences and integrated and curated metadata from heterogeneous sources (RefSeq, GenBank, COG-UK and NMDC); it also exposes computed nucleotide and amino acid variants, called from original sequences. A GISAID-specific ViruSurf database offers a subset of these functionalities. Given the current pandemic outbreak, SARS-CoV-2 data are collected from the four sources; but ViruSurf contains other virus species harmful to humans, including SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, Ebola, and Dengue. The database is centered on sequences, described from their biological, technological, and organizational dimensions. In addition, the analytical dimension characterizes the sequence in terms of its annotations and variants. The web interface enables expressing complex search queries in a simple way; arbitrary search queries can freely combine conditions on attributes from the four dimensions, extracting the resulting sequences. Several example queries on the database confirm and possibly improve results from recent research papers; results can be recomputed over time and upon selected populations. Effective search over large and curated sequence data may enable faster responses to future threats that could arise from new viruses.

name: database of Disease-Gene Associations with annotated Relationships
description: The database of Disease-Gene Associations with annotated Relationships (eDGAR) is a database for collecting and organizing the data on gene/disease associations as derived from OMIM, Humsavar and ClinVar. For each heterogeneous or polygenic disease, eDGAR provides information on the relationship among the proteins encoded by the involved genes, including transcription factors and protein-protein interactions.

name: Data, Optimization, Model and Evaluation Registry
description: The DOME registry provides a curated set of annotations for ML papers following the DOME recommendations. Data collection, annotation and integration in The DOME Registry is the result of an effort of expert curators.

name: Open Data Marche Camcom
description: Opendata portal of the Marche Chamber of Commerce

name: OpenData Unicam
description: Open data portal of the University of Camerino (UniCam), providing openly licensed datasets on teaching, administration, university infrastructure, and sustainability initiatives.

name: Open Data UniUrb
description: Open data portal of the University of Urbino Carlo Bo (UniUrb), publishing institutional CSV datasets on students, degree courses, graduates, Erasmus mobility, and doctoral programmes under CC BY 4.0.

name: ISPAT Sistema informativo degli indicatori statistici
description: ISPAT Sistema informativo degli indicatori statistici, the Autonomous Province of Trento's structural indicator databank with provincial and European comparisons.

name: ISPAT Annuario on-line
description: ISPAT Annuario on-line, the navigable statistical yearbook tables of the Autonomous Province of Trento. Distinct from the ISPAT structural indicators databank on the same host.

name: STEM - WebGIS
description: STEM (Sistema di TElerilevamento e Monitoraggio del territorio e dell'ambiente trentino). Public WebGIS of the Autonomous Province of Trento for remote-sensing and environmental monitoring data, including CC-BY LiDAR downloads. Built on the Trilogis WebGIS framework (js/libs/Trilogis assets).

name: Portale Geocartografico Trentino
description: Main geoportal of the Autonomous Province of Trento. Gateway to thematic WebGIS viewers (WGT, STEM), the GeoNetwork geocatalog, WMS/WFS services and vector/raster downloads (carta tecnica, LiDAR, ortofoto, geologia, catasto grotte). Built with Trilogis contribution.

name: GeoKatalog Südtirol
description: GeoKatalog spatial data catalogue of the Autonomous Province of Bolzano – South Tyrol.

name: Veneto Sistema Statistico Regionale banche dati
description: Regione Veneto Sistema Statistico Regionale banche dati, queryable JSP tables for tourism, population, labour, transport, and other official regional indicators.

name: Research Data Unipd
description: Official institutional repository for research data produced by members of the University of Padua, supporting data discovery, sharing, and reuse in accordance with FAIR principles. Datasets are described with metadata and assigned a DOI.

name: GeoPortale Regione Veneto
description: Official GeoPortale of Regione Veneto (IDT-RV 2.0), providing search, view, and download of regional spatial data and CSW metadata. Distinct from the GeoServer at idt2-geoserver.regione.veneto.it.

name: Geoportale SIGI - Comune di Verona
description: Official municipal WebGIS (SIGI) of the Comune di Verona, with several hundred map layers.

name: Oman Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Portal
description: National portal of Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information for monitoring and reporting Sustainable Development Goals indicators since 2016. Provides bilingual Arabic and English access to the 17 UN SDGs, policy briefs, publications, and official indicator data linked to the Oman Data Portal.

name: Manafeth - Oman Statistical Portal for International Trade
description: Official NCSI portal of Oman for international trade statistics (Manafeth). Provides bilingual Arabic and English access to imports, exports, re-exports, trade balances, HS-coded commodities, partner countries, and customs ports, with Excel downloads, charts, maps, and a REST API.

name: Oman National Open Data Portal
description: Oman's National Open Data Portal providing access to open government datasets from public entities across sectors, supporting transparency, innovation, and reuse under the Open Government License of the Sultanate of Oman.

name: City of Whitehorse Open Data
description: Official open data portal for the City of Whitehorse, Yukon.

name: Yukon Geological Survey data system
description: Yukon Geological Survey integrated data system for publications, spatial compilations, Minfile mineral occurrences, assessment reports, drill core, and related geoscience datasets.

name: City of Brandon Open Government
description: City of Brandon Open Government portal with an open data catalogue, maps, and applications covering governance, parks, infrastructure, and finance.

name: Manitoba Land Initiative
description: Manitoba Land Initiative geospatial data warehouse. New updates stopped in February 2022; datasets remain available for download while DataMB is the current provincial portal.

name: NL Community Accounts
description: Public table builder of community, regional, and provincial social and economic indicators for Newfoundland and Labrador, including demographics, health, income, labour, education, and well-being accounts.

name: Newfoundland and Labrador Open Data
description: The Newfoundland and Labrador Open Data repository increases access to government information and data.

name: GeoScience OnLine
description: No explicit catalog description available at target URL, but appears to be portal for geospatial and mapping data from Government of Newfoundland and Labrador, likely managed by a government department or agency.

name: GeoNB Data Catalogue
description: GeoNB is the Province of New Brunswick’s gateway to geographic information and related value-added applications.

name: Public Health Ontario Snapshots
description: Interactive map-based public health indicator dashboards by public health unit, covering chronic disease, injuries, mortality, reproductive health, substance use, and social determinants. Distinct from the PHO open-data inventory.

name: IESO Data Directory
description: Public reports on Ontario electricity demand, prices, and generation.

name: Wellbeing Toronto
description: City of Toronto neighbourhood wellbeing explorer with selectable demographic, health, safety, and economic indicators mapped across Toronto neighbourhoods.

name: Ontario Community Health Profiles Partnership
description: Open-access health equity indicator tables, charts, and maps for Ontario neighbourhoods and larger geographies, covering adult and child health, hospital conditions, maternal health, and socio-demographic measures.

name: Public Health Ontario Open Data
description: PHO's data inventory lists all PHO data sets and identifies whether a data set is currently open, in the process of being opened or exempt from being released.

name: Dryden Maps Gallery
description: Public City of Dryden ArcGIS Online map gallery with municipal GIS maps for reference use.

name: West Parry Sound Geography Network Interactive Mapping
description: West Parry Sound Geography Network interactive mapping application for parcels, civic addresses, roads, planning, and related regional GIS layers.

name: County of Simcoe Interactive Map
description: County of Simcoe public interactive map viewer with switchable municipal and thematic map configurations.

name: DELVE Datasets
description: University of Toronto DELVE collection of datasets for evaluating learning methods in valid experiments.

name: Matter Lab Open Software and Data
description: Open software and data page of the Matter Lab at the University of Toronto, listing computational chemistry databases and tools including CEPDB.

name: OGSEarth
description: OGSEarth publishes Ontario Geological Survey geoscience data for viewing in Google Earth and similar GIS tools, including geology, mining claims, index maps, administrative boundaries, and abandoned mines.

name: INSPQ Indicateur de santé publique
description: Public Quebec health indicators with regional comparisons and charts by age and sex, covering mortality, perinatal health, mental health, and related topics. The Infocentre portal is login-only and is not this catalog.

name: Institut de la statistique du Québec
description: Official statistical tables and indicators for Quebec from the Institut de la statistique du Québec. Covers demography, labour, economy, health, education, and society after the December 2025 closure of the BDSO databank.

name: Carte interactive MRC Brome-Missisquoi
