description: Public Leaflet GIS of MRC Brome-Missisquoi for graphic matrices, wetlands, forest cover, and municipal property search.

name: SIG public MRC des Collines-de-l'Outaouais
description: Public graphic-matrix GIS of MRC des Collines-de-l'Outaouais for cadastre, assessment units, and orthophotos of its local municipalities.

name: SIGÉOM
description: SIGÉOM is Quebec's geoscience information system. It holds geological mapping, mineral exploration, mining-activity, and EXAMINE document records, with an interactive map and free vector downloads.

name: Nordicana D
description: Data collection of the Université Laval Centre for Northern Studies (CEN) disseminating Nordic research data, including long-term environmental monitoring from northern stations.

name: Saskatchewan Conservation Data Centre
description: SKCDC is a provincial centre that collects, standardizes, and shares data on wild species and ecological communities in Saskatchewan, Canada. It integrates observations from the public, researchers, and other sources to produce species lists, conservation rankings (local, national, global), and maps. Its mission is to support biodiversity conservation by providing accessible, high-quality information to inform planning, policy, and management.

name: PEI GIS Data Catalog
description: Prince Edward Island GIS Data Catalog listing provincial basemap, civic address, boundary, imagery, property, and resource layers available for download.

name: Town of Stratford Interactive Zoning Map
description: Town of Stratford interactive zoning map for municipal land-use districts, published on the Shape Stratford planning site.

name: Nunavut Geoscience
description: Canada-Nunavut Geoscience Office portal for public mineral exploration and geoscience data, including the Nunavut Mineral Project Inventory, assessment report references, and the MIRAGE mineral occurrence search.

name: Nunavut Planning geodata
description: The mapping services provided include topographical mapping of all non-tax based communities in Nunavut. Satellite imagery is acquired on a regular basis to maintain our mapping. The topographical maps can be downloaded from this website or obtained by contacting the Regional Community Planner or the Coordinator, Planning and Lands Information Systems in Kugluktuk.

name: BC Community Health Data
description: Community health profiles and a searchable indicator database for British Columbia municipalities and Community Health Service Areas, covering demographics, socio-economic status, and health outcomes.

name: UBC Library Open Collections
description: UBC Library Open Collections provides direct programmatic access to all of the metadata and much of the media available on the website through APIs.

name: BC Transit Open Data
description: BC Transit public catalog of GTFS static/realtime feeds and stop/route GIS files for 40-plus transit systems outside Metro Vancouver.

name: City of Chilliwack Open Data Catalogue
description: GIS open data catalogue of the City of Chilliwack, British Columbia. Provides municipal spatial datasets such as sanitary and drainage utilities, roads and addressing, flood construction levels, and elevation, downloadable in DWG, SHP, GDB, KML, and JSON formats under the City of Chilliwack Open Data License.

name: Nanaimo Data Catalogue
description: City of Nanaimo Maps & Data page for open geospatial and civic datasets. The former data.nanaimo.ca catalogue and /open-data-catalogue URL redirect here.

name: GEOweb Property Viewer
description: District of North Vancouver GEOweb property viewer for parcels, zoning, OCP, utilities, and related municipal layers.

name: Central Saanich Web Map
description: District of Central Saanich public web GIS map for municipal property and planning layers.

name: Cowichan Valley GIS Downloads
description: Cowichan Valley Regional District GIS download catalogue providing public access to geospatial extracts, including orthophotos, contours, and LiDAR-derived elevation products for the regional district.

name: TransLink App Developer Resources
description: Metro Vancouver TransLink developer catalog of GTFS feeds and Real-Time Transit Information (RTTI) APIs. Registration required for API keys.

name: FirstVoices
description: Indigenous language archive and dictionary platform hosting community-managed word lists, recordings, and teaching materials.

name: Alberta Regional Dashboard
description: Interactive socio-economic indicators for Alberta municipalities and regions, covering population, labour, income, housing, and industry for living, working, and investment decisions.

name: Interactive Health Data Application
description: Alberta Health Interactive Health Data Application with filterable tables and maps of health-status and determinant indicators, including demographics, mortality, chronic and infectious disease, and children's health.

name: Alberta Health Analytics
description: Alberta Health analytics site with interactive health-status reports and the community profiles dashboard for 132 local geographic areas, covering demographics, mortality, disease, and children's health.

name: Alberta Economic Dashboard
description: Provincial economic indicators dashboard for Alberta, covering labour, prices, trade, and related series distinct from the municipal Regional Dashboard.

name: AESO Market and System Reporting
description: Market and system reports for Alberta's electricity grid.

name: Banff Open Data
description: Open Data is Town of Banff datasets freely accessible in machine-readable formats with no restrictions in licensing or copyright.

name: Red Deer Open Data
description: This catalogue provides access to City managed datasets. The data is available for download in several machine-readable formats. The City of Red Deer maintains a catalogue of datasets and APIs from various City departments for public use.

name: Open Data Areas Alberta
description: Open Data Areas Alberta distributes packaged geospatial datasets for selected rural regions, including Beaver Hills, Fort McMurray, Fox Creek, Rocky Mountain House/Sylvan, Taber, and Utikuma Lake.

name: Alberta Geological Survey
description: AGS delivers geoscience in several key areas, including surficial mapping, bedrock mapping, geological modelling, resource evaluation (hydrocarbons, minerals), groundwater, and geological hazards. We also are responsible for maintaining the Alberta Table of Formations and providing geoscience outreach to stakeholders ranging from professional colleagues and academia to the general public.

name: Nova Scotia Economics and Statistics
description: Nova Scotia Economics and Statistics division tables and releases on population, labour, prices, and the provincial economy, maintained by the Department of Finance and Treasury Board.

name: NWT Indicators Dashboard
description: Public dashboard of Northwest Territories socio-economic indicators maintained by the Department of Executive and Indigenous Affairs, linked from the territorial statistics bureau.

name: NWT Time Series Retrieval
description: Northwest Territories Bureau of Statistics time-series retrieval of about 700 demographic, social, and economic series, viewable on screen or downloadable for analysis.

name: Health Infobase
description: Public Health Agency of Canada indicator frameworks and data tools for chronic disease, mental health, perinatal health, physical activity, and related determinants, with interactive charts and downloadable tables.

name: Statistics Canada
description: Main website of Statistics Canada, Canada's national statistical agency. Provides access to official statistics, data tables, publications, and analytical products covering economic, social, and environmental topics for Canada.

name: Job Bank labour market information
description: Employment and Social Development Canada Job Bank labour-market information, with occupational outlooks, wages, and regional labour trends. The job-search interface is not this catalog.

name: CMHC Housing Market Information Portal
description: Free interactive portal for Canadian housing market statistics from Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation. Covers housing starts and completions, rental vacancy and rents, existing housing stock, and core housing need from the national level down to neighbourhoods, with exportable tables.

name: Notifiable Diseases Online
description: Public Health Agency of Canada query and extract tool for nationally notifiable disease case counts, with tables going back to 1924 and CSV or Excel downloads.

name: Census Profile 2021
description: Statistics Canada Census of Population profile query for 2021 community and higher geographies, covering age, language, income, housing, education, and labour characteristics.

name: CER Energy Commodities
description: Canada Energy Regulator data on crude oil, petroleum products, natural gas, natural gas liquids, and electricity.

name: ArcticStat
description: Public and independent statistical databank dealing with the countries, regions and populations of the Circumpolar Arctic. The data mainly comes from national statistics agencies of the Arctic countries, their regional offices or from government ministries.

name: Bank of Canada Valet API
description: Bank of Canada Valet API providing programmatic access to exchange rates, economic statistics, and other financial time series. Series and groups can be listed and retrieved as JSON, CSV, or XML without registration.

name: MSC Datamart
description: Meteorological Service of Canada HTTPS raw-data server for GRIB2 NWP model output, weather radar products, observations, and other real-time meteorological files with a rolling 30-day archive.

name: Natural Resources Canada Geophysical Data
description: A data catalog serving as a central hub for geophysical data and related resources for Canada, managed by Natural Resources Canada.

name: odesi
description: Odesi is a Canadian social science data repository and online exploration and analysis tool. It contains 5,700+ datasets curated by academic libraries in Canada, featuring searchable survey questions and variables from thousands of datasets. Odesi provides both microdata and aggregate data in a variety of formats. Coverage includes subjects such as: agriculture, business and finance, census of population, communications and information, consumer surveys, crime and justice, demographics and population, education, elections and politics, geography, government finances and economic indicators, health, labour and employment, natural resources and environment, public opinion polls, social surveys, trade, travel.

name: Environment Canada Data Catalogue
description: Environment and Climate Change Canada data catalogue for discovering and downloading environmental and scientific datasets, including climate, air, ice, and related observations.

name: Petrinex Public Data
description: Public petroleum volumetric and infrastructure data for western Canada.

name: MDA GSI Portal
description: MDA GSI portal for searching and ordering RADARSAT-2 synthetic aperture radar imagery.

name: Datasets.ai Open Data Search
description: Global search engine operated by AntColony Inc. that aggregates open datasets from government portals, international organizations, and public institutions worldwide, with a public GraphQL API for discovery and AI/ML research.

name: Canadian Laboratory Initiative on Pediatric Reference Interval Database
description: The CALIPER Database is a specialized medical database that provides age-, sex-, and ethnicity-specific reference intervals for laboratory test results in children and adolescents. Developed through a nationwide Canadian research initiative led by The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), it contains data from over 12,000 healthy participants and covers more than 200 biochemical, hematological, immunological, and endocrine markers. The database helps healthcare professionals accurately interpret pediatric laboratory results and improve the diagnosis and monitoring of childhood diseases.

name: Bacterial Protein Interaction Database
description: Bacteriome.org is a database integrating physical (protein-protein) and functional interactions within the context of an E. coli knowledgebase.

name: Northern Ontario Plant Database
description: The Northern Ontario Plant Database (NOPD) is a website that provides free public access to records of herbarium specimens housed in northern Ontario educational and government institutions.

name: Pathway Commons
description: Pathway Commons is a convenient point of access to biological pathway information collected from public pathway databases. Information is sourced from public pathway databases and is readily searched, visualized, and downloaded. The data is freely available under the license terms of each contributing database.

name: OrtholugeDB
description: OrtholugeDB contains Ortholuge-based orthology predictions for completely sequenced bacterial and archaeal genomes. It is also a resource for reciprocal best BLAST-based ortholog predictions, in-paralog predictions (recently duplicated genes) and ortholog groups in Bacteria and Archaea. The Ortholuge method improves the specificity of high-throughput orthology prediction.

name: BenchSci
description: BenchSci offers a free application to academic and non-profit researchers to help select appropriate antibodies for their research based on data from over 14M publications and 12.4 million products. Using the platform, scientists are able to filter for their experimental context, find previously verified antibody products, and leverage cross-reactivity analysis to reduce redundant purchases per target and design more successful experiments. BenchSci also has an expanded Reagent Selection app commercially available to help scientists find appropriate products across seven different reagent and model system types.

name: DNA Modification Database
description: DNAmod is an open-source database (https://dnamod.hoffmanlab.org) that catalogues DNA modifications and provides a single source to learn about their properties. The database annotates the chemical properties and structures of all curated modified DNA bases, and a much larger list of candidate chemical entities. DNAmod includes manual annotations of available sequencing methods, descriptions of their occurrence in nature, and provides existing and suggested nomenclature. DNAmod enables researchers to rapidly review previous work, select mapping techniques, and track recent developments concerning modified bases of interest.

name: Journal of Applied Econometrics Data Archive
description: The JAE Data Archive, which is hosted by a server belonging to the Economics Department of Queen's University, contains data for all papers accepted after January, 1994, unless the data are confidential. There are also data for a few papers accepted earlier. Volume 10, No. 1 (1995) is the first issue in which all papers were accepted subject to the proviso that data be provided.

name: Wildlife Management Information System
description: The Wildlife Management Information System (WMIS) is the Government of Northwest Territories (GNWT) online, geo-referenced wildlife database. WMIS provides a central repository for government staff, industry, researchers and public to store and access standardized wildlife observation data to support the conservation and management of wild species and their habitat in the Northwest Territories (NWT).

name: Canadian VirusSeq Data Portal
description: The goal of the CanCOGeN VirusSeq project is to sequence up to 150,000 viral samples from Canadians testing positive for COVID-19. The VirusSeq Data Portal is an open-source and open-access data portal for all Canadian SARS-CoV-2 sequences and associated non-personal contextual data. It harmonizes, validates and automates submission to international databases.

name: Pain Genes Database
description: Pain Genes Database, operated by McGill University, The Alan Edwards Centre for Research on Pain, Pain Genetics Lab, provides research data on basic biological and medical research, general genetics, and zoology.

name: Open Science and Data Platform
description: The Open Science and Data Platform provides access to science, data, publications and information about development activities across the country that can be used to understand the cumulative effects of human activities to support better decisions in the future.

name: Groundwater Information Network
description: The Groundwater Information Network (GIN) is developed to improve knowledge of groundwater systems, and enhance groundwater management, through increased access to groundwater information. GIN connects a variety of groundwater information from authoritative sources, such as water well databases, water monitoring data, aquifer and geology maps, and related publications.

name: Motus Wildlife Tracking System
description: The Motus Wildlife Tracking System (Motus) is an international collaborative research network that uses coordinated automated radio telemetry to facilitate research and education on the ecology and conservation of migratory animals. Motus is a program of Birds Canada in partnership with collaborating researchers and organizations.

name: Canadian Climate Data and Scenarios
description: The CCDS is an interface for distributing climate change information. The goals of CCDS are to: Support climate change impact and adaptation research in Canada and other countries; Support stakeholders requiring scenario information for decision making and policy development. Provide access to Canadian research on the development of scenarios and adaptation research.

name: Queen's Research Data Centre
description: The Queen's Research Data Centre is a member of the Canadian Research Data Centre Network (CRDCN) that provides researchers with access to microdata 'masterfiles' from population and health surveys. Access to the RDC is limited to those with projects approved by Statistics Canada. Before applying to an RDC, you will have to show that your research cannot be conducted using Public Use Microdata Files (PUMFs) available through the Data Liberation Initiative (DLI).

name: Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging
description: The Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging (CLSA) is a large, national, long-term study of more than 50,000 individuals who were between the ages of 45 and 85 when recruited. These participants will be followed until 2033 or death. The aim of the CLSA is to find ways to help us live long and live well, and understand why some people age in healthy fashion while others do not.

name: PathBank
description: PathBank is an interactive, visual database containing more than 100 000 machine-readable pathways found in model organisms such as humans, mice, E. coli, yeast, and Arabidopsis thaliana. The majority of these pathways are not found in any other pathway database. PathBank is designed specifically to support pathway elucidation and pathway discovery in metabolomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and systems biology. All PathBank pathways include information on the relevant organelles, subcellular compartments, protein complex cofactors, protein complex locations, metabolite locations, chemical structures, and protein complex quaternary structures. The database is easily browsed and supports full text, sequence, and chemical structure searching.

name: DataNB
description: DataNB is a research data repository hosted by the University of New Brunswick that provides access to a wide range of de‑identified and linkable administrative datasets for approved research projects. It supports evidence‑based decision‑making and academic research by enabling analysis of population, health, education, environment, and social data from New Brunswick.

name: cis-Regulatory Element Database
description: The cisRED database holds conserved sequence motifs identified by genome scale motif discovery, similarity, clustering, co-occurrence and coexpression calculations. Sequence inputs include low-coverage genome sequence data and ENCODE data.

name: The Cell Map
description: TheCellMap.org is an open-access database that stores, visualizes, and enables exploration of genetic interaction networks from both yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) and human cells. It integrates genome-wide Synthetic Genetic Array (SGA) data in yeast with CRISPR-based perturbation screens in human cells to map functional relationships between genes. Users can interactively browse global networks, extract subnetworks, and explore gene functions or functional modules.

name: Permafrost Information Network
description: Permafrost Information Network (PIN) connecting borehole stratigraphic, geotechnical, ground thermal, and surficial geology data from Geological Survey of Canada sources. The site currently shows a migration notice.

name: Human Metabolome Database (HMDB)
description: Comprehensive database of human metabolites with chemical, clinical, and molecular biology data.

name: Forest Change Data Catalogue
description: The Forest Climate Change Data Catalogue is a collection of data sets that are relevant to the Canadian forest sector under a changing climate. Created by Canadian Forest Service scientists, these data sets include static maps, raw data, and interactive maps that cover all of Canada. Data themes include drought, fire, climate and tree distribution; multiple climate scenarios are projected to the year 2100.

name: Canadian Open Genetics Repository
description: The Canadian Open Genetics Repository is a collaborative effort for the collection, storage, sharing and robust analysis of variants reported by medical diagnostics laboratories across Canada. As clinical laboratories adopt modern genomics technologies, the need for this type of collaborative framework is increasingly important. If you want to join COGR project and get data please send an email at cogr@opengenetics.ca and the introduction to the project will be arranged.

name: National Earthquake DataBase
description: The National Earthquake DataBase (NEDB) comprises a number of separate databases that together act as the national repository for all raw seismograph data, measurements, and derived parameters arising from the Canadian National Seismograph Network (CNSN), the Yellowknife Seismological Array (YKA), previous regional telemetered networks in eastern and western Canada (ECTN, WCTN), local telemetered networks (CLTN, SLTN), the Regional Analogue Network, and the former Standard Seismograph Network (CSN). It supports the efforts of Earthquakes Canada in Canadian seismicity monitoring, global seismic monitoring, verification of the Comprehensive nuclear Test Ban Treaty, and international data exchange.

name: BioChem database
description: BioChem is an archive of marine biological and chemical data maintained by Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO). It holds biological and chemical data that are from department research initiatives and collected in areas of Canadian interest.

name: Artificial Intelligence-Ready CHEmiCal Knowledge Base
description: Artificial Intelligence-Ready CHEmiCal Knowledge Base (AIRCHECK) is an open, cloud-based platform that provides the high-quality, structured data AI needs to accelerate drug discovery. AIRCHECK helps researchers train and improve AI models to predict how small molecules interact with proteins.

name: Canadian Coast Guard - e-Navigation Portal
description: The portal provides up-to-date information on marine weather, tides, currents, navigational hazards, notices to mariners, ice conditions, nautical charts, and sailing directions, all in one place to support safe and efficient navigation.

name: Arctic Research Database Data Catalogue
description: Arctic Research Foundation (ARF) is a private, non-profit organization creating a new kind of scientific infrastructure for the Canadian Arctic, through our operation of efficient, cutting-edge research vessels and self-powered mobile labs.

name: DrugBank
description: Comprehensive drug and drug-target database covering approved, investigational, and experimental pharmaceuticals.

name: Marine Environmental Data Section
description: Marine Environmental Data Section (MEDS) of Fisheries and Oceans Canada: national archive for oceanographic data (waves, tides, water column profiles), with data request services.

name: Canadian Disaster Database
description: The Canadian Disaster Database (CDD) contains detailed disaster information on more than 1000 natural, technological and conflict events (excluding war) that have happened since 1900 at home or abroad and that have directly affected Canadians. The database describes where and when a disaster occurred, the number of injuries, evacuations, and fatalities, as well as a rough estimate of the costs. As much as possible, the CDD contains primary data that is valid, current and supported by reliable and traceable sources, including federal institutions, provincial/territorial governments, non-governmental organizations and media sources. Data is updated and reviewed on a semi-annual basis.

name: The Global Proteome Machine Database
description: The Global Proteome Machine Database (gpmDB holds the minimum amount of information necessary for common bioinformatics-related tasks (such as sequence assignment validation) rather than being a complete record of a proteomics experiment. It was also created to aid in the process of validating peptide MS/MS spectra as well as protein coverage patterns. Most of the data is held in a set of XML files: the database serves as an index to those files, allowing for rapid lookups and reduced database storage requirements.

name: Canadian Database of Geochemical Surveys
description: This website is the public interface to the "Canadian Database of Geochemical Surveys". The database has two long-term goals. Firstly, it aims to catalogue all of the regional geochemical surveys that have been carried out across Canada, beginning in the 1950s. Secondly, it aims to make the raw data from those surveys available in a standardised format. Over 1,500 surveys have been catalogued.

name: Better Outcomes Registry & Network
description: Funded by the Government of Ontario, the Better Outcomes Registry & Network (BORN) is Ontario's prescribed perinatal, newborn and child registry with the role of facilitating quality care for families across the province. BORN collects, interprets, shares and rigorously protects high-quality data.

name: CHILDdb
description: CHILDdb provides an opportunity for researchers to explore CHILD data to study genetic and environmental factors influencing child health and development.

name: Élections Québec's Open Data
description: Élections Québec's Open Data is available on this website is accessible to everyone, but is mostly used by media, IT developers and researchers. It is used, among other things, on websites, for applications and in studies.

name: Primate Cell Type Database
description: PrimateDatabase.com, a publicly available web-accessible archive of intracellular patch clamp recordings and highly detailed three-dimensional digital reconstructions of neuronal morphology. PrimateDatabase.com is unique because it is currently the largest collection of non-human primate (NHP) intracellular recordings.

name: Canadian Astronomy Data Centre
description: Canadian Astronomy Data Centre archive of observations from CFHT, JCMT, and other facilities, with IVOA TAP access.

name: The Centre for Applied Genomics Databases
description: The Centre for Applied Genomics hosts a variety of databases related to ongoing supported projects. Curation of these databases is performed in-house by TCAG Bioinformatics staff. The Autism Chromosome Rearrangement Database, The Cystic Fibrosis Mutation Database, TThe Lafora Progressive Myoclonus Epilepsy Mutation and Polymorphism Database are included.

name: Biofactoid
description: Biofactoid (biofactoid.org) helps authors share a searchable representation of their interactions (e.g. binding, gene expression, post-translational modification) between genes or gene products, as well as chemicals. This information, with author attribution, is shared in social media and public databases, such as Pathway Commons, where it can be discovered and analyzed in the context of a large and growing corpus of knowledge. Biofactoid (biofactoid.org) is a public, academic project between groups at Harvard University, University of Toronto and Oregon Health & Science University to help improve the way we share and search for research findings.

name: Gemma
description: Gemma is a database for the meta-analysis, re-use and sharing of genomics data, currently primarily targeted at the analysis of gene expression profiles. Gemma contains data from thousands of public studies, referencing thousands of published papers. Users can search, access and visualize co-expression and differential expression results.

name: CANJEM
description: CANJEM (CANadian Job-Exposure Matrix) is a large source of retrospective information on job-based exposure for a given occupation and time period. Covering most occupations and many agents, it provides information on the probability, frequency and intensity of exposure from a list of 258 occupational risk factors.

name: NRC Digital Repository
description: Public access repository for discovering research outputs produced by the National Research Council Canada, including research data and publications.

name: BioGRID Open Repository of CRISPR Screens
description: BioGRID ORCS is an open repository of CRISPR screens compiled through comprehensive curation efforts. Our current index is version 1.0.3 and searches more than 49 publications and 58,161 genes to return more than 895 CRISPR screens from 3 major model organism species and 629 cell lines. All screen data are freely provided through our search index and available via download in a wide variety of standardized formats.

name: FooDB
description: Database of food constituents, chemistry, and biology covering compounds found in foods.

name: Open Data Commons for Spinal Cord Injury
description: The Open Data Commons for Spinal Cord Injury is a cloud-based community-driven repository to store, share, and publish spinal cord injury research data. There are several challenges for scientific reproducibility and bench-to-bedside translation. For example, only research and data that are published actually get disseminated, a phenomenon known as publication bias. Published research reflects to only a small fraction of all data collected, and data that do not lead to publication are largely ignored, hidden away in filing cabinets and hard drives. This results in an abundance of inaccessible scientific data known as “dark data”. Even when research is disseminated, it is usually in the form of summary reports of aggregated data (e.g. averages across individual subjects) such as scientific articles. The fact that the individual subject-level data are inaccessible further contributes to dark data. The spinal cord injury (SCI) community created the ODC-SCI to mitigate dark data in SCI research. The ODC-SCI also aims to increase transparency with individual-level data, enhance collaboration, facilitate advanced analytics, and conform to increasing mandates by funders and publishers to make data accessible. Members of the ODC-SCI have access to a private digital lab space managed by the PI or multi-PIs for dataset storage and sharing. The PIs can share their labs’ datasets with the registered members of the ODC-SCI community and make their datasets public and citable. The ODC-SCI implements stewardship principles that scientific data be made FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable) and has been widely adopted by the international SCI research community.

name: GWFNet
description: GWFNet is an online data catalogue developed within the Global Water Futures (GWF) program to support water science research. It serves as a centralized portal that indexes and describes datasets, models, observation sites, publications, and research projects related to freshwater systems. Rather than hosting raw data itself, GWFNet provides structured metadata to help researchers discover and connect water-related scientific resources.

name: Manitoba Population Research Data Repository
description: The Population Health Research Data Repository housed at MCHP is a comprehensive collection of administrative, registry, survey, and other data primarily relating to residents of Manitoba. It was developed to describe and explain patterns of health care and profiles of health and illness, facilitating inter-sectoral research in areas such as health care, education, and social services.

name: Canine Inherited Disorders Database
description: The CIDD (Canine Inherited Disorders Database) is an online resource providing information on genetic disorders in dogs. It offers details about inheritance patterns, clinical consequences, diagnosis, and recommendations for care, directed to dog owners, veterinarians, and breeders.

name: Fisheries and Oceans Canada Pacific Region Data Archive
description: The Institute of Ocean Sciences (IOS)/Ocean Sciences Division (OSD) data archive contains the holdings of oceanographic data generated by the IOS and other agencies and laboratories, including the Institute of Oceanography at the University of British Columbia and the Pacific Biological Station. The contents include data from British Columbia coastal waters and inlets, British Columbia continental shelf waters, open ocean North Pacific waters, Beaufort Sea and the Arctic Archipelago.

name: Open Exoplanet Catalogue
description: The Open Exoplanet Catalogue is a catalogue of all discovered extra-solar planets. It is a new kind of astronomical database, decentralized and completely open.

name: TreeSource
description: TreeSource is the National database on wood and trees quality in Canada. Developed by the Canadian Forest Service, it aims to gather the largest possible amount of information on trees quality (dendrometry, physico-mechanical and chemical properties) for economically important species across Canada, for research purposes.

name: Integrated Interactions Database
description: The Integrated Interactions Database (IID) is a database of detected and predicted protein-protein interactions (PPIs) in a number of species. It stores networks that are specific to tissues, sub-cellular localizations, diseases, and druggable proteins.

name: Canada-Nova Scotia Offshore Petroleum Board Data Management Centre
description: Data Management Centre geoviewer of the Canada-Nova Scotia Offshore Energy Regulator, providing access to offshore petroleum and geoscience data.

name: Natural Products Atlas
description: Open-access knowledge base of microbial and fungal natural product structures.

name: Avibase
description: Avibase is an extensive database information system about all birds of the world, containing over 53 million records about 10,000 species and 22,000 subspecies of birds, including distribution information for 20,000 regions, taxonomy, synonyms in several languages and more.

name: The Yeast Metabolome Database
description: The Yeast Metabolome Database (YMDB) is a manually curated database of small molecule metabolites found in or produced by Saccharomyces cerevisiae (also known as Baker’s yeast and Brewer’s yeast). This database covers metabolites described in textbooks, scientific journals, metabolic reconstructions and other electronic databases.

name: Termini-Oriented Protein Function INferred Database
description: The Termini-Oriented Protein Function INferred Database (TopFIND) is an integrated knowledgebase focused on protein termini, their formation by proteases and functional implications. It contains information about the processing and the processing state of proteins and functional implications thereof derived from research literature, contributions by the scientific community and biological databases.

name: FlowRepository
description: FlowRepository is a database of flow cytometry experiments where you can query and download data collected and annotated according to the MIFlowCyt standard. Data are generally associated with peer reviewed manuscripts.

name: Pseudomonas Genome DB
description: The Pseudomonas Genome Database is a resource for peer-reviewed, continually updated annotation for all Pseudomonas species. It includes gene and protein sequence information, as well as regulation and predicted function and annotation.

name: Canada Vigilance Adverse Reaction Online Database
description: The Canada Vigilance Adverse Reaction Online Database contains information about suspected adverse reactions (also known as side effects) to health products. Adverse reaction reports are submitted by: consumers and health professionals, who submit reports voluntarily; and manufacturers and distributors (also known as market authorization holders), who are required to submit reports according to the Food and Drugs Act. Data is stored from 1965 onwards.

name: EarthStat
description: EarthStat serves geographic data sets that help solve the grand challenge of feeding a growing global population while reducing agriculture’s impact on the environment.

name: International Human Epigenome Consortium Data Portal
description: The International Human Epigenome Consortium (IHEC) coordinates the production of reference epigenome maps through the characterization of the regulome, methylome, and transcriptome from a wide range of tissues and cell types. The IHEC Data Portal provides discovery, visualization, analysis, download, and sharing of epigenomics data, is the official source to navigate through IHEC datasets, and represents a strategy for unifying the distributed data produced by international research consortia.

name: Fly-FISH
description: Fly-FISH documents the expression and localization patterns of Drosophila mRNAs at the cellular and subcellular level during early embryogenesis and third instar larval tissues. A high-resolution, high-throughput fluorescence detection method is used to detect expressed mRNAs. The data can be accessed by searching the localization categories, searching for specific genes or browsing the list of tested genes.

name: Atlantic Canada Conservation Data Centre
description: The Atlantic Canada Conservation Data Centre (AC CDC) compiles and provides objective data about biological diversity in Atlantic Canada, and we undertake fieldwork to further knowledge of the distribution and status of species and ecological communities of conservation concern. All our efforts are in support of conservation-related decision making, research and education.

name: ICES Data Repository
description: The ICES Data Repository consists of record-level, coded and linkable health data sets. It encompasses much of the publicly funded administrative health services records for the Ontario population eligible for universal health coverage since 1986 and is capable of integrating research-specific data, registries and surveys. Currently, the repository includes health service records for as many as 13 million people.

name: Human Reference Protein Interactome Mapping Project
description: The Human Reference Protein Interactome Mapping Project (HuRI) is a repository, created by the Center for Cancer Systems Biology (CCSB) at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, which stores the data from the ongoing work on the first complete reference map of the human protein-protein interactome network. All pairwise combinations of human protein-coding genes are systematically being interrogated to identify which are involved in binary protein-protein interactions. HuRI has grown in several distinct stages primarily defined by the number of human protein-coding genes amenable to screening for which at least one Gateway-cloned Open Reading Frame (ORF) was available at the time of the project. Three proteome-scale human PPI datasets are available via HuRI. PPI datasets generated in systematic screens on smaller sets of our human ORF collection have also been included. Also included are all PPIs identified in screens using different protein isoforms from the same gene as generated by alternative splicing.

name: Hydro-Québec Open Data
description: The open data movement has become an important trend in the space of a few years. Governments, companies and communities integrate open data into their innovation efforts. This project aims to enable others to further utilize Hydro-Quebec data in order to actively contribute to the energy transition.

name: Bedford Institute of Oceanography - Oceanographic Databases
description: Databases maintained by Ocean Sciences at the Bedford Institute of Oceanography, including temperature-salinity profiles for the NW Atlantic, sea-surface temperature and chlorophyll from satellite, monthly statistics of ocean currents and other moored instruments, and daily temperature observations from coastal thermographs.

name: Internationally Peer Reviewed Chemical Safety Information
description: IPCS INCHEM provides access to internationally peer reviewed information on chemicals published through the International Programme on Chemical Safety (IPCS). All types of chemicals from the full range of exposure situations (environment, food, occupational) are included. Searching across all collections or within individual collections is available.

name: The National Soil DataBase
description: The NSDB is the set of computer readable files which contain soil, landscape, and climatic data for all of Canada. It serves as the national archive for land resources information that was collected by federal and provincial field surveys, or created by land data analysis projects. The NSDB includes GIS coverages at a variety of scales, and the characteristics of each named soil series.

name: Health Data Nexus
description: The Temerty Centre for Artificial Intelligence Research and Education in Medicine (T-CAIREM) at the University of Toronto is the nexus for healthcare of the future. We provide world-class educational programs in AI in medicine and fund research opportunities that bring together experts from a range of disciplines. We have also created the secure Health Data Nexus platform to house datasets for applied AI learning and research.

name: Lunaris Canadian Research Data
description: Canada's national discovery service for multidisciplinary research data from institutions across the country. Provides access to datasets from academic, government, and other organizations, supporting text-based and map search.

name: Satellog
description: Satellog is a database that catalogs all pure 1-16 repeat unit satellite repeats in the human genome along with supplementary data. Satellog analyzes each pure repeat in UniGene clusters for evidence of repeat polymorphism.

name: Polar Data Catalogue
description: An online database that describes and provides access to diverse data sets generated by Arctic and Antarctic researchers. It includes metadata and data from a wide range of disciplines including natural sciences, policy, health, and social sciences, and supports Canadian Arctic and Antarctic research and monitoring communities.

name: Mousebytes
description: MouseBytes is an open-access high-throughput pipeline and database for rodent touchscreen-based cognitive assessment. It employs advanced web technologies and is connected to a database/repository of cognitive data obtained using touchscreen technology which allows its use without any software installation. Not only can users deposit their original data, but they are also able to extract, export, share and re-analyze data obtained from other laboratories and benefit from data visualization.

name: TAPoR 3.0
description: TAPoR 3.0 is the third iteration of the original TAPoR (Text Analysis Portal for Research). It is a both a resource for discovery and a community. The TAPoR team has created a place for Humanities scholars, students and others interested in applying digital tools to their textual research to find the tools they need, contribute their experience and share new tools they have developed or used with others.

name: DistanceRegular.org Mathematical Graph Database
description: DistanceRegular.org is an online repository of distance-regular graphs available for download in a variety of formats.

name: The Autism Chromosome Rearrangement Database
description: The Autism Chromosome Rearrangement Database is a collection of hand curated breakpoints and other genomic features, related to autism, taken from publicly available literature, databases and unpublished data.

name: Mutopia Project
description: The Mutopia Project is an online repository of free sheet music, offering thousands of music scores that are in the public domain or released under open licenses. It provides downloadable and editable sheet music in formats like PDF, MIDI, and LilyPond, making it easy to print, modify, perform, and share.

name: Cancer in Young People in Canada
description: The Cancer in Young People in Canada (CYP-C) surveillance program collects in-depth data concerning risk factors, health outcomes, quality and accessibility of care, and late effects among children and youth with cancer. CYP-C represents a collaboration involving the C17 Council, Canadian Partnerships Against Cancer (CPAC), Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC), provincial and territorial cancer registries, Statistics Canada and non-governmental organizations.

name: Yeast Phenome
description: Yeast Phenome aggregates and annotates all published screens of the yeast knock-out collection.

name: Database of Genomic Variants
description: The Database of Genomic Variants (DGV) is a publicly accessible, comprehensive curated catalogue of structural variation (SV) found in the genomes of control individuals from worldwide populations.

name: Historical Climate Data, Canada
description: The Historical Climate Data is an access point to historical weather, climate data, and related information for numerous locations across Canada. Temperature, precipitation, degree days, relative humidity, wind speed and direction, monthly summaries, averages, extremes and Climate Normals, are some of the information you will find on the site.

name: Canadian Wildland Fire Information System
description: The Large Fire Database (LFDB) is a compilation of forest fire data from all Canadian agencies, including provinces, territories, and Parks Canada. The data set includes only fires greater than 200 hectares in final size; these represent only a few percent of all fires but account for most of the area burned (usually more than 97%). Therefore, the LFDB can be used for spatial and temporal analyses of landscape-scale fire impacts.
tags: canadian forest fire weather index fwi

name: National Forestry Database
description: The principal role of the National Forestry Database (NFD) is to collect and compile national forest data and forest management statistics. The NFD serves as Canada’s credible, accurate, and reliable source of national information on forest management and its impact on the forest resource.

name: Concordia's Open Data
description: Technology has allowed Concordia to collect large amounts of data and information on a variety of topics, which the university feels should be accessible to all. Concordia’s open data makes machine-readable data easy to access from a single point and free to reuse without copyright, patents or other restrictions.

name: Biological General Repository for Interaction Datasets
description: The Biological General Repository for Interaction Datasets (BioGRID) is a public database that archives and disseminates genetic and protein interaction data from model organisms and humans. BioGRID currently holds over 1,740,000 interactions curated from both high-throughput datasets and individual focused studies, as derived from over 70,000+ publications in the primary literature. Complete coverage of the entire literature is maintained for budding yeast (S. cerevisiae), fission yeast (S. pombe) and thale cress (A. thaliana), and efforts to expand curation across multiple metazoan species are underway. All data are freely provided via our search index and available for download in many standardized formats.

name: Database of Religious History
description: The Database of Religious History (DRH), originally launched by the Cultural Evolution of Religion Research Consortium at the University of British Columbia, is now an independent global academic initiative. It serves as a centralized, expert-authored repository of standardized and qualitative data on the history of religions, integrating references, images, and analytical tools. It enables scholars and the public to explore, visualize, and verify historical patterns, compare scholarly perspectives, and document differing interpretations.

name: Bio-Analytic Resource for Plant Biology
description: Plant biology data visualization and web services covering gene expression and related large-scale datasets.

name: Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database
description: A bioinformatic database of antimicrobial resistance genes, their products and associated phenotypes.

name: NatureCounts
description: NatureCounts is an open data platform that collects and interprets biodiversity data, and makes those data available and accessible to inform research and conservation action. NatureCounts provides tools and features to: - Facilitate data collection by citizen science and research programs. - Integrate and streamline data from hundreds of projects into a single database.

name: Wildtrax
description: WildTrax is an online platform for storing, managing, and sharing environmental sensor Data. WildTrax was created through a partnership between the University of Alberta, Dr. Erin Bayne and the Bioacoustic Unit, the Alberta Biodiversity Monitoring Institute (ABMI), and Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC).

name: Cystic Fibrosis Mutation Database
description: The Cystic Fibrosis Mutation Database (CFTR1) is a genetic mutation database focused on the CFTR gene, which is linked to cystic fibrosis. It was established to collect and share information on individual gene sequence variants and mutations affecting CFTR and to support research and communication among scientists studying the disease.

name: ALEXA
description: ALEXA is a microarray design platform for 'alternative expression analysis'. This platform facilitates the design of expression arrays for analysis of mRNA isoforms generated from a single locus by the use of alternative transcription initiation, splicing and polyadenylation sites. We use the term 'ALEXA' to describe a collection of novel genomic methods for 'alternative expression' analysis.

name: Animal Genome Size Database
description: A comprehensive catalogue of animal genome size data where haploid DNA contents (C-values, in picograms) are currently available for 4972 species (3231 vertebrates and 1741 non-vertebrates) based on 6518 records from 669 published sources.

name: TheCellVision
description: The Cell Vision is a web-accessible scientific repository and visualization platform for high-content microscopy image data and associated quantitative results from large-scale cell screening experiments. It hosts hundreds of thousands of fluorescence microscopy images and analysis outputs, enabling users to explore, compare, and extract information about subcellular morphology, protein localization, and abundance in single cells.

name: CANUE Data Portal
description: CANUE (Canadian Urban Environmental Health Research Consortium) provides standardized, postal-code level environmental exposure data across Canada. The database includes air pollution, green and blue spaces, weather and climate, as well as urban and socioeconomic indicators. Its purpose is to link these data with health research to better understand how urban environments affect human health.

name: Androgen Receptor Mutations Database
description: Androgen Receptor Gene Mutations Database is for all who are interested in mutations of the Androgen Receptor Gene. In light of the difficulty in getting new AR mutations published the curator will now accept new mutations that have not been published, provided that it is from a reputable research or clinical laboratory.

name: Alberta Biodiversity Monitoring Institute Data and Tools
description: The ABMI Data & Tools provides open access to biodiversity and environmental data collected by the Alberta Biodiversity Monitoring Institute (ABMI) across the province of Alberta, Canada. It includes species and habitat raw data, mapping products, camera and acoustic records, and analytical tools for exploring and visualizing biodiversity information.

name: Canada's National Forest Inventory
description: The National Forest Inventory (NFI) is a collaborative effort involving federal, provincial and territorial government agencies. They monitor a network of twenty thousand sampling points across Canada on an ongoing basis to provide information on the state of Canada's forests and a continuous record of forest change. They provide data and products to forest science researchers, forest policy decision-makers and interested stakeholders.

name: Canadian Tides and Water Levels Data Archive
description: The Canadian tide and water level data archive presently holds water level observations reported from over a thousand stations, with the earliest dating back to 1848. The number of observations spans on average 6 years per station, with 60 stations measuring water levels for over 50 years.

name: Toxin and Toxin Target Database (T3DB)
description: Database of toxins, toxin targets, and toxic exposome chemistry.

name: SuperDARN Canada
description: The SuperDARN Canada database provides open access to data collected from five Canadian HF radars: Saskatoon, Clyde River, Inuvik, Rankin Inlet, and Prince George. It includes FITACF data that track ionospheric plasma motion, useful for studying space weather and solar‑terrestrial interactions. Users can explore data availability with a built-in inventory tool and download datasets directly using the provided interface.

name: DataStream
description: DataStream is an open data platform for sharing information about freshwater health. It allows users to access, visualize and download full water and sediment quality datasets published by communities, governments and researchers. It is accessible via its regional DataStream hubs.

name: CIS-BP
description: The Catalog of Inferred Sequence Binding Preferences (CIS-BP) is a library of transcription factor (TF) DNA binding motifs and specificities. The data are organized in a user friendly manner for ease of searching, browsing, and downloading. CIS-BP also includes built-in web tools for scanning DNA sequences for putative TF binding sites, predicting the DNA binding motif of a given TF, and identifying a TF that might recognize a given DNA motif.

name: The Federated Research Data Repository (FRDR)
description: A bilingual publishing platform for sharing and preserving Canadian research data. It is a curated, general-purpose repository, custom built for large datasets, supporting search, deposit, and access to research data collections.

name: Health Data Nova Scotia
description: Health Data Nova Scotia (HDNS), is a data repository based in the Faculty of Medicine's, Department of Community Health and Epidemiology at Dalhousie University, focused on supporting data driven research for a healthier Nova Scotia.
tags: health data of nova scotia residents

name: GeneMANIA
description: GeneMANIA is an online functional genomics database that helps researchers explore gene function by finding genes related to input gene lists based on large sets of functional association data like co-expression, protein interactions, pathways, and co-localization. The system integrates data from many publicly available biological datasets to predict gene function and visualize gene–gene relationships.

name: BacMap
description: BacMap is a picture atlas of annotated bacterial genomes. It is an interactive visual database containing hundreds of fully labeled, zoomable, and searchable maps of bacterial genomes.

name: Altalis
description: Altalis is a Canadian geospatial data repository and distribution platform specializing in spatial data, mapping products, and imagery for the province of Alberta. It provides access to a wide range of GIS datasets, including cadastral maps, topographic data, LiDAR, infrastructure information, and land-use records.

name: Data Access Support Hub
description: The Data Access Support Hub (DASH) is a one-stop data access service portal for researchers requiring multi-regional data in Canada. DASH services are provided by a multi-centre coordination team from various provincial/territorial data centres and pan-Canadian organizations, including the Canadian Institute for Health Information (CIHI) and Statistics Canada.

name: Gagnahlaðborðið
description: Reykjavík civic open-data dashboard (Gagnahlaðborðið) with data stories on schools, welfare, finance, sustainability, and city services. Distinct from the CKAN Gagnagátt catalog.

name: Statistics Iceland Research Database
description: Statistics Iceland metadata catalog for the research database of confidential microdata. Documents the population, income, children, migration, and education tables at variable level. Microdata are released only through a secure remote environment to approved research entities.

name: Hafro Data Server
description: Public CSV file repository of the Marine and Freshwater Research Institute with stock assessments, environmental series, and other marine research datasets.

name: Stjórnartíðindi
description: Official gazette of Iceland (Stjórnartíðindi), published on the island.is government portal.

name: Skipulagsvefsjá
description: National planning map viewer for approved regional, municipal, and local plans, including digital planning data for viewing and download. luk.skipulag.is serves the same Skipulagsvefsjá product.

name: Kortagluggi Íslands
description: National map viewer (Kortagluggi / Kortasjá) operated by Náttúrufræðistofnun. gis.is, kortasja.lmi.is, and atlas.lmi.is/kortasja redirect here. Harvestable OGC layers remain on the gis.is GeoServer.

name: Þjónustukort (Kortasjá Byggðastofnunar)
description: National service map (Þjónustukort / Kortasjá Byggðastofnunar) showing public and private service locations across Iceland. OpenLayers viewer operated by Byggðastofnun; the former GeoServer path is no longer published.

name: Skipulagsgátt
description: National planning portal (Skipulagsgátt) for planning cases, environmental impact assessment, and development permits, including case documents and public consultation.

name: UST environmental data API
description: Public API directory of Umhverfis- og orkustofnun with air-quality station JSON/CSV, consultation cases, municipal waste statistics, and Water Framework Directive measurements.

name: Loftgæði á Íslandi
description: Icelandic air-quality measurements from the national monitoring stations.

name: CLARIN-IS
description: National CLARIN-IS consortium website for Icelandic language resources, coordinated by the Árni Magnússon Institute for Icelandic Studies. Harvestable datasets are in the CLARIN-IS DSpace repository.

name: Global Terrestrial Network for Permafrost - Database
description: The Global Terrestrial Network for Permafrost (GTN-P) database stores borehole temperatures, active-layer thickness, and related essential climate variables for the pan-Arctic, Antarctic, and mountain permafrost regions. The programme secretariat is hosted with the Arctic Portal / CAFF in Iceland.

name: IMO EPOS Volcano Monitoring API
description: Icelandic Meteorological Office web services exposing volcano monitoring, seismic, GNSS, ash and gas forecast, and eruption catalogue data for the EPOS Volcano Observations thematic core service.

name: LibyaStat
description: Independent public explorer of Libyan macroeconomic, trade, oil, and exchange-rate indicators compiled from the Central Bank of Libya, the National Oil Corporation, and official trade sources.

name: Libya Spatial Data Portal
description: National spatial data catalog of the Libyan Spatial Data Infrastructure (LSDI / بوابة البيانات المكانية), operated by the General Information Authority. Leaflet catalog of geospatial metadata and map layers shared by Libyan public institutions. No public CSW or OGC API was reachable in August 2026.

name: Mapový portál města Ostravy
description: Public GIS map portal of the statutory city of Ostrava with thematic applications and WMS services.

name: Mapový portál Ústí nad Labem
description: Public map-application catalog of the statutory city of Ústí nad Labem, with WMS services.

name: Mapový portál města Kadaně
description: Public GIS portal of the town of Kadaň. Geoportal publishing public government datasets and services, managed by Město Kadaň.

name: Praha v číslech
description: Praha v číslech dashboards on Data Praha, with public charts and indicator pages on population, mobility, and city services. The city's open data catalogue is recorded separately as the LKOD catalog at lkod.cz.

name: Katalog indikátorů a metrik IPR Praha
description: Catalogue of Indicators and Metrics on the Prague Planning Analytical Materials (ÚAP) portal. Citywide time series with interactive charts and CSV export, used to track Prague strategy goals.

name: Digitální technická mapa Prahy a Středočeského kraje
description: Shared digital technical map portal for Prague and the Central Bohemian Region.

name: Geoportál Prahy 6
description: Public geoportal of Prague municipal district Praha 6 (cadastral units, territorial plan, municipal property, elections). Same product family as Geoportál Prahy 5.

name: Geoportal Prague
description: Open data catalog providing geographic, environmental, and urban planning data for Prague.

name: Geoportál Prahy 5
description: Public geoportal of Prague municipal district Praha 5.

name: Geoportál Prahy 13
description: Public geoportal of Prague municipal district Praha 13 (cadastral units, transport, schools, waste, elections). Same product family as Geoportál Prahy 5.

name: Otevřená data Plzeňského kraje
description: Public open-data catalog of Plzeňský kraj listing organisational, council, official-board, grants, heritage and meteorological datasets. Distinct from the GeoReal geoportal at geoportal.plzensky-kraj.cz and the DTM portal.

name: Databáze otevřených dat města Plzně
description: Open data portal of the City of Pilsen providing public access to datasets related to city operations and its organizations.

name: Mapový portál města Plzně
description: Public map portal of the statutory city of Plzeň.

name: Portál územního plánování Olomouckého kraje
description: Olomouc Region territorial-planning map portal (ÚAP/DMVS gateway) for spatial plans and analytical materials.

name: Mapy Olomouc
description: Public map portal of the statutory city of Olomouc.

name: Czech Statistical Office Public Database
description: Official online data catalog of the Czech Statistical Office (CZSO), a professional, independent, and expert institution in the Czech Republic.

name: Czech Statistical Office DataStat
description: DataStat data catalog of the Czech Statistical Office (CZSO), a professional, independent, and expert institution in the Czech Republic.

name: Czech Statistical Office Catalogue of Products
description: Official online data catalog of the Czech Statistical Office (CZSO), a professional, independent, and expert institution in the Czech Republic.

name: ČEPS Transmission System Data
description: Transmission-system statistics and charts published by the Czech electricity TSO.

name: Onemocnění aktuálně
description: Ministry of Health dashboard of current infectious-disease indicators for Czechia, including COVID-19 regional overviews and related time series.

name: OTE Market Statistics
description: Czech electricity and gas market statistics published by the market operator OTE.

name: CNB ARAD Time Series System
description: ARAD public time-series database of the Czech National Bank. Hierarchical indicators and prepared reports cover monetary, financial-market, and macroeconomic statistics compiled by the CNB.

name: SVOD Epidemiology of malignant neoplasms in Czechia
description: Public cancer epidemiology portal for Czechia (SVOD). Interactive tables and charts of incidence, mortality, prevalence, and survival from the Czech National Cancer Registry, with open data and summary downloads.

name: Katalog zdravotnických dat NZIS Open
description: NZIS Open catalogue of health data outputs from the National Health Information System, including open datasets, statistical summaries, infographics, and interactive visualizations. Distinct from the Ministry of Health CKAN open data record at opendata.mzcr.cz.

name: volby.gov.cz Election results
description: Official election results portal of the Czech Statistical Office, with tables and machine-readable results for presidential, parliamentary, regional, municipal, and European Parliament elections.

name: Czech Statistical Office Database of National Accounts
description: Czech Statistical Office Database of National Accounts

name: Czech National Traffic Information Registry
description: Czech National Access Point metadata registry. Documents NeTEx EPIP timetable sources and DATEX II road-traffic feeds.

name: Otevřená data Ministerstva vnitra
description: Open-data catalog of the Ministry of the Interior publishing datasets of the ministry, the Police of the Czech Republic and the Fire Rescue Service.

name: e-Sbírka
description: Electronic Collection of Laws of the Czech Republic, the official catalog of promulgated legislation that replaced the paper Sbírka zákonů.

name: Otevřená data o exekucích
description: Open data catalog of the Chamber of Bailiffs of the Czech Republic, publishing municipal and bailiff-level execution statistics as CSV/JSON with a DCAT-AP JSON-LD catalog file.

name: Katalog otevřených dat České školní inspekce
description: Open data catalog of the Czech School Inspectorate (Česká školní inspekce). Publishes inspection reports, school questionnaires, classroom observation records, and related education datasets as CSV, JSON, and XML, harvested by the national open data catalog.

name: Integrovaný registr znečišťování
description: Czech integrated pollution register. Public search of facility releases and transfers reported under the national IRZ and E-PRTR.

name: Otevřená data Ministerstva obrany
description: Open data listing of the Ministry of Defence of the Czech Republic. https://opendata.army.cz redirects to the ministry's published datasets page. The former data.army.cz hostname no longer resolves.

name: Open data of the Ministry of Regional Development
description: Open data of the Ministry of Regional Development of the Czech Republic. The former data.mmr.cz CKAN catalog now redirects to the ministry's datasets in the National Open Data Catalog (NKOD).

name: National Open Data Portal
description: National Open Data Portal - Portál o datech České republiky. Publishes datasets from various organizations in Czechia.

name: MONITOR Státní pokladny katalog
description: Data from the State treasury MONITOR application. Budget and accounting information from all levels of central and local government, including master data code lists and transactional datasets.

name: Open data of the Ministry of Finance
description: Data Catalog provides access to transactional data and code lists in csv and xml formats for third-party systems.

name: ČHMÚ Open Data Server
description: Czech Hydrometeorological Institute bulk open-data server for weather radar volumes and composites (ODIM HDF5), ALADIN NWP GRIB, satellite, radiosonde, and forecast products.

name: Opendata katalog Českého rozhlasu
description: Provisional open-data catalog of Český rozhlas / iROZHLAS listing broadcast-schedule and playlist APIs and related datasets; harvested by NKOD. Distinct from the national catalog at data.gov.cz.

name: Czech Statistical Office GIS Data Portal
description: A platform for sharing geographically oriented statistical data, analytical outputs and services

name: Geoportál ŘSD
description: Public geoportal of Ředitelství silnic a dálnic with map applications for the Czech road and motorway network, TEN-T corridors, rest areas and construction history, plus an unauthenticated ArcGIS Server REST catalog (48 MapServers).

name: Geoportál SOWAC-GIS
description: VÚMOP SOWAC-GIS geoportal for soil, water and landscape protection maps and WMS. Distinct from the Micka metadata catalogue at metadata.vumop.cz.

name: ČÚZK ATOM Download Services
description: INSPIRE ATOM download services of the Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre (ČÚZK). Provides pre-packaged geospatial datasets for cadastre, RÚIAN, and INSPIRE themes, with OpenSearch discovery.

name: Geoportál ČÚZK
description: Official geoportal of the Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre (ČÚZK). Provides access to cadastral maps, topographic datasets (ZABAGED), orthophoto, elevation models, INSPIRE view and download services, and open geospatial data, with an OGC CSW metadata catalogue.

name: National Metadata Directory
description: The National Metadata Directory (NMD) is a central aggregator of metadata for scientific datasets in the Czech Republic. The NMD collects metadata from all repositories within the National Repository Platform and from other repositories containing datasets created by the Czech academic community. It serves as the primary discovery point across repositories and directs users to the primary repositories where the datasets reside.

name: Czech National Corpus
description: Portal and catalog of the Czech National Corpus, providing access to synchronic, historical, and parallel corpora of Czech.

name: ValidatorDB
description: ValidatorDB is a collection of validation results for the entire Protein Data Bank. Annotation (3-letter code) of HET residues larger than 6 heavy atoms is inspected, i.e. if the residue has the same topology and stereochemistry as the model ligand or residue stored in the wwCCD. Validation reports for the entire database can be inspected as well as for the arbitrary set of PDB entries or PDB annotations (3-letter residue code). Results are available in graphical form via Web UI and can be downloaded in the form of CSV files for further inspection.

name: Map collection Charles University Faculty of Science
description: The Map Collection at the Faculty of Science CU (formerly the State Map Collection) belongs to one of the most extensive university map collections in Central and East Europe. The map collection is digitized as part of the Czech Ministry of Culture's project NAKI.

name: Integrated Database of Small Molecules
description: IDSM is an integrated database of small molecules that aggregates many different sources of information about small molecules into a single, logically coherent and semantically interconnected information source.

name: Database Of Local Biomolecular Conformers
description: Dolbico, the Database Of Local Biomolecular Conformers, stores DNA structural data including the information about DNA local spatial arrangement. The main aim of Dolbico is the exploration of DNA structure at a local level. The analysis of local DNA structure is based on a classification system that uses 9 torsional angles (7 backbone angles and two glycosidic torsions) to categorize dinucleotides into several distinct conformational families. The implemented classification workflow is able not only to classify dinucleotides into already existing classes, but is also able to discover new classes in new solved DNA structures.

name: ASEP Repository
description: Institutional repository of the Czech Academy of Sciences for bibliographic records, full texts, and research datasets.

name: ChannelsDB 2.0
description: ChannelsDB is a comprehensive and regularly updated resource of channels, pores and tunnels found in biomacromolecules deposited in the Protein Data Bank. The database contains information about channel positions, geometry and physicochemical properties.

name: Human Endogenous Retrovirus database
description: This database is compiled from the human genome nucleotide sequences obtained mostly in the Human Genome Projects. The database makes it possible to continuously improve classification and characterization of retroviral families. The HERV database now contains retroviruses from more than 90 % of the human genome.

name: GlobalFungi
description: GlobalFungi is a collection and validation of data published on the composition of fungal communities in terrestrial environments including soil and plant-associated habitats. Users can search for individual sequences, fungal species hypotheses, species or genera, to get a visual representation of their distribution in the environment and to access and download sequence data and metadata. In addition, the user interface also allows authors to submit data from studies not yet covered and in this way to help to build the resource for the community of researchers in systematics, biogeography, and ecology of fungi.

name: IRESite
description: The IRESite database presents information about experimentally studied IRES (Internal Ribosome Entry Site) segments. IRES regions are known to attract the eukaryotic ribosomal translation initiation complex and thus promote translation initiation independently of the presence of the commonly utilized 5'-terminal 7mG cap structure.

name: Ancient mtDNA database
description: This is the place where you can find an updated list of the published mitochondrial sequences coming from the ancient DNA samples (aDNA). The main interest of our database lies in the anatomically modern Homo sapiens samples, ranging from the late Paleolithic to roughly Iron Age times, focusing on an Euroasian geographical area. We provide both the mtDNA sequences (in FASTA format), and the metadata for the samples (ID, date, geolocation, site, culture, mtDNA haplogroup, etc.), available to download in a comma-separated (CSV) text file.

name: European Chemical Biology Database
description: The European Chemical Biology Database (ECBD) collects experimental results from biological screening programs performed within the EU-OPENSCREEN platform. There are 3 chemical libraries in ECBD: bioactive, diverse, and academic. The bioactive library contains compounds selected with a strong emphasis on target coverage and selectivity. The diverse library contains compounds with unbiased chemical diversity, designed by five academic computational chemistry groups. In the academic library, compounds are collected from European chemists.

name: Hepatitis C Virus Ires Variation Database
description: HCVIVdb is a database of published variations observed within the internal ribosome entry site (IRES) of the hepatitis C Virus.

name: Educational and Research Picture Archiving and Communication System
description: The core of the system is tailored PACS (Picture Archiving and Communication System). It forms the basis for educational and research applications such as the development of databases of case studies describing the treatment of real patients. Images appropriate for teaching or research purposes are made anonymous. This database is in Czech and has restricted access.

name: MolMeDB: Molecules on Membranes Database
description: MolMeDB is an open chemistry database concerning the interaction of molecules with membranes.

name: Czech Social Science Data Archive
description: The Czech Social Science Data Archive (CSDA) is a national data services center for the social sciences, which acquires, processes, documents, and stores digital data files from scientific projects and makes them available for further analytical use in scientific research and teaching at universities.

name: Swiss-Czech Proteomics Server
description: Proteomics database of time-series protein expression for Streptomyces, Caulobacter and Neisseria, hosted by the Institute of Microbiology of the Czech Academy of Sciences. Historically referred to as the Swiss-Czech Proteomics Server.

name: Mutational data for protein stability
description:
FireProtDB is a comprehensive, manually curated database of the protein stability data for single-point mutants.
Proteins find their use in numerous biomedical and biotechnological applications. Naturally occurring proteins usually cannot withstand harsh industrial environments since they have evolved to function under mild conditions. Increasing protein stability is one of the key determinants of protein applicability. The predictive power of the current computational tools is compromised by the limited experimental data that would allow a rigorous training and testing.
This database combines the published datasets from ProTherm and ProtaBank, the data extracted from the recent literature, and the measurements collected in our laboratory. The annotations were obtained from VariBench and HotSpot Wizard. The graphical user interface is designed to facilitate both types of the expected use: (i) the interactive explorations of individual entries on the level of a protein or a mutation and (ii) the construction of highly customized, machine learning-friendly datasets using advanced searching and filtering.

name: Atlases - Pathology images
description: A collection of high resolution histological images from contributors across the Czech Republic.

name: ASEP Repository
description: The ASEP Data Repository is an institutional multidisciplinary on-line repository that stores scientific outputs - bibliographic records, full texts and datasets of the institutional authors from The Czech Academy of Sciences. The repository is hosted by Library of the Czech Academy of Sciences. Data that are stored in database are accessible in the on-line catalogue. Each dataset has its own description and metadata according to international standards.

name: rPredictor
description: rPredictorDB is a predictive database of secondary structures of individual RNAs and their formatted plots.

name: Archives of programs and data for physics
description: These archives contain public domain programs for calculations in physics and other programs that we suppose about will help during work with computer. Physical constants and experimental or theoretical data as cross sections, rate constants, swarm parameters, etc., that are necessary for physical calculations are stored here, too. Programs are mainly dedicated to computers compatible with PC IBM.

description: Cartographic encyclopedia and map catalog developed by the MIIGAiK Center for Thematic Cartography with Moscow State University and the Institute of Geography RAS, supported by the Russian Geographical Society. Provides regional, thematic and historical map records and explanatory geographic texts. Map assets remain publicly accessible, but the sampled map viewers embed legacy Flash (SWF) files and do not provide a modern browser-native viewing experience.

description: Public thematic atlas of the Caspian Sea and surrounding countries, published by the MSU Faculty of Geography with Russian Geographical Society support. name: ГИС Арктика
