name: Экологические риски бассейна реки Оки
description: Public environmental map of the Oka River basin developed by MIIGAiK. Thematic layers cover watersheds, landscapes, forest change, protected areas, pollution sources, climate, environmental risks and aerial surveys. The map is embedded from kartfak.ru/development/oka/.

name: Картографический атлас «Дельты рек озера Байкал»
description: Public cartographic atlas of river deltas around Lake Baikal, created by the Baikal Institute of Nature Management SB RAS with the Institute of System Dynamics and Control Theory SB RAS. Publishes GIS projects and vector-layer archives, topographic maps, Landsat imagery and terrain illustrations for individual deltas. The atlas was produced through a 2009–2011 research project; the public site retains its historical research materials.

name: PastVu
description: Collaborative archive of georeferenced historical photographs and paintings with a map interface, gallery, dates and descriptive metadata.

name: Интерактивные карты ИГКЭ

name: Открытые данные Авиалесоохраны
description: Public map and data service for forest fires, satellite monitoring, weather anomalies and forecasts in Russia.

name: Геопортал геолого-геофизических работ на озере Байкал

Maps sediment-core sampling locations, seismic survey lines and lake-floor structures. Sampling records include dates, sampler types, depth and hydrate indicators, with public date and sampler filters.

Publishes chronologically organized geographic objects for ancient states and polities, archaeological cultures and sites, settlements and ethnogeographic areas, linked to encyclopedia articles. The project covers ancient societies worldwide; mas97.ru provides the associated encyclopedia and project information.

name: Геопортал Русского географического общества

Provides filters by water area, region, plot status, identifier and area, with a legend for permitted zones, buffers and plot lifecycle stages. Viewing the map is public; plot applications and auction participation require separate authenticated services.

name: Каталог ледников России
description: Russian glacier catalog organized by glacier region, with mapped glacier outlines, morphology, area and historical inventory comparisons. Provides downloadable shapefiles for the catalog and individual regions.

name: Ретромап
description: Searchable archive of historical maps and aerial imagery with georeferenced map viewing, spatial search and comparison of maps from different years.

The restoration notice dates the archived content to May 2024; information is not being updated and some sections are disabled. Formerly hosted at oopt.aari.ru.

Provides a sheet index, individual records with nomenclature and map images, and information on geometric correction and historical land-use analysis. The site lists 100 sheets; some further materials are supplied by contacting the authors.

name: Unified State Register of Soil Resources of Russia (EGRPR)

description: World Data Center B for Oceanography at RIHMI-WDC in Obninsk. Publishes physical and chemical ocean datasets from cruises (1900–2015), TESAC/GLOSS products, and regional seas collections. Distinct from the Meteorology WDC on the same host.

name: SPECTR-W3
description: SPECTR-W3 provides experimental, theoretical, and compiled data on the spectroscopic properties of atoms and ions. It contains information such as ionization potentials, energy levels, spectral lines, transition probabilities, oscillator strengths, and collisional cross-sections, all extracted from published scientific literature and contributions from researchers. The database is widely used in atomic physics, plasma spectroscopy, and related fields, and is one of the largest repositories of spectroscopic data for highly charged ions.

name: KVERT Catalog of Active Volcanoes
description: KVERT catalog of active volcanoes of Kamchatka and the Kuril Islands, with aviation color codes, activity summaries, and per-volcano pages from the Institute of Volcanology and Seismology FEB RAS.

name: Fungal Diversity in Culture collections
description: FungalDC (Fungal Diversity in Culture Collections) connects tree blocks of information on each fungal species presented: 1. genetic information for this species from GenBank, 2. taxonomic information from Index Fungorum and MycoBank, 3. contact information of each microbial culture collection (in WDCM/CCINFO) that keeps this species' strains.

name: Baikal Branch Earthquake Catalog (GS RAS)
description: Public main earthquake catalog of the Baikal branch of GS RAS (events with energy class K≥11), with query by date, coordinates, and class, plus recent events and epicenter maps.

name: World Radiation Data Centre
description: The World Radiation Data Centre (WRDC) is one of six World Data Centres which are part of the Global Atmosphere Watch (GAW) programme of the World Meteorological Organization. The WRDC centrally collects and archives radiometric data from the world to ensure the availability of these data for research by the international scientific community.

name: IZMIRAN Observation Data, Models and Forecasts
description: IZMIRAN public hub of ionospheric, geomagnetic, cosmic-ray, solar-radio, and space-weather observation datasets, models, and forecasts.

description: Public inventory of satellite-data archives of IKI-Monitoring (IKI RAS), listing instruments, date ranges, and volumes. Online analysis runs through Vega-Science and requires an account.

description: World Data Center for Solid Earth Physics, Moscow. Collects and distributes seismology, gravimetry, heat-flow, and geomagnetic datasets. Distinct from the Solar-Terrestrial Physics WDC on the same host.

name: SAO RAS OASIS Observation Archive
description: OASIS general observation archive of the Special Astrophysical Observatory of RAS. Public search of telescope instrument collections (images and spectra) by date, coordinates, and object.

The information basis of the Centre is updated on regular basis from various sources including the bilateral data exchange with the World Data Centre for Meteorology in Ashville, North Carolina, USA

name: Пулковский каталог солнечной деятельности
description: Solar-activity database with downloadable historical sunspot and Wolf-number series, activity-feature catalogs, synoptic maps and data-format documentation.

name: World Data Center for Solar-Terrestrial Physics, Moscow
description: World Data Center for Solar-Terrestrial Physics in Moscow, archiving and distributing solar-terrestrial physics observations.

name: VDJdb: a curated database of T-cell receptors with known antigen specificity
description: The primary goal of VDJdb is to facilitate access to existing information on T-cell receptor antigen specificities, i.e. the ability to recognize certain epitopes in certain MHC contexts. Our mission is to both aggregate the scarce TCR specificity information available so far and to create a curated repository to store such data. In addition to routine database updates providing the most up-to-date information, we make our best to ensure data consistency and fight irregularities in TCR specificity reporting with a complex database validation scheme.

name: WWW-MINCRYST

name: Carbohydrate Structure Database

Zelinsky Institute of Organic Chemistry of the Russian Academy of Sciences in Moscow. Bacterial and plant/fungal collections were merged into CSDB in 2015.

name: Kamchatka Earthquake Catalog (EIS SD, GS RAS)
description: Unified seismological information system of the Kamchatka branch of GS RAS. Public query of the Kamchatka and Commander Islands earthquake catalog (1962–present), stations, and maps; some extra fields require an account.

name: SIMuRG GNSS Ionosphere Data System (ISTP SB RAS)
description: SIMuRG (System for Ionosphere Monitoring and Research from GNSS) of ISTP SB RAS. Public GNSS TEC products including maps, time series, disturbance indices, and a station/database query interface.

name: Russian Arctic Vegetation Archive (AVA-RU)

name: Russian-Ukrainian Geomagnetic Data Center

The MAGNUS hardware-software system underlies the operation of the Center.

name: Centre for Astronomical Data of the Institute of Astronomy of the Russian Academy of Sciences
description: CAD INASAN was established in 1980 as a branch regional center of the Centre de Donnes Stellaire (CDS). Since that time, the CAD has been working to distribute, create and store astronomical data according to the requirements of time, specifics of techniques and requests of the Russian astronomical community.

name: SeaDataNet European Directory of the Cruise Summary Reports (CSR)
description: SeaDataNet is a pan-European distributed marine data infrastructure for the management, exchange and re-use of marine and oceanographic data sets and collections. A major objective and challenge in SeaDataNet is to promote discoverability of these data resources in a consistent and comprehensive manner. This is achieved through the SeaDataNet metadata services a set of directories, with associated user interfaces and web services, each governed by a SeaDataNet partner and content provided through national SeaDataNet collating nodes. The European Directory of Cruise Summary Reports (CSR) is the SeaDataNet catalogue promoting discoverability of, and access to, reports of the research oceanographic cruises operated by European countries. CSR utilises a metadata format based upon the ISO 19119 content model. The CSR Schema and XML coding are supported by URLs and URNs to the SeaDataNet Common Vocabularies.Find an existing cruise, see if cruises exist in your area of interestChief scientists of Research cruises, Oceanographers, researchers, ship owners, public authorities.

description: The WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (ICTRP) registry platform and clinical trial Search Portal aims to provide a single point of access to information about ongoing and completed clinical trials to ensure that a complete view of research is accessible to all those involved in health care decision making. Global health and scientific community access is provided through a centralized database system containing primary clinical trial registrations from primary data providers in the WHO Registry Network in facilitating unambiguous identification of clinical trials and links to full original study records. In May 2022, the Seventy-fifth World Health Assembly adopted a resolution (WHA75.8) on “Strengthening clinical trials to provide high-quality evidence on health interventions and to improve research quality and coordination”. The WHO secretariat has developed this webpage in order to provide a single point of access for information and resources of relevance to resolution WHA 75.8. This includes initiatives and guidances highlighted to WHO as part of the public consultation held related to WHA 75.8 in October and November 2022. It also provides a uniform interface for the scientific and industrial communities to access the comprehensive microbial resource information.

name: OECD/AIAS ICTWSS Database
description: Institutional Characteristics of Trade Unions, Wage Setting, State Intervention and Social Pacts database, maintained with the University of Amsterdam AIAS-HSI and published by the OECD.

name: Banned Books — International Catalogue of Censored Literature
description: Open catalogue documenting book bans and challenges worldwide, with sources and a CC-BY dataset deposit.

name: CellFinder
description: CellFinder maps validated gene and protein expression, phenotype and images related to cell types.The data allow characterization and comparison of cell types and can be browsed by using the body browser and by searching for cells or genes. All cells are related to more complex systems such as tissues, organs and organisms and arranged according to their position in development. CellFinder provides long-term data storage for validated and curated primary research data and provides additional expert-validation through relevant information extracted from text.

name: AlgaeBase
description: AlgaeBase is a global algal database of taxonomic, nomenclatural and distributional information. It contains information on algae that includes terrestrial, marine and freshwater organisms. For the convenience of marine botanists, we have included the sea-grasses (about 100 species), even though they are flowering plants.

name: Selective Targets database
description: The Selective Targets database (SelTarbase ) is a curated database of public MNR mutation data in microsatellite unstable human tumors. A comprehensive database of all human coding, untranslated, non-coding RNA- and intronic MNRs (MNR_ensembl) is also included.

name: Open Connectome Project
description: Open Connectome Project: Reverse Engineering the Brain One Synapse at a Time

name: Cell Signaling Technology Pathway Database
description: A small pathway portal for showcasing Cell Signaling Technology phospho-antibody products. Contains pathway diagrams that are clickable and link to more information about each protein and the commercial products that are available for that protein.

name: Pathoplexus
description:
Pathoplexus is an open-source database designed to enhance the sharing and analysis of human viral pathogen genomic data. Developed in response to the growing need for specialized viral databases, Pathoplexus aims to offer the features needed for the research community to share and explore datasets for viruses of public health importance. By leveraging new open-source software, Pathoplexus provides a robust and user-friendly platform for scientists and public health professionals.

One of the key features of Pathoplexus is its flexible data sharing options. Users can choose to share their data openly or with time-limited protections to ensure proper attribution and safeguard their contributions. After a specified period, all data becomes openly accessible through INSDC-member databases. Data on Pathoplexus consists of both data directly submitted to Pathoplexus (which users can choose to keep protected for a period of time, or make open straight away) and data from INSDC-member databases.

name: International Space Environment Service
description: International Space Environment Service (ISES) coordinates operational space weather data, forecasts, and alerts among regional warning centres worldwide.

name: MultiCellular DataBase
description: A database for storing MultiCellDS files. In the future, MultiCellDB will include a curated library of quality-controlled digital cell lines, starting with digital representations of breast cancer (MCF7, MCF10A, MDA-MB-231), lung cancer (HCC827, H1975), and metastatic colon cancer (HCT-116 and patient-derived lines) cell lines. The user interface and API are under active development.

name: BIPM Key Comparison Database (KCDB)
description: Scientific data repository. managed by International Bureau of Weights and Measures. powered by Custom software. accessible at kcdb.bipm.org.

name: Global Carbon Budget Data Hub
description: Annual global carbon budget datasets on fossil emissions and natural sinks.

name: OmicsDB
description: OmicsDB offers an integrated platform for studying biological networks in multiple organisms, as well as accessing gene expression data. By expanding the classic single species databases across species, it is possible to leverage the amount of information to an even higher level. Its main goal is to enable researchers to find omics data as well as biological networks (Coexpression, PPI etc). One of the main ideas has been to cover non-model species (Fungal plant pathogens, Sorghum, Cassava etc), to allow researchers in these fields similar oppertunities as researchers in more developed fields (Like Arabidopsis or Yeast).

name: SeaDataNet Data Products catalogue
description:
SeaDataNet provides different types of data products from its database: 
•	harmonised and quality controlled aggregated datasets (ODV collections of all SeaDataNet measurements of temperature and salinity by sea basins) 
•	derived climatologies (regional gridded field products based on the aggregated datasets) 
Both types of data products are created for all the European sea basins, namely: Arctic Ocean, Baltic Sea, Black Sea, Mediterranean Sea, North Atlantic, and North Sea.

The aggregated datasets are provided as ODV (https://www.seadatanet.org/Software/ODV)  data collections, while the climatology gridded fields are provided in NetCDF files.

Each SeaDataCloud product is described in a Product Information Document (PIDoc) that can be accessed from the product’s landing page. Product PIDoc contains detailed information about the product: the data source, statistics on spatial and temporal data coverage, information about quality procedures, applied methods and tools used, comparison with previous versions, information about validation procedures and so on.

Example of DOI (landing page) : https://doi.org/10.12770/2a2aa0c5-4054-4a62-a18b-3835b304fe64
Example of PIDoc : https://archimer.ifremer.fr/doc/00658/77059/

name: Dateno
description:
Dateno is a next-generation dataset search engine that provides fast, comprehensive access to open datasets worldwide. Our mission is to make data discovery and integration as seamless as possible for researchers, analysts, developers, journalists, and anyone else working with data.

Our Vision

We believe that access to data should be easy and efficient. By creating a powerful search engine specifically for datasets, we aim to accelerate research, innovation, and data-driven decision-making across various fields.
What Sets Us Apart

    Speed: We've optimized our search functionality to deliver results as quickly as possible using Meilisearch.
    Comprehensive Filtering: Our advanced filtering system allows users to narrow down results by various parameters, making it easier to find exactly what you need.
    API-First Architecture: We're building Dateno with API access in mind, allowing for seamless integration into your workflows and applications.
    Extensive Index: Our constantly growing index includes millions of records from thousands of data catalogs worldwide.
    Data Preservation: We're committed to archiving datasets that are at risk of disappearing, ensuring valuable data remains accessible.

How It Works
Dateno is built on the Dateno registry of data catalogs. We crawl various types of data sources, including:

- Open data portals
- Geoservers/geoportals
- Scientific data repositories
- Microdata catalogs
- Databases of indicators

We use common APIs and export formats like DCAT, CKAN API, CSW, WFS, WMS, and ArcGIS Rest API to gather data. After crawling, we enrich the data and convert it to a unified structure similar to DCAT, creating a single search index.

name: ODINWESTPAC Data Service
description: ODINWESTPAC data service of the IOC/IODE Ocean Data and Information Network for the Western Pacific.

name: American Type Culture Collection database
description: ATCC authenticates microorganisms and cell lines and manages logistics of long-term preservation and distribution of cultures for the scientific community. ATCC supports the cultures it acquires and authenticates with expert technical support, intellectual property management and characterization data.

name: ICAC World Cotton Database
description: The ICAC World Cotton Database is an interactive platform offering comprehensive statistics on cotton supply and use by country and region, covering seasons from 1920/21 to the present.

name: AD Data Initiative Repository
description: The AD Data Initiative Repository enables sharing of human or human-derived Alzheimer’s and related dementia data. Some of the platform’s key features are it is available to data contributors at no cost; is secure with clearly outlined privacy policies and terms of use; allows for configurable data access and data request forms with flexible data sharing options and visibility into data usage via audit trail.

name: ATCC Genome Portal
description: Database and knowledgebase of authenticated microbial genomics data with full data provenance to physical materials held within American Type Culture Collection's (ATCC) biorepository and culture collections. Data includes whole genome sequencing data for bacterial, viral and fungal strains at ATCC, their genome assemblies, metadata, drug susceptibility data, and more. All data is freely available for non-commercial research use only (RUO) applications via the web portal interface or via a REST-API. The goal is to provide the research community with provenance information and authentication between the biological source materials and reference genome assemblies derived from them.

name: Marine Data Viewer displaying in-situ measurements of essential ocean variables co-located with model and satellite products
description:
The Marine Data Viewer uses information from in-situ and satellite observations as well as model products to provide the user with the possibility to observe the marine environment. The user interface of the map viewer is designed for (citizen) scientists and allows for interaction with large data collections by geographical area and using sliders for date, time and depth. 

The in-situ values are provided by SeaDataNet and Euro-Argo and are co-located with product layers from Copernicus Marine, based upon modelling and satellite data.

name: SECURE-Cirrhosis Registry
description: SECURE-Cirrhosis Registry is a secure, online, de-identified Personal Health Identifier (PHI)-free reporting registry for patients with chronic liver disease and post-liver transplantation

name: GOOS BioEco Portal
description: GOOS BioEco metadata portal for biological and ecological Essential Ocean Variable observing programmes.

name: International Aid Transparency Initiative Data
description: The International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) provides a global open data standard and infrastructure for publishing and accessing data on development and humanitarian activities. It enables governments, NGOs, and donor organisations to publish structured, machine-readable data about their projects, budgets, transactions, and results. These data are stored in a central registry and made openly accessible for download and analysis.

name: The Lens Scholarly and Patent Knowledge
description: The Lens is building an interactive tool for understanding the landscape of patent and research works in any domain, including human coronaviruses and COVID-19.

name: IIASA Energy Data
description: Scientific data repository. managed by International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis. powered by Custom software. accessible at data.ene.iiasa.ac.at.

name: International COVID-19 Data Alliance
description: Convened by Health Data Research UK, the national institute for health data in the UK, ICODA was an open and inclusive global collaboration of leading life science, philanthropic and research organisations that came together to harness the power of health data to respond to the COVID-19 pandemic. Building on the ICODA programme, HDR UK has now convened the HDR Global programme which seeks to assist with data science skills and enable trustworthy data access, re-use and analysis in regions, communities and disease areas, where evidence to tackle threats to public health is lacking

name: Accelerating Medicines Partnership in Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal
description: The Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal (CMDKP) aggregates and analyzes genetic association results, epigenomic annotations, and results of computational prediction methods to provide data, visualizations, and tools in an open-access portal. The aim of the CMDKP is to facilitate research on the molecular basis of complex diseases, including type 1 and type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular disease, and sleep disorders.

name: Monarch Initiative
description: The Monarch Initiative is an integrative data and analytic platform connecting phenotypes to genotypes across species, bridging basic and applied research with semantics-based analysis. The correlation of phenotypic outcomes and disease with genetic variation and environmental factors is a core pursuit in biology and biomedicine. We have created or currently contribute to many essential bio-ontologies that together enable sophisticated and semantically integrated computational analysis across gene, genotype, variant, disease, and phenotype data. We have developed algorithms and tools that are in use by multiple communities for tasks including the identification of animal models of human disease through phenotypic similarity, phenotype-driven computational support for differential diagnostics, and translational research.

name: Comparative Agendas Project
description: The Comparative Agendas Project (CAP) is an open research database that compiles and codes government policy activity data from countries around the world using one consistent classification system. Researchers, students, and policymakers can use it to analyze trends in policy-making over time and compare how different governments respond to issues. It covers a wide range of topics across decades and lets users download datasets for deeper analysis.

name: Phenotype KnowledgeBase
description: The Phenotype Knowledgebase website, PheKB, is a collaborative environment to building and validating electronic algorithms to identify characteristics of patients within health data.

name: Virtual Metabolic Human
description: The Virtual Metabolic Human (VMH) database captures information on human and gut microbial metabolism, linking to information from hundreds of diseases and nutritional data-related resources (5,607 unique metabolites, 19,313 unique reactions, 3,695 human genes, 255 Mendelian diseases, 818 microbe reconstructions, 632, 685 microbial genes, and 8,790 food items as of 2022-09-19). VMH also contains manually curated genome-scale metabolic reconstructions, which have been assembled based on genomic, biochemical, and physiological data. The VMH helps to facilitate rapid analyses and interpretations of complex biological data arising from large-scaled biomedical studies for enabling complex queries and detailed graphical representations of human metabolism (distributing computational models for simulating human and microbial metabolism).

name: GeoNames
description: GeoNames integrates geographical data such as names of places in various languages, elevation, population and others from various sources. Users may manually edit, correct and add new names using a user friendly wiki interface.

name: Global Dam Watch Database
description: Harmonized global database of river barriers and reservoirs, integrating GRanD, GOODD, FHReD, and related dam datasets.

name: SenNet Consortium
description: The goal of the Cellular Senescence Network (SenNet) is to identify and functionally characterize the heterogeneity of senescent cells across multiple tissues in human health, and lifespan at single-cell resolution.

name: DOMMINO: A comprehensive database of macromolecular interactions
description: Database of MacroMolecular INteractions, a resource for macromolecular interactions.

name: Database of Places, Language, Culture, and Environment
description: The Database of Places, Language, Culture, and Environment (D-PLACE) is an expandable, open-access databases that aims to describe the dispersed corpus of information describing human cultural diversity. Its goal is to make it easy for individuals to contrast their own cultural practices with those of other societies, and to consider the factors that may underlie cultural similarities and differences. D-PLACE contains cultural, linguistic, environmental and geographic information 'societies', which are groups of people in a particular locality who often share a language and cultural identity. All cultural descriptions are tagged with the date to which they refer and with the ethnographic sources that provided the descriptions. The majority of the cultural descriptions in D-PLACE are based on ethnographic work carried out in the 19th and early-20th centuries (pre-1950). D-PLACE lets you visualize cross-cultural data in three ways: as a list in a table, on a global map, or on a linguistic tree (i.e., phylogeny or classification). Data points (i.e., rows in the table, points on the map, points on the tree) represent the expression of a particular cultural feature by a particular society at a given time and place, as recorded by the Source. Data points are colour-coded to allow you to quickly assess the diversity of a cultural feature across societies in the table, map, or linguistic tree.

name: Poxvirus Bioinformatics Resource Center
description: Poxvirus Bioinformatics Resource Center has been established to provide specialized web-based resources to the scientific community studying poxviruses. This resource is no longer being maintained. For tools and data supporting virus genomics, especially related to poxviruses and other large DNA viruses, please visit the Viral Bioinformatics site maintained by our collaborator, Chris Upton: http://virology.ca For information on virus taxonomy, please visit the ICTV web site at http://www.ictvonline.org/ For updated sequence data and analytical tools, please visit http://www.viprbrc.org

name: The Atlas of Small Chiral Polytopes
description: This atlas contains information about all chiral polytopes whose regular covers have automorphism group of order at most 2000, and not 1024 or 1536.

name: iSpyBio
description: iSpyBio is an intelligent and unbiased search engine for Life scientists. It ranks reagents by the number of data such as publications, reviews, characterization images and tested applications. It displays over 500,000 reagents such as antibodies, proteins, ELISA kits and biomolecules. iSpyBio’s proprietary search algorithm is unique and rapidly analyzes the end-users search query against its large database. Powerful filters allow the user to enhance the search results, for example if they want a protein expressed in yeast or an antibody that only works in mouse. As iSpyBio syncs with supplier and other public databases, it is always up-to-date. This allows iSpyBio to exclude out of stock items but show the most recent testing results and peer-reviewed publications.

name: Type 2 Diabetes Knowledge Portal
description: The Type 2 Diabetes Knowledge Portal is an open-access resource for human genetic information on type 2 diabetes (T2D). It is a central repository for data from large genomic studies that identify DNA variants whose presence is linked to altered risk of having T2D or related traits such as high body mass index. Pinpointing these DNA variants, and the genes they affect, will spur novel insights about how T2D develops and suggest new potential targets for drugs or other therapies to treat T2D.

name: HydroSHEDS
description: Suite of global hydrographic datasets, including river networks, basins, and related water layers.

name: Morphinome
description: The Morphinome Database is repository for proteins regulated by morphine administration.

name: SeaDataNet CDI Data Discovery & Access service: OGC WFS service for metadata features of all data sets (open and restricted)
description:
The **SeaDataNet CDI OGC WFS service** provides a metadata endpoint in OGC Feature format. It provides a WFS endpoint to the metadata overview of the CDI service, e.g. for integration in (web)GIS applications.

The SeaDataNet infrastructure links more than 100 national oceanographic data centres and marine data centres from 35 countries bordering all European seas. The data centres manage large sets of marine and ocean data (such as samples, timeseries, profiles, trajectories, etc), originating from their own institutes and from other parties in their country, in a variety of data management systems and configurations. 

The CDI service itself provides access to the data resources from more than 800 data originators. The Common Data Index service (CDI) gives users, via an ISO19115 - ISO19139 based index (metadatabase), a highly detailed insight in the availability and geographical spreading of marine data from the different data centres across Europe.  Data sets are available in ODV (Ocean Data View) and NetCDF (CF) SeaDataNet formats that can be imported to ODV software, which includes the Data Interpolating Variational Analysis software tool (DIVA).

name: SeaDataNet European Directory of Marine Environmental Data (EDMED)
description: SeaDataNet is a pan-European distributed marine data infrastructure for the management, exchange and re-use of marine and oceanographic data sets. A major objective and challenge in SeaDataNet is to promote discoverability of these data resources in a consistent and comprehensive manner. This is achieved through the SeaDataNet metadata services a set of directories, with associated user interfaces and web services, each governed by a SeaDataNet partner and content provided through national SeaDataNet collating nodes. The European Directory of Marine Environmental Data (EDMED) is the SeaDataNet catalogue promoting discoverability of, and access to, marine and oceanographic data sets and collections held within European research organisations. EDMED covers a wide range of disciplines including marine meteorology; physical, chemical and biological oceanography; and marine geology and geophysics. Data sets are described in EDMED irrespective of their format. EDMED utilises a metadata format based upon the ISO 19115 content model. The EDMED Schema and XML coding are supported by URLs and URNs to the SeaDataNet Common Vocabularies.For communities who need to search and access standardised marine data sets and collectionsMore than 110 data providers (linked to more than 600 data originators) and several thousands of data users.

name: OBO Foundry
description: The Open Biological and Biomedical Ontology (OBO) Foundry is a collective of ontology developers that are committed to collaboration and adherence to shared principles. The mission of the OBO Foundry is to develop a family of interoperable ontologies that are both logically well-formed and scientifically accurate. To achieve this, OBO Foundry participants voluntarily adhere to and contribute to the development of an evolving set of principles including open use, collaborative development, non-overlapping and strictly-scoped content, and common syntax and relations, based on ontology models that work well, such as the Gene Ontology (GO). The OBO Foundry is overseen by an Operations Committee with Editorial, Technical and Outreach working groups.

name: International Soil Carbon Network
description: The International Soil Carbon Network (ISCN) is a science-based network that facilitates data sharing, assembles databases, identifies gaps in data coverage, and enables spatially explicit assessments of soil carbon in context of landscape, climate, land use, and biotic variables. The ISCN Database is an evolving data resource.

name: HypoxiaDB
description: HypoxiaDB is a manually-curated non-redundant catalogue of human hypoxia-regulated proteins with a goal of collecting proteins whose expression patterns are altered in hypoxic conditions.

name: IOC Ocean Data and Information System Catalogue
description: IOC/IODE Catalogue of Sources for ocean-related web data systems, products and services, including ODIS nodes and NODC catalogs.

name: IMO Compendium on Facilitation and Electronic Business
description: IMO data set and reference model cataloguing maritime data elements and datasets for Maritime Single Window and electronic business, published as a public HTML catalogue.

name: Crop Ontology
description: CGIAR Crop Ontology curation tool for crop-specific trait, method, and scale vocabularies used in breeding.

name: OPTIMADE
description: Open Databases Integration for Materials Design, a federated API specification and index over materials databases.

name: Species+
description: Species+ portal maintained by UNEP-WCMC with the CITES Secretariat, listing CITES and CMS Appendix species with quotas, suspensions, distribution, and public CSV downloads of species lists. Distinct from the CITES Trade Database of shipment records.

name: IVOA Registry of Registries
description: IVOA Registry of Registries listing searchable Virtual Observatory resource registries worldwide.

name: Universal Human Rights Index
description: OHCHR Universal Human Rights Index of recommendations issued by UN human rights mechanisms, searchable by country, theme, and mechanism.

name: IPBES Catalogue of Assessments
description: IPBES Catalogue of Assessments on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services, listing global to sub-national assessments.

name: WTO HS Tracker
description: WTO HS Tracker of Harmonized System product-code changes, mergers, splits, and correlations across HS editions.

name: buildingSMART Data Dictionary
description: OpenBIM data dictionary of classifications, properties, and allowed values for the built environment, with a public search UI and Dictionary API.

name: Registry of Polar Observing Networks
description: Registry of Polar Observing Networks (RoPON), a SAON inventory of polar observing networks and assets.

name: ISSN Portal
description: The ISSN Portal is the official registry of International Standard Serial Numbers, identifying serials and continuing resources worldwide.

name: WMO Weather Radar Database
description: WMO Weather Radar Database of operational weather radar metadata, maintained for WIGOS by the Turkish State Meteorological Service.

name: ALMA Science Archive
description: Query interface for Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array observations and data products from the ALMA partnership.

name: Ocean Biodiversity Information System
description: To be the most comprehensive gateway to the world’s ocean biodiversity and biogeographic data and information required to address pressing coastal and world ocean concerns.

name: Genesys PGR
description: Global catalog of plant genetic resources in genebanks, including passport data and accession searches operated with CGIAR and the Crop Trust.

name: MAPPPD (Mapping Application for Penguin Populations and Projected Dynamics)
description: Mapping Application for Penguin Populations and Projected Dynamics (MAPPPD). Open catalog of Antarctic penguin census records for emperor, gentoo, chinstrap, and Adélie penguins, curated by Oceanites.

name: Open Speech and Language Resources
description: OpenSLR is a site devoted to hosting speech and language resources, such as training corpora for speech recognition, and software related to speech recognition. We intend to be a convenient place for anyone to put resources that they have created, so that they can be downloaded publicly.

name: NEA Data Bank Computer Program Services
description: The Data Bank operates a computer program service related to nuclear energy applications. The software library collects programs, compiles and verifies them in an appropriate computer environment, ensuring that the computer program package is complete and adequately documented. This collection of material contains more than 2000 documented packages and group cross-section data sets.

name: INTERMAGNET
description: INTERMAGNET International Real-time Magnetic Observatory Network. Catalog and access point for geomagnetic observatory time series from participating institutes.

name: OPCW Online Scheduled Chemicals Database
description: Searchable registry of chemicals covered by the schedules in the Annex on Chemicals of the Chemical Weapons Convention, with CAS Registry Numbers, HS codes, IUPAC names, molecular formulas, structures, and synonyms. Search requires free registration.

name: MolecularNet Datasets
description: MolecularNet provides access to molecular datasets for machine learning and cheminformatics research, including datasets for molecular property prediction, drug discovery, and chemical informatics applications. The platform offers standardized benchmarks for molecular machine learning tasks.

name: Open Traits Network
description: The Open Traits Network (OTN) is a global, decentralised community of researchers and institutions focused on standardising and integrating trait data across all organisms. Maintains a global registry of trait-based initiatives and advocates for open data and reproducible methods in trait science.

name: Site Survey Data Bank (SSDB)
description: A repository for digital site survey data submitted in support of International Ocean Discovery Program (IODP) proposals, expeditions and related activities. Used by proponents to submit data for evaluation and serves as a resource for the science community to access drilling-related data.

name: Tatoeba
description: Collaborative catalog of sentences and translations spanning thousands of languages.

name: Universal Dependencies
description: Catalog of cross-linguistic dependency treebanks annotated with a shared Universal Dependencies standard.

name: OECD Existing Chemicals Database
description: Database by the OECD Cooperative Chemicals Assessments Programme to track the status of chemical and chemical categories, and related OECD assessments, SIDS contact points, and other reports.

name: R-universe Datasets
description: R-universe datasets catalog; discover and access datasets from the R package ecosystem. Part of r-universe.dev by rOpenSci.

name: World Vegetable Center Genetic Resources
description: World Vegetable Center genebank catalog of vegetable genetic resources and seeds, using an embedded Genesys-PGR interface.

name: IPHC Data Pages
description: International Pacific Halibut Commission data pages for Pacific halibut survey, commercial, and biological datasets.

name: BirdLife DataZone
description: BirdLife International DataZone of species, Important Bird and Biodiversity Areas and related conservation datasets.

name: Global Information System of the International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture
description: GLIS is made available according to Art. 17 of the International Treaty to facilitate access and exchange, based on existing information systems, on scientific, technical and environmental matters related to plant genetic resources for food and agriculture. This service assigns Digital Object Identifiers (DOIs) to Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA) for reference in third party systems and scientific literature. Access to the system is free and open to anyone.

name: World Values Survey
description: The World Values Survey (WVS) is a worldwide network of social scientists studying changing values and their impact on social and political life. The WVS in collaboration with EVS (European Values Study) carried out representative national surveys in more than 100 countries containing almost 90 percent of the world's population. These surveys show pervasive changes in what people want out of life and what they believe.

name: EPPO Global Database
description: EPPO database of plant pests, diseases, invasive plants, and related phytosanitary information.

name: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
description: Global catalog of extinction-risk assessments for plant, animal, and fungus species, the canonical source for threatened-species status.

name: Harmful Algal Event Database (HAEDAT)
description: IOC-UNESCO Harmful Algal Information System event database of harmful algal events, with public browse, CSV export, and REST API.

name: WIPO Knowledge Repository
description: WIPO Knowledge Repository (TIND), a mixed institutional repository. Publications dominate; a documented Datasets collection includes GII and related research data files. OAI-PMH is public at /oai2d; the WIPODATASETS set currently returns only deleted identifiers, so harvest needs a type filter on HTML/OAI records.

name: Joint Evaluated Fission and Fusion File
description: The Joint Evaluated Fission and Fusion File (JEFF) project is a collaboration between NEA Data Bank member countries. The JEFF library combines the efforts of the JEFF and EFF/EAF Working Groups to produce a common sets of evaluated nuclear data, mainly for fission and fusion applications. It contains a number of different data types, including neutron and proton interaction data, radioactive decay data, fission yields, and thermal scattering law data.

name: CIFOR-ICRAF Knowledge Datasets
description: CIFOR-ICRAF provides access to datasets related to forestry, agroforestry, and landscape restoration research, supporting evidence-based policy and practice for sustainable land use. The organization focuses on tropical and subtropical regions.

name: ESO Science Archive Facility
description: Public archive of raw and processed data from ESO telescopes at La Silla Paranal and APEX, including catalogs and DOI-assigned data collections.

name: CIBMTR Publicly Available Datasets
description: CIBMTR provides access to publicly available datasets related to hematopoietic cell transplantation and cellular therapy research, supporting clinical research and outcomes analysis. The Center for International Blood and Marrow Transplant Research maintains one of the largest databases of transplant outcomes.

name: FAANG Dataset Portal
description: Open-access data portal supporting the FAANG initiative, providing multi-omic functional annotation datasets for domesticated animals, with standardized rich metadata and FAIR data sharing principles.

name: UNESCO Digital Library
description: The UNESCO Digital Library provides access to publications, documents and other materials either produced by UNESCO or pertaining to UNESCO’s fields of competence. It is constantly enriched with new publications and documents produced by UNESCO, as well as with acquisitions, resources shared by other institutions and donations. The UNESCO Digital Library is the repository of UNESCO’s institutional memory and a source of information on UNESCO activities (in education, natural sciences, social and human sciences, culture, and communication and information), with more than 350,000 documents dating back to 1945.

name: International information system for the agricultural science and technology
description: The International System for Agricultural Science and Technology (AGRIS) is a multilingual bibliographic database that connects users directly to a rich collection of research and worldwide technical information on food and agriculture. Maintained by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), AGRIS has been serving users from developed and developing countries through facilitating access to knowledge in agriculture, science and technology since 1975.

name: UniProt
description: Comprehensive public catalog of protein sequence and functional annotation from the UniProt Knowledgebase, UniRef clusters, and UniParc archive.

name: FishBase
description: Global encyclopedia and relational database of finfish species, biology, ecology, and fisheries data.

name: GH Archive
description: Public timeline of GitHub events, archived as timestamped JSON for software-engineering and open-source research.

name: Bionomia Datasets
description: Global biodiversity attribution datasets published by Bionomia, including open profile and specimen-claim exports derived from GBIF-linked records.

name: Lienchiang County Government Public Data Service
description: Lienchiang County (Matsu) government public data service listing county datasets by agency.

name: Chiayi County Urban Plan Map Query
description: Chiayi County urban plan map and document query for zoning and plan sheets.

name: Taitung County Government Open Data
description: Taitung County Government open data listing of county datasets.

name: Taitung Multi-purpose Geographic Information System
description: Taitung County multi-purpose GIS (TTGIS) with cadastral navigation and map layers.

name: Kaohsiung Urban Plan Geographic Information
description: Kaohsiung Urban Development public GIS viewer with urban-plan maps, zoning query, locate, historical imagery, and thematic layers. Distinct from the Urban GIS open-data download site.

name: Kaohsiung Urban GIS Open Data Platform
description: Kaohsiung City urban planning GIS open data platform, providing urban plan layers for download.

name: Penghu Urban Plan Land Use Zoning Query
description: Penghu County urban plan land-use zoning map query and certificate system.

name: Miaoli County Spatial Information Map
description: Miaoli County land GIS (栗智網) with cadastral, zoning, and 3D map layers.

name: Taoyuan Urban Plan Geographic Information Service
description: Taoyuan City urban plan GIS with zoning, cadastral lookup, and plan-area layers.

name: Hsinchu City Happy Livable Web GIS
description: Hsinchu City land and housing GIS (幸福宜居網) with cadastral, zoning, and real-estate map layers.

name: Chiayi City Government Open Data Platform

name: Repository of Psychological Instruments in Serbian
description:
REPOPSI is an open repository that enables users to freely access and share psychological instruments in Serbian and other languages. It was established in 2020 by the Laboratory for Research of Individual Differences (LIRA) at the University of Belgrade – Faculty of Philosophy. 

REPOPSI holds psychological measures, scales, tests, and other instruments commonly used in social and behavioral science research. While it is primarily intended for Serbian instruments (that is, instruments translated/adapted into Serbian or originally developed by local scientists), it also documents English and multilingual instruments. REPOPSI is a growing collection – it currently contains around 200 instrument records, half of which are available in both Serbian and English. 
REPOPSI increases the visibility and availability of psychological instruments in Serbian and prevents overlapping translation efforts. Being a good starting point for any project, REPOPSI helps researchers and students quickly find the materials they need. Bilingual and multilingual instruments it offers have proven to facilitate participation in multi-country research projects. 

Instruments found in REPOPSI may be used under the Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) license. They can be freely accessed and used without permission for noncommercial purposes, provided instrument authors and translators are cited.
