description: Tavira Mapas is a geoportal published by Câmara Municipal de Tavira for Faro, using Custom software. It is available at mapas.cm-tavira.pt. Catalog id mapascmtavirapt.

name: InfoCursos - Dados e Estatísticas de Cursos Superiores
description: DGEEC portal of higher-education course statistics (CTeSP, bachelor, integrated master, master) from RAIDES, including intake scores, student profile, progression, and graduate unemployment.

name: DataLABOR
description: DataLABOR is a Portuguese portal with labor, employment, and social protection statistics and dashboards, with legal information and microdata-based indicators.

name: TravelBI by Turismo de Portugal
description: Turismo de Portugal knowledge portal for tourism performance indicators, source-market analysis, regional dashboards, and related publications for Portugal as a destination.

name: InfoEscolas - Estatísticas do Ensino Básico e Secundário
description: DGEEC portal of school-level statistics for basic and secondary education in mainland Portugal, with indicators of enrolment, progression, exam results, and context by school, municipality, district, and NUTS.

name: Statistics Portugal indicator database
description: Official dissemination database of Statistics Portugal (INE). Users browse themes and build custom indicator tables with time series and NUTS geography, covering population, national accounts, prices, labour, enterprises, and social statistics.

name: BPStat
description: BPstat is the Banco de Portugal’s statistical website, through which statistical information about the Portuguese and euro area economies is provided. All information released in BPstat can be accessed free of charge, without the need for registration or subscription.

name: Observatório da Emigração
description: ISCTE observatory of Portuguese emigration, publishing destination-country tables on stocks, flows, remittances, and related indicators compiled from national statistical offices abroad.

name: NAP Portugal
description: Portuguese National Access Point for multimodal travel and road-traffic data. Portugal publishes a national NeTEx profile.

name: REN Data Hub
description: Public electricity and gas system data for Portugal published by REN.

name: OpenData BNP
description: National Library of Portugal open-data site with linked-data downloads and an OAI-PMH endpoint.

name: IHPT ENC WMS
description: Public WMS visualization of official S-57 Electronic Navigational Charts produced by the Portuguese Hydrographic Institute, covering mainland Portugal, Madeira, the Azores, Cape Verde and Angola. Distinct from the Institute's GeoServer open-data platforms. Not for navigation.

name: Centro de Dados Geográficos da DGT
description: Geographic data download service of Direção-Geral do Território (DGT), providing LiDAR digital elevation models, point clouds, and orthophotos for mainland Portugal and the Azores.

name: iSIP Portal Público
description: Public Land Parcel Identification System (iSIP / LPIS) viewer of Portugal's CAP paying agency, with parcel geometry, land cover, orthophoto, and related constraints. No beneficiary data.

name: CIIMAR GIS Data Server
description: Public GIS data server for CIIMAR coastal monitoring and management layers.

name: ICNF GeoCatalog
description: Catálogo com informação geográfica de dados abertos (opendata) disponível para descarregamento em diversos formatos. Interagir com a informação geográfica de diferentes temas.

name: Perdigao Field Experiment
description: Data repository of a meteorological experiment conducted in Perdigão, Portugal between December 15, 2016 to June 15, 2017. The Perdigao field project is part of a larger joint US/European multi-year program in Portugal. The project is partially funded by the European Union (EU) ERANET+ to provide the wind energy sector with more detailed resource mapping capabilities in the form of a new digital EU wind atlas.

name: Yeast Searching for Transcriptional Regulators and Consensus Tracking
description: YEASTRACT (Yeast Search for Transcriptional Regulators And Consensus Tracking) is a curated repository of more than 48333 regulatory associations between transcription factors (TF) and target genes in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, based on more than 1200 bibliographic references.

name: LEAFDATA
description: The LEAFDATA resource collects information from primary research articles focusing on Arabidopsis leaf growth and development. The result section of selected papers is manually annotated and organized into distinct categories. Text fragments of the manuscripts are displayed with links to the original papers on PubMed.

name: Arquivo.pt - the Portuguese web-archive
description: Arquivo.pt is a research infrastructure that preserves millions of files collected from the web since 1996 and provides a public search service over this information. It contains information in several languages. Periodically it collects and stores information published on the web. Then, it processes the collect data to make it searchable, providing a “Google-like” service that enables searching the past web (English user interface available at https://arquivo.pt/?l=en).

name: The mitochondrial DNA breakpoints database
description: A comprehensive on-line resource with curated datasets of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) rearrangements.

name: Antimicrobial Combination Networks
description: The database aims to bridge the gap between agent repositories and studies documenting the effect of antimicrobial combination therapies. Most notably, our primary aim is to compile data on the combination of antimicrobial agents, namely natural products such as AMP. To meet this purpose, we have developed a data curation workflow that combines text mining, manual expert curation and graph analysis and supports the reconstruction of AMP-Drug combinations.

name: OECS Data Platform
description: OECS Commission web-based data dissemination platform for comparable social, economic, environmental, and ICT statistics and SDG indicators across Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States member countries.

name: sieCARICOM Regional Energy Information System
description: Regional Energy Information System (sieCARICOM) publishing energy supply, demand, capacity and production indicators for Caribbean Community member states, developed with OLACDE and hosted by CCREEE. TLS certificate on siecaricom.ccreee.org was expired on 25 August 2026; the indicator application still served content.

name: CARPHA Data
description: Indicators catalog. managed by Caribbean Public Health Agency. powered by Custom software. accessible at carpha.org.

name: Eastern Caribbean Central Bank Statistics
description: Eastern Caribbean Central Bank statistics dashboards for monetary, financial, economic, and debt indicators covering Eastern Caribbean Currency Union member countries.

name: Data Palestine
description: Civic open-data platform compiling Palestinian statistical, humanitarian, and socioeconomic datasets and indicators from PCBS, World Bank, and other public sources, with a catalog UI, explorer, and versioned JSON API.

name: Palestine Datasets (Tech For Palestine)
description: Open datasets from the Tech For Palestine collective documenting casualties, named fatalities, journalist deaths, and infrastructure damage in Gaza and the West Bank since October 2023. Versioned JSON and CSV APIs are published at data.techforpalestine.org under the Unlicense (public domain).

name: CapeFarmMapper 3
description: Online agricultural mapping application of the Western Cape Department of Agriculture. Provides access to cadastral, land cover, biodiversity and farm-level geographic layers.

name: Nelson Mandela Bay GIS Data Downloads
description: Nelson Mandela Bay Municipality public GIS downloads, including cadastral, ward, cemetery and waste-site shapefiles.

name: ISIbalo Data Portal
description: Official Statistics South Africa data product portal. Provides downloadable census, survey and administrative datasets and metadata after the Nesstar service was discontinued.

name: HST District Health Barometer
description: Interactive District Health Barometer of the Health Systems Trust. Public health performance indicators for South Africa's 52 districts, with maps, league tables and downloads.

name: Global Index on Responsible AI
description: Country rankings, pillar and dimension scores, and an evidence explorer assessing responsible artificial-intelligence governance, implementation, civil society participation and enabling conditions worldwide.

name: CSIR GreenBook
description: CSIR GreenBook online repository of municipal climate-risk data, projections and adaptation information for South African settlements.

name: SARB Online Statistical Query
description: South African Reserve Bank download facility for Quarterly Bulletin macroeconomic time series. Series can be selected by KBP code or keyword and exported as tables.

name: Stats SA Census Dissemination
description: Interactive Census 2022 dissemination portal of Statistics South Africa. Distinct from the SuperWEB2 table builder; publishes census indicators and geographic profiles as a JavaScript census explorer.

name: Youth Explorer
description: Youth-centred indicator explorer for South Africa, mapping census, labour market and wellbeing measures from national to ward and main-place level.

name: National Integrated Water Information System
description: National Integrated Water Information System dashboards publishing Department of Water and Sanitation water-resource indicators with CSV and Excel downloads.

name: SARS Trade Stats Portal
description: South African Revenue Service merchandise trade statistics portal, with interactive visualisations and a download wizard for imports and exports by country and commodity.

name: ISS Crime Hub
description: Institute for Security Studies Crime Hub statistics wizard. Compares SAPS crime categories, police stations and reporting years, with maps and downloadable reports.

name: RQIS Water Quality Data and Reports
description: Resource Quality Information Services data and reports for South African river and dam water quality, including chemistry time series and monitoring programme outputs.

name: Spatial Tax Data South Africa
description: There is a glaring gap in the availability of credible spatial economic data in South Africa. This ambitious project draws on administrative tax recor

name: National Treasury Transparency Portal
description: National Treasury Transparency Portal publishing South African public procurement data as Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) packages, with bulk JSON, CSV and Excel downloads and a REST API.

name: Municipal Finance Data
description: National Treasury catalog and JSON API for South African municipal Section 71 financial data, covering metro, district and local municipalities.

name: Municipal Money
description: National Treasury citizen scorecard for municipal financial performance. Profiles indicators, audit outcomes and comparisons for South African municipalities. Machine-readable cubes are published on Municipal Finance Data.

name: Vulekamali – South Africa Budget Data Portal
description: National Treasury budget transparency portal for South African national and provincial expenditure data, developed with Imali Yethu. The former CKAN datastore at data.vulekamali.gov.za no longer resolves; the public catalog is the vulekamali website.

name: Environmental Geographic Information Systems (EGIS) - Data Download
description: Provides access to baseline geospatial data and services for geospatial technology users.

name: SANHO nautical chart catalogue
description: Public catalogue of South African Navy Hydrographic Office paper charts and Electronic Navigational Charts, with ENC usage-band listings (overview, coastal, approaches, harbour) and product metadata. Distinct from the DFFE OCIMS operational portal.

name: South Africa Oceans and Coastal Information Management System
description: Oceans and Coastal Information Management System of the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment, providing operational marine tools, a coastal viewer, aquaculture and fisheries support, and links to related data resources. Distinct from the CSIR OCIMS CKAN catalog.

name: SANSA Earth Observation Catalogue
description: Earth observation catalogue of the South African National Space Agency. Provides search and ordering of satellite imagery covering southern Africa, including Landsat, SPOT, CBERS and SumbandilaSAT archives.

name: Chief Surveyor-General Spatial Data
description: Chief Surveyor-General spatial data page for South African cadastral datasets including erven, farms, servitudes and administrative boundaries.

name: National Environmental Screening Tool
description: National web-based environmental screening tool used to generate mandatory EIA screening reports and inspect spatial environmental sensitivity themes.

name: SAWS Marine Portal
description: Marine data portal of the South African Weather Service: in-situ and remotely sensed ocean observations (SST, sea level, currents, drifting buoys, ships, HF radar, Argo), forecasts and products.

name: Petroleum Agency SA Data Portal
description: Public map of South African petroleum wells, seismic surveys, and licence areas.

name: DIRISA Data Share
description: DIRISA national research data services portal, including Data Share for FAIR publication of research datasets with DataCite DOIs and related deposit tools.

name: SAEON Observations Database
description: SAEON observations platform: 36 sites, 267 stations, 1,716 sensors, 1,489 datasets and 67.5M verified observations; public dataset/sensor query at /query/datasets and /query/data.

name: IDIA Public Data Archive
description: Inter-University Institute for Data Intensive Astronomy public data archive, hosting MeerKAT and related radio-astronomy datasets.

name: JWS Online
description: JWS Online is a systems biology repository and browser-based simulator for curated kinetic models, maintained by Stellenbosch University with a Manchester University mirror at this URL. A Stellenbosch instance is also available at https://jjj.biochem.sun.ac.za/.

name: MeerKAT Archive
description: Archive of MeerKAT radio telescope observations operated by the South African Radio Astronomy Observatory.

name: South African Weather Service
description: South African Weather Service public website, listed in re3data as a climate data source. Harvestable WIS 2.0 services are recorded separately as wisweathersacoza.

name: South African Environmental Observation Network Open Data Platform
description: The South African Environmental Observation Network (SAEON) Open Data Platform (ODP) is a metadata repository that facilitates the publication, discovery, dissemination, and preservation of earth observation and environmental data in South Africa. SAEON is a long-term environmental observation and research facility of the National Research Foundation (NRF).

name: MARISMA Spatial Data Portal
description: Spatial data used in the MARISMA project (EBSA and MSP workstreams) in an interactive data viewer. Users can select and download files for different countries. Shapefiles require GIS programs, KMZ files require Google Earth. Metadata describes data sources and methods. The portal is managed by the Institute for Coastal and Marine Research, Nelson Mandela University.

name: Grenadines Marine Resource Space-use Information System (MarSIS)
description: Participatory marine GIS for the Grenada Bank (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines and Grenada), built by CERMES at the University of the West Indies with Sustainable Grenadines Inc. Public products include Google Earth KMZ layers for habitats, space-use, and multi-use zoning, plus island heritage maps and an annotated research e-library.

name: KOPI National Forest Monitoring System statistics
description: KOPI publishes National Forest Monitoring System statistics for Suriname, including forest cover, deforestation, land use after deforestation, forestry-sector production, mangroves, and historical emissions. Tables can be exported as CSV, Excel, and JSON. Managed by SBB and launched in March 2021.

name: DONDRU Climate Change Knowledge Database Suriname
description: DONDRU is Suriname's climate-change knowledge database. It publishes environmental and climate indicators through an MRV tool covering GHG inventory, drivers, impacts, adaptation, mitigation, and the NDC portfolio, plus related publications. Developed by NIMOS with the Ministry of Spatial Planning and Environment and launched in June 2022.

name: BPS en Cifras
description: National social security indicators dashboard of Uruguay's Banco de Previsión Social (BPS). Publishes statistics on benefits, pensions, contributions, coverage, and related social security indicators, with charts, maps, and downloads.

name: INE Uruguay indicadores
description: Official website and indicator tables of Uruguay's National Institute of Statistics (INE). Disseminates census, demographic, labour, price, and economic statistics. Distinct from the INE NADA microdata archive on the same host.

name: Datos abiertos del Presupuesto Nacional
description: Open-data tables for Uruguay's National Budget Law 2025-2029, including revenue, expenditure credit, the multi-year budget, and staffing, published as CSV. The same site also publishes the 2025 rendición de cuentas workbooks.

name: SOHMA nautical charts and publications catalogue
description: Public catalogue of Uruguayan paper nautical charts, ENC cells distributed via IC-ENC, freely downloadable inland ENCs, tide tables and notices to mariners, maintained by the Navy's oceanography, hydrography and meteorology service.

name: Visualizador geoCatastro
description: Official cadastral map viewer of Uruguay's Dirección Nacional de Catastro (Ministry of Economy and Finance). Provides public search and visualization of urban, suburban and rural parcels, cadastral localities, blocks, sections, survey plans, and cadastral values.

name: Geoportal SIG - Intendencia de Rocha
description: Geoportal of the Intendencia Departamental de Rocha. The previous GeoNetwork path /metadata returns HTTP 404; the public entry point is the SIG geoportal.

name: Singapore in Figures
description: Singapore Department of Statistics Singapore in Figures dashboards. Interactive key economic and socio-demographic indicators across economy, industry, trade, and related themes, distinct from SingStat Table Builder.

name: URA Property Data
description: Urban Redevelopment Authority Property Data portal for private residential and commercial market statistics, including prices, rentals, vacancies, stock, and pipeline supply, with time-series query tools. Paid REALIS subscription is a separate product and is not this catalog.

name: Singapore Energy Statistics
description: Energy Market Authority Singapore Energy Statistics annual publication. Interactive charts and downloadable tables cover energy supply, transformation, consumption, balances, prices, solar, and manpower.

name: CPF Statistics
description: Central Provident Fund Board statistics on membership, balances, contributions, investments, and withdrawals for retirement, housing, and healthcare, with topic tables and a quarterly Excel download.

name: MAS Statistics
description: Monetary Authority of Singapore statistics hub for exchange rates, S$NEER, interest rates, the Monthly Statistical Bulletin, insurance, currency, reserves, MAS bills, payments, and related financial indicators. Distinct from the MAS API Catalog on eservices.mas.gov.sg.

name: Stan Tourism Statistics
description: Singapore Tourism Board Stan public tourism statistics. Visitor arrivals, hotel performance, hotel landscape, and tourism-receipts dashboards are available without login, plus annual visitor-profile and cruise Excel tables. Industry features behind Singpass are out of scope.

name: Business Insights Tool for Enterprises (BITE)
description: Singapore Department of Statistics Business Insights Tool for Enterprises (BITE). Public dashboards and a peer-benchmark tool covering industry outlook, business costs, customer demographics, and trade statistics for firms.

name: Singapore SDG Progress Tracker
description: Singapore Department of Statistics SDG Progress Tracker. National reporting pages for the UN Sustainable Development Goals, with indicator availability, trend assessments, and related methodology. Not an Open SDG installation.

name: IMDA Statistics on Telecom Services
description: IMDA half-yearly statistics on telecommunications services in Singapore, including mobile and fixed-line subscriptions, broadband penetration, and usage indicators, with tables from 1997 onwards.

name: MSF Research Reports and Data
description: Ministry of Social and Family Development research reports and data portal. Headline social indicators plus filterable reports and datasets on family, financial assistance, disability, domestic violence, and related topics.

name: SingStat Table Builder
description: Official statistics table builder from the Department of Statistics Singapore. Searchable catalogue of data tables and series on the economy, population, and socio-demographic domains, with a public JSON API for resource IDs, metadata, and table data.

name: LTA DataMall
description: LTA DataMall publishes static downloads and AccountKey-gated real-time APIs for Singapore land transport (bus arrivals, traffic, parking, taxi availability, and related feeds) for developers, researchers, and the public.

name: OCEANS-X
description: Maritime API and data catalogue from the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore. Successor to the Singapore Maritime Data Hub (SG-MDH). Lists dynamic, static, and GeoSpace-Sea datasets and APIs for vessel movements, port operations, cargo, bunkers, and weather.

name: Data.gov.sg Open Data Singapore
description: Singapore's national open data portal. Publishes datasets from government agencies with collection and dataset APIs (list, metadata, search, and download) plus real-time environment APIs.

name: Nexdata
description: Commercial catalogue of off-the-shelf AI training datasets and custom collection/annotation services (speech, image, video, text, and point cloud) from Nexdata, a Singapore-headquartered training-data company.

name: Ocean Market
description: Decentralized marketplace for publishing, buying, and selling data assets as data NFTs and datatokens, including compute-to-data workflows. Operated by Ocean Protocol Foundation Ltd., a Singapore company limited by guarantee.

name: URA SPACE
description: URA SPACE is the Urban Redevelopment Authority's public map portal for Singapore. It provides location-based planning information including Master Plan zoning, land use and control plans, conservation areas, urban design guidelines, car parks, private residential properties, and demographics, with a documented data API for car parks, property transactions, planning decisions, and approved use.

name: OneMap
description: Authoritative national map of Singapore developed by the Singapore Land Authority. Provides base maps, geocoding, routing, thematic layers, planning-area boundaries, and population query APIs.

name: Model Zoo
description: Community catalogue of open-source deep learning code and pretrained models, built in Singapore, with filters by framework and task for transfer learning and education.

name: APEX Cloud API Catalog
description: APEX Cloud API Catalog is a api catalog operated by Government Technology Agency.

name: MAS API Catalog
description: Monetary Authority of Singapore API catalogue of MAS Data APIs (non-sensitive) for monthly statistical bulletin series, including banking, insurance, exchange rates, interest rates, and other financial statistics.

name: Human Intermediate Filament Database
description: Human Intermediate Filament Database (HIFD) is a curated catalogue of human intermediate filament genes, proteins, and disease-associated sequence variants (keratins, desmins, lamins, and related families). Curated at the Bioinformatics Institute, A*STAR, since 2006. HTTPS on www.interfil.org fails certificate checks; the working host is https://interfil.org/.

name: WOVOdat
description: WOVOdat is a global database of volcanic unrest (seismic, geodetic, gas, and hydrologic observations) used to study pre-eruptive processes and improve eruption forecasts. Built for the World Organization of Volcano Observatories and hosted at the Earth Observatory of Singapore.

name: 2DMatPedia
description: 2DMatPedia (2D Materials Encyclopedia) is an open computational database of more than 6,000 two-dimensional materials from top-down exfoliation and bottom-up elemental substitution, with structural, electronic, and energetic properties. Produced at NUS Centre for Advanced 2D Materials. The site is HTTP-only; HTTPS is not served.

name: AlloMAPS
description: AlloMAPS (Allosteric Mutation Analysis and Polymorphism of Signaling) provides structure-based energetics of allosteric communication in proteins, including Allosteric Signaling Maps for annotated allosteric proteins, PDBselect chains, pathological SNPs, AlphaFold proteomes, GPCRs, and Pfam-trRosetta domains. Hosted by the Bioinformatics Institute of A*STAR.

name: DENR-10 Geospatial Database
description: Public geospatial database of DENR Region 10 (Northern Mindanao): land permits, forestry tenures and environmental datasets on a Vue/Leaflet map.

name: FNRI eNutrition
description: Data warehouse of the National Nutrition Survey (NNS) from the DOST Food and Nutrition Research Institute. Publishes Facts and Figures tables on growth and body composition, biomarkers, food and nutrient intake, food security, and related health indicators, plus Public Use Files from successive NNS rounds.

name: Open Data Philippines
description: Official Open Data Philippines (ODPH) portal, an online repository of datasets from national government agencies. The current site is an Angular application without a public CKAN-style harvest API.

name: PH-EITI Contracts Portal
description: PH-EITI Contracts Portal publishing mining, oil, and gas contracts and licenses between the Philippine government and extractive companies. Originally launched in 2015 as a ResourceContracts country site; the current portal is a custom PH-EITI application (184 contracts).

name: BetterGov.ph Open Data Portal
description: Community-run open data portal by BetterGov.ph that curates Philippine public datasets from government agencies, NGOs, and community contributors. Provides search, filtering, and a REST API covering tax, procurement, legislative, and other government data.

name: NHA MAPS Portal
description: Map portal of the National Housing Authority linking public Leaflet/ArcGIS map apps of NHA housing project locations, landholdings and resettlement sites.

name: Geoportal Philippines
description: Official geospatial data portal providing access to datasets, maps, and resources for the Philippines.

name: PHIVOLCS Maps Portal
description: Maps portal of DOST-PHIVOLCS linking volcano, earthquake and hazard map applications and the GeoRiskPH information systems ecosystem.

name: Global Long-term Experiments Network Metadata Portal
description:
The Global Long-Term Agricultural Experiment Network (GLTEN) is a network of long-term agricultural experiments. The GLTEN was launched in May 2018 with the aim of establishing and supporting a collaborative network within the international agricultural science community. 
The aim of the GLTEN metadata portal is to increase the visibility of long-term agricultural experiments and provide new opportunities for collaborations and data re-use. The GLTEN Metadata portal uses a defined metadata schema to provide consistent descriptions of over 200 LTEs, representing diverse and contrasting climate regions and environments, as well as multiple crop systems and land management schemes.

name: Philippine Traditional Knowledge Digital Library on Health
description: National digital library of Philippine traditional knowledge on health, including medicinal plants, healing practices, rituals, terminology, and healer records documented with Indigenous Cultural Communities and local communities. Joint product of DOST-PCHRD, PITAHC, and UP Manila.

name: Baguio City Open Data Portal
description: Official open data portal of Baguio City, publishing public datasets on infrastructure projects, traffic apprehensions, medical data, and mortality statistics.

name: Forest Global Earth Observatory
description: Forest Global Earth Observatory (ForestGEO, formerly CTFS) is a STRI-hosted global network of forest research plots. The site describes the network and points researchers to plot data access; STRI headquarters are in Panama.

name: CTFS Panama Atlas
description: CTFS Panama Atlas dataset pages from the Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute, sharing plot, climate, and related forest-dynamics data for the Panama Canal watershed research sites (Barro Colorado Island and associated plots).

name: ODP régional du Sénégal
description: ANSD regional Open Data Platform (ODP) for official statistics of Senegal's 14 regions. Distinct from the national AfDB/Knoema Open Data for Africa hub.

name: Géoportail du PGIIS
description: PGIIS flood-management geoportal cited by Géo Sénégal as the data-exchange platform for inundation management. The public URL is an ArcGIS Enterprise Portal path (/portal/). Distinct from the CKAN site inondations-dakar.org. The TLS handshake currently fails from some networks.

name: Géo Sénégal
description: National geospatial data infrastructure portal of Senegal (Géo Sénégal). Publishes Géo Data themes, a cartothèque, and BaseGéo vector/imagery downloads produced with ANAT.

name: West African Vegetation Database
description: Vegetation-plot database for West Africa (phytosociological and dendrometric relevés and floristic inventories), maintained with Cheikh Anta Diop University. Public search is available; a free account is required for full download. HTTPS is not offered. Last data edit noted on the site in January 2023.

name: Prostorski portal Mestne občine Novo mesto
description: Municipal spatial-acts catalog of the City of Novo mesto (OPN and OPPN documents) with a map viewer connected to PISO.

name: Zdravje v občini
description: Zdravje v občini (Health in the Municipality) is the National Institute of Public Health platform of municipal health indicators for all Slovenian municipalities, with maps, comparisons to national and regional averages, and methodological notes. Distinct from the NIJZ PxWeb table portal.

name: NAP Slovenia
description: Slovenian National Access Point for traffic, multimodal travel, and alternative-fuel infrastructure data, including IPPT bus and train timetables.

name: Uradni list
description: Official gazette of Slovenia. Catalog of laws and other acts published in Uradni list.

name: Portal Prostor (E-prostor)
description: Official Portal Prostor of the Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia (GURS). Provides public and registered access to cadastre, real estate, topographic, address, and other geodetic data, plus INSPIRE dataset and network service lists including WMS, WFS, and download services.

name: GERK public viewer
description: Public viewer of Slovenia's graphical unit of agricultural land (GERK / LPIS), operated by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Food for CAP IACS reference parcels.

name: Agency for Communication Networks and Services of the Republic of Slovenia (AKOS) Geoportal
description: AKOS mobile GIS geoportal providing spatial and infrastructure information for Slovenia.

name: STAGE (SURS geoportal)
description: STAGE (STAtistics and GEography) is the Statistical Office of the Republic of Slovenia (SURS) interactive web map for presenting and disseminating geospatial statistics on administrative units (municipalities, regions, settlements) and grid cells, with options to define custom areas and download data for GIS analysis.

name: Portal CLSS (Ciklično lasersko skeniranje Slovenije)
description: 3D viewer and download portal for Slovenia's Cyclic Laser Scanning (CLSS) LiDAR products, operated by the Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia. Provides classified point clouds, digital terrain and surface models, hillshade, and orthoimagery on a 1 km grid, free and without registration.

name: Stress Knowledge Map
description: Stress Knowledge Map (SKM) is a knowledge graph resulting from the integration of dispersed published information on plant molecular responses to biotic and abiotic stressors. SKM enables interactive exploration of its contents, and represents a basis for network and dynamical modelling of responses. SKM contains two complementary resources: the Plant Stress Signalling model (PSS) and the Comprehensive Knowledge Network (CKN).

name: GoMapMan
description: GoMapMan is an open web-accessible resource for gene functional annotations in the plant sciences. It was developed to facilitate improvement, consolidation and visualization of gene annotations across several plant species.

name: Encyclopedia of Graphs
description: Encyclopedia of Graphs is an online encyclopedia of graph collections aiming to help researchers find and use data about different families of graphs. It has been created as a part of the ESF funded GReGAS project combining 16 top scientific teams from all over the world trying to develop a coherent theory of graph representations.

name: ADP - Social Science Data Archives
description: Central Slovenian Social Science Data Archives of the University of Ljubljana, established in 1997. The tasks include acquiring significant data sources with a wide range of social science disciplines relevant to Slovenian social scientists, checking and preparing them for digital preservation, and disseminating them for scientific, educational, and other purposes. ADP offers access to data for social science analysis, with emphasis on problems related to Slovenian society. Priority is given to theoretically significant and methodologically well-designed studies, especially data over time and international comparative data that include Slovenia. ADP is a national representative of ICPSR and a member of CESSDA, EDAN, and DwB.

name: Datasets of Highly Symmetric Objects
description: Datasets of Highly Symmetric Objects contains several datasets of highly symmetric graphs and other combinatorial objects, such as the Foster census of cubic arc-transitive graphs, census of rotary maps, a census of cubic vertex-transitive graphs, 4-valent arc-transitive graph etc.

name: Cadastre minier du Mali (SICAM)
description: Système Intégré du Cadastre Minier (SICAM / SIGCAM), the public mining-cadastre portal of the Direction Nationale de la Géologie et des Mines. Custom JHipster application (not Trimble Landfolio). Successor to the MCAS repository at mali.revenuedev.org.

name: Kingdom of Bahrain Portal for Sustainable Development Goals
description: National SDG reporting portal of the Kingdom of Bahrain, published by the Ministry of Sustainable Development. Documents progress toward the UN Sustainable Development Goals 2030 with goal status pages, national policies, Voluntary National Reviews, and a downloadable SDMX 2.0 GenericData extract of official indicators.

name: Geovisor SINACAR
description: INRA platform for Bolivia's National Rural Environmental Cadastre (SINACAR), with agrarian-property maps served from geoserver.inra.gob.bo. The former /geovisor path returns HTTP 404.

name: Infraestructura de Datos Geoestadísticos (IDG) - INE Bolivia
description: Official geostatistical data infrastructure of Bolivia's Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE). Catalogs geospatial data from the 2001, 2012, and 2024 population censuses and the 2013 agricultural census, with interactive maps and OGC WMS/WFS services on territorial units and multiscalar geostatistical grids.

name: IDE-SERGEOMIN
description: Spatial data infrastructure of Bolivia's Servicio Geológico Minero (SERGEOMIN). Provides map viewers and geospatial layers on geology, hydrogeology, mineral deposits, volcanoes, seismicity, and related geoscientific themes.

name: Geoportal INE Bolivia
description: Official geostatistical geoportal of Bolivia's Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE). Publishes interactive maps of census statistics and indicators by theme, including population, health, education, migration, housing, and basic services.

name: Sejong Statistics Portal
description: Official statistics portal of Sejong Special Self-Governing City, publishing municipal statistical tables and indicators.

description: Official statistics website of Haiti's Haitian Institute of Statistics and Informatics (IHSI). Publishes statistical tables, yearbooks, and census products covering population, prices, and economic statistics.

name: Portail National de Données de Santé
description: MSPP public health data portal for routine SISNU indicators, EMMUS survey tables, and HMIS statistical reports. Distinct from the login-walled DHIS2 at sisnu.net.

name: HaitiDocs
description: Civil-society library of Haiti public indicators with CSV/JSON downloads and a catalog API, plus official documents sourced from IHSI, BRH, MEF and international agencies.

name: DGB Haiti Banque de données
description: Direction Générale du Budget public data bank of downloadable Excel and PDF series on Haiti civil-service headcount, payroll, and average age of officials.

name: MEF Haiti TOFE et TEB
description: Ministry of Economy and Finance download bank of TOFE fiscal-operations tables and TEB treasury execution files in Excel and PDF, covering 2000 onward.

name: Carte sanitaire d'Haïti
description: MSPP public health-facility geoportal. Maps institutions from the EPSSS evaluation, with filters, tabular extracts, and facility search by department and commune.

name: CEP Haiti centres d'inscription et de vote
description: Public CEP map and searchable register of Haiti voter-registration and polling centres, with department/commune filters and Excel/PDF export.

name: GeoTechMap Haiti
description: URGéo public map of Haiti geotechnical test results (PANDA, H/V, Vs30, SPT, boreholes) and mass-movement hazard layers, contributed by partner institutions.

name: AYITISTATS
description: Civil-society discovery catalog of Haiti's public data, operated by the AYITISTATS association from France. Indexes 12,000+ datasets, official reports, and geospatial files from 100+ institutional sources including IHSI, and links users to the original publishers rather than hosting the files.

name: CLIMEXHA Haiti climate projections
description: Regional climate projection catalog from URGéo at Université d'État d'Haïti. Publishes department-level NetCDF files of precipitation and temperature for historical periods and CMIP6 SSP scenarios.

name: NENDO - Nos Écoles Nos Données
description: NENDO (Nos Écoles Nos Données) school map and education indicators application from the Burkina Open Data Initiative. Locates preschool and primary schools in selected communes and publishes examination success rates. No public catalog API is exposed.

name: INERA OpenData
description: Phytosanitary image and research-data bank of INERA (Direction régionale de recherches environnementales et agricoles de l'Ouest, Bobo-Dioulasso). Publishes labelled and raw smartphone and drone datasets (mango, cashew, rice, cotton; COCO and YOLO formats) from the FONRID-IA project, with a public dataset dashboard and downloads.

name: INE Guiné-Bissau
description: Official statistics website of Guinea-Bissau's National Institute of Statistics. Publishes statistical tables and indicators covering census, demography, and economic statistics.

name: Central Bank of Montenegro Statistics
description: Central Bank of Montenegro statistics catalog of monetary, financial, and related national indicators.

name: Službeni list Crne Gore
description: Službeni list Crne Gore is a open data portal published by Službeni list Crne Gore for Montenegro, using Custom software. It is available at www.sluzbenilist.me. Catalog id sluzbenilistme.

name: Geoportal CG
description: National geoportal of Montenegro (Geoportal CG), operated by the Real Estate Administration (Uprava za nekretnine). Landing page for interactive web maps (Geoportal01/Geoportal02) and cadastral geospatial data aligned with INSPIRE. The linked GeoNetwork catalogue on port 8443 did not respond during review.

name: IDDEEA Open Data Portal
description: Official open data portal of IDDEEA BiH, publishing regularly updated statistical datasets from national registers of citizens, identity cards, travel documents, motor vehicles, driving licences, fines, tachograph cards, and seafarers' documents.

name: Službeni list BiH
description: Official gazette of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

name: Kutaisi Municipal Works Map
description: Interactive municipal map of infrastructure works in Kutaisi (new, ongoing, and completed), operated by Kutaisi City Hall. Public Google Maps viewer with clustered project markers; citizens can also submit reports.

name: Batumi Emergency Buildings Map
description: Public Leaflet map of emergency (avariuli) residential buildings in Batumi, with search by cadastral code and address. Operated by Batumi City Hall. The municipal GIS hosts gis.batumi.gov.ge, map.batumi.gov.ge, and geoportal.batumi.gov.ge are access-restricted.

name: Georgia Budget Monitor
description: Budget Monitor of the State Audit Office of Georgia: interactive fiscal transparency portal for budget, audits, public spending, and SDG-related indicators.

name: Georgia SDG Monitoring Platform
description: National Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) monitoring platform for Georgia, tracking nationalized goals, targets, and indicators.

name: Water Information System of Georgia
description: Water Information System of Georgia (WIS Georgia), a gateway to data and information on freshwater and marine resources developed with EEA SEIS support.

name: Georgia Open Procurement Dashboard
description: Open procurement visualization dashboard of the State Procurement Agency of Georgia, companion to the OCDS open data portal.

name: Georgia’s Open Data Lab
description: Open Data Lab (DataLab) of the Institute for Development of Freedom of Information (IDFI). Independent catalog of public-sector datasets collected from Georgian central and local institutions, with browse, download, and basic visualisation tools covering finance, social issues, education, transport, and local government.

name: Data.gov.ge Georgia Open Data Portal
description: Official national open data portal of Georgia (data.gov.ge), launched under Open Government Partnership commitments. Public institutions publish datasets and metadata for reuse. Administered by the Digital Governance Agency (legal successor of the Data Exchange Agency) under the Ministry of Justice.

name: Parliament of Georgia Open Data
description: Open data and public-information portal of the Parliament of Georgia, publishing parliamentary structure, legal acts, plenary records, reports, staffing, spending, procurement, and related documents, with a documented REST API.

name: Georgia Public Procurement Open Data
description: Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) portal of the State Procurement Agency of Georgia, publishing public procurement tenders and plans in machine-readable form.

name: Georgia Air Quality Portal
description: National air quality portal of Georgia. Public map of automatic and indicative monitoring stations with pollutant filters, plus a JSON stations API. Operated by the Environmental Information and Education Centre (EIEC).

name: Georgia National Spatial Data Infrastructure Geoportal
description: National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI) geoportal of Georgia, operated by NAPR. Public discovery, viewing, and download of national geospatial datasets and services, with a metadata catalogue at /ka/catalog. This in-house portal replaced the former GeoNetwork instance at geonetwork.napr.gov.ge.

name: MEPA Geographic Information Portal
description: Geographic information portal of the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture of Georgia, with a public catalog of spatial layers for viewing and download.

name: GEOSTAT Interactive Map
description: GEOSTAT Interactive Map (gis.geostat.ge). Public Leaflet GIS of official statistics by region and municipality, with a GeoMap API at gis-api.geostat.ge. Distinct from the Geostat PxWeb table database.

name: Georgia NAPR Interactive Map
description: NAPR multifunctional interactive map of Georgia (maps.gov.ge). Public viewer for cadastral parcels, addresses, orthophotos, and other core geospatial layers. Distinct from the NSDI metadata geoportal at nsdi.gov.ge.

name: TCSA Interactive Map
description: Interactive Leaflet map of the Technical and Construction Supervision Agency of Georgia (TCSA), showing construction-supervision objects on a public map viewer.

name: Cave Biodiversity of Georgia Database
description: Cave Biodiversity of Georgia (CBG) open-access database of cave fauna and cave systems, with searchable records and downloadable taxonomic and regional data.

name: OceanDNA Georgian IODE Associate Data Unit
description: IODE Associate Data Unit at Tbilisi State University for Georgian Black Sea marine data and metadata (EDMO, EDMED, EDMERP and Georgian CDI).

name: EEGHUB Georgia EEG Dataset
description: EEGHUB searchable catalog of clinical EEG recordings (EDF) from the Ivane Beritashvili Center of Experimental Biomedicine, covering normal and pathological brain activity across age, sex, and medication filters. Listed as a NI4OS-Europe / EOSC thematic service.

name: Georgian National Corpus
description: Georgian National Corpus (GNC) catalog of annotated language corpora, including Old, Middle, and Modern Georgian, a 200-million-word reference corpus, dialect, Megrelian, and Svan sub-corpora, with public search and concordance tools.

name: Ilia State University Georgian Language Corpus
description: Georgian Language Corpus (GLC) at Ilia State University, a searchable catalog of annotated monolingual and bilingual texts (Old, Middle, and Modern Georgian) with lemma and morphosyntactic tagging.

name: Caucasus Barometer Datasets
description: Caucasus Barometer annual household survey datasets from the Caucasus Research Resource Centers (CRRC), covering social, economic, and political attitudes in Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. Tables and microdata can be browsed and downloaded from the surveys catalog.

name: Caucasus Barcode of Life
description: Caucasus Barcode of Life (CaBOL) public DNA-barcode reference database for animals and plants of the Caucasus, coordinated by Ilia State University with partners in Georgia, Armenia, and Germany. Includes specimen identifications and sequence search.

name: Tbilisi City Hall Architecture Map
description: Tbilisi City Hall architecture map (მერიის რუკა). Public OpenLayers viewer of architecture and planning layers. Distinct from the municipal services map at ms.gov.ge/msmap/. HTTPS on this host fails certificate checks; the map is served over HTTP.

name: Tbilisi Municipal Map
description: Interactive municipal GIS map of Tbilisi (maps.tbilisi.gov.ge redirects here), operated by Tbilisi municipal services. Orthophoto and city layers are also published through a MapProxy WMS/WMTS endpoint.

name: National Statistical Office of Malawi
description: Official statistics website of Malawi's National Statistical Office. Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics.

name: IFPRI Malawi Datasets Catalog
description: WordPress datasets listing of the IFPRI Malawi Strategy Support Program (MaSSP). Entries are mostly IFPRI Malawi studies deposited in Harvard Dataverse, not a harvestable open-data portal.

name: Institut National de la Statistique de Djibouti (INSTAD)
description: INSTAD national statistics website with downloadable statistical yearbooks, monthly and quarterly bulletins, CPI and trade indices, RGPH census reports, and a microdata request form.

name: Cartes nationales du CERD
description: CERD national thematic map gallery covering geology, seismicity, hydrogeology, climate, soils, vegetation, and regional atlas sheets for Djibouti.

name: Portail Interactif de Djibouti
description: GeoHorn territorial portal for Djibouti with Leaflet map dashboards of INSTAD RGPH 2024 census indicators. Demography is published; heritage, health, education, and other themes are being rolled out.

name: Bahamas National Statistical Institute
description: Official statistics website of the Bahamas National Statistical Institute (BNSI). Publishes census, labour, national accounts, prices, foreign trade, vital, environmental and SDG statistics as themed pages and PDF reports.

name: National Social Care Data Portal for Wales
description: National Social Care Data Portal for Wales. Public catalog of social care workforce, demand, and population-projection indicators, replacing the former Daffodil Cymru projections platform.

name: InfoBaseCymru
description: InfoBaseCymru provides easy access to information for Wales, and allows you to view data in maps and tables. The information covers a range of themes from local authority level to a local area (lower super output area) level, as well as other regions.

name: Cardiff Council Open Data Catalog
description: Open data catalog published by Cardiff Council, featuring datasets on various local government topics for transparency and reuse.

name: Open Data Wales
description: Wales Open Data Portal – A catalog of open datasets published by Welsh public bodies.

name: NISRA Equality Matters
description: NISRA Equality Matters dashboard. Browse official Section 75 equality statistics from Northern Ireland departments by equality group, theme, and producer, with charts and links back to tables on the NISRA Data Portal.

name: NISRA Custom Area Profiles
description: NISRA Custom Area Profiles. Select one or more local government districts, district electoral areas, Super Data Zones, or Data Zones on a map to build a custom census and local-statistics profile with downloadable tables and charts.

name: NISRA Local Statistics Explorer
description: NISRA Local Statistics Explorer. Search a postcode or council area for headline official statistics across people, health, work, education, environment, crime, and the economy, with Northern Ireland averages for comparison. Distinct from the NISRA Data Portal (PxStat).

name: NISRA Flexible Table Builder
description: NISRA Census 2021 Flexible Table Builder. Build custom people and household tables, or search and customise ready-made Census 2021 tables for Northern Ireland. Distinct from the NISRA Data Portal (PxStat).

name: NISRA Census Area Explorer
description: NISRA Census Area Explorer for Census 2021. Interactive area profiles for Northern Ireland, the 11 local government districts, and smaller geographies, with comparisons to Census 2011. Distinct from the Census Flexible Table Builder.

name: PfG Wellbeing Framework
description: Programme for Government Wellbeing Framework dashboard. About 50 official statistics indicators across ten wellbeing domains, with improving/worsening assessments and geographic and Section 75 breakdowns. Underlying tables are on the NISRA Data Portal.

name: Historic Environment Scotland Downloads
description: Download datasets and access web services for Listed Buildings, Scheduled Monuments, Gardens and Designed Landscapes, Battlefields, Historic Marine Protected Areas, World Heritage Sites, Properties in Care, NRHE/Canmore, and Historic Landuse Assessment.

name: Scottish Parliament Open Data
description: Official open data portal of the Scottish Parliament, listing parliamentary datasets and APIs for reuse under an open licence.

name: Scottish Pollution Release Inventory
description: Scottish Pollution Release Inventory. Public search of industrial pollutant releases to air, water and waste transfers.

name: National Marine Plan Interactive (NMPi)
description: National Marine Plan Interactive (NMPi) is Marine Scotland's interactive mapping tool for spatial data supporting Scotland's National Marine Plan.

name: Scotland's Noise
description: Scotland strategic noise maps and downloads produced under the Environmental Noise Directive.

name: Scottish Remote Sensing Portal
description: Scottish Government portal for finding, sharing and reusing remote sensed data from Scottish public sector organisations. Currently provides Scottish Public Sector LiDAR downloads by 10km tiles and OGC web map services.

name: Find Scottish Government Data
description: Scottish Government discovery service for public datasets published across Scottish public-sector websites, powered by Dtechtive semantic search.

name: PA-X Peace Agreements Database
description: Searchable database of peace agreements and coded provisions, maintained at the University of Edinburgh.

name: Historic Environment Scotland
description: Historic Environment Scotland archives and collections catalogue for listed buildings, scheduled monuments, Canmore/NRHE records, and related heritage research collections.

name: Public Health Scotland COVID-19 Research Repository
description:
The COVID-19 Research Repository has been developed by Public Health Scotland (PHS) with an aim to bring together and provide access to Scottish COVID-19 research on a single shared platform in order to promote Scottish research to an international audience.

The main objectives of the repository are to:

    -make research easier to find
    -raise awareness of Scottish research
    -track, understand and report on the impact of this work
   - reduce duplication of effort
    -encourage a collaborative, cross-sectoral approach to COVID-19 research in Scotland
    -provide full-text open access to research wherever possible
    -ensure permanent preservation of PHS research

name: Research Data Scotland
description: We work with researchers, analysts and policymakers to make it faster and simpler to access public sector data for research.

name: Explore local statistics
description: Office for National Statistics Explore Local Statistics service. Find, compare, and visualise subnational indicators for places across the United Kingdom, with bulk downloads in CSV, XLSX, CSVW, and JSON-stat.

name: Tax Justice Network Data Portal
description: Searchable catalog of country-level tax and financial transparency variables, including the Financial Secrecy Index, Corporate Tax Haven Index, State of Tax Justice and macroeconomic indicator collections.

name: Office for Budget Responsibility Data
description: Office for Budget Responsibility public-finances databank, historical forecasts, and supplementary fiscal and economic tables.

name: UKHSA data dashboard
description: UK Health Security Agency public health dashboard sharing indicators on respiratory viruses, healthcare-associated infections, antimicrobial resistance, vaccinations, syndromic surveillance, and other health threats that inform public health decision making in England. Data can be viewed in charts and maps, downloaded as CSV or JSON, and queried through a public API.

name: Explore education statistics
description: Department for Education official statistics dissemination service. Find publications, build tables, and download datasets on schools, further education, higher education, children's social care, and related education themes, with a public statistics API.

name: Justice Data
description: At-a-glance data on services provided by the Ministry of Justice, using quality assured and published data. Covers justice in numbers, CJS statistics, prisons, probation, contracted services, courts, and legal aid for England and Wales.

name: Road traffic statistics
description: Department for Transport street-level and summary road traffic statistics for Great Britain. Explore traffic by vehicle type, road type, region, and local authority, with bulk CSV downloads and a public REST API for count points and flows.

name: Discover Water
description: Public indicators of drinking-water quality, leakage, supply, and environmental performance for water companies in England and Wales.

name: Bank of England Database
description: Bank of England database portal for browsing, visualizing and exporting data series published by the Bank of England. Includes interest rates, exchange rates, yield curves, money and credit statistics, household credit, business finance, and other economic indicators. Provides daily spot rates for GBP, EUR, and USD, as well as official Bank Rate history and yield curves.

name: ONS Census 2021 custom dataset
description: Office for National Statistics Census 2021 custom dataset builder for England and Wales. Select a population type, geography, and variables to build and download multivariate census tables. Distinct from Nomis census tables.

name: Environmental Information Data Centre (CEH)
description: Data catalog from the UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology, providing access to environmental data, including datasets on biodiversity, soils, vegetation, and more.

name: Thames Water Open Data
description: Open data portal for Thames Water network, environmental, and service datasets covering London and the Thames Valley.

name: UK Energy Performance of Buildings data
description: Official download service for Energy Performance Certificates and Display Energy Certificates for buildings in England and Wales.

name: Met Office Weather DataHub
description: Met Office API catalog of UK and global NWP model output (UM Global, UKV, MOGREPS), site-specific forecasts, land observations, warnings, and map imagery.

name: NaPTAN and NPTG
description: National catalog of public transport access nodes and the National Public Transport Gazetteer for England, Scotland, and Wales, with downloads and an API.

name: Food Standards Agency Data
description: Food Standards Agency open data. Datasets on food hygiene ratings, approved food establishments, local authority enforcement, biotoxins, animal welfare, incidents and recalls, and related policy and research data.

name: Defra Data Services Platform
description: Defra group have put in place the Data Services Platform to make environmental data openly available to a wide range of users. The more people know about the environment, the better informed will be their actions and decisions. Data is available for download in commonly used formats and via APIs; much is spatial and can be used in GIS applications.

name: Ocean Data Viewer - UNEP-WCMC
description: Contemporary datasets on Ocean+ Data Viewer will remain available under the Ocean+ tag on the UNEP-WCMC GIS Portal. A small number of older datasets are being archived. The website provides datasets on ocean habitats, including coral, mangrove, seagrass, saltmarsh, and cold-water coral, supporting environmental research, conservation, and policy.

name: Bath: Hacked Datastore
description: Open data about Bath & North East Somerset

name: Planning Data
description: A platform to help create services to inform planning and housing decisions in England. Find planning and housing data that is easy to use and trust; explore data on a map, search and filter, and use the Planning Data API.

name: Elexon BMRS
description: Balancing Mechanism Reporting Service for Great Britain electricity market and system data.

name: DPUK Data Portal
description: A data repository providing access to multi-modal cohort data including lifestyle information, cognitive test results, brain imaging, and genetics, from over 60 population and clinical cohorts. Enables secure, remote analysis for research into dementia and related conditions.

name: JNCC Open Data
description: JNCC Open Data Portal. Search and access nature conservation data and resources via the JNCC Resource Hub. Joint Nature Conservation Committee (UK).

name: Research datasets | Bank of England
description: The database draws on previously published datasets compiled by various public and private sector sources. It combines elements of these, together with new datasets, including the Inflation Attitudes Survey, which contains individual responses on inflation and other economic variables.

name: UK Research & Statistics Official
description: Research and statistics published by UK government departments and agencies, covering a wide range of topics and sectors.

name: Department for Business and Trade Data API
description: Public dataset API from the Department for Business and Trade, listing UK tariff, trade quota, export-control and related open datasets with JSON metadata and table downloads.

name: Open Net Zero by Icebreaker One
description: Open Net Zero is a data catalogue that indexes datasets across industry, environment, and finance, helping users search and access data stored on other platforms.

name: National Gas Transmission Data Portal
description: Operational gas transmission data published by National Gas for the Great Britain network.

name: Bus Open Data Service
description: England's bus open-data catalog. Timetables, vehicle locations, and fares; fares are published using the UK NeTEx profile.

name: Cefas Data Portal
description: Cefas catalog of marine, fisheries, aquaculture and environmental datasets from UK monitoring and research programmes.

name: Omics Discovery Index (OmicsDI)
description: The Omics Discovery Index (OmicsDI) provides a knowledge discovery framework across heterogeneous omics data (genomics, proteomics, transcriptomics and metabolomics).

name: Opendatabay
description: Licensed marketplace for AI-ready and LLM training datasets (text, image, audio, video, code, synthetic, and other modalities). Listings are publicly browsable; dataset access is sold under provider-set commercial or research licenses. Operated by Opendatabay Ltd, a UK company.

name: Rail Data Marketplace
description: Catalog of Great Britain rail data products, including open datasets and licensed feeds.

name: MEDIN Discovery Metadata Portal
description: UK marine metadata catalog for discovering datasets held by MEDIN Data Archive Centres and partner organisations.

name: WebTRIS
description: Map and API of National Highways traffic monitoring sites and historic flow data. Live updates are paused; historic observations remain available.

name: COMET-LiCS Sentinel-1 InSAR Portal
description: COMET-LiCS portal for Sentinel-1 interferograms and coherence products processed with the LiCSAR processor.

name: OS Data Hub
description: Great Britain's geospatial data platform operated by Ordnance Survey. Provides APIs and downloads for OS OpenData and Premium products, including maps, addresses, boundaries, terrain, and transport networks.

name: GeoSeer
description: GeoSeer is a geospatial search engine that indexes OGC web services (WMS, WFS, WCS, WMTS). It discovers endpoints, fetches GetCapabilities documents, cleans and deduplicates layers, and records spatial extents. As of February 2026, GeoSeer's published statistics report about 3.53 million live datasets (~3.10 million distinct), about 350 thousand services across roughly 309 thousand endpoints, from about 4,235 hosts in 97 countries. The free search and API omit some low-value layers; GeoSeer Licensed database products may include additional records.

name: ONS Developer Hub - API Catalog
description: Office for National Statistics Developer Portal, providing API access and documentation for ONS datasets and related resources.

name: UK public sector APIs
description: Catalogue of APIs published by public sector organisations in the UK. Collects a list of government APIs to understand what APIs are published, where development is taking place, and whether APIs are suitable for reuse. Assists users across government in finding and accessing inter-departmental data exchanges and sharing best practices in API development.

name: UniChem
description: EMBL-EBI chemical identifier mapping service that cross-references structures across public chemistry databases.

name: SLA Speech Tools
description: SLA Speech Tools constitutes a free and public repository for researchers and teachers that are interested in using materials/tools on second language speech acquisition and pronunciation teaching in diverse educational contexts.

name: SUITS Data Repository
description: The SUITS Open Data Repository (S-ODR) is a global repository for urban mobility data collections (e.g. citizen mobility, freight traffic, FCD, parking, traffic lights, etc.), acquired from the partners of the H2020/SUITS Project (https://www.suits-project.eu/). However, any other contributor of relevant such datasets is invited and welcome to contribute. Anonymized or pseudonymized (only) contributions can be uploaded after registration. Data access is free, respecting license terms & conditions.

name: Virtual Parts Repository
description: The Virtual Parts Repository (VPR) is a repository of reusable, modular and composable models of biological parts.

name: Wellcome Collections - Images
description: Wellcome Images is one of the Wellcome Library's major visual collections and also forms part of Wellcome Collection. Wellcome Images is one of the world's richest and most unique collections, with themes ranging from medical and social history to contemporary healthcare and biomedical science.

name: Digital Bodleian
description: Digital Bodleian first launched in 2015 with the aim of bringing together digitized content from the Bodleian Libraries’ extraordinary and rich collections into a single portal. The Bodleian Libraries have been digitizing content since the early 1990s and Digital Bodleian was and is designed to enable access to that content for the widest possible audience. Digital Bodleian quickly established itself as a key resource for research and teaching based on Bodleian Libraries’ collections, and usage has steadily increased over the years since launch. The site has relaunched, in late 2020, with a new and improved search and discovery interface, which aims to: facilitate improved searching, filtering and browsing of collection items; improve display of item-level metadata; enable viewing and download of highest-quality resolution images for the purposes of non-commercial research and teaching; and improve curation and delivery of Bodleian Libraries content, as well as the delivery of content on behalf of partners such as Oxford’s colleges and Digital Humanities projects. The relaunched Digital Bodleian benefited from funding from the Oxford University GLAM Digital Strategy Implementation Programme, and the technical redevelopment was completed in partnership with text & bytes LLC. The Bodleian Libraries are committed to digitizing as many of our special collections holdings as possible, but the vastness of these holdings means that only a relatively small amount is available online. If you would like to explore our special collections further, there are a number of additional online resources available. These include the main library catalogue for print collections SOLO, where information about, for example, rare books can be found; Bodleian Archives & Manuscripts, which contains information about our post-1500 archival and manuscript collections; and numerous TEI catalogues, which contain records for our Western medieval and non-Western manuscript collections. Guidance on all of our available finding aids is provided by Weston Library Special Collections. Digital Bodleian also works in partnership with a number of Oxford colleges and Digital Humanities projects to deliver images of their collections.

name: Plants of the World Online
description: The Plants of the World Online portal (POWO), is a database created to store information on all the world's known seed-bearing plants.Coverage will increase over time. Data comes from a variety of sources which are both monographic (global) and regional in scope. These data sources vary in the extent to which comprehensive synonymy is included, their stage of development (proximity to publication) and the degree to which they have been exposed to peer review.

name: Identifiers.org Central Registry
description: The Identifiers.org Central Registry provides the necessary information for the generation and resolution of unique and perennial identifiers for life science data. Those identifiers are both in URI and compact form, and make use of Identifiers.org to provide direct access to the identified data records on the Web. Resource maintainers request an Identifiers.org prefix for their databases or services.

name: ClinicalCodes.org Clinical Code Repository
description: The ClinicalCodes repository aims to hold code lists for all published electronic medical record studies, irrespective of code type (e.g. Read, ICD9-10, SNOMED) and database (CPRD, QResearch, THIN etc.). Once deposited, code lists will be freely available, with no login needed to download codes.

name: UK Reading Experience Database
description: UK RED is an open-access database housed at The Open University containing over 30,000 easily searchable records documenting the history of reading in Britain from 1450 to 1945. Evidence of reading presented in UK RED is drawn from published and unpublished sources as diverse as diaries, commonplace books, memoirs, sociological surveys, and criminal court and prison records.

name: Zeta Functions of Lie Rings Archive
description: This archive of zeta functions of Lie rings delivers PDF files detailing the zeta function calculated; these contain the local zeta functions, the functional equation they satisfy (if there is one), the abscissa of convergence of the global zeta function and the order of the pole, the ghost zeta function, and the natural boundary (if it has one).

name: Electron Microscopy Data Bank
description: Public archive of electron microscopy density maps of macromolecular complexes and subcellular structures.

name: Collaborative OPen Omics
description:
Collaborative OPen Omics (COPO) is an online platform that serves as a metadata broker, facilitating the description of research data like reads, samples, images, sequence annotations, assemblies and data files in alignment with the FAIR (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability and Reusability) principles.

By supporting various community-recognised metadata standards, data formats and Application Programming Interface (API) methods, COPO ensures that data is accurately described, discoverable and can be easily integrated across different systems. This promotes enhanced collaboration, better data management, and long-term preservation thereby, making scientific outputs more accessible and reusable for a wider audience.

Submitted data are stored in public repositories, enabling open access and ensuring that valuable research outputs are shared, reused, and built upon by the global research community. COPO integrates with key international data repositories promoting the open exchange of scientific data and advancing discoveries in various fields of life sciences.

name: Open Source Brain
description: Open Source Brain is a resource for sharing and collaboratively developing computational models of neural systems.

name: Codex
description: CODEX is a curated, comprehensible database of next generation sequencing (NGS) experiments, including ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, DNase-seq and ATAC-seq. It includes NGS experiments from both mice and humans. While the main focus of CODEX is haematopoiesis and embryonic systems, the database includes a wide range of cell types.

name: International Mouse Phenotyping Consortium
description: The International Mouse Phenotyping Consortium (IMPC) produces a publicly-available repository that stores information on IMPC processes, data and annotations. The IMPC is an international effort by 19 research institutions to identify the function of every protein-coding gene in the mouse genome by switching off or ‘knocking out’ each of the roughly 20,000 genes that make up the mouse genome.

name: Aberdeen Birth Cohorts
description: The University has followed all of the children born in Aberdeen in 1921, 1936, and 1950-1956 as they grow and age. Collectively these groups are known as the ABERDEEN BIRTH COHORTS, and are a jewel in the crown of Scottish health research and have helped to advance our understanding of aging well. The Children of the 1950s study is a population-based resource for the study of biological and social influences on health across the life-course and between generations.

name: European Variation Archive
description: Open archive of genetic variation data from all species, including studies, variants, and files.

name: York Digital Library
description: York Digital Library, operated by University of York, provides research data on humanities and social sciences, history, and fine arts, music, theatre and media studies.

name: Blocks of finite groups
description: Blocks of finite groups is a research database and collaborative wiki dedicated to the study of block theory in finite group representation theory. It gathers classifications, known results, conjectures, and references related to blocks, including information on Morita equivalence classes and Donovan’s conjecture.

name: The DNA Replication Origin Database
description: This database summarizes our knowledge of replication origins in the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Each proposed origin site has been assigned a Status (Confirmed, Likely, or Dubious) expressing the confidence that the site genuinely corresponds to an origin.

name: Ontology Lookup Service (OLS)
description: The Ontology Lookup Service (OLS) provides a centralized repository for biomedical ontologies, enabling users to search, browse, and access ontology terms and their relationships. OLS4 is the latest version offering improved search capabilities, RESTful API access, and support for a wide range of biomedical and life sciences ontologies.

name: Western Channel Observatory Data Portal
description: Western Channel Observatory data pages for long-term oceanographic and biological time series in the western English Channel.

name: Network of Cancer Genes
description: The Network of Cancer Genes (NCG) contains information on duplicability, evolution, protein-protein and microRNA-gene interaction, function, expression and essentiality of cancer genes from manually curated publications . NCG also provides information on the experimental validation that supports the role of these genes in cancer and annotates their properties (duplicability, evolutionary origin, expression profile, function and interactions with proteins and miRNAs).

name: The Encyclopedia of Proteome Dynamics
description: The EPD has been created and is maintained by the Lamond group in the University of Dundee. It combines a polyglot persistent database and web-application that provides open access to integrated proteomics data for >30 000 proteins from published studies on human cells and model organisms. It is designed to provide a user-friendly interface, featuring graphical navigation with interactive visualizations that facilitate powerful data exploration in an intuitive manner. The EPD offers a flexible and scalable ecosystem to integrate proteomics data with genomics information, RNA expression and other related, large-scale datasets.

name: Health Data Research Gateway
description: A portal enabling researchers and innovators in academia, industry and the NHS to search for and request access to UK health data.

name: Polonsky Foundation Digitization Project
description: Through the generous support of The Polonsky Foundation, this project made 1.5 million digitized pages freely available. Portions of the Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana (Vatican Library) and the Bodleian Libraries’ collections of Hebrew manuscripts, Greek manuscripts, and incunabula were selected for digitization by a team of scholars and curators from around the world. The selection process was informed by a balance of scholarly and practical concerns; conservation staff at the Bodleian and Vatican Libraries worked with curators to assess not only the significance of the content, but the physical condition of the items, prioritizing items that are robust enough to withstand being transported to the imaging studio and handled by the photographers. In order to preserve the integrity and completeness of the manuscript collections, the libraries also agreed to digitize whole collections where appropriate. While the Vatican and the Bodleian had been creating digital images from our collections for a number of years, this project provided an opportunity for both libraries to increase the scale of their digitization services. In both cases, this meant significant investments in the equipment, infrastructure and people that make digitization possible. Over the course of this project, both libraries also revealed information about their digitization techniques and methods.

name: Vertebrate Gene Nomenclature Committee
description: The Vertebrate Gene Nomenclature Committee (VGNC) is an extension of the established HGNC (HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee) project that names human genes. VGNC is responsible for assigning standardized names to genes in selected vertebrate species that lack a nomenclature authority; currently these are chimpanzee, macaque, dog, cat, cattle, pig and horse. The VGNC also coordinates with the existing vertebrate nomenclature committees, MGNC (mouse), RGNC (rat), CGNC (chicken), XNC (Xenopus frog) and ZNC (zebrafish), to ensure genes are named in line with their human homologs.

name: NSHD46 Database
description: The NSHD46 Database is an online showcase of the National Survey of Health and Development 1946 birth cohort, listing variables and metadata collected over decades of follow‑up. It allows researchers to browse and discover clinical, biological, questionnaire, and life‑course data from the study before applying for access. While only non‑sensitive summary information is displayed, it helps researchers plan and request detailed data for health and population research.

name: Patient-Derived tumor Xenograft Finder
description: PDX Finder is an open repository for the upload and storage of clinical, genomic and functional Patient-Derived Xenograph (PDX) data which provides a comprehensive global catalogue of PDX models available for researchers across distributed repository databases. Integrated views are provided for histopathological image data, molecular classification of tumors, host mouse strain metadata, tumor genomic data and metrics on tumor response to chemotherapeutics. The data model for PDX Finder is based on the minimal information standard for PDX models developed in collaboration with a broad range of stakeholders who create and/or use PDX models in basic and pre-clinical cancer research.

name: WorldPop Open Population Repository
description: Open access to global development data, primarily focusing on high resolution, gridded population estimates and related demographic statistics. Available data includes population counts, demographics, and model outputs at 100m and 1km resolutions, integrated from census, satellite, survey, and other sources.

name: Old Bailey Proceedings Online
description: The Old Bailey Proceedings Online makes available a fully searchable, digitised collection of all surviving editions of the Old Bailey Proceedings from 1674 to 1913, and of the Ordinary of Newgate's Accounts between 1676 and 1772.
