It allows access to over 197,000 trials and biographical details of approximately 2,500 men and women executed at Tyburn, free of charge for non-commercial use.

name: ForestPlots Forest Inventory Network
description: Network and repository of tropical and subtropical forest plot inventory data.

name: BioImage Archive
description: Public archive for biological images from any imaging modality, from near-atomic to whole-organism scales.

name: The Forensic Linguistic Databank
description: The Forensic Linguistic Databank (FoLD) is a permanent, controlled‑access online repository of forensic linguistic data hosted by the Aston Institute for Forensic Linguistics at Aston University. It contains a diverse range of language datasets relevant to forensic analysis, such as malicious communications, investigative interviews, legal documents, and online posts, which support research into language and the justice system.

name: BioModels
description: Repository of mathematical models of biological and biomedical systems, including SBML and related formats.

name: Research Data Oxford
description: Research data management is a general term covering how you organize, structure, store, and care for the information used or generated during a research project. The University of Oxford policy mandates the preservation of research data and records for a minimum of 3 years after publication. A place to securely hold digital research materials (data) of any sort along with documentation that helps explain what they are and how to use them (metadata).

name: Launchpad
description: Launchpad is a software and source code repository with a number of features including bug tracking, translations, new feature tracking and both Bazaar and Git version control.

name: IntAct
description: Open catalog of molecular interactions curated from the literature and user submissions, part of the IMEx consortium.

name: Air Information Resource
description: Data Archive on UK-AIR (Air Information Resource) provides information on air quality and air pollution in the UK. A range of information is available, from the latest pollution levels, pollution forecast information, a data archive, and details of the various monitoring networks.

name: UK Stem Cell Bank
description: The UK Stem Cell Bank (UKSCB) facilitates the use and sharing of quality-controlled stem cell lines to support scientific research and clinical development of stem cell therapies.  The work of the UK Stem Cell Bank covers three main areas: banking for all UK-derived human embryonic stem cell lines, research in the standardisation, quality and safety of human pluripotent stem cell (hPSC)-based products, and regulation regarding international best practice, policies and guidelines relating to stem cell use and regulation around the world.

name: HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee
description: HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee catalog of approved symbols and names for human genes.

name: OmniPath: intra- & intercellular signaling knowledge
description: OmniPath is a database of molecular biology prior knowledge. It combines data from more than 100 resources and contains protein-protein and gene regulatory interactions, enzyme-PTM relationships, protein complexes, protein annotations and intercellular communication.

name: Pesticide Properties Database (PPDB)
description: Curated database of pesticide physicochemical, human-health, and ecotoxicological properties.

name: PSDI Data Sources
description: Catalog of physical-sciences data sources in the UK Physical Sciences Data Infrastructure, including crystallography, materials, and chemistry databases. Successor to the Physical Sciences Data-Science Service.

name: International Plant Names Index
description: The International Plant Names Index (IPNI) provides nomenclatural information (spelling, author, types and first place and date of publication) for the scientific names of Vascular Plants from Family down to infraspecific ranks.

name: BioCatalogue
description: The BioCatalogue provided a common interface for registering, browsing and annotating Web Services to the Life Science community. Services in the BioCatalogue could be described and searched in multiple ways based upon their technical types, bioinformatics categories, user tags, service providers or data inputs and outputs. They were also subject to constant monitoring, allowing the identification of service problems and changes and the filtering-out of unavailable or unreliable resources. The system was accessible via a human-readable ‘Web 2.0’-style interface and a programmatic Web Service interface. The BioCatalogue followed a community approach in which all services can be registered, browsed and incrementally documented with annotations by any member of the scientific community.

name: EMPIAR
description: Electron Microscopy Public Image Archive for raw 2D electron microscopy images supporting 3D reconstructions.

name: PhytoPath
description: PhytoPath is a new bioinformatics resource that integrates genome-scale data from important plant pathogen species with literature-curated information about the phenotypes of host infection. Using the Ensembl Genomes browser, it provides access to complete genome assembly and gene models of priority crop and model-fungal, oomycete and bacterial phytopathogens. PhytoPath also links genes to disease progression using data from the curated PHI-base resource.

name: UKRI Gateway to Research
description: UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) Gateway to Research (GtR), a public catalog of UK publicly funded research and innovation. It covers awards, projects, organisations, people, publications, and research outcomes, with open APIs and data published under the Open Government Licence.

name: Catalogue of Somatic Mutations in Cancer
description: The Catalogue of Somatic Mutations in Cancer (COSMIC) is a database of manually-curated somatic mutation information relating to human cancers. The COSMIC database combines manually-curated data and genome-wide screen data.

name: World Data Centre for Geomagnetism, Edinburgh
description: The WDC Geomagnetism, Edinburgh has a comprehensive set of digital geomagnetic data as well as indices of geomagnetic activity supplied from a worldwide network of magnetic observatories. The data and services at the WDC are available for scientific use without restrictions.

name: ChEBI
description: Chemical Entities of Biological Interest: EMBL-EBI ontology and dictionary of small molecular entities.

name: Flytrap
description: Flytrap is an interactive database for displaying gene expression patterns, in particular P[GAL4] patterns, via an intuitive WWW based interface. This development consists of two components, the first being the html interface to the database and the second, a tool-kit for constructing and maintaining the database.

name: UK Solar System Data Centre Data Archive
description: The UK Solar System Data Centre (UKSSDC) is the Natural Environment Research Council's (NERC) Designated Data Centre for the Solar terrestrial physics and chemistry. It provides a central archive and data centre facility for Solar System science in the UK. The UKSSDC supports data archives for the whole UK solar system community encompassing solar, inter-planetary, magnetospheric, ionospheric and geomagnetic science. The UKSSDC is part of RAL Space based at the STFC run Rutherford Appleton Laboratory in Oxfordshire.

name: BioTime
description: BioTIME is a comprehensive collection of assemblage time-series in which the abundances of the species that comprise ecological communities have been monitored over time. The database is a free, publicly available, open-access resource.

name: CATH Protein Structure Classification
description: Hierarchical classification of protein domain structures at Class, Architecture, Topology, and Homologous superfamily levels.

name: The Structural Antibody Database
description: The SAbDab (Structural Antibody Database) is a specialized bioinformatics resource that collects and organizes all publicly available antibody structures deposited in the Protein Data Bank (PDB). It provides consistently curated annotations including antibody sequences, heavy/light chain pairings, antigen information, structural classifications, and binding affinity data. Researchers can search, visualize, and download individual antibody structures or customized datasets for structural and computational analyses.

name: PomBase
description: Comprehensive database for fission yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe, including annotation, literature, and large-scale datasets.

name: Description of Plant Viruses
description: DPVweb provides a central source of information about viruses, viroids and satellites of plants, fungi and protozoa. Comprehensive taxonomic information, including brief descriptions of each family and genus, and classified lists of virus sequences are provided. The database also holds detailed, curated, information for all sequences of viruses, viroids and satellites of plants, fungi and protozoa that are complete or that contain at least one complete gene. The database will not be updated with sequence or taxonomic data from Aug 2013.

name: DatabasE of genomiC varIation and Phenotype in Humans using Ensembl Resources
description: DECIPHER (Database of Chromosomal Imbalance and Phenotype in Humans Using Ensembl Resources) is an international web-based platform that shares genetic and phenotypic data from rare disease patients and provides variant interpretation interfaces

name: Pancreatic Expression database
description: The Pancreatic Expression Database (PED) is a repository for pancreatic-derived -omics data. With a generic web-based system, the database provides the research community with an open access tool to mine currently available pancreatic cancer experimental data sets generated by using large-scale transcriptomic, genomic, proteomic, miRNA and methylomic platforms. The website also provides users with the opportunity to include their own published dataset in the database.

name: MRC National Survey of Health and Development
description: The MRC National Survey of Health and Development 1946 (NSHD) was the first ever British birth cohort study. It has collected information from birth to the current day on the health and life circumstances of five and a half thousand men and women born during a week in March 1946 throughout England, Wales, and Scotland. The study explores differences in child development by factors like social class, biological factors, health and education.

name: Centre for Environmental Data Analysis Archive
description: The CEDA Archive operates the atmospheric and earth observation data centre functions on behalf of NERC for the UK atmospheric science and earth observation communities. It covers climate, composition, observations and NWP data as well as various earth observation datasets, including airborne and satellite data and imagery.

name: CAPS-DB : a structural classification of helix-capping motifs
description: CAPS-DB is a structural classification of helix-cappings or caps compiled from protein structures. Caps extracted from protein structures have been structurally classified based on geometry and conformation and organized in a tree-like hierarchical classification where the different levels correspond to different properties of the caps.

name: European Nucleotide Archive
description: EMBL-EBI archive of the world's nucleotide sequencing information, covering raw reads, assemblies, and annotated sequences as Europe's INSDC node.

name: Oxford Text Archive
description: The Oxford Text Archive develops, collects, catalogues and preserves electronic literary and linguistic resources for use in Higher Education, in research, teaching and learning. We also give advice on the creation and use of these resources, and are involved in the development of standards and infrastructure for electronic language resources.

name: Imperial College Research Computing Service Data Repository
description: A lightweight digital repository for data based on the concepts of collections of filesets and the relationships between them. Both the collection and the fileset are assigned a DOI by the DataCite organisation which can be quoted in articles. Browsing and data deposition are available only when logged in.

name: The Polygenic Score Catalog
description: The Polygenic Score Catalog is an open database of published polygenic scores (PGS; also referred to as polygenic risk scores [PRS] or genetic/genomic risk scores [GRS]).  Each PGS in the Catalog is consistently annotated with relevant metadata; including scoring files (variants, effect alleles/weights), annotations of how the PGS was developed and applied, and evaluations of their predictive performance.

name: The International Genome Sample Resource
description: The International Genome Sample Resource (IGSR) was established to ensure the ongoing usability of data generated by the 1000 Genomes Project and to extend the data set. The 1000 Genomes Project ran between 2008 and 2015, creating the largest public catalogue of human variation and genotype data. As the project ended, the Data Coordination Centre at EMBL-EBI has received continued funding from the Wellcome Trust to maintain and expand the resource. IGSR was set up to do this and has the following aims: ensure the future access to and usability of the 1000 Genomes reference data; incorporate additional published genomic data on the 1000 Genomes samples; and expand the data collection to include new populations not represented in the 1000 Genomes Project.

name: GENCODE
description: Reference annotation of gene features in the human and mouse genomes based on biological evidence.

name: West of Scotland Twenty-07 Study
description: The Twenty-07 Study was set up in 1986 in order to investigate the reasons for differences in health by socio-economic circumstances, gender, area of residence, age, ethnic group, and family type. 4510 people are being followed for 20 years. The initial wave of data collection took place in 1987/8, when respondents were aged 15, 35 and 55. The final wave of data collection took place in 2007/08 when respondents were aged 35, 55 and 75.

name: World Data Centre for Glaciology, Cambridge
description: Until 2014 housed in the library of the Scott Polar Research Institute, the WDC for Glaciology, Cambridge, maintains a particularly comprehensive collection of publications covering all aspects of snow and ice worldwide. Glaciological literature has been systematically collected and catalogued at the Scott Polar Research Institute since 1920. The SPRI Picture Library houses one of the world's most comprehensive collections of historical photographs of the Polar Regions.

name: ChemSpider
description: Royal Society of Chemistry structure-centric chemical database aggregating identifiers, properties, and literature from many sources.

name: Clinical Study Data Request Platform
description: ClinicalStudyDataRequest.com (CSDR) is a consortium of clinical study Sponsors/Funders. It is a leader in the data sharing community inspired to drive scientific innovation and improve medical care by facilitating access to patient-level data from clinical studies. CSDR seeks to be the researcher-preferred and trusted platform for responsible sharing of high quality patient-level data for the purpose of facilitating innovative data-driven research leading to improvements in patient care. This will be accomplished through the facilitation of the responsible sharing of patient-level data from a range of clinical study Sponsors/Funders through a researcher-friendly platform, utilizing industry leading practices, including an independent review of proposals and protection of patient privacy and confidentiality.

name: CCDC Access Structures
description: Public CCDC Access Structures service for deposited organic and metal-organic crystal structures.

name: European Xenopus Resource Center
description: The European Xenopus Resource Centre (EXRC) is situated in Portsmouth, United Kingdom and provides tools and services to support researchers using Xenopus models. The EXRC depends on researchers to obtain and deposit Xenopus transgenic and mutant lines, Xenopus in-situ hybridization clones, Xenopus specific antibodies and other resources with the centre. EXRC staff perform quality assurance testing on these reagents and then makes them available to the community at cost.

name: Centre for Environmental Data Analysis
description: The CEDA Archive is the national data centre for atmospheric and earth observation research. We host over 15 Petabytes of atmospheric and earth observation data. Sources include aircraft campaigns, satellites, automatic weather stations and climate models, amongst many more.

name: SureChEMBL
description: EMBL-EBI patent chemistry database extracting and indexing chemical structures from the patent literature.

name: Virgo Millennium Database
description: When published in 2005, the Millennium Run was the largest ever simulation of the formation of structure within the ΛCDM cosmology. It uses 10(10) particles to follow the dark matter distribution in a cubic region 500h(−1)Mpc on a side, and has a spatial resolution of 5h−1kpc.

name: myExperiment
description: myExperiment is a collaborative environment where scientists can safely publish their workflows and in silico experiments, share them with groups and find those of others. Workflows, other digital objects and bundles (called Packs) can now be swapped, sorted and searched like photos and videos on the Web.

name: ChemBio Hub
description: The ChemBio Hub vision is to provide the tools that will make it easier for Oxford University scientists to connect with colleagues to improve their research, to satisfy funders that the data they have paid for is being managed according to their policies, and to make new alliances with pharma and biotech partners. Funding and development of the ChemBio Hub was ending on the 30th June 2016.

name: Human Organ Atlas
description: The Human Organ Atlas provides Hierarchical Phase-Contrast Tomography images of human anatomy from the micron to whole organ scale. Human tissue is inherently hierarchical and multiscale with cells, tissues and organs organised into specific structures at each of the levels.

name: Office for National Statistics
description: The Office for National Statistics (ONS) is the UK’s largest independent producer of official statistics and is the recognised national statistical institute for the UK. It is responsible for collecting and publishing statistics related to the economy, population and society at national, regional and local levels. It also conducts the census in England and Wales every ten years.

name: The Health Improvement Network
description: THIN is a medical data collection scheme that collects anonymised patient data from its members through the healthcare software Vision. The UK Primary Care database contains longitudinal patient records for approximately 6% of the UK Population. The anonymised data collection, which goes back to 1994, is nationally representative of the UK population.

name: INTERMAGNET Data Viewer
description: British Geological Survey host of the INTERMAGNET geomagnetic observatory catalog, with public visualisation, provisional and definitive data downloads, and bulk observatory files.

name: British Association of Dermatologists Biologic and Immunomodulators Register
description: British Association of Dermatologists Biologic and Immunomodulators Register (BADBIR) is a clinical study to monitor the long-term safety of drugs used to treat psoriasis.

name: Complex Portal
description: Manually curated catalog of macromolecular complexes with participants, topology, and experimental evidence.

name: Wellcome Sanger Institute Data Resources
description: The Wellcome Sanger Institute Data Resources provide access to a wide range of large-scale genomic and biological datasets generated by the institute’s research programs. These resources include human, pathogen, cancer, cellular, and biodiversity genomics data, often produced through international collaborations and major sequencing initiatives. The platform serves as a gateway to datasets, archives, and data portals that support biomedical and life science research worldwide.

name: FlyAtlas 2
description: FlyAtlas 2 is the RNA-Seq successor to the original FlyAtlas (which was based on microarray analysis). Specifically, FlyAtlas 2 now provides access to: transcript information, sex-specific data for adult somatic tissues, and micro-RNA genes. FlyAtlas2 supports search by gene, category or tissue; and functionality has been improved through mobile support and the option to download results in spreadsheet format. Gene coverage has been extended by the inclusion of microRNAs and many of the RNA genes included in Release 6 of the Drosophila reference genome. The web interface has been modified to accommodate the extra data, but at the same time has been adapted for viewing on small mobile devices. Users also have access to the RNA-Seq reads displayed alongside the annotated Drosophila genome in the (external) UCSC browser, and are able to link out to the previous FlyAtlas resource to compare the data obtained by RNA-Seq with that obtained using microarrays.

name: ChEMBL
description: Manually curated EMBL-EBI database of bioactive drug-like small molecules, assays, and targets extracted from the literature.

name: The National Archives
description: The National Archives is the UK government's official archive and publisher. It preserves over 1,000 years of history, from medieval manuscripts to digital records, and provides guidance on information management while ensuring public access to national records.

name: Galaxy Zoo
description: Galaxies, made up of billions of stars like our Sun, are the beacons that light up the structure of even the most distant regions in space. Not all galaxies are alike, however. They come in very different shapes and have very different properties; they may be large or small, old or young, red or blue, regular or confused, luminous or faint, dusty or gas-poor, rotating or static, round or disky, and they live either in splendid isolation or in clusters.

name: Continuous Plankton Recorder Survey
description: The Continuous Plankton Recorder (CPR) Survey has been monitoring the pulse of the oceans through the plankton since 1931. The CPR is a robust and reliable instrument designed to capture plankton samples over huge areas of ocean. The CPR is usually towed from the stern of volunteer merchant ships such as RoRo and Container Ships. However this versatile recorder has also been deployed from large sailing vessels, fishing boats and super tankers. The methodology has been used across the world's oceans, as well as in the North Sea, the Mediterranean, the Baltic, and in freshwater lakes.

name: UKEOF Catalogue
description: This catalogue provides United Kingdom environmental observations. The website for this resource is being updated and therefore it may not be completely available.

name: searchRxiv
description: searchRxiv enables researchers to: post their searches, ensuring credit for all those involved; obtain a digital object identifier (DOI) for their search, enabling it to be cited; link searches to published articles as relevant; find it easier to follow best practice for structuring their search strategy; and easily find relevant searches in their subject area by searching across search strings as well as metadata describing those search strings.

name: Met Office Hadley Centre Observations Dataset
description: HadCRUT4 is a gridded dataset of global historical surface temperature anomalies relative to a 1961-1990 reference period. Data are available for each month since January 1850, on a 5 degree grid. The dataset is a collaborative product of the Met Office Hadley Centre and the Climatic Research Unit at the University of East Anglia.

name: RNAcentral
description: Unified catalog of non-coding RNA sequences integrating expert databases into a single access point.

name: Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable Environmental and Health Registry
description: FAIREHR allows researchers to preregister their studies in the field of human and environmental health, following the FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) guidance principles.

name: ionomicHUB
description: ionomicHUB provides curated ionomic data on many thousands of plant samples freely available to the public. It is an international collaborative cyber research environment to help identify and understand the genes and gene networks that function to control the ionome, the mineral nutrient and trace element composition of an organism or tissue. The iHUB is a collaborative workspace with components that integrate both cyberinfrastructure and human interactions to maximize both community access to ionomic resources, and knowledge extraction from these resources.

name: Public Geodata Repository
description: OSGeo's mission is to support the collaborative development of open source geospatial software, in part by providing resources for projects and promoting freely available geodata. The Public Geodata Repository is a distributed repository and registry of data sources free to access, reuse, and re-distribute.

name: Rothamsted e-RA
description: Electronic Rothamsted Archive of long-term agricultural experiment and meteorological datasets.

name: Climate Action Plan Explorer
description: The Climate Action Plan Explorer (CAPE) is a fully searchable database of UK local authority climate action plans, climate targets, and climate emergency declarations.

name: EDINA
description: EDINA delivers online services and tools to benefit students, teachers and researchers in UK Higher and Further Education and beyond.

name: Rfam RNA Families Database
description: Collection of RNA families represented by multiple sequence alignments, consensus secondary structures, and covariance models.

name: OmicsPred
description: OmicsPred is a resource for predicting multi-omics data (proteomics, metabolomics, transcriptomics etc.) directly from genotypes. To do this, we use extensive multi-omics data to train genetic scores using machine learning. Here, you can explore and download the genetic scores for a wide range of biomolecular traits in human blood as well as the summary statistics of their associations with key traits and diseases in the UK Biobank.

name: Marine Data Exchange
description: The Marine Data Exchange (MDE) is the first of its kind and a world leading digital platform of industry survey data, research and evidence that was created by The Crown Estate in 2013. It provides a digital platform for offshore industries to share survey data collected throughout the lifetime of offshore projects, and hosts new data and research generated through programmes such as The Crown Estate’s Offshore Wind Evidence and Change (OWEC) programme. Through this approach, we can ensure that existing data and evidence drives positive impact, whilst identifying and addressing data and evidence gaps. The significant evidence base on the MDE – which is currently over 500TB of data – will be important in accelerating offshore wind deployment to reach net zero by 2050, achieving energy security, and in driving holistic evidence-based decisions that support the protection and enhancement of the marine environment. By making this wealth of data freely available through cutting-edge technology, we give offshore projects in the UK a valuable head start, helping those involved to make informed, evidence-based decisions and address consenting and planning challenges.

name: Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children
description: ALSPAC is a longitudinal birth cohort study which enrolled pregnant women who were resident in one of three Bristol-based health districts in the former County of Avon with an expected delivery date between 1st April 1991 and 31st December 1992. Around 14,000 pregnant women were initially recruited.

name: BioImages - Virtual Field-Guide
description: This site offers an enormous collection of photographs of wild species and natural history objects. It covers most groups of organisms with the exception of birds and other vertebrates. The photographs are presented to illustrate biodiversity and as an aid to identification. The criterion for inclusion of a species is that it must have been, or might be expected to be, found in Britain or Ireland. BioImages follows the biological classification.

name: Allele Frequency Net Database
description: The Allele Frequency Net Database (AFND) provides the scientific community with a freely available repository for the storage of frequency data (alleles, genes, haplotypes and genotypes) related to human leukocyte antigens (HLA), killer-cell immunoglobulin-like receptors (KIR), major histocompatibility complex Class I chain related genes (MIC) and a number of cytokine gene polymorphisms in worldwide populations.

name: General Practice Notebook
description: GPnotebook is a concise synopsis of the entire field of clinical medicine focused on the needs of the General Practitioner with material organised systematically to ensure rapid retrieval of information. The content of GPnotebook is based on clinical practice in the United Kingdom and provides a clinical reference for general practitioners and medical students; it may also be a useful reference resource for other health professionals. As well as being a clinical reference, GPnotebook also aims to be a tool for clinical education, clinical governance and continuing professional development.

name: Worldpop
description: High spatial resolution, contemporary data on human population distributions are a prerequisite for the accurate measurement of the impacts of population growth, for monitoring changes and for planning interventions. The WorldPop project aims to meet these needs through the provision of detailed and open access population distribution datasets built using transparent approaches.

name: CiteAb
description: CiteAb collects high quality citation data, powering a citation ranked reagent search engine that fundamentally changes the way researchers find the right products for their experiments. We also provide life science data services for pharma & biotech companies, reagent suppliers, and investors

name: KnetMiner
description: KnetMiner is a knowledge platform for genes, traits, diseases and their interactions across species. We integrate a range of open-access data, transform into a knowledge graph and augment with new text-mined relationships. Free KnetMiner resources include Arabidopsis, wheat, rice and COVID-19 (publicly funded). Many other species specific datasets can be subscribed to for a fee. In addition to web-based access, the knowledge graphs can also be accessed programmatically through RDF-SPARQL and Neo4j-Cypher endpoints.

name: Born in Bradford
description: Born in Bradford is one of the biggest and most important medical research studies undertaken in the UK. The project started in 2007 and is looking to answer questions about our health by tracking the lives of 13,500 babies and their families and will provide information for studies across the UK and around the world.

name: SignaLink 3.0
description:
SignaLink 3.0 is an integrated resource to analyze signaling pathway cross-talks, transcription factors, miRNAs and regulatory enzymes. Main features:

    - A signaling network resource with known and predicted information for human and model organisms
    - Manually curated dataset of major signaling pathways - including curated data from resources such as ACSN, InnateDB, Reactome and Signor
    - Extends pathways with integrated regulatory resources to contain pathway-specific transcription factors, miRNA, scaffolds and post translational modifying enzymes
    - Proteins are classified by pathway position (core/non-core) and function (ligand, receptor, mediator, etc.)
    - Signaling interactions are directed and labeled with PubMed IDs of the publications of experimental evidence
    - A multi-layered network structure allows the selection of user-specific details
    - Allows filtering based on tissue or sub-cellular localization
    - Supporting downloads in csv or psimi tab formats

name: Energy Data Centre
description: The Energy Data Centre holds research data, metadata only records for data; grey literature and information on funded projects in the energy research field.  It is a capability of the UK Energy Research Centre and is funded by UKRI. UKERC's vision is "Independent whole systems research for a sustainable energy future" and the EDC's vision within that is "access to energy information now, and for the future"

name: National Digital Archive of Datasets
description: National Digital Archive of Datasets is a scientific data repository, operated by National Archives, publishing datasets and related research documentation.

name: Human Ageing Genomic Resources
description: The Human Ageing Genomic Resources (HAGR) is a collection of databases and tools for the biology and genetics of ageing. HAGR features several databases with high-quality, manually-curated data: 1) GenAge, a database of genes associated with ageing in humans and model organisms; 2) AnAge, an extensive collection of longevity records and complementary traits for over 4,000 vertebrate species; and 3) GenDR, a database containing both gene mutations that interfere with dietary restriction-mediated lifespan extension and consistent gene expression changes induced by dietary restriction.

name: PIR SuperFamily
description: The PIR SuperFamily concept is being used as a guiding principle to provide comprehensive and non-overlapping clustering of UniProtKB sequences into a hierarchical order to reflect their evolutionary relationships.

name: Open Targets Platform
description: Integrated catalog of evidence associating targets, diseases, and drugs for drug discovery.

name: Technical Registry PRONOM
description: PRONOM  is an online registry of technical information. PRONOM is a resource for anyone requiring impartial and definitive information about the file formats, software products and other technical components required to support long-term access to electronic records and other digital objects of cultural, historical or business value.

name: International Standard Name Identifier Database
description: The International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI) Database is used to uniquely identify persons and organizations worldwide. ISNIs are assigned when there is a high level of confidence in matching new names to existing names in the database or when sufficiently rich metadata is available to determine that the new name does not yet exist in the ISNI database.

name: GWAS Catalog
description: NHGRI-EBI catalog of published human genome-wide association studies and SNP-trait associations.

name: G4Atlas: a comprehensive transcriptome-wide G-quadruplex database
description: G4Atlas is a transcriptome-wide G-quadruplex database containing and visualising transcriptome RNA G-quadruplex (rG4) experimental data, generated from rG4-seq, chemical profiling and ligand-binding methods. rG4 is a vital RNA tertiary structure motif that involves the base pairs on both Hoogsteen and Watson-Crick faces of guanines, and is relevant to the post-transcriptional regulation of gene expression. RNA secondary structure prediction information across both experimentally identified and unidentified rG4s is also included to enable users to display any potential competitive folding between rG4 and RNA secondary structures. As such, G4Atlas allows users to explore the general functions of rG4s in diverse biological processes, and provides a starting point for further data-driven deep learning algorithms to examine rG4 structural features.

name: Protein Data Bank in Europe
description: European wwPDB member catalog of macromolecular structures, with search, validation, and programmatic access to PDB entries.

name: DesignTheory.org Combinatorial Design Database
description: DesignTheory.org is a research project funded by the U.K. Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council to provide various resources for Design Theory through the Internet. The project aims to cover theoretical, computational, and statistical aspects of combinatorial designs. In particular, one of its goals is the development of an on-line database of designs useful for mathematicians and statisticians in academia and industry.

name: Digital Image Archive of Medieval Music
description: The Digital Image Archive of Medieval Music (DIAMM), founded in 1998, preserves and provides high-resolution digital images of medieval polyphonic music sources from across Europe. Its goals are conservation, restoration, and improved scholarly access to fragile manuscripts, including fragments and complete works.

name: Dimensions
description: The Dimensions database is a scholarly database containing research articles, citations, books, chapters, and conference proceedings, as well as awarded grants, patents, clinical trials, policy documents, datasets and altmetric information. The free version includes a searchable publications index and links to all the other different entities. The subscription version includes further faceting, further analytical capabilities, and searchable indices of the non-publication content.

name: Electronic Enlightenment: letters & lives
description: Electronic Enlightenment—EE—is a digital resource for the study of the letter and its place in the rich writing cultures of the ‘long’ eighteenth century. Based on the best critical editions, EE benefits from collaboration with a large network of university presses, editors, scholars, and students who have contributed texts, and continues to grow by adding more archive/print editions and commissioning born-digital correspondences. EE is a wide-ranging online collection of edited correspondence of the early modern period, linking people across Europe, the Americas and Asia from the early 17th to the mid-19th century.

name: Graded Ring Database
description: A database of graded rings in algebraic geometry, including classifications of toric varieties, polarised K3 surfaces, and Fano 3-folds and 4-folds.

name: Global Research Identifier Database
description: Global Research Identifier Database (GRID) stores information on research-related organisations worldwide. GRID record contains a unique GRID ID, relevant metadata, and relationships between associated institutions.

name: Malaria Atlas Project
description: The Malaria Atlas Project (MAP) brings together researchers based around the world with expertise in a wide range of disciplines from public health to mathematics, geography and epidemiology. We work together to generate new and innovative methods of mapping malaria risk. Ultimately our goal is to produce a comprehensive range of maps and estimates that will support effective planning of malaria control at national and international scales.

name: Nottingham Arabidopsis Stock Centre Seeds Database
description: The Nottingham Arabidopsis Stock Centre (NASC) provides seed and information resources to the International Arabidopsis Genome Programme and the wider research community.

name: Deciphering the Mechanisms of Developmental Disorders
description: Initiated in 2013, DMDD has the ambitious goal of identifying all embryonic lethal knockout lines made at the Wellcome Trust Sanger institute, through their work as a major centre for creation of individual mouse gene knockouts. DMDD uses a combination of comprehensive 3D imaging, tissue histology, immunocytochemistry and transcriptomics to identify abnormalities in embryo and placental structure for each embryonic lethal line. All data is made freely available via this web site, enabling individual researchers to identify lines relevant to their own research. The DMDD programme is coordinating its work with similar international efforts through the umbrella of the International Mouse Phenotyping Consortium.

name: Expression Atlas
description: Gene and protein expression catalog across species and conditions, including baseline and differential studies.

name: MIRAGE
description: MIRAGE, operated by Middlesex University, provides research data on medicine, epidemiology, medical biometry, medical informatics, and biomedical technology and medical physics.

name: OpenStreetMap
description: OpenStreetMap (https://www.openstreetmap.org/export#map=6/51.324/10.426) is built by a community of mappers that contribute and maintain data about roads, trails, cafés, railway stations, and much more, all over the world. Planet.osm is the OpenStreetMap data in one file.

name: PHI-base
description:
PHI-base database contains expertly curated molecular and biological information on genes proven to affect the outcome of pathogen-host interactions. PHI-base catalogues experimentally verified pathogenicity, virulence and effector genes from fungal, Oomycete and bacterial pathogens, which infect animal, plant, fungal and insect hosts. An online community  curation portal, called PHI-Canto (https://canto.phi-base.org) supports article curation by authors with datasets being displayed at http://phi5.phi-base.org.
Data and source code availability: All data sets are available from Github at  https://github.com/PHI-base. 
Discussion board: curation issues for community curation can be discussed and followed using the PHI-canto curation tracker (https://github.com/PHI-base/curation)
Funding: PHI-base is funded from the UK Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC) [BB/S020020/1]. 
Citation reference: Urban, M. et al (2022). NAR doi: 10.1093/nar/gkab1037

name: History Data Service
description: History Data Service, operated by Economic and Social Research Council, provides research data on humanities and social sciences, history, and social and behavioural sciences.

name: DefElement
description: DefElement is an encyclopedia of finite element definitions. The website contains a collection of definitions of finite elements, including commonly used elements such as Lagrange, Raviart–Thomas, Nédélec (first kind), and Nédélec (second kind) elements, and more exotic elements such as serendipity, Hermite, P1-iso-P2, and Regge elements. DefElement currently contains the definition of 67 elements.

name: IMEx Consortium Molecular Interaction Database
description: The IMEx consortium is an international collaboration between a group of major public interaction data providers who have agreed to share curation effort and develop and work to a single set of curation rules when capturing data from both directly deposited interaction data or from publications in peer-reviewed journals, capture full details of an interaction in a “deep” curation model, perform a complete curation of all protein-protein interactions experimentally demonstrated within a publication, make these interaction available in a single search interface on a common website, provide the data in standards compliant download formats, make all IMEx records freely accessible under the Creative Commons Attribution License.

name: IRIS: A digital repository of instruments and data for research in language studies
description: IRIS is a free, searchable, up- and downloadable collection of datasets and instruments, materials, and stimuli that are used to elicit data for research into first, second, and foreign languages. This includes research into the effectiveness of different types of experimental treatments and instructional techniques; linguistic development and how languages are processed and learnt; the contexts in which first and second languages are used and learnt; and stakeholders' (learners', teachers', policy-makers') opinions about language use and how these impact teaching and learning. IRIS also hosts postprints of publications in the language sciences.

name: OPEN-ADAS
description: Open Atomic Data and Analysis Structure database of atomic data for fusion and astrophysical plasma modelling.

name: International Seismological Centre
description: International Seismological Centre. Global earthquake bulletin, event catalog, and associated seismic parametric data used as a community reference.

name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database
description: Catalog of predicted protein structures from AlphaFold, provided by DeepMind and EMBL-EBI.

name: International Traditional Medicine Clinical Trial Registry
description: The ISRCTN registry is a primary clinical trial registry recognised by WHO and ICMJE that accepts all clinical research studies (whether proposed, ongoing or completed), providing content validation and curation and the unique identification number necessary for publication. All study records in the database are freely accessible and searchable.

name: Plant DNA C-values database
description: A database containing genome size (C-value) data for all groups of land plants and red, green and brown algae.

name: Early Modern Letters Online
description: Early Modern Letters Online (EMLO) is a combined finding aid and editorial interface for basic descriptions of early modern correspondence: a collaboratively populated union catalogue of sixteenth-, seventeenth-, and eighteenth-century letters.

name: miRBase
description: The miRBase database is a searchable database of published miRNA sequences and annotation. Each entry in miRBase represents a predicted hairpin portion of a miRNA transcript (termed mir in the database), with information on the location and sequence of the mature miRNA sequence (termed miR). Both hairpin and mature sequences are available for searching and browsing, and entries can also be retrieved by name, keyword, references and annotation.

name: Genome3D
description: Genome3D is a resource that provides structural annotation and 3D models of genomes of model organisms such as human, yeast and E.coli. The database can be used to predict protein structures that have not yet been identified. Genome3D uses structural classification data from several UK-based resources including CATH and SCOP.

name: Permanent Service for Mean Sea Level
description: Global catalog of long-term mean sea-level records from tide gauges, hosted by the National Oceanography Centre.

name: Science Photo Library
description: Science Photo Library (SPL) provides creative professionals with striking specialist imagery, unrivalled in quality, accuracy and depth of information. We have more than 600,000 images and 40,000 clips to choose from, with hundreds of new submissions uploaded to the website each week.

name: BioSamples
description: Catalog of biological sample metadata linking records across EMBL-EBI archives and external repositories.

name: Xenopus laevis and tropicalis biology and genomics resource
description: Xenbase is the model organism database for Xenopus laevis and X. (Silurana) tropicalis which was created to improve knowledge of developmental and disease processes. Through curation and automated data provisioning from various sources, Xenbase aims to integrate the body of knowledge on Xenopus genomics and biology together with the visualization of biologically-significant interactions.

name: University of East Anglia Climatic Research Unit Datasets
description: Climatic datasets available for use by the research community

name: EchoBase
description: EchoBASE is a new database that has been created to integrate information from post-genomic experiments into a single resource with the aim of then providing functional predictions for the 1500 or so gene products for which we have no knowledge of their physiological function.. While EchoBASE provides a basic annotation of the genome, taken from other databases (see the Annotation), its novelty is in the curation of post-genomic experiments and their linkage to genes of unknown function. Experiments published on E. coli are curated to one of two levels. Papers dealing with the determination of function of a single gene are briefly described, while larger dataset are actually included in the database and can be searched and manipulated. This includes data for proteomics studies, protein-protein interaction studies, microarray data, functional genomic approaches (looking at multiple deletion strains for novel phenotypes) and a wide range of predictions that come out of in silico bioinformatic approaches.

name: Unimod
description: Unimod is a community-supported, comprehensive database of protein modifications for mass spectrometry applications. The aim is to provide accurate and verifiable values, derived from elemental compositions, for the mass differences introduced by all types of natural and artificial modifications. Other important information includes any mass change, (neutral loss), that occurs during MS/MS analysis, and site specificity, (which residues are susceptible to modification and any constraints on the position of the modification within the protein or peptide).

name: UK Data Archive
description: The UK Data Archive, based at the University of Essex, is curator of the largest collection of digital data in the social sciences and humanities in the United Kingdom. With several thousand datasets relating to society, both historical and contemporary, our Archive is a vital resource for researchers, teachers and learners. We are an internationally acknowledged centre of expertise in the areas of acquiring, curating and providing access to data.

name: Virtual Fly Brain
description: VFB is an interactive tool for neurobiologists to explore the detailed neuroanatomy, neuron connectivity and gene expression of Drosophila melanogaster. Our goal is to make it easier for researchers to find relevant anatomical information and reagents. We integrate the neuroanatomical and expression data from the published literature, as well as image datasets onto the same brain template, making it possible to run cross searches, find similar neurons and compare image data on our 3D Viewer.

name: IUPHAR/BPS Guide to PHARMACOLOGY
description: Expert-curated catalog of drug targets and ligand-activity relationships from the International Union of Basic and Clinical Pharmacology and the British Pharmacological Society.

name: Structure, Interfaces and Alignments for Protein-Protein Interactions Database
description: SNAPPI-DB is an object-oriented database of domain-domain interactions observed in structural data. The structural data is obtained from the MSD data warehouse as the MSD provides consistent data with links to many types of data about proteins and nucleic acids.

name: European Bank for induced pluripotent Stem Cells
description: The European Bank for induced pluripotent Stem Cells (EBiSC) is a centralised, not-for-profit iPSC bank providing researchers across academia and industry with access to scalable, cost-efficient and consistent, high quality iPSC lines and derived products for new medicines development.

name: Multi-Omics Research Factory
description: MORF (Multi-Omics Research Factory) was initially created by the BBSRC-funded DETOX project, led by Prof. Gavin Thomas at the University of York, to manage large and complex multi-omics datasets. Built by biologists for biologists, it allows the whole team to access the data securely from their browser, without the need for programming skills. As data becomes publicly available, it can be accessed and further analysed here. MORF's tools are also freely-available and include the MORF genome browser, which incorporates over 100 microbial genomes, and MORFlux, a flux balance analysis (FBA) modelling tool.

name: UK National Data Repository
description: Public discovery catalog of UK oil and gas well, seismic, and related petroleum data held by the North Sea Transition Authority.

name: PRIDE Archive
description: Public repository of mass spectrometry-based proteomics data, including protein and peptide identifications and supporting evidence.

name: freeBIRD
description: The FREEBIRD website aims to facilitate data sharing in the area of injury and emergency research in a timely and responsible manner. It has been launched by providing open access to anonymised data on over 30,000 injured patients (the CRASH-1 and CRASH-2 trials).

name: ALSoD
description: ALSoD is a freely available database that has been transformed from a single gene storage facility recording mutations in the SOD1 gene to a multigene ALS bioinformatics repository and analytical instrument combining genotype, phenotype, and geographical information with associated analysis tools.

name: InterPro
description: Classification of proteins into families and prediction of domains and important sites using signatures from member databases.

name: PKRxiv
description: A managed open access data repository and visualization platform for collaborative sharing of anonymised, individual-level pharmacokinetic data.

name: HIV and COVID-19 Registry in Europe
description: In March the NEAT ID Foundation initiated the development of a simple Data “Dashboard” to monitor the progress of COVID-19 in HIV infected patients across Europe in real time. The Dashboard shows at European and Country level the number of cases reported to NEAT ID with COVID-19 co-infection with HIV, the number of hospitalisations and the number of deaths (from sites who have contributed to date).

name: LG Inform Explorer
description: Public LG Inform Explorer from the Local Government Association. Browse local-authority performance, contextual, and financial metrics by theme. The signed-in LG Inform report builder is separate and is not this catalog.

name: Southend Public Opinion Observatory
description: Independent Southend-on-Sea public data hub with community-proposition totals, city trends, weather and bathing-water observations, and downloadable CSV and JSON files. Not operated by Southend-on-Sea City Council.

name: Newcastle Urban Observatory
description: Urban sensor catalog for Newcastle, with a public API of traffic, environment, and infrastructure observations.

name: Southampton Data Observatory
description: Southampton Data Observatory is a one-stop shop for data, intelligence, specialist reports, needs assessments, summary analysis and headline statistics covering the city's population, health, community safety, economy and public services. Home to Southampton's Single Needs Assessment, including the Joint Strategic Needs Assessment (JSNA) and Community Safety Strategic Assessment. Themes include Population, Health, Economy, Place, Community Safety, Children and Young People, and Research & HDRC Southampton.

name: British Geological Survey National Geoscience Data Centre
description: The National Geoscience Data Centre (NGDC) collects and preserves geoscientific data and information, making them available for the long-term to a wide range of users and communities. NGDC is recognised as the NERC Environmental Data Centre for geoscience data.

name: Local Government Association datasets
description: Identify and browse open data datasets published by UK local authorities. Here are links to datasets logged by councils and datasets harvested from repositories that support the Inventory schema. Sign in to add yours.

name: CEDA Data Catalogue
description: The CEDA Data Catalogue allows users to find, review, and access diverse datasets related to environmental and geoscientific research. It provides metadata, spatial and temporal information, and links to background information about the data. The catalog supports various record types, including Datasets, Dataset Collections, Projects, Instruments, Platforms, and Computations, enabling users to discover data by type, theme, or project.

name: Automatic Knowledge Ltd - Resources
description: Open data resources for researchers, analysts, journalists and others, including a GeoPackage containing all buildings in Great Britain and English IMD 2019 geofiles. Data is sourced from ONS and MHCLG, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

name: Trafford Data Lab
description: Open data catalog and visualisation lab for Trafford Council. Publishes 3-star open data in CSV and GeoJSON under the Open Government Licence v3.0, covering population, boundaries, health, elections, housing, and local services.

name: Parliament Dataset Explorer
description: Data catalog for datasets related to the UK Parliament, including legislative, procedural, and administrative data.

name: Bassetlaw Open Data
description: Open data portal. managed by Bassetlaw District Council. providing access to bassetlaw open data.

name: Channel Coastal Observatory
description: Data portal for the National Network of Regional Coastal Monitoring Programmes, providing coastal survey, lidar, wave, tide, and habitat mapping data.

name: Transport for London Unified API
description: Catalog of Transport for London's Unified API for lines, stops, arrivals, and other network data. The public API responds without a key.

name: British Oceanographic data centre Published Data Library (PDL)
description: Marine data available to download from the British Oceanographic Data Centre (BODC) database, including CTD profiles, currents, samples, and wave data.

name: CEDA Data Catalogue
description: CEDA's Data Catalogue allows users to find datasets and related data, describing actual data in the archive with spatial and temporal information, access details, and background information about data collection.

name: open database of xtals
description: Public database of crystal structures derived largely from ab initio structure prediction, with OPTIMADE access.

name: UWE Research Data Repository
description: The UWE Research Data Repository holds research data and metadata associated with existing or forthcoming EPSRC-funded publications, produced by UWE Bristol researchers. All UWE Bristol researchers who have produced research data associated with an existing or forthcoming publication, and which can be shared without restriction, are invited to enter their datasets in this repository.

name: ERCOFTAC Classic Collection
description: ERCOFTAC Classic Collection of experimental and computational test cases for validating turbulence, fluid-mechanics, and combustion models.

name: CCP-NC Database
description: Database of calculated NMR parameters in magres format from the Collaborative Computational Project for NMR Crystallography.

name: TInnGO Open Data Repository
description: Open repository of gender-related transport and smart-mobility datasets from the H2020 TInnGO project.

name: British Antarctic Survey Discovery Metadata System
description: Web-based catalog to discover, access, and visualize datasets, specimen collections, maps, research publications, images, and metadata for polar regions, primarily from UK-funded scientific research.

name: Bhutan Interactive Data Portal
description: Interactive data portal of Bhutan's National Statistics Bureau. Publishes official statistical indicators on the economy and population, with maps, charts, and downloads. The NSB website currently uses a non-public TLS certificate.

name: Thimphu Thromde GIS
description: Public OpenLayers GIS of Thimphu Thromde (Thimphu Thromde Geo Info). The viewer lists municipal utility, land-use, plot, and administrative layers; GeoServer WMS, WFS, WCS, and WMTS are published through /api/gs/ (workspace Thimphu, 22 WFS feature types). Layer editing tools require login.

name: Kiribati Education Data Portal
description: Public Kiribati Education Management Information System (KEMIS) dashboards from the Ministry of Education. Publishes national and sub-sector indicators on school enrolment, teachers, and standardised examinations from the annual school survey, using a Plotly Dash app at data.moe.gov.ki. Not a cross-government open data portal.

name: Putrajaya CityView
description: Public Putrajaya CityView map listed on MyGDI as the Federal Territory of Putrajaya GIS application, showing city geospatial layers for residents and agencies.

name: MPKj CitySense
description: Kajang Municipal Council CitySense public GIS with local-plan maps, open-space layers, and neighbourhood-representative zoning.

name: GES MBDKlang
description: Klang City Council Green Earth Smart System (GES) geospatial portal with public I-MAPS and land-use / development map applications.

name: TuahGIS Hang Tuah Jaya
description: Hang Tuah Jaya Municipal Council TuahGIS public map portal with lot search and municipal geospatial layers.

name: MelGIS
description: Melaka state GIS application listed on MyGDI as the official state GIS, on a distinct host from the existing MyGDI Spatial ArcGIS REST and One Map Melaka Hub catalogs.

name: e-GeoRIS Seremban
description: Seremban City Council engineering GIS portal (e-GeoRIS) publishing municipal road, street-lighting, bus-stop, and community-facility map layers.

name: DBKL City Planning System
description: Kuala Lumpur City Hall GIS planning platform (eMap / CPS) for land use, zoning, and Kuala Lumpur City Plan 2040 layers.

name: MySubNasional Indicator Portal
description: Official DOSM subnational indicator portal connecting national, state, district, parliamentary, and state legislative assembly statistics in a unified interactive dashboard.

name: NEWSS Official Statistics Portal
description: NEWSS (National Enterprise Wide Statistical System) portal of the Department of Statistics Malaysia for searching and downloading official statistical products.

name: Population Quick Info
description: DOSM Population Quick Info table query. Public cross-tabulation and time series of intercensal population estimates, current estimates, and projections by state, age, sex, and ethnic group.

name: National Property Information Centre (NAPIC)
description: Official portal of Malaysia's National Property Information Centre (NAPIC), under the Valuation and Property Services Department (JPPH). Publishes property market statistics, house price and rental indices, transaction tables, occupancy data, time series downloads, and related publications covering residential, commercial, industrial, and agricultural property.

name: MyLabourHub
description: DOSM labour-market data hub with more than 100 key and supporting indicators across supply and demand, wages, productivity, informal work, MSMEs, graduates, and SDG labour themes, plus interactive visualisations and a stats explorer.

name: TaniStats - Integrated Agricultural Statistical System
description: Official DOSM digital gateway for Malaysia's agricultural statistics. Integrates Agricultural Census 2024 results, agrifood commodity prices, food and nutrition statistics, food security indicators, and related agricultural datasets in interactive dashboards.

name: Malaysia Informative Data Centre (MysIDC)
description: Open Data portal of the Department of Statistics, Malaysia, providing access to various statistical indicators and datasets.

name: METS Online
description: DOSM merchandise external trade statistics database. Public key indicators, visualisations, and a Trade Statistics explorer for exports, imports, and trade balance by partner and commodity (HS and SITC) with a long time series.

name: BNM OpenAPI Portal
description: Official Bank Negara Malaysia OpenAPI portal providing free REST access to central bank datasets. Covers exchange rates, interest rates, monetary and banking statistics, financial and capital markets, macroeconomic indicators, insurance and takaful, financial inclusion, payment statistics, government securities, Islamic interbank money market, Bond Info Hub, and FAST tendering data.

name: Malaysia Open Science Platform (MOSP)
description: National research data platform that harvests metadata from Malaysian institutional repositories and government agencies. An initiative of the Academy of Sciences Malaysia in collaboration with the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MOSTI).

name: PutraRDRepo
description: PutraRDRepo is Universiti Putra Malaysia's institutional research data repository for storing, managing, and sharing datasets produced by UPM researchers.

name: Malaysia Biodiversity Information System (MyBIS)
description: National one-stop repository for biodiversity information in Malaysia and the country's Clearing-House Mechanism under the Convention on Biological Diversity. Provides searchable species records, specimen data, protected area information, literature, and datasets collated from published sources and partner agencies.

name: NIH-Data Repository System (NIH-DaRS)
description: Platform for centralizing research data by Ministry of Health Malaysia. Research data can be stored in various formats and for long-term data preservation. These datasets are valuable and potential for secondary data usage and translational research.

name: PerakGIS
description: Perak state GIS unit portal listed on MyGDI, with a public gallery of state web GIS applications (village boundaries, flood hotspots, geographic names, housing).

name: GeoJohor
description: GeoJohor is the Johor state land-use geoportal, providing public maps of current land use, gazetted zoning, administrative boundaries, health, education, religious and public facilities, recreation, and affordable housing, plus agency modules from state departments.

name: GeoJB
description: Johor Bahru City Council GeoJB geoportal, listed as a Malaysia.gov.my digital service, providing public GIS maps for planning and urban analysis.

name: P'GEO 2.0 MBPG
description: Pasir Gudang City Council P'GEO 2.0 GIS, linked from the official MBPG digital-services page as the public municipal mapping portal.

name: Pengerang iMAP
description: Pengerang Municipal Council Smart GIS (iMAP) with a public interactive map and open-data gallery for land use, facilities, licensing, and property.

name: Gobierno de Córdoba Datos
description: Catálogo de datos abiertos del Gobierno de Córdoba, Argentina.

name: Mapas Córdoba
description: Geoportal oficial de IDECOR (Mapas Córdoba) con mapas temáticos, descargas y geoservicios OGC (WMS, WFS, WCS) de la provincia de Córdoba.

name: Geoportal de Villa María
description: Municipal geoportal of Villa María publishing cadastral, transport, and urban layers from GeoServer.

name: IDECBA - Visualizador de mapas
description: Visualizador de la Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires (IDECBA), nodo IDERA de CABA.

name: Repositorio Digital Institucional Facultad de Ciencias Sociales-UBA
description: Institutional repository of the Facultad de Ciencias Sociales, Universidad de Buenos Aires. Public collection Datos de Investigación holds research-data records.

name: IDE San Luis / Catastro
description: Portal de la Dirección Provincial de Catastro y Tierras Fiscales, nodo IDE provincial de San Luis listado por IDERA.

name: DEIE Mendoza indicadores
description: Dirección de Estadísticas e Investigaciones Económicas de Mendoza. Portal de consulta de indicadores económicos y sociales provinciales, con buscador de datos y estadísticas.

name: Datos Abiertos Lujan de Cuyo
description: Portal de datos abiertos de la Municipalidad de Lujan de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina.

name: Observatorio Territorial Godoy Cruz
description: Visor de información geográfica del Observatorio Territorial de la Municipalidad de Godoy Cruz, Mendoza.

name: Geoportal Ciudadano Mendoza
description: Geoportal ciudadano de la Municipalidad de la Ciudad de Mendoza, interfaz pública de mapas municipales.

name: Consultas Catastrales San Juan
description: Visor público de consultas catastrales de la Dirección de Geodesia y Catastro de San Juan.

name: SIT Catastral Formosa
description: Sistema de Información Territorial catastral de Formosa (SIT Catastral v2).

name: Datos Abiertos IPECD Corrientes
description: Página de datos abiertos del Instituto Provincial de Estadística y Ciencia de Datos de Corrientes.

name: IDEMCC Corrientes
description: Portal IDEMCC, Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de la Municipalidad de Corrientes.

name: ideCorr - Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de Corrientes
description: Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de Corrientes (ideCorr). Geoportal provincial listado por IDERA.

name: Visor de infraestructura San José
description: Visor municipal de infraestructura de San José (Entre Ríos) sobre Leaflet y GeoServer.

name: UrbaSIG Buenos Aires
description: Visor UrbaSIG de ordenamiento urbano y territorial de la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

name: IDE Municipio de Luján
description: Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales del Municipio de Luján (Buenos Aires).

name: CARTO ARBA
description: Visualizador cartográfico CARTO ARBA de la Agencia de Recaudación de la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

name: Olavarría Georreferenciada
description: Geoportal municipal Olavarría Georreferenciada con mapas y capas territoriales del partido.

name: Geoportal Brown
description: WMS geoportal of Almirante Brown with a public layer catalog. Separate from the Argenmap viewer at ide.brown.gob.ar.

name: Mapa digital Mar del Plata
description: Mapa digital de General Pueyrredón / Mar del Plata listado por IDERA. Probe returned HTTP 400.

name: IDE Balcarce
description: Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de la Municipalidad de Balcarce, listada por IDERA.

name: Bahía Geo-referenciada
description: Geoportal municipal Bahía Geo-referenciada / Mapas de la Municipalidad de Bahía Blanca.

name: Mapa escolar Buenos Aires
description: Geoportal del mapa escolar de la Provincia de Buenos Aires (Dirección General de Cultura y Educación).

name: IDE Las Flores
description: Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales del Municipio de Las Flores.

name: Visualizador IDEhab Buenos Aires

name: Sistema de Consulta de Datos Educativos Nacionales
description: Sistema de Consulta de Datos Educativos Nacionales. Indicadores de trayectorias, evaluaciones Aprender y búsqueda de establecimientos educativos.

name: INDEC COMEX Argentina
description: Sistema de consulta de comercio exterior de bienes del INDEC. Permite consultar exportaciones e importaciones por producto (NCM), país y período desde 2002, y descargar bases de datos.

name: Datos Abiertos del Senado de la Nación
description: Micrositio de datos abiertos del Honorable Senado de la Nación. Publica listados legislativos en formatos reutilizables (JSON y similares).

name: Presupuesto Abierto
description: Catálogo de datos abiertos presupuestarios de la Administración Pública Nacional (Presupuesto Abierto). Publica series de ingresos, gastos y cuenta de inversión.

description: Environmental geovisor of the Centro de Información Ambiental (SInIA), with thematic layers for water, soil, biodiversity, forests, and protected areas.

name: Geoportal Federal para la Gestión Local (MapaMuni)
description: Geoportal federal del IGN para gobiernos locales, con visor de mapas, análisis territorial y datos municipales.

name: Repositorio Institucional Universidad Católica de Salta
description: This site provides access to the research outputs of the institution. The interface is available in Spanish.

name: Pierre Auger Open Data
description: Public cosmic-ray datasets from the Pierre Auger Observatory, including event data, reconstruction products, and analysis examples.

name: DACyTAr - Datos Primarios en Acceso Abierto de la Ciencia y la Tecnología Argentina
description: Data catalog from the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation, Argentina.

name: IDE Río Negro (IDERN)
description: Geoportal de la Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de Río Negro (IDERN).

name: Visualizador IDET Tucumán
description: Visualizador público de la Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de Tucumán (IDET).

description: Visor municipal InfoMapa de Rosario con cartografía urbana y servicios WMS listados por IDERA.

name: Education Management Information System of the Kyrgyz Republic (ISUO)
description: Public education-statistics dashboard of the Kyrgyz Republic EMIS (ISUO). Publishes counts of educational organizations, staff, and learners by education level and region. Distinct from the staff EMIS login at emis.edu.gov.kg and from datasets republished on data.gov.kg.

name: Open Budget of the Kyrgyz Republic
description: Treasury Open Budget portal of the Kyrgyz Republic. Publishes republican and local budget execution indicators (income, spending, and public debt) with a public JSON API. Distinct from the NSC open-data tables and the IMF NSDP.

name: Citizen Budget of Local Communities of the Kyrgyz Republic
description: Ministry of Finance web application for citizen budgets of cities and ayil aimaks. Lists local draft, approved, and executed budgets with public statistics pages. Distinct from the national Treasury Open Budget portal at budget.okmot.kg.

name: National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic Statistics
description: National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic statistics catalog of monetary, banking, and external-sector tables. Distinct from the IMF NSDP page hosted by the National Statistical Committee.

name: National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic
description: Official website of the National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic. Provides access to official statistical data, indicators, publications, and reports covering economics, social statistics, financial sector, labor, population, agriculture, industry, trade, transport, education, health, and regional statistics. The website includes an Open Data section, analytical materials, infographics, and links to Sustainable Development Goals indicators.

name: Open Data of the National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic
description: Native open-data table catalog of the National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic. Indicator series are grouped by theme (GDP, population, prices, labour, agriculture, and others) and downloadable as JSON, XML, and Excel. Distinct from the NSC homepage and the IMF NSDP page on the same host.

name: GitData Archive
description: Explore GitData Archive, your gateway to cutting-edge unreviewed scholarly insights and research archives. Our platform brings together a diverse range of disciplines, enabling faster discovery and collaboration across fields.

name: Central Bank of Belize Statistics
description: Central Bank of Belize public statistics tables covering the banking system, interest and exchange rates, financial soundness, public finance, and the external sector.

name: CZMAI Coastal and Marine Data Centre
description: Coastal Zone Management Authority and Institute catalog of coastal and marine spatial layers for Belize, including zoning schemes, marine habitat, species distribution, and shipping layers. Several shapefiles are directly downloadable; others are available on request.

name: Biodiversity and Environmental Resource Data System of Belize
description: Public spatial data warehouse of the Biodiversity and Environmental Resource Data System of Belize (BERDS) with downloadable baseline shapefiles for ecosystems, protected areas, biological corridors, hydrology, and related layers, each with ArcGIS metadata. The original 120,000-record flora and fauna specimen database is private while this warehouse remains open.

name: NunaGIS
description: Public NunaGIS geodata portal for Greenland maps, land allocations, planning, nature, cultural heritage, and address data, operated by Asiaq – Greenland Survey.

name: Asiaq Kortforsyning
description: Asiaq map supply (Kortforsyning) for downloading free Greenland technical base maps, digital terrain models, elevation contours, and orthophotos.

name: PISUNA-net Observation Database
description: PISUNA-net is the public catalog of local and Indigenous observations of living resources along Greenland's west and north coasts, collected with hunters and fishers and hosted by NSIDC ELOKA for the Government of Greenland.

name: NT Atlas and Spatial Data Directory
description: Public NT Atlas land administration mapping system for viewing and querying commonly used Northern Territory Government spatial datasets, including cadastre and related land information.

name: BOCSAR
description: NSW Bureau of Crime Statistics and Research public crime, courts, custody, and policing statistics. Includes crime mapping, sentencing and custody dashboards, and downloadable recorded crime datasets.

name: HealthStats NSW
description: Interactive population health indicators catalog for New South Wales. Users can explore and download statistics on health status, risk factors, hospitalisations, and outcomes by topic and location, including Local Health Districts, Local Government Areas, and Primary Health Networks.

name: BHI Data Portal
description: NSW Bureau of Health Information data portal for public hospital and ambulance performance. Users compare Healthcare Quarterly activity and performance results and trends across NSW health services.

name: Northern Beaches Council Mapping
description: Northern Beaches Council Icon GIS public planning map for zoning and local government map layers.

name: Historical Atlas of Sydney
description: The Historical Atlas of Sydney contains digital versions of maps and associated documents.

name: HealthStats Tasmania
description: Tasmanian Government HealthStats portal for transparent health-system statistics, linking the health system dashboard and other Tasmanian public health indicator resources.

name: Temperate Reef Base Portal
description: Data catalog specializing in temperature and reef-related datasets.

name: Tasmania Government Government Open Data
description: Tasmanian Local Government Consolidated Data Collection (CDC). Statewide Data Repositories. ESRI ArcGIS Layer Files for Opendata datasets. Contains .lyr files for ArcGIS ver 9.2 - 10.8. Includes metadata and guidelines for use.

name: Queensland Regional Profiles
description: Queensland Government Statistician's Office automated regional profile reports using demographic, social, economic and workforce indicators for LGAs, SA2s and custom combined regions.

name: Queensland Survey Analytic System
description: Queensland Health Queensland Survey Analytic System (QSAS) for preventive health survey results. Interactive tables cover adult and child indicators by Hospital and Health Service, Primary Health Network, and local government area.

name: Translink Open Data
description: Queensland Translink HTML catalog of GTFS schedule and GTFS-Realtime feeds for South East Queensland and regional urban bus, rail, tram, and ferry networks. Distinct from the data.qld.gov.au harvest copy.

name: Logan PD Hub
description: Logan City Council PD Hub public mapping of Logan Planning Scheme zoning, overlays, property and flooding reports, and related planning enquiry tools.

name: Preventive Health SA Open Data Portal
description: Preventive Health SA epidemiology portal with interactive visualisations of South Australian population health, cancer, and pregnancy outcome indicators drawn from statewide surveillance collections.

name: SA Health Hospital Dashboards
description: SA Health public hospital performance dashboards covering emergency department activity, inpatient occupancy, elective surgery waiting lists and ambulance service indicators for South Australian public hospitals.

name: Victorian Population Health Survey Dashboards
description: Victorian Agency for Health Information dashboards for the Victorian Population Health Survey, with LGA and regional views of adult health and wellbeing indicators.

name: Victorian Health Services Performance
