description: Victorian Agency for Health Information catalog of quality and safety performance for public health services and hospitals, covering emergency care, planned surgery, ambulance, mental health, and specialist clinics.

name: City of Port Phillip 3D Development Activity Model
description: City of Port Phillip 3D Development Activity Model for viewing planning and building activity in the municipality.

name: Corangamite CMA NRM Portal
description: Corangamite CMA Natural Resource Management Portal for property, catchment, and landscape spatial data in the Corangamite region.

name: North Central CMA Flood Eye
description: North Central CMA Flood Eye property flood report service for address search, flood maps, and downloadable flood intelligence reports.

name: Monash Forecasting Repository
description: Monash University archive of time-series datasets for forecasting research and benchmarking.

name: The Victorian Government Developers portal and API Catalogue
description: Victoria's portal for application developers to connect with government data, offering access to a catalog of APIs for government datasets and services.

name: BioGrid Australia Ltd Scientific Data Repository
description: BioGrid Australia provides a secure research platform and infrastructure that provides access to real-time clinical, imaging and biospecimen data across jurisdictions, institutions and diseases. The web-based platform provides ethical access while protecting both privacy and intellectual property. BioGrid supports research in areas including endocrinology (diabetes), imaging (MRI, PET), neurosciences, oncology, and respiratory diseases.

name: ABS MicrodataDownload
description: ABS MicrodataDownload is the Australian Bureau of Statistics portal for discovering, applying for and downloading confidentialised unit record files and other microdata products from ABS surveys and Census-related collections.

name: BITRE Dashboards
description: Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics public dashboards for Australian infrastructure and transport statistics, including road safety, crash, freight, and infrastructure construction indicators.

name: NCVER International VET Students Visualisation
description: NCVER International VET students visualisation compares international and domestic VET students at Australian training providers (2018–2022), hosted on NCVER's visualisation gallery with linked SAS Visual Analytics explorer.

name: AIC Statistics
description: Australian Institute of Criminology statistics hub with interactive dashboards on national crime and justice indicators including homicide, deaths in custody, cybercrime and intimate partner homicide.

name: JSA NERO (Employment by Region and Occupation)
description: Nowcast of Employment by Region and Occupation (NERO) provides monthly experimental employment estimates for 355 ANZSCO occupations across 88 SA4 regions, with an interactive dashboard and downloadable tailored datasets.

name: National Core Maternity Indicators Dashboard
description: AIHW National Core Maternity Indicators dashboard presents the 13 national core maternity clinical and outcome indicators with the latest available data for monitoring perinatal care in Australia.

name: ComparED
description: Australian Government QILT explorer to compare higher education institutions and study areas on student experience, graduate employment and salary indicators.

name: Safe Work Australia Interactive Data
description: Safe Work Australia interactive statistics on work health and safety and workers' compensation. Dashboards cover fatalities, claims, injury rates, prosecutions, hazards, and industry comparisons.

name: My School
description: ACARA My School profiles of Australian schools with NAPLAN results, attendance, finances and student background indicators.

name: MBS Funded Services Monthly Data Dashboard
description: AIHW Medicare Benefits Scheme funded services monthly data dashboard with interactive statistics on MBS service volumes, benefits and related trends.

name: NCVER Latest VET Statistics Dashboard
description: NCVER Latest VET statistics dashboard displays headline indicators from each NCVER VET collection and survey, with links to publications, DataBuilders, and related visualisations.

name: ABARES Farm Data Portal
description: ABARES interactive farm survey portal with historical and forecast estimates for Australian broadacre and dairy farms, including financial performance, productivity, and regional results, plus bulk CSV downloads.

name: NCVER Atlas of Total VET
description: NCVER Atlas of total VET is a mapping resource for total VET activity by state, territory and SA2, with tabs for trends, student characteristics, program enrolments, completions and subject enrolments.

name: JSA Training to Occupation Pathways (TOP)
description: Jobs and Skills Australia Training to Occupation Pathways (TOP) maps VET qualifications to ANZSCO occupations, supporting qualification-to-job and job-to-training exploration for workforce and career planning.

name: AEDC Community Data Explorer
description: Australian Early Development Census community data explorer with tables, maps and graphs of child development indicators by local community.

name: Open Electricity
description: Public explorer of Australian electricity generation, price, and emissions, formerly OpenNEM.

name: ABS SEIFA 2021
description: ABS Socio-Economic Indexes for Areas (SEIFA) 2021 release with interactive quintile maps and Data Explorer datasets for IRSAD, IRSD, IER and IEO across SA1, SA2, LGA, suburb and postal geographies.

name: National Cancer Screening Programs Quarterly Data
description: AIHW Cancer screening programs quarterly data report with interactive participation and activity indicators for BreastScreen Australia, the National Cervical Screening Program and the National Bowel Cancer Screening Program.

name: AIHW Hospitals
description: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare MyHospitals interactive hospital performance platform. Users explore access, activity, and related measures for local hospitals, local hospital networks, and national totals.

name: Eora Global MRIO
description: Global multi-region input-output tables and environmental footprint series.

name: ACNC Charity Data Explorer
description: Interactive explorer of Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission charity data with filters by size, subtype, state and postcode.

name: First Nations Primary Health Care Access Dashboard
description: AIHW interactive dashboard on Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander primary health care patterns of service use, preferences and access to services (2024 release).

name: JSA Internet Vacancy Index
description: Jobs and Skills Australia Internet Vacancy Index (IVI) tracks online job advertisements by occupation, skill level, state and territory, and regional geography. Monthly experimental indicator used in JSA labour-market dashboards and regional profiles.

name: JSA Regional Labour Market Indicator
description: Jobs and Skills Australia Regional Labour Market Indicator (RLMI) combines employee and employer labour-market indicators into SA4 ratings and an interactive map of regional labour-market performance relative to the national average.

name: ABS Measuring What Matters
description: Australian Bureau of Statistics national wellbeing dashboard for the Measuring What Matters framework, with 50 interactive indicator pages across healthy, secure, sustainable, cohesive and prosperous themes.

name: JSA Monthly Labour Market Dashboards
description: Jobs and Skills Australia monthly labour market dashboards combining ABS Labour Force, Internet Vacancy Index, DSS income support and Small Area Labour Markets data for national, state and 51 Employment Regions.

name: RBA Statistical Tables
description: Reserve Bank of Australia catalog of statistical tables covering money and credit, interest rates, payments, balance sheet, and other economic and financial series, published as downloadable spreadsheets.

name: Jobs and Skills Atlas
description: Jobs and Skills Australia labour market atlas. Users explore unemployment, employment, vacancies, occupations, skills, and industries at national, state, and SA4 regional level.

name: NNDSS Data Visualisation Tool
description: National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System visualisation from the Australian Centre for Disease Control. Users explore notification counts and rates for nationally notifiable diseases by state, age, sex, and time, updated daily.

name: PBS Prescriptions Monthly Data Dashboard
description: AIHW Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme prescriptions monthly data dashboard with interactive trends in PBS prescription volumes and costs for Australia.

name: AIHW Chronic Conditions Dashboard
description: AIHW chronic conditions dashboard consolidates prevalence indicators for major condition groups including cancer, diabetes, dementia, kidney disease, respiratory, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal conditions by age and other dimensions.

name: Youth Justice in Australia 2024–25 Dashboard
description: AIHW Youth justice in Australia 2024–25 data dashboard on young people under youth justice supervision, with national and state/territory indicators.

name: Australian Burden of Disease Study 2024 Interactive Data
description: AIHW Australian Burden of Disease Study 2024 interactive data explorer for disease burden indicators including mortality, morbidity and disability-adjusted life years by condition and population group.

name: Cancer Data in Australia Summary Dashboard
description: AIHW Cancer data in Australia summary visualisation for national cancer incidence, survival and prevalence indicators with interactive charts and tables.

name: NCVER DataBuilder
description: NCVER DataBuilder is an interactive table builder for Australian vocational education and training collections, complementing VOCSTATS with publication-aligned custom tables and exports.

name: Australia's Health Performance Framework
description: AIHW Australian Health Performance Framework indicator set on population health, health system performance, and health system characteristics, disaggregated by state and territory and selected local areas.

name: Australian Energy Statistics
description: Official Australian Energy Statistics dataset hub with annual energy consumption, production and trade tables by fuel, industry and state or territory, including interactive energy flows visualisations.

name: Medicare GP Bulk Billing Dashboard
description: AIHW Medicare GP bulk billing monthly data dashboard showing bulk billing rates from 1984 onward at national, state/territory and LGA levels, with socioeconomic and age-group breakdowns.

name: JSA Occupation Shortage List
description: Jobs and Skills Australia Occupation Shortage List provides a point-in-time interactive assessment of occupation shortage ratings at ANZSCO unit group (4-digit) and occupation (6-digit) levels for Australia and each state and territory.

name: Access to BreastScreen Australia Services Dashboard
description: AIHW interactive dashboard on geographic access to BreastScreen Australia screening services, supporting analysis of population coverage and service availability.

name: GEN Aged Care Data
description: Comprehensive aged care statistics portal operated by the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare. Publishes data tables, dashboards, fact sheets, and reports on capacity and activity in Australia's aged care system, including people using care, providers, services, and care needs.

name: ABS Data by region
description: Interactive regional statistics explorer of the Australian Bureau of Statistics. Users search by map or region to compare more than 4,500 areas across Australia on over 800 data items covering population, economy, industry, income, employment, education, health, and environment.

name: AIHW HSV Risk Factors Dashboard
description: AIHW heart, stroke and vascular disease risk factors dashboard shows trends and status for biomedical and behavioural risk factors including smoking, obesity, hypertension, diabetes and physical activity.

name: National Preventive Health Monitoring Dashboard
description: AIHW interactive national preventive health monitoring dashboard tracking risk-factor and preventive health indicators across Australian populations.

name: EarthByte Resources
description: EarthByte endeavors to make a variety of geological and geophysical data sets available to the community with every publication and project collaboration.

name: AEMO NEMWeb
description: Public market-data files for the Australian National Electricity Market, including outages and half-hourly reports.

name: NDIS Participant Datasets
description: Datasets focused on information about National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) participants and their experience in the Scheme. Covers topics such as participant numbers, plan budgets, plan utilisation, participants by diagnosis, participant goals, plan management types and participant demographics.

name: GNSS Data Repository
description: GNSS data collected by Continuously Operating Reference Station (CORS) is made available in RINEX files and in real-time NTRIP streams. Data includes daily, hourly, high-rate observation and navigation files, with sample rates from 1 to 30 seconds. Access methods include SFTP, S3, Web API, and web applications. All data is public under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia Licence.

name: National Road Safety Data Hub
description: Australian Government hub for national road safety statistics, run by the Office of Road Safety. Publishes dashboards and downloadable tables on road deaths, hospitalised injuries, and related safety indicators.

name: Geoscience Australia Portal
description: This portal provides full access to Geoscience Australia data and other publicly available data sources.

name: OzCoasts Maps and Data Catalog
description: OzCoasts maps and data catalog of Australian coastal, estuarine, and seabed information.

name: Digital Earth Australia Public Data Set
description: Repository holding the Public Data Set of Digital Earth Australia. Contains open-source satellite imagery and related geospatial data products for Australia.

name: Australian Government API Catalogue
description: Making it easier to discover and implement APIs offered by the Australian state, territory and federal government.

name: Fair Work Commission API
description: Open datasets for fish and wildlife management in Florida. Downloadable in various formats including CSV, KML, Zip, GeoJSON, GeoTIFF, and PNG. Includes API access.

name: METEOR - Metadata Online Registry
description: Online access to a wide range of nationally endorsed data standards for the health, community services, and housing sectors. Supports national consistency in data collection and reporting, and is based on ISO/IEC 11179 Metadata Registries.

name: AAO Data Central
description: Australian astronomical data archive providing catalogs, spectra, and TAP access for AAO and partner survey datasets.

name: National Coronial Information System
description: The National Coronial Information System (NCIS) is a secure database of information on deaths reported to a coroner in Australia and New Zealand. The NCIS contains data on almost 500,000 cases, investigated by a coroner. Data includes demographic information on the deceased, contextual details on the nature of the fatality and searchable medico-legal case reports including the coronial finding, autopsy and toxicology report and police notification of death. The database is available to coroners to assist investigations and access is available on application (subject to ethics approval processes) for research projects.

name: Online Mendelian Inheritance in Animals
description: Online Mendelian Inheritance in Animals catalog of genes, inherited disorders, and traits in animal species.

name: ANSTO Open Science Portal
description: Research data catalog of the Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organisation, listing environmental monitoring, isotope, materials, and neutron-beam datasets.

name: Brassica Genome
description: This site hosts Brassica genome databases.

name: BenthGenome
description: Nicotiana benthamiana originates from the remote regions of northern Australia. It is used extensively in laboratories around the world for many types of research including metabolic engineering, plant-microbe interactions, RNAi, vaccine production and functional genomics. This site aims to provide easy access to our latest genome and transcriptome assemblies of both laboratory and wild strains of Nicotiana benthamiana.

name: AIMS Data Catalogue
description: The AIMS Data Catalogue is the publicly accessible metadata index maintained by the Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS). It describes all data collected by AIMS (e.g. reef surveys, weather-station observations, oceanographic measurements), helping researchers find datasets useful for their work.

name: Ningaloo Atlas
description: The Ningaloo Atlas was created in response to the need for more comprehensive and accessible information on environmental and socio-economic data on the greater Ningaloo region. As such, the Ningaloo Atlas is a web portal to not only access and share information, but to celebrate and promote the biodiversity, heritage, value, and way of life of the greater Ningaloo region.

name: Australian National University - Combinatorial Data
description: This page contains some collections of combinatorial data. Unless otherwise specified, graphs are presented in either graph6 or sparse6 format. The extension on the file name (.g6 or .s6) indicates which is used in each case.

name: Tern Data Discovery Portal
description: The TERN Data Discovery Portal (TDDP) is a gateway to search and access all the datasets published by the Australian Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network. Users can conduct textual and graphical searches on the metadata catalogue using a web interface with temporal, spatial, and eco science related controlled vocabulary keywords. Requests to download data discovered through different data services associated with TERN. Downloading, using and sharing data will be subjected to the TERN data licensing framework.

name: HILDA Survey
description: The Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia (HILDA) Survey is a household-based panel study that collects valuable information about economic and personal well-being, labour market dynamics and family life.

name: PrimesDB
description: PRIMESDB is a systems biology platform that is being developed to enable the collection, integration and analysis of state-of-the-art genomics, proteomics and mathematical modelling data being generated by the PRIMES project. PRIMES is investigating the role of protein interaction machines in oncogenic signalling with a particular focus on the EGFR network. PRIMESDB provides a centralised knowledgebase and analysis platform for cancer protein interaction networks.

name: Advanced Ecological Knowledge and Observation System
description: The Advanced Ecological Knowledge and Observation System from the Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network (TERN AEKOS) focuses on ecological plot data that are generated by land-based ecosystem projects that use survey, monitoring and experimental studies to collect raw data on plants, animals (including traits) and their immediate environments at the same location. Plot data are observations sampled by using scientific techniques such as quadrants, grids, transects, animal trap arrays and other structured sampling techniques.

name: OCTOPUS database
description: OCTOPUS is a web-enabled database for visualizing, querying, and downloading cosmogenic radionuclide, luminescence, radiocarbon ages, and denudation rates related to erosional landscapes, Quaternary depositional landforms, and paleoecological, paleoenvironmental, and archaeological records. It also includes ancillary geospatial data layers.

name: CSIRO Data Access Portal
description: Data catalog providing access to scientific and research datasets managed by CSIRO.

name: Australian Waterbird Surveys
description: Australian Waterbird Surveys (AWS) is an information source of waterbird communities around Australia, based on surveys of their diversity and numbers. It relies on rigorous data collection protocols and includes more than 50 waterbird species and up to 30 years of survey data. This open source also includes the extent of flooding of thousands of wetlands observed during our surveys. As a group, waterbirds can be sentinels of the ecological health of our wetlands and rivers.

name: South Australian Resources Information Geoserver
description: SARIG is an initiative of the Government of South Australia that provides access to over 130 years of South Australian minerals, petroleum and geothermal geoscientific information in an interactive online mapping format.

name: The Sand Atlas
description: The Sand Atlas is an open project that collects and shares data on the shapes and morphologies of sand grains. Using micro-CT scans and advanced tools, it processes and labels particles to create detailed 3D models.

name: The Ecological Register
description: The Ecological Register is a repository for published lists and counts of plants and animals from individual locations around the world. It is intended for use by ecologists and students who want quick and simple access to spatially localized species abundance distributions, and is particularly useful for macroecological studies of diversity patterns.

name: TERN EcoPlots
description:
The aim of EcoPlots is to harmonise plot-based ecology data from different sources to enable integrated search and access to data based on different jurisdiction, data sources, feature types, parameters and temporal extent.
The EcoPlots is developed based on semantic data integration approach, each of the data sources are mapped to the TERN Plot ontology. Datasets are generally received from custodians in various forms including PostgreSQL database and CSV file format . In data ingestion process, each of the source datasets are mapped to a TERN Plot ontology including identifying and mapping domain feature types, parameters and categorical values to TERN controlled vocabularies, performing data validation routines and resolving taxonomic names. All data are organised in Resource Description Framework (RDF) and stored in a triple store.

name: CCC Data Base
description: The CCC method yields accurate excitation and ionisation cross sections for atomic and ionic targets which are well-modelled by one or two valence electrons above a Hartree-Fock core. Inner core ionisation can be a major contributor to the total ionisation cross section. Such contributions can be estimated using various forms of Born-based approximations.

name: Genome Taxonomy Database
description: Standardized microbial taxonomy based on genome phylogeny for Bacteria and Archaea.

name: Analysis & Policy Observatory
description: Open repository of public policy research, grey literature, and related datasets from Australian and international organisations.

name: Australian Antarctic Data Centre
description: Manages, archives, and provides long-term stewardship for Australia's Antarctic and subantarctic scientific data, supporting the Australian Antarctic Program and the international research community. Offers GIS and mapping services, data management, and scientific domain expertise.

name: University of Tasmania Research Data Portal
description: The University of Tasmania Research Data Portal (RDP) enables UTAS researchers to securely store and publish their datasets. Datasets published in RDP are publicly available through the Research Data Australia Search Portal (https://researchdata.edu.au/).

name: DMITRE Petroleum
description: South Australia has considerable potential for petroleum and geothermal energy. The Energy Resources Division provides geoscientific and engineering information and data to support industry exploration and development.

name: Australian Industrial Chemicals Introduction Scheme
description: The Australian Industrial Chemicals Introduction Scheme (AICIS) replaced the National Industrial Chemicals Notification and Assessment Scheme (NICNAS) as the national regulator for the importation and manufacture (introduction) of industrial chemicals in Australia. Assessments are conducted on the hazards and risks to human health and the environment from the introduction and use of industrial chemicals in Australia. The scope of the assessments varies and may include hazard characteristics, risk assessments and risk management recommendations to regulators and standard setting bodies in Australian and state and territory governments.

name: eFish
description: The project aims to examine and index the genomic diversity through the generation of complete mitochondrial and nuclear genome sequences of sharks and rays of the Pacific Rim. There is a huge diversity of elasmobranch fishes in this region, but many species are under threat because of poor management and conservation measures in many countries. It is absolutely critical that species’ identities are correct for conservation and fisheries management purposes.

name: BloodChIP Xtra
description: BloodChIP Xtra is a user-friendly database that facilitates genome-wide exploration and visualization of transcription factor (TF) occupancy and chromatin configuration in rare primary human hematopoietic stem (HSC-MPP) and progenitor (CMP, GMP, MEP) cells and acute myeloid leukemia (AML) cell lines (KG-1, ME-1, Kasumi1, TSU-1621-MT), along with chromatin accessibility and gene expression data from these and primary patient AMLs.  An interactive web interface allows users to explore the regulatory landscape of any gene across multiple blood cell types, and then associate the epigenetic/regulatory profile with gene expression across healthy and leukemic cells. All queries, as well as the complete database, can be exported by the user for further data analysis.

name: Colorectal Cancer Atlas
description: Colorectral Cancer Atlas is an web-based resource which integrates genomic and proteomic pertaining to colorectal cancer cell lines and tissues. Data catalogued includes, quantitative and non-quantitative protein expression, sequence variations, cellular signaling pathways, protein-protein interactions, Gene Ontology terms, protein domains and post-translational modifications (PTMs).

name: Research Data Australia
description: Find, access, and re-use data for research - from over one hundred Australian research organisations, government agencies, and cultural institutions.

name: The AuScope EarthBank Platform
description: The AuScope EarthBank platform (formerly AusGeochem) is an easy-to-use platform for uploading, visualising, analysing and discovering georeferenced sample information and data produced by various geoscience research institutions such as universities, geological survey agencies and museums.

name: Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network
description: TERN provides open data, research and management tools, data infrastructure and site-based research equipment. The open access ecosystem data is provided by TERN Data Discovery Portal , see https://www.re3data.org/repository/r3d100012013.

name: Stemformatics
description: Stemformatics is a collaboration between the stem cell and bioinformatics community. We were motivated by the plethora of exciting cell models in the public and private domains, and the realisation that for many biologists these were mostly inaccessible. We wanted a fast way to find and visualise interesting genes in these exemplar stem cell datasets. We'd like you to explore.

name: TISSUES
description: TISSUES is a weekly updated web resource that integrates evidence on tissue expression from manually curated literature, proteomics and transcriptomics screens, and automatic text mining. All evidence to common protein identifiers and Brenda Tissue Ontology terms is mapped, and confidence scores that facilitate comparison of the different types and sources of evidence are assigned. These scores are visualized on a schematic human body to provide a convenient overview.

name: 45 and Up Study
description: More than a quarter of a million people — one in 10 NSW men and women aged over 45 — have been recruited to our 45 and Up Study, the largest ongoing study of healthy ageing in the Southern Hemisphere. The baseline information collected from all of our participants is available in the Study’s Data Book.

name: cropPAL
description: cropPAL2020 provides a tool to investigate subcellular localisation in a growing number of crop species through the unification of disparate datasets and by the provision of web services through an accessible interface. Users can construct powerful queries or interrogate their protein sets resulting in a one-stop-shop for protein localisation and protein location relationships. The compendium of cropPAL2020 houses large scale proteomic (MS/MS), fluorescence protein (FP) localisation as well as Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) inferred from Arabidopsis PPI experimentation. The cropPAL2020 search interface provides flexible options of refining or interrogating protein data sets by location, interactions, protein properties and bibliographic information.

name: Pacific and Regional Archive for Digital Sources in Endangered Cultures
description: PARADISEC (the Pacific And Regional Archive for Digital Sources in Endangered Cultures) is a digital archive that preserves recordings and materials documenting endangered languages and small cultures, mainly from the Pacific and Southeast Asia. It provides access to audio, text, and visual data collected through fieldwork, ensuring they are safely digitized and catalogued according to international archiving standards.

name: World Data Centre for Space Weather
description: The World Data Centre section provides software and data catalogue information and data produced by the Bureau of Meteorology - Space Weather Services (SWS) over the past decades. Thousands of gigabytes of Ionospheric, Magnetometer, Spectrograph, Cosmic Ray data and Solar images are available for download. These areas are continually growing, with the addition of new data types, downloadable tools and data from new locations.

name: ExoCarta
description: A database of exosomes, membrane vesicles of endocytic origin released by diverse cell types.

name: TurtleSAT
description: TurtleSAT is a new website where communities are mapping the location of freshwater turtles in waterways and wetlands across the country. Australia's unique freshwater turtles are in crisis - their numbers are declining and your help is needed to record where you see turtles in your local area.

name: InnateDB
description: InnateDB has been developed to facilitate systems level investigations of the mammalian (human, mouse and bovine) innate immune response. Its goal is to provide a manually-curated knowledgebase of the genes, proteins, and particularly, the interactions and signaling responses involved in mammalian innate immunity. InnateDB incorporates information of the whole human, mouse and bovine interactomes by integrating interaction and pathway information from several of the major publicly available databases but aims to capture an improved coverage of the innate immunity interactome through manual curation.

name: Ecosounds
description: Ecosounds is a repository of environmental audio recordings. This website facilitates the management, access, visualization, and analysis of environmental acoustic data.

name: WheatGenome
description: An integrated database and portal for wheat genome information.

name: Monash University Research Repository
description: Monash University Research Repository, operated by Monash University, provides research data on humanities and social sciences, medicine, and geophysics and geodesy.

name: UniCarbKB
description: UniCarbKB is an initiative that aims to promote the creation of an online information storage and search platform for glycomics and glycobiology research. The knowledgebase will offer a freely accessible and information-rich resource supported by querying interfaces, annotation technologies and the adoption of common standards to integrate structural, experimental and functional data.

name: AIMS Data Repository
description: Data catalog for searching metadata records held by the Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS), supporting discovery of marine and environmental datasets.

name: WorldClim - Global Climate Data
description: WorldClim is a set of global climate layers (climate grids) with a spatial resolution of about 1 square kilometer. The data can be used for mapping and spatial modeling in a GIS or with other computer programs.

name: Australian Urban Research Infrastructure Network
description: AURIN is a collaborative national network of leading researchers and data providers across the academic, government, and private sectors. We provide a one-stop online workbench with access to thousands of multidisciplinary datasets, from over 100 different data sources.

name: COVID-19 Global Rheumatology Alliance
description: COVID-19 Global Rheumatology Alliance aim to collect, analyze and disseminate information about COVID-19 and rheumatology to patients, physicians and other relevant groups to improve the care of patients with rheumatic disease.

name: Australasian Virtual Herbarium
description: Australasian Virtual Herbarium, a catalog of digitised plant, algae, and fungi specimen records from Australasian herbaria.

name: Boola Boola Forest bird study
description: This study assessed differences in avian biodiversity across different forest age-classes, including mature stands (> 100 years), in a managed, mixed-species eucalypt forest located in Gippsland, south-eastern Australia. Avian surveys and detailed habitat measurements were initially carried out in 50 two hectare stands ranging in age from 100 years.

name: Bureau of Meteorology Data Catalogue
description: The Bureau of Meteorology Data Catalogue is a centralized metadata repository that documents the agency’s environmental data holdings. It provides structured descriptions of datasets related to weather, climate, oceanography, and atmospheric sciences, including information on scope, quality, and access conditions.

name: PARADISEC Catalog
description: Catalog of digitized audio, video, and text collections documenting small and endangered languages, with a focus on the Pacific and surrounding regions.

name: CardiacAI Data Repository
description: The team have established the CardiacAI Data Repository that brings large amounts of Australian healthcare data together in a secure environment with strict conditions for use of these data with an appropriate level of oversight of research activities.

name: TROVE
description: Trove helps you find and use resources relating to Australia. It’s more than a search engine. Trove brings together content from libraries, museums, archives and other research organisations and gives you tools to explore and build.

name: Australasian Right Whale Photo-Identification Catalogue (ARWPIC)
description: An online platform to share images and sightings of southern right whales, enabling individual identification and tracking. Used to support conservation management and research on this endangered species.

name: Australia Telescope Online Archive
description: Australia Telescope Online Archive of observations from the Australia Telescope Compact Array and Parkes.

name: Language Data Commons of Australia
description: National discovery portal for Australian language data collections, including materials previously held in the Australian National Corpus.

name: UniCarb-DR
description: A repository of glycans with associated MS information and spectra. The repository allows researcher to submit their glycomics MS data for public display. The data is not curated by other than then data provider. Curated data will be transfered to UniCarb-DR

name: Australian Data Archive
description: The Australian Data Archive (ADA) provides a national service for the collection and preservation of digital research data. ADA disseminates this data for secondary analysis by academic researchers and other users. The archive is based in the ANU Centre for Social Research and Methods (CSRM) at the Australian National University (ANU).

name: IMOS Animal Tracking Database
description: National acoustic telemetry catalog for the IMOS Animal Tracking Facility. It collates receiver deployments, tag metadata, and animal detections from a continent-wide hydrophone network, with public exploration and login-based data contribution, filtering, and download.

name: Australian Drosophila Ecology and Evolution Resource
description: The Australian Drosophila Ecology and Evolution Resource (ADEER) is a disciplinary research data repository that provides open access to datasets on the ecology, evolution, genomics, and biogeography of Australian Drosophila species. The repository includes long-term clinal surveys, species distribution records, genomic datasets, and phenotypic data collected by the Hoffmann Lab and collaborating researchers. ADEER was developed to preserve, curate, and share these datasets for studies of evolutionary biology, climate adaptation, and biodiversity.

name: Chickpea Portal
description: This resource contains genome and gene sequences, features and isolationed chromosome alignments, while functional annotation can be searched in GBrowse. Chickpea forms a critical component of the Australian and Indian farming system, offering offer a high value alternative to cereals, an important disease break, opportunities for grass weed control and respite from high nitrogen application.

name: Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry
description: The Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry (ANZCTR) is an online register of clinical trials being undertaken in Australia, New Zealand and elsewhere. The ANZCTR includes trials from the full spectrum of therapeutic areas of pharmaceuticals, surgical procedures, preventive measures, lifestyle, devices, treatment and rehabilitation strategies and complementary therapies. The ANZCTR mandatory data items comply with the minimum dataset requirements of the International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE) and the World Health Organization (WHO).

name: OzFlux Data Portal
description: Public catalog of OzFlux flux-tower collections, with site lists, maps, and downloads of carbon, water, and energy exchange measurements across Australian ecosystems.

name: ConoServer
description: ConoServer is a database specializing in sequences and structures of peptides expressed by marine cone snails. The database gives access to protein sequences, nucleic acid sequences and structural information on conopeptides. ConoServer's data are first collected from the peer reviewed literature and from publicly available databases, including UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot, NCBI nucleotide (nt), and the World Wide Protein Data Bank. The data are then curated manually, which include the addition of references, the analysis of sequence regions, the identification of cysteine frameworks and gene superfamilies, and the identification of mature peptides in the precusor sequences.

name: Research Vocabularies Australia
description: Research Vocabularies Australia (RVA) helps users access and reuse vocabularies for all areas of research. Some vocabularies are hosted by the Australian Research Data Commons (ARDC) and can be accessed directly through the RVA, otherwise links are provided to the vocabulary owner’s web page. Research Vocabularies Australia also allows you to create and/or publish a vocabulary as well as integrate an existing vocabulary into your own system.

name: Data Hub of Australian Research on Marine and Aquatic Ecocultures
description: DHARMAE (Data Hub of Australian Research on Marine and Aquatic Ecocultures) is a disciplinary research data repository hosted by the University of Technology Sydney (UTS). It brings together interdisciplinary datasets related to water, marine systems, ecology, and cultural knowledge, including Indigenous and local community perspectives. The repository supports the discovery and reuse of research data linked to environmental and social studies of aquatic ecosystems, particularly in Australia. It is mainly used to store and share curated research project data within a controlled research infrastructure.

name: ATNF Pulsar Catalogue
description: All observations obtained with the Parkes radio telescope are made available to the general community after an embargo period. Usually this embargo period is set to 18 months after the observation. The catalogue includes all published rotation-powered pulsars, including those detected only at high energies. It also includes Anomalous X-ray Pulsars (AXPs) and Soft Gamma-ray Repeaters (SGRs) for which coherent pulsations have been detected.

name: NOPIMS
description: Public catalog of Australian offshore petroleum well and survey data, reports, and downloads.

name: Monash University - Combinatorial data
description: A mathematical research data archive in combinatorics, especially focused on properties and enumerations of Latin squares and related combinatorial structures.

name: Banana21
description: The vast majority of the bananas currently grown and consumed were not conventionally bred but are selections made over probably thousands of years from naturally occurring hybrids. Cultivated bananas are very nearly sterile and as a consequence are not propagated from seed but rather through vegetative propagation, primarily suckers as well as more recently micropropagated or tissue cultured bananas. These factors, very old selections, near sterility and vegetative propagation, mean that these bananas have not been genetically improved either for resistance or improved quality and are becoming increasing in affected by serious pests and diseases.

name: HealthStats ACT
description: ACT Health population health statistics and indicators from the Epidemiology Section. Topic dashboards and Excel tables cover alcohol, cancer, deaths, risk factors, mental health, mothers and babies, and related series.

name: WA Health Our Performance
description: WA Department of Health Our performance hub publishes hospital emergency department, elective surgery, hand hygiene and related public hospital performance indicators and dashboards for Western Australia.

name: DEMIRS Data and Software Centre
description: The Data and Software Centre lets you download state-wide spatial datasets, geology series map data, resources such as Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety (DEMIRS) software (including user guides and videos where available), and documentation on map services provided by DEMIRS.

name: AGLDWG Catalogue - Linked Data PID Register
description: Australian Government Linked Data Working Group register of persistent identifiers for Linked Data resources: datasets, ontologies, vocabularies, registers and organisations.

name: Censo 2024 — Angola
description: Official 2024 Population and Housing Census results portal of Angola's Instituto Nacional de Estatística. Publishes a national statistical panorama (36.6 million inhabitants), a provincial explorer, a census atlas, and Excel/PDF downloads covering 76 indicators for all 21 provinces on population, housing, energy, water, sanitation, and education.

name: Plataforma de Monitorização Agro-Climática (INAMET)
description: INAMET agro-climatic monitoring platform for southern Angola (Cunene, Huíla, and Namibe). Publishes province, municipality, and grid indicators for precipitation, temperature, soil water, vegetation health, and drought, plus hydrologic-year bulletins.

name: Banco Nacional de Angola Statistics
description: National Bank of Angola statistics catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: Geoportal ZPUSMZ
description: Public county geoportal of the Sisak-Moslavina Institute for Spatial Planning, with OpenLayers map layers and a GeoServer WFS of spatial plans and cadastre.

name: GIS Grada Varaždina
description: Public web GIS of the Town of Varaždin, with a layer menu and map measurement tools.

name: GeoPortal Zagrebačke infrastrukture prostornih podataka
description: Public ZIPP geoportal of the City of Zagreb, listing thematic maps and WMS services for planning, cadastre, environment, and related spatial layers.

name: SDŽ GIS Portal
description: Public GIS portal of Split-Dalmatia County with interactive maps of county facilities and spatial data.

name: Geoportal Zavoda za prostorno uređenje PGŽ
description: Geoportal of the Institute for Spatial Planning of Primorje-Gorski Kotar County for viewing, overlaying, and downloading spatial-plan data.

name: DZS Public microdata
description: Croatian Bureau of Statistics list of public-use microdata files. Currently the 2011 census of population, households and dwellings, the 2016 tourist activity survey, and the 2016 adult education survey. Download requires registration.

name: Hrvatski zavod za zapošljavanje - Statistika On-Line
description: Interactive labour market statistics database of the Croatian Employment Service. It provides monthly and annual data on registered unemployment, inflows and outflows from the unemployment register, and job vacancies from 1952 to the present.

name: Državni zavod za statistiku - Croatian Bureau of Statistics Data Catalog
description: Official data catalog and statistical portal of the Croatian Bureau of Statistics

name: DZS short-term business statistics (STS) database
description: Short-term business statistics (STS) database of the Croatian Bureau of Statistics covering industry, construction, services, and trade.

name: Croatian National Access Point
description: Croatia's National Access Point (NAP) for road and traffic data, operated by Hrvatske ceste d.o.o. The catalog publishes metadata and DATEX II feeds for real-time traffic conditions, roadworks, cameras, weather, and infrastructure data required under the EU ITS Directive.

name: Narodne novine
description: Official gazette of Croatia. Searchable catalog of published laws and other official acts.

name: Geoportal DGU
description: Official geoportal of the State Geodetic Administration of Croatia (DGU), providing map viewing and OGC services for official state maps, orthophotos, cadastre, spatial units, and INSPIRE datasets.

name: Geoportal ISPU
description: Official geoportal of Croatia's Spatial Planning Information System (ISPU). Provides public access to national, regional and local spatial plans, building permits and related spatial layers maintained by the Ministry of Physical Planning, Construction and State Assets.

name: GeoAdriatic - Croatian Marine Spatial Data Portal
description: Croatian Marine Spatial Data Portal providing search and view services for marine spatial data and e-services of the Hydrographic Institute of the Republic of Croatia, including nautical charts, bathymetry, navigational warnings, and hydrographic surveys.

name: Real Property Registration and Cadastre Joint Information System (JIS)
description: Public map application of Croatia's Joint Information System (JIS) for land registry and cadastre (Uređena zemlja / Organised Land). Provides search and map viewing of cadastral parcels, possessors, and land registry owners, operated by the State Geodetic Administration and the Ministry of Justice.

name: Bioportal GIS
description: GIS viewer of the Nature Protection Information System (Bioportal) for protected areas, Natura 2000, habitats, and species distribution in Croatia.

name: ARKOD Preglednik
description: Official web map viewer of Croatia's Land Parcel Identification System (ARKOD / LPIS), operated by the Paying Agency for Agriculture, Fisheries and Rural Development. Provides public access to agricultural land-use parcels, cadastral overlays, orthophoto, and related LPIS layers, with INSPIRE WMS and WFS services.

name: GeoPortal Hrvatskih voda
description: Interactive geoportal of Hrvatske vode (Croatian Waters) for viewing and analysing national water-management spatial data. Thematic layers include agglomeration registers, flood hazard and risk maps, preliminary flood risk assessment, and protected water areas. OGC map and feature services are published through GeoServer.

name: GeoHrvatska
description: Public viewer of official Croatian spatial data from NSDI (NIPP) subjects, maintained by the State Geodetic Administration.

name: HAC Geoportal
description: Public geoportal of Croatian Motorways (HAC) for viewing and downloading motorway spatial data.

name: DEMLAS Data Warehouse
description: DEMLAS land-administration data warehouse of the Faculty of Geodesy, University of Zagreb, for searching and downloading cadastral, land-cover, elevation, and related project datasets. The former GeoNetwork catalogue at /geonetwork is no longer published.

name: KLASUS - Croatian Bureau of Statistics Classification Database
description: KLASUS is a tool designed for use by all users of classifications, which enables browsing and searching of classifications by name and code, provides a presentation of individual elements of classifications, their headings, explanations or indices, if any, as well as correspondence tables between various versions of classifications. It also offers a chance to download classifications in multiple formats with all their levels and elements.

name: MATDAT
description: Materials-properties database of design-relevant metals with static, cyclic, and fatigue data used in mechanical engineering and finite-element analysis.

name: BNM Reports Generator
description: Interactive reports generator of the National Bank of Moldova, publishing official monetary, financial, and macroeconomic statistical tables for download.

name: Monitorul Oficial
description: Official gazette of the Republic of Moldova.

name: MTender Public Procurement Portal
description: MTender public procurement portal of the Republic of Moldova. Publishes the State Register of Public Procurement as Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) 1.1 records, with a public tender search UI and a JSON listing API.

name: AGEPI Intellectual Property Databases
description: AGEPI intellectual property databases for Moldova, with searchable registers of patents, trademarks, industrial designs, plant varieties, geographical indications, and related objects, plus bulk WIPO ST.36 XML downloads of the national patent collection.

name: SIA Cadastrul de Stat al Apelor
description: State Water Cadastre information system of the Republic of Moldova, providing public map layers and records of water bodies, intakes, and water management objects.

name: Harta interactivă a drumurilor din Republica Moldova
description: Public interactive road map of the National Road Administration of Moldova, listing national, regional, and TEN-T road layers, pavement condition, traffic, and related datasets.

name: Pécs Zöldkataszter
description: Public green-space cadastre of Pécs with queryable layers for trees, shrubs, green areas, public space, and locally protected sites.

name: BKK OpenData
description: Open data portal of the Centre for Budapest Transport (BKK), publishing static GTFS timetable data and GTFS-Realtime feeds for Budapest public transport.

name: Újbuda térinformatikai rendszer
description: Public MapFish/OpenLayers GIS of Budapest District XI (Újbuda), with cadastre, zoning, institutions, green inventory, and related municipal layers via MapServer WMS/WFS.

name: Budapest Térinformatikai Portál
description: Official GIS portal of the Municipality of Budapest, publishing public spatial applications and map data for the capital.

name: NFSZ Labour Market Statistics
description: Labour-market statistics portal of the National Employment Service (NFSZ), with interactive series on registered jobseekers, active labour-market programmes, settlement-level unemployment, and related employment indicators.

name: AKI Agricultural Information Portal
description: Public agricultural information portal of the Institute of Agricultural Economics (AKI), with queryable Market Price Information System (PÁIR) series and Farm Accountancy Data Network (FADN / tesztüzem) tables for Hungary.

name: KSH Sustainable Development Indicators
description: National sustainable development indicator set of the Hungarian Central Statistical Office, grouped by the National Framework Strategy on Sustainable Development resources and by the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals.

name: KSH STADAT
description: STADAT predefined statistical tables of the Hungarian Central Statistical Office. Complements the Statinfo query database with ready-made indicator tables on population, labour, prices, national accounts, and social statistics.

name: MNB Statistics
description: Statistical publications and time-series portal of the Magyar Nemzeti Bank, covering monetary, financial-account, supervisory, and related official statistics, with SDMX downloads on selected series.

name: KSH Statinfo Dissemination Database
description: Official dissemination database (Statinfo / Tájékoztatási adatbázis) of the Hungarian Central Statistical Office. Users can select statistical themes and build custom tables covering population, labour, education, health, income, housing, national accounts, business statistics, agriculture, energy, transport, tourism, prices, science and technology, environment, and territorial statistics.

name: KSH Gazetteer of Hungary
description: Official gazetteer of Hungarian localities (Helyiségnévtár) of the Hungarian Central Statistical Office. Lists settlement names, administrative classification, and main census and demographic indicators.

name: KSH Census 2022 Database
description: Interactive Census 2022 query database of the Hungarian Central Statistical Office. Users build tables from 45 data cubes on population, households, families, and dwellings, with breakdowns to county, district, and settlement.

name: Magyar Közlöny
description: Official gazette of Hungary. Catalog of issues of the Magyar Közlöny.

name: OKIR environmental information system
description: Hungarian National Environmental Information System, including the public E-PRTR module and related environmental registers.

name: OVF Hydrological Open Data
description: Public hydrological open-data portal of the General Directorate of Water Management (OVF), listing water-level, discharge, water-temperature, groundwater and precipitation station time series for download; distinct from geoportal.vizugy.hu ArcGIS REST.

name: KSH High-Value Datasets
description: High-Value Datasets portal of the Hungarian Central Statistical Office (KSH), providing machine-readable statistical datasets and an OpenAPI at data.ksh.hu.

name: Rendőrségi térképtár
description: Hungarian National Police public map library (Digitális Térképészeti Rendszer) with crime, accident and thematic map compositions and an unauthenticated OData Open Data API.

name: CARPATCLIM - Carpathian Climate Data Portal
description: CARPATCLIM climate atlas for the Carpathian Region, publishing harmonized historic climate grids (1961-2010) for regional climatology and drought studies. The former GeoNetwork instance on port 10000 is unreachable; data remain on the project website.

name: NATéR Metadata Search
description: Public metadata search interface of the National Adaptation Geo-information System (NATéR / NAGiS), operated by HungaroMet.

name: TEIR Territorial Information System
description: National Territorial Information System (TEIR) portal for Hungarian regional statistics and maps. The former gis.teir.hu ArcGIS Server is unreachable; the public interface is now the OENY TEIR application.

name: SZTFH Map Server
description: SZTFH geological map server providing interactive geological and geophysical maps of Hungary, with public WMS and WFS services.

name: Földmegfigyelési Információs Rendszer (eFöld)
description: Földmegfigyelési Információs Rendszer (FIR / eFöld), Hungary's Copernicus Collaborative Ground Segment catalog for searching, viewing and downloading Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-3 products. Public search is available; download requires registration.

name: HungaroMet Meteorological Data Archive
description: HungaroMet open meteorological data archive (Meteorológiai Adattár) providing free observation, climate, and forecast data files under Hungary's open meteorological data policy.

name: ReSpecTh
description: ReSpecTh is a scientific data repository that provides curated datasets in reaction kinetics, spectroscopy, and thermochemistry useful for chemical research and modelling. The database includes experimental, empirical, and computed data on gas‑phase reactions and molecular properties, often applied in combustion and atmospheric chemistry studies.

name: Translocatome
description: Translocatome is a database that collects and characterises manually curated and predicted translocating proteins from human cells. The prediction is made by a gradient boosting based machine learning algorithm (XGBoost), using highly curated positive and negative learning sets.

name: Országos Légszennyezettségi Mérőhálózat
description: Hungarian national air-quality monitoring network. Automatic and manual station measurements and assessments.

name: Compartmentalized Protein-Protein Interaction
description: The compartmentalized protein-protein interaction database (ComPPI), provides qualitative information on the interactions, proteins and their localizations integrated from multiple databases for protein-protein interaction network analysis.

name: TÁRKI Data Archive
description: National social science data archive of Hungary (CESSDA ERIC service provider), with a public catalogue of survey and related empirical research datasets since 1985.

name: Törökbálint térinformatikai rendszere
description: Public municipal GIS of Törökbálint with a layer catalog covering cadastre, institutions, and other local spatial datasets.

name: Open Data Den Haag
description: Open data portal of the municipality of The Hague (Den Haag)

name: E-depot of Erfgoed Leiden en Omstreken (part of Gemeente Leiden)
description: Erfgoed Leiden en Omstreken (ELO) is part of the municipality of Leiden. ELO performs services related to historical preservation, archaeology and archiving for the municipality of Leiden, as well as ten other surrounding municipalities and implementation services such as the fire department and municipal health services. ELO is responsible for physical archives and digital (born) archives.

name: Dutch PV Portal 3.0 Meteorological Data Portal
description: A portal providing access to meteorological data collected and stored in the Dutch PV Portal 3.0 database, including weather and climate data for 46 weather stations in the Netherlands and provincial averages. Data is sourced from KNMI and used to assess solar panel performance.

name: Radboud Data Repository
description: Institutional repository that supports Radboud University and Radboudumc researchers in archiving and sharing collected, processed, or analyzed data. The repository assigns a DOI and rich metadata to every collection and supports long-term storage, internal archival, and public publication of research data.

name: Centerdata Microdata Catalog
description: LISS Data Archive, providing access to microdata collected by the LISS panel for scientific research.

name: BHIC — Brabants Historisch Informatie Centrum
description: The Het Geheugen van Brabant is the regional historical archive for the Dutch province of North Brabant. It provides access to historical records, photos, film clips, and genealogical data that document life and heritage in Brabant over many centuries.

name: Regionaal Archief Tilburg
description: Regionaal Archief Tilburg (RA Tilburg) is one of the four institutions of foundation Mommerskwartier and is based in Tilburg, the Netherlands. The statutory task (Public Records Act https://www.nationaalarchief.nl/sites/default/files/field-file/Netherlands%20Public%20Records%20Act%201995.pdf) of RA Tilburg is to function as a repository for decentralized, local government organizations such as municipalities, communal schemes, and Water Authorities.

name: Data & Cijfers Almelo
description: Open data portal. managed by Gemeente Almelo. powered by Custom software. accessible at data.almelo.nl.

name: Dalfsenkaart
description: Public thematic map site of Gemeente Dalfsen with municipal geodata including BGT layers.

name: Geoportaal Overijssel
description: Public geoportal of Provincie Overijssel with searchable maps and GIS file downloads. Distinct from the GeoServer backends at services.geodataoverijssel.nl.

name: Maddison Historical Statistics
description: Maddison Project long-run GDP and population statistics for countries and regions, maintained by the Groningen Growth and Development Centre.

name: Economic Transformation Database
description: Sectoral employment and value-added series for developing economies, from the Groningen Growth and Development Centre.

name: Clio Infra
description: Historical global indicator datasets on population, prices, wages, and inequality, reconstructed for modern country boundaries.

name: DNB Statistics Data Search
description: De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) statistics data search portal providing access to macroeconomic time series and statistical data. Covers areas including monetary policy, financial stability, banking supervision, economic activity, prices, exchange rates, money and capital markets, public finances, and other economic indicators for the Netherlands.

name: World Input-Output Database
description: World input-output tables and socio-economic accounts for major economies, hosted by the Groningen Growth and Development Centre.

name: Gasunie Transport Services Transparency
description: Operational gas-transport transparency data for the Dutch transmission network.

name: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) Data Catalog
description: Official Dutch statistics catalog by Statistics Netherlands (CBS), providing open data on various national topics, based on administrative registers and surveys.

name: Global Data Lab
description: Global and subnational indicators on human development, education, health, climate, wealth, gender, demographics, governance and the Sustainable Development Goals, produced from household surveys and other research sources.

name: RVO - Offshore Wind Datahub
description: A modern data catalog designed to streamline metadata management, data discovery, and data governance. It enables users to efficiently explore and manage data assets.

name: Spotzi Data Catalog
description: Spotzi's data catalog offers premium data add-ons for users seeking to enrich their mapping, profiling, and targeting solutions with global and regional datasets such as postal code boundaries, demographics, consumer behavior, POI data, etc.

name: Officiële bekendmakingen
description: Official publications catalog of the Netherlands, including the Staatsblad, Staatscourant, and other official announcements.

name: Emissieregistratie
description: Dutch national emission inventory. Public tables of pollutant releases to air, water and soil from point and diffuse sources, including E-PRTR facilities.

name: Nationaal Toegangspunt Mobiliteitsdata
description: Dutch National Access Point for mobility data (NTM). Metadata catalog for ITS and multimodal datasets, distinct from NDOV Loket.

name: TenderNed Aanbestedingsdatasets
description: Open datasets of Dutch public procurement notices published by TenderNed.

name: PDOK Datasets
description: The PDOK Datasets website is a public data catalog providing access to Dutch geospatial datasets and services.

name: NDOV Loket
description: Dutch public-transport data locker with operator folders of GTFS and NeTEx timetable files.

name: Land Portal Datasets
description: Datasets covering a wide range of land-related themes and issues, sourced from various international data providers, useful for land governance, research and policy-making.

name: EP-Online
description: Public files of registered energy labels and energy performance for buildings in the Netherlands, including a full extract and update files.

name: Netherlands Space Office Open Data Portal
description: Het Satellietdataportaal van Netherlands Space Office (NSO) biedt gratis toegang tot voorbewerkte satellietdata van Nederland, met een focus op hoge-resolutiefoto’s. Het portaal is een generieke voorziening die diverse toepassingen mogelijk maakt, waaronder het verbeteren van basisregistratiesystemen op plekken zoals Bonaire, Saba en Sint Eustatius.

name: PBL Dataportaal
description: Public dataset and map portal of PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency. Distinct from the PBL ArcGIS services at geoservice.pbl.nl.

name: DMI Products and Data Catalog
description: Public product catalogue of the Dutch Metropolitan Innovations ecosystem. Dataset listings from municipalities and vendors are browsable without login; transactions go through connected DMI marketplaces.

name: Actueel Hoogtebestand Nederland (AHN)
description: Official portal for Actueel Hoogtebestand Nederland (AHN), the national LiDAR elevation dataset of the Netherlands. Provides a 2D height viewer, a 3D point-cloud viewer, and access to DTM, DSM, and LAZ downloads covering the whole country.

name: GeoTiles (TU Delft)
description: Tiled nationwide geodata catalog hosted by TU Delft, providing AHN1–AHN5 LiDAR point clouds and rasters, Beeldmateriaal orthophotos, and JARKUS coastal LiDAR as overlapping map-sheet tiles for download and parallel processing.

name: MATROOS Operational Ocean Data Services
description: MATROOS (Multifunctional Access Tool foR Operational Oceandata Services) catalog of North Sea operational model and monitoring time series used by NOOS partners.

name: 3DBAG
description: Open 3D building models for the Netherlands, with a public viewer and collections API covering LoD1 and LoD2 building geometry.

name: Atlas Leefomgeving
description: Dutch living-environment atlas. Public maps of environmental noise, air and related themes, including Environmental Noise Directive layers.

name: LIWO Landelijk Informatiesysteem Water en Overstromingen
description: LIWO (Landelijk Informatiesysteem Water en Overstromingen), the national flood-information map viewer, with GeoServer WMS and WCS layers.

name: Waterkwaliteitsportaal
description: Dutch water-quality portal used to exchange and publish surface-water and Water Framework Directive data.

name: DANS (Data Archiving and Networked Services) Data Search Engine
description: A data catalog provided by Data Archiving and Networked Services (DANS), which is a national service focusing on archiving and providing access to research data from various disciplines, often related to academia.

name: NS API Portal
description: Catalog of Nederlandse Spoorwegen APIs for rail travel, disruptions, and related open data.

name: Netherlands Government API Catalogues
description: Catalog of APIs for government datasets, provided by the Dutch government.

name: Stelselcatalogus
description: National metadata catalog of Dutch government data concepts, information models and relationships across base registers such as BRP, the Trade Register and the Cadastre. Published as a knowledge graph with SPARQL access.

name: Kinase-Ligand Interaction Fingerprints and Structures database
description: Kinase-Ligand Interaction Fingerprints and Structures database (KLIFS) is a database that revolves around the protein structure of catalytic kinase domains and the way kinase inhibitors can interact with them. Based on the underlying systematic and consistent protocol all (currently human and mouse) kinase structures and the binding mode of kinase ligands can be directly compared to each other. Moreover, because of the classification of an all-encompassing binding site of 85 residues it is possible to compare the interaction patterns of kinase-inhibitors to each other to, for example, identify crucial interactions determining kinase-inhibitor selectivity.

name: Paired Omics Data Platform
description: Paired Omics Data Platform (PoDP) was created to streamline access to paired omics data so humans and computers can access and read paired datasets as well as record and exploit validated links between BGCs and metabolites. The aim of the PoDP is to connect public metabolomics datasets to their genomic origins. The PoDP does not store any metabolomics or genomics datasets, but captures metadata defining pairs of omics datasets in existing public databases and platforms already validated and utilized by the genomics and metabolomics communities.

name: Repository SCP
description: The Repository SCP is the institutional repository for the Netherlands Institute for Social Research (SCP), which is a government agency which conducts research into the social aspects of all areas of government policy. The main fields studied are health, welfare, social security, the labour market and education, with a particular focus on the interfaces between these fields. The reports published by SCP are widely used by government, civil servants, local authorities and academics.

name: Longitudinal Aging Study Amsterdam Database
description: The Longitudinal Aging Study Amsterdam (LASA) is a long-term, multidisciplinary cohort study of older adults in the Netherlands, started in 1992, tracking physical, cognitive, emotional, and social functioning. It includes multiple measurement “waves” over decades, allowing researchers to study trajectories and predictors of aging. Access to LASA data requires submitting a research proposal, which is reviewed by a steering committee; the data are not open publicly but are shared under conditions to ensure scientific use.

name: KNMI Climate Explorer
description: The KNMI Climate Explorer is a web application to analysis climate data statistically.

name: CLARIAH Tools
description: CLARIAH tools offers a Common Lab providing access to large collections of tools (i.e. software and software services) developed in the CLARIAH project, as well as some tools from predecessors and sister projects. Our tools are designed for researchers and developers in the Humanities and Social Sciences.

name: NLOG Dutch subsurface data
description: Public data on oil, gas, geothermal energy, salt, and subsurface storage in the Netherlands and on the Dutch continental shelf.

name: Open Rotterdam Glaucoma Imaging Data Sets
description: Open Rotterdam Glaucoma Imaging Data Sets, operated by Stichting Glaucoomfonds, provides research data on neurosciences, clinical neurosciences iii - ophthalmology, and medicine.

name: COVID-19 related data initiatives - Project overview
description: Overview of COVID-19 related data initiatives managed by Health-RI, collating projects from academic and health institutions.

name: DHS Data Access
description: The DNB Household Survey (DHS) supplies longitudinal data to the international academic community, with a focus on the psychological and economic aspects of financial behavior. The study comprises information on work, pensions, housing, mortgages, income, assets, loans, health, economic and psychological concepts, and personal characteristics. The DHS data are collected from 2,000 households participating in the CentERpanel.

name: LOFAR Long Term Archive
description: LOFAR Long Term Archive of radio interferometric observations from the Low-Frequency Array.

name: Naturalis BioPortal
description: Naturalis BioPortal is the public catalog of digitized natural-history specimens and species data from Naturalis and partner collections, served by the Netherlands Biodiversity API.

name: RIPE Atlas
description: Global Internet measurement network with public probes, built-in measurements, and a results catalog.

name: Donders Repository
description: The Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition and Behavior at the Radboud University created the Donders Repository for archiving, preserving and sharing the research data generated and processed at the institute.

name: PROFILES Registry
description: The PROFILES registry aims to provide a national resource for research into the psychosocial well-being of cancer survivors in conjunction with the Netherlands Cancer Registry and its clinical embedding that builds on high quality cancer registry data.

name: PSnpBind
description: PSnpBind is an open-access scientific database of mutated protein–ligand binding complexes created with a high-throughput virtual screening workflow. It contains hundreds of thousands of protein–ligand dockings that show how single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in protein binding sites affect ligand binding affinity.

name: Define Secondary Structure of Proteins
description: The DSSP algorithm (Kabsch & Sander, Biopolymers. [1983] 22:2577-2637) annotates the secondary structure of protein structures in detail, including hydrogen bonding and beta sheet topology. The DSSP databank provides these annotations for all structure models in the Protein Data Bank (PDB). The annotations are available in two formats: annotated mmCIF files (preferred) and the DSSP format (deprecated).

name: CLARIN INT Portal
description: The focus of CLARIN INT Portal is on resources that are relevant to the lexicological study of the Dutch language and on resources relevant for research in and development of language and speech technology. For Example: lexicons, lexical databases, text corpora, speech corpora, language and speech technology tools, etc.

name: Adjectives Project
description: The Adjectives Project is a website that collects interesting examples and theorems of schemes and morphisms in algebraic geometry. The aim of this project is to gain a better understanding of the many adjectives regarding schemes and morphisms, and the relation between them. The website can be used to find examples of schemes and morphisms with certain adjectives. It also uses the theorems to automatically make deductions about the properties of the schemes and morphisms.

name: Leiden Open Variation Database
description: The Leiden Open Variation Database (LOVD) provides a flexible, freely available tool for gene-centered collection and display of DNA variations. LOVD also stores patient-centered data, NGS data, and variants outside of genes.

name: Le Superficie Algebriche
description: A tool for studying numerical invariants of minimal algebraic surfaces over the complex numbers, implemented in order to better understand the Enriques–Kodaira classification and to showcase how mathematics can be visualised on the web.

name: AlphaFill
description:
The AlphaFill databank contains computational structure models from the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database and the Big Fantastic Virus Database that are enriched with co-factor, ligand and ion coordinates that are transplanted from experimental structure models (from PDB-REDO) by homology. The level of sequence identity, the global and local structure similarity, and the atomic clashes between the transplant and the protein are used as descriptors to assess transplant quality. 
The web interface also allows the filling of user-provided structure models.

name: Climate4Impact
description: Climate4Impact is a portal for climate model data operated by KNMI. It supports climate change impact modellers and consultants with access to GCM/RCM data and transformation tools, developed in the European IS-ENES projects.

name: European Climate Assessment & Dataset
description: The European Climate Assessment & Dataset (ECA&D) is a large observational climate database that collects daily weather and climate data from thousands of meteorological stations across Europe and the Mediterranean. It provides long-term records of climate variables and extreme events to support monitoring and analysis of climate change and variability.

name: eLaborate
description: eLaborate is the Huygens Institute transcription and annotation platform for historical texts and scholarly editions.

name: UMCG Research Data Catalogue
description: The UMCG Research Data Catalogue is a manually filled catalogue for large data collections (i.e. Databanks and Biobanks) of the University medical center Groningen. Currently you can find more than 60 resources in this catalogue, however this catalogue is still in development. In the future we hope to share all re-usable research data of the UMCG in this catalogue.

name: ProRepeat: An Integrated Repository for Studying Amino Acid Tandem Repeats in Proteins
description: ProRepeat is an integrated curated repository and analysis platform for in-depth research on the biological characteristics of amino acid tandem repeats. ProRepeat collects repeats from all proteins included in the UniProt knowledgebase, together with 85 completely sequenced eukaryotic proteomes contained within the RefSeq collection.

name: CLARIN Standards Information System
description:
CLARIN Standards Information System provides information on the LRT (Language Resources and Technology) standards and data formats used across CLARIN. CLARIN (https://www.clarin.eu/content/about-clarin ) stands for "Common Language Resources and Technology Infrastructure" and is an ERIC (European Research Infrastructure Consortium), a distributed network of language-resource and language-research centres across Europe (and beyond). CLARIN centres often allow for data depositions for archiving or processing, in formats that correspond to their research profiles.
The primary aim of the CLARIN SIS is to aggregate and visualise information on data deposition formats used by CLARIN centres and on standards recommended to centres and to individual users. Its secondary aims include providing the basis for research on data formats and aggregating data from other Research Infrastructures that focus on various aspects of Digital Humanities.
Information provided by the SIS is open access and can be retrieved via API.

name: AHCODA-DB
description: AHCODA-DB is a data repository with web-based mining tools for the analysis of automated high-content mouse phenomics data. It provides users with tools to systematically explore mouse behavioural data, both with positive and negative outcome, published and unpublished, across time and experiments with single mouse resolution.

name: Zorggegevens
description: Zorggegevens is a metadata base with an overview of metadata from datasources about public health and care in the Netherlands. In this overview Zorggegevens shows who collects what data, for what purpose, who finances this datasource, what the data is used for and where the data is available for secondary data usage. This overview concerns sources such as healthcare records, patient records, surveys, monitors and other sources that are available for secondary data usage.

name: Maastricht University Library Digital Collections
description: Maastricht University Library Digital Collection is the digital heritage showcase of Maastricht University Library. It provides access to digitized and born-digital materials from the university’s special and heritage collections, including manuscripts, rare books, photographs, and art collections.

name: Orfeus - European Integrated Data Archive
