description: EIDA, an initiative within ORFEUS, is a distributed federation of datacenters established to (a) securely archive seismic waveform data and metadata gathered by European research infrastructures, and (b) to provide transparent access to the archives by the geosciences research communities.

name: Netherlands Cancer Registry
description: The Netherlands Cancer Registry is the national registration since 1989, providing statistics on cancer in the Netherlands. The registry is maintained by the Netherlands Comprehensive Cancer Organisation (IKNL). Data on incidence, prevalence, survival, mortality can be viewed in NCR data & figures on the IKNL website.

name: Parameters of Strongly Regular Graphs
description: Tables with parameters for strongly regular graphs, with columns for: existence; number of vertices (v); valency (k); number of common neighbours of two adjacent vertices (λ); number of common neighbours of two nonadjacent vertices (μ); positive eigenvalue with multiplicity (rf); negative eigenvalue with multiplicity (sg); comments (undocumented at present).

name: Penn World Table
description: PWT version 10.1 is a database with information on relative levels of income, output, input and productivity, covering 183 countries between 1950 and 2019.

name: National Library of the Netherlands  e-depot
description: The e-Depot of the National Library of the Netherlands (KB) is the library's digital-preservation archive for electronic publications and related digital objects deposited for long-term access.

name: Erasmus University Rotterdam Data Repository
description: The EUR Data Repository (EDR) is the institutional data-repository of Erasmus University Rotterdam.

name: DEB Register
description: International Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa Patient Registry (DEB Register) provides phenotypic and genotypic information on DEB and the related COL7A1 mutations. The registry is intended to aid in disease diagnosis, genetic counseling, and discovery of novel insights.

name: Fanography
description: A tool to visually study the geography of Fano 3-folds.

name: PseudoBase
description: PseudoBase is a collection of RNA pseudoknots that have been made available for retrieval to the scientific community.

name: Luchtmeetnet
description: Dutch air-quality measurement network. Station readings, maps and open downloads of monitoring data.

name: CancerData
description: The CancerData site is an effort of the Medical Informatics and Knowledge Engineering team (MIKE for short) of Maastro Clinic, Maastricht, The Netherlands. It offers a central, online repository for the sustained storage of clinical protocols, publications and research datasets. The data that are offered can vary from documents, spreadsheets to (bio-)medical images and treatment simulations. CancerData is a registered member of DataCite, which is an international consortium and member of the International DOI Foundation. Via DataCite, we have the ability to offer persistent identifiers to the datasets via the registration of Digital Object Identifiers (DOI).

name: Catalogue of Life
description: Global species catalog bringing together taxonomic checklists into a consistent listing of known species.

name: TRAILS
description: TRAILS is a prospective cohort study, which started in 2001 with population cohort and 2004 with a clinical cohort (CC). Since then, a group of 2500 young people from the Northern part of the Netherlands has been closely monitored in order to chart and explain their mental, physical, and social development. These TRAILS participants have been measured every two to three years, by means of questionnaires, interviews, and all kinds of tests.

name: e-Depot of the National Archives of the Netherlands
description: The National Archives of the Netherlands (Nationaal Archief), which is situated in The Hague, holds over 3.5 million records that have been created by the central government, organisations and individuals and are of national significance. Many records relate to the colonial and trading history of the Netherlands in the period from 1600 to 1975. The Dutch presence in countries in North and South America, Africa and Asia is reflected within these collections.

name: Sound and Vision
description: Sound and Vision has one of the largest audiovisual archives in Europe. The institute manages over 70 percent of the Dutch audiovisual heritage. The collection contains more than a million hours of television, radio, music and film from the beginning in 1898 until today. All programs of the Dutch public broadcasters come in digitally every day. Individuals and institutions entrust their collection to Sound and Vision as well.

name: manYPoints – Table of Curves with Many Points
description: manYPoints aims at providing an open access up-to-date source for information on curves over finite fields with many points.

name: Overview of Medical Research in the Netherlands
description: The Overview of Medical Research in the Netherlands (OMON), previously the Dutch Trial Register (LTR), is a register in which a part of the clinical studies in The Netherlands are registered. OMON currently includes all research from the old National Trial Register (NTR) and Toetsingonline registries and more recent studies registered in the Research Portal and CTIS. The Central Committee on Research Involving Human Subjects (CCMO) manages the register. CCMO is accountable to the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and is a non-profit organisation. OMON is an official data provider to the International Clinical Trial Registry Platform (ICTRP) of the World Health Organization (WHO).

name: Europeana
description: Europeana is the European digital library aggregating digitised cultural heritage from libraries, archives, and museums across Europe. The Europeana Foundation is based in The Hague.

name: Netherlands Polar Data Center
description: Netherlands Polar Data Center archives and provides access to data from Dutch polar research projects and publications.

name: Kaarten Provincie Zeeland
description: Mapperr map catalog of Provincie Zeeland listing available provincial maps. Distinct from the GeoNetwork catalog at dataportaal.zeeland.nl and the GeoServer at opengeodata.zeeland.nl.

name: Amsterdam open data
description: Open data catalog of the City of Amsterdam

name: Maps Amsterdam
description: Public thematic map gallery of the City of Amsterdam with interactive maps and open geodata.

name: Flora de Guinea Ecuatorial
description: Online flora and herbarium database of Equatorial Guinea, with more than 60,000 taxon records (accepted names, synonyms, specimens, maps, habitat, and literature) and over 22,000 herbarium specimens. Hosted by Universidad Complutense de Madrid (FloraGE 5.0); the programme began at the Real Jardín Botánico (CSIC). Five volumes are published; a further volume is planned for 2026.

name: IMSEE (Monaco Statistics)
description: Official statistics website of the Monegasque Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (IMSEE / Monaco Statistics). Publishes thematic indicators, studies, and the annual Monaco en chiffres compendium on territory, population, employment, economy, public life, and living conditions.

name: IMSEE Dashboard
description: Public visualization dashboard of the Monegasque Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (IMSEE), developed by Thoody Consulting. Interactive charts covering the Principality's economy, Monegasque population, resident population, and building surfaces.

name: Data Monaco
description: National public data portal of the Principality of Monaco (Data Monaco), operated by the Direction des Plateformes et des Ressources Numériques. Publishes 673 government datasets (633 open, 40 restricted), mainly from IMSEE, with download and REST metadata API access across health, economy, education, population, environment, and transport.

name: OA-ICC Ocean Acidification Data Portal
description: OA-ICC portal for biological-response datasets on ocean acidification. Filterable catalog of more than 1,500 published datasets (PANGAEA DOIs), maintained by the IAEA Ocean Acidification International Coordination Centre at the Environment Laboratories in Monaco, with the filter UI hosted at IPSL.

name: MARIS (Marine Radioactivity Information System)
description: IAEA Marine Radioactivity Information System (MARIS). Open catalog of radioactivity measurements in seawater, biota, sediment, and suspended matter, maintained by the IAEA Environment Laboratories in Monaco. Users can search, filter, and download named datasets (hundreds of thousands of measurements).

name: CIESM Atlas of Exotic Species in the Mediterranean
description: CIESM Atlas of Exotic Species in the Mediterranean. Public checklist and species sheets (fishes, crustaceans, molluscs, and other groups) with origin, establishment status, and distribution records, maintained by the Mediterranean Science Commission in Monaco.

name: Taldau information-analytical system of the Bureau of National Statistics
description: Official statistical platform managed by the Bureau of National Statistics, offering demographic and other official statistics for Kazakhstan, including population, gender, age groups, and more.

name: Qamqor Legal Statistics Portal
description: Official crime and legal statistics portal of the Committee on Legal Statistics and Special Accounts of the Prosecutor General's Office: public interactive dashboards on registered crimes, road traffic accidents and other legal statistics indicators.

name: Open Budgets of Kazakhstan
description: Open Budgets portal of Kazakhstan's e-government, publishing budget program passports, income and expenditure execution, republican and local budget reports, and National Fund figures for public use.

name: Statistics on Children of Kazakhstan (Bala)
description: Official child statistics portal of the Bureau of National Statistics, bringing together indicators and publications on children of Kazakhstan at national, regional and district levels, with disaggregation by age, gender and urban or rural residence across areas such as demography, health, education and living standards.

name: Bureau of National Statistics (stat.gov.kz)
description: Main website of the Bureau of National Statistics, sharing population, inflation, labor market and other official indicators for Kazakhstan along with announcements and methodological materials.

name: SEDA System for Education Data Analysis
description: SEDA publishes school-quality and access indicators from Kazakhstan's National Educational Database (NOBD), with an indicator list and an interactive map. The TLS certificate on seda.iac.kz was expired when last probed.

name: Gender Statistics of Kazakhstan
description: Official gender statistics portal of the Bureau of National Statistics, presenting the national gender indicator system and publications on the situation of women and men in Kazakhstan across population, family, health, education, employment, human rights and politics.

name: Open Data Repository of the National Bank of the Republic of Kazakhstan
description: Open data repository of the National Bank of Kazakhstan, publishing monetary, banking, balance-of-payments and other financial statistics. A REST API is present but requires authentication.

name: AtlasSD socio-demographic atlas of Kazakhstan
description: Public AtlasSD electronic atlas of socio-demographic development of Kazakhstan's regions, with yearly indicator reports and thematic maps compiled by Al-Farabi Kazakh National University.

name: Socio-labor indicators dashboard (ERDO Enbek)
description: Public dashboard of socio-labor indicators for Kazakhstan (employment, wages, vacancies, pensions, social payments and labor-force forecasts), published by the Workforce Development Center. The older iac.enbek.kz host redirects here.

name: Kazhydromet hydrological database
description: Surface-water hydrological observation database of Kazhydromet, covering water levels, discharge, ice and related measurements from monitoring stations across Kazakhstan.

name: KOREM electricity market analytics portal
description: Public analytics portal of KOREM, the operator of Kazakhstan's wholesale electricity and capacity market, with interactive dashboards of centralized trades, prices, volumes and balancing indicators. Embedded from korem.kz.

name: State Climate Cadastre of Kazakhstan
description: State Climate Cadastre of Kazhydromet, providing monthly and annual meteorological observation series and climate normals for Kazakhstan after user registration.

name: Open Data Portal of the Republic of Kazakhstan
description: Official Open Data portal of Kazakhstan, publishing machine-readable datasets from central state bodies, regional akimats and other organizations, with search, download (Excel/JSON) and a documented v4 API.

name: WaterBalance Kazakhstan Open Geoportal
description: Open multilingual geoportal and spatial data catalog for hydrological analysis of Kazakhstan water basins, providing downloadable vector, raster and time-series datasets.

name: Kazakhstan Flood Monitoring Geoservice
description: Public geoinformation service for flood monitoring and water infrastructure, providing mapped information on reservoirs, dams, hydraulic structures and related flood-risk features.

name: Kazakhstan Public Environmental Monitoring Map
description: Interactive public environmental monitoring map cataloging regional environmental problems, industrial impacts, pollution indicators and government response measures across Kazakhstan.

name: OSMANOV.KZ Property and Land Map
description: Public Kazakhstan property and land geoportal combining cadastral search with planning, red-line, water-protection, building and Almaty seismic layers from documented official sources.

name: Public cadastral map of Kazakhstan (EGKN)
description: Public cadastral map of the Unified State Cadastre of Real Estate (EGKN), displaying land, legal and urban-planning cadastre information for plots across Kazakhstan.

name: Kazakh Invest Interactive Map
description: National interactive investment map cataloging investment projects, industrial and special economic zones, infrastructure, natural resources and regional information across Kazakhstan.

name: Геопортал РГП «Госградкадастр»
description: Геопортал РГП «Госградкадастр» — инструмент предоставления информации о текущем и планируемом развитии населенных пунктов, карты, рельеф, административные объекты, генеральные и детальные планы.

name: Unified Subsoil Use Platform (Minerals)
description: Unified Subsoil Use Platform providing an interactive map and reference data on mineral deposits, licenses, contracts, applications and geological reports in Kazakhstan. Public browsing is free; full access is paid.

name: Kazakhstan National Water Resources Information System
description: National geospatial platform for searching, monitoring and managing Kazakhstan water resources, including rivers, lakes, canals, dams and other hydraulic infrastructure.

name: Archaeology.kz Heritage Map
description: Searchable national catalog and interactive map of archaeological and cultural heritage monuments across Kazakhstan, with regional and object-level records.

name: Qazaqstan.Space Open Data and Atlas
description: Public geospatial data registry and interactive atlas for Kazakhstan, with documented layers, dataset indexes, provenance, freshness and machine-readable files.

name: National Spatial Data Fund portal
description: Spatial data web portal of the National Cartographic and Geodetic Fund, cataloguing digital topographic maps and plans, orthophotos, analog maps and geodetic network materials. Access requires a Kazakhstan electronic digital signature.

name: Kazhydromet Interactive Maps and Databases
description: Catalog of Kazakhstan environmental monitoring maps and databases covering air quality, surface water, meteorology, hydrology, radiation and soil quality.

name: Akmola Regional Map Portal
description: Interactive map portal of Akmola Region (Интерактивная карта Акмолинской области), publishing geographic and spatial data for the oblast. HTTP only; the HTTPS certificate does not match.

name: Open Data Smart Almaty
description: Almaty city open data portal (Smart Almaty), publishing municipal datasets for public reuse.

name: Varna Municipal GIS
description: Public geographic information system of Varna Municipality, providing interactive maps of cadastre, spatial plans, and city layers.

name: Burgas Open Data Bank
description: Open Data Bank of Burgas Municipality (Smart Burgas), publishing administration datasets and data from the city's intelligent systems.

name: Burgas eGIS
description: eGIS portal of Burgas Municipality for electronic GIS-based services and remote access to the municipal spatial data holdings.

name: Sofiaplan Open Data
description: Open data catalog of Sofiaplan, the municipal enterprise for strategic spatial planning of Sofia. Provides downloadable datasets and a REST API covering urban planning, environment, transport, population, and infrastructure for Sofia City Municipality.

name: iSofMap
description: Public iSofMap viewer of GIS-Sofia EOOD, providing Sofia cadastre, regulation plans, the general spatial plan, addresses, and municipal-property layers from the SOFKAR spatial database.

name: OpenData.bg survey catalog
description: Survey-data catalog of the Open Society Institute - Sofia, publishing sociological research datasets on political, economic, and social attitudes.

name: Monitorstat
description: NSI Monitorstat information system for statistical indicators and metadata used to monitor national, European and international strategies and programmes, including Bulgaria's UN Sustainable Development Goals indicator set.

name: Infostat - Information System of NSI (National Statistical Institute)
description: Infostat is the interactive statistical request system of the National Statistical Institute of Bulgaria, used to extract official tables and time series. The former infostat.nsi.bg application now redirects to the NSI Infostat product page.

name: State Fund Agriculture Municipal Funding Dashboard
description: Interactive municipal dashboard of State Fund Agriculture (ДФЗ) projects and funding by municipality.

name: Bulgarian National Bank Statistics
description: Bulgarian National Bank statistics catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic indicators. Distinct from the IMF SDDS Plus NSDP on the same site.

name: Open Data Portal of Bulgaria
description: Official open data portal of the Republic of Bulgaria, operated by the Ministry of e-Government. Custom Laravel application (not CKAN) with a REST API under /api. The site may return HTTP 403 to some datacenter clients because of a WAF.

name: Prosecutor's Office of the Republic of Bulgaria Open Data Portal
description: Public open-data portal of the Prosecutor's Office of the Republic of Bulgaria (ПРБ) at opendata.prb.bg/odp-ui/.

name: NHIS Public Health Registers
description: Public registers of the National Health Information System (НЗИС), listing healthcare registers including pharmacies and medical-results datasets.

name: Държавен вестник
description: State Gazette of Bulgaria. Official journal catalog of promulgated laws and other legal acts.

name: NIGGG Real-time Information
description: Real-time geophysical information map of the National Institute of Geophysics, Geodesy and Geography at the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences (OpenLayers station/event viewer).

name: NSI Data Catalogue (AtlasData)
description: National metadata catalogue of the National Statistical Institute of Bulgaria (AtlasData / ISKD). Centralized catalog of structural and reference metadata for datasets collected, analysed and disseminated by NSI, including concepts, quality documentation and related legal bases.

name: Bulgarian Portal for Open Science
description: National repository and discovery portal for publicly funded Bulgarian research outputs. NACID harvests institutional repositories via OAI-PMH and accepts direct deposits of publications and research data under Ordinance No. 1 of 6 March 2025. OpenAIRE Graph indexes datasets collected from this source.

name: ARPHA Preprints
description: ARPHA Preprints provides a preprint (not peer-reviewed, not copyedited and not typeset versions of manuscripts) service for those manuscripts submitted to journals hosted on the ARPHA Platform that have selected this service. Preprints are optional, therefore authors need to confirm during submission whether they want their manuscript to be posted as a preprint. ARPHA Preprints is not open for direct submission of preprints, but only through the submission systems of the participating ARPHA journals. The scope and the article type of preprints are determined by those of the journal.

name: The Open Biodiversity Knowledge Management System
description:
OpenBiodiv utilizes semantic publishing workflows, text mining, common standards, ontology modelling and graph database technologies to establish a robust infrastructure for creating and managing a Biodiversity Knowledge Graph.

OpenBiodiv encompasses data extracted from full-text article XMLs published by Pensoft and taxonomic treatments extracted by Plazi from journals of other publishers. The data from both sources are converted to RDF and are integrated in a graph database which contains the OpenBiodiv-O ontology and a RDF version of the GBIF taxonomic backbone. OpenBiodiv provides the following services: XML-to-RDF conversion workflow and software for JATS TaxPub XML versions of journal articles, RDF conversion of taxonomic hierarchies in CSV (example: GBIF taxonomic backbone), a triple store of close to one billion triples of facts and metadata extracted from literature, SPARQL endpoint, accessible for regular queries and federated queries with other domain-specific or generic endpoints, and predefined SPARQL queries reflecting different research questions. 
Within BiCIKL, OpenBiodiv will be developed to provide a LOD version of data liberated from the literature to make them interoperable   with other data infrastructures throughout the biodiversity data life cycle.

name: Brunei SDG Tracker
description: National Sustainable Development Goals website of Brunei Darussalam. Publishes an SDG Tracker dashboard of progress since 2015 and goal pages listing UN targets and indicators. Built with UNESCAP National SDG Tracker support and hosted by the Special National Coordination Committee on SDGs.

name: BDCB Monetary and Financial Statistics
description: Public statistics catalog of Brunei Darussalam Central Bank. Queryable time series with download for monetary and financial statistics, bank and finance company performance, overnight standing facilities rates, retail lending rates, Sukuk Al-Ijarah, and BDCB Islamic Bills. JSON APIs on cms.bdcb.gov.bn back the series pages.

name: Survey Geoportal Negara Brunei Darussalam
description: National Survey Spatial Data Infrastructure geoportal of Brunei Darussalam's Survey Department. Public Ember/OpenLayers map viewer for cadastral lots, orthophotos, house numbering, Hala Kiblat, and survey products. No public harvestable OGC or catalog API was found; WMS GetCapabilities on historical ERDAS paths returns 403.

name: UBD Herbarium Online
description: Public specimen catalog of the Universiti Brunei Darussalam Herbarium (UBDH). Searchable collection records include catalog id, family, species, district, locality, vegetation type, and images. About 14,167 records are publicly listed. Index Herbariorum code UBDH; developed with the UBD Faculty of Science.

name: Système d'Information sur les Marchés Agricoles (SIMA Niger)
description: Agricultural market information system of Niger (SIMA). Public weekly price tables by year, month, region, market, and product, with CSV/Excel export. JSON series are served at /_api/prix-produits-agricoles/.

name: Carte Cadastrale — Cadastre Niger
description: Public cadastral map of Cadastre Niger (Ministère de l'Urbanisme et de l'Habitat). Leaflet/OpenLayers viewer with GeoServer WMS layer cadastre:parcelles and parcel pop-ups. Distinct from the paid e-services homepage and from the mining cadastre.

name: Cadastre minier du Niger (e-Mines)
description: Public mining-cadastre map of e-Mines Niger (Ministère des Mines). Lists mineral titles with holders, substances, areas, and a Leaflet/Mapbox map. The application-and-payment homepage is not this catalog.

name: Géoportail - Adressage de la ville de Niamey
description: Public addressing geoportal of Niamey operated by Agence de Modernisation des Villes du Niger. Custom OpenLayers map of addressed streets, neighbourhoods, public facilities, and arrondissement boundaries published as GeoJSON layers.

name: Géoportail de la Direction Générale de la Protection Civile
description: Public Leaflet geoportal of the Direction Générale de la Protection Civile. Maps disaster events with filters by type, region, and period, plus counts of people, households, and houses affected.

name: BDINA - Base de Données sur les Inondations ANADIA-Niger
description: BDINA flood-impact database for Niger since 1998 (ANADIA). Guest login opens table, map, and chart queries of localities, people affected, and damages. Managed by CC/SAP; the query application is hosted at anadia2.fi.ibimet.cnr.it.

name: SLAPIS
description: Système Local d'Alerte Précoce aux Inondations de la Sirba (SLAPIS), a flood early-warning and hydrometeorological data portal for the Sirba basin in Niger, developed with CNR Institute for BioEconomy.

name: ISTEEBU Burundi
description: Official statistics website of Burundi's Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (ISTEEBU). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics.

name: Myanmar Biodiversity Portal
description: Wildlife Conservation Society catalog of Myanmar biodiversity datasets and documents, including species, ecosystems, protected areas, and marine conservation resources.

name: Open Data: Myanmar Jade
description: Open-data site presenting Myanmar jade-industry datasets, data stories, and interactive tools compiled from Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) disclosures. Supported by the Natural Resource Governance Institute and the School of Data.

name: Myanmar Land and Agriculture Monitoring Project (LAMP)
description: SERVIR Southeast Asia Land and Agriculture Monitoring Project (LAMP) dashboard for Myanmar. Public map layers cover biophysical condition (EVI), forest gain and loss, fire hotspots, land cover, and seasonal rice cultivation in the main rice-producing states and regions, with downloadable analysis.

name: NSIA Afghanistan
description: Official statistics website of Afghanistan's National Statistics and Information Authority (NSIA). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, and economic statistics.

name: ACKU AfghanData Digital Repository
description: AfghanData is the public digital repository of the Afghanistan Centre at Kabul University (ACKU). It provides downloadable digitized research reports, theses, maps, statistical publications, and environmental materials on Afghanistan.

name: GBoS Data Portal
description: Official statistics portal of the Gambia Bureau of Statistics (GBoS). Publishes sector indicator tables with CSV, Excel, and PDF downloads covering macroeconomic and financial data, education, health, demography, tourism, agriculture, SDGs, and related official statistics, plus a GIS mapping page.

name: volare – Vorarlberger Landesbibliothek
description: Volare is the repository of the Vorarlberger Landesbibliothek (Vorarlberg State Library). Digital Objects are made end-user-friendly available and they are secured in a long term. Pupils, students, patrimonial researchers but also the general public can use the imagery for various purposes. Volare facilitates access to regional, social and cultural history research.

name: Open Government Data - Land Steiermark
description: Das Land Steiermark steht für eine offene Verwaltung und setzt dies im Bereich der Datenbereitstellung um. Daten, die in anderer Form für die Öffentlichkeit frei zugänglich sind, werden sukzessive als "Open Government Data - OGD" angeboten. Die wesentlichen Kriterien für offene Verwaltungsdaten sind die Maschinenlesbarkeit sowie eine Lizenz zur uneingeschränkten Weiterverwendung. Open Government Data portal providing access to datasets from the Styrian State Government including environmental, climate, waste, and tourism data.

name: WegenerNet Data Portal
description: The WegenerNet Data Portal provides a multi-decadal data source for Austrian and international weather, climate, and ecosystems research. The WegenerNet Open-Air Laboratory Feldbach Region comprises over 150 meteorological stations. These stations measure weather and climate in a tightly spaced grid with an unprecedented level of accuracy and detail. The measurements of several parameters are taken in 5-min intervals within the entire grid since Jan 1, 2007.

name: Graz Humanities Asset Management System
description: Humanities' Asset Management System of the University of Graz, publishing digital scholarly editions and research data collections.

name: IEM OpenData Archive
description: Open research-data archive of the Institute of Electronic Music and Acoustics (IEM) listing spatial-audio datasets, room impulse responses, and related experimental data.

name: ONB Labs - Data sets
description: Selected digital collections from the Austrian National Library as open data, curated for public use.

name: Minimum Information about a Tailoring Enzyme (MITE)
description: Repository of the MITE data standard for tailoring enzymes, with enzyme reactions, substrate specificities, and substrate–product pairs.

name: VMF Data Server
description: The VMF Data Server provides a portfolio of tropospheric products and forms a source of consistent troposphere delays models for all space geodetic techniques. The products include mapping functions, such as the widely used VMF1, but also ray-traced delays for VLBI observations as well as corrections for atmospheric pressure loading.

name: mdw Repository
description: Institutional repository of the University of Music and Performing Arts Vienna (mdw) for capturing, archiving, and publishing digital media objects and research data from teaching, research, and the arts. It provides persistent identifiers and follows FAIR and open-access principles.

name: Calabi-Yau data
description: The Calabi-Yau database is a large curated collection of numerical and combinatorial data on Calabi-Yau manifolds, especially those arising from reflexive polytopes in various dimensions. It organizes results from the classification of these polytopes along with associated topological information like Hodge numbers. The database was assembled to support research in algebraic geometry and string theory by providing easy access to detailed properties of Calabi-Yau spaces.

name: Open Government Data - Land Salzburg
description: Open Government Data portal of Land Salzburg providing access to datasets from the Salzburg State Government. The portal covers various topics including population and society, education culture and sport, energy, regions and cities, health, international topics, justice legal system and public safety, agriculture fisheries forestry and food, government and public sector, environment, transport, economy and finance, and science and technology.

name: Stadtplan Salzburg
description: Public OpenLayers city map of Stadt Salzburg with address search and thematic layers (zoning, trees, mobility, downloads). City OGD is published on data.gv.at; Land SAGIS is a separate catalog.

name: Digitale Mozart Edition
description: The Digital Mozart Edition (DME) aims to make the oeuvre of Wolfgang Amadé Mozart (1756–1791) accessible in digital formats. Access is free for everyone for academic, private and educational purposes.

name: Austrian NeuroCloud
description: The Austrian NeuroCloud (ANC) is a FAIR-enabling open repository for neurocognitive research data, hosted at the University of Salzburg. It provides storage, curation, and reuse services for BIDS-formatted neuroscience datasets, with discovery via a knowledge graph, data interface, and Neurobagel federated search.

name: AMDC Mikrodatenkatalog
description: Public metadata catalog of the Austrian Micro Data Center (AMDC) at Statistics Austria. Researchers at accredited institutions can search 164 register and survey microdata products (EU-SILC, Mikrozensus, ASEP, ADCOL, and others) and apply for fee-based remote access in a protected research environment.

name: OeNB User-Defined Statistical Query
description: Oesterreichische Nationalbank interactive statistical query. Users build custom tables of monetary, banking, and financial indicators and can retrieve the same series as XML via the OeNB data web service.

name: IQS Indikatorendatenbank
description: IQS indicator database for the Austrian school system. Publishes quality-assured charts and Excel tables from national educational-standards assessments and international studies (PIRLS, TIMSS, PISA), with methodological notes for each indicator.

name: AMIS Arbeitsmarktdaten online
description: BMASGPK labour-market information system (AMIS). Public query database and standard tables covering unemployment, employment, vacancies, apprenticeships, international unemployment rates, and population statistics, combining AMS and social-insurance data.

name: AGGM Transparency Platform
description: Public transparency data for the Austrian gas market.

name: Offener Haushalt
description: Municipal and association budget indicators portal for Austria (Voranschlag, Rechnungsabschluss, downloads and visualizations), operated by KDZ.

name: ÖBB Open Data
description: Austrian Federal Railways open-data catalog of GTFS schedules, NeTEx MMTIS infrastructure data, network GeoJSON/SHP, station registers, rolling stock, and environmental datasets.

name: Statistik Austria open.data Portal
description: Independent statistics for evidence-based decision making, providing microdata, regional statistics, and geodata.

name: RTR Open-Data Portal
description: Open-data portal of the Austrian broadcasting and telecommunications regulator (RTR), with a public dataset list for market and regulatory data.

name: OpenData der Sozialversicherung
description: Open data catalog of the Austrian social insurance umbrella organization (DVSV), with CSV datasets on workplace accidents, employment, e-vaccination, and SARI hospital admissions.

name: Lärminfo
description: Austrian strategic noise maps and noise action plans under the Environmental Noise Directive.

name: Wasser WebGIS (WISA)
description: Federal water WebGIS hub of the Austrian ministry, launching maps for the National River Basin Management Plan, flood-risk management, eHYD hydrography, HORA natural hazards, and EMREG emissions.

name: Austrian Map
description: Public Austrian Map viewer of the Federal Office of Metrology and Surveying (BEV).

name: Tethys Acoustic Metadata Database
description: Tethys database houses the metadata associated with the acoustic data collection efforts by the Passive Acoustic Group. These metadata include dates, locations, and technical details related to acoustic data collections.

name: probeBase
description: probeBase is a manually maintained and curated database of rRNA-targeted oligonucleotide probes and primers. Contextual information and multiple options for evaluating in silico hybridization performance against the most recent rRNA sequence databases are provided for each oligonucleotide entry, which makes probeBase an important and frequently used resource for microbiology research and diagnostics. The major features of probeBase include a classification of probes and primers according to the NCBI taxonomy database, a powerful and customizable search function, which serves to query for target organisms, probe names, primers, target sites, and references. The probeBase match tool can be used to match near-full length rRNA sequences against probeBase and find all published probes targeting the query sequences. The new proxy match tool extends this analysis to partial rRNA sequences, which exploits full-length sequences in the rRNA sequence database SILVA to find published probes potentially targeting partial query sequences. A tool for submitting new or missing probe sequences or references helps to keep probeBase up-to-date.

name: NHMW Data Repository
description: Institutional repository of the Natural History Museum Vienna for sharing, storage and publication of research data generated at the NHMW, by NHMW researchers and collaboration partners, or research data on NHMW objects generated by external researchers. It assigns DataCite DOIs and supports FAIR principles, including optional publication embargoes.

name: The Cancer Immunome Atlas
description: The Cancer Immunome Database (TCIA) provides results of comprehensive immunogenomic analyses of next generation sequencing data (NGS) data for 20 solid cancers from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and other datasources.

name: ALADDIN
description: The ALADDIN database (A Labelled Atomic Data INterface) is a numerical scientific database maintained by the International Atomic Energy Agency that provides evaluated atomic, molecular, and plasma–material interaction data of interest to nuclear fusion and plasma research. It includes recommended cross sections, rate coefficients, and surface interaction data compiled from IAEA publications and coordinated research projects, supporting modelling and diagnostics of fusion plasmas and related physical processes.

name: Open Scientific Collections Austria (OSCA) Portal
description: Public search catalog of Open Scientific Collections Austria (OSCA) for digitized natural-science specimens. The portal searches the OSCA cache plus GBIF, GeoCASe, Europeana, and DiSSCo. Distinct from the already registered OSCA IPT at ipt.osca.science.

name: FindStat
description: This collaborative project is a database of combinatorial statistics and maps on combinatorial collections and a search engine, identifying your data as the composition of known maps and statistics.

name: Tethys Austria Research Data Repository
description: Tethys RDR is a digital geoscientific Research Data Repository (RDR) of GeoSphere Austria. It publishes supplementary research data for text publications and other data types, supporting multiple metadata standards, backup strategies, and dataset classifications.

name: Phonogrammarchiv
description: Phonogrammarchiv of the Austrian Academy of Sciences, an audiovisual research archive of sound and video recordings for language, music, and cultural heritage.

name: EMEP European Air Pollution Monitoring
description: The European Monitoring and Evaluation Programme (EMEP) is a scientifically based and policy driven programme under the Convention on Long-range Transboundary Air Pollution (CLRTAP) for international co-operation to solve transboundary air pollution problems.

name: THANADOS (The Anthropological and Archaeological Database of Sepultures)
description: THANADOS (The Anthropological and Archaeological Database of Sepultures) is a digital humanities portal for archaeologically and anthropologically investigated burials. Data are published as open data, mapped to CIDOC CRM, and presented through a catalogue, interactive maps, and export formats.

name: Palynological Database
description: PalDat (Palynological Database) is the world’s largest online database for palynological (pollen) data. It offers free access to detailed pollen records, including images (LM, SEM, TEM) and associated botanical literature.

name: Water Isotope System for Data Analysis, Visualization and Electronic Retrieval
description: WISER is a self-service platform for data of the Global Networks of Isotopes in Precipitation (GNIP) and Rivers (GNIR), hosted within the IAEA's repository for technical resources (NUCLEUS). GNIP in WISER currently contains over 130,000 records, and stable isotopes are current to the end of 2013, and will be updated as verified data comes in.

name: Atomic and Molecular Data Information System
description: The Atomic and Molecular Data Unit operates within the Nuclear Data Section of the International Atomic Energy Agency, Vienna, Austria.The primary objective of the Atomic and Molecular Data Unit is to establish and maintain internationally recommended numerical databases on atomic and molecular collision and radiative processes, atomic and molecular structure characteristics, particle-solid surface interaction processes and physico-chemical and thermo-mechanical material properties for use in fusion energy research and other plasma science and technology applications.

name: NOE Open Government Data - Bestandsliste
description: Catalog of open government datasets from the Lower Austria region.

name: IIASA Models, Tools and Data Catalog
description: IIASA's catalog covering integrated assessment models, climate scenarios, socio-economic pathways, and related database resources.

name: Digital Upper Austrian Regional Library
description: The Upper Austrian Regional Library views itself as keeper of the Upper Austrian heritage and does so by digitizing the so called "OBDERENNSIA", regionally relevant (mainly historical) literature from the 16th to the 20th century as well as medieval manuscripts and autographs.

name: Bheemdatta Municipality GIS Portal
description: Public municipal GIS portal for Bheemdatta Municipality with baseline, utility, orthophoto, and tourism map layers.

name: Nepal in Data
description: Civil-society statistics portal compiling Nepal development data from 1950 onward across agriculture, economy, health, education, governance, infrastructure, and environment. The dataset explorer at data.nepalindata.com requires an issued account.

name: Nepal Ministry of Finance Macroeconomic Dashboard
description: Ministry of Finance macroeconomic dashboard with Google Charts tables and charts for real-sector growth, revenue, monetary aggregates, external trade, consumer prices, and the USD exchange rate.

name: Nepal Trade Information Portal
description: Nepal Trade Information Portal operated by the Trade and Export Promotion Centre. Includes a public trade-data explorer for imports and exports by HS commodity, partner country, and yearly, quarterly, or monthly series, plus tariff and market-access tables.

name: FCGO Daily Budgetary Comparative Analysis
description: Financial Comptroller General Office daily receipts and payments status for the Government of Nepal. Publishes live treasury tables for revenue, grants, and recurrent, capital, and financing expenditure, with Excel export.

name: National Population and Housing Census 2021 Results
description: Official National Population and Housing Census 2021 results portal of the National Statistics Office. Provides population and household indicators, visualizations, and national, provincial, and local-level data downloads.

name: SORMAS Nepal Public Dashboard
description: Public SORMAS Nepal surveillance bulletin of the Epidemiology and Disease Control Division. Publishes weekly outbreak-prone disease counts (AGE, SARI, dengue, and related syndromes) with filters by province, district, and municipality.

name: Nepal Development Finance Information Management System
description: Public dashboard of Nepal's Development Finance Information Management System, operated by the Ministry of Finance. Lists official development assistance projects with commitments, disbursements, and breakdowns by province, sector, finance type, partner, and SDG.

name: LocalBoundaries of Nepal
description: Open administrative boundary data for Nepal's provinces, districts, and local levels, plus protected areas, downloadable as GeoJSON, TopoJSON, Shapefile, KML, and GeoPackage. The public hostname is localboundries.oknp.org (historical spelling).

name: ICIMOD Regional Database System
description: Regional Database System (RDS) is ICIMOD’s clearing house for curated datasets across the Hindu Kush Himalaya. It supports search by title, abstract, keywords, and geographic extent, dataset download after registration, and a Data Explorer for maps and charts. ICIMOD is a regional intergovernmental centre based in Kathmandu serving Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, China, India, Myanmar, Nepal, and Pakistan.

name: Gandaki Province Monitoring System
description: Public monitoring dashboard of Gandaki Province. Publishes program and activity counts, budget, and physical and financial progress by ministry, district, office, and funding source.

name: Lalitpur Metropolitan City Building Search
description: Public Leaflet house-search map for Lalitpur Metropolitan City metric addresses, searchable by ward and house number.

name: KMC House Numbering System
description: Public house-numbering GIS of Kathmandu Metropolitan City with ward, building, and road layers over drone orthophoto and street-map basemaps.

name: San Luis Virtual
description: San Luis Virtual municipal Leaflet map for public works, urban services, and technical consultation of San Luis Potosí city.

name: CEIEG Sinaloa Sistema de Indicadores Estadísticos
description: CEIEG Sinaloa Sistema de Indicadores Estadísticos publishes state indicator values and national rankings by PED theme, plus interactive query pages for employment, education, health, security, agriculture, and related series.

name: IMPLAN Ahome Mapas Interactivos
description: IMPLAN Ahome catalog of interactive planning, risk, environmental, and industrial maps for Los Mochis and the municipality of Ahome.

name: Visor Territorial del Estado de Sinaloa
description: Sinaloa state cadastral territorial viewer with public citizen access to orthophotos, base map, INEGI, health, and education layers.

name: Datos Abiertos del Gobierno del Estado de Tamaulipas
description: Official open data catalog for the State of Tamaulipas, Mexico, offering datasets related to government, economy, society, and more.

name: Seguimiento de Indicadores de Coahuila
description: Coahuila Sistema de seguimiento de indicadores publishes state development-plan, SDG, poverty, and social-lag indicators aligned with the Plan Estatal de Desarrollo 2023-2029.

name: Visor Saltillo
description: Visor Saltillo municipal GIS with 200+ public layers for cadastre, zoning, risk, mobility, and sociodemographic data.

name: SEIEG Aguascalientes
description: Aguascalientes SEIEG is the state statistical and geographic information system, with a public dashboard of education, economy, environment, security, and social indicators.

name: SIIMP Aguascalientes
description: SIIMP municipal cartographic portal for territorial ordering and urban development programmes of Aguascalientes.

name: MIDO Oaxaca
description: MIDO is Oaxaca's public Sistema de Monitoreo de Indicadores de Desempeño, tracking strategic impact indicators and government management indicators of the Plan Estatal de Desarrollo.

name: OAXOTAR Plataforma de Información Geoespacial
description: OAXOTAR geospatial catalog of territorial ordering and municipal risk atlases for Oaxaca, distinct from SISPLADE GeoNode.

name: Datos Abiertos del Gobierno del Estado de Queretaro
description: Open Data Portal for the State of Querétaro, Mexico.

name: Mapa Cartográfico de Querétaro
description: CEIEG and SITEGEQ cartographic map of Querétaro with municipal search, cadastre lookup, schools, health centres, and INEGI economic units.

name: Monitor estadístico de la Ciudad de México
description: Monitor estadístico de la Ciudad de México publishes citywide and alcaldía indicators on employment, inflation, tourism, security, education, health access, and economic activity, distinct from the CKAN indicadores portal and SIEG geoportal.

name: SIGCDMX
description: SIGCDMX open geographic information system with 60+ parcel-level layers for cadastre, land use, mobility, services, and environment across Mexico City alcaldías.

name: Chihuahua SICIP Monitoreo del Desempeño
description: Chihuahua SICIP Monitoreo del Desempeño is a public dashboard of Plan Estatal de Desarrollo program indicators and budget-execution progress by public entity and theme.

name: CIEGEQROO Banco de Información Estadística Estatal
description: CIEGEQROO Banco de Información Estadística Estatal publishes Quintana Roo demographic, labour, IMSS, poverty, public-finance, municipal GDP, PED, and Agenda 2030 indicator tables and visualizers.

name: Datos Abiertos del Poder Legislativo del Estado de Quintana
description: Micrositio de Datos Abiertos del Poder Legislativo del Estado de Quintana Roo, que ofrece acceso a datos y recursos abiertos relacionados con el proceso legislativo y la administración pública.

name: MonitorBC Baja California
description: MonitorBC is Baja California's public citizen-monitoring portal for Plan Estatal de Desarrollo 2022-2027 indicators, SDG alignment, and Sistema Estatal de Evaluación del Desempeño program results.

name: SIMIG Playas de Rosarito
description: IMPLAN Playas de Rosarito SIMIG catalog of 19 interactive municipal maps covering urban structure, risks, beaches, and public services.

name: Sistema de Información Geográfica de Tijuana
description: IMPLAN Tijuana geographic information system with municipal layers and the Atlas Municipal de Riesgos 2024. Some analysis tools require registration.

name: MIDE Jalisco
description: MIDE Jalisco is the public monitoring system for Plan Estatal de Desarrollo indicators at state, municipal, regional, and metropolitan levels, including SDG alignment and open-data downloads. Distinct from the IIEG statistical institute.

name: Catastro Guadalajara Datos Abiertos
description: Guadalajara municipal cadastre open-data downloads, including shapefiles and spreadsheets for street values, block boundaries, and cadastral regions.

name: Datos Abiertos del Gobierno del Estado de Jalisco
description: Sitio de datos abiertos del Gobierno del Estado de Jalisco, parte de la Red de Portales Jalisco.

name: Mapa Guadalajara
description: Mapa Guadalajara public Leaflet geoportal for cadastral parcels, land use, mobility, environment, Lidar, and municipal service layers.

name: Mapa Urbano Zapopan
description: Mapa Urbano Zapopan municipal cartographic viewer for partial urban development plans, land use, colonies, and municipal infrastructure layers.

name: ZOOM Metropolitano
description: ZOOM Metropolitano interactive map catalog of 500+ official layers for the nine municipalities of the Guadalajara metropolitan area.

name: SPED Puebla seguimiento de indicadores
description: SPED Puebla publishes strategic, sectoral, institutional, and regional indicators from the Plan Estatal de Desarrollo and municipal development plans for public monitoring of state planning.

name: SEI Puebla Banco de Indicadores Municipales y Regionales
description: SEI Puebla Banco de Indicadores Municipales y Regionales is a public table explorer of sociodemographic, economic, poverty, environment, and government indicators for Puebla's municipalities and regions, with a JSON consultation API.

name: Datos Abiertos del Estado de Puebla
description: Open data portal of the Government of the State of Puebla, with thematic datasets on open government, environment, population, employment, and transport.

name: Atlas de Riesgos del Municipio de Puebla
description: Atlas de Riesgos del Municipio de Puebla with interactive maps of geological, hydrometeorological, and other hazards for civil protection and urban planning.

name: SIGEE Nayarit Sistema de Información Geográfica, Estadística y Evaluación
description: SIGEE Nayarit publishes interactive PED-aligned dashboards of geographic, statistical, and evaluation indicators for governance, security, inequality, regional development, and economic growth.

name: SIGEBB Bahía de Banderas
description: SIGEBB municipal GIS for Bahía de Banderas with public Leaflet layers for cadastre parcels, land use, orthophotos, hydrology, AGEBs, and colonies.

name: Atlas Municipal de Riesgos Bahía de Banderas 2026
description: Bahía de Banderas 2026 municipal risk atlas with public Leaflet layers for floods, hydrology, beaches, coastal zone, and weather.

name: SIG Durango indicadores públicos
description: Durango Sistema de Información Gubernamental publishes public Matrices de Indicadores para Resultados and progress dashboards aligned with the Plan Estatal de Desarrollo, covering state secretariats and agencies.

name: Atlas de Riesgos del Estado de México
description: Estado de México 2025 risk atlas with a public AGEB hazard map and a Leaflet visualizer over GeoServer WMS layers for state and municipal threats.

name: INEGI Indicadores por entidad federativa
description: INEGI Indicadores por entidad federativa presents representative state-level indicators by theme, with charts for comparing Mexican states with each other and over time.

name: CONEVAL InfoPobreza
description: CONEVAL InfoPobreza publishes multidimensional poverty indicators, the Índice de Tendencia Laboral de la Pobreza, income poverty lines, and the Índice de Rezago Social for Mexico and the 32 states.

name: SIESVIM
description: INEGI SIESVIM (Sistema de Indicadores de Estadísticas de Violencia contra las Mujeres) publishes official indicators on violence against women for public consultation.

name: INEGI InfoLaboral (ENOE)
description: INEGI InfoLaboral is the interactive query system for strategic labour-force indicators from the Encuesta Nacional de Ocupación y Empleo (ENOE), covering population aged 15 and over from 2005 onward.

name: INEGI SCINCE 2020
description: INEGI SCINCE 2020 (Sistema para la Consulta de Información Censal) maps Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020 sociodemographic indicators at state, municipality, locality, and metropolis levels, with tabular download.

name: Catálogo Nacional de Indicadores (CNI)
description: Official National Catalog of Indicators (CNI) of Mexico, coordinated by INEGI within the National System of Statistical and Geographic Information (SNIEG). It publishes key indicators with metadata and statistical series covering demographic and social, economic, environmental, and government, public security and justice topics for public policy design, monitoring and evaluation.

name: SINBA Cubos dinámicos
description: SINBA Cubos dinámicos (DGIS, Secretaría de Salud) is Mexico's public health statistical cube catalog, covering hospital discharges, deaths, births, services, resources, injuries, and related series.

name: INEGI Indicadores de Bienestar por entidad federativa
description: INEGI Indicadores de Bienestar por entidad federativa publishes OECD Better Life Index-style well-being indicators for Mexican states, for comparison across entities and over time. INEGI states these series are not official statistics.

name: CONSAR SISET estadísticas del SAR
description: CONSAR SISET publishes statistical tables for Mexico's retirement-savings system (SAR), including AFORE assets, SIEFORE investments, accounts, transfers, commissions, and net-return indicators.

name: Banco de México Sistema de Información Económica (SIE)
description: Banco de México Sistema de Información Económica (SIE) publishes official monetary, financial, balance-of-payments, inflation, and survey time series. Series can be browsed in the SIE catalog and retrieved through a documented REST API (JSON, JSONP, XML).

name: INEGI Banco de Indicadores
description: INEGI Banco de Indicadores provides sociodemographic and economic indicators for Mexico by theme and geographic area (national, state, and municipality), including historical time series. Data can be queried through the web application and a documented REST API (JSON, JSONP, XML, JSON-stat, and PC-Axis).

name: CONAGUA Sistema Nacional de Información del Agua (SINA)
description: CONAGUA Sistema Nacional de Información del Agua (SINA) publishes statistical and geographic water indicators (quantity, quality, uses, infrastructure, and management) with CSV, shapefile, KML, and GeoJSON downloads.

name: INEGI Sistema de Información sobre el Cambio Climático (SICC)
description: INEGI Sistema de Información sobre el Cambio Climático (SICC) publishes official climate, emissions, mitigation, vulnerability, and related statistical and geographic indicators for Mexico.

name: INEGI SCITEL
description: INEGI SCITEL (Sistema de Consulta de Integración Territorial) publishes census and intercensal ITER locality indicators, with online queries and Excel/CSV export down to municipality and locality.

name: SENER Sistema de Información Energética

Research goals include, but are not limited to the following: examination of the aging processes and its disease and disability burden in a large representative panel of older Mexicans; evaluation of the effects of individual behaviors, early life circumstances, migration and economic history, community characteristics, and family transfer systems on multiple health outcomes; and comparison of the health dynamics of older Mexicans with comparably aged Mexican-born migrants in the U.S. and second generation Mexican-American using similar data from the U.S. population (for example the biennial Health and Retirement Study HRS) to assess the durability of the migrant health advantage.

name: Portal de Datos Abiertos UNAM, Colecciones Universitarias / UNAM Open Data Portal

It works as an online access point to search university collections authorized for their use, reuse and free redistribution by anyone, without copyright restrictions, patents or other control mechanisms, as long as the Terms of Free Use for UNAM Open Data are respected. The portal contains data, digital objects and geospatial layers of biological collections, artistic work, music, veterinary medicine, university projects, among others. It allows databases to be consulted and downloaded in open and structured formats. One of the most outstanding collections is the National Herbarium of Mexico (MEXU), with almost two million records and high resolution images of plants around the world, mainly collected in Mexico.

description: Data and metadata repository for the NFDI-MatWerk consortium on materials science and engineering.

name: Forschungsdatenportal IKM - Digital Humanities Center
description: Research data portal operated by the Digital Humanities Center at the University of Tübingen, supporting management, archiving, and publication of research data across disciplines, especially for the humanities and social sciences.

name: State Archives of Baden-Württemberg
description: The State Archives of Baden-Württemberg provide finding aids, digitized holdings, and archival information services for the state's historical records.

name: Open Access Power-Grid Frequency Database
description: Catalog of openly available power-grid frequency recordings from TSOs, research projects, and independent measurements.

name: KITopen
description: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology central repository for publications and research data, with public search in KITopen.

name: TALAR Tübingen
description: CLARIN B-centre repository for linguistic research data at the University of Tübingen (TALAR / Text+).

name: Leben in Berlin
description: Leben in Berlin, a public Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg explorer of family, housing, and childcare indicators for Berlin with a location filter. Distinct from the MATS-Datenportal and from SIS-Dashboards.

name: Open Energy Platform
description: Community database and tools for energy-system research, including scenarios, factsheets, and a public schema browser.

name: IANUS - Forschungsdatenzentrum Archäologie
description: IANUS ist ein zentrales, fachspezifisches Forschungsdatenzentrum für Archäologie und Altertumswissenschaften in Deutschland. Es bietet eine technische Infrastruktur für die digitale Langzeitarchivierung und unterstützt das Forschungsdatenmanagement einschließlich des Lebenszyklus forschungsrelevanter Informationen.

name: Endangered Languages Archive (ELAR)
description: Digital repository preserving and publishing endangered-language documentation collections from around the world.

name: EUBUCCO
description: Harmonized European building-stock database of individual building footprints with height, use type, floors, and construction year.

name: LAUDATIO Repository
description: Repository for historical linguistically annotated corpora and related research data.

name: Umweltportal Niedersachsen Dashboard
description: Umweltportal Niedersachsen Dashboard, public energy-transition indicators (wind, solar, generation, consumption, GHG) with Landkreis charts. Distinct from the portal map and Messwerte geoviewer.

name: Regionalmonitoring Niedersachsen
description: Regionalmonitoring Niedersachsen, a public LSN indicator atlas of population, economy, labour, social, education, and public-finance series by region. Distinct from LSN-Online.

name: LSN-Online
description: LSN-Online regional statistical database of Lower Saxony, with more than 1,000 tables and about 90 million values down to municipality level across official statistics.

name: Geoportal Landkreis Cuxhaven
description: Official Cuxland-GIS geoportal hub of Landkreis Cuxhaven listing public map services for planning and environment.

name: Energieatlas Niedersachsen
description: Public energy atlas of Lower Saxony with spatial energy datasets and maps.

name: Geoportal Landkreis Oldenburg
description: Official geoportal hub of Landkreis Oldenburg with interactive district maps for planning, environment, and public facilities.

name: NFDI4Ing Ingest Service
description: NFDI4Ing repository for publishing research data from civil engineering, architecture, and urbanism.

name: Jugendsozialmonitoring Brandenburg
description: Jugendsozialmonitoring Brandenburg, a public dashboard of child and youth social and health indicators by Landkreis. Distinct from Brandenburger Sozialindikatoren (LASV) and from MATS Berlin-Brandenburg.

name: Gesundheitsplattform Brandenburg
description: Gesundheitsplattform Brandenburg, a public LAVG explorer of AOLG health and social indicators with Kreis tables, maps, time series, and Excel export. Distinct from Jugendsozialmonitoring, Brandenburger Sozialindikatoren (LASV), and from federal GBE-Bund. GBE im Fokus factsheets are extra views, not a second catalog.

name: Infektionsbericht Brandenburg
description: Infektionsbericht Brandenburg, a public LAVG dashboard of weekly notifiable-disease indicators under the Infektionsschutzgesetz. Distinct from Gesundheitsplattform Brandenburg. Influenzabericht and Abwassermonitoring on sibling hosts are extra surveillance views, not separate catalogs.

name: Brandenburger Sozialindikatoren
description: Brandenburger Sozialindikatoren, a public LASV dashboard of Land and Kreis social indicators in nine themes (social protection, health, care, demography, education, housing). Distinct from MATS Berlin-Brandenburg.

name: Geoportal Amt Peitz
description: Public geoportal UI of Amt Peitz, distinct from the geoportal.amt-peitz.de ArcGIS REST directory.

name: GeoPortal Havelland
description: Public MapGate geoportal of Landkreis Havelland.

name: Geoportal Landkreis Merzig-Wadern
description: District geoportal of Landkreis Merzig-Wadern with interactive map services for infrastructure, environment, and local points of interest.

name: Deutsche Bundesbank Research Data
description: Catalog of Bundesbank research microdata on banks, securities, enterprises, and households. Access is limited to approved research projects.

name: paneldata.org SOEP documentation catalog
description: Public study and variable catalog for the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) and related longitudinal studies. Documents datasets, variables, questionnaires, and frequencies; actual microdata access is provided by the SOEP Research Data Center at DIW Berlin after registration.

name: AOK Gesundheitsatlas Deutschland
description: AOK Gesundheitsatlas Deutschland, a public explorer of regional disease prevalence and related indicators down to Kreis level, based on AOK claims data adjusted to the resident population. Not the official GBE-Bund product.

name: Versorgungsatlas Dashboard
description: Versorgungsatlas dashboard of common chronic diseases, a public regional indicator explorer of SHI physician billing data operated by the Zentralinstitut für die kassenärztliche Versorgung (Zi). Distinct from GBE-Bund and from the AOK Gesundheitsatlas.

name: Digitaler Gleichstellungsatlas
description: Digitaler Gleichstellungsatlas, a public BMBFSFJ explorer of more than 40 regional equality indicators (leadership, education, labour, unpaid care) for Länder and Kreise. Distinct from the BMBFSFJ open-data portal.

name: Klimadashboard Deutschland
description: Klimadashboard Deutschland, a public civil-society explorer of climate, energy, emissions, and health indicators for Germany, including regional views for Länder, Kreise, and Gemeinden as slices of this one catalog. Distinct from the Münster municipal Klimadashboard and from UBA Data Cube.

name: 50Hertz Grid Data
description: Transmission grid data for the 50Hertz control area in eastern Germany.

name: TransnetBW Market Data
description: Generation, load, and grid figures for the TransnetBW control area in Baden-Württemberg.

name: Integrationsmonitoring der Länder
description: Integrationsmonitoring der Länder, the public IntMK indicator catalog with definitions and Excel time series for all 16 Länder on demography, legal status, education, labour, health, housing, and related integration topics. Distinct from the Niedersachsen Open SDG migration report.

name: SDG-Portal für Kommunen
description: National portal of SDG indicators for German municipalities (SDG-Indikatoren für Kommunen), with comparable local time series mapped to the 17 Sustainable Development Goals.

name: INKAR
description: INKAR online atlas of the BBSR with about 600 regional indicators on spatial and urban development in Germany and the EU, including maps, downloads, and a core set of municipal SDG indicators.

name: Energy-Charts
description: Public electricity generation, price, and import-export charts for Germany and neighbouring countries, published by Fraunhofer ISE.

name: Gesundheitsberichterstattung des Bundes
description: Informationssystem der Gesundheitsberichterstattung des Bundes (IS-GBE). Queryable health tables and indicators compiled by Destatis from more than 100 sources, covering health status, care, diseases, and financing.

name: SMARD Strom- und Gasmarktdaten
description: Official electricity and gas market data platform of the Federal Network Agency (Bundesnetzagentur). Publishes generation, consumption, wholesale prices, and system-stability time series with interactive charts and a public download/API under CC BY 4.0.

name: DKR Länderatlas
description: DKR Länderatlas, the public interactive cancer atlas of Deutsche Krebsregister e.V. (formerly GEKID) with Land-level incidence and related indicators. Kreisatlas and Survivalatlas on the same host are extra views, not separate catalogs. Distinct from the RKI Krebsdaten scientific repository.

name: SurvStat@RKI 2.0
description: SurvStat@RKI 2.0 public query system for aggregated German infectious-disease notification data reported under the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Users can build tables, charts, and maps from a limited version of the national notification database.

name: Jorda-Schularick-Taylor Macrohistory Database
description: Jorda-Schularick-Taylor annual macro-financial series for advanced economies since 1870, including credit, asset prices, and public finances.

name: Dashboard Integration
description: Dashboard Integration, Destatis public explorer of about 60 federal integration indicators (labour, education, language, housing, income, participation). Optional account is only for saved views. Distinct from IntMK and GENESIS.

name: Deutsche Bundesbank Statistics
description: Deutsche Bundesbank statistics portal providing access to macroeconomic time series and real-time data, including the SDMX REST web service. Covers monetary policy, financial stability, banking supervision, economic activity, prices, exchange rates, money and capital markets, and public finances. The legacy time-series database UI is scheduled to close on 30 June 2026; series remain available through this portal and the SDMX API.

name: Tarifdatenbank
description: Destatis Tarifdatenbank of collective-agreement wages and related provisions (working time, special payments, leave) by industry and region. Distinct from GENESIS-Online tariff-index tables.

name: Dashboard Konjunktur
description: Dashboard Konjunktur, Destatis public explorer of about 100 high-frequency economic indicators (prices, industry, construction, trade, labour, energy). Optional account is only for saved views. Distinct from GENESIS and Dashboard Integration.

name: i6eal Open AI Data Catalogue
description: Public catalogue of 16 datasets on artificial intelligence, public policy, regulation, and public-sector evidence in Germany and the European Union, with DCAT-AP JSON-LD and an OpenAPI description. Compilation metadata is CC BY 4.0; underlying source records keep their original rights.

name: OpenStreetMap Community Open Data Portal
description: Downloadable data extracts from OpenStreetMap (OSM), providing vector data for various regions as shapefiles or GeoPackage

name: Netztransparenz
description: Joint data portal of the German transmission system operators for grid fees, EEG accounts, and system data.

name: BBBike OpenStreetMap Extracts Data Catalog
description: Service providing extracts from OpenStreetMap for more than 200 areas worldwide, available in multiple formats including OSM, PBF, Shapefile, Osmand, mapsforge, GeoJSON, or SQLite.

name: Datenportal des BMFTR
description: Data portal of the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR), formerly the BMBF Datenportal. Publishes statistical datasets on education, research, and related topics and is harvested by GovData as a DCAT-AP.de source.

name: THW-Pegel Open Data
description: Public open-data API and catalog of THW water-level (Pegel) measurements.

name: Deutscher Wetterdienst Open Data Server
description: The Deutscher Wetterdienst Open Data Server (CDC) provides free meteorological, climatological, and radar datasets of Germany as bulk file downloads.

name: MISSY (Microdata Information System)
description: Online service platform that provides structured metadata for official statistics, including metadata at the study and variable level, as well as reports and tools for data handling and analysis. All documentation refers to microdata available for scientific purposes.

name: OPEN DATA WIRTSCHAFT
description: Open data catalog related to economic data (Wirtschaft), information, and datasets in Germany.

name: OpenAPC
description: Open dataset of article processing charges paid by universities, funders, and research organisations, with a public data browser.

name: Regelleistung Datacenter
description: Tender results for German balancing reserves: FCR, aFRR, mFRR, and interruptible loads.

name: DB Open Data Infos
description: Deutsche Bahn open data information portal. Since 10 March 2024 the former CKAN catalog has been retired; DB open datasets are published via Mobilithek, GovData and Open Data ÖPNV, while APIs remain on the DB API Marketplace. The site documents DB InfraGO mobility APIs including Timetables, StaDa (station data) and FaSta (station facility status).

name: ISIMIP Repository (ISIMIP Output Data)
description: Repository for climate impact simulation output data across various sectors, organized by ISIMIP simulation rounds. Provides public access to model outputs for agriculture, biodiversity, biomes, fire, forests, mortality, lakes, fisheries, permafrost, and water sectors.

name: Mobilithek
description: Germany's National Access Point (NAP) for mobility data, published by the Federal Ministry of Transport. The catalog provides metadata and access to open and restricted traffic, public transport, and infrastructure datasets required under the EU ITS Directive, including DATEX II feeds and DCAT-AP.de metadata.

name: DWD Climate Data Center (CDC)
description: Official Climate Data Center (CDC) portal of Deutscher Wetterdienst. Provides free search, interactive map-based access, and download of German climate and weather observation data, including station, area, and raster products.

name: Open Data Portal Wirtschaft und Energie
description: Open data portal of the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWE / BMWK). GovData harvests a DCAT-AP.de dump of the catalog.

name: Open Data Portal BMBFSFJ
description: Open data portal of the Federal Ministry for Education, Family Affairs, Senior Citizens, Women and Youth (BMBFSFJ), formerly published at daten.bmfsfj.de. Harvested by GovData as a DCAT-AP.de source.

name: Pontus-X Ecosystem Catalogue
description: Public Gaia-X / Ocean Enterprise catalogue of data, algorithm, and SaaS offerings operated by deltaDAO. Listings are browsable without login; consumption may require a wallet and contract.

name: Datarade
description: Global data marketplace for finding, comparing, and accessing commercial data products from 2,600+ providers. Buyers can preview samples and pricing for free; purchases are arranged with the listed providers.

name: GISC Offenbach
description: WMO Global Information System Centre Offenbach operated by Deutscher Wetterdienst. Public WIS Portal for discovering and accessing WIS meteorological metadata and products.

name: WasserBLIcK
description: German water information portal with public water-body factsheets used for Water Framework Directive reporting.

name: CODE-DE-Lab
description: CODE-DE-Lab, the German national Copernicus Collaborative Ground Segment platform for searching, accessing and processing Sentinel and other Earth observation data. Catalogue APIs include OData, RESTO and STAC; download requires an account.

name: ArcGIS Server of the Geoportal of the Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources
description: Geoportal. managed by Federal Statistical Office of Germany. powered by Custom software. accessible at regionalatlas.statistikportal.de.

name: Geofabrik Download Server
description: Free download server for OpenStreetMap data extracts, updated daily by region. Offers OSM data in various formats suitable for GIS applications.

name: GEI Digital - Viewer
description: Data catalog for harvesting and accessing digital resources via GEI-Digital, supporting OAI-PMH protocol for metadata retrieval [1].

name: EOC Geoservice
description: Earth Observation Data Catalog for discovery, visualization, and direct download of geospatial datasets from the Earth Observation Center (EOC) of the German Aerospace Center (DLR).

name: Julius Kühn-Institut (JKI) Geoportal
description: GIS-based data catalogs for agricultural landscape structures, including directories of small structures (hedgerows, meadow orchards, copses, bushes, etc.) and geospatial analyses at the municipal level.

name: Service Centre of the Federal Government for Geo-Information and Geodesy - Open Data
description: The BKG Service Centre (GDZ) publishes open federal geodata of Germany for download, including administrative boundaries, elevation, and topographic products.

name: Geoportal des Bundesamtes für Strahlenschutz (BfS)
description: Interactive geoportal for BfS radiation-protection measurement data (IMIS), with map visualization, time series, and download of geospatial services.

name: GeotIS
description: Public geothermal information system for medium-depth and deep geothermal energy in Germany, operated by LIAG.

name: EOWEB GeoPortal
description: DLR EOWEB GeoPortal for searching and ordering TerraSAR-X, TanDEM-X, and other German satellite data archive products.

name: Data Catalog: da|ra
description: da|ra – The Registration Agency for Social and Economic Data, provides registration and curation services for research data in the social, behavioral, and economic sciences. The catalog serves as a central hub for discovering and registering datasets in these domains.

name: FAIRagro Search Hub
description: NFDI FAIRagro search hub for agrosystem research datasets and domain repositories.

name: DataCite Commons
description: DataCite Commons is the public discovery interface for the PID Graph, a linked scholarly metadata graph built from DataCite DOIs and related persistent identifiers. It supports search and analytics for works (DOIs), people (ORCID iDs), organizations (ROR IDs, Crossref Funder Registry IDs), and repositories, surfacing citations, references, and other relationships together with COUNTER usage where available. The Commons web app is backed by DataCite’s public GraphQL and REST APIs.

name: DB API Marketplace
description: Deutsche Bahn developer portal (DB API Marketplace) listing mobility and railway APIs including Timetables, StaDa, FaSta, RIS passenger information, shared mobility GBFS, and related products. The catalog is publicly browsable; API keys require free registration and per-product licences.

name: O2A REGISTRY
description: AWI O2A REGISTRY of research platforms, sensors, and devices used in polar and marine observing, complementary to the O2A Data Portal and O2A SAMPLES.

name: BARTOC
description: BARTOC is a registry of knowledge organization systems (thesauri, ontologies, classifications, and related terminology registries), hosted by the Common Library Network GBV in Göttingen.

name: MPI-Mainz UV/VIS Spectral Atlas
description: Spectral atlas of gaseous molecules of atmospheric interest with absorption cross sections.

name: Phospho.ELM Phosphorylation Site Database
description: Phospho.ELM is a manually curated database of eukaryotic phosphorylation sites. The resource includes data collected from published literature as well as high-throughput data sets.

name: International Centre for Global Earth Models
description: The International Centre for Global Earth Models (ICGEM) is a service that collects, archives, and makes available global gravity field models of the Earth  to the public in a standardized format. These models include both static and temporal solutions and can be downloaded, visualized interactively, or used within web-based calculation tools to derive gravity field functionals like geoid heights and gravity anomalies.

name: Vitis International Variety Catalogue
description: VIVC, the Vitis International Variety Catalogue, is a global database of grapevine species, cultivars, and genetic resources. It is maintained by the Geilweilerhof Institute for Grapevine Breeding in Siebeldingen, Germany. It provides detailed information about grapevine varieties, including synonyms, pedigree, passport data, morphological descriptors, and DNA-profiling when available.

name: BigBrain Database
description: The BigBrain database contains an ultra-high-resolution 3D reconstruction of a human post-mortem brain, created by slicing, staining, and scanning it at microscopic detail. It offers precise anatomical information, such as local morphology, cell densities, and connectivity, beyond what current standard neuroimaging can capture, especially in highly folded cortical and subcortical regions.

name: Geological and Environmental Reference Materials
