description: GeoReM is a Max Planck Institute database for reference materials of geological and environmental interest, such as rock powders, synthetic and natural glasses as well as mineral, isotopic, biological, river water and seawater reference materials. GeoReM contains published analytical data and compilation values (major and trace element concentrations and mass fractions, radiogenic and stable isotope ratios). GeoReM contains all important metadata about the analytical values such as uncertainty, analytical method and laboratory. Sample information and references are also included.

name: Forschungsdatenzentrum Bildung
description: Research Data Centre Education (FDZ Bildung, VerbundFDB at DIPF/IQB): catalog of German educational research study data; access via scientific-use-file application.

name: Bach digital
description: Bach digital is the online database of autograph manuscripts and original sources of Johann Sebastian Bach and his family, coordinated by the Bach-Archiv Leipzig.

name: GRDC Data Portal
description: The GRDC (Global Runoff Data Centre) Data Portal provides access to quality-checked river discharge (runoff) time series from national hydrological services worldwide. Users can search stations or regions on a map, preview data in tables, and download in several formats (e.g. NetCDF, CSV, WaterML2) along with watershed boundary layers.

name: Digitale Historische Bibliothek Erfurt/Gotha
description: The Digital Historical Library Erfurt/Gotha presents digitized early prints and manuscripts from the Gotha Research Library and related Erfurt collections.

name: CRC/TRR 247
description: Research data infrastructure of CRC/TRR 247 (Heterogeneous Oxidation Catalysis) at Ruhr University Bochum, sharing catalysis and materials datasets among project partners.

name: Digitale Sammlungen der Württembergischen Landesbibliothek
description: Digitale Sammlungen of the Württembergische Landesbibliothek Stuttgart publish digitized manuscripts, rare prints, and regional historical sources.

name: MorpheusML model repository
description: The public MorpheusML model repository collects, curates, documents and tests computational models for multi-scale and multicellular biological systems. Model must be encoded in the model description language MorpheusML. Subsections of the repository distinguish published models from contributed non-published and example models. New models are simulated in Morpheus or Artistoo independently from the authors and results are compared to published results. Successful reproduction is documented on the model's webpage. Models in this repository are included into the CI and test pipelines for each release of the model simulator Morpheus to check and guarantee reproducibility of results across future simulator updates. The model’s webpage provides a History-link to all past model versions and edits that are automatically tracked via Git. Each model is registered with a unique and persistent ID of the format M..... The model description page (incl. the biological context and key results of that model), the model’s XML file, the associated paper, and all further files (often simulation result videos) connected with that model can be retrieved via a persistent URL of the format https://identifiers.org/morpheus/M.....

name: Database of MHC Ligands and Peptide Motifs
description: SYFPEITHI is a database comprising more than 7000 peptide sequences known to bind class I and class II MHC molecules.

name: International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service
description: The primary objectives of the IERS are to serve the astronomical, geodetic and geophysical communities by providing data and standards related to Earth rotation and reference frames.

name: The Track Hub Registry
description: The Track Hub Registry is a global centralised collection of publicly accessible track hubs. Its goal is to allow third parties to advertise track hubs, and to make it easier for researchers around the world to discover and use track hubs containing different types of genomic research data.

name: Proteome-pI : proteome isoelectric point database
description: Proteome-pI is an online database containing information about predicted isoelectric points for 5,029 proteomes (21 million of sequences) calculated using 18 methods. The isoelectric point, the pH at which a particular molecule carries no net electrical charge, is an important parameter for many analytical biochemistry and proteomics techniques, especially for 2D gel electrophoresis (2D-PAGE), capillary isoelectric focusing, liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry and X-ray protein crystallography. The database allows the retrieval of virtual 2D-PAGE plots and the development of customized fractions of proteome based on isoelectric point and molecular weight. Moreover, Proteome-pI facilitates statistical comparisons of the various prediction methods as well as biological investigation of protein isoelectric point space in all kingdoms of life (http://isoelectricpointdb.org/statistics.html). The database includes various statistics and tools for interactive browsing, searching and sorting. It can be searched and browsed by organism name, average isoelectric point, molecular weight or amino acid frequencies. Proteins with extreme pI values are also available. For individual proteomes, users can retrieve proteins of interest given the method, isoelectric point and molecular weight ranges (this particular feature can be highly useful to limit potential targets in analysis of 2DPAGE gels or before conducting mass spectrometry). Finally, some general statistics (total number of proteins, amino acids, average sequence length, amino acid and di-amino acid frequencies) and datasets corresponding to major protein databases such as UniProtKB/TrEMBL and the NCBI non-redundant (nr) database have also been precalculated.

name: Polytopia
description: The main goal of the project is to build models of all polyhedra in a collective endeavor (citizen art) and, to date, all polyhedra with up to nine vertices have been made available for adoption. Users can adopt an individual polyhedron, give it a name and then help it take shape by building a model; this “Adopt a Polyhedron” project allows users to actively participate in mathematics with the building of geometric models as the focus.

name: The Nothobranchius furzeri Information Network
description: The Nothobranchius furzeri Information Network (NFIN) is a resource dedicated to the short-lived killifish Nothobranchius furzeri, a powerful vertebrate model for research on development and aging. The database hosts several types of data, including a high-quality draft genome of the inbred GRZ strain, genome-wide variation data from different natural and laboratory populations, and a transcriptome browser with annotated protein-coding genes. These datasets support studies on genetic diversity, lifespan, molecular mechanisms of aging, and comparative analyses with other fish models.

name: Geochemistry of Rocks of the Oceans and Continents
description: The Geochemistry of Rocks of the Oceans and Continents (GEOROC) database is a collection of published analyses of igneous rocks and mantle xenoliths. It contains major and trace element concentrations, radiogenic and nonradiogenic isotope ratios as well as analytical ages for whole rocks, glasses, minerals and inclusions. Samples come from 11 different geological settings. Metadata include, among others, geographic location with latitude and longitude, rock class and rock type, alteration grade, analytical method, laboratory, reference materials and references.

name: Forschungsdatenzentrum am Institut zur Qualitätsentwicklung im Bildungswesen / Research Data Centre at Institute for Educational Quality Improvement
description:
For more than 20 years, Germany has been building up an extensive collection of data within the framework of international and national school performance studies (e.g. PISA, IGLU, IQB Trends in Student Achievement), which enables systematic analyses of framework conditions, processes and outcomes in the education system.

This potential can only be fully exploited if researchers from different disciplines have access to the data.

To make this possible, the Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) established the Research Data Centre (FDZ at the Institute for Educational Quality Improvement (IQB) in 2007. Since 2011, the FDZ at the IQB has been part of the Centre for International Student Assessment (ZIB).

The FDZ at IQB is intensively involved in the further development of the research data infrastructure in the education sector. It fulfils two core tasks:

    It makes the data sets of national and international school performance studies in Germany available to the scientific community for re- and secondary analyses.
    It is active in the promotion of young researchers by offering advice for young researchers and events for the methodological training of young researchers (e.g. twice-yearly academies on methods of empirical educational research).

name: Open Power System Data
description: Open Power System Data compiles and publishes power-system time series (generation, load, prices, and related data) for research on electricity markets and grids.

name: ARACHNE IDAI.objects
description: iDAI.objects / Arachne is the central object database of the German Archaeological Institute, documenting ancient objects, buildings, and related research images.

name: RES³T
description: RES³T is the Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf database of surface-complexation parameters for sorption modelling in aquatic and environmental chemistry.

name: TERENO Data Discovery Portal
description: Terrestrial Environmental Observatories data discovery portal for German landscape observatory datasets.

name: intRechtDok
description: The Virtual Law Library (intRechtDok) is a disciplinary repository of the Scientific Information Service for International and Interdisciplinary Legal Research established at Berlin State Library which contains specialized information for international and interdisciplinary legal research.

name: Archive of Formal Proofs
description:
The Archive of Formal Proofs is a collection of proof libraries, examples, and larger scientific developments, mechanically checked in the theorem prover Isabelle. It is organized in the way of a scientific journal. Submissions are refereed.
The archive repository is hosted on Heptapod to provide easy free access to archive entries. The entries are tested and maintained continuously against the current stable release of Isabelle. Older versions of archive entries will remain available.

name: RAMEDIS
description: RAMEDIS is a rare metabolic disease database of case reports and genetic/clinical data, originally developed for research on inborn errors of metabolism.

name: DARIAH-DE Repository (Digital Research Infrastructure for the Arts and Humanities)
description: DARIAH-DE Repository (Digital Research Infrastructure for the Arts and Humanities) provides 11 datasets ([82%] open access) according to the BASE search index as of 2023-03-08.

name: Brainstem Connectome
description: Database of all known neuronal connections of the rat brainstem. Connections are directed, weighted and bilateral. It is built using the neuroVIISAS platform. The Brainstem Connectome is a highly structured neuroontology composed of datasets from over 1,000 peer-reviewed original research publications. It contains more than 35,000 specific experimental observations and over 18,000 neuronal connections.

name: Small angle scattering biological data bank
description: Curated repository for small angle scattering data and models. SASBDB contains X-ray (SAXS) and neutron (SANS) scattering data from biological macromolecules in solution.

name: Maya Image Archive
description: The Maya Image Archive is intended to host research materials provided by various scholars. Comprising image collections with photographs, drawings, notes and manuscripts, the Maya Image Archive allows the user to browse through the results of several decades of research trips through the entire Maya region.

name: circBase
description: circBase is a database of circular RNA (circRNA) detections in eukaryotic organisms, maintained at the Max Delbrück Center for Molecular Medicine.

name: The German Human Genome-Phenome Archive Data Portal
description:
The German Human Genome-Phenome Archive (GHGA) is a dedicated repository for storing and sharing diverse genomic and phenotypic data from a wide range of scientific studies, including clinical trials, population research, routine healthcare, and biomedical investigations usually coming from research institutions in Germany. By connecting with international initiatives such as the European Genome-phenome Archive (EGA) and the European Genomic Data Infrastructure (GDI), GHGA ensures that data is FAIRly stored, accessible, and interoperable across the globe.

GHGA has set up a trusted, long-term repository, with plans to preserve data at every stage, from raw sequencing files to processed data and research results. Developed in phases, GHGA will continually add features that support secondary research, including secure processing environments, data statistics, and data analysis tools. In this way, GHGA provides a secure and evolving resource for researchers, accelerating scientific discoveries and the development of innovative healthcare solutions.

Recognizing the sensitivity of human omics data, GHGA ensures strict data protection through robust security systems that maintain patient privacy and comply with ethical standards. Access to restricted datasets is not managed by GHGA, but by relevant Data Access Committees (DACs) appointed by the respective data controllers. DACs oversee requests based on established ethical and legal guidelines, while complying with the data subject’s consent. GHGA functions as an intermediate - who facilitates access for authorized users, such as researchers and healthcare professionals, ensuring that only those with proper clearance can access controlled data.

name: plankton*net
description: plankton*net is an image and occurrence database of marine and freshwater plankton, operated by the Alfred Wegener Institute (AWI).

name: Research Data Center SOEP
description: The Research Data Center (RDC) of the Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP), based at DIW Berlin, provides researchers with secure access to longitudinal microdata from a large, multidisciplinary household survey in Germany. It distributes anonymized SOEP data under a scientific-use contract, in compliance with German data protection regulations.

name: Fachinformationssystem Geophysik
description: FIS Geophysik is the German subject information system for geophysics, indexing literature and data sources for applied and general geophysics.

name: ZFDM repository
description: The ZFDM repository is the institutional research data repository of Universität Hamburg's Center for Sustainable Research Data Management.

name: Motion Capture Database HDM05
description: The HDM05 database is a freely available motion‐capture dataset providing over three hours of well-documented human motion recordings in C3D and ASF/AMC formats. It covers more than 70 action classes, each performed multiple times by various actors.

name: LIVIVO
description: LIVIVO is ZB MED's search portal for life sciences, health, nutrition, and environmental literature and research information.

name: AQUiLA
description: AQUiLA is Senckenberg's public search for scientific literature, collection objects, and related research information across Senckenberg institutions.

name: LITTERBASE
description: LITTERBASE summarises results from scientific studies in understandable global maps and figures and opens scientific knowledge on marine litter to the public. These publications form the basis of continuously updated maps and figures for policy makers, authorities, scientists, media and the general public on the global amount, distribution and composition of marine litter and its impacts on aquatic life. The portal conveys a broad, fact-based understanding of this environmental problem. It provides a text-based publication search interface as well as a map viewer to retrieve litter data in a geographical context, with further information available from the underlying publication.

name: TerraSAR-X TOR
description: TerraSAR-X science data of the German Aerospace Center (DLR): SAR imagery and related products from the TerraSAR-X radar satellite mission.

name: MORPHYLL
description: MORPHYLL is a database for acquisition of ecophysiologically-relevant morphometric data of fossil leaves, mainly from the Paleogene geologic period. It contains digitized fossil leaves from various collections and supports searches for specific taxa, locations, and morphometry. Queries and images are publicly available, while full access to the complete set of data including morphometry and high resolution images is available upon request.

name: CARLA - Conservatory Archive Records Leipzig with Additions
description: CARLA is the digital archive of the University of Music and Theatre Leipzig, publishing conservatory records, historical documents, and related metadata.

name: Marine Data Portal
description: Central access point to research data from the German marine research community and international collaborations.

name: SABIO-RK Biochemical Reaction Kinetics Database
description: SABIO-RK is a database for biochemical reactions, their kinetic equations with their parameters, and the experimental conditions under which these parameters were measured.

name: Biological Collection Access Service for Europe
description: BioCASe (Biological Collection Access Service) is a networking protocol and portal for querying distributed natural-history collection databases in Europe.

name: Wissenschaftliche Sammlungen
description: The portal Wissenschaftliche Sammlungen is the national information service on university collections in Germany, coordinated at Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin.

name: FDZ-BO
description: FDZ-BO at DIW Berlin is the research data centre for business and organizational data, providing access to linked survey and firm datasets.

name: Neutron Monitor Database
description: Network database of standardized ground-based neutron monitor measurements of cosmic-ray intensity variations.

name: Science3D
description: Science3D was a synchrotron tomography and 3D-imaging data repository linked to PETRA III and DORIS, developed with DESY and Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon; re3data now reports the service as no longer available.

name: Evolutionary Genealogy of Genes: Non-supervised Orthologous Groups
description: eggNOG (evolutionary genealogy of genes: Non-supervised Orthologous Groups) is a database of orthologous groups of genes. The orthologous groups are annotated with functional description lines (derived by identifying a common denominator for the genes based on their various annotations), with functional categories (i.e derived from the original COG/KOG categories).

name: STRENDA DB
description: Beilstein STRENDA database for reporting enzyme kinetics data according to STRENDA guidelines.

name: studyforrest
description: studyforrest is an open neuroimaging resource of high-resolution 3T/7T MRI and physiological data acquired while participants watched the movie Forrest Gump.

name: European Mouse Mutant Cell Repository
description: The EuMMCR (European Mouse Mutant cell Repository) is the mouse ES cell distribution unit in Europe. The EuMMCR has been founded as distribution unit of EUCOMM (European Mouse Mutagenesis Program). The EuMMCR provides an online database to help users discover and choose targeting vectors and mutant ES cell lines produced in the EUCOMM and EUCOMMTOOLS consortia.

name: Geosciences Collection Access Service
description: GeoCASe (Geosciences Collection Access Service) is an extended version of BioCASE (Biological Collection Access Service), which is a transnational network of biological collections of all kinds. GeoCASe provides access to paleontological, mineralogical, and geological data; providers are required to use ABCDEFG, an extention of ABCD, in their configuration files.

name: GEOMAR OSIS Ocean Science Information System
description: GEOMAR Ocean Science Information System catalog of research-cruise datasets, samples and related marine observations.

name: TextGrid Repository
description: A long-term archive for humanities research data. It provides an extensive, searchable, and reusable repository of texts and images.

name: ECHO – Cultural Heritage Online
description: ECHO – Cultural Heritage Online, operated by the Max Planck Institute for the History of Science in Berlin, provides digitized cultural-heritage and history-of-science research collections.

name: Virtuelles Skriptorium St. Matthias
description: The Virtual Scriptorium St. Matthias reconstructs the medieval library of St. Matthias Abbey in Trier from dispersed manuscripts, hosted at the University of Trier.

name: ROCEEH Out of Africa Database
description: The ROCEEH Out of Africa Database (ROAD) is web-based research database that integrates archaeological, paleoanthropological, paleontological, and environmental data from prehistoric sites across Africa and Eurasia dating from about 3 million to 20 000 years ago. It links geographic and chronological information with cultural and fossil records to support studies of early human evolution and dispersal. ROAD pulls data from thousands of scientific publications and lets users search, map, and analyze this multidisciplinary information.

name: O2A Data Portal
description: Alfred Wegener Institute O2A Data Portal for discovering polar and marine datasets, platforms, sensors, expeditions, and related publications in the Observations to Archives framework.

name: MitoCheck
description: MitoCheck aims to integrate information on cellular function of human genes while giving access to supporting information such as microscopy images of phenotypes.

name: Sandrart.net Art History Database
description: sandrart.net is a research database on Joachim von Sandrart's Teutsche Academie and early modern art literature, with texts, persons, and works.

name: Historical Data Centre Saxony-Anhalt
description: The Historical Data Centre Saxony-Anhalt at MLU Halle-Wittenberg publishes historical statistics and research data on the region's social and economic history.

name: Discuss Data
description: Discuss Data is a community platform for sharing, discussing, and archiving research data on the post-Soviet region, hosted by Göttingen State and University Library.

name: Pandora
description: The Pandora initiative offers a platform for the secure storage of data concerning the study of the human story. This service is available to researchers devoted to the study of the human past (e.g. historians, archaeologists, paleoclimatologists).

name: MetaCrop 2.0
description: The MetaCrop resource contains information on the major metabolic pathways mainly in crops of agricultural and economic importance. The database includes manually curated information on reactions and the kinetic data associated with these reactions. Ontology terms are used and publication identification available to ease mining the data.

name: Kipoi
description: Kipoi is an API and a repository of ready-to-use trained models for genomics. It currently contains 2206 different models, covering canonical predictive tasks in transcriptional and post-transcriptional gene regulation.

name: Reanalysis Tropopause Data Repository
description: The Reanalysis Tropopause Data Repository provides access to tropopause parameters estimated from meteorological reanalyses. The tropopause data sets provided on the web site have been created using meteorological reanalyses distributed by the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR), and the National Centers for Atmospheric Prediction (NCEP).

name: SupraBank
description: Repository for intermolecular and supramolecular interaction data of molecular systems.

name: BacDive
description: Database of standardized bacterial strain information mobilized from diverse sources.

name: Health Data Lab
description: Health Data Lab (Forschungsdatenzentrum Gesundheit) of the Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM) provides access to German statutory health insurance data for research under the Digital Care Act.

name: DeZIM.fdz DataSearch
description: DeZIM.fdz DataSearch is a metadata portal that lets users search and explore datasets related to integration and migration research. It is part of the DeZIM Institute’s research data centre, which archives both quantitative and qualitative survey data, as well as text corpora, from projects on migration and social integration.

name: swMATH
description: swMATH is an information service for mathematical software, indexing packages, publications, and related metadata, operated with zbMATH / FIZ Karlsruhe and ZIB.

name: List of Prokaryotic names with Standing in Nomenclature
description: List of Prokaryotic names with Standing in Nomenclature, the authoritative catalog of prokaryote nomenclature.

name: GenomeRNAi
description: The GenomeRNAi database collects RNAi phenotypes recorded in the literature for Homo sapiens and Drosophila melanogaster, as well as details on RNAi reagents. The data is well integrated with information from other resources, allowing comparison within and across species. Download files are provided.

name: European Zebrafish Resource Center
description: The European Zebrafish Resource Center (EZRC) at KIT maintains zebrafish lines, genomic resources, and related research data for the biomedical community.

name: doRiNA
description: Database of RNA interactions in post-transcriptional regulation.

name: HIIK conflict datasets
description: Yearly HIIK conflict datasets in CSV and XLSX, covering monitored conflicts worldwide, with the project codebook.

name: Movebank
description: Catalog of animal tracking and sensor data from GPS, Argos, and related telemetry studies, hosted by the Max Planck Institute of Animal Behavior.

name: Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy
description: The Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (CDMS) is an online scientific catalog of spectral line data for atoms and molecules of astrophysical and atmospheric interest. It provides transition frequencies, intensities, energy levels, and related parameters used in radio and sub-millimeter astronomy and molecular spectroscopy. The classic catalog version documents these spectral lines to support identification and analysis of molecular signals in space.

name: Human Protein-Protein Interaction rEference
description: HIPPIE integrates human protein-protein interactions from several manually curated source databases. It provides a web tool to query the interaction data, generate highly reliable, context-specific interaction networks and to make sense out of them.

name: Mathematical Research-Data Repository
description: This is a repository of the Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences in Leipzig, dedicated to mathematical research data. In particular, the purpose of this repository is to collect scripts and code, to explain applications of mathematical software, to showcase additional examples to paper publications, and more generally to host supplementary material developed for research projects or discussed in workshops. MathRepo is in the process of restructuring so that its content meets the FAIR Principles for sustainable research. In the future, MathRepo will follow the guidelines developed by the Mathematical Research Data Initiative MaRDI.

name: GABI-Kat SimpleSearch
description: T-DNA insertions in Arabidopsis and their flanking sequence tags.

name: Biobank of blood donors
description: The Interdisciplinary Biomaterial and Database Würzburg (ibdw) manages biomaterials and associated clinical data of University Hospital Würzburg.

name: The algebraic phylogenetics database
description: The algebraic phylogenetics database collects algebraic invariants, Markov models, and related computational resources for phylogenetic tree reconstruction.

name: TRY Plant Trait Database
description: Global catalog of curated plant functional traits assembled by the TRY network at the Max Planck Institute for Biogeochemistry and iDiv.

name: DeZIM Research Data Center
description: The DeZIM Research Data Center archives and provides survey and research data on integration, migration, and social cohesion in Germany.

name: Wand- und Deckenmalerei in Lübecker Häusern 1300 bis 1800
description: This Kiel University project documents wall and ceiling paintings in Lübeck houses from 1300 to 1800, with images, building records, and art-historical metadata.

name: BAW INGRID Data Repository
description: Scientific data repository. managed by Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau (BAW). powered by Custom software. accessible at datenrepository.baw.de.

name: Domain Interaction Graph Guided ExploreR
description: DIGGER is an essential resource for studying the mechanistic consequences of alternative splicing such as isoform-specific interaction and consequence of exon skipping. The database integrates information of domain-domain and protein-protein interactions with residue-level interaction evidence from co-resolved structures. DIGGER allows users to seamlessly switch between isoform and exon-centric views of the interactome and to extract sub-networks of relevant isoforms (isoforms specific PPIs).

name: meereisportal.de Data Portal
description: The data and image archive of meereisportal.de is an open data portal providing sea ice data for the Arctic and Antarctic. In addition to graphic representations of the underlying verified data and derived data products, it is also possible to download the data for further processing. It is intended as a service both for scientific groups performing research on sea ice and as a platform for communicating the results of their research. Information is available in German and English. The URL seaiceportal.de is used to designate those areas of the website, such as this data portal, which are available in English.

name: Digitale Sammlungen, Goethe-Universität Frankfurt am Main
description: Digitale Sammlungen of Goethe University Frankfurt's Senckenberg library present digitized manuscripts, rare books, and scholarly collections.

name: SAH digital
description: SAH digital at TIB Hannover publishes digitized sources and research data of the Scientific Commission for the History of German Jewry (SAH).

name: Jean Paul – Sämtliche Briefe digital
description: Jean Paul – Sämtliche Briefe digital is the digital edition of Jean Paul's correspondence, published by the Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences.

name: The AIMe registry for artificial intelligence in biomedical research
description: The AIMe registry is a community-driven reporting platform for AI in biomedicine that the FeatureCloud team developed. It aims to enhance the accessibility, reproducibility, and usability of biomedical AI models and allows future revisions by the scientific community. AIMe stands for “artificial intelligence in biomedical research” and consists of a user-friendly web service, which guides authors of new AIs through the AIMe standard, a generic minimal information standard that allows reporting of any biomedical AI system. As such, the paper serves one of FeatureCloud’s main objectives, namely increasing transparency and thereby maximizing societal acceptance and patient trust. The AIMe registry for artificial intelligence in biomedical research consists of a user-friendly web service that guides authors of new AIs through the AIMe standard, a generic minimal information standard that allows reporting of any biomedical AI system. Once the AIMe standard has been reported, a database entry and an HTML report along with a unique AIMe identifier are created. The latter serves to keep the entry openly accessible and can be disseminated by the authors, for example by inclusion in a manuscript. The AIMe2021 standard is divided into five sections: Metadata, Purpose, Data, Method and Reproducibility providing YAML specification for download.

name: Simple Modular Architecture Research Tool
description: SMART (Simple Modular Architecture Research Tool) is a web resource providing simple identification and extensive annotation of protein domains and the exploration of protein domain architectures. It allows the identification and annotation of genetically mobile domains and the analysis of domain architectures. More than 500 domain families found in signalling, extracellular and chromatin-associated proteins are detectable. These domains are extensively annotated with respect to phyletic distributions, functional class, tertiary structures and functionally important residues. Each domain found in a non-redundant protein database as well as search parameters and taxonomic information are stored in a relational database system. User interfaces to this database allow searches for proteins containing specific combinations of domains in defined taxa.

name: coastDat
description: coastDat is a coastal data service of Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon with model hindcasts of waves, hydrodynamics, and related marine climate parameters.

name: RDC at ZPID
description: The Research Data Center (RDC) at ZPID (formerly PsychData) provides a method for publishing and reusing psychological research data from the diverse fields of psychological research. The service offer of the RDC comprises the following three pillars: providing support for the documentation of research data, assistance in archiving research data (e.g., in PsychArchives), and provision of datasets and analysis structures (e.g., PsychOpen CAMA) for reuse.

name: KITopen
description: KITopen is the institutional repository of Karlsruhe Institute of Technology for publications and research data, operated by KIT Library.

name: correspSearch - Search scholarly editions of letters
description: correspSearch is a search service for scholarly editions of letters, aggregating correspondence metadata from participating digital edition projects.

name: GFZ Data Services (Deutsches GeoForschungsZentrum, Helmholtz-Zentrum Potsdam)Weitere BezeichnungGFZ Data Services (German Research Centre for Geosciences, Helmholtz-Zentrum Potsdam)
description: GFZ Data Services (Deutsches GeoForschungsZentrum, Helmholtz-Zentrum Potsdam)Weitere BezeichnungGFZ Data Services (German Research Centre for Geosciences, Helmholtz-Zentrum Potsdam) provides 8.523 datasets ([26%] open access) according to the BASE search index as of 2019-09-25.

name: German Fruit Genebank
description: German genebank network cataloguing fruit genetic resources conserved in Germany.

name: ProteomicsDB
description: ProteomicsDB is a protein-centric in-memory database for the exploration of large collections of quantitative mass spectrometry-based proteomics data. ProteomicsDB was first released in 2014 to enable the interactive exploration of the first draft of the human proteome. To date, it contains quantitative data from 78 projects totalling over 19k LC-MS/MS experiments. A standardized analysis pipeline enables comparisons between multiple datasets to facilitate the exploration of protein expression across hundreds of tissues, body fluids and cell lines. We recently extended the data model to enable the storage and integrated visualization of other quantitative omics data. This includes transcriptomics data from e. g. NCBI GEO, protein-protein interaction information from STRING, functional annotations from KEGG, drug-sensitivity/selectivity data from several public sources and reference mass spectra from the ProteomeTools project. The extended functionality transforms ProteomicsDB into a multi-purpose resource connecting quantification and meta-data for each protein. The rich user interface helps researchers to navigate all data sources in either a protein-centric or multi-protein-centric manner. Several options are available to download data manually, while our application programming interface enables accessing quantitative data systematically.

name: German Federation for Biological Data
description: The German Federation for Biological Data (GFBio) provides search functionality and access to data stored in its member archives and data centers, and is the national contact point for issues concerning the management and standardisation of biological and environmental research data during the entire data life cycle (from acquisition to archiving and data publication). GFBio offers long term storage of your data through their collaborating archives and data centers.

name: prometheus
description: prometheus is a distributed digital image archive for art and cultural studies. The prometheus image archive brings together heterogeneous and distributed image and media databases from a wide range of institutions and enables image searches through a single interface. The image providers make their databases available to research and teaching free of charge.

name: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin Media Repository
description: The Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin Media Repository is a digital asset management system used to store, organize, and share research and teaching media such as images, audio, video, and documents. It supports both public access collections and restricted collaborative workspaces for research groups and academic projects. The platform also manages metadata and enables reuse of media across different systems and websites.

name: Weizenbaum Library
description: The Weizenbaum Library is an open digital repository hosted by the Weizenbaum Institute for the Networked Society that provides free access to academic publications, research data, and multimedia resources in the social sciences and humanities. It focuses on research about digital society, technology, communication, and the societal impacts of computing and networks.

name: SFB 882 Forschungsdatenzentrum
description: The FDZ of SFB 882 (From Heterogeneities to Inequalities) at Bielefeld University archived survey and project data of the collaborative research centre.

name: European Mouse Mutant Archive
description: The European Mouse Mutant Archive – EMMA is the INFRAFRONTIER’s non-profit repository for the collection, archiving (via cryopreservation) and distribution of relevant mutant mouse and rat strains essential for basic biomedical research. The laboratory mouse is the most important mammalian model for studying genetic and multi-factorial diseases in human beings. The comprehensive physical and data resources of EMMA support basic biomedical and preclinical research, and the available research tools and mouse/rat models of human disease offer the opportunity to develop a better understanding of molecular disease mechanisms and may provide the foundation for the development of diagnostic, prognostic and therapeutic strategies.

name: Mass Centric Peptide Database
description: We presented MaCPepDB, which provides a fast and reliable way to get mass-based information about tryptic peptides of the complete UniProtKB. It can provide help for designing targeted proteomic experiments or tracking down the protein origin of peptides. The web interface of the database allows easy access, and the REST API facilitates the inclusion of the provided information into larger proteomics workflows.

name: Datenbank Gesprochenes Deutsch
description: The Database of Spoken German (DGD) of the Leibniz Institute for the German Language provides annotated corpora of spoken German for linguistic research.

name: Der Karlsruher Wolkenatlas
description: The Karlsruhe Cloud Atlas is a photographic and didactic atlas of cloud types and atmospheric optical phenomena, maintained at KIT.

name: MLentory
description: MLentory is a knowledgebase that stores and rationalises ML models found on the web. It harmonizes that data, and makes it available and searchable on an FDO (FAIR Digital Object) registry. The system is intended to extract ML (Machine Learning) model information from different platforms, normalize that data in a common format, store it, and share it in a FDO registry to facilitate Information Retrieval and comparison/recommendation systems.

name: African Plants
description: African Plants is an online photo guide and identification database of vascular plants from Africa, featuring images of ferns and seed plants in their natural habitats. It allows users to browse species alphabetically or filter by traits like leaf shape and flower colour to help identify plants.

name: Database for Hydrological Time Series of Inland Waters
description: DAHITI (Database for Hydrological Time Series of Inland Waters) is an open hydrological database developed by the German Geodetic Research Institute at the Technical University of Munich (DGFI-TUM). It provides satellite-derived time series of water levels, surface area, volume variations, and other hydrological parameters for lakes, reservoirs, rivers, and wetlands worldwide.

name: Research Data Centre of the Research Institute Social Cohesion
description: The Research Data Centre of the Research Institute Social Cohesion (FGZ/RISC) provides survey and project data on social cohesion in Germany.

name: Digitales Depot Deutsches Schifffahrtsmuseum
description: Digitales Depot of the German Maritime Museum (DSM) in Bremerhaven publishes collection objects, images, and documentation of maritime heritage.

name: RADAM database portal
description: Radiation Damage (RADAM) database of experimental and theoretical data on radiation interaction with biomolecular systems, hosted by MBN Research Center.

name: HeRBi
description: HeRBi (Herbarium Botanischer Garten Karlsruhe) is the digital herbarium of KIT, publishing specimen records and images of the Karlsruhe botanical collections.

name: DEMel
description: DEMel (Digitale Edition der Memoiren des Marquis d'Argens) publishes the digital scholarly edition and related textual data at the University of Rostock library.

name: WDC-RSAT
description: World Data Center for Remote Sensing of the Atmosphere (WDC-RSAT) at DLR. Atmosphere-related satellite data and information products.

name: IllustrisTNG Data Access
description: Public data release of the IllustrisTNG cosmological hydrodynamical simulations, including catalogs and snapshots.

name: Freshwater Research and Environmental Database
description: The Freshwater Research and Environmental Database is the central data repository for IGB Leibniz-Institute of Freshwater Ecology and Inland Fisheries. It is were we store and share environmental data from observations of lakes, rivers, peatlands and other freshwater habitats. In FRED you can find continuous data collected over several decades for our long-term research programme at the lakes Müggelsee, Stechlinsee, Arendsee and the river Spree, as well as environmental data derived from short-term projects in aquatic ecosystems.

name: The Perovskite Database Project
description: The Perovskite Database Project is an open-access repository that collects and organizes experimental data on perovskite devices, especially solar cells. It aggregates data extracted from thousands of scientific publications and allows users to explore, search, filter, and visualize the dataset with interactive tools.

name: polyDB web interface
description: polyDB is a general database for discrete geometric objects. The database is accessible via web and an interface from the software package polymake. It contains various datasets from the area of lattice polytopes, combinatorial polytopes, matroids and tropical geometry.

name: Open Power System Data
description: Open Power System Data platform providing curated European power system datasets, including time series, power plants, weather, and generation capacity.

name: deadtrees.earth Tree Mortality Observatory
description: deadtrees.earth is an open global platform for mapping, analyzing, and sharing remote-sensing and citizen-science data on tree mortality. It is operated by the Chair of Sensor-based Geoinformatics at the University of Freiburg.

name: International Soil Moisture Network
description: The International Soil Moisture Network (ISMN) harmonizes in-situ soil moisture observations from global networks for satellite validation and climate research.

name: Sammlungsportal Georg-August-Universität Göttingen
description: The collections portal of the University of Göttingen documents university scientific collections, objects, and related digital records.

name: European XFEL Metadata Catalogue
description: myMdC metadata catalogue of experiments and datasets produced at the European X-Ray Free-Electron Laser.

name: Edaphobase
description: Pan-European data warehouse and query portal for soil-organism occurrence and ecological data.

name: Répertoire International des Sources Musicales
description: Répertoire International des Sources Musicales (RISM) Online is a free, searchable web service providing access to millions of records of musical sources: manuscripts, printed music, writings on music, and libretti—from libraries, archives and cultural collections around the world.

name: Corynebacterial Regulation Network
description: Corynebacterial Regulation Network a reference database and analysis platform for corynebacterial transcription factors and gene regulatory networks.

name: Open Research Data (ZALF)
description: Platform for freely accessible landscape research data, providing quality assessed data and their metadata such as context information on measurement objectives, equipment, methods, testing and investigation areas. Secures quality, integrity and long-term availability of landscape and ecosystem research data and enhances accessibility of free data from ZALF long-term monitoring campaigns, landscape laboratories, field trials and experiments.

name: SLUB Digital Collections
description: The SLUB Digital Collections are the online repository of digitized cultural and scholarly materials from the Saxon State and University Library Dresden. They include hundreds of thousands of titles, volumes, images, maps, drawings, audio files, and video clips, making historical and research-relevant materials widely accessible.

name: UrMEL
description: UrMEL is Thuringia's digital library and cultural-heritage portal, aggregating digitized manuscripts, prints, and related collections from regional libraries.

name: Risklayer Explorer
description: Risklayer Explorer is a global risk and disaster analytics platform developed by Risklayer GmbH in collaboration with the Center for Disaster Management and Risk Reduction Technology (CEDIM) at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology. It provides open access to near-real-time and historical data on natural hazards (e.g., earthquakes, tropical cyclones), climate risk indicators, and socio-environmental analytics via interactive maps and metrics. The platform integrates multiple datasets and visualizations to support research, decision-making, and public awareness of disaster risks and resilience.

name: WSI-Datenzentrum
description: The WSI Data Centre of the Institute of Economic and Social Research (Hans-Böckler-Stiftung) publishes labour-market, collective-bargaining, and social-policy indicators.

name: GIGA Research Data
description: GIGA Research Data is the data offering of the German Institute for Global and Area Studies, covering area-studies datasets and related documentation.

name: Deutsche Genbank Reben
description: The Deutsche Genbank Reben documents grapevine genetic resources held in German collections, coordinated with the Julius Kühn Institute and partner institutes.

name: PlabiPD
description: Plant Bioinformatics and Data portal collecting genome publications and genome resources for crop plants.

name: ibeetle-base
description: iBeetle-Base is a public database that provides RNAi phenotype annotations for the red flour beetle (Tribolium castaneum), based on a large-scale gene-knockdown screen. It also offers sequence data for all T. castaneum genes, links to orthologs, and images of observed phenotypes.

name: Forschungsdaten­zentrum der Bundesanstalt für Arbeitsschutz und Arbeitsmedizin
description: The Research Data Centre of BAuA (Federal Institute for Occupational Safety and Health) provides survey and research data on work, health, and occupational safety.

name: SubtiWiki
description: Collaborative resource for the Bacillus community.

name: Morph·D·Base
description: Morph·D·Base is an online platform designed to improve the quality, comparability, and transparency of morphological data in biology. The database provides a space for detailed documentation of specimens, taxonomy, literature, and media, while also enabling the creation of morphological character matrices linked with standardized metadata.

name: Forschungsdatenzentrum des Deutschen Jugendinstituts
description: The Research Data Centre of the German Youth Institute (FDZ-DJI) provides survey microdata on children, youth, family, and related DJI studies.

name: Discover
description: The Discover platform offers access to research data from projects related to LMU Munich. It provides a one-stop search entry point and enables a targeted search for relevant research data. Discover is an important resource for researchers and students, allowing them to access a wide range of data covering the broad spectrum of research at LMU Munich.

name: Medical Data Models
description: MDM-Portal (Medical Data-Models) is a meta-data registry for creating, analysing, sharing and reusing medical forms, developed by the Institute of Medical Informatics, Heidelberg University Hospital in Germany. see also https://doi.org/10.1055/s-0044-1786839 Electronic forms for documentation of patient data are an integral part within the workflow of physicians. A huge amount of data is collected either through routine documentation forms (EHRs) for electronic health records or as case report forms (CRFs) for clinical trials. This raises major scientific challenges for health care, since different health information systems are not necessarily compatible with each other and thus information exchange of structured data is hampered. Software vendors provide a variety of individual documentation forms according to their standard contracts, which function as isolated applications. Furthermore, free availability of those forms is rarely the case. Currently less than 5 % of medical forms are freely accessible. Based on this lack of transparency harmonization of data models in health care is extremely cumbersome, thus work and know-how of completed clinical trials and routine documentation in hospitals are hard to be re-used. The MDM-Portal serves as an infrastructure for academic (non-commercial) medical research to contribute a solution to this problem. It already contains more than 25,000 system-independent forms (CDISC ODM Format, www.cdisc.org, Operational Data Model) with more than 600,000 data-elements. This enables researchers to view, discuss, download and export forms in most common technical formats such as PDF, CSV, Excel, SQL, SPSS, R, etc. A growing user community will lead to a growing database of medical forms. In this matter, we would like to encourage all medical researchers to register and add forms and discuss existing forms.

name: NFDI4Ing Terminology Service
description: NFDI4Ing Terminology Service is a repository for ontologies in the broad engineering domain. It aims to serve as a central access point to the latest ontology versions. Most of the ontologies in our service are managed in various Git repositories such as GitLab or GitHub. Only a few of them are still managed on self-hosted web servers.

name: METASPACE
description: The METASPACE platform hosts an engine for metabolite annotation of imaging mass spectrometry data as well as a spatial metabolite knowledgebase of the metabolites from thousands of public datasets provided by the community. The METASPACE engine open online platform provides tools for integrated into validated workflows for clinical use exploratory analysis. Submit or interact with high-resolution imaging mass spectrometry (HR imaging MS) spatial data, explore knowledgeable annotations from all datasets using the interactive interface, collaborate with project team members on dataset annotation, or export the metabolite annotations to mine hundreds of thousands of metabolites found in community-provided datasets.

name: IMK/IAA generated MIPAS/Envisat data
description: IMK/IAA MIPAS/Envisat data at KIT are retrieved atmospheric composition products from the MIPAS instrument on ESA's Envisat satellite.

name: miRNAverse
description: miRNAverse is a manually curated registry of information about miRNA databases and other data sources. It was created to help researchers in biological and biomedical science to find and use such resources.

name: Public DGS Corpus (MeineDGS)
description: Public German Sign Language corpus with searchable transcripts and session records, harvested into CLARIN VLO via the AdWHH OAI provider.

name: A Database for Number Fields
description: The site contains a database of number fields up to degree 19 which are represented by a minimal polynomial of a primitive element. The database contains polynomials for all transitive groups up to that degree, even for most of the possible combinations of signature and Galois group. Up to degree 7, the fields with minimal (absolute) discriminant with given Galois group and signature have been included. Furthermore, the minimal fields in degree 8 have been included for all imprimitive groups and some of the primitive cases.

name: World Data Center for Climate (WDCC)
description: The WDCC archives, disseminates and publishes Earth System model data and related data products to support the international climate research community. The WDCC is a discipline specific repository providing active preservation for research only. The WDCC is certified by Core Trust Seal (CTS) and an accredited regular member of the World Data System. WDCC follows the FAIR principles - all metadata is openly accessible, the access to the data is free of charge. The WDCC is hosted by the German Climate Computing Center (DKRZ) in Hamburg.

name: zbMATH Open
description: zbMATH Open (formerly Zentralblatt MATH) is the longest-running abstracting and reviewing service in pure and applied mathematics. It indexes publications, authors, references, and mathematical software and has been freely accessible since 2021.

name: Collaborative Research Centre 806 Database
description: The Collaborative Research Centre 806 Database (CRC806-Database) serves as the central research data management infrastructure for the Collaborative Research Centre  806, providing a secure archive and publication platform for primary research data, including archaeological site records, paleoclimatic reconstructions, artifact distributions, faunal and geomagnetic datasets, spanning the dispersal of anatomically modern humans from Africa to Europe.

name: Sprachatlas Baden-Württemberg
description: The Baden-Württemberg Language Atlas (Sprachatlas) at the University of Tübingen eScience Center maps dialectal variation with georeferenced linguistic data.

name: VBASE2
description: VBASE2 is an integrative database of germ-line variable genes from the immunoglobulin loci of human and mouse. All variable gene sequences are extracted from the EMBL-Bank.

name: Inorganic Crystal Structure Database
description: ICSD (Inorganic Crystal Structure Database) was founded in 1977 on the initiative of Prof. Bergerhoff (University of Bonn). Since 1985, FIZ Karlsruhe has been involved in the production of the database with various partners; since 2017, FIZ Karlsruhe has been solely responsible for the product. ICSD is the world’s largest database for fully determined inorganic crystal structures and contains the crystallographic data of published crystalline inorganic structures, including atom coordinates, dating back to 1913. Organometallic and theoretical structures have been added within the past years.

name: Fachrepositorium Lebenswissenschaften
description: The repository provides access free of charge to scientific texts from various institutions working in the fields of medicine, health and nutritional, environmental and agricultural sciences. FRL is maintained by ZB MED - Information Centre for Life Sciences

name: Cranach Digital Archive
description: The Cranach Digital Archive documents paintings and drawings by Lucas Cranach the Elder and his workshop, with images, research texts, and related metadata.

name: Open Data LMU - Physics
description: Open Data LMU Physics is the research data repository of the LMU Munich Faculty of Physics, used to publish datasets from physics research groups.

name: Human Pluripotent Stem Cell Registry
description: The human pluripotent stem cell registry (hPSCreg) is a public registry and data portal for human embryonic and induced pluripotent stem cell lines (hESC and hiPSC). The Registry provides comprehensive and standardized biological and legal information as well as tools to search and compare information from multiple hPSC sources and hence addresses a translational research need. To facilitate unambiguous identification over different resources, hPSCreg automatically creates a unique standardized name for each cell line registered. In addition to biological information, hPSCreg stores extensive data about ethical standards regarding cell sourcing and conditions for application and privacy protection. hPSCreg is the first global registry that holds both, manually validated scientific and ethical information on hPSC lines, and provides access by means of a user-friendly, mobile-ready web application.

name: HLA Ligand Atlas
description: The HLA Ligand Atlas is a comprehensive collection of tissue and HLA allele specific HLA ligands that are naturally presented. The data was generated in standardized mass spectrometry experiments and analyzed using a well defined computational analysis workflow. We provide an easy to use query interface to quickly identify peptides of interest in the database, e.g. using sequence patterns or by specifying a tissue or HLA allele of interest. Query results can be exported and the complete HLA Ligand Atlas can be downloaded.

name: FactGrid
description: The FactGrid database is a collaborative, multilingual knowledge platform that hosts structured research data from a wide range of scholarly projects. It primarily contains biographical, historical, genealogical, and prosopographical data, as well as information on events, places, institutions, and relationships between individuals. The platform is widely used in the humanities and social sciences, particularly in history, archival studies, and digital humanities research.

name: Modular Observation Solutions for Earth Systems Data Discovery Portal
description: The Modular Observation Solutions for Earth Systems (MOSES) Data Discovery Portal was created to facilitate access to data and information obtained in MOSES campaigns. MOSES is an Earth and Environment observing system comprising highly flexible and mobile observation modules specifically designed to investigate the interactions of short-term events and long-term trends across Earth compartments. Heat waves, hydrological extremes, ocean eddies and permafrost thaw are the main focuses of this resource.

name: Coscine
description: Coscine application for research data projects, metadata, and storage, operated by the RWTH Aachen IT Center for DH.NRW universities and NFDI users. about.coscine.de is the product site and is not a second catalog.

name: Forschungsdatenzentrum des LIfBi
description: The Research Data Centre of LIfBi provides microdata of the National Educational Panel Study (NEPS) and related educational-trajectory datasets.

name: Pedestrian Dynamics Data Archive
description: The Pedestrian Dynamics Data Archive is a research data repository providing open access to experimental data on pedestrian movement, including video recordings and precise trajectory data collected under controlled conditions for use in scientific studies. These datasets support research on crowd dynamics, safety engineering, human behavior and modelling, and are available for reuse with proper attribution.

name: German Portal for Medical Research Data
description: The FDPG is the German Portal for Medical Research Data, a central online platform that allows researchers to request and access pseudonymized patient data and biosamples from routine clinical care at German university hospitals for scientific studies. It was developed as part of the Medical Informatics Initiative (MII) and harmonizes data from multiple university medical sites under common standards to support research while complying with data protection regulations.

name: Deutsches Textarchiv
description: The German Text Archive (DTA) of the Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences publishes historical German texts with linguistic annotation and TEI encoding.

name: RAKIP-Web Model Repository
description: The RAKIP-Web Model Repository at the German Federal Institute for Risk Assessment (BfR) publishes modular food-safety and microbial risk-assessment models.

name: TIB Digital Long-Term Archive
description: The TIB digital long-term archive preserves scientific and technical publications and research outputs of the German National Library of Science and Technology.

name: Determination of Ectomycorrhizae
description: DEEMY collects descriptive data on ectomycorrhizae, including extant character descriptions and definitions. Ectomycorrhizae are mutualistic structures formed by fungi and the roots of forest trees. They are predominantly found in the temperate and boreal climate zones but occur also in humid tropic regions, as well as in soils of poor nutrition. Without mycorrhizae, trees would not be able to take up water and minerals. Ectomycorrhizae show a wide range of anatomical diversity which represents their possible function in tree nutrition and ecology. Their anatomical data, in general, allow a quick determination and provide at the same time ecologically important information about possible functions for tree nutrition.

name: Collections-Online - Sammlungsportal der Staatlichen Museen zu Berlin
description: SMB Collections Online is the object catalogue of the Staatliche Museen zu Berlin, with records and images from the Berlin State Museums.

name: FACHPORTAL pädagogik
description: The German Education Portal is the central access point to scientific information for educational research, educational science and subject didactics. By offering this information service free of charge, the German Education Portal supports the Open Access principle, i.e. open access to scientific sources. At its heart, the service focuses on indexes of literature, research sources and structured information on different educational science and educational research aspects.

name: ConsensusPathDB
description: ConsensusPathDB-human integrates interaction networks in Homo sapiens including binary and complex protein-protein, genetic, metabolic, signaling, gene regulatory and drug-target interactions, as well as biochemical pathways. Data originate from currently 31 public resources for interactions and interactions that we have curated from the literature. The interaction data are integrated in a complementary manner (avoiding redundancies), resulting in a seamless interaction network containing different types of interactions.

name: BonaRes Repository
description: The BonaRes Repository stores soil and agricultural research data from research projects and long-term field experiments which contribute significantly to the analysis of changes of soil and soil functions over the long term. Research data are described by the metadata following the BonaRes Metadata Schema (DOI: 10.20387/bonares-5pgg-8yrp) which combines international recognized standards for the description of geospatial data and research data. Metadata includes AGROVOC keywords.

name: ISIMIP Repository
description: ISIMIP repository for climate impact simulation input, output, and derived datasets across multiple model sectors and simulation rounds.

name: Tilings Encyclopedia
description: The Tilings Encyclopedia provides extensive examples of nonperiodic substitution tilings.

name: PTMcode
description: PTMCode is a resource of known and predicted functional associations between protein post-translational modifications (PTMs) within and between interacting proteins.

name: coastMap
description: coastMap is a collection of data based on the observations of the seafloor and water conditions and atmosphere of mainly the North Sea. This information can be used for analysis and modelling by researchers.

name: Kiezdeutschkorpus KiDKo
description: KiDKo (Kiezdeutschkorpus) is a corpus of informal youth language from multilingual urban neighbourhoods, documented at Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin.

name: KASCADE Cosmic Ray Data Centre
description: KCDC is a public data centre created to share the data from the KASCADE and KASCADE‑Grande cosmic-ray experiments. It provides open access to hundreds of millions of recorded “air-shower” events, allowing both scientists and non-experts to explore high-energy astroparticle physics data. KCDC offers not only raw and reconstructed data, but also metadata, documentation, and tools (including example analyses) to help users understand and reuse the data meaningfully.

name: Digital Collections ULB Düsseldorf
description: Digital Collections of ULB Düsseldorf (Heinrich Heine University) offer digitized books, manuscripts, and scholarly materials from the university library.

name: Eurac Research - openEO - backend
description: The Eurac Research backend provides Earth Observation (EO) data available for processing using OGC WC(P)S and the open data cube.

name: DSMZCellDive
description:
DSMZCellDive was created to enable decision-making on the best cell model for research questions by provision of curated data. Originally set up for visualising gene expression data of DSMZ cell lines, DSMZCellDive now harbours Short tandem repeat (STR) for cell line authentication, Cyctochrome c oxidase (COI), and Human leukocyte antigen (HLA) data. With this dataset, customers are able to retrieve the optimal model cell line for their needs and gain information on these.
Currently, gene expression profiles can be obtained for 157 DSMZ human cell lines, 4629 short tandem repeat (STR) reference data sets , 960 short DSMZ cell line descriptions, and 164 human leukocyte antigen (HLA) data. Tumour types include leukemia and lymphoma tumour subtypes, breast cancer, retinoblastoma, and neuroblastoma tumour entities. STR profiles can be mapped, top10 expressing cell lines for genes are displayed, and enzyme connections to the BRENDA database are given.

name: GlycomeDB
description: GlycomeDB is the result of a systematic data integration effort, and provides an overview of all carbohydrate structures available in public databases, as well as cross-links.

name: Side Effect Resource
description: SIDER contains information on marketed medicines and their recorded adverse drug reactions. The information is extracted from public documents and package inserts. The available information include side effect frequency, drug and side effect classifications as well as links to further information, for example drug_target relations.

name: Civil Aircraft for the Regular Investigation of the atmosphere Based on an Instrument Container
description: This resource collects data on the composition of the atmosphere using passenger jet airliners. This information supports scientific research on changes in the atmosphere and particle composition. Data is available after registration.

name: RESPECT
description: The RESPECT database is part of a research platform developed within a scientific project studying environmental change in tropical ecosystems, particularly in South Ecuador. It provides access to datasets related to biodiversity, climate, soil properties, and ecosystem processes collected through field observations and monitoring systems. The database supports interdisciplinary research on how environmental changes affect ecosystem functions and feedback mechanisms in biodiversity hotspots. Overall, it serves as a repository for sharing and reusing ecological and environmental data generated by the RESPECT research unit.

name: InfraNode
description: InfraNode is a free, keyless REST API (and MCP server) that normalises open public data for German cities behind one consistent interface. It aggregates official open sources (DWD weather, UBA air quality, Bundesnetzagentur, SMARD electricity market, BORIS land values, Destatis regional statistics, DELFI/GTFS public transit, BKG and others) into a uniform JSON envelope per city, with per-field source, license and required attribution. Open source (Apache-2.0), no API key or signup. A reproducible open-data snapshot is archived on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20752355).

name: Pharmacokinetics Database
description: PK-DB an open database for pharmacokinetics information from clinical trials as well as pre-clinical research. The focus of PK-DB is to provide high-quality pharmacokinetics data enriched with the required meta-information for computational modeling and data integration.

name: Beilstein Archives
description: This repository is currently limited to preprints related to the Beilstein Journal of Nanotechnology and the Beilstein Journal of Organic Chemistry. All preprints are posted with a CC-BY 4.0 license.

name: QED - Quellen und Editionen - Max Weber Stiftung
description: QED (Quellen und Editionen) on perspectivia.net publishes digital source editions of the Max Weber Foundation's humanities institutes.

name: The Multiply Perfect Numbers Page
description: The Multiply Perfect Numbers Page is an archive of more than five thousand multiply perfect numbers. The archive gives the logarithm of the logarithm, the number of distinct prime factors, the number of consecutive small factors, the exponents of the primes, etc. (in short, enough information to construct the base representation of a desired multiply perfect number) plus historical information such as the name of the discoverer and the date of discovery.

name: Database: Unit Groups of Orders
description: The database contains generators and presentations of the unit groups of certain orders in various types of simple rational algebras of small degree.

name: HALO Database
description: HALO is a Gulfstream G-550 aircraft specifically equipped with numerous in situ and remote sensing instruments. It allows to study important scientific questions with regard to atmospheric chemistry, atmospheric physics, climate research, satellite validations, and Earth system observations. It enables the university-based atmospheric and Earth system research community in Germany in partnership with colleagues from the national research centers to perform state-of-the-art science utilizing HALO as a unique infrastructure.

name: Research Platform for Jewish Epigraphy
description: Epidat - The Database of Jewish epigraphy - provides the inventory, documentation, editions and presentation of epigraphical collections.

name: Information System Ecotoxicology and Environmental Quality Targets
description: The ETOX pages as a module of ChemInfo enable targeted research on data related to aquatic and terrestrial ecotoxicology (tests) as well as information on national and international quality criteria, standards, and objectives. The focus is on substances that are relevant for the development of environmental quality standards under the Water Framework Directive 60/2000/EC, or that enable the assessment of measured substance concentrations in soils, biota, and waters.

name: IOWDB
description: IOWDB / ODIN is the oceanographic data portal of the Leibniz Institute for Baltic Sea Research (IOW), publishing marine observations from the Baltic Sea.

name: ZUdoc Zeppelin University Research Documentation System and Repository
description: ZUdoc is Zeppelin University's research documentation system and repository for publications and research information of the university.

name: COVID19-NMR
description: The COVID-19 NMR Repository aims to make as many viral RNA and proteins as possible available for NMR work and screen them using a fragment library. Originally, the goal of the project was to determine RNA and protein structures of SARS-CoV-2 and to investigate the drugability of those structures by small molecules. As the initial work has been completed, they continue to investigate viral research via NMR and beyond.

name: Regular Graphs
description: The tables in Regular Graphs contain numbers of simple connected k-regular graphs on n vertices and girth at least g with given parameters n,k,g. If a number in the table is a link, then further information about the graphs (such as adjacency lists or shortcode files) is available. Most of the numbers were obtained by the computer program GENREG which not only computes the number of regular graphs for the chosen parameters but also constructs the desired graphs.

name: StrainInfo
description: In microbiology, the communication and comparison of research findings and data is often complicated by the existence of a number of different designation and identifiers for the same strain. StrainInfo is a service developed to provide a resolution of microbial strain identifiers by storing culture collection numbers, their relations, and culture-associated data.

name: Golm Metabolome Database
description: GC-MS reference library and metabolome database from the Max Planck Institute of Molecular Plant Physiology.

name: CrossAsia Open Access Repository
description: The CrossAsia Open Access Repository is a digital platform of the Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin that promotes open access in Asian Studies. It stores and provides access to academic publications, research data, theses, reports, and other scholarly materials related to Asia. It supports long-term preservation and open sharing of digital research outputs, serving scholars in the humanities and social sciences with a focus on Asian regions.

name: Leibniz Data Manager
description: The Leibniz Data Manager (LDM) is an open research data repository and management system hosted by the Technische Informationsbibliothek (TIB) that helps researchers publish, search, and explore scientific datasets across disciplines.

name: webKnossos
description: webKnossos is an open-source data sharing and annotation platform for multi-terabyte 2D and 3D electron-microscopy (EM) and light-microscopy (LM) datasets. Core features are fast 3D data streaming, link-sharing to specific locations in the data, and collaborative annotation features (volume labelling, line-segment annotation and more). Users may browse and view publicly-available data, while registered users can search, download and analyze database content.

name: Comprehensive Resource of Mammalian protein complexes
description: CORUM is a database that provides a manually curated repository of experimentally characterized protein complexes from mammalian organisms, mainly human (64%), mouse (16%) and rat (12%). Each protein complex is described by a protein complex name, subunit composition, function as well as the literature reference that characterizes the respective protein complex.

name: Oral-History.Digital interview portal
description: CLARIN C-centre catalog of scholarly audiovisual oral-history interview collections, curated at Freie Universität Berlin.

name: Archiving BASIS
description: GESIS Sharing / SowiDataNet|datorium is a self-deposit repository for social science research data, operated by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences.

name: vegetweb
description: vegetweb is the information system of the German Vegetation Reference Database, providing phytosociological plot data and related vegetation-science resources.

name: European Vitis Database
description: The European Vitis Database catalogues grapevine genetic resources (cultivars, accessions, and characterization data) coordinated by the Julius Kühn Institute.

name: TOAR Database
description: The TOAR (Tropospheric Ozone Assessment Report) Database is an international effort to collect, harmonize, and provide access to long-term surface ozone observations as well as related data.

name: The ROSAT Mission
description: The ROSAT mission archive at MPE Garching provides X-ray catalogues, images, and related high-energy astrophysics data from the ROSAT satellite.

name: Packomania
description: Packomania is divided into these sections: Section 1: Packings of equal and unequal circles in fixed-sized containers with maximum packing density; Section 2: Packings of equal and unequal circles in variable-sized containers with maximum packing density; Section 3: Packings of equal spheres in fixed-sized containers with maximum packing density; and Section 4: Literature.

name: IODP Bremen Core Repository
description: The IODP Bremen Core Repository at MARUM stores and provides access to marine sediment cores from International Ocean Discovery Program expeditions.

name: Research Data Centre of the Federal Institute for Vocational Education and Training
description: The Research Data Centre of the Federal Institute for Vocational Education and Training (BIBB-FDZ) processes the microdata from BIBB research projects and makes them available for non-commercial research.

name: Flora von Frankfurt am Main
description: Flora of Frankfurt am Main is a Senckenberg occurrence database of plant records for the Frankfurt region, with maps and species documentation.

name: COCONUT
description: Collection of Open Natural Products: aggregated open natural-product structure database.

name: FAIRequest - transfer unit for data and biomaterials
description: FAIRequest is the transfer unit of the SHIP / University Medicine Greifswald studies, handling applications for data and biomaterial for health research.

name: Information System on Graph Classes and their Inclusions
description: ISGCI is an encyclopaedia of graphclasses with an accompanying java application that aids research about particular graph classes. Researchers can: check the relation between graph classes and get a witness for the result; draw clear inclusion diagrams; colour these diagrams according to the complexity of selected problems; find the P/NP boundary for a problem; save diagrams as Postscript, GraphML or SVG files; and find references on classes, inclusions and algorithms.

name: MediaDive
description: Cultivation media are a substantial part of many fields of life sciences and are key for successful cultivation and therefore achieving a deeper understanding of microorganisms. Despite their fundamental importance, cultivation media as data resource are mostly neglected, especially in terms of standardization and availability. We present MediaDive (https://mediadive.dsmz.de), a comprehensive and expert-curated cultivation media database, which comprises recipes, instructions and molecular compositions of almost 3,200 standardized cultivation media for more than 40,000 microbial strains from all domains of life.
