MediaDive is designed to enable broad range applications from every-day-use in research and diagnostic laboratories to knowledge-driven support of new media design and artificial intelligence-driven data mining. A number of intuitive search and comparison tools is fostering these approaches. External user engagement is covered by a dedicated media builder tool.

name: The Plastics-Active Enzymes Database
description: The PAZy database (Plastics-Active Enzymes Database) is an open repository of biochemically characterized enzymes that can act on and degrade synthetic plastics. It focuses only on experimentally verified plastic-active enzymes, excluding predicted or unverified ones, to support reliable research into plastic biodegradation.

name: MO|RE data
description: MO|RE data is a discipline-specific research data repository focused on motor performance and sports science data, especially results from standardized motor tests used in research. It provides an e-research infrastructure where researchers and practitioners can upload, search, and reuse motor test datasets, which are quality-checked and permanently archived.

name: FunTree: A Resource For Exploring The Functional Evolution Of Structurally Defined Enzyme Superfamilies
description: A resource for exploring the evolution of protein function through relationships in sequence, structure, phylogeny and function.

name: BRENDA
description: Comprehensive enzyme information system including ligands, reactions, and kinetic data.

name: TAMBORA
description:
tambora.org - the climate and environmental history collaborative research environment

tambora.org supports collaborative work in Historical Climatology. One major goal of this research field is to reconstruct climatic trends from all man-made sources.

name: The human DEPhOsphorylation Database
description: DEPOD - the human DEPhOsphorylation Database is a manually curated database collecting human active and inactive phosphatases, their experimentally verified protein and non-protein substrates, and dephosphorylation site information, and pathways in which they are involved. It also provides links to popular kinase databases and protein-protein interaction databases for these phosphatases and substrates.

name: Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (ARS)
description: ARS (Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance) of the Robert Koch Institute collects routine laboratory data on antibiotic resistance of bacterial pathogens in Germany.

name: PhageDive
description: PhageDive is a specific database for bacteriophages and archaeal viruses. Built on the BacDive model, it gathers and links all the experimental data and metadata of the viruses present in different culture collections. Its implementation aims to facilitate access to all viruses information for the scientific community. The database covers taxonomy, host strain, phage morphology, life cycle, origin and genomic data.

name: Badische Landesbibliothek Digital Collections
description: In the digital collections of the Badische Landesbibliothek we offer you free access to the digitised works from our collections. We are continuously increasing the number of books and manuscripts available online. Use the search function to search the titles and structural data of the works already included, or browse the collections on the left. Special highlights from our collections and current projects can be found on the main page.

name: EUROLAS Data Center
description: The EUROLAS Data Center (EDC) is one of the two data centers of the International Laser Ranging Service (ILRS). It collects, archives and distributes tracking data, predictions and other tracking relevant information from the Consortium of European Satellite Laser Ranging (SLR) network. Additionally EDC holds a mirror of the official Web-Pages of the ILRS at Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC).

name: Historical Time Series
description: Histat is an online database of historical time series maintained by Leibniz Institute SAFE providing data from economic, social, and historical science research, particularly focused on Germany’s past.

name: MDZ Digital Collections
description: The Munich Digitization Center (MDZ) has been bringing the rich holdings of the Bavarian State Library (BSB) online since 1997. The Digital Collections include digitized manuscripts, prints, music, maps, photographs, newspapers and magazines.

name: GFZ Data Services
description: GFZ Data Services metadata portal. Citable geoscience datasets from GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences, with DOI landing pages and discovery search.

name: PolMine
description: PolMine publishes corpora and tools for the computational analysis of political texts, including parliamentary proceedings, developed at the NRW School of Governance.

name: Datenrechercheportal UFZ
description: The UFZ Data Research Portal (DRP) is the institutional catalogue for research datasets of the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research.

name: PRODORIC
description: PRODORIC is a comprehensive database about gene regulation and gene expression in prokaryotes. It includes a manually curated and unique collection of transcription factor binding sites, along with a variety of bioinformatics tools for the prediction, analysis and visualization of regulons and gene reglulatory networks.

name: PAINT
description: FAIR database of concentrating solar power plant operational data, including calibration images, deflectometry, kinematics, and weather observations published as STAC metadata.

name: Theater und Musik in Weimar 1754 - 1990
description: Theater und Musik in Weimar 1754–1990 is a digital collection of Weimar playbills and related performing-arts sources, based at Friedrich Schiller University Jena.

name: JenAge Ageing Factor Database
description: JenAge Ageing Factor Database (AgeFactDB) compiles genes, chemical compounds, and other factors linked to ageing and lifespan from model-organism and human studies.

name: Sistema Estadístico Nacional de Honduras
description: Web platform of Honduras's National Statistical System (SEN). Inventory of official statistical operations produced by INE and other state institutions.

name: SEFIN EDCA
description: Open Contracting (EDCA/OCDS) publication page of Honduras's Ministry of Finance. Offers SIAFI-linked contracting processes with bulk downloads. A developer API is mentioned on the page but no stable harvest URL was confirmed.

name: ONCAE Datos Abiertos
description: Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) publication of Honduras's public procurement agency. Bulk JSON, CSV, and Excel downloads from HonduCompras, the electronic catalog, and the direct-contract module.

name: Datos Abiertos SEFIN
description: Open-data catalog of Honduras's Ministry of Finance. Publishes public-investment execution tables by department and related fiscal datasets as downloadable files, separate from the SEFIN contracting publication (EDCA).

name: Agua de Honduras
description: Agua de Honduras is a SERNA/CIAT water-planning platform with hydrographic delimitations, climate, soils, land cover, water demand and quality, floods, and hydrology. The former ArcGIS REST services directory on this host is gone; the live site is a custom catalog and decision-support tools at /catalogoinformacion.

name: Azerbaijan National SDG Information Portal
description: National Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) information portal of Azerbaijan (DİM), operated by the State Statistical Committee. Publishes goal-level statistics, a statistical database, reporting status, national reports, and search across producing agencies, in Azerbaijani and English.

name: CBAR Interactive Statistical Database
description: Public interactive statistical database of the Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan (CBAR). Covers macroeconomic, monetary, financial-sector, payments, and external-sector indicators in Azerbaijani and English.

name: Ministry of Ecology and Natural Resources Open Data
description: Open data section of the Ministry of Ecology and Natural Resources e-services portal. Lists geographic datasets (administrative units, mountains, national parks, lakes, rivers, railways, places) and ministry statistics; the dataset records are also published on the national open data portal.

name: ARXKOM Interactive Urban Planning Map
description: Nationwide interactive collection of regional and municipal master plans and detailed urban-planning maps.

name: Enterprise Azerbaijan Geo-Economic Map
description: Interactive thematic map of transport, investment, natural resources, energy, services, infrastructure, and regional economic assets.

name: Siem Reap Smart City Data Platform
description: Siem Reap Smart City Data Platform (SSDaP), developed under the JICA Siem Reap Smart City Project. Centralizes and visualizes city data in real time for evidence-based policymaking, transparency and community access to public information, covering themes such as traffic, waste management and urban services.

name: NIPH Data Sharing Platform
description: Public catalog of survey and research datasets from the National Institute of Public Health (STEPS, WHS+, diabetes/hypertension, and health-workforce studies). Metadata is listed without login; file access requires a registered request.

name: NIS Open Health Platform
description: NIS Open Health platform listed alongside CamStat, the microdata catalog, and Open SDG in National Institute of Statistics dissemination materials. Intended public health-indicator catalog at healthdata.nis.gov.kh. TLS handshake to the host timed out in August 2026.

name: TRC Telecom Statistics
description: Telecom statistics published by the Telecommunication Regulator of Cambodia. Periodic figures on mobile and fixed telephone subscribers, mobile and fixed internet subscriptions, penetration rates, operator and ISP licence counts and network coverage.

name: CAMAGRIMARKET
description: Public agricultural market information system (CAMAGRIMARKET) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries. Guest JSON endpoints list commodity categories, market products, and latest farmgate prices in KHR; posting offers requires a user account.

name: Cambodia Malaria Information System Dashboard
description: Public dashboard of Cambodia's Malaria Information System (MIS), run by the National Center for Parasitology, Entomology and Malaria Control. Real-time surveillance with national and provincial trends, monthly cases by species, operational-district and village maps, case classifications, incidence indicators, reporting timeliness, stocks and hotspots.

name: Cambodia Education Management Information System (EMIS)
description: Public Education Management Information System of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport, with school mapping, school report cards, WASH reports, and downloadable annual education statistics and indicators.

name: Cambodia Disaster Damage and Loss Information System (CamDi)
description: Cambodia Disaster Damage and Loss Information System (CamDi), the DesInventar-based disaster loss database of the National Committee for Disaster Management. The Cambodia_Sendai database covers 1996-2023 with over 12,500 records queryable by hazard, province, district and commune, including deaths, injuries, housing, crop and infrastructure damage and economic losses.

name: GDCE Customs Statistics
description: Official customs statistics database of the General Department of Customs and Excise of Cambodia. Publishes five-year totals of trade volume, exports, imports, balance and coverage with downloadable periodic releases, metadata, glossary and reference tables.

name: Cambodia Natural Rubber Prices and Statistics
description: Public rubber market information pages of MAFF's General Directorate of Rubber, with guest-queryable farmgate, provincial, international, and futures natural-rubber prices (date filters from 2020) and downloadable statistics tables.

name: Cambodia Securities Exchange Market Data
description: Market data portal of the Cambodia Securities Exchange. Daily and historical trade summaries for Main Board and Growth Board stocks, CSX index data with open, high, low, close, volume, value and market capitalization, plus daily KHR/USD exchange rate.

name: Cambodia NDC Tracking
description: Public NDC tracking dashboard of the National Council for Sustainable Development. Lists Cambodia's Nationally Determined Contribution mitigation, adaptation, and enabling actions with annual implementation progress, budgets, and responsible agencies. Separate from the NCSD climate change data portal on the same host.

name: EAC Annual Report on Power Sector
description: Annual Report on Power Sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia published by the Electricity Authority of Cambodia (2003-present), with Salient Features data series on generation capacity, energy delivered, transmission, consumers, tariffs, licenses and village electrification.

name: IDPoor Public Data Query
description: Public IDPoor query dashboards of the Ministry of Planning, with guest access to aggregate household and individual poverty statistics, charts, and a provincial map. Detailed household extracts require a registered data user.

name: Cambodia Tourism Statistics
description: Tourism statistics page of the Ministry of Tourism of Cambodia. Publishes monthly and annual Cambodia Tourism Statistics reports (PDF) covering international tourist arrivals, outbound tourism, tourism receipts, average length of stay and hotel occupancy.

name: Data for Economic and Finance (Data EF)
description: Official open data portal of Cambodia's Ministry of Economy and Finance (Data EF / Data for Economic and Finance). Publishes public datasets on public finance, macroeconomics, financial markets, trade, and related economic statistics, with download and REST API access.

name: Cambodia Urban Database
description: Cambodia Urban Database of the Center for Khmer Studies (CKS). Public repository of reports, journal articles, quantitative datasets, master plans, maps, and images on urbanization in Cambodia, funded by the Australian Government through The Asia Foundation’s Ponlok Chomnes Program.

name: Cambodia ODA Database
description: Guest-accessible Official Development Assistance database of the Council for the Development of Cambodia, with a public project list, donor/sector/province reports, and custom queries of ODA commitments and disbursements.

name: NCDD Cambodia Gazetteer
description: Public database hub of the National Committee for Sub-National Democratic Development (NCDD). The live Gazetteer Database Online lists official codes and names of Cambodia's provinces, districts, communes, and villages; other NCDD applications on the same hub require login.

name: Cambodia Vulnerability Mapping
description: Public Leaflet map of multidimensional poverty and vulnerability for Cambodia, published by the National Institute of Statistics with UNDP support. Uses open geospatial inputs and Google Earth Engine. The site describes results as an exploratory AI study, not official NIS statistics.

name: Agricultural Cooperatives Map (AC Maps)
description: MAFF interactive map and filterable directory of about 1,266 agricultural communities and cooperatives across Cambodia, with Khmer and English interfaces.

name: Cambodia Environmental Management Information System (CEMIS)
description: Cambodia Environmental Management Information System (CEMIS) of the Ministry of Environment. Documented as a central spatial data platform for protected-area and environmental layers under the Cambodia Sustainable Landscape and Ecotourism Project (World Bank). TLS handshake to cemis.moe.gov.kh timed out in August 2026.

name: Cambodian National Forest Monitoring System
description: Public OpenLayers geo-portal of Cambodia's National Forest Monitoring System (NFMS / REDD+), operated by the Ministry of Environment Carbon Crediting Secretariat. Layer groups include administrative boundaries, waterbodies, and other WMS layers. Same-origin GeoServer at /geoserver returned HTTP 502 when probed in August 2026; the map UI itself is live.

name: Cambodia Mekong Delta Digital Atlas (CAM-MeDiA)
description: Public Shiny/Leaflet Cambodia Mekong Delta Digital Atlas (CAM-MeDiA) with a named data catalogue of administrative, water, agriculture, infrastructure, fisheries, socio-economic, and climate layers for national and subnational planning. Built for the Royal Government of Cambodia and hosted by ICEM.

name: Cambodia Biophysical M&E Dashboard (SERVIR Southeast Asia)
description: SERVIR Southeast Asia Biophysical M&E Dashboard for Cambodia, run by ADPC with USAID. Monitors landscape-scale biodiversity and conservation interventions with map layers and downloadable analysis of biophysical conditions and forest change.

name: Cambodia National Flood Forecasting Center
description: Public hydromet station, rainfall, flood-extent, and drought map portal of the National Flood Forecasting Center under the Department of Hydrology and River Works (Ministry of Water Resources and Meteorology). Station pages and flood maps are guest-accessible; staff login is separate.

name: RUPP iHub
description: iHub, the academic repository of the Faculty of Engineering of the Royal University of Phnom Penh. Collects approved research papers, dissertations and conference papers from RUPP and other Cambodian universities.

name: Computational Materials Repository
description: Collection of computational materials databases hosted by DTU Physics / CAMD.

name: Lolland Kommune BorgerGIS
description: Public BorgerGIS webkort of Lolland Municipality, providing municipal geographic themes and local map layers.

name: Medstat
description: Public statistics on medicinal product consumption in Denmark, published by the Danish Health Data Authority.

name: SSI Overvågning i tal, grafer og kort
description: Public infectious-disease surveillance dashboards of Statens Serum Institut: notifiable diseases, laboratory reports, vaccination coverage, and related graphs and maps.

name: DOFbasen Statistik
description: Public bird-observation statistics from DOFbasen: counts by year, species, and municipality, phenology graphs, and locality richness tables.

name: Sundhedsdatabank
description: Public health statistics catalog of the Danish Health Data Authority. Successor to eSundhed, it publishes aggregated indicators on contacts with the health system, disease, treatment, and related registers.

name: Retsinformation
description: Official Danish legal information system, including Lovtidende and consolidated legislation.

name: Folketingets Åbne Data
description: Open data from the Danish Parliament (Folketinget), including cases, documents, members, meetings, and debate transcripts, published through a public OData API.

name: Energi Data Service
description: Free open data portal from Energinet with electricity and gas system datasets, including production, consumption, prices, balancing markets, CO2 emissions, and gas flows. Data can be searched, downloaded as CSV, JSON, or Excel, and retrieved through a public REST API.

name: Dataudveksleren
description: Denmark's National Access Point (NAP) for mobility, traffic, and road datasets, operated by the Danish Road Directorate. The catalog publishes metadata and access to DATEX II feeds, geospatial services, and files required under the EU ITS Directive, plus additional public Danish road data from government and private providers.

name: GeoFA
description: GeoFA is the national collection of municipal geographic subject data (paths, outdoor facilities, school districts, and related themes) published with a common data model for reuse across Danish municipalities.

name: Vandplandata
description: Danish river-basin planning catalog. Public Water Framework Directive data on water bodies, status and measures.

name: Danish Marine Spatial Data Infrastructure
description: National Marine Spatial Data Infrastructure portal of the Danish Geodata Agency, including Det Marine Danmarkskort and a public inventory of marine geodata (coast, depth, habitats, energy, fisheries and maritime limits).

name: Satlas
description: Provides easy access to a range of raw and derived satellite-based products for monitoring current, short-, and long-term conditions.

name: Dataforsyningen
description: National geospatial data supply of the Danish Agency for Climate Data (Klimadatastyrelsen). Provides access to more than 100 geographic datasets as maps, downloads, web applications, and OGC web services (WMS, WMTS, WFS, WCS), including base maps, height models, addresses, and climate-related products.

name: GEUS EGDI Geoportal
description: Data catalog providing access to geological, geophysical, groundwater, environmental, and geotechnical data from Denmark and Greenland.

name: Datafordeler
description: National distribution platform for Danish basic public data (grunddata), covering persons, real estate, businesses, water and climate, maps, and addresses. Data is available via GraphQL, REST, OGC geoservices, and file download after registration. Open grunddata is licensed CC BY 4.0; some registers such as CPR require additional access agreements.

name: International Council for the Exploration of the Sea Data Portal
description: Public data portal of the International Council for the Exploration of the Sea, cataloguing fisheries, oceanographic, and marine ecosystem datasets from ICES coordinated surveys and member contributions.

name: Systema Dipterorum
description: The Systema Dipterorum database is a comprehensive online taxonomic resource for the insect order Diptera (flies and midges). It provides names, classification information, and reference data for species and higher taxa around the world, helping researchers check valid names and taxonomic details.

name: Rigsarkivets Digital Data
description: Search portal for digital archival datasets of Rigsarkivet (the Danish National Archives), including digitized records and research data listings.

name: antiSMASH database
description: The antiSMASH database is a knowledgebase that contains precomputed results from the antiSMASH tool for a number of microbial organisms. It provides search functionalities as well as access to antiSMASH’s ClusterBlast functionality, and any ClusterBlast hit is cross-referenced to the database, as well as to similar clusters from the MIBiG database.

name: MiDAS Field Guide
description: Microbial Database for Activated Sludge (MiDAS) is a central resource for information about the microbes in the engineered ecosystem of activated sludge, anaerobic digesters, and related wastewater treatment systems, such as biofilms, granules and membrane-bioreactors.

name: BloodSpot
description: BloodSpot is a database of mRNA expression in healthy and malignant haematopoiesis and includes data from both humans and mice. The core function of BloodSpot is to provide an expression plot of genes in healthy and cancerous haematopoietic cells at specific differentiation stages. In addition to the default plot, that displays an integrated expression plot, two additional levels of visualization are available; an interactive tree showing the hierarchical relationship between the samples, and a Kaplan-Meier survival plot. Prior to BloodSpot, this service was provided by an earlier project, HemaExplorer, also by the same research group. HemaExplorer was updated to the BloodSpot platform, which all users are encouraged to use instead.

name: Danish (Q)SAR Database
description: The Danish (Q)SAR Database of DTU National Food Institute publishes predictions from (quantitative) structure–activity relationship models for chemical substances, covering toxicological and environmental endpoints used in chemical risk assessment.

name: Arter
description: National portal for recording and exploring Danish species observations. Arter gathers biodiversity finds from public and citizen-science sources and makes them searchable for the public, researchers, and nature managers.

name: ICES Oceanography
description: ICES oceanographic data catalog for CTD, bottle and related hydrographic profiles from the North Atlantic and adjacent seas.

name: Search Tool for Interactions of Chemicals
description: STITCH is a resource to explore known and predicted interactions of chemicals and proteins. Chemicals are linked to other chemicals and proteins by evidence derived from experiments, databases and the literature.

name: World Data Centre for Geomagnetism, Copenhagen
description: The World Data Centre for Geomagnetism, Copenhagen, at DTU Space archives analogue magnetograms and distributes geomagnetic observatory data, including the Polar Cap (PCN) index and related models. Data files are also available from the WDC FTP archive.

name: Greenland Ecosystem Monitoring Data Portal
description: Data portal of Greenland Ecosystem Monitoring (GEM), an integrated long-term research programme on Arctic ecosystems and climate change effects and feedbacks since 1995.

name: Minimum Information about a Biosynthetic Gene Cluster Repository
description: The MIBiG (Minimum Information about a Biosynthetic Gene Cluster) Repository stores Biosynthetic Gene Clusters (BGC) that are manually curated through community efforts. It is a central reference database for BGCs of known function, and provides the basis for comparative analyses for a number of tools. It has enabled many computational analyses of BGC function and novelty central to both small and large-scale studies of microbes and microbial communities.

name: ScienceData
description: Research data storage and sharing platform operated for Danish universities, providing public and restricted access to scientific datasets.

name: Danish National Birth Cohort
description: The Danish National Birth Cohort is a large, longitudinal research database that follows about 100,000 Danish pregnancies from early gestation through childhood and beyond to study how early-life exposures affect later health outcomes. It combines prospectively collected interviews, questionnaires, biological samples, and links to national health registries to enable life-course epidemiological research.

name: ICES DATRAS
description: Database of Trawl Surveys (DATRAS) catalog of ICES coordinated fisheries-independent bottom-trawl and related survey datasets.

name: CEPERJ Dados
description: CEPERJ Dados table explorer of socioeconomic, demographic, and environmental series for Rio de Janeiro state, municipalities, and government regions, with HTML and CSV downloads. Distinct from SES-RJ TabNet.

name: SIGA Angra dos Reis
description: Municipal GIS catalog of Angra dos Reis (SIGA), listed as an own-host node in the INDE geoservices directory.

name: Geoportal INEA
description: Environmental geoportal of the Instituto Estadual do Ambiente (INEA) of Rio de Janeiro. INEA OGC layers are also published as a workspace on the shared INDE GeoServer.

name: IPECEDATA
description: IPECE geosocioeconomic indicator system for Ceará, with municipal and planning-region series and historical downloads.

name: IJSN Painéis Interativos
description: IJSN interactive indicator dashboards for Espírito Santo, covering economic conjuncture, municipal GDP, SDG indicators, poverty, and related themes. Distinct from SES-ES TabNet and the dados.es.gov.br CKAN portal.

name: InfoVis Bahia
description: InfoVis Bahia visualization platform of SEI, with socioeconomic indicators and dashboards for Bahia. Distinct from IBGE SIDRA.

name: Geoportal IDE Bahia
description: Public geoportal of Bahia's state spatial data infrastructure (IDE-BA), for discovery and visualization of state geospatial data.

name: Anuário Estatístico do Pará
description: Anuário Estatístico do Pará 2024, FAPESPA web yearbook of demographic, social, economic, infrastructure, and environmental indicators with thematic maps and downloadable spreadsheets.

name: Dados Abertos do Paraná (IPARDES BDEweb)
description: Paraná open-data landing page for IPARDES BDEweb, the state statistical database of physical, economic, social, and administrative indicators for all 399 municipalities.

name: Dados Abertos de Curitiba
description: Municipal open data portal of Curitiba, publishing government documents and datasets for public reuse.

name: Observatório SEPOG Rondônia
description: Observatório SEPOG public panorama of socioeconomic indicators for Rondônia and its municipalities, including a Power BI panorama and state statistical profile. Distinct from AGEVISA TabNet.

name: Perfil Municipal RS
description: Perfil Municipal RS public municipal indicator profiles (Idese, GDP, education, health, sanitation, and security) maintained by DEE/SPGG. Distinct from the DataRS table warehouse and the Dados RS CKAN portal.

name: DataRS
description: DataRS socioeconomic repository of the Rio Grande do Sul Department of Economics and Statistics, with table, map, and chart queries for more than 2,300 variables by municipality and planning region. Distinct from the Dados RS CKAN portal.

name: Geoportal de Gramado
description: Municipal geoportal of Gramado, Rio Grande do Sul, built with GeoBuilder and OpenLayers for the city spatial data infrastructure.

name: IMRS Fundação João Pinheiro
description: Índice Mineiro de Responsabilidade Social (IMRS) municipal indicator database of the Fundação João Pinheiro, with tables, profiles, and maps for Minas Gerais municipalities. Distinct from DataViva.

name: PortalGeo Alfenas
description: Municipal PortalGeo of Alfenas, with public thematic maps of lots, streets, urban perimeter, rural areas, and environmental layers.

name: Geoweb Betim
description: Municipal Geoweb of Betim, with public thematic maps for zoning, cadastral plants, streets, health territories, and urban parameters.

name: Geoportal IDE-Sisema
description: Public map viewer of IDE-Sisema, the spatial data infrastructure of Minas Gerais' environment and water-resources system. Companion to the Sisema GeoNetwork catalog and GeoServer.

name: IBGE Microdata FTP
description: IBGE public FTP archive of statistical microdata, including Census and PNAD Contínua files with documentation. Complements SIDRA aggregated tables.

name: SICONFI
description: Public SICONFI consultation of Brazilian subnational accounting and fiscal statistics (FINBRA and related reports). Distinct from Tesouro Transparente CKAN open data.

name: CONAB Portal de Informações
description: CONAB Portal de Informações with agricultural production, supply, family farming, logistics, and market panels plus file downloads. Complements IBGE SIDRA rather than replacing it.

name: SINISA Painel de Indicadores
description: SINISA interactive sanitation-indicator panel for water supply, sewage, solid waste, and urban drainage, succeeding the SNIS annual collection from 2024.

name: SNIS Série Histórica
description: SNIS Série Histórica consultation of water, sewage, solid-waste, and stormwater sanitation indicators for Brazilian providers and municipalities. Historical series preceding SINISA.

name: ODS Brasil
description: Official Brazilian SDG (ODS) indicator platform operated by IBGE, with production status, series, and metadata for Agenda 2030 monitoring. Distinct from SIDRA table queries.

name: IBGE Cidades@
description: IBGE Cidades@ municipal and state profile system with tables, rankings, and historical series drawn from IBGE surveys and other official sources. Distinct from the SIDRA table builder.

name: Ipeadata
description: IPEA time-series database of macroeconomic, regional, and social indicators for Brazil, with an OData API for series metadata and values.

name: Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)
description: Banco Central do Brasil time-series catalog (SGS) of monetary, credit, fiscal, and external-sector indicators, with a public JSON series API. Distinct from BCB CKAN open data and the IMF NSDP page.

name: Atlas do Desenvolvimento Humano (Atlas Brasil)
description: Atlas of Human Development in Brazil with municipal, state, and metropolitan HDI profiles produced by PNUD, IPEA, and Fundação João Pinheiro.

name: Comex Stat
description: Official Brazilian foreign-trade query system (Comex Stat) with monthly export and import series since 1997 and a public REST API.

name: Dados Abertos da Câmara dos Deputados
description: Open data and REST API of the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies covering legislators, votes, propositions, events, parties, and related legislative collections.

name: INMET BDMEP
description: INMET Banco de Dados Meteorológicos (BDMEP) for historical station observations (hourly, daily, and monthly) as CSV. Distinct from the INMET WIS 2.0 in a box geoportal.

name: Brasil.IO Civic Open Data
description: Civic open-data project publishing Brazilian public-interest datasets (companies, gazettes, elections, health, and related administrative records).

name: Portal Brasileiro de Dados Abertos
description: Portal Brasileiro de Dados Abertos, the national open data catalog of the Brazilian federal government, operated by the Controladoria-Geral da União (CGU).

name: Medicamentos Transparentes
description: Open data on public medicines procurement, structured from the Portal Nacional de Contratações Públicas and republished as OCDS.

name: Dados Abertos - Portal de Transparência da UFPR
description: No módulo de Dados Abertos concentram-se diversas informações sobre a nossa Universidade. Informações Acadêmicas Graduação Pós-Graduação Extensão e Cultura.

name: BDGEx Banco de Dados Geográficos do Exército
description: Banco de Dados Geográficos do Exército (BDGEx), the Brazilian Army geographic database listed as an own-host node in the INDE geoservices and metadata catalogs (CSW and MapCache WMS). Public product UI also documented at geoportal.eb.mil.br.

name: INPE Image Catalog
description: INPE Catalogo de Imagens. Public catalog of Brazilian Earth observation satellite imagery from CBERS, Amazonia-1, and related missions.

name: Visualizador da INDE
description: National Spatial Data Infrastructure (INDE) layer viewer over harvested WMS and WFS services from federal and state nodes. Companion to the INDE GeoNetwork metadata catalog.

name: Brazil Data Cube Explorer
description: Brazil Data Cube Explorer is INPE's public web portal for viewing image collections, data cubes, classifications, and mosaics covering Brazil, with spatiotemporal search and download from the Brazil Data Cube project.

name: Brazil Data Cube
description: Project portal for Brazil Data Cube at INPE, describing the national Earth observation data cube programme and linking to the Data Cube Explorer and STAC API used to access image collections, cubes, and mosaics for Brazil.

name: Catálogo de APIs governamentais
description: Catálogo de APIs governamentais is a api catalog operated by Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação em Serviços Públicos.

name: STING
description: The Blue Star STING database stores information on the interactions between proteins and other bio macromolecules. Structure descriptors used in the analysis of these interactions are stored in STING DB to aid research primarily into the problems challenging Brazilian agriculture, livestock and medicine.

name: speciesLink
description: speciesLink (also known as the Distributed Information System for Biological Collections: Integrating Species Analyst and SinBiota (FAPESP)) implements a distributed information system to retrieve primary biodiversity data from collections within the state of São Paulo (Brazil) as well as data integrated from other networks and observation data registered in the SinBiota database.

name: Open Science Brazil
description: Open Science Brazil é um repositório de dados abertos gerenciado pela Editora ALUMNI IN . Este portal de livre acesso permite os usuários disponibilizar todos os seus resultados de pesquisa de maneira citável, compartilhável e rastreável.

name: FishSounds
description: FishSounds is an open, global online repository of acoustic recordings and published information about sound production across all known fish species. It compiles both sound files and scientific data from peer-reviewed literature and researcher contributions to help document which fish make sounds and what those sounds are like.

name: Repositório Maxwell - PUC-Rio
description: The Maxwell Repository houses and makes available Electronic Theses and Dissertations, Senior Projects, Specialization Monographs, Learning Objects (Open and Restricted), Datasets, journals. All materials are products of the Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio) community and, except for the Learning Object, all have DOIs.

name: ALUMNI.IN BOOKS
description: At Alumni.In Books, we are committed to providing a streamlined, transparent, and inclusive editorial process that promotes high-quality academic publishing in alignment with open science and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

name: ATTO Data Portal
description: The Amazon Tall Tower Observatory (ATTO) Data Portal is an interdisciplinary platform for storing, sharing, exchanging, and publishing data collected by the ATTO research consortium. Its core goal is to improve understanding of biogeochemical cycles and energy fluxes across the geosphere, biosphere, and atmosphere in the Amazon region and to feed that understanding into climate and Earth system models.

name: BioSurfDB
description: BioSurfDB is a online database for biodegradation and biosurfactants. It is a curated relational information system integrating data from: (i) metagenomes; (ii) organisms; (iii) biodegradation relevant genes; proteins and their metabolic pathways; (iv) bioremediation experiments results, with specific pollutants treatment efficiencies by surfactant producing organisms; and (v) a biosurfactant-curated list, grouped by producing organism, surfactant name, class and reference. The main goal of this repository is to gather information on the characterization of biological compounds and mechanisms involved in biosurfactant production and/or biodegradation and make it available in a curated way and associated with a number of computational tools to support studies of genomic and metagenomic data.

name: Galoá Proceedings.Science
description:
Proceedings.Science is an open access repository and publishing platform managed by Galoá. It is dedicated to hosting, organizing, and preserving conference proceedings, extended abstracts, and academic papers from various scientific events, ensuring they are findable and accessible to the global research community.

Galoá Science is a Crossref Sponsor and a member of the ORCID Consortia, ensuring persistent identifiers and interoperability for all hosted research objects.

name: Brazilian Rare Disease Portal
description: The Brazilian Online Atlas of Rare Diseases service from the National Network of Rare Diseases. This portal was developed to disseminate information from the nationally representative survey about the epidemiology, clinical picture, diagnostic and therapeutic resources used and costs with rare diseases of genetic and non-genetic origin in Brazil, in addition to other relevant information and knowledge involving the domain of rare diseases. Although the database was collected in Portuguese, there is a translation of the metadata and supporting documentation in English available and linked from this record (10.5281/zenodo.13643431).

name: Exploration and Production Data Bank
description: Exploration and Production Data Bank, operated by Geological Survey of Brazil, provides research data on geophysics and geodesy, geochemistry, mineralogy and crystallography, and geosciences.

name: Brazilian Flora 2020
description: In 2010, Brazil published the Catalog of Plants and Fungi of Brazil and launched the first online version of the List of Species of the Brazilian Flora, meeting Target 1 of the Global Strategy for Plant Conservation (GSPC-CBD). This botanical milestone was only achieved due to the commitment of more than 400 Brazilians and foreign taxonomists who worked on a platform where information about our flora was included and disseminated in real time. The "Brazilian List", as it was popularly known, closed in November 2015 with the publication of five papers and their respective databases dealing with the different groups of fungi and plants. We enthusiastically present in 2016, the brand new system that houses the Brazilian Flora 2020 project, aiming to achieve Target 1 established for 2020 by the GSPC-CBD. This new project icludes provisions to include descriptions, identification keys and illustrations to all species of plants, algae and fungi known in the country. The Brazilian Flora 2020 project is part of the Reflora Programme and is being conducted with the support of the Sistema de Informação sobre a Biodiversidade Brasileira (SiBBr). At the moment has nearly 700 scientists working in a network to prepare the monographs. These researchers are also responsible for nomenclatural information and geographic distribution (coverage in Brazil, endemism and biomes), as well as valuable data regarding life forms, substrate and vegetation types for each species. The search results on this page include information on endangered species (thanks to the cooperation with the Centro Nacional de Conservação da Flora) and allow access to the Index Herbariorum (due to the collaboration of The New York Botanical Garden). Besides this information, users can also access images of herbarium specimens, including nomenclatural types, from both the Reflora Virtual Herbarium and INCT Virtual Herbarium of Flora and Fungi; as well as images of live plants and scientific illustrations with all images included by the experts in each group.

name: InfoDF
description: InfoDF statistical evidence portal of IPEDF Codeplan, with downloadable indicator series for the Federal District. Distinct from the IPEDF GeoNode catalog.

name: DataIMESC
description: DataIMESC interactive socioeconomic indicator warehouse of IMESC, with more than 800 series in maps, charts, and downloadable tables for Maranhão municipalities. Distinct from the Maranhão open data portal.

name: BDE-Goiás
description: Banco de Dados Estatísticos (BDE) of Goiás, with socioeconomic variables for the state and municipalities maintained by Instituto Mauro Borges.

name: Anuário Estatístico de Mato Grosso
description: Anuário Estatístico de Mato Grosso, with social, economic, and environmental dataset chapters for the state, municipalities, and IBGE regions. Distinct from GeoDados MT and open-data portals.

name: SIG Cuiabá
description: Public municipal GIS of Cuiabá (SIG Cuiabá / Cuiabá Smart), with streets, neighborhoods, and urban map layers.

name: BDE Pernambuco
description: Base de Dados do Estado (BDE) of Pernambuco, an IPARDES-style statistical warehouse of socioeconomic indicators for the state and municipalities.

name: SIDTec Paraíba
description: SIDTec public dashboards of science, technology, higher-education, and labour-market indicators for Paraíba, compared with Brazil and the Northeast. Distinct from SES-PB TabNet.

name: SEADE Painel
description: SEADE Painel of social, economic, and demographic indicators for São Paulo municipalities and regions. Distinct from the SEADE CKAN repository.

name: GeoSampa
description: Official digital map of the City of São Paulo (GeoSampa), the public layer catalog and viewer. Companion to the GeoSampa GeoNetwork metadata catalog and WMS/WFS/raster GeoServer hosts.

name: GeoMogi
description: Municipal urban GIS of Mogi das Cruzes (GeoMogi), with a public OpenLayers map of master-plan, zoning, and public-facility layers.

name: SigSantosWeb
description: Public municipal GIS viewer of Santos (SigSantosWeb), with cadastral and urban map layers.

name: SIGA Santo André
description: Municipal GIS catalog of Santo André (SIGA), listed as an own-host node in the INDE geoservices directory.

name: SPTrans Área do Desenvolvedor
description: São Paulo municipal transit developer catalog of GTFS static feeds and the Olho Vivo realtime bus API. Public product listing; developer registration required for downloads and API keys.

name: Datamap
description: The aggregation of observations into a scientific repository aimed at quantifying the balance of greenhouse gases and climate uncertainties in the Amazon presents a unique opportunity to understand better how environmental phenomena operate in the region while enabling the synthesis of the enormous amount of data generated there. DataMap/Amazon was conceived with the above vision in mind.

name: MMA Statistics Database
description: Maldives Monetary Authority platform for macroeconomic, financial, fiscal, and real-sector statistics, with a public query UI. Series API documentation exists but requests require registration.

name: Maldives Open Data Portal
description: Central source of anonymized open public data published by Maldives government agencies and state bodies.

name: Maldives Climate Data Portal
description: Centralized platform for structured collection and management of climate-related data in the Maldives, with publicly published datasets.

name: The Coral Database
description: National platform for collaborative monitoring data on coastal, oceanic, reef and other ecosystems in the Maldives.

name: ITS Factory Data Sources
description: ITS Factory data sources. Listing of open mobility data sources for the Tampere region: GTFS dump files, Journeys API, SIRI and other transport data interfaces with documentation links.

name: Linked Open Aalto Data Service
description: Linked Open Aalto Data Service. Aalto University content as linked open data with dataset browse, SPARQL endpoint and vocabularies covering courses, people, publications, places, projects, organizations and events.

name: Helsingin seudun opaskartta
description: Helsingin seudun opaskartta (Helsinki region guide map). Public multi-layer map viewer maintained by the Helsinki City Survey Department.

name: Hangon digitaalinen palvelukartta
description: Hangon digitaalinen palvelukartta (digital service map of the City of Hanko). Public map of local services and points of interest.

name: EcoDrug PLUS
description: EcoDrug PLUS (EcoDrug+) is a freely available and publicly accessible database, established to facilitate environmental risk assessment of pharmaceuticals and other bioactive substances, including veterinary medicines and pesticides. EcoDrug+ advancements on the original ECODrug database include a more extensive and intuitive graphical user interface for investigating the potential for chemicals to interact with protein targets based on their conservation with human drug, veterinary, and pesticide targets across 180 phylogenetically diverse wildlife taxa. EcoDrug+ integrates genomic and chemoinformatic data from open-access sources for ~7200 pharmaceuticals, 34 000 agrochemicals, 61 000 human metabolites, and 5800 other bioactive chemicals. Advanced search capabilities of EcoDrug+ include the ability to interrogate the database via text queries, chemical structure drawings, target protein sequence BLAST, and/or specified mechanisms of action. Chemical compound data are organized into clusters to facilitate the exploration of similar groups using interactive knowledge graphs. The integration of effects-based knowledge informs on appropriate endpoints and susceptible species for the testing of drugs (and other bioactive chemicals). Georeferenced measured environmental concentrations (for n = 266 chemicals) furthermore provide relevant exposure data for testing and environmental risk analysis.

The portal is provided by the Ministry of Education and Culture and implemented by CSC – IT Center for Science.

name: Electron Microscopy Image Library of Mouse Tissues
description: Building of this virtual electron microscopy (EM) image library on normal mouse tissues is initiated as part of an EOSC-Life project at the Biocenter Oulu Transgenic and Tissue Phenotyping, and Electron Microscopy Core Facilities, University of Oulu, Finland, in collaboration with Infrafrontier. The open-access, annotated EM image library presents educative reference information for researchers using gene modified mice as disease or pre-clinical models. By providing a deeper understanding of tissues at ultrastructural level, it eases and aids in understanding structural changes and related phenotypes in mouse models. This resource is currently in development.

name: Finnish Social Science Data Archive
description: The Finnish Social Science Data Archive (FSD) is a national-level service resource for research and teaching in Finland. FSD promotes data sharing and curates and disseminates digital research data for research, teaching and studying purposes. FSD serves both Finnish and international users. FSD is an expert in the curation and preservation of digital research data collected to study society, people and culture. FSD focuses on acquiring Social Science data, but data from other relevant fields (Arts and Humanities, Education, and Health Science) is also archived. FSD is Finland's service provider for CESSDA ERIC, the Consortium of European Social Science Data Archives.

name: COVID-19 Host Genetics Initiative
description: The COVID-19 host genetics initiative brings together the human genetics community to generate, share, and analyze data to learn the genetic determinants of COVID-19 susceptibility, severity, and outcomes. Such discoveries could help to generate hypotheses for drug repurposing, identify individuals at unusually high or low risk, and contribute to global knowledge of the biology of SARS-CoV-2 infection and disease.

name: Sequencing Initiative Suomi
description: The Sequencing Initiative Suomi (SISu) search engine offers a way to search for data on sequence variants in the Finnish population. It provides valuable summary data for researchers and clinicians as well as other researchers with an interest in genetics in Finland. With SISu, you can examine the attributes and appearance of different variants in Finnish cohorts and see their aggregate distribution in Finland visualized on a map. The SISu project is an international collaboration between multiple research groups aiming to build tools for genomic medicine.
