name: WheatIS
description: Wheat Information System federated search across wheat genetics, genomics, and phenotype data resources.

name: France Government API Catalogue
description: Site qui référence toutes les API du service public et permet aux administrations et utilisateurs de faciliter le partage et la circulation des données administratives françaises.

name: Viral Host Range database
description:
The Viral Host Range database (VHRdb) represents a unique resource for the community to rapidly find, document analyze and disseminate data related to the range of hosts that a virus can infect. Over the years, countless host range experiments have been performed in many laboratories. However, these data are not readily available to the community and are therefore underexploited.

The VHRdb is an online resource that centralizes experimental data related to the host range of viruses. While it originates from bacteriophages and bacteria interaction studies, its design is compatible with viruses infecting all living forms. Users can browse publicly available data to find which host is infected by a virus, and vice versa. Users can also upload their own data, with the option to keep it private or make it public, analyze results across independent sets of data, generate and visualize outputs. Data implemented in the VHRdb are linked to users and, if available, to publications and sequence identifiers.

The VHRdb is an initiative from the Debarbieux lab and is developed and maintained in collaboration with the Bioinformatics and Biostatistics Hub of Institut Pasteur.

If you wish to import a collection or very sizable data into the VHRdb, please do no hesitate to contact us to arrange details such as specific identifiers (see Documentation).

name: INERIS - Chemical Substances Portal
description: The database centralizes data produced by national or international reference organizations on chemical substances and provides detailed information on their toxicological, ecotoxicological, and physicochemical properties as well as technical and economic data, and the main applicable regulations. Please note that this resource is mainly in French, and has been assessed by our in-house team partially via automated translations.

name: ParameciumDB
description:
Paramecia are unicellular eukaryotes of large size (~ 120 micrometers for P aurelia species) that belong to the ciliate phylum. Ciliates, like the Last Eukaryotic Common Ancestor, have the axonemal structure in the form of vibrating cilia that assure locomotion and food capture and are essential for pairing of paramecia of opposite mating types during conjugation (sexual reproduction). Like multicellular eukaryotes, ciliates separate germinal and somatic functions, harbouring two different kinds of nuclei. A diploid germinal micronucleus transmits the genetic information to the next sexual generation, while a polyploid somatic macronucleus is responsible for gene expression. Reproducible DNA elimination, which occurs in many animal lineages, takes place in ciliates during sexual reproduction, when a new somatic macronucleus develops from a copy of the germline micronucleus.
The somatic genomes of numerous Paramecium species are being sequenced and annotated. ParameciumDB integrates the genomes as they become available, to provide resources for functional and comparative genomics to the community. ParameciumDB interfaces and tools have been redesigned. Your feedback is welcome.

name: REDAC
description: Linguistic corpora, lexica, and applications developed at CLLE, Université Toulouse Jean Jaurès, with OLAC/OAI-PMH for CLARIN VLO.

name: GermOnline
description: GermOnline is a cross-species database gateway focusing on high-throughput expression data relevant for germline development, the meiotic cell cycle and mitosis in healthy versus malignant cells. The portal provides access to the Saccharomyces Genomics Viewer (SGV) which facilitates online interpretation of complex data from experiments with high-density oligonucleotide tiling microarrays that cover the entire yeast genome.

name: WURM Raman Spectroscopy Database
description: The WURM project is a scientific database providing computed physical properties of minerals, including crystal structures, dielectric parameters, and Raman and infrared spectra for a wide range of minerals. These properties are calculated using quantum mechanical methods such as density‑functional theory and presented in an accessible online format.

name: Bureau Central Sismologique Français - Réseau National de Surveillance Sismique
description: The national information site on seismicity in France provides real-time information on seismic events in or near France, based on recordings from the monitoring stations of the French seismological and geodesic network Résif, from research or monitoring project stations, from stations in the networks of bordering countries (Germany, United Kingdom, Belgium, Spain, Italy, Luxembourg, Switzerland) and from stations in the global networks.

name: Norine
description: Public database of nonribosomal peptides (1,744 peptides) with structure search and annotation, hosted by Université de Lille.

name: EaSy Data
description: EaSy Data (for Earth System Data) is the French data repository for the environmental domain. It allows researchers in the Environmental and Earth sciences to publish their data and obtain a DOI. Submissions must comply with the scope defined by the communities. Data are moderated by community scientists before validation. Metadata are based on community standards (ISO 19115) and are exposed via standard API (CSW and OGC API).

name: Emissions of atmospheric Compounds and Compilation of Ancillary Data
description: Emissions of atmospheric Compounds and Compilation of Ancillary Data (ECCAD) aims at providing scientific users with an easy access to a large number of existing datasets on surface emissions of atmospheric compounds at the global and regional scales. Data manipulation tools as well as statistical information over the different regions (climatic regions, continents, oceans, OECD regions, etc.) are also available for users.

name: COCOON
description: Collections de Corpus Oraux Numériques: archive of oral corpora and related language documentation hosted on Huma-Num.

name: Clinical Research Data Sharing Repository
description: The clinical research Data Sharing Repository is capable of holding any type of digital object -data sets, documents, media file etc- in a secure research environment (TRE). The repository collects the metadata necessary for the Findability of the objects, promoting data sharing in clinical research.

name: European Synchrotron Radiation Facility Paleontology Database
description: The Paleontology database hosts data obtained from X-ray Computed Tomography experiments at ESRF. While the ESRF data portal hosts the raw data from the experiments, this space provides access to processed tomograms and, in some cases, associated derivatives (images, movies, 3D meshes). Data are only deposited here upon request from the experimental teams and relevant parties (museum curators, researchers involved in the analysis). Data hosted here cover a wide taxonomical spectrum and can represent complete specimens or specific close-ups depending on the case.

name: Knottin database
description: This resource is no longer available because its underlying source material is not in scope for FAIRsharing.Organisations previously linked: [3998, 448]. Publications previously linked: [323, 3861].

name: Encyclopaedia of Exoplanetary Systems
description: Community catalog of confirmed exoplanets and planetary systems with queryable tables.

name: Kinetic Database for Astrochemistry
description: KIDA (KInetic Database for Astrochemistry) is a database of kinetic data of interest for astrochemical (interstellar medium and planetary atmospheres) studies. KIDA is a project initiated by different communities in order to 1) improve the interaction between astrochemists and physico-chemists and 2) simplify the work of modeling the chemistry of astrophysical environments. Here astrophysical environments stand for the interstellar medium and planetary atmospheres. Both types of environments use similar chemical networks and the physico-chemists who work on the determination of reaction rate coefficients for both types of environment are the same.

name: RunMyCode
description: RunMyCode is an online repository allowing people to share code and data associated with scientific publications. Its goal is to allow members of the academic community to replicate scientific results and to demonstrate the robustness of published code.

name: The Diatom EST Database
description: Diatoms are photosynthetic unicellular eukaryotes that play an essential role in marine ecosystems. On a global scale, they generate around one fifth of the oxygen we breathe. On this web site we present searchable databases of diatom ESTs (expressed sequence tags) that can be used to explore diatom biology.

name: Phenol-Explorer
description: Phenol-Explorer is the first comprehensive database on polyphenol content in foods. The database contains more than 35,000 content values for 500 different polyphenols in over 400 foods. These data are derived from the systematic collection of more than 60,000 original content values found in more than 1,300 scientific publications. Each of these publications has been critically evaluated before inclusion in the database.

name: Ifremer Vidéos Sciences Marines
description: Ifremer catalog of marine-science videos from submersible dives, organized by oceanographic cruise, vehicle, dive and camera, with associated metadata.

name: International Service of Geomagnetic Indices
description: The International Service of Geomagnetic Indices (ISGI) is in charge of the elaboration and dissemination of geomagnetic indices, and of tables of remarkable magnetic events, based on the report of magnetic observatories distributed all over the planet, with the help of 6 ISGI Collaborating Institutes.

name: Extracellular Matrix Interaction Database
description: MatrixDB stores experimental data established by full-length proteins, matricryptins, glycosaminoglycans, lipids and cations. MatrixDB reports interactions with individual polypeptide chains or with multimers (e.g. collagens, laminins, thrombospondins) when appropriate. Multimers are treated as permanent complexes, referencing EBI identifiers when possible. Human interactions were inferred from non-human homologous interactions when available.

name: NAKALA
description: Huma-Num research data repository for depositing, documenting, and disseminating digital research data in the humanities and social sciences.

name: Metabolomic Repository Bordeaux
description: MeRy-B is a plant metabolomics platform allowing the storage and visualisation of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) metabolic profiles from plants.

name: Oryza Tag Line
description: Oryza Tag Line consists in a searchable database developed under the Oracle management system integrating phenotypic data resulting from the evaluation of the Genoplante rice insertion line library.

name: SONEL Sea Level Observing System
description: SONEL catalog of GNSS-equipped tide-gauge and coastal sea-level observations supporting GLOSS and related sea-level research.

name: The Mathematical Functions Grimoire
description: The Mathematical Functions Grimoire (Fungrim) is an open source library of formulas and data for special functions. Fungrim currently consists of 457 symbols (named mathematical objects), 3130 entries (definitions, formulas, tables, plots), and 82 topics (listings of entries). The Fungrim website provides a permanent ID and URL for each entry, symbol or topic. All data in Fungrim is represented in semantic form designed to be usable by computer algebra software.

name: Coriolis Marine In Situ Observations
description: Coriolis catalog of European in-situ ocean observations, including Argo, ships, moorings and related operational oceanography data streams.

name: mouseTube
description:
mouseTube is a database dedicated to mouse ultrasonic communication. mouseTube aims at gathering mouse ultrasonic vocalisations recordings and making them available for the community. 
mousetube associates a set of metadata to download links of raw files of mouse vocalization recordings hosted on repositories by the owners of these files.
Members sharing data on mouseTube are fully responsible for the content of raw files and the accuracy of the metadata provided. mouseTube data are freely available and can be used for subsequent publications with appropriate references.
This is a temporary version of MouseTube.
This 0.5 version uses the same database as the 0.0 version but with more recent and safer technologies. The main improvement is that data are now accessible without authentication.
If you want to share vocalization files, please contact us. This version does not allow to share file but we can do it manually.
We are currently developing a new version (v1.0) with more functionalities.

name: Exposome Explorer
description: First database dedicated to biomarkers of exposure to environmental risk factors for diseases.

name: Insertion Sequence Finder
description:
This database provides a list of insertion sequences (IS) isolated from bacteria and archae. It is organized into individual files containing their general features (name, size, origin, family.....) as well as their DNA and potential protein sequences. Some of the entries have been identified as individual elements by their insertion activities but a growing number are included from their description in sequenced bacterial genomes. It also includes certain transposons, in particular, members of the Tn3 family of replicative transposons.
Note from the FAIRsharing team: we have classified the status of the resource as 'uncertain' because we can't access the data, and we are making every effort to engage with the resource owners to understand if it is a temporary issue or if the resource is no longer active.

name: INIES
description: French environmental product database for buildings, publishing FDES and PEP declarations for construction products and equipment.

name: Boundary Layer Late Afternoon and Sunset Turbulence
description: BLLAST is a research programme aimed at exploring the late afternoon transition of the atmospheric boundary layer. The late afternoon period of the diurnal cycle of the boundary layer is poorly understood. This is yet an important transition period that impacts the transport and dillution of water vapour and trace species. The main questions adressed by the project are: - How the turbulence activity fades when heating by the surface decreases?

name: A database of Galois polynomials
description: PARI/GP is a cross platform and open-source computer algebra system designed for fast computations in number theory: factorizations, algebraic number theory, elliptic curves, modular forms, L functions... It also contains a wealth of functions to compute with mathematical entities such as matrices, polynomials, power series, algebraic numbers, etc., and a lot of transcendental functions as well as numerical summation and integration routines. PARI is also available as a C library to allow for faster computations.

name: STARK-B
description: STARK-B, operated by Paris Observatory, provides research data on optics, quantum optics and physics of atoms, molecules and plasmas, optics, quantum optics, atoms, molecules, plasmas, and astrophysics and astronomy.

name: Genomicus
description: Genomicus is a genome browser that enables users to navigate in genomes in several dimensions: linearly along chromosome axes, transversaly across different species, and chronologicaly along evolutionary time.

name: European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre
description: The European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre collects real-time earthquake parameters and phase pickings from seismological networks across the Euro-Mediterranean region and publishes them on emsc-csem.org.

name: Bacterial protein tYrosine Kinase database
description: The Bacterial protein tYrosine Kinase database (BYKdb) contains computer-annotated BY-kinase sequences. The database web interface allows static and dynamic queries and provides integrated analysis tools including sequence annotation.

name: OSCAR Corpus
description: Multilingual web-crawled corpora extracted from Common Crawl and published as openly licensed language datasets.

name: European Hepatitis C Virus database
description: The euHCVdb is mainly oriented towards protein sequence, structure and function analyses and structural biology of Hepatitis C Virus.

name: ImMunoGeneTics Information System
description: IMGT is a high-quality integrated knowledge resource specialized in the immunoglobulins (IG) or antibodies, T cell receptors (TR), major histocompatibility complex (MHC) of human and other vertebrate species, and in the immunoglobulin superfamily (IgSF), major histocompatibility complex superfamily (MhcSF) and related proteins of the immune system (RPI) of vertebrates and invertebrates.

name: ELRA Catalogue of Language Resources
description: ELRA catalogue of language resources distributed by ELDA for human language technology research and development.

name: Toolbox for Sensitive Data Objects
description: For life science research infrastructures, sensitive data generate an additional layer of complexity. Cross-domain categorisation and discovery of digital resources related to sensitive data presents major interoperability challenges. To support the FAIRification process, a toolbox demonstrator aiming at improving the discovery of digital objects related to sensitive data (e.g., regulations, guidelines, best practice, tools) has been developed. The toolbox is based upon a categorisation system developed and harmonised across a cluster of 6 life science research infrastructures (ECRIN, EATRIS, BBMRI, ERINHA, EMBRC, Euro-BioImaging). 3 different versions were built, tested by subsequent pilot studies, finally leading to a system with 7 main categories (sensitive data type, resource type, research field, data type, stage in data sharing life cycle, geographical scope, specific topics).

name: Quetelet-Progedo
description: Quetelet-Progedo is Progedo's data repository dedicated to quantitative social sciences and humanities. Its data collection currently includes administrative, survey (aggregate- and individual-level), geographic, and historical data that cover a wide range of themes such as education, labour, wages, demography, family, health, migration, etc. These data have primarily been produced by French government agencies (notably the French National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE)[5] and, more recently, by academic researchers. Quetelet-Progedo, as a product of Progedo, has been jointly funded by the French Ministry of Higher Education and Research and the CNRS. Please note that the majority of the data and documentation is in French.

name: BCL-2 Database
description: BCL2DB is a database designed to integrate data on BCL-2 family members and BH3-only proteins.

name: LXCat
description: Open-access collection of electron and ion scattering cross sections, swarm parameters, and related plasma data.

name: Maison méditerranéenne des sciences de l'homme, Phonothèque
description: A place of living memory, the Phonotheque of the MMSH aims to bring together recordings of the sound heritage that have the value of ethnological, linguistic, historical, musicological or literary information on the Mediterranean area. It documents fields little covered by conventional sources, or completes them with the point of view of actors or witnesses.

name: IUPAC AERIS
description: This website provides kinetic and photochemical data evaluated by the IUPAC Task Group on Atmospheric Chemical Kinetic Data Evaluation.

name: VRP-REP
description: Repository of vehicle routing problem instances, solutions, and related benchmark datasets.

name: SIMBAD
description: CDS database of astronomical objects beyond the Solar System with identifications, measurements, and bibliography.

name: National 3D Data Repository
description: The National 3D Data Repository is the preferred backup solution for 3D data produced in the context of projects in Higher Education and Research in Digital Humanities. It benefits from a secure backup environment for 3D data provided by Huma-Num. Its development and maintenance are ensured by Archeovision. Its specifications are the result of work carried out within the Consortium 3D SHS.

name: Open-source Scientific Software and Service Repository
description: The ESCAPE Open-source Scientific Software and Service Repository (OSSR) is a sustainable open-access repository to share scientific software, services and datasets to the astro-particle-physics-related communities and enable open science. It is built as a curated Zenodo community (https://zenodo.org/communities/escape2020) integrated with several tools to enable a complete software life-cycle. The ESCAPE Zenodo community welcomes entries that support the software and service projects in the OSSR such as user-support documentation, tutorials, presentations and training activities. It also encourages the archival of documents and material that disseminate and support the goals of ESCAPE.

name: EMSC Seismic Portal
description: European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre event portal providing interactive earthquake search, maps, and FDSN web services.

name: Orphanet
description: Orphanet is the reference resource for information on rare diseases and orphan drugs. Its aim is to contribute to the improvement of the diagnosis, care and treatment of patients with rare diseases. Orphanet maintains the Orphanet nomenclature, essential for interoperability, and the Orphanet Rare Disease Ontology (ORDO).

name: Stark Broadening Parameters for Neutral and Singly Charged Ions
description: Stark Broadening Parameters for Neutral and Singly Charged Ions, operated by Paris Observatory, provides research data on optics, quantum optics and physics of atoms, molecules and plasmas, optics, quantum optics, atoms, molecules, plasmas, and physics.

name: GreenPhylDB: A phylogenomic database for plant comparative genomics
description: GreenPhylDB (https://www.greenphyl.org) is a database designed to facilitate the exploration of gene families and homologous relationships among plant genomes, including staple crops critically important for global food security. GreenPhylDB is available since 2007, after the release of the Arabidopsis thaliana and Oryza sativa genomes and has undergone multiple releases. With the number of plant genomes currently available, it becomes challenging to select a single reference for comparative genomics studies but there is still a lack of databases taking advantage several genomes by species for orthology detection. GreenPhylDBv5 introduces the concept of comparative pangenomics by harnessing multiple genome sequences by species. We created 19 pangenes and processed them with other species still relying on one genome. In total, 46 plant species were considered to build gene families and predict their homologous relationships through phylogenetic-based analyses.

name: Orphadata Science
description: Quality datasets on rare diseases and orphan drugs from the Orphanet knowledge base, in reusable formats.

name: ANPERSANA
description: ANPERSANA is the digital library of IKER (UMR 5478), a research centre specialized in Basque language and texts. The online library platform receives and disseminates primary sources of data issued from research in Basque language and culture. As of today, two corpora of documents have been published. The first one, is a collection of private letters written in an 18th century variety of Basque, documented in and transcribed to modern standard Basque.

name: ReMap
description: ReMap is a large scale integrative analysis of DNA-binding experiments for Homo sapiens, Mus musculus, Drosophila melanogaster and Arabidopsis thaliana transcriptional regulators. The catalogues are the results of the manual curation of ChIP-seq, ChIP-exo, DAP-seq from public sources (GEO, ENCODE, ENA).  ReMap (https://remap.univ-amu.fr) aims to provide manually curated, high-quality catalogs of regulatory regions resulting from a large-scale integrative analysis of DNA-binding experiments in Human, Mouse, Fly and Arabidopsis thaliana for hundreds of transcription factors and regulators. In this 2022 update, we have uniformly processed >11 000 DNA-binding sequencing datasets from public sources across four species.  The four regulatory catalogs are browsable through track hubs at UCSC, Ensembl and NCBI genome browsers. Finally, ReMap 2022 comes with a new Cis Regulatory Module identification method, improved quality controls, faster search results, and better user experience with an interactive tour and video tutorials on browsing and filtering ReMap catalogs.

name: Software Heritage
description: Universal archive of publicly available source code, preserving software as cultural and scientific heritage.

name: ShareLoc Single-Molecule Localization Microscopy Catalog
description: Open catalog of single-molecule localization microscopy datasets and tools. Files are stored on Zenodo; ShareLoc is the public discovery layer (Institut Pasteur).

name: Harmonia Universalis
description: Harmonia universalis is a prosopographical database gathering data on the actors of the mesmerist movement at the end of the 18th century. The Harmonia Universalis database is designed as a space for exchange and sharing between researchers and enthusiasts. Any interested person can participate in its realization by contacting the administrators of the database. They will then be able to enter directly on line the information they wish to introduce.

name: CADE Extended Astronomical Data Archive
description: Centre d'Analyse de Données Etendues (IRAP): archive of extended astronomical survey maps in HEALPix, with VO/Aladin access.

name: Echidna Databases
description: Interactive interfaces, static databases and static tables for Elliptic Curves and Higher Dimensional Analogues.

name: VESPA (Virtual European Solar and Planetary Access) query portal
description:
**VESPA (Virtual European Solar and Planetary Access) is a web-based data search interface for Planetary Science and Heliophysics data. VESPA is a project of the Europlanet-2024 programme funded by European Community.**

The VESPA portal provides access to data content provided by the science community, which is freely available to researchers and the general public. It is hosted and maintained by the Observatory of Paris, France.

The VESPA portal is a search interface mainly connecting data services responsive to the EPN-TAP protocol in several science fields. It supports user-friendly searching on metadata associated with generic observation conditions (such as target, instrument, time/space/spectral coverages, illumination conditions, etc) and metadata specific to each dataset (such as instrumental parameters). Other protocols such as PDAP and NASA PDS keyword search are also supported.

name: Protist Ribosomal Reference Database
description: The PR2 reference sequence database began as part of the BioMarks project from previous work in the Plankton Group of the Station Biologique of Roscoff. It aims to provide a reference database of carefully annotated 18S rRNA sequences using nine unique taxonomic fields (from domain to species). At present, it contains over 240,000 sequences. Although it focuses on protists, it also contains sequences from metazoa, fungi and plants as well a limited set of 16S sequences from plastids and bacteria. Several metadata fields are available for many sequences, including geo-localisation, whether it originates from a culture or a natural sample, and host type. The annotation of PR2 is performed by experts in each of the taxonomic groups.

name: University Bourgogne Franche-Comté Scientific data repository
description: Scientific data repository. managed by University Bourgogne Franche-Comté. providing access to search-data.ubfc.fr.

name: BASECOL
description: Ro-vibrational collisional excitation database (VAMDC node) of molecular collision rates for astrophysical modelling.

name: Pangloss Collection
description: Archive of audio recordings and annotated texts for lesser-documented languages, maintained by CNRS LACITO.

name: Kinsources
description: Repository of coded kinship and marriage network datasets (127 datasets, ~800k individuals) for anthropological demography, browsable and downloadable.

name: Archimer Ifremer Institutional Archive
description: Archimer institutional repository of Ifremer scientific publications and associated marine research outputs.

name: BDOH Hydrology Observatories Database
description: Base de Données des Observatoires en Hydrologie: INRAE catalog of long-term hydrology and biogeochemistry observatories (rainfall, discharge, suspended sediment, and related time series).

name: Argo Global Data Assembly Centre
description: Ifremer Global Data Assembly Centre for the Argo ocean profiling-float network, providing the complete official NetCDF collection and selection tools.

name: Bureau Central de Magnétisme Terrestre
description: The BCMT data portal offers access magnetic data and indices of the French network of ground observatories, operated all over the world by French research institutions and international partners.

name: Infevers
description: A registry of Hereditary Auto-inflammatory Disorder Mutations.

name: HyperLeda
description: HyperLEDA is an astronomical database of galaxies and extragalactic objects compiled at the Observatoire de Lyon / Observatoire de Haute-Provence. It aggregates observational measurements and physical properties of millions of celestial objects from the literature into a homogeneous, searchable catalog.

name: TropGENE DB
description: TropGENE DB is a database that manages genetic and genomic information about tropical crops studied by Cirad. The database is organised into crop specific modules.

name: SEDOO
description: The SEDOO is the data center of the Observatoire Midi-Pyrénées, supporting its entire scientific scope. It serves Earth and environmental science communities by providing long-term data stewardship, FAIR-compliant data management, and sustainable digital services. SEDOO supports local, national, and international scientific projects throughout the full data lifecycle, from data acquisition and processing to dissemination, preservation, and reuse.

name: Agronomic Linked Data
description: The Agronomic Linked Data (AgroLD) is a knowledge-based system relying on Semantic Web technologies and exploiting standard domain ontologies, which integrates data about plant species of high interest for the plant science community. AgroLD is an RDF knowledge base of 100M triples created by annotating and integrating more than 50 datasets from 10 data sources and linked using 10 ontologies.

name: HOTVOLC
description: OPGC HOTVOLC service for thermal monitoring of volcanic activity from geostationary satellite data, delivering GeoTIFF and time-series products through an EPOS REST API.

name: CDPP Archive
description: The CDPP Archive (Centre de Données de la Physique des Plasmas) is a long-term scientific repository operated by CNES for the preservation and dissemination of plasma physics and space mission data. It provides access to calibrated datasets, metadata, documentation, and quicklook products from numerous space missions studying the Earth's magnetosphere, the solar wind, planets, and the heliosphere. The archive supports standardized data discovery through the REGARDS platform and follows international metadata standards (SPASE) to facilitate interoperability and long-term preservation

name: Strasbourg Astronomical Data Center
description: Strasbourg astronomical Data Center (CDS) is dedicated to the collection and worldwide distribution of astronomical data and related information. Alongside data curation and service maintenance responsibilities, the CDS undertakes R&D activities that are fundamental to ensure the long term sustainability in a domain in which technology evolves very quickly. R&D areas include informatics, big data, and development of the astronomical Virtual Observatory (VO).

name: The crop modeling community model repository
description: CropMRepository provides an accessible online location for storing and efficiently retrieving and sharing simulation models of soil and crop growth biophysical processes. Models are stored in the open-source format Crop Modeling MetaLanguage (Crop2ML) developed and supported by the Agricultural Model Exchange Initiative (AMEI). CropMRepository and Crop2ML follow the Minimum Information Required in the Annotation of Models (MIRIAM) and the Open Modeling Foundation (OMF) sets of guidelines that define how a model should be encoded, annotated, and documented in order to be successfully distributed, exchanged and ultimately reused.All models are provided under an open-source license. This means that the models are available freely for use, modification, and distribution, to all users. The models deposited in CropMRepository are citable by using the unique and perennial model identifier assigned to each model.

name: Banana Genome Hub
description: The Banana Genome Hub is the official portal for the Musaceae genome resources.

name: ESTHER database
description: The server ESTHER (ESTerases and alpha/beta-Hydrolase Enzymes and Relatives) is dedicated to the analysis of proteins or protein domains belonging to the superfamily of alpha/beta-hydrolases, exemplified by the cholinesterases.

name: BAliBASE
description: BAliBASE; a benchmark alignment database, including enhancements for repeats, transmembrane sequences and circular permutations.

name: Centre National de Ressources Textuelles et Lexicales
description: Created in 2005 by the CNRS, CNRTL unites in a single portal, a set of linguistic resources and tools for language processing. The CNRTL includes the identification, documentation (metadata), standardization, storage, enhancement and dissemination of resources. The sustainability of the service and the data is guaranteed by the backing of the UMR ATILF (CNRS - Université Nancy), support of the CNRS and its integration in the excellence equipment project ORTOLANG .

name: ANISEED
description: Ascidian Network for In Situ Expression and Embryological Data: genome, cell-lineage, and 3D embryo catalog for tunicates (ELIXIR data resource).

name: YeastIP
description: YeastIP is a gene database for the molecular taxonomy and phylogeny of yeasts. It contains the major barcodes of all the species of the subphylum Saccharomycotina, tools to establish the identification of yeasts to the species level, and associated phylogenetic relationships. The YeastIP database offers easy and immediate access to the type strain or representative strain sequences of each species. In addition, associated information is available in a simple, clear interface, with expert-validated sequences. YeastIP allows easy retrieval of these sequences through the use of a search tool. YeastIP was developed with the intention of helping both nonspecialists and taxonomists to establish rapid identification and phylogenetic reconstruction.

name: PerSCiDO
description: Institutional research-data catalog of Université Grenoble Alpes (GRICAD). Public metadata search, SPARQL, and REST API; deposits with Creative Commons licenses and DataCite DOIs.

name: ECRIN Clinical Research Metadata Repository
description: The ECRIN Clinical Research Metadata Repository is a portal allowing users to search for studies using a variety of criteria and identify the data objects (trial registrations, results summaries, journal articles, protocols etc.) associated with them. The repository is intended to support researchers and reviewers locate available data objects of all types, from a wide variety of sources. Where the data is publicly available, links are provided to directly access the data object. For controlled data, links to information about data access are available.

name: CRISPRCasdb
description: CRISPRCasdb acts as a gateway to a publicly accessible database and software to enable the easy detection of CRISPR sequences in locally-produced data and the consultation of CRISPR sequence data present in the database. It also gives information on the presence of CRISPR-associated (cas) genes when they have been annotated as such.

name: Ifremer Océanothèque
description: Ifremer Océanothèque catalog of ocean images and related underwater-imagery collections from research campaigns and submersibles.

name: Speech and Language Data Repository (SLDR/ORTOLANG)
description: Speech and Language Data Repository (SLDR/ORTOLANG) provides 268 datasets ([34%] open access) according to the BASE search index as of 2015-11-02.

name: Integrated Tumor Transcriptome Array and Clinical data Analysis database
description: ITTACA is a database created for Integrated Tumor Transcriptome Array and Clinical data Analysis. ITTACA centralizes public datasets containing both gene expression and clinical data and currently focuses on the types of cancer that are of particular interest to the Institut Curie: breast carcinoma, bladder carcinoma, and uveal melanoma.

name: IPGP Data Center
description: The main mission of IPGP Data Center is to manage and to distribute geophysical data from the Institut de physique du globe de Paris to support the geophysical research community.

name: FairOnChain datasets
description: Open FAIR blockchain datasets for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Gnosis, Hoodi, and Holesky. Data is collected from project-operated nodes, catalogued with metadata, and updated daily.

name: MorphoMuseuM
description: MorphoMuseuM, also referred to as M3, is a peer reviewed, online data journal that publishes 3D models of vertebrates, including models of type specimens, anatomy atlases, reconstruction of deformed or damaged specimens, and 3D datasets (see https://doi.org/10.1017/scs.2017.14 for details).

name: iPPI-DB - Inhibitors of Protein-Protein Interaction Database
description: IPPI-DB is a database of modulators of protein-protein interactions. It contains exclusively small molecules and therefore no peptides. The data are retrieved from the literature either peer reviewed scientific articles or world patents. A large variety of data is stored within IPPI-DB: structural, pharmacological, binding and activity profile, pharmacokinetic and cytotoxicity when available, as well as some data about the PPI targets themselves.

name: VirHostNet
description: VirHostNet is a bioinformatic information system dedicated to the biocuration, data integration, reproducible systems-level analysis and visualisation of Virus / Host protein-protein interactions Network based on graph theory. VirHostNet is an open and gold standard knowledgebase shared in PSI MITAB 2.5 format using the PSICQUIC webservice and distributed through the NDEx platform.

name: CUPIDON
description: Cupidon « Catalogue Unique pour le Partage Interopérable des DONnées » is the BRGM data repository. Metadata are moderated by community scientists before validation. Metadata are based on community standards (ISO 19115) and are exposed via standard API (CSW).

name: Bibliothèques Virtuelles Humanistes
description: This subject based repository collects and provides information relating to the humanities and the period of the Renaissance in particular. Principal materials are a wide range of digitised books from the period, available as a series of page images. The site interface is available in French only. Whilst the site has aspirations to include 2000 items over the coming years, there remains a considerable amount of work to achieve this target.

name: Earth Orientation Parameters Product Center
description: The Earth Orientation Parameters Product Center (EOP-PC) is a scientific data service operated by the Paris Observatory that provides access to Earth Orientation Parameters (EOP), which describe variations in the Earth's rotation and orientation in space. The resource distributes observational and derived datasets used for geodesy, astronomy, satellite navigation, and Earth science applications. It serves as a repository of validated Earth orientation products contributed by international observing techniques and coordinated through global geodetic services.

name: WIDDE
description: This next generation database is dedicated to the storage and management of dense genotyping data sets (up to several hundreds of thousands markers genotyped on thousands of individuals). It includes several utilities to select (on a population and/or marker location basis) data subsets, to perform basic data quality check and standard population genetics analyses (test of Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, Principal Component Analysis) and to export the resulting datasets in various popular formats. Users can also upload their own genotyping data and explore them with data stored in WIDDE and assign new individuals to WIDDE populations using distance-based method and supervised hierarchical clustering. WIDDE contains public (freely accessible) and private (accessible via a login and password) data. The current version features cattle and sheep data but expect more to come!

name: PlantRNA
description: The PlantRNA database compiles tRNA gene sequences retrieved from fully annotated plant nuclear, plastidial and mitochondrial genomes. For each tRNA gene, the linear secondary structure is given as well as biological information. This includes 5'- and 3'- flanking sequences, A and B box sequences, region of transcription initiation and poly(T) transcription termination stretches, tRNA intron sequences, aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases and enzymes responsible for tRNA maturation and modification. Data on mitochondrial import of nuclear-encoded tRNAs as well as the bibliome for the respective tRNAs and tRNA binding proteins are also included.

name: OryGenesDB: an interactive tool for rice reverse genetics
description: The aim of this Oryza sativa database was first to display sequence information such as the T-DNA and Ds flanking sequence tags (FSTs) produced in the framework of the French genomics initiative Genoplante and the EU consortium Cereal Gene Tags. This information was later linked with related molecular data from external rice molecular resources (cDNA full length, Gene, EST, Markers, Expression data...).

name: Open Neuroscience Graph
description: The Open Neuroscience Graph is an open-access, curated knowledge graph that maps the open science ecosystem in neuroscience as a browsable digital garden. Built from an Obsidian vault and published as a static website using Quartz, the project replaces traditional linear presentation with a networked structure of interlinked Markdown notes. Bidirectional links, full-text search, and an integrated graph visualization allow users to navigate thematic relationships dynamically rather than sequentially. The complete source material is openly available to sustain, replicate and extend the resource, including all Markdown content, media attachments, Quartz configuration files, and site customizations. Researchers, educators, and open-science practitioners may explore the site directly, download the vault for offline use in Obsidian, or fork the material to build new, derivative knowledge bases.

name: SulfAtlas
description: Widespread in nature, sulfated biomolecules are highly diverse in chemical structure and biological function. These compounds include sulfate esters (ROSO3-) and sulfamates (RN(H)SO3-) and range from small molecules to complex polymers. Sulfatases cleave sulfate groups from such molecules and constitute a biologically and industrially important group of enzymes. However, the number of sulfatases which have been characterized is limited in comparison to the huge diversity of the sulfated compounds. In the context of the explosion of genomic data, the functional annotation of sulfatases is thus particularly prone to flaws and misinterpretations. A classification system allowing for a better prediction of substrate specificity and for setting the limit of functional annotations was therefore urgently needed for sulfatases. SulfAtlas describes the family and sub-families of structurally-related sulfatases. Sub-families are created based on phylogenetic analyses and essentially correspond to different substrate specificities. Experimental evidences for the activity of new sulfatases will be regularly updated.

name: RENAG-DC
description: RENAG (Réseau NAtional GNSS permanent) is the French national research infrastructure for continuous GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) observations, providing long-term scientific data from a network of permanent stations. It acquires, archives, validates, and distributes GNSS data that support geoscience research such as crustal deformation, sea-level change, and atmospheric studies.

name: SpodoBase
description: SpodoBase is an integrated database for the genomics of the Lepidoptera Spodoptera frugiperda. It is a publicly available structured database with insect pest sequences which will allow identification of a number of genes and comprehensive cloning of gene families of interest for the scientific community.

name: ILL Data Portal
description: In order to control access to the experimental data obtained at the ILL in a coherent and secure fashion, the ILL has developed a portal for consulting, downloading and managing your data. Here “data” is understood to mean raw data, processed data, and meta-data (e.g. log files or “logs”).

name: BASS2000 Solar Survey Archive
description: BASS2000 archives and distributes groundbased solar observations provided by various instruments: the THEMIS telescop,  the RadioHéliographe and Réseau Décamétrique of Nancay, the SpectroHéliographes of Meudon and Coimbra, the Coronographe and CLIMSO of Pic du Midi, USET at Royal Observatory of Belgium.

name: GnpIS
description: Genetic and Genomic Information System (GnpIS) at INRAE URGI. Multispecies portal bridging plant and fungal genetic maps, markers, phenotypes, germplasm, and genome annotations.

name: National Inventory of Natural Heritage
description: The National Inventory of Natural Heritage (INPN) is a repository for data needed for the development of conservation strategies and the dissemination of information as well as national and international reports relating to the French natural heritage (plant and animal species, natural habitats and geological heritage). It was created to provide a national reference bank for French biodiversity.

name: OPTEER
description: OPTEER is the public Climat-Air-Énergie knowledge platform of observatory ORECA in Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, with territorial factsheets, maps and charts. Advanced features may require a free account.

name: Atmo BFC
description: Open data portal. managed by Atmo BFC. providing access to atmo bfc.

name: Grand Besançon
description: Open data portal. managed by Grand Besançon. providing access to grand besançon.

name: SIG du Département de la Nièvre
description: Public SIG of the Département de la Nièvre with road conditions, traffic orders and drinking-water maps.

name: Bègles en cartes
description: Bègles en cartes is a geoportal published by Ville de Bègles for Gironde, using Custom software. It is available at carte.mairie-begles.fr. Catalog id cartemairiebeglesfr.

name: Seine Aval
description: Geoportal. managed by Seine Aval. providing access to seine aval.

name: Kurdistan Region Statistics Office Indicators
description: Kurdistan Region Statistics Office public indicator catalog of health, education, poverty, prices, and related official statistics by governorate.

name: EIS Iraq Environmental Information System
description: Environmental Information System of Iraq (EIS Iraq), a UNEP/GEF/CIMA platform for the Ministry of Environment. Public catalog of environmental indicators, graphs, documents, and WebGIS layers covering land, water, biodiversity, marine and coastal themes, hazards, and related SDG reporting.

name: Central Bank of Iraq Statistical Website
description: Central Bank of Iraq statistical website of economic and financial time series, including monetary, banking, and related indicators, with public table views.

name: Iraqi Agrometeorological Network
description: Ministry of Agriculture station network publishing public daily and weekly agrometeorological tables (rainfall, temperature, humidity, wind, solar radiation) by governorate and station.

name: Iraq Displacement Tracking Matrix
description: IOM Iraq Displacement Tracking Matrix country portal. Publishes IDP and returnee Master List datasets, dashboards, and informal-site assessments by governorate, district, subdistrict, and location.

name: National Open Government Portal
description: Iraq's bilingual national open government data portal. Publishes official datasets from ministries and other government entities by organization and topic, with a public geospatial data section, developed with the National Center for Digital Transformation (NDTC).

name: Open Data Gate of UOITC
description: Open data portal of the University of Information Technology and Communications (UoITC) in Baghdad. Publishes university datasets on faculties, employees, payroll, students, graduates, research, ranking, and continuing education.

name: Iraq LD Monitor
description: Iraq LD Monitor is the national land-degradation knowledge platform of the Ministry of Environment, developed with FAO. It publishes land-cover, productivity, and soil organic carbon maps, governorate profiles, and a download center aligned with UNCCD SDG 15.3.1.

name: Iraq Geographic Portal
description: Iraq Geographic Portal (بوابة العراق الجغرافية). National catalog of public GIS services from ministries and governorates, including Baghdad and Nineveh spatial atlases, hosted as ArcGIS web maps by the National Center for Spatial Data Management.

name: Iraqi Digital Repository
description: Iraqi Digital Repository is a scientific data repository operated by Library of the Al-Abbas Holy Shrine.

name: Portal de Datos Abiertos Diputación Provincial de Cuenca
description: Datos abiertos que pueden ser reutilizados o redistribuidos libremente por cualquier persona.

name: Gobierno abierto Ayuntamiento de Cuenca
description: Open data portal. managed by Gobierno abierto Ayuntamiento de Cuenca. providing access to gobierno abierto ayuntamiento de cuenca.

name: Ayuntamiento de Alcázar de San Juan - Portal de Datos Abiertos
description: Portal de datos abiertos del Ayuntamiento de Alcázar de San Juan que proporciona acceso a información pública municipal para promover la transparencia y la reutilización de datos. El portal incluye conjuntos de datos sobre administración municipal, servicios públicos, urbanismo, movilidad, medio ambiente, presupuestos, contrataciones públicas y otros temas de interés ciudadano. Los datos están disponibles en formatos abiertos y reutilizables para facilitar su análisis y la creación de aplicaciones y servicios innovadores basados en información pública.

name: Datos abiertos de la Universidad de Castilla - La Mancha
description: Open data portal of the University of Castilla-La Mancha (Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha, UCLM) providing access to institutional transparency data and open datasets. The portal is part of the university's transparency and open government initiatives, offering datasets related to institutional activities, administrative information, and public sector data. It supports transparency requirements and enables public access to university data for research, analysis, and accountability purposes.

name: EIEL Diputación de Toledo
description: Public EIEL map viewer of the Diputación de Toledo for municipal infrastructure and local equipment survey layers in the province.

name: Oficina de dades obertes - Govern de les Illes Balears
description: Open data portal of the Government of the Balearic Islands, providing access to datasets published by regional government entities.

name: Ports de Balears open data
description: Catálogo de datos abiertos del Ports de Balears.

name: Portal de Cartografia de Menorca
description: Geoportal. managed by Consell Insular de Menorca. powered by Custom software. accessible at cartografia.cime.es.

name: SOCIB Data Catalog
description: SOCIB web data catalog for Balearic Islands coastal observing and forecasting system oceanographic datasets.

name: Balearic Islands Coastal Observing and Forecasting System Data Repository
description: The Balearic Islands Coastal Observing and Forecasting System Data Repository (SOCIB) Data Repository contains data collected for both coastal and open ocean regions. The collection includes data from, high frequency radar, gliders, drifters, research vessel instruments, profilers, and moorings, amongst others, and advanced numerical model simulations from the Forecasting System.

name: SIE Sistema de Información Estadística de Castilla y León
description: Sistema de Información Estadística (SIE) multidimensional warehouse of the Junta de Castilla y León. Public SAS/IntrNet table builder for regional, provincial, and municipal statistics, distinct from the estadistica.jcyl.es CMS.

name: Estadística de Castilla y León
description: Official statistics portal of the Junta de Castilla y León, publishing regional statistical operations, tables, and indicator products.

name: Portal de datos abiertos de Castilla y León
description: Portal de datos abiertos de Castilla y León

name: Open Data - Datos Abiertos - Ayuntamiento de Valladolid
description: Portal de datos abiertos del Ayuntamiento de Valladolid que proporciona acceso a información pública municipal para promover la transparencia y la reutilización de datos. El portal incluye conjuntos de datos sobre administración municipal, servicios públicos, urbanismo, movilidad, medio ambiente, presupuestos, contrataciones públicas y otros temas de interés ciudadano. Los datos están disponibles en formatos abiertos y reutilizables para facilitar su análisis y la creación de aplicaciones y servicios innovadores basados en información pública.

name: GIS Valladolid
description: Municipal cartography and urban evaluation GIS of the Ayuntamiento de Valladolid, with a public map viewer for city geographic information.

name: ICANE Banco de datos
description: Statistical databank of the Instituto Cántabro de Estadística (ICANE), with themed tables for Cantabria that users can query and download.

name: Ayuntamiento de Castro-Urdiales Open Data Portal
description: Portal de datos abiertos del Ayuntamiento de Castro-Urdiales que proporciona acceso a información pública municipal para promover la transparencia y la reutilización de datos. description: Portal de datos abiertos del Ayuntamiento de Camargo que proporciona acceso a información pública municipal para promover la transparencia y la reutilización de datos. El portal incluye conjuntos de datos sobre administración municipal, servicios públicos, urbanismo, movilidad, medio ambiente, presupuestos, contrataciones públicas y otros temas de interés ciudadano. Los datos están disponibles en formatos abiertos y reutilizables para facilitar su análisis y la creación de aplicaciones y servicios innovadores basados en información pública.

name: Mapas Cantabria
description: Official geographic information viewer of the Government of Cantabria. Public map viewer for consulting and downloading regional cartography, orthophotos, and GIS layers produced by the Government of Cantabria and other administrations.

name: Datos Abiertos de la Ciudad Autónoma de Melilla
description: Portal de datos abiertos de la Ciudad Autónoma de Melilla que proporciona acceso a información pública para promover la transparencia y la reutilización de datos. El portal incluye conjuntos de datos sobre administración pública, servicios públicos, urbanismo, movilidad, medio ambiente, presupuestos, contrataciones públicas y otros temas de interés ciudadano. Los datos están disponibles en formatos abiertos y reutilizables para facilitar su análisis y la creación de aplicaciones y servicios innovadores basados en información pública.

name: Pamplona Open Data Portal
description: Open data portal of the City of Pamplona providing datasets from various municipal sectors.

name: Observatorio ARGOS
description: Observatorio ARGOS of the Servicio Andaluz de Empleo. Public municipal queries of registered unemployment, job demand, and contracts, plus labour-market indicator reports. Distinct from IECA BADEA/SIMA/INDEA.

name: BADEA Banco de Datos Estadísticos de Andalucía
description: Tabular statistical warehouse of the Instituto de Estadística y Cartografía de Andalucía. Users build and download cubes covering labour, business, industry, tourism, economic accounts, living conditions, and R&D, with a JSON REST API.

name: SIMA Andalucía pueblo a pueblo
description: Sistema de Información Multiterritorial de Andalucía (SIMA) municipal and territorial statistical factsheets published by IECA for Andalusian municipalities and higher geographies.

name: INDEA Indicadores Estadísticos de Andalucía

name: DisGeNET
description: DisGeNET is a discovery platform containing one of the largest collections available of genes and variants involved in human diseases. DisGeNET integrates data from expert curated repositories, GWAS catalogues, animal models, and the scientific literature, and covers the whole landscape of human diseases. The current version of DisGeNET (v7.0) contains 1,134,942 gene-disease associations (GDAs), between 21,671 genes and 30,170 diseases, disorders, traits, and clinical or abnormal human phenotypes, and 369,554 variant-disease associations (VDAs), between 194,515 variants and 14,155 diseases, traits, and phenotypes. The data are homogeneously annotated with controlled vocabularies and community-driven ontologies. Additionally, several original metrics are provided to assist the prioritization of genotype-phenotype relationships. The information is accessible through a web interface, a Cytoscape App, an RDF SPARQL endpoint, a REST API, and an R package.

name: PeroxisomeDB

name: Agile Protein Interactomes Dataserver
description: APID Interactomes (Agile Protein Interactomes DataServer) provides information on the protein interactomes of numerous organisms, based on the integration of known experimentally validated protein-protein physical interactions (PPIs). The interactome data includes a report on quality levels and coverage over the proteomes for each organism included. APID integrates PPIs from primary databases of molecular interactions (BIND, BioGRID, DIP, HPRD, IntAct, MINT) and also from experimentally resolved 3D structures (PDB) where more than two distinct proteins have been identified. This collection references protein interactors, through a UniProt identifier.

name: Annotated regulatory Binding Sites from Orthologous Promoters
description: ABS is a database of Annotated regulatory Binding Sites from known binding sites identified in promoters of orthologous vertebrate genes.

name: Integrative Onco Genomics
description: IntOGen is a framework for automatic and comprehensive knowledge extraction based on mutational data from sequenced tumor samples from patients. The framework identifies cancer genes and pinpoints their putative mechanism of action across tumor types.

name: Isogeny Database
description: The Isogeny Database contains a collection of data on graphs of supersingular elliptic curves, and it is anticipated that higher-genus analogues of these graphs will be added in the future. The database currently contains all graphs for characteristic up to 30,000 and isogeny degrees 2 through 11, and a basic list of invariants for each graph.

name: Magic Open Data
description: Public data catalog (assumed from domain; actual description may vary based on your content).

name: BioExcel - Covid19
description: BioExcel-CV19 is a platform designed to provide web-access to atomistic-MD trajectories for macromolecules involved in the COVID-19 disease.

name: PMut Data Repository
description: PMut Data Repository collects predictions of the pathological effect of all possible single amino acid variants on Uniref Human protein sequences. Predictions were prepared using PMut 2017 predictor (2017 version).

name: 3D interacting domains
description: The database of 3D Interaction Domains (3did) is a collection of domain-domain interactions in proteins for which high-resolution three-dimensional structures are known. 3did exploits structural information to provide critical molecular details necessary for understanding how interactions occur.

name: OntoCommons ontology catalogue
description: The purpose is to list the existing domain ontologies related to the OntoCommons project and use cases topics. On the Semantic Web, ontologies define the concepts and relationships used to describe a given domain and annotate data about it. In the OntoCommons Horizon CSA we are collecting ontologies about materials, construction, manufacturing and other industries. Here you can find the list of ontologies we have identified so far.

name: PanDrugs2
description: PanDrugs provides a bioinformatics platform to prioritize anticancer drug treatments according to individual multi-omics data. The current version of PanDrugs database integrates data from 23 primary sources and stores 74,087 drug-target associations obtained from 4,642 genes and 14,659 unique compounds.

name: The Improved Database Of Chimeric Transcripts and RNA-Seq Data
description: ChiTaRS 5.0 is the latest and most comprehensive chimeric transcript repository, with 111 582 annotated entries from eight species, including 23 167 known human cancer breakpoints. The database includes unique information correlating chimeric breakpoints with 3D chromatin contact maps, generated from public datasets of chromosome conformation capture techniques (Hi–C). In this update, we have added curated information on druggable fusion targets matched with chimeric breakpoints, which are applicable to precision medicine in cancers. The introduction of a new section that lists chimeric RNAs in various cell-lines is another salient feature. Finally, using text-mining techniques, novel chimeras in Alzheimer's disease, schizophrenia, dyslexia and other diseases were collected in ChiTaRS. Thus, this improved version is an extensive catalogue of chimeras from multiple species. It extends our understanding of the evolution of chimeric transcripts in eukaryotes and contributes to the analysis of 3D genome conformational changes and the functional role of chimeras in the etiopathogenesis of cancers and other complex diseases.

name: ourproject.org Collaborative Project Hosting
description: ourproject.org is a free content repository, which has translated the Free Software initiative to other fields. It includes content beyond software projects, allowing any kind of social, cultural or artistic projects to also be included.

name: CosmoHub
description: CosmoHub is a web application based on Hadoop to perform interactive exploration and distribution of massive cosmological datasets.

name: MAGNDATA
description: Collection of published commensurate and incommensurate magnetic structures with portable CIF-type files, maintained with the Bilbao Crystallographic Server. The catalog states that it holds more than 2,000 structures.

name: Proteins Mosaic Q Project Repository
description: Collaborative repository of protein structure images generated by citizen scientists and researchers as part of the Proteins Mosaic Q Project. Images are produced using Jmol with a standardized color scheme that highlights amino acid chemical types (nonpolar, polar, acidic, basic, special), enabling visual inspection of the spatial clustering pattern known as the Mosaic Q. The repository supports the gathering of independent visual evidence for a conserved structural property across protein structures.

name: COVID-19 Data Portal Spain
description: The Spanish COVID-19 Data Portal provides information, guidelines, tools and services to support researchers in utilising Spanish and European infrastructures for data sharing, in particular the European COVID-19 Data Portal. For those interested in ongoing, large research projects in Spain there is a list of projects funded by major funding agencies. It is updated at intervals with new services, tools and data.

name: FireDB
description: fireDB is a database of Protein Data Bank structures, ligands and annotated functional site residues. The database can be accessed by PDB codes or UniProt accession numbers as well as keywords.

name: MultiDark Database
description: The MultiDark database provides results from cosmological simulations performed within the MultiDark project. This database can be queried by entering SQL statements directly into the Query Form. The access to that form and thus access to the public & private databases is password protected.

name: MindBigData
description: The version 1.0 of the open database contains 1,151,268 brain signals of 2 seconds each, captured with the stimulus of seeing a digit (from 0 to 9) and thinking about it, over the course of almost 2 years between 2014 & 2015, from a single Test Subject David Vivancos. All the signals have been captured using commercial EEGs (not medical grade), NeuroSky MindWave, Emotiv EPOC, Interaxon Muse & Emotiv Insight, covering a total of 19 Brain (10/20) locations.

name: Green Non-Coding Database
description: The Green Non-Coding Database (GreeNC) is a repository of lncRNAs annotated in plants and algae. By using the same pipeline to annotate lncRNAs and organizing them in a central database we aim to provide a tool for the scientific community that can boost the research on this class of transcripts. The GreeNC database provides information about sequence, genomic coordinates, coding potential and folding energy for all the identified lncRNAs.

name: CEACS Data Library
description: CEACS Data Library, operated by Fundación Juan March, provides research data on humanities and social sciences, education sciences, and psychology.

name: LifeWatch ERIC Training Catalogue
description: Following the FAIR principles and best practices, the LifeWatch ERIC training catalogue hosts the metadata of relevant learning resources so that these can be shared, searched, discovered, accessed and reused. The LifeWatch ERIC training catalogue’s accurate and descriptive metadata allow all users to find the most appropriate and well-suited educational resources for their needs.

name: Futurelan
description: Lanbide Futurelan public explorer of employment projections for Basque Country sectors, occupations, and education levels. Distinct from the Eustat PxWeb databank.

name: Udalmap indicadores municipales
description: Udalmap municipal sustainability and equipment indicators for the Basque Autonomous Community. Public indicator selector with CSV, JSON, and REST/LOD downloads, distinct from the Eustat PxWeb databank and from Open Data Euskadi.

name: Gobierno Vasco Open Data Portal
description: Catálogo de datos del Gobierno Vasco, portal de información geográfica y temática.

name: Open data Vitoria-Gasteiz
description: Estamos abiertos a sus aportaciones o sugerencias.

name: Bilbao OPEN DATA
description: Open data portal. managed by Bilbao OPEN DATA. providing access to bilbao open data.

name: Getxo Opendata
description: Open data portal. managed by Getxo Opendata. providing access to getxo opendata.

name: GEO Vitoria-Gasteiz
description: Municipal geoportal of Vitoria-Gasteiz (GEO Vitoria-Gasteiz), with a public map viewer and WMS services for city and environmental cartography. Distinct from the municipal open-data portal.

name: SIG Errenteria
description: Municipal GIS of Errenteria with a public street-map viewer and PGOU cartography, linked from the town hall planning site. Distinct from the municipal open-data catalogue on Gipuzkoa Irekia.

name: GeoBilbao
description: Public geographic data viewer of the Ayuntamiento de Bilbao.

name: b5m - Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de Gipuzkoa
description: Geoportal. managed by Diputación Foral de Gipuzkoa. powered by Custom software. accessible at b5m.gipuzkoa.net.

name: ESS StatBank
description: Statistical databank of the Ethiopian Statistical Service. Provides queryable national official statistics and indicator reports across economic and social themes.

name: BOOST Cameroon Open Budget portal
description: Ministry of Finance BOOST / open-budget portal with interactive tables of Cameroon government revenue and expenditure and downloadable BOOST files from the fichiersBoost section.

name: Plateforme Urbaine du Cameroun
description: National urban geoportal for Cameroon infrastructure and planning data. Public Hydra catalog of resources, projects, and QGIS/MapStore atlases.

name: マップあいち
description: Aichi Prefecture integrated GIS (マップあいち) publishing prefectural map layers and related open geospatial data.

name: ちばの大気環境
description: Chiba Prefecture's air environment portal publishing atmospheric monitoring data and downloads.

name: 福岡県地理情報提供システム
description: Fukuoka Prefecture's geographic information system providing prefectural spatial data and maps.

name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Statistics
description: Official statistics site of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Statistics Division. Searchable catalog of prefectural surveys and yearbook tables (population, economy, prices, industry) as Excel, CSV, and PDF.

name: Arctic and Antarctic Data
description: Arctic Data archive System (ADS) collects observation data and modeling products obtained by various Japanese research projects and gives researchers access to these resources. Includes features like metadata catalog, real time monitors, sea route search, live camera, Arctic research directory, and ADS data registration.

name: 20万分の1日本シームレス地質図 (1:200,000 Seamless Geological Map of Japan)
description: AIST/GSJ seamless geological map viewer for Japan (1:200,000) with 2D/3D viewers and legend-based layer switching; sibling product of the registered GeoNavi on the same host.

name: Ibaraki Shared Open Data Catalog
description: Shared open data catalog used by Ibaraki municipalities including Joso, Naka, Sakuragawa, Namegata, Tsukubamirai, Omitama, Ibaraki Town, Oarai, Miho, and Ami.

name: ORDEN（Osaka Regional Data Exchange Network）
description: Osaka Regional Data Exchange Network (ORDEN), Osaka Prefecture's open data portal for the prefecture and its municipalities.

name: 福井県庁GISポータル
description: Fukui Prefecture GIS portal publishing sediment-disaster, flood, and tsunami hazard map viewers.

name: 福井市都市計画情報Webサービス
description: Fukui City urban planning WebGIS publishing zoning, district plans, and related map layers.

name: 小諸もろもろマップ
description: Komoro City's web map portal (Komoro Moromoro Map) with municipal spatial layers.

name: 富山県GIS
description: Toyama Prefecture public GIS publishing cultural heritage, hazard, and other prefectural map layers.

name: 奈良観光データポータル
description: Nara tourism open data portal operated by the INVOLVE NPO.

name: にしのみやオープンデータ
description: Nishinomiya city open data catalog with keyword search, CSV and XML downloads, and dashboards for statistics, city administration, and living environment.

name: にしのみやWebGIS
description: Nishinomiya City public WebGIS publishing cultural, public-facility, and disaster-prevention map layers.

name: Social Science Japan Data Archive
description: Social Science Japan Data Archive (SSJDA) at the University of Tokyo Institute of Social Science. Collects, preserves, and disseminates Japanese labor and social-survey microdata for secondary analysis. Metadata is open; dataset access is restricted.

name: RAIDA Regional Revitalization Data Platform
description: Regional revitalization data analysis and evaluation platform (RAIDA) from the Cabinet Office. Public regional indicators and summaries on population, tourism, and related themes; successor to V-RESAS.

name: 日本都道府県市区町村データ
description: Community-maintained data site with structured data on Japanese prefectures, cities, towns and villages.

name: JEPX Spot Market Data
description: Day-ahead spot prices and traded volumes on the Japan Electric Power Exchange.

name: 石油統計データ
description: Petroleum Association of Japan's official oil statistics data portal.

name: IPSS Population Statistics Collection
description: Population Statistics of Japan (Jinko Tokei Shiryoshu), the annual indicator collection of the National Institute of Population and Social Security Research. Online tables cover fertility, mortality, nuptiality, households, and prefecture series, with Excel and CSV downloads.

name: JIP Database
description: Japan Industrial Productivity (JIP) Database 2026 from RIETI and the Institute of Economic Research, Hitotsubashi University. Industry-level growth accounting, capital, labour, and input-output tables as Excel downloads.

name: 貿易統計データベース
description: Trade statistics database of the Japan Leather and Leather Goods Industries Association.

name: RESAS Regional Economy Society Analyzing System
description: Regional Economy Society Analyzing System (RESAS). Government maps and charts of prefecture and municipality indicators on industry, population, tourism, and consumption. The former RESAS Open API ended in March 2025; the public dashboard remains available without login.

name: Trade Statistics of Japan
description: Ministry of Finance Japan Customs trade statistics. Public search of ordinary and special trade tables by HS statistical commodity code, partner country, and customs office, with CSV download of query results.

name: BOJ Time-Series Data Search
description: BOJ's main time-series statistics is updated three times on each business day at around 9:00, 12:00, and 15:00 JST. Flat files of data packages become available for downloading by around 10:00 a.m. on the day of the release of each statistics.

name: Japan SDG Global Indicators
description: Official Japan SDG global indicator pages on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs JAPAN SDGs Action Platform. Time series and metadata for UN SDG indicators, published by goal rather than as an Open SDG site.

name: LUFT DATA
description: LUFT DATA, a data search platform aggregating Japanese open datasets.

name: GTFSデータリポジトリ
description: Japanese national GTFS repository (gtfs-data.jp) listing 600+ municipal and regional bus feeds from 400+ organizations, with a public catalog UI and harvest API at api.gtfs-data.jp/v2/feeds.

name: Dataset | ROIS-DS Center for Open Data in the Humanities
description: We provide three types of datasets, namely Kuzushiji-MNIST、Kuzushiji-49、Kuzushiji-Kanji, for different purposes. Pre-Modern Japanese Text, owned by National Institute of Japanese Literature, consists of image and text data and was released as open data. Some books also have summary, transcription, and tagging data. Cooking books in the Edo period, provided from Dataset of Pre-Modern Japanese Text, were curated for creating recipe datasets through the process of transcription, translation to modern Japanese, and structuring into the recipe format. As a by-product of transcription for the Dataset of Pre-Modern Japanese Text (PMJT), shapes and coordinates of old Japanese characters (Kuzushiji) were compiled to create another dataset for training to make machines and humans smarter. Adapted from Kuzushiji Dataset, KMNIST dataset is a drop-in replacement for MNIST dataset. We provide three types of datasets, namely Kuzushiji-MNIST、Kuzushiji-49、Kuzushiji-Kanji, for different purposes. Seal Script Dataset is a machine learning-friendly dataset of 'Tensho' character images cropped from old dictionaries of characters from Japan and China to be used for the interpretation of seals.... Based on the results of digitization of magazines published in the early to mid-Meiji period (modern magazines), we release machine learning datasets for OCR and develop OCR software (Kindai-OCR).

name: KYOTO DATA MARKETPLACE
description: KYOTO DATA MARKETPLACE (京都データ取引市場) public catalog of more than 1,000 named datasets, mixing free open data with priced commercial products.

name: Japan Data Exchange (JDEX)
description: JDEX data marketplace operated by Japan Data Exchange Inc. Public homepage lists named datasets; some listings require a free membership to view.

name: DataMart
description: DataMart AI-training data marketplace operated by AOS Data. Public homepage lists named datasets; purchase requires a free membership.

name: 地図・空中写真閲覧サービス
description: GSI catalog for searching and viewing historical and current topographic maps and aerial photographs of Japan.

name: 地理空間情報ライブラリー
description: GSI geospatial information library for searching, viewing, and obtaining maps and geospatial content produced by GSI and other Japanese public bodies.

name: 地質図Navi (GeomapNavi)
description: Geological Survey of Japan web GIS for viewing and using national geological maps and related geoscience layers.

name: ハザードマップポータルサイト
description: National hazard map portal providing overlay flood, landslide, storm surge, and tsunami risk layers (重ねるハザードマップ) and links to municipal hazard maps.

name: 基盤地図情報ダウンロードサービス
description: Download service for Japan's Fundamental Geospatial Data (FGD), including basic map items and digital elevation models. User registration is required to download files.

name: GISC Tokyo
description: WMO Global Information System Centre Tokyo operated by the Japan Meteorological Agency. Public WIS portal for discovery, access and retrieval of WIS metadata, with an OAI-PMH provider for the full WIS catalogue.

name: J-SHIS 地震ハザードステーション
description: Japan Seismic Hazard Information Station providing probabilistic seismic hazard maps, subsurface data, and related geospatial products from NIED.

name: 統計GIS / jSTAT MAP
description: Statistics Bureau geographic information system providing census and other official statistics as maps, plus small-area and mesh boundary data downloads (jSTAT MAP).

name: 位置参照情報ダウンロードサービス
description: MLIT location reference information download service providing geocoded address and block-level reference data for Japan.

name: 国土数値情報ダウンロードサイト
description: MLIT National Land Numerical Information download catalog of GIS datasets on land use, infrastructure, disaster risk, urban planning, and land prices.

name: JAXA G-Portal
description: JAXA Earth observation data portal for searching and downloading satellite products such as GCOM-C/SGLI.

name: KuniJiban 国土地盤情報検索サイト
description: National geotechnical information search site for borehole logs and soil test results from MLIT civil works, operated by the Public Works Research Institute.

name: NICT AI Data Testbed
description: NICT catalog of datasets for AI research and development, searchable across language, speech, bio, brain, atmosphere, space weather, cybersecurity, and machine-learning collections.

name: Create with AI – Datasets
description: Curated catalog of machine learning and AI datasets from the Create with AI project, focused on AI and creative expression. Features image, audio, video, and multimodal datasets with Japanese and English coverage.

name: ABCI Datasets
