description: AI Bridging Cloud Infrastructure (ABCI) is the world first large-scale Open AI Computing Infrastructure, constructed and operated by National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST).

name: GSI Dataset (CNN feature extraction training data)
description: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan labeled aerial-photo training datasets for semantic segmentation of map features such as roads, buildings, water, and vegetation.

name: SIGNATE
description: Japanese data science competition platform with a catalog of challenge datasets.

name: e-Gov API Catalog
description: e-Gov API Catalog is a api catalog operated by Digital Agency of Japan.

name: Nobeyama Radio Polarimeters
description: The NoRP continuously observes the full Sun at microwave frequencies, measuring both total radio flux and circular polarization. Its data archive provides raw and calibrated data, daily averaged fluxes, and time series with high temporal resolution. The publicly available archive goes back to 1978, and earlier data from predecessor instruments at lower frequencies are also included via the merged datasets.

name: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes
description: Suite of integrated databases (PATHWAY, GENES, COMPOUND, BRITE, etc.) for molecular biology, genomics and chemistry, with web UI and REST API (rest.kegg.jp). Bulk FTP requires subscription.

name: GlyTouCan
description: The international glycan structure repository for glycans published in the literature. Any glycan structure, ranging in resolution from monosaccharide composition to fully defined structures can be registered and have an accession number assigned as long as there are no inconsistencies in the structure.

name: Database of Kashiwa Encyclopedia for human genome mutations in Regulatory regions and their Omics contexts
description: The Database of Kashiwa Encyclopedia for human genome mutations in Regulatory regions and their Omics contexts (DBKERO) stores transcriptome information with a catalogue of genomic variations including public SNP data and epigenome information to enable further in-depth analyses on the disease-causing molecular mechanisms. Recent additions include genomic variation datasets and epigenome variation datasets focusing on the Japanese population. These datasets were collected as a series of genome-wide association studies and as part of International Human Epigenome Consortium (IHEC) projects. The goal is to have this database serve as a model case for the genomic, epigenomic and transcriptomic variations occurring in particular ethnic backgrounds and underlying various diseases. Clinical samples data were also associated with data from various model systems such as drug perturbation datasets using cultured cancer cells.

name: Riken open science portal
description: Integrated data catalog providing access to plant metabolome, imaging, and various life science datasets from RIKEN.

name: World Data Centre for Greenhouse Gases
description: WDCGG serves to collect, archive and distribute data on greenhouse gases (CO2, CH4, CFCs, N2O, etc.) and other related gases (CO, etc.) in the atmosphere and elsewhere as observed under the Global Atmosphere Watch Programme (GAW) programme. The data comes from organizations and individual researchers worldwide (referred to here simply as contributors).

name: 国立高専研究情報ポータル
description: Research information portal of the National Institute of Technology (KOSEN), aggregating research outputs across Japan's colleges of technology.

name: Plant Promoter Database
description: Genome-wide plant promoter database for several plant species, including Arabidopsis thaliana, rice, poplar, and Physcomitrella patens.

name: Astronomical Data Archives Center
description: Astronomical Data Archives Center of the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan, archiving and distributing observational astronomy data.

name: Integbio Database Catalog
description: This database collects URL information from international life science databases. Information about the publishing, updating or closing of databases is not always announced in research papers, so searching the literature alone is insufficient for comprehending trends in research fields. This service compiles summary information on more than 2,541 databases and ensures the information is permanently available for comprehensive search and browsing.

name: RDF Portal
description: The RDF Portal provides a collection of life science datasets in RDF (Resource Description Framework). The portal aims to accelerate integrative utilization of the heterogeneous datasets deposited by various research institutions and groups. In this portal, each dataset comes with a summary, downloadable files and a SPARQL endpoint.

name: Human Genetic Variation Database
description: The Human Genetic Variation Database (HGVD) aims to provide a central resource to archive and display Japanese genetic variation and association between the variation and transcription level of genes. The database currently contains genetic variations determined by exome sequencing of 1,208 individuals and genotyping data of common variations obtained from a cohort of 3,248 individuals. The HGVD browser can be used to view allele and genotype frequencies, number of samples, coverages, and expression QTL (eQTL) significances.

name: Japan Proteome Standard Repository
description: jPOSTrepo (Japan ProteOme STandard Repository) is a data repository of sharing MS raw/processed data.

name: ChemTHEATRE
description: ChemTHEATRE is an online resource for browsing and analyzing curated and user-contributed data sets of environmental contaminants. ChemTHEATRE also stores metadata of the samples and of the experimental methods.

name: Japanese Virtual Observatory
description: Japanese Virtual Observatory portal for discovering and accessing Japanese astronomical data collections via IVOA protocols.

name: GlycoNAVI
description: GlycoNAVI is a repository of data relevant to carbohydrate research. It contains a free suite of carbohydrate research tools organized by domain, including glycans, proteins, lipids, genes, diseases and samples.

name: Japan Chemicals Collaborative Knowledge database
description: J-CHECK is a database developed to provide the information regarding "Act on the Evaluation of Chemical Substances and Regulation of Their Manufacture, etc. " (CSCL) by the authorities of the law, Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, and Ministry of the Environment. It provides information such as the list of CSCL, chemical safety information obtained in the existing chemicals survey program, Japan Challenge Program, etc.

name: JAMSTEC GODAC DARWIN
description: DARWIN cruise data and sample catalog of JAMSTEC GODAC, providing metadata and access to research-vessel observations and samples.

name: Protein Structure Change Database
description: The Protein Structural Change DataBase (PSCDB) presents the structural changes found in proteins, represented by pairs of ligand-free and ligand-bound structures of identical proteins, and links these changes to ligand-binding.  It classifies protein structural changes into 7 classes, in terms of the ligand binding sites and the location where the dominant motion occurs.

name: Metabolonote
description: Metabolonote is a specialized database system that manages metadata for experimental data obtained through the study of Metabolomics. This system was developed with the aim of promoting the publication and utilization of Metabolomics data by simplifying the metadata recording process.

name: Influenza Life Cycle pathway map
description: To understand the mechanisms of influenza A viral replication and the host responses, we took the literature-based manual curation approach to construct a comprehensive influenza virus-host respoce map. The infuenza A virus (IAV) comprehensive pathway map (FluMap) was constructed by manual curation with the literature as well as various pathway databases such as Reactome, KEGG and Panther Pathway database.

name: NEAR-GOOS Regional Delayed Mode Data Base
description: NEAR-GOOS regional delayed-mode database of ocean and marine-meteorology observations for the North-East Asian GOOS region, operated by JODC.

name: Yamaguchi University Navigator for Open access Collection and Archives
description: Institutional repository of Yamaguchi University. IRDB reports 2 dataset records (July 2026).

name: NINJAL Corpus Portal
description: Portal to Japanese language corpora and related language resources published by NINJAL.

name: National Institute of Polar Research Science Database
description: The National Institute of Polar Research (NIPR) serves as Japan’s National Antarctic Data Center under the Scientific Committee on Antarctic Research (SCAR). It collects, archives, and shares scientific data from Japan’s polar research, especially from the International Polar Year (2007–2008) and the Japanese Antarctic Research Expeditions (JARE).

name: MassBank Human
description: Shin-MassBank spectral library of averaged product-ion spectra derived from metabolome DDA/IDA datasets, including known and unknown compounds.

name: Human Gene and Protein Database
description: Human Gene and Protein Database (HGPD) presents SDS-PAGE patterns and other informations of human genes and proteins.

name: UMIN Clinical Trials Registry
description: UMIN-CTR is a Clinical Trials Registry hosted by the japanese University Hospital Medical Information Network (UMIN). UMIN-CTR has been recognized by the ICMJE as an "acceptable registry". At a minimum, a paper should be received for consideration by an ICMJE-affiliated journal, if the corresponding trial is registered by the appropriate deadline with UMIN-CTR. The WHO is developing the International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (ICTRP) project in order to collect various clinical trial registry systems throughout the world under fixed standards as "member registries" and "associate registries. "

name: GlycoPOST
description: GlycoPOST is a mass spectrometry data repository for glycomics. Users can release their "raw/processed" data via this site with a unique identifier number for the paper publication. Submission conditions are in accordance with the Minimum Information Required for a Glycomics Experiment (MIRAGE) guidelines.

name: FlyGlycoDB
description: The glycobiology of Drosophila has been extensively studied in recent years, and much information has accumulated regarding glycan-related genes and proteins in Drosophila. As a database for glycan-related genes in Drosophila, FlyGlycoDB provides specific access to this information.

name: REFOLDdb
description: REFOLDdb is a resource for the optimization of protein refolding, referring to published methods employed in the refolding of recombinant proteins. It stores a collection of published experimental approaches and records for refolding proteins. It contains data converted from the original REFOLD database that had been created and updated until 2009 by Monash University in Australia, as well as data retrieved from articles on refold technologies published since 2009.

name: Data Integration and Analysis System
description: The Data Integration and Analysis System (DIAS) was created to collect and store earth observation data; to analyze such data in combination with socio-economic data, and convert data into information useful for crisis management with respect to global-scale environmental disasters, and other threats; and to make this information available within Japan and overseas.

name: JAXA Lunar and Planetary Exploration Data Analysis Group Archive
description: JAXA's Lunar and Planetary Exploration Data Analysis Group (JLPEDA) archive of Japanese lunar and planetary mission data.

name: Spectral Database for Organic Compounds (SDBS)
description: AIST spectral database of organic compounds covering NMR, IR, Raman, MS, and ESR.

name: PubChemQC
description: Quantum-chemically optimized structures and properties for PubChem compounds.

name: AIST Network Database System for Thermophysical Property Data
description: AIST/NMIJ network database of evaluated thermophysical properties such as thermal conductivity, thermal diffusivity, heat capacity, density, surface tension, and vapor pressure.

name: Protein Data Bank Japan
description: Japanese wwPDB member catalog of macromolecular structures, with search, visualization, and downloads.

name: GlycoProtDB
description: GlycoProtDB is a glycoprotein database providing information of Asn (N)-glycosylated proteins and their glycosylated site(s), which were constructed by employing a bottom-up strategy using actual glycopeptide sequences identified by LC/MS-based glycoproteomic technologies. The database is searchable using gene ID, gene name, and its description (protein name) as query. Each data sheet of glycproteins is based on a single amino acid sequence in Wormpep database for C.elegans and NCBI Refseq database for mouse. The sheet presents actually detected N-glycosylation site(s) which are displayed each capturing methods of glycopeptide subset, e.g., lectins Concanavalin A, wheat germ agglutinin (WGA), or HILIC (hydrophilic interaction chromatography), as well as potential N-glycosylation sites (NX[STC], X≠P). Protein sequences, which have common glycopeptide sequence(s), are linked each other.

name: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes
description: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, including compound, reaction, glycan, and pathway data.

name: KNApSAcK
description: Species-metabolite relationship database for plant and microbial natural products.

name: Subaru-Mitaka Okayama-Kiso Archive Photometry
description: Subaru Observatory Astronomical Projects data archive at the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan.

name: RIKEN Arabidopsis Genome Encyclopedia II
description: RARGE II provides basic information about the Arabidopsis genome, such as information related to cDNA sequences and transposon insertion mutants. To create it, publicly available information for a total of 66,209 Arabidopsis mutant lines was used, including loss-of-function (RATM and TARAPPER) and gain-of-function (AtFOX and OsFOX) lines, as well as phenotype data gained through the mapping of descriptions onto Plant Ontology (PO) and Phenotypic Quality Ontology (PATO) terms.

name: ERG-Science Center
description: ERG Science Center archives and distributes data from JAXA's Arase (ERG) geospace exploration satellite.

name: PGDBj Ortholog Database
description: The PGDBj Ortholog Database, created under the auspices of the Plant Genome Database Japan (PGDBj), contains information about orthologous genes in plants based on their corresponding amino acid sequence similarity. By placing PGDBj Ortholog Database as a 'hub' within a suite of resources and databases, the aim is to make reciprocal links between databases containing information about various organisms. Users can find orthologs in different subsets of organisms by searching the database using either amino acid information or keywords. The PGDBj 'amino acid sequence DB' contains 500,000 amino acid sequences from 20 plant species classified in Viridiplantae. The PGDBj Ortholog Database provides gene cluster information based on amino acid sequence similarity. Over 500,000 amino acid sequences of 20 Viridiplantae species were subjected to reciprocal BLAST searches and clustered. Sequences from plant genome DBs (e.g. TAIR10 and RAP-DB) were also included in the cluster with a direct link to the original DB. To provide outgroups in the Viridiplantae comparative analyses, ortholog data sets derived from Cyanobacteria and Deuterostomia are also being analyzed.

name: SSBD: a platform for Systems Science of Biological Dynamics
description: SSBD is a two-tiered data resource comprising SSBD:repository, a public repository for the sharing of all types of bioimaging data reported in journals, and SSBD:database, an added-value database for the sharing of curated, highly reusable data with rich metadata. It also shares large amounts of biosystems dynamics data obtained via image analysis or computer simulation.

name: UniCarb-DB
description: UniCarb-DB is a curated database of glycomic mass spectrometry fragment data.

name: Japan Existing Chemical Database
description: The Japan Existing Chemical Data Base makes available the toxicity test reports from Japan's existing chemicals safety programme. Each report consists of the nomenclature of the chemical, abstracts and summarized data from the studies in English. Individual study reports are available in Japanese.

name: Japan Space Systems
description: Japan Space Systems publishes satellite remote sensing products and related geospatial datasets.

name: Autophagy Database
description: Autophagy Database of autophagy-related proteins, genes, and literature.

name: ViBrism DB
description: ViBrism DB is a database for anatomical gene expression maps and topological co-expression network graphs created with original techniques of microtomy-based gene expression measurements, Transcriptome Tomography. The DB is equipped with a WebGL-based 2D/3D visualization platform, BAH viewer, and a network viewer. Users can access a total of 172,022 datasets of coding/non-coding transcripts and lncRNAs, present in the mouse brains at four post-natal stages. Expression maps are seen in the whole anatomical context of 3D MR images of the brains. In situ hybridization images and anatomical area maps are browsable in the same space of 3D expression maps. Created images are shareable using URLs, including scene-setting parameters. The DB is expandable by community activity.

name: NITE Japan-GHS
description: This database includes GHS classification results by the Japanese government with symbols, signal words, hazard statements and precautionary statements and rationale for the classification in accordance with the Japanese classification guidance. These classifications are advisory classifications and intended to be used as a reference for preparing GHS labelling and SDSs by enterprises.

name: ROdent Unidentified Gene-Encoded large proteins
description: The ROUGE protein database is a sister database of HUGE protein database which has accumulated the results of comprehensive sequence analysis of human long cDNAs (KIAA cDNAs). The ROUGE protein database has been created to publicize the information obtained from mouse homologues of the KIAA cDNAs (mKIAA cDNAs).

name: Panel Data Research Center Datasets
description: The Panel Data Research Center (PDRC) collects, constructs and organizes large-scale panel data sets for social science and economic research. The site provides longitudinal microdata (e.g., household and firm surveys) to qualified academic users for empirical analysis of behavior and policy effects over time.

name: Arabidopsis Thaliana Trans-factor and cis-Element prediction Database
description: ATTED-II is a coexpression database for plant species with parallel views of multiple coexpression data sets and network analysis tools. The user can find functional gene relationships and design experiments to identify gene functions by reverse genetics and general molecular biology techniques.

name: Plant Organelles Database  3
description: Plant Organelles Database 3 of the National Institute for Basic Biology, documenting plant organelle images and related data.

name: Japan Meteorological Agency Data
description: Japan Meteorological Agency public weather and climate data site, including past observation downloads and related meteorological products.

name: Comprehensive Database of Archaeological Site Reports in Japan
description: Institutional repository of Nara National Research Institute for Cultural Properties. IRDB reports 3502 dataset records (July 2026).

name: Okayama University Scientific Achievement Repository
description: Institutional repository of Okayama University. IRDB reports 1194 dataset records (July 2026).

name: DataBase of Transcriptional Start Sites
description: This database includes TSS data from adult and embryonic human tissue. DBTSS now contains 491 million TSS tag sequences for collected from a total of 20 tissues and 7 cell cultures.

name: DNA Data Bank of Japan
description: Japan's INSDC nucleotide sequence archive at the National Institute of Genetics, exchanging data daily with GenBank and ENA.

name: WDC for Ionosphere and Space Weather
description: World Data Center for Ionosphere and Space Weather at NICT, archiving ionospheric and space-weather observations.

name: Database of self-dual codes
description: This site hosts a database of self‑dual codes — lists and data files of codes over various rings and finite fields that are equal to their own dual. These include binary self‑dual codes (codes over the field with 2 elements); Hermitian and Euclidean self‑dual codes over GF(4) (the finite field with 4 elements); Ternary self‑dual codes (codes over GF(3)); Self‑dual codes over rings like ℤ₄, ℤ₆, etc.

name: SMOKA
description: Subaru-Mitaka-Okayama-Kiso Archive of optical and infrared observations from NAOJ telescopes.

name: Data Center for Aurora in NIPR
description: The Data Center for Aurora in NIPR is responsible for data archiving and dissemination of all-sky camera observations, visual observations, other optical observations (such as TV and photometric observations), auroral image and particle observations from satellites, geomagnetic observations, and observations of upper atmosphere phenomena associated with aurora.

name: MB-POST
description: Shin-MassBank metabolomics mass spectrometry repository (MB-POST) for depositing and sharing raw and processed experimental datasets.

name: Kyushu University Institutional Repository
description: Institutional repository of Kyushu University. IRDB reports 225 dataset records (July 2026).

name: World Data Center for Geomagnetism, Kyoto
description: The mission of the WDC for Geomagnetism, Kyoto is to provide geomagnetic field data supplied from a worldwide network of magnetic observatories, and the geomagnetic indices (AE index, ASY/SYM index, and Dst index) derived in this data center to researchers specializing mostly in solar terrestrial physics, and geomagnetism, the graduate students majoring in these academic disciplines, and citizens having an interest in those research fields.

name: LipidBank
description: LipidBank is an open, publicly free database of natural lipids including fatty acids, glycerolipids, sphingolipids, steroids, and various vitamins.

name: CURATOR
description: CURATOR institutional repository of Chiba University Library for research outputs and datasets.

name: Classification of association schemes with small vertices
description: Aa catalogue/database of: all association schemes up to a given number of vertices (small orders), with their parameters, intersection numbers, eigenmatrices (P and Q matrices), and structural properties (commutative, symmetric, etc.).

name: TogoVar: A comprehensive Japanese genetic variation database
description: TogoVar (A comprehensive Japanese genetic variation database) is a database that has collected and organized genome sequence differences between individuals (variants) in the Japanese population and disease information associated with them. TogoVar provides variant frequencies in the Japanese population that have been aggregated across research projects. Two available datasets, JGA-NGS and JGA-SNP, are obtained by aggregating individual genomic data that have been registered in the NBDC Human Database / Japanese Genotype-phenotype Archive (JGA). In addition, TogoVar integrates information related to genotypes or phenotypes that has been compiled independently in a variety of different databases and provides information for interpreting variants in a one-stop, easy-to-understand manner. TogoVar is developed and operated by Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS), Joint Support-Center for Data Science Research, Research Organization of Information and Systems (ROIS), and supported by Life Science Database Integration Project of Japan Science and Technology Agency.

name: J-DOSS JODC Data On-line Service System
description: Japan Oceanographic Data Center online catalog for searching and downloading oceanographic observations and related marine information.

name: Functional ANnoTation Of the Mammalian genome Database
description: FANTOM (Functional ANnoTation Of the Mammalian genome) is a worldwide collaborative project aiming at identifying all functional elements in mammalian genomes.

name: World Data Center for Cosmic Rays
description: The World Data Center for Cosmic Rays (WDCCR) provides long-term, quality-controlled observations of cosmic-ray neutron monitor data collected from stations around the world, with records dating back to 1953. The database offers standardized hourly measurements in multiple formats to support research in cosmic rays, space weather, solar–terrestrial physics, and geophysics.

name: SCPortalen
description: SCPortalen is a single-cell database created to facilitate and enable researchers to access and explore published single-cell datasets. It integrates human and mouse single-cell transcriptomics datasets, single-cell metadata, cell images and sequence information.

name: Kochi Core Center
description: Kochi Core Center marine core repository and associated scientific data from ocean drilling cores.

name: Intrinsically Disordered proteins with Extensive Annotations and Literature
description: IDEAL (Intrinsically Disordered proteins with Extensive Annotations and Literature) is a collection of experimentally-verified intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) that cannot adopt stable globular structures under physiological conditions. IDEAL contains manually curated annotations on IDPs in locations, structures, and functional sites such as protein binding regions and post-translational modification sites together with references and structural domain assignments.

name: MAWI Traffic Archive
description: WIDE backbone packet traces and related traffic datasets from the MAWI working group.

name: LSDB Archive
description: National life science database archive service that preserves and publishes downloadable datasets with standardized metadata and clear reuse conditions.

name: DARTS
description: JAXA/ISAS Data Archives and Transmission System for space science missions including astronomy, solar physics, and solar system science.

name: Miyagi Open Data Portal
description: Open Data Catalog for Miyagi Prefecture provided by the Miyagi Prefectural Government

name: 宮城県森林情報提供システム
description: Miyagi Prefecture public forest GIS publishing forest-plan maps, protection forests, and related geospatial layers.

name: Iwate Prefecture Open Data Catalog
description: Official open data catalog for Iwate Prefecture, providing datasets from local government and related agencies.

name: Hiroshima Prefectural Government Open Data Portal
description: A catalog service that allows users to search and download data. Open data is freely available to anyone for both commercial and non-commercial use. Access to infrastructure data from a map, including visualized content like disaster risk information and inspection results for public civil engineering facilities on 3D maps and GIS.

name: Hirosaki City Open Data Catalog
description: Open data catalog for Hirosaki City, Aomori Prefecture, listed by the Digital Agency as the city open data site.

name: Statistikportal Liechtenstein
description: Official statistics portal of the Liechtenstein Office of Statistics. Publishes current statistical data, analyses, and publications covering population, labour, economy, environment, health, education, transport, and other areas of public life. Complementary to the eTab PxWeb database.

name: LILEX
description: Consolidated legislation catalog of Liechtenstein (LILEX), the official legal database.

name: Geodatenportal Liechtenstein
description: Official geodata portal of the Liechtenstein National Administration. Public online maps, applications and a download area for GDI-Liechtenstein, including the GeoMapFish viewer, a metadata catalogue hosted on geocat.ch, INTERLIS models, and a geoshop.

name: Liechtenstein-Institut Datensätze
description: Public catalog of research datasets from the Liechtenstein-Institut, covering parliamentary votes, national elections since 1945, referendums since 1918, municipal council agendas, and survey/media datasets. Dataset records are listed under /datensaetze; the site is slow but the listing and record pages respond publicly.

name: Lesotho Land Cover Statistics
description: Lesotho NextGen land-cover statistics viewer (NextGen-LCDB / NextGen-Atlas / ReNOKA). Annual land-cover indicators prepared for integrated catchment management, developed with the Ministry of Forestry, Range and Soil Conservation and partner institutions.

name: Lesotho Bureau of Statistics
description: Official statistics website and data portal of Lesotho's Bureau of Statistics. Publishes indicator tables and statistical publications covering census, prices, national accounts, and social statistics.

name: Lesotho Statistical Research Portal
description: Statistical Research Portal for Lesotho macroeconomic time series. Browse by category and download series sourced from the Central Bank of Lesotho, Bureau of Statistics, and Ministry of Finance (balance of payments, national accounts, government finance, prices, and monetary survey).

name: Lesotho Soil Information System (LeSIS)
description: Lesotho Soil Information System (LeSIS). National soil and land maps from the Ministry of Forestry, Range and Soil Conservation, including primary survey points, secondary products, land maps, and related spatial layers used for digital soil mapping.

name: EirGrid Smart Grid Dashboard
description: All-island electricity generation, demand, and interconnector data published by EirGrid.

name: Tusla Data Hub
description: Tusla Child and Family Agency Data Hub of performance and activity indicators. Interactive charts cover service metrics at national, region, and area level.

name: NDTRS Interactive Tables
description: Health Research Board National Drug Treatment Reporting System interactive tables. Users query treatment episodes by substance, year, age, gender, treatment status, and geography, then export results.

name: Health System Performance Assessment Platform
description: Department of Health interactive platform for Ireland's Health System Performance Assessment framework. Public indicator pages cover access, quality, efficiency, equity, and related health-system domains with charts and downloads.

name: SEMO Market Data
description: Single Electricity Market prices, volumes, and reports for Ireland and Northern Ireland.

name: Met Éireann Open Data Portal
description: Met Éireann open data portal for radar and numerical weather prediction data in machine-readable formats.

name: Iris Oifigiúil
description: Irish official gazette of statutory announcements, public notices, and official appointments.

name: Transport Infrastructure Ireland Data Portal
description: Transport Infrastructure Ireland download portal for road network and traffic datasets, published under CC BY 4.0.

name: Met Éireann Open Observations
description: Met Éireann open observations archive with OGC API Environmental Data Retrieval collections for station-based weather observations.

name: Irish Soil Information System
description: Public soil maps, soil guide, and downloads for the Irish Soil Information System, produced by Teagasc and Cranfield University for the EPA.

name: EPA Maps GIS Data
description: EPA Maps GIS site for browsing and downloading Irish environmental spatial datasets (air, water, land, and related layers). The former GeoNetwork catalog at /geonetwork is no longer published.

name: v-sense.scss.tcd.ie Research Datasets
description: V-SENSE is a team of 20+ researchers in Visual Computing at the intersection of Computer Vision, Computer Graphics and Media Signal Processing. We are building a dynamic environment where enthusiastic young scientists with different backgrounds get together to shape the future in fundamental, as well as applied research projects.

name: EPA Ireland Environmental Open Data
description: Environmental Protection Agency Ireland REST APIs for bathing water, radiation monitoring, Water Framework Directive, licences, and related environmental data.

name: Houses of the Oireachtas Open Data APIs
description: Houses of the Oireachtas public APIs for legislation, debates, members, and related parliamentary data.

name: CSO Data Standards Portal
description: Central Statistics Office catalog of approved data standards, including concepts, questions, classifications, and code lists.

name: Recode
description: Recode (Researcher Collaboration and Data Exchange) is a University College Cork platform for sharing research datasets and collaborating on data-intensive projects.

name: Irish air quality catalog
description: Irish air-quality monitoring catalog. Station readings, maps and the Air Quality Index for Health.

name: Linguistic Linked Open Data
description: Linguistic Linked Open Data (LLOD) cloud, a community catalog of language resources published as Linked Data, with Irish academic participation from the University of Galway.

name: SAFER-Data
description: Secure Archive For Environmental Research Data, the EPA archive of publicly available environmental research datasets and reports.

name: ExplorEnz
description: The Enzyme Database was developed as a new way to access the data of the IUBMB Enzyme Nomenclature List. The data, which are stored in a MySQL database, preserve the formatting of chemical names according to IUPAC standards.

name: Ireland’s Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) Node
description: National portal that compiles biodiversity data from multiple sources and makes it freely available online.

name: STATIN Jamaica
description: Official statistics website of the Statistical Institute of Jamaica (STATIN). Publishes indicator tables, census products, and statistical publications covering population, labour, prices, and economic statistics.

name: ISA DeepData
description: ISA Deep Seabed and Ocean Database (DeepData). Public map catalog of contractor environmental baseline and assessment data for the international seabed Area. Geological resource data remain confidential.

name: Vilniaus miesto interaktyvūs žemėlapiai
description: Vilnius city public interactive maps portal with themed municipal GIS layers for planning, city maintenance, and infrastructure.

name: Šiaulių miesto atviri duomenys
description: Municipal open data portal of Šiauliai city, with themed datasets covering budget, infrastructure, GIS maps, demographics, education, health, and public procurement.

name: Lietuvos bankas statistics database
description: Bank of Lithuania statistics database covering monetary financial institutions, interest rates, investment and pension funds, insurance, and payments statistics.

name: Higienos institutas health statistics
description: Health statistics portal of the Institute of Hygiene with indicators on morbidity, hospital care, causes of death, and selected surgical procedures.

name: Official Statistics Portal of Lithuania
description: Official Statistics Portal of Lithuania providing data and metadata on various national statistics.

name: IRD crime statistics (NVŽR)
description: Public crime-statistics query of the Departmental Register of Criminal Offences (NVŽR). Filter registered and investigated offences from 2003 by municipality, Criminal Code article, and person characteristics; download PDF, Excel, or CSV.

name: Švietimo valdymo informacinė sistema (ŠVIS)
description: Education Management Information System (ŠVIS). Public education statistics and monitoring indicators for schools, municipalities, and the state, including official statistical-form tables from the National Education Agency.

name: Litgrid System Data
description: Generation, consumption, and grid statistics for the Lithuanian power system.

name: Visuomenės sveikatos stebėsenos informacinė sistema
description: Public Health Monitoring Information System with municipality- and facility-level health indicators and a public JSON API.

name: VisiMarsrutai GTFS directory
description: Public directory of Lithuanian municipal and national GTFS feeds (per-municipality zips plus gtfs_all.zip) published by the VisiMarsrutai journey-planner service.

name: Lietuvos atvirų duomenų portalas
description: Vieningas prieigos taškas prie visų Lietuvoje atvertų duomenų rinkinių ir suteikiantis technologines priemones atvirų duomenų rinkimui

name: geoportal.lt Lithuanian spatial information portal
description: National Lithuanian spatial information portal (geoportal.lt) for discovering, viewing, and downloading state geographic datasets. The former GeoNetwork metadata catalogue at /geonetwork is no longer published; INSPIRE discovery remains on inspire-geoportal.lt.

name: SRIS Protected Species Information System
description: Protected Species Information System (SRIS) catalog of species occurrence and conservation data for Lithuania.

name: REGIA
description: REGIA regional geo-information map for Lithuanian municipalities, with cadastre, addresses, property values, and municipal spatial layers.

name: Lithuania Government API Catalog
description: Official catalogue of public-sector APIs of Lithuania, operated alongside the national open data portal.

name: Lithuanian Academic Electronic Library (eLABa)
description: National aggregated open-access repository of Lithuanian research and study documents, including publications, electronic theses and dissertations, and empirical research data from higher-education and research institutions.

name: Theoretical Crystallography Open Database
description: Open-access collection of theoretically calculated or refined crystal structures of organic, inorganic, and metal-organic compounds, excluding biopolymers.

name: Predicted Crystallography Open Database
description: Public-domain collection of predicted and enumerated inorganic crystal structures (CIF), including GRINSP and ZEFSA-II models. The site reports 1,062,771 entries, and a Si-O search returns structure records.

name: Crystallography Open Database
description: Open collection of crystal structures of organic, inorganic, metal-organic compounds and minerals.

name: MIDAS National Research Data Archive
description: MIDAS is a national research data repository managed by Vilnius University. The aim of MIDAS is to collect, process, store and analyze research data and other relevant information in all fields of knowledge,   enabling free, easy and convenient access to the data via the Internet. MIDAS provides services for registered and unregistered users: students, listeners, academics, researchers, scientists, research administrators, other actors of the research and studies ecosystem, and all individuals interested in research data.

name: Føroyakort
description: Public geodata portal of Umhvørvisstovan (Faroese Environment Agency) for downloading authoritative Faroese maps and geospatial datasets, including vector maps, orthophotos, topographic maps, elevation models, and documented WMS and ArcGIS web services. Kortal.fo cadastral search is part of this site.

name: ENVOFAR
description: ENVOFAR is the public catalog of Faroese environmental and oceanographic datasets, with downloadable currents, hydrography, time series, and contaminant data maintained by Umhvørvisstovan, Havstovan (Faroe Marine Research Institute), and Firum (Aquaculture Research Station of the Faroes).

name: Cyprus Department of Meteorology WIS2 data
description: Public WIS2 file server of the Cyprus Department of Meteorology, with core weather observations (SYNOP, TEMP, wind profiles), monthly climate observations, and forecast products.

name: Cyprus Air Quality
description: Cyprus air-quality monitoring catalog. Station maps, pollution levels and measurement reports.

name: DARECLIMED Data Repository
description: DARECLIMED data repository of The Cyprus Institute for climate, water resources, and energy datasets covering the Eastern Mediterranean. Climate holdings include atmospheric and proxy data, reconstructions, and terrestrial and oceanic observations. Datasets are visualized and subset via a restricted Live Access Server (LAS); access is granted on request.

name: CyCLOPS Stations Metadata API
description: Public GNSS station metadata and RINEX product catalogue of the CyCLOPS research infrastructure. OpenAPI lists 19 stations and derived GNSS products (rinex_daily_30s, rinex_hourly_30s); displacement timeseries remain authenticated.

name: ITHANET Portal
description: ITHANET Portal for clinicians and researchers working on haemoglobinopathies. Hosts disease-specific databases of haemoglobin variants and genetic modifiers (IthaGenes), epidemiology (IthaMaps), and genotype-phenotype case reports (IthaPhen), plus news, trials, and related networks.

name: Bnei Shimon Regional Council GIS
description: Public GIS viewer of Bnei Shimon Regional Council (Hebrew interface).

name: Local Government Situation Report
description: Ministry of Interior open information system on local government in Israel. Users compare municipalities, municipal corporations, and regional clusters on demography, audit and economy, human resources, and government mechanisms.

name: CBS Database of Prices and Price Indices
description: Central Bureau of Statistics database of prices and price indices, including consumer, producer, housing, and construction input indices, with a public index API.

name: CBS 2022 Census Data
description: Central Bureau of Statistics 2022 Population Census dashboards. Users explore demographic, social, and economic census estimates by nationwide, district, locality, and statistical area, with comparison across geographies and earlier censuses.

name: Yodaat – Women and Gender Knowledge in Israel
description: Yodaat is a knowledge center and catalog of publications, organizations, and data on women and gender in Israel, maintained by a civil-society initiative.

name: Israel Water Authority National Water Map
description: National Water Map GIS portal of the Israel Water Authority, publishing hydrological and water-resource geographic layers for professionals and the public.

name: GovMap
description: GovMap is the national map portal of the Survey of Israel, providing public access to nationwide basemaps and government spatial layers.

name: HORDE
description: HORDE (Human Olfactory Data Explorer) is a searchable database of human and other mammalian olfactory receptor genes, with annotation, classification, orthologs, BLAST search, and FASTA downloads. It is developed at the Crown Human Genome Center, Weizmann Institute of Science.

name: PROTACpedia
description: PROTACpedia is a freely accessible, manually curated database of Proteolysis Targeting Chimeras (PROTACs). Public search is open; registered users can deposit records and download the full database as SDF or CSV.

name: eQuilibrator - the biochemical thermodynamics calculator
description: Thermodynamics calculator for biochemical reactions. eQuilibrator is a simple web interface designed to enable easy thermodynamic analysis of biochemical systems. eQuilibrator enables free-text search for biochemical compounds and reactions and provides thermodynamic estimates for both in a variety of conditions.

name: SNPedia
description: SNPedia is a wiki resource of the functional consequences of human genetic variation as published in peer-reviewed studies. Entries are formatted to allow associations to be assigned to single genotypes as well as sets of genotypes (genosets). Curation occurs through editorial, community/user, and semi-automated processes.

name: ODiseA
description: ODiseA (Organ-Disease Annotations) is a manually curated database of hereditary diseases and the tissues they inflict. It annotates 2,181 diseases and 1,920 causal genes across 45 tissues, with public search and bulk download.

name: VDJbase
description: VDJbase is a public database of immunoglobulin and T-cell receptor genotypes and haplotypes inferred from adaptive immune receptor repertoire sequencing (AIRR-seq). It is developed at Bar-Ilan University and supports search, population comparison, and download of genotype and haplotype records.

name: Parallel Workloads Archive
description: Archive of HPC job-log traces in Standard Workload Format for parallel-systems and scheduling research.

name: MalaCards
description: The MalaCards human disease database is an integrated compendium of annotated diseases mined from dozens of sources, with a web card for each disease covering genes, symptoms, drugs, variations, and related publications.

name: Cross-National Time-Series Data Archive
description: Cross-National Time-Series Data Archive of national political, economic, and social indicators compiled by Databanks International.

name: DifferentialNet
description: DifferentialNet is a database of differential protein-protein interactions across human tissues. Users query a protein and retrieve tissue-specific up- or down-regulated interactions by combining experimentally detected PPIs with GTEx and Human Protein Atlas expression profiles.

name: SEE Lab Data Repository
description: Public data repository of the Technion SEE Lab (Service Enterprise Engineering). It publishes operational log-file databases from call centers and hospitals at transaction resolution; three datasets (AnonymousBank, USBank, HomeHospital) are free for academic use with documentation.

name: Bitter Compounds Database
description: BitterDB is a free and searchable database of bitter compounds. Compounds can be searched by name, chemical structure, similarity to other bitter compounds, association with a particular human bitter taste receptor, and so on. The database also contains information on mutations in bitter taste re- ceptors that were shown to influence receptor activation by bitter compounds. The aim of BitterDB is to facilitate studying the chemical features associated with bitterness.

name: Proteopedia
description: Proteopedia is a collaborative 3D encyclopedia of protein, nucleic acid, and other biomolecule structures. Maintained with the Israel Structural Proteomics Centre at the Weizmann Institute of Science, it holds more than 125,000 structure pages with interactive annotations.

name: TRACE
description: TRACE (Tissue Risk Assessment of Causality by Expression) is a catalog of tissue-associated disease-risk scores for 18,927 human protein-coding genes. Users can download the catalog or upload a gene list or VCF and a disease-inflicted tissue to obtain TRACE scores.

name: TissueNet
description: Knowledge of the molecular interactions of human proteins within tissues is important for identifying their tissue-specific roles and for shedding light on tissue phenotypes. However, many protein-protein interactions (PPIs) have no tissue-contexts. The TissueNet database bridges this gap by associating experimentally-identified PPIs with human tissues that were shown to express both pair-mates. Users can select a protein and a tissue, and obtain a network view of the query protein and its tissue-associated PPIs. TissueNet v.2 is an updated version of the TissueNet database previously featured in NAR. It includes over 40 human tissues profiled via RNA-sequencing or protein-based assays. Users can select their preferred expression data source and interactively set the expression threshold for determining tissue-association. The output of TissueNet v.2 underlines qualitative and quantitative features of query proteins and their PPIs. The tissue-specificity view highlights tissue-specific and globally-expressed proteins, and the quantitative view highlights proteins that were differentially expressed in the selected tissue relative to all other tissues. Together, these views allow users to quickly assess the unique versus global functionality of query proteins. Thus, TissueNet v.2 offers an extensive, quantitative and user-friendly interface to study the roles of human proteins across tissues.

name: Israel Marine Data Center
description: National oceanographic data centre of Israel Oceanographic and Limnological Research (IOLR). ISRAMAR archives and distributes marine observations, forecasts, cruise and time-series data, and biological datasets for Israel's Mediterranean, Red Sea, and inland waters. Member of the IOC/IODE network.

name: GeneCards
description: GeneCards is a searchable integrative database of annotated and predicted human genes. It consolidates genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, genetic, clinical, and functional information from about 125 web sources. Developed at the Weizmann Institute of Science as the core of the GeneCards Suite.

name: GeneLoc
description: GeneLoc is the genome locator of the GeneCards Suite at the Weizmann Institute of Science. It presents an integrated map of human genes and markers in a scalable genomic neighborhood and assigns location-based GeneCards identifiers. Development is frozen and the maps are not in sync with the latest GeneCards release.

name: PathCards
description: PathCards is an integrated database of human biological pathways and their annotations. Human pathways were clustered into SuperPaths based on gene content similarity. Each PathCard provides information on one SuperPath which represents one or more human pathways. It includes 1,658 SuperPath entries, consolidated from 11 selected web sources and is modeled on the architecture and richness of the popular GeneCards database of human genes.

name: IUI Eilat National Monitoring Program data
description: Public download archive of the Israel National Monitoring Program at the Gulf of Eilat, operated by the Interuniversity Institute for Marine Sciences. It publishes meteorological time series from the IUI pier and ecological and oceanographic survey datasets for public use.

name: Nof HaGalil GIS
description: Public community GIS viewer of Nof HaGalil on the Metropolinet GMSC platform (Hebrew interface).

name: SIECA International Trade in Services Statistics
description: SIECA platform for international trade in services statistics of Central American countries, with intra- and extra-regional exports, imports and balances.

name: SECEM MERCOSUR Foreign Trade Statistics
description: Sistema de Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior del MERCOSUR (SECEM), a public interactive catalog of merchandise import and export statistics for MERCOSUR member states by period, partner and product.

name: SIECA Observatorio de Inteligencia Económica
description: SIECA economic intelligence observatory with Central American merchandise trade statistics, macroeconomic indicators and commercial intelligence for the Central American customs union (Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua and Panama).

name: CAF Datos Abiertos
description: Open data portal. managed by CAF - Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean. powered by Custom software. accessible at www.caf.com.

name: Amazon Regional Observatory (ORA)
description: Open data portal. managed by Amazon Cooperation Treaty Organization. powered by Custom software. accessible at oraotca.org.

name: CAPMAS Egypt
description: Official statistics website of Egypt's Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS). The public indicator SPA and REST API on port 8080 serve numeric series for CPI, labour force, foreign trade, and other subjects. Pinned CPI for Total Egypt was 13.0 percent year-on-year in July 2026 (83 monthly observations).

name: Ministry of Finance Data Repository
description: Public data warehouse of the Egyptian Ministry of Finance. Publishes fiscal, revenue, expenditure, debt, and real-sector indicator tables in Arabic and English, plus budget and mid-year review reports.

name: Egypt National Accounts Data
description: Interactive national accounts explorer of the Ministry of Planning and Economic Development, publishing GDP, public investment, and governorate accounts tables.

name: Egypt National Observatory for Women
description: Interactive indicators dashboard monitoring Egypt's National Strategy for the Empowerment of Egyptian Women 2030, covering political, economic, social, and protection indicators.

name: CBE Time Series
description: Central Bank of Egypt public time-series catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: ENHD ENC Online Digital Catalogue
description: Public online catalogue of Electronic Navigational Charts (ENC) produced by the Egyptian Navy Hydrographic Department, listing official ENC cells for Egyptian waters.

name: Atlas of Egyptian Cities
description: Public geoportal of the Ministry of Local Development with interactive city comparisons and atlas levels for urban sustainability and climate indicators across Egyptian cities.

name: Bibliotheca Alexandrina Digital Assets Repository
description: Bibliotheca Alexandrina Digital Assets Repository is a scientific data repository operated by Bibliotheca Alexandrina.

name: European Industrial Emissions Portal
description: EEA European Industrial Emissions Portal (successor to E-PRTR) with industrial emissions, releases, and related environmental indicators for EU facilities.

name: Urban Data Platform Plus
description: Joint Research Centre Urban Data Platform Plus (territorial.ec.europa.eu) of city and regional indicators for the EU, successor to urban.jrc.ec.europa.eu.

name: AGSI Gas Storage Inventory
description: European gas storage inventory, historical fill levels, and unavailability data published by Gas Infrastructure Europe.

name: EIB Investment Survey
description: EIB Investment Survey data portal tracking investment needs and constraints across Europe. Provides access to survey data from 2016-2024 covering topics including access to finance, climate change and energy efficiency, innovation activities, international trade, investment dynamics, investment impediments, investment needs, and firm profiles. Data can be explored by country, sector, firm size, and survey wave with visualization and download capabilities.

name: Cedefop datasets
description: Cedefop public datasets and skills-intelligence products, including the Skills Forecast, European Skills Index, OVATE, and European Skills and Jobs Survey explorers.

name: The Evidence Hub
description: Evidence Hub is a chart-based evidence platform on digital services regulation, including indicators and analyses on online harms and policy responses.

name: TARIC Consultation
description: Integrated Tariff of the European Union (TARIC) public consultation database of customs duties, tariff quotas, suspensions and other commodity measures applied in the EU customs union.

name: EUMOFA
description: European Market Observatory for Fisheries and Aquaculture Products. Public dashboards and bulk downloads of aquaculture production, EU imports, and first-sale time series.

name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
description: Pan-European electricity-market data catalog of load, generation, transmission, balancing, outages, and prices published by ENTSO-E under Regulation (EU) 543/2013. Data can be exported from the platform and queried through the Transparency Platform REST API.

name: Composite Indicators and Scoreboards
description: Joint Research Centre Competence Centre on Composite Indicators and Scoreboards (COIN), publishing EU composite indicators and policy scoreboards.

name: Access2Markets
description: European Commission Access2Markets portal for EU import and export conditions, including tariffs, procedures, rules of origin and other market-access requirements of the EU customs union.

name: ESPON Database Portal
description: ESPON Database Portal of territorial indicators and research datasets for European regions, used in cohesion and spatial-planning analysis.

name: EU-OSHA data visualisation
description: Public data visualisation portal of the European Agency for Safety and Health at Work, including ESENER survey indicators and related OSH dashboards.

name: ENTSOG Transparency Platform
description: Pan-European gas-market transparency data for flows, capacities, and nominations published by ENTSOG.

name: ALSI LNG Inventory
description: European LNG terminal inventory, historical send-out, and terminal data published by Gas Infrastructure Europe.

name: European Central Bank Statistical Data Warehouse (SDW)
description: Online portal for ECB official statistics and data, including datasets, publications, and tools for data processing and export.

name: Digital Decade DESI visualisation tool
description: European Commission visualisation tool for Digital Economy and Society Index (DESI) and Digital Decade indicators by member state.

name: SSH Open Marketplace
description: A discovery portal and aggregator that fosters serendipity in digital methods, provides a catalogue of well-curated resources and contextualises them for the Social Sciences & Humanities communities.

name: European Environment Agency, Datasets
description: Public data and analysis site of the European Environment Agency, with dataset pages, indicators, and the EEA datahub. The EEA secretariat is in Copenhagen; geospatial catalogue records remain under EU/Federal/geo.

name: EMODnet Data Ingestion
description: Public service for marine data collectors and producers providing an easy data submission process for marine datasets including metadata, supporting further integration in European marine data management infrastructures.

name: CESSDA DC Data Catalogue
description: Metadata for over 40,000 data collections from social science research across more than 20 European countries; includes quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-modes data, cross-sectional or longitudinal, and both recent and historical data.

name: EUR-Lex
description: Official catalog of European Union law, including the Official Journal, treaties, legislation, case-law, and international agreements. Distinct from the Publications Office open-data portal and from data.europa.eu.

name: COVID-19 Data Portal
description: A resource providing rapid and open data sharing for SARS-CoV-2 and COVID-19 research, facilitating access to biomolecular datasets, including genome, protein, and other experimental data. It is part of the European COVID-19 Data Platform and managed by EMBL-EBI.

name: Africa Knowledge Platform
description: A gateway to data and information on Africa's social, economic, territorial and environmental development, developed by the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission. It features data, tools, partnerships, and stories developed in-house or with African and international partners. It provides a single entry-point to the wealth of European Commission knowledge on Africa and aims to support the European Union (EU) objective of deepening the partnership with Africa.

name: TED Open Data Service
description: Linked open data catalog of EU public procurement notices published in the Supplement to the Official Journal (Tenders Electronic Daily). Notices can be looked up and queried with SPARQL over the eProcurement Ontology.

name: Blue-Cloud Data Discovery and Access Service
description: Federated data discovery and access service for marine and ocean datasets from European Blue Data Infrastructures (SeaDataNet, EMODnet, EurOBIS, Euro-Argo, ENA, EcoTaxa, ICOS-Marine, SOCAT, and others). Provides a common interface for discovery, mapping, and retrieval; supports CSW, OAI-PMH, ERDDAP and similar protocols. Part of Blue-Cloud 2026 and the European Digital Twin Ocean / EOSC.

name: LDS Central Catalogue
description: Public central catalogue of the European Language Data Space. Lists language datasets and models offered by LDS participants; joining the data space is required for full access and transfer.

name: INTERACT GIS
description: INTERACT GIS station catalogue for searching Arctic and northern terrestrial research stations by facilities, monitoring, and environmental features. Distinct from the INTERACT dataset portal.

name: M3G GNSS Metadata System
description: M3G is a metadata management and distribution system for multiple GNSS networks, providing station metadata catalog access for geodetic infrastructure.

name: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service
description: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service product portal. European land-cover, land-use, vegetation, water, and related geospatial products from the Copernicus programme.

name: EUMETSAT Data Catalogue
description: Data catalogue for finding, viewing, downloading and using satellite data from EUMETSAT and partner organisations

name: MeteoAlarm Early Warnings API
description: OGC API Environmental Data Retrieval catalog of weather warnings issued by MeteoAlarm members, with a locations query and an archive from 2019.

name: EMODnet Bathymetry
description: EMODnet Bathymetry WMS of coastlines, depth contours, and digital terrain model layers for European seas.

name: Ocean Browser - Python WMS Web Visualization
description: Web visualization service for oceanographic data via Python and WMS

name: WEkEO
description: WEkEO Copernicus Data and Information Access Service (DIAS). Harmonized catalog and processing environment for Sentinel, Copernicus services, and complementary Earth observation datasets.

name: EUMETNET Open Radar Data
description: EUMETNET Open Radar Data catalog of OPERA weather radar volumes, European composites, and national radar product links.

name: EFFIS
description: Copernicus Emergency Management Service European Forest Fire Information System for fire danger, burnt area, and related maps.

name: Global Human Settlement Layer
description: Copernicus download catalog of global built-up surface, population, and settlement-model grids produced by the Joint Research Centre.

name: CLARIN Virtual Language Observatory
description: Faceted browser for exploring language resources, services, and tools from CLARIN centres, including datasets, corpora, and language technology.

name: European Language Grid Catalogue
description: Catalogue of language resources, tools, and language technology services aggregated by the European Language Grid.

name: ENVRI-Hub
description: Central gateway to data and services from European environmental research infrastructures, with a catalogue of services and datasets across Earth-system disciplines.

name: PaNOSC Open Data Portal
description: Federated search portal for open datasets from European photon and neutron research facilities.

name: DEEP Open Catalog - Deep Hybrid DataCloud
description: A comprehensive platform to easily develop, build, share and deploy Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Deep Learning modules on top of distributed e-Infrastructures. Includes ready-to-use modules in a variety of domains, executable on local, server, or distributed computing e-Infrastructures supporting the DEEP-Hybrid-DataCloud stack.

name: European Commission Redisstat SDMX API
description: Redisstat SDMX dissemination API endpoint operated under European Commission services (DG COMP, EMPL, GROW).

name: Euro-VO Registry
description: European Virtual Observatory searchable registry of IVOA-compliant astronomical data resources and services.

name: eartH2Observe
description: EartH2Observe brings together the findings from European FP projects DEWFORA, GLOWASIS, WATCH, GEOWOW and others. It will integrate available global earth observations (EO), in-situ datasets and models and will construct a global water resources re-analysis dataset of significant length (several decades). The resulting data will allow for improved insights on the full extent of available water and existing pressures on global water resources in all parts of the water cycle.

name: ELRA Catalogue of Language Resources
description: ELRA catalogue of language resources: corpora, lexica, terminologies and evaluation packages for speech and language technologies. Browsable catalog; distribution under license (free or commercial).

name: CLARIN-ERIC
description: CLARIN is a European Research Infrastructure for the Humanities and Social Sciences, focusing on language resources (data and tools). It is being implemented and constantly improved at leading institutions in a large and growing number of European countries, aiming at improving Europe's multi-linguality competence.

name: CERIC Data Portal
description: Metadata catalogue of experimental datasets, proposals, samples, and publications from CERIC-ERIC partner research facilities.

name: ICOS Data Portal
description: Main discovery interface for the ICOS Carbon Portal—standardized greenhouse gas and carbon-cycle observations from ICOS atmosphere, ecosystem, and ocean networks, with curated data products, provenance, and long-term access for research and monitoring.

name: ESA Planetary Science Archive
description: ESA archive of data from planetary science missions including Rosetta, Mars Express, and ExoMars.

name: Eurobarometer
description: Eurobarometer is a series of public opinion surveys conducted regularly on behalf of the European Commission to measure attitudes and perceptions of people across the European Union. It covers a wide range of topics such as politics, social issues, economy, environment and public policy. The database provides access to survey data, reports and analysis that support research and decision‑making on European public opinion.

name: In-service Aircraft for a Global Observing System Data Portal
description: The IAGOS Data Portal provides observational data and added-value products produced by the European Research Infrastructure IAGOS. Datasets can be discovered and downloaded through the portal. Data and metadata follow the standards for Atmospheric community.

name: CIARD Ring
description: The CiardRING is a global directory of web-based information services and datasets for agricultural research for development (ARD). It is the principal tool created through the CIARD initiative to allow information providers to register their services and datasets in various categories and so facilitate the discovery of sources of agriculture-related information across the world.

name: ARIADNE Portal
description: ARIADNE is a research infrastructure for archaeology. Its main objective is to support research, learning and teaching by enabling access to digital resources and innovative new services. It does this by maintaining a catalogue of digital datasets, by promoting best practices in the management and use of digital data in archaeology, by offering training and advice, and by supporting the development of innovative new services for archaeology.

name: Information Platform for Chemical Monitoring
description: IPCHEM - the Information Platform for Chemical Monitoring is the reference access point for discovering chemical monitoring data collections which are managed by and are available to European Commission bodies, Member States, international and national organisations and research communities.

name: European Social Survey Data Portal
description: The European Social Survey (ESS) is an academically driven cross-national survey that has been conducted across Europe since its establishment in 2001. Every two years, face-to-face interviews are conducted with newly selected, cross-sectional samples. The survey measures the attitudes, beliefs and behaviour patterns of diverse populations in more than thirty nations. The ESS data including the integrated data file for each round, methodological data and contextual information are available for download via the ESS Data Portal. Summary data and main data variables are also searchable from this portal.

name: European Union Observatory for Nanomaterials
description: The European Union Observatory for Nanomaterials (EUON) provides information about existing nanomaterials on the EU market. Whether you are developing policies in the area, a consumer or representing industry or a green NGO, the information on the EUON offers interesting reading about the safety, innovation, research and uses of nanomaterials. The EUON is funded by the European Commission. It is hosted and maintained by the European Chemicals Agency (ECHA).

name: STOREDB
description: STOREDB provides infrastructure for sharing data and resources in radiation biology and epidemiology. It is a platform for the archiving and sharing of primary data and outputs of all kinds, including epidemiological and experimental data, from research on the effects of radiation. It also provides a directory of bioresources and databases containing information and materials that investigators are willing to share. STORE supports the creation of a radiation research commons.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem Portal
description: The Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem is an open ecosystem that provides free instant access to a wide range of data and services from the Copernicus Sentinel missions and more on our planet’s land, oceans and atmosphere. The Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem not only ensures the continuity of the open and free access to Copernicus data but also extends the portfolio for data processing and data access possibilities. Delve into the data immediately via the Copernicus Browser or register to create an account and have an even better comprehensive exploration experience.

name: Global Genome Biodiversity Network
description: The DNA Bank Network was established in spring 2007 and was funded until 2011 by the German Research Foundation (DFG). The network was initiated by GBIF Germany (Global Biodiversity Information Facility). It offers a worldwide unique concept. DNA bank databases of all partners are linked and are accessible via a central web portal, providing DNA samples of complementary collections (microorganisms, protists, plants, algae, fungi and animals).

name: MS Global Data-Sharing Initiative
description: The Multiple Sclerosis International Federation (MSIF) and the Multiple Sclerosis Data Alliance (MSDA) have teamed up to form a Global Data Sharing Initiative to achieve insights on the effect of COVID-19 in people with MS as fast as possible, with the intent to steer clinical decision-making during the pandemic.

name: BioVel
description: BioVeL is a virtual e-laboratory that supports research on biodiversity issues using large amounts of data from cross-disciplinary sources. BioVeL supports the development and use of workflows to process data. It offers the possibility to either use already made workflows or create own. BioVeL workflows are stored in MyExperiment - Biovel Group http://www.myexperiment.org/groups/643/content.

name: SIEUSOIL Data Hub
description: Data catalog platform supporting the SIEUSOIL project, focused on soil and land data.

name: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials
description: EudraCT (European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials) is the European Clinical Trials Database of all interventional clinical trials of medicinal products commencing in the European Union from 1 May 2004 onwards. The EudraCT database has been established in accordance with Directive 2001/20/EC. Please note that as of 31 January 2023, creation and submission of new Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs) for trials to be conducted in the EU/EEA is no longer allowed through EudraCT and must be performed through the Clinical Trials Information System

name: European Medical Information Framework Catalogue
description: The EMIF catalogue contains extensive metadata on a number of European health data resources, such as registries, EHRs, biobanks etc., organized by a number of communities, such as EMIF-EHR, EMIF-AD, EPAD, ADVANCE, BigData@Heart, PIONEER etc. The metadata collected is the data available, the data governance procedures, contact details etc. The catalogue intends to comprise different vertical projects through the creation of communities, such as EMIF-Electronic Health Record Data (EMIF-EHR) and EMIF-Alzheimer’s Disease (EMIF-AD), the BigData@Heart (for cardiovascular) and PIONEER (for prostate cancer) projects, supporting distinct databases and users.

name: MarBEF Data System
description: MarBEF Data System, the data catalog of the EU Network of Excellence on Marine Biodiversity and Ecosystem Functioning.

name: DiSSCover
description: DiSSCover is a platform for curating and annotating digital specimens, which serve as digital surrogates for physical specimens. It provides access to all specimen-related data, including metadata (where, when, by whom), digital media and derived or related data like sequence data, chemical composition and sampled environment. Users, including researchers, taxonomic experts and citizen scientists, can annotate and enrich specimen data to support science, with future integration of approved annotations pending a community review process. The annotations are stored as FAIR Digital Objects (with a persistent identifier).

name: ECHA Classification, Labelling and Packaging
description: The ECHA C&L inventory is an EU public C&L inventory that provides electronic public access to classification and labelling information on chemical substances placed on the market in the European Union. The database contains classification and labelling information on notified and registered substances received from manufacturers and importers in the framework of the REACH and CLP Regulations ((EC) No 1907/2006 and No 1272/2008) in their C&L notifications or registration dossiers.

name: IsoArcH database
description: IsoArcH is a non-profit initiative dedicated to preserving and sharing isotopic data for research worldwide.

name: Copernicus Marine Data Store
description: Provides free, open, regular and systematic reference information on the blue (physical), white (sea ice), and green (biogeochemical) ocean state, variability and change. It supports scientists, blue economy sectors, decision makers and the general public.

name: BioImage Model Zoo
description: The BioImage Model Zoo is a community-driven, fully open resource where standardized pre-trained models can be shared, explored, tested, and downloaded for further adaptation or direct deployment in multiple end user-facing tools (e.g., ilastik, deepImageJ, QuPath, StarDist, ImJoy, ZeroCostDL4Mic, CSBDeep). To enable everyone to contribute and consume the Zoo resources, we provide a model standard to enable cross-compatibility, a rich list of example models and practical use cases, developer tools, documentation, and the accompanying infrastructure for model upload, download and testing.

name: CESSDA Data Catalogue
description: The CESSDA Data Catalogue contains the metadata of all data in the holdings of CESSDA service providers. It is a one-stop-shop for search and discovery, enabling effective access to European research data for researchers. Details of over 40, 000 data collections are listed. These are harvested from fifteen different CESSDA Service Providers. TEST

name: ESA Open Science Catalog
description: A catalog of publicly available geoscience products, datasets and resources developed in the frame of scientific research projects funded by ESA EO (Earth Observation). The catalog provides metadata and links to the actual data hosted by various data providers.

name: Euro-Argo Data Selection
description: Euro-Argo selection and download catalog for Argo profiling-float data from the European contribution to the global Argo array.

name: EnerMaps
description: EnerMaps is a scientific data repository, operated by EnerMaps, publishing datasets and related research documentation.

name: NORMAN Suspect List Exchange
description: NORMAN Network exchange of suspect lists for environmental contaminant screening by mass spectrometry.

name: ESA Space Data Preservation Archive
description: Joint “Space Data Preservation Archive” (formerly indicated as “EO Cold Back-up Archive”) used to receive, ingest and archive EO and other ESA directorates space data for long-term preservation. The archive is interfaced with EO and Science missions PDGSs through Front End Circulators (PE-FE and Mercury) ensuring internal and external interfaces for data records and associated technical content exchange and circulation.

name: EVORA Portal
description: Unified view of viral materials, derived products, services and related entities harvested from EVA, ERINHA and ELIXIR (via FAIRsharing). A consolidated catalogue of resources in virology to support outbreak response and pandemic preparedness.

name: ECHA CHEM
description: European Chemicals Agency public chemicals database covering REACH, CLP, and related regulatory substance data.

name: Earth Online
description: Earth Online presents news and information on European Space Agency activities in the field of Earth observation. The website offers information about ESA’s Earth Observation data, and the satellite missions and instruments that acquire this data.

name: European Genome-Phenome Archive (EGA)
description: Permanent archive for controlled sharing of personally identifiable genetic, phenotypic, and clinical datasets from biomedical research. Metadata is publicly searchable; access to data files is granted by Data Access Committees.

name: JERICO-RI Catalogue
description: JERICO research infrastructure catalogue of coastal observatory datasets and services.

name: Open PHACTS
description: Open PHACTS, operated by European Commission, Research and Innovation, FP7, Infrastructures, provides research data on basic biological and medical research, medicine, and pharmacy.

name: VAMDC Portal
description: VAMDC aims to be an interoperable e-infrastructure that provides the international research community with access to a broad range of atomic and molecular (A&M) data compiled within a set of A&M databases accessible through the provision of this portal and of user software. Furthermore VAMDC aims to provide A&M data providers and compilers with a large dissemination platform for their work.

name: EU Clinical Trial Register
description: The EU Clinical Trials Register contains information on interventional clinical trials on medicines conducted in the European Union (EU), or the European Economic Area (EEA) which started after 1 May 2004.

name: EBRAINS
description: EBRAINS is a platform for sharing brain research data ranging in type as well as spatial and temporal scale. The EBRAINS data curation service aims to provide maximum impact, visibility, reusability, and longevity. The user interface of the EBRAINS Knowledge Graph allows you to easily find data of interest. EBRAINS hosts a wide range of data types and models from different species. All data are well described and can be accessed immediately for further analysis.

name: AHEAD
description: AHEAD, the European Archive of Historical Earthquake Data 1000-1899, is a distributed archive aiming at preserving, inventorying and making available, to investigators and other users, data sources on the earthquake history of Europe, such as papers, reports, Macroseismic Data Points (MDPs), parametric catalogues, and so on.

name: ESASky
description: ESA sky-visualization portal for discovering and downloading public astronomy data from ESA and partner missions.

name: WEkEO Portal
description: WEkEO offers access to reference products for Sentinel 1, 2, 3, 5p and 6, a subset of reference products from the Copernicus Services, and data from a number of other missions (eg. EUMETSAT meteorological satellites). WEkEO includes visualisation tools to aid with data search and discover along with a variety of data processing tools.
