It also offers access to a cloud processing environment.

name: Geoportal Municipalidad de La Serena
description: Municipal geoportal of La Serena publishing local geospatial maps and layers.

name: IDE GORE Coquimbo
description: Regional spatial data infrastructure (IDE) of the Gobierno Regional de Coquimbo. Publishes more than 30 public map viewers covering planning, environment, infrastructure, energy, tourism, and disaster risk.

name: Visor Territorial MINVU Biobío
description: Territorial map viewer of MINVU for Chile's Biobío region.

name: SIT Antofagasta
description: Regional territorial information system of Antofagasta with a public map viewer and regional statistics.

name: Latinobarometro
description: Public-opinion survey microdata for Latin American countries.

name: DEIS - Departamento de Estadísticas e Información de Salud
description: Departamento de Estadísticas e Información de Salud (DEIS). Official Chilean health statistics, open files, and interactive Tableros DEIS on births, mortality, vaccination, and nutrition.

name: Siete - Banco Central de Chile Statistical Data Portal
description: Official statistical data portal of the Central Bank of Chile, providing access to national and sectoral statistics.

name: Superintendencia de Pensiones - Centro de Estadísticas
description: Centro de Estadísticas of Chile's Superintendencia de Pensiones. Public time series on pension funds, affiliates, contributions, unemployment insurance, and the PGU solidarity pillar.

name: CEAD - Estadísticas delictuales
description: Centro de Estudios y Análisis del Delito (CEAD). Public query of police-case, denuncia, and detention statistics by region and commune, plus crime surveys such as ENUSC.

name: BEST - Base de Estadísticas en Series Temporales CMF
description: BEST (Base de Estadísticas en Series Temporales) of Chile's Comisión para el Mercado Financiero. Interactive banking time series, distinct from the CMF bank-by-bank financial statements database.

name: Indicadores CEDEUS
description: Urban sustainability indicators catalog of CEDEUS comparing Chilean cities across sustainability dimensions.

name: Base de datos Bancos - Comisión para el Mercado Financiero, CMF Chile
description: This portal provides access to a variety of financial data and reports related to banks operating in Chile. Users can select specific banks and reporting periods to view detailed financial information, facilitating transparency and analysis of the banking sector in the country.

name: SINIM - Sistema Nacional de Información Municipal
description: Sistema Nacional de Información Municipal (SINIM). National municipal variables and indicators for Chile's communes, covering finance, human resources, health, education, and territorial management.

name: Indicadores CTCI
description: Science, technology, knowledge and innovation indicators portal of Chile's Consejo Nacional de CTCI.

name: Observatorio Social - Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia
description: Observatorio Social of Chile's Ministry of Social Development and Family. Publishes poverty lines, communal poverty estimates, CASEN results, and social indicators from administrative records.

name: ChileCompra Datos Abiertos
description: Open-data catalog of ChileCompra (Mercado Público), with bulk downloads of contracting processes in OCDS.

name: Datos Abiertos Legislativos del Congreso Nacional
description: Legislative open data portal of Chile's National Congress covering bills, votes, legislators, and published laws from the Chamber of Deputies, Senate, and BCN.

name: Catálogo de Datos Abiertos Data Observatory
description: National open data catalog of Data Observatory, a Chilean public-private-academic nonprofit. Indexes 1,000+ FAIR datasets from public and private institutions on health, climate, pensions, permits, education, environment, astronomy, and social indicators, with DataCite metadata and links to original sources.

name: Portal de Datos CNR
description: Open data portal of Chile's Comisión Nacional de Riego, publishing irrigation contest results, ERNC bonus series, and photovoltaic and micro-hydro catalogs.

name: Visualizador Inventario Forestal Nacional INFOR
description: National Forest Inventory (IFN) map visualizer of Chile's Instituto Forestal, distinct from the INFOR GeoServer.

name: Visualizador geográfico Censo 2024
description: Public MapLibre viewer of Chile's 2024 Population and Housing Census. Lets users pick a geographic level and inspect census geography published by INE.

name: Mapa de Proyectos ACERA
description: Public map catalog of renewable energy and storage projects in Chile maintained by ACERA.

name: SIG Corporativo SEA
description: Corporate GIS of Chile's Servicio de Evaluación Ambiental with public SEIA project maps, EIA baseline layers, and a spatial download center.

name: GEOMOP Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales
description: GEOMOP spatial data infrastructure portal of Chile's Ministerio de Obras Públicas, distinct from the ArcGIS REST services directory.

name: SIG Bomberos de Chile
description: Public GIS viewer of Bomberos de Chile with Leaflet-based territorial layers.

name: Visualizador Integrado PTLBP
description: Integrated catalog and map viewer of Chile's Plataforma Tecnológica de Líneas de Base Públicas (PTLBP). It publishes environmental baseline datasets, GeoServer layers, and harvested metadata for ecosystems, land use, protected areas, and environmental impact assessment.

name: Geoportal WWF Chile
description: Public geoportal of WWF Chile publishing conservation-related geospatial layers.

name: SIT Rural
description: SIT Rural territorial information viewer operated by CIREN for rural geospatial data in Chile.

name: DataClima CR2
description: DataClima reúne plataformas climáticas y bases de datos compiladas por el Centro de Ciencia del Clima y la Resiliencia (CR2), con filtros por dominio geográfico, tema y rango temporal.

name: Portal de Datos Instituto Milenio BASE
description: Research data portal of Instituto Milenio BASE with Antarctic and sub-Antarctic biodiversity datasets and GBIF record exploration.

name: Data Observatory
description: Data Observatory is a Chilean public-private-academic collaboration that publishes and promotes data for science, research, and productive development, including astronomy, climate, aquaculture, and AI-related collections.

name: Departamento de Epidemiología MINSAL - Bases de datos
description: Public health datasets published by the Departamento de Epidemiología of Chile's Ministry of Health, including national health survey microdata, questionnaires, and related epidemiological databases.

name: SIB-Aysén
description: Sistema de Información en Biodiversidad para Aysén. Catálogo público de más de 2.800 especies y 10.000 registros de plantas, animales, hongos y microalgas de la Región de Aysén, con fichas, georreferenciación y mapeo.

name: Indicadores DTPM
description: Public transport indicators catalog of Santiago's Directorio de Transporte Público Metropolitano.

name: Datos Abiertos Municipalidad de Maipú
description: Open data inventory of the Municipality of Maipú, listing municipal datasets by theme (territory, transit, public services) as part of the commune's data policy.

name: Geoportal SSMS
description: Geoportal of Chile's Servicio de Salud Metropolitano Sur with a public map catalog and QGIS/WMS/CSW geospatial services.

name: Cook Islands Biodiversity and Ethnobiology Database
description: Public Cook Islands Biodiversity and Ethnobiology Database (CIBED) of the Cook Islands Natural Heritage Trust. Searchable species accounts integrate scientific and traditional information on plants, animals, and other organisms of the Cook Islands, native and non-native, across terrestrial, marine, and freshwater environments.

name: Lao PDR Foreign Trade Statistics (E-Statistic)
description: Public foreign-trade statistics explorer of the Department of Foreign Trade. Query imports, exports, and transit by product, partner country, border checkpoint, and transport mode; view trade-balance series and top-15 rankings. A login exists for extra features.

name: K4D Development Indicators
description: Access portal to statistical data from the Lao Government. District- and village-level development indicators from national censuses covering demographics, education, health, ethnicity, economy, poverty, living conditions, and migration.

name: Lao PDR Education and Sports Management Information System
description: GIS-enabled education and sports indicator platform of the Ministry of Education and Sports of Lao PDR. Public dashboards and maps of school and education statistics, built on the Tupaia platform by Beyond Essential Systems with support from the European Union and UNICEF.

name: Lao Land Use Information System (LUIS)
description: Public land-use planning geoportal of Lao PDR. Interactive Leaflet web map and GeoServer WMS/WFS layers of village, district, and province land-use plans, forest zones, and administrative boundaries. Statistic query pages require a user account.

name: Laos National Government Data Exchange (GDX)
description: Public Government Data Exchange catalog of the Digital Government Centre. Lists ministry APIs and organization codes, with downloadable service documents and usage statistics. The JSON service list is public without login.

name: Pha Khao Lao Species Database
description: Public agrobiodiversity species catalog of plants, animals, and fungi of Laos, developed by NAFRI with the Centre for Development and Environment.

name: Tanzania Census Information Dissemination Platform
description: Official Census Information Dissemination Platform (Census Hub) of Tanzania's National Bureau of Statistics. Provides 2022 Population and Housing Census results, visualizations, publications, and an API for population, buildings, social services, and disability indicators.

name: NeST Open Contracting Data Portal
description: National e-Procurement System of Tanzania (NeST) Open Contracting Data Portal of the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority. Publishes public procurement records as Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) packages, with search, filters, downloads, and a REST API.

name: UNCTAD database on AfCFTA tariff liberalization
description: UNCTAD database of AfCFTA tariff offers, rules of origin and related import trends for African Continental Free Trade Area member states.

name: AfCFTA e-Tariff Book
description: AfCFTA Secretariat e-Tariff Book publishing provisional schedules of tariff concessions offered by State Parties and customs unions under the African Continental Free Trade Area.

name: AFREC Hydropower and Dams in Africa
description: Country query of African hydropower plants and dams, with installed capacity, generation, and dam characteristics compiled by AFREC.

name: AfCFTA Non-Tariff Barriers
description: Online mechanism for monitoring, reporting and eliminating non-tariff barriers in Africa under the AfCFTA and participating regional economic communities.

name: African Trade Observatory
description: African Union / ITC African Trade Observatory dashboard for intra-African trade flows, market access conditions and AfCFTA implementation monitoring (Compare, Explore and Monitor modules).

name: Afreximbank Trade Data Intelligence
description: Public explorer of African trade and macroeconomic indicators, with country filters, tabular and chart views, and downloadable country reports.

name: AfricaFertilizer
description: AfricaFertilizer (AFO) portal hosted by IFDC. Public fertilizer production, trade, consumption, and retail-price statistics and market intelligence for sub-Saharan African countries.

name: SIE-UEMOA Energy Information System
description: Public energy information system of UEMOA member states, with energy balances and indicators for supply, production, access, and consumption.

name: BCEAO EDEN - Entrepôt de Données Économiques et Financières
description: Public economic and financial statistical warehouse (EDEN) of the Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO), with about 15,300 time series covering the real, monetary, fiscal, external, and social sectors of UEMOA / WAEMU member states. The site is live; the TLS certificate chain does not validate against public CAs as of August 2026. No documented machine API.

name: ECOWAS Energy Information System (WAEIS)
description: Public ECOWAS energy balances, infrastructure statistics, and key performance indicators for West African member states.

name: SADC ICT Observatory
description: SADC ICT Observatory with queryable ICT, postal and socio-economic indicators for Southern African Development Community member states.

name: WIO Symphony
description: WIO Symphony, a cumulative impact assessment tool and spatial data catalog for the Western Indian Ocean.

name: IGAD Groundwater Information System (GWIS)
description: Regional groundwater information system for the Horn of Africa, with borehole search, aquifer maps, water-level analysis, and public WMS, WFS, and WCS services. Distinct from the IGAD GeoNode spatial portal.

name: Lake Chad Information System (LIS)
description: Lake Chad Information System (LIS) / Knowledge Management Platform of the Lake Chad Basin Commission. Public geoportal of hydrological, climate, environmental, and socio-economic layers for the basin, with an e-library and a documented GeoServer WMS at https://lis.cblt.org/geoserver/cblt.lis/wms.

name: Zambezi Water Resources Information System (ZAMWIS)
description: Geoportal. managed by Zambezi Watercourse Commission. powered by Custom software. accessible at zamwis.zambezicommission.org.

name: FeSeRWAM – Fertilizer and Seed Recommendations Map for West Africa
description: Interactive map catalog of site-specific agricultural input packages for ECOWAS countries plus Chad and Mauritania, including Togo packages contributed by ITRA. Users filter by country, crop, variety, and fertilizer and download matching packages as PDF, CSV, or Excel.

name: Zindi
description: Zindi is an African machine-learning competition platform that publishes challenge datasets focused on African problems (agriculture, health, finance, climate, and related domains). zindi.africa redirects here. There is no documented public catalog API.

name: OFAC - Observatoire des forêts d'Afrique centrale
description: COMIFAC Central African Forests Observatory (OFAC), based in Yaoundé. Public catalog of forest-ecosystem datasets including an interactive geoportal, a 135-species timber database, production monitoring, and cartographic products covering COMIFAC states including Cameroon.

name: Plateforme RIHA
description: Public specimen catalog of the RIHA (Réseau des Herbiers d'Afrique) regional platform. Browseable collections include Herbier National de Guinée (HNG) plus herbaria in Benin, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Gabon, and Togo. Distinct from the inactive Living Atlases datasets host collections.african-herbaria.org and from the network IPT.

name: ODINAFRICA marine projects and vessels portal
description: IOC Africa / ODINAFRICA portal of marine-related projects, research vessels, and related ocean information for Africa.

name: Nonthaburi City Municipality Public GIS
description: Public municipal GIS of Nonthaburi City Municipality with facility, CCTV, air-quality, and flood-monitoring layers.

name: DDS-Portal
description: Digital Disease Surveillance (DDS) Portal of the Department of Disease Control, publishing public communicable-disease situation dashboards by week, province, and disease group.

name: TCEB Open Data
description: TCEB MICE statistics catalog with public tables for travelers, spending, and events, exportable as CSV and JSON.

name: Health KPI
description: Ministry of Public Health Health KPI system of public provincial and regional health-performance indicators. Distinct from the Health Data Center (HDC) standard-report catalog.

name: NSO Interactive Dashboard
description: NSO Interactive Dashboard gallery of official statistics across 21 branches, with searchable thematic dashboards by sector, province, and year.

name: NSO Key Statistics and Indicators
description: National Statistical Office public catalog of key official statistics and indicators, with 370 searchable tables compiled from NSO surveys and other government agencies across social, economic, and environmental branches.

name: FPO Statistic Database
description: Fiscal Policy Office Statistic Database of fiscal and macroeconomic series (GFS operations, revenue, monthly economic indicators). Distinct from the FPO CKAN data catalog.

name: Thailand's Trade Statistic
description: Thailand's Trade Statistic, the Ministry of Commerce table catalog of international trade (exports, imports, balance) by partner, HS code, and commodity structure, with public query UI and documented APIs.

name: NSO Statistical Data Warehouse
description: NSO Statistical Data Warehouse (ระบบคลังข้อมูลสถิติ) with public table reports from about 30 NSO census and survey projects. Distinct from StatHub (.Stat Suite) and the SDMX-RI API.

name: Official Statistics Thailand
description: NSO inventory of official statistics under the Thailand Statistical System Master Plan, listing official statistical series by producing agency with links to government data catalogs.

name: Labour Market Information System (LMIS)
description: Ministry of Labour Labour Market Information System (LMIS) public dashboard of employment, migrant-worker, social-security, and skills-training indicators.

name: SSO GIS Statistics
description: Social Security Office GIS and statistics dashboards for insured persons, benefit payments, contribution arrears, and Social Security Fund status. Distinct from the SSO CKAN data catalog.

name: DOPA Official Statistics Registration Systems
description: Official civil-registration statistics of the Department of Provincial Administration (BORA). Public tables and downloads for population by age and area, vital events, and related registration services.

name: Bank of Thailand Statistics
description: Bank of Thailand public statistics catalog of economic, monetary, financial-institution, financial-market, and payment-system tables. Distinct from the IMF NSDP page and from the registration-required BOT API portal.

name: SIPET Power Sector Data Browser
description: Interactive data browser for power-sector indicators and related statistics across Southeast Asia, published by the Southeast Asia Partnership for Energy Transition (SIPET) as part of its power-sector resources.

name: Thailand Provincial Energy Database
description: Provincial and regional energy database with public fact sheets, final energy consumption, and energy-potential outputs.

name: Open Cultural data(Thailand)
description: Data catalog for cultural information in Thailand, likely managed by the Ministry of Culture or a related agency.

name: TMD Open Data
description: Thai Meteorological Department open government data portal with weather datasets and JSON/XML APIs, separate from the department CKAN at catalog.tmd.go.th.

name: Ministry of Interior open data (Thailand)
description: Open data portal operated by the Ministry of Interior (Thailand), providing access to government datasets.

name: BaanScope Open Data
description: Aggregate open datasets derived from BaanScope's tracked pipeline of new-build residential projects by Thailand's nine largest SET-listed developers. Three cuts are published, by Bangkok-metro district, by developer and by completion year, each with a column dictionary. Files are served as CSV and JSON under CC BY 4.0 with permissive CORS headers, need no sign-up or API key, and are regenerated on every site build.

name: Thai National Research Repository
description: Thai National Research Repository is the national research-output and research-data repository operated under the National Research Council of Thailand / NRIIS.

name: ASEAN Microbial Database (AmiBase)
description: ASEAN microbial species database operated by BIOTEC, searchable catalog of bacteria, archaea, fungi, algae, protozoa and viruses.

name: Queen Sirikit Botanic Garden Living Plant Database
description: Living plant collection database of Queen Sirikit Botanic Garden (32,000+ records), with linked herbarium and threatened-plant databases.

name: Thailand Biodiversity Information Facilities (TH-BIF)
description: National biodiversity information platform of ONEP covering species, protected areas, and related biodiversity datasets.

name: Thailand Agricultural Research Repository
description: Thailand Agricultural Research Repository (TARR) is the Agricultural Research Development Agency catalog of agricultural research outputs and datasets. It is CoreTrustSeal-certified.

name: Thailand Bioresource Research Center
description: Public catalog of microbial and bioresource collections (strains, molecular materials, antibodies, viruses) at TBRC/BIOTEC.

name: PTTEP Ocean Data Platform
description: PTTEP Ocean Data Platform catalog of ocean datasets published for the UN Ocean Decade / ODIS node.

name: Khon Kaen Municipality GIS KKM Map
description: Public GIS map of places, opening hours, and related municipal layers for Khon Kaen City Municipality (GIS KKM Map).

name: Kadıköy (Yalova) Kent Rehberi
description: Public city-guide map of Kadıköy (Yalova) municipality.

name: SEFFAF Ankara Open Data Portal
description: Akıllı şehirleşme kapsamında dijital çağa entegre edilen hizmetlerimiz ile Coğrafi Bilgi Sistemleri (CBS) altyapısında görsellerle desteklenmiş nitelikli bilgilere ulaşabilecekleri ve her türlü ihtiyaca yönelik kullanıma hazır 'Şeffaf Ankara ve Açık Veri' platformu oluşturulmuştur. Çağdaş ve modern şehircilik anlayışına uygun olarak Ankara'nın demografik ve kültürel yapısı, Belediye hizmetleri, çalışmaların ve şehrin dinamikleri hakkında birçok veriye sahip bir uygulamadır.

name: Kayseri Metropolitan Municipality open data portal
description: Kayseri Büyükşehir Belediyesi açık veri platformu ile verileri sizin kullanımınıza sunarak sizlerin verileri analiz ederek proje üretmelerinizi ve ülkemize, Kayseri'ye katkı sağlamalarınızı hedeflemektedir.

name: Kayseri CBS Kent Rehberi
description: Geographic information portal and city-guide map of Kayseri metropolitan municipality.

name: Hatay Kent Rehberi
description: Public city-guide map of Hatay metropolitan municipality, including panorama and address layers.

name: Sakarya Kent Rehberi
description: Public city-guide map of Sakarya metropolitan municipality.

name: Balıkesir Metropolitan Municipality Open Data Platform
description: Balıkesir Büyükşehir Belediyesi Açık Veri Platformu, çeşitli kamu verilerini yayınlar ve erişime açar. Veriler temasına göre kategorize edilmiştir: Ulaşım, Yapılar, Yönetişim, Mekan Yönetimi, Sağlık, İnsan, İletişim, Güvenlik gibi.

name: Bursa Kent Rehberi
description: Public city-guide map of Bursa metropolitan municipality.

name: İnegöl Kent Rehberi
description: Public city-guide map of İnegöl municipality.

name: Manisa Metropolitan Municipality Open Data Platform
description: Open data portal of Manisa Metropolitan Municipality, publishing municipal datasets for reuse.

name: TÜİK Açık Veri Kataloğu (evam.tuik.gov.tr)
description: Electronic Data Research Center (E-VAM) is an environment where researchers authorized with e-government and SMS verification can study micro data without having to come to the Data Research Centers located in the Presidency building and 13 Regional Directorates of the Turkish Statistical Institute.

name: Milli Eğitim İstatistikleri
description: Ministry of National Education official statistics portal for formal education indicators produced under the Official Statistics Programme (schools, students, teachers, and related breakdowns).

name: Yükseköğretim Bilgi Yönetim Sistemi
description: Council of Higher Education (YÖK) Higher Education Information Management System, publishing official student, graduate, academic-staff, and unit statistics from YÖKSİS as queryable reports.

name: Population Data portal by Turkish Statistical Institute
description: Turkish Statistical Institute data portal, national statistics database

name: TÜİK Yayınlar
description: Turkish Statistical Institute publications catalog on the BİRUNİ platform. Searchable database of TÜİK statistical publications (books, bulletins, newsletters) by name, language, format, category, and type, with download links.

name: Merkezi Yönetim Bütçe İstatistikleri
description: Public Accounts General Directorate (Muhasebat) catalog of central government budget statistics and detailed tables published by the Ministry of Treasury and Finance.

name: TUIK Veri Portalı (Turkish Statistical Institute Data Portal)
description: Official data catalog of the Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK), providing access to statistical datasets and publications about Turkey.

name: SGK Veri Uygulaması
description: Social Security Institution (SGK) interactive statistics application (SgkVeri) for querying insured-person, workplace, health, and financial social-security indicators. Distinct from SGK PDF yearbooks and monthly bulletins.

name: Hazine Müsteşarlığı Dağıtım Verileri
description: Ministry of Treasury and Finance dissemination database (HMVDS) for querying public-finance, state-owned enterprise, external-financing, insurance, and macroeconomic indicator series.

name: BDDK Veri
description: Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BDDK) public data portal for Turkish banking-sector and non-bank financial institution statistics, including monthly bulletins and time series.

name: TÜİK İl Göstergeleri
description: Turkish Statistical Institute provincial indicators (İl Göstergeleri) query application for comparing selected official statistics across provinces.

name: EVDS Electronic Data Delivery System
description: Electronic Data Delivery System (EVDS) of the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye, publishing monetary, financial, and economic time series. The public web interface moved from evds2.tcmb.gov.tr to evds3.tcmb.gov.tr.

name: TBB Veri Sorgulama Sistemi
description: Public statistical query system of the Banks Association of Turkey (TBB), with reports on member-bank financial statements, provincial credit and deposit stocks, ATM/POS counts, and Risk Center series.

name: TÜİK MEDAS
description: Turkish Statistical Institute Central Dissemination System (MEDAS), a legacy table-query database still published on biruni.tuik.gov.tr. Distinct from the newer Veri Portalı at veriportali.tuik.gov.tr.

name: TEİAŞ YTBS Türkiye Elektrik İstatistikleri
description: Public electricity generation, consumption, peak-load, and installed-capacity statistics from the Load Dispatch Information System (YTBS) of the Turkish Electricity Transmission Corporation (TEİAŞ).

name: EPİAŞ Şeffaflık Platformu
description: EPİAŞ (EXIST) Transparency Platform publishing electricity and natural gas market statistics for Turkey, including generation, consumption, day-ahead market prices, transmission, and related time series. Data is available through the web interface, Excel downloads, and REST APIs after free registration.

name: TÜİK Veri Portalı (veriportali.tuik.gov.tr)
description: Web portal of the Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) for browsing and accessing official statistics and indicator data for Türkiye.

name: TÜİK Uluslararası Seçilmiş Göstergeler
description: Turkish Statistical Institute international selected indicators query application for comparing Turkey with other countries on official statistical topics.

name: Turkey official statistics portal
description: Official statistics portal providing reliable, transparent, and impartial data on various national and international topics, managed by central government institutions in Türkiye.

name: TÜİK Bölgesel İstatistikler
description: Turkish Statistical Institute regional statistics query application with NUTS region, province, and district tables from 1995 onward. Distinct from the national Veri Portalı.

name: TÜİK 1990 Genel Nüfus Sayımı
description: Turkish Statistical Institute 1990 General Population Census query application on the BİRUNİ platform with census population results by administrative units (province, district, town, and village).

name: Ministry of Health Open Data Portal
description: Open data portal of the Turkish Ministry of Health, providing health-related datasets for preview, download, and project use.

name: Republic of Türkiye Supreme Election Council Open Data Portal
description: Open data portal of the Supreme Election Council of Turkey (Yüksek Seçim Kurulu), publishing election-related datasets for public access.

name: MTA Yerbilimleri Harita Görüntüleyici
description: Public geological map viewer with geology, landslide, fault, earthquake, and map-index layers.

name: HGM Atlas
description: National web mapping application of the General Directorate of Mapping (HGM Atlas).

name: HGM Geoportal
description: National mapping-agency geoportal for discovering HGM geospatial products and metadata.

name: TUCBS Ulusal Coğrafi Bilgi Platformu
description: Turkey National Geographic Information System (TUCBS) portal for geographic metadata, map viewing, and open geospatial layers.

name: TÜİK Coğrafi İstatistik Portalı (Geographic Statistics Portal)
description: Official geographic statistics portal of the Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK), presenting official indicators as thematic maps at NUTS-2, province, district, and 1 km grid levels.

name: Harman - Türkiye Akademik Arşivi
description: Harman (Türkiye Akademik Arşivi) is Turkey's national academic archive search service, developed by TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM. It harvests metadata from institutional open archives and journals according to international standards and provides a central Solr-based discovery interface. Full records remain at the original archive URLs. The service launched in 2016 as part of TÜBİTAK open science activities.

name: TÜİK Sınıflamalar (DIESS)
description: Turkish Statistical Institute statistical classifications database (Sınıflamalar) on the BİRUNİ platform. Browse national and international standard statistical classifications (NACE, CPA, ISIC, PRODCOM, IBBS and others) with correspondence tables.

name: YÖK National Thesis Center
description: YÖK National Thesis Center is a scientific data repository operated by Council of Higher Education.

name: KOERI TOROS Near-Fault Observatory
description: Kandilli Observatory TOROS near-fault observatory services for the Marmara region, exposing FDSN event catalogues plus radon station, concentration, and Vp/Vs products.

name: Sivas Municipality Open Data Platform
description: Open data portal of Sivas Municipality, publishing municipal datasets by theme.

name: Bahçelievler Belediyesi Açık Veri Portalı
description: Open data portal of Bahçelievler Municipality (Istanbul), a public SPA catalog distinct from the municipal KEOS geoportal.

name: Küçükçekmece Belediyesi Açık Veri Platformu
description: It was created by Küçükçekmece Municipality as the first step in releasing Küçükçekmece's data. Protection of Personal Data It has made this data available free of charge so that it can be accessed in accordance with the provisions of the Law (KVKK) and the law.id: acikverikucukcekmecebeltr

name: Marmara Municipalities Union Open Data Portal
description: Open data portal of the Marmara Municipalities Union (Marmara Belediyeler Birliği), publishing datasets and analysis reports on urbanization, environment, culture, local diplomacy, and municipal services across the Marmara Region of Turkey.

name: Çekmeköy Belediyesi Açık Veri Portalı
description: Open data portal of Çekmeköy Municipality (Istanbul), publishing municipal datasets from the municipality and affiliated organizations for public reuse.

name: Eyüpsultan Belediyesi open data portal
description: Official open data portal for Eyüpsultan municipality.

name: Beyoğlu Kent Rehberi
description: Public city-guide map of Beyoğlu municipality.

name: İstanbul Şehir Haritası
description: Public city map of Istanbul metropolitan municipality (Şehir Haritası).

name: Trabzon Kent Rehberi
description: Public city-guide map of Trabzon metropolitan municipality, distinct from the GeoServer OGC endpoint.

name: Central Bank of Samoa Statistics
description: Central Bank of Samoa public statistics tables covering monetary, banking, fiscal, prices, and external-sector indicators.

name: MINECOFIN Data
description: File catalog of Rwanda government finance statistics (GFSM 2014 workbooks), public debt stock series, and the macro framework dataset.

name: National Bank of Rwanda Statistics
description: National Bank of Rwanda public statistics catalog of monetary, financial, and macroeconomic tables. Distinct from the registration-required FX rates API.

name: Rwanda Data Sharing Platform
description: National Data Sharing Platform of Rwanda. Public catalog of government datasets operated by the Rwanda Information Society Authority (RISA), with a JSON API at api.data.gov.rw.

name: BCT Statistiques
description: Banque Centrale de Tunisie public statistical tables covering monetary, banking, and related macroeconomic series, beyond the IMF National Summary Data Page.

name: Tunisia Data Portal
description: INS Tunisia data portal for analyzing, visualizing, and reporting official statistical indicators for Tunisia and its governorates. No public machine-readable API was found beyond the website.

name: Portail Mizaniatouna du Ministère des Finances
description: Ministry of Finance BOOST / open-budget portal (Mizaniatouna) with interactive visualizations of Tunisian government budget allocations and expenditure.

name: Plateforme du Budget ouvert de la Tunisie
description: Open-budget platform of the Tunisian Ministry of Finance with public dashboards of government expenditure by programme, operational unit, and economic nature.

name: Données ouvertes du Ministère de l'Intérieur
description: Sectoral open data portal of the Tunisian Ministry of Interior, listing public datasets on security, civil protection, and interior administration.

name: Portail sectoriel des données ouvertes du transport
description: Sectoral open data portal of the Tunisian Ministry of Transport, publishing transport networks, stops, and related public datasets. The former CKAN API is no longer available.

name: Portail des données agricoles ouvertes
description: Open data portal of the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, publishing agricultural, water, and fisheries datasets for Tunisia. The former CKAN API is no longer available.

name: OTC Géoportail cadastral
description: Cadastral geoportal of the Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre (OTC), providing web-GIS access to Tunisian cadastral and topographic information.

name: Registre National des Données Publiques
description: National Register of Public Data (registre.data.gov.tn / PDIMS), the inventory of datasets produced by Tunisian public bodies. Complementary to the national open data portal at data.gov.tn.

name: Bactibase: database dedicated to bacteriocins
description: BACTIBASE contains calculated or predicted physicochemical properties of bacteriocins produced by both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria. The information in the database allows rapid prediction of structure/function relationships and target organisms of these peptides, supporting medical and food applications.

name: Gazeta Zyrtare
description: Official gazette of the Republic of Kosovo.

name: Geodata Togo
description: National institutional geoportal of Togo (Geodata Togo / Géoportail institutionnel), a custom map catalogue also served at geoportail.gouv.tg. Public layers are published through GeoServer WMS, WCS, and WMTS; WFS is not publicly accessible.

name: FertiTogo
description: ITRA soil fertility information system for Togo. Publishes regional fertility maps (pH, organic matter, available phosphorus, exchangeable potassium, and salinity) as downloadable products, plus crop fertilizer recommendation sheets and an interactive advisor built from soil samples collected across the country.
